proof.tactics:
by
  have hPNT := prime_counting_ratio
  have hMERT := prime_reciprocal_mertens
  have hEUL := prime_euler_product_asymptotic
  obtain ⟨hVlow, hcut⟩ := V_lower_bound_and_power_cutoff hPNT
  
  have hmem : ∀ (C : Finset ℕ) (lo hi : ℝ), 0 ≤ hi → (∀ b ∈ C, 0 < b) → ∀ bp : ℕ × ℕ,
      bp ∈ corePairs C lo hi ↔ bp.1 ∈ C ∧ bp.2.Prime ∧
        lo < (corePairValue bp : ℝ) ∧ (corePairValue bp : ℝ) ≤ hi := by
    intro C lo hi hhi hC bp
    rcases bp with ⟨b, p⟩
    simp only [corePairs, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.product_eq_sprod,
      Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_range]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨⟨hb, _⟩, hp, hlo, hupper⟩
      exact ⟨hb, hp, hlo, hupper⟩
    · rintro ⟨hb, hp, hlo, hupper⟩
      refine ⟨⟨hb, ?_⟩, hp, hlo, hupper⟩
      have hbpos := hC b hb
      have hfloor := (Nat.le_floor_iff hhi).mpr hupper
      have hle : p - 1 ≤ corePairValue (b, p) := by
        unfold corePairValue
        nlinarith
      omega
  
  have htot : ∀ (x : ℝ), 0 ≤ x → ∀ n : ℕ,
      n ∈ totientsUpTo x ↔ 1 ≤ n ∧ (n : ℝ) ≤ x ∧ ∃ m : ℕ, m.totient = n := by
    intro x hx n
    simp only [totientsUpTo, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, h3⟩
      exact ⟨h1, (Nat.le_floor_iff hx).mp h2, h3⟩
    · rintro ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩
      exact ⟨⟨h1, (Nat.le_floor_iff hx).mpr h2⟩, h3⟩
  have hLL : Tendsto logLog atTop atTop :=
    Real.tendsto_log_atTop.comp Real.tendsto_log_atTop
  have hVpos : ∀ᶠ y : ℝ in atTop, 0 < V y := by
    filter_upwards [hVlow, eventually_gt_atTop (1 : ℝ)] with y hy hy1
    have hlog : 0 < Real.log y := Real.log_pos hy1
    have : 0 < y / (2 * Real.log y) := by positivity
    linarith
  apply doubling_of_raw_counting_contracts
  intro ε hε hε2
  obtain ⟨L, R, P, hL, hcov⟩ :=
    exists_powerRawPairs_fullSelection_coverage hPNT hMERT hEUL ε hε
  let S : ∀ y : ℝ, CoreRecords.CoreSelection y (L y) R P :=
    fun y => CoreRecords.CoreSelection.fullSelection y (L y) R P
  let Q : ℝ → Finset (ℕ × ℕ) := fun y => CoreRecords.powerRawPairs (S y)
  have h6 := record_cores_and_actual_values R 4
  have hcore : ∀ᶠ y : ℝ in atTop, ∀ b ∈ (S y).cores, 0 < b ∧
      Real.log b ≤ Real.log R + 4 * Real.log (logLog y) * (Real.log y) ^ (4 / 5 : ℝ) := by
    filter_upwards [h6, hL] with y hy hLy
    exact (hy (L y) P (S y) hLy).1
  have hact : ∀ᶠ y : ℝ in atTop, ∀ bp ∈ Q y, corePairValue bp ∈ totientsUpTo y := by
    filter_upwards [h6, hL] with y hy hLy
    exact (hy (L y) P (S y) hLy).2
  have hcov' : ∀ᶠ y : ℝ in atTop,
      V y - (((Q y).image corePairValue).card : ℝ) ≤ ε * V y + V (y ^ (99 / 100 : ℝ)) := hcov
  
  have hcoll : (fun y => ((collisionPoints (Q y) corePairValue).card : ℝ)) =o[atTop] V := by
    have h8 := powerRawPairs_collisions_bound hPNT hMERT hEUL R P 4 (by norm_num)
    have hb : ∀ᶠ y : ℝ in atTop, ((collisionPoints (Q y) corePairValue).card : ℝ) ≤
        4 * R * (y / (Real.log y * (logLog y) ^ 2)) := by
      filter_upwards [h8, hL] with y hy hLy
      exact hy (L y) (S y) hLy
    rw [Asymptotics.isLittleO_iff]
    intro c hc
    filter_upwards [hb, hVlow, hLL.eventually_ge_atTop (max 1 (8 * (R : ℝ) / c)),
      eventually_gt_atTop (1 : ℝ)] with y hcount hV hTlarge hy
    have hT1 : 1 ≤ logLog y := (le_max_left _ _).trans hTlarge
    have hTq : 8 * (R : ℝ) / c ≤ logLog y := (le_max_right _ _).trans hTlarge
    have hTp : 0 < logLog y := by linarith
    have hTs : 0 < (logLog y) ^ 2 := by positivity
    have hlog : 0 < Real.log y := Real.log_pos hy
    have hy0 : 0 < y := by linarith
    have hR0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ R := Nat.cast_nonneg R
    have hcoeff : 4 * (R : ℝ) / (logLog y) ^ 2 ≤ c / 2 := by
      rw [div_le_iff₀ hTs]
      have he := (div_le_iff₀ hc).mp hTq
      have hsq : logLog y ≤ (logLog y) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
      have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsq hc.le
      nlinarith
    have hV' : y / Real.log y ≤ 2 * V y := by
      rw [div_le_iff₀ hlog]
      have hv := (div_le_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < 2 * Real.log y)).mp hV
      nlinarith
    have hVn : 0 ≤ V y := by positivity
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _), abs_of_nonneg hVn]
    calc
      _ ≤ 4 * R * (y / (Real.log y * (logLog y) ^ 2)) := hcount
      _ = (4 * (R : ℝ) / (logLog y) ^ 2) * (y / Real.log y) := by
        field_simp
      _ ≤ (c / 2) * (2 * V y) :=
        mul_le_mul hcoeff hV' (div_nonneg hy0.le hlog.le) (by positivity)
      _ = c * V y := by ring
  
  have hnonQ : ∀ᶠ y : ℝ in atTop, (Q y).Nonempty := by
    filter_upwards [hcov', hcut.def (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 4), hVpos] with y hy hr hV
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hV] at hr
    by_contra hQ
    have hzero : Q y = ∅ := Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hQ
    rw [hzero, Finset.image_empty, Finset.card_empty, Nat.cast_zero, sub_zero] at hy
    have := (le_abs_self (V (y ^ (99 / 100 : ℝ)))).trans hr
    nlinarith
  have hnonS : ∀ᶠ y : ℝ in atTop, (S y).cores.Nonempty := by
    filter_upwards [hnonQ] with y hy
    obtain ⟨bp, hbp⟩ := hy
    have hbp' : bp ∈ corePairs (S y).cores (y ^ (99 / 100 : ℝ)) y := hbp
    simp only [corePairs, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.product_eq_sprod,
      Finset.mem_product] at hbp'
    exact ⟨bp.1, hbp'.1.1⟩
  
  have h7 := power_corePairs_imbalance hPNT (fun y => (S y).cores) (R : ℝ) 4 hcore hnonS
  have himb : (fun y => ((Q y).card : ℝ) -
      2 * (((Q y).filter (fun a => corePairValue a ∈ totientsUpTo (y / 2))).card : ℝ)) =o[atTop]
      (fun y => ((Q y).card : ℝ)) := by
    refine h7.congr' ?_ (Eventually.of_forall fun _ => rfl)
    filter_upwards [hact, hcore, eventually_ge_atTop (0 : ℝ)] with y hy hC hy0
    have hCpos : ∀ b ∈ (S y).cores, 0 < b := fun b hb => (hC b hb).1
    have hh : 0 ≤ y / 2 := by positivity
    have he : (Q y).filter (fun a => corePairValue a ∈ totientsUpTo (y / 2)) =
        corePairs (S y).cores (y ^ (99 / 100 : ℝ)) (y / 2) := by
      ext bp
      rw [Finset.mem_filter]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨hb, hsmall⟩
        have hm := (hmem _ _ _ hy0 hCpos bp).mp hb
        exact (hmem _ _ _ hh hCpos bp).mpr
          ⟨hm.1, hm.2.1, hm.2.2.1, ((htot _ hh _).mp hsmall).2.1⟩
      · intro hb
        have hm := (hmem _ _ _ hh hCpos bp).mp hb
        have hlarge : bp ∈ Q y := (hmem _ _ _ hy0 hCpos bp).mpr
          ⟨hm.1, hm.2.1, hm.2.2.1, hm.2.2.2.trans (by linarith)⟩
        have hv := (htot _ hy0 _).mp (hy bp hlarge)
        exact ⟨hlarge, (htot _ hh _).mpr ⟨hv.1, hm.2.2.2, hv.2.2⟩⟩
    show _ = ((Q y).card : ℝ) - _
    rw [he]
    rfl
  refine ⟨Q, fun _ => corePairValue, fun y => V (y ^ (99 / 100 : ℝ)), ?_, hcut, hcoll, himb⟩
  filter_upwards [hact, hcov'] with y h1 h2
  exact ⟨h1, h2⟩

erdos_416.parts.i.definitions:
noncomputable def totientsUpTo (x : ℝ) : Finset ℕ :=
  (Finset.Icc 1 ⌊x⌋₊).filter (fun n => ∃ m : ℕ, m.totient = n)


noncomputable def collisionPoints {α β : Type*} (s : Finset α) (f : α → β) : Finset α :=
  s.filter fun a => ∃ b ∈ s, b ≠ a ∧ f b = f a


def largestPrimeFactor (n : ℕ) : ℕ := max 1 (n.primeFactors.sup id)

noncomputable def logLog (x : ℝ) : ℝ := Real.log (Real.log x)


def corePairValue (bp : ℕ × ℕ) : ℕ := (bp.2 - 1) * bp.1


noncomputable def corePairs (cores : Finset ℕ) (lo hi : ℝ) : Finset (ℕ × ℕ) :=
  (cores.product (Finset.range (⌊hi⌋₊ + 2))).filter fun bp =>
    bp.2.Prime ∧ lo < (corePairValue bp : ℝ) ∧ (corePairValue bp : ℝ) ≤ hi

noncomputable def fordWeight (idx : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ((idx : ℝ) + 1) * Real.log ((idx : ℝ) + 1) - idx * Real.log idx - 1

def weightedForm {L : ℕ} (a : Fin L → ℝ) : (Fin L → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ where
  toFun x := ∑ idx, a idx * x idx
  map_add' x y := by simp [mul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  map_smul' t x := by simp [Finset.mul_sum, mul_left_comm]

noncomputable def FordGeometry.outerForm (L : ℕ) : (Fin L → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ :=
  weightedForm (fun idx => fordWeight (idx.val + 1))

noncomputable def CollisionBox.cutoff (Y ν : ℝ) : ℝ := Real.exp ((Real.log Y) ^ ν)

noncomputable def CollisionBox.primeCoordinate (T : ℝ) (p : ℕ) : ℝ := logLog p / T


structure CoreRecords.LowerCoreRecord (Y : ℝ) (L R : ℕ) (P : ℝ) where
  length_pos : 0 < L
  tail : ℕ
  tail_pos : 0 < tail
  tail_le : tail ≤ R
  lower : Fin L → ℕ
  prime : ∀ idx, (lower idx).Prime
  order : StrictAnti lower
  last_lower : max 17 (largestPrimeFactor tail) < lower ⟨L - 1, by omega⟩
  last_upper : (lower ⟨L - 1, by omega⟩ : ℝ) ≤ P
  gaps : ∀ idx j : Fin L, j.val = idx.val + 1 →
    (6 / 5 : ℝ) * logLog (lower j) ≤ logLog (lower idx)
  upper : ∀ idx, (lower idx : ℝ) ≤ CollisionBox.cutoff Y (4 / 5)
  facet : FordGeometry.outerForm L
      (fun idx => CollisionBox.primeCoordinate (logLog Y) (lower idx)) ≤
    1 - (logLog Y) ^ (-1 / 8 : ℝ)

noncomputable def CoreRecords.LowerCoreRecord.integer {Y P : ℝ} {L R : ℕ}
    (Q : CoreRecords.LowerCoreRecord Y L R P) : ℕ :=
  Q.tail * ∏ idx, Q.lower idx

noncomputable def CoreRecords.LowerCoreRecord.numericalCore {Y P : ℝ} {L R : ℕ}
    (Q : CoreRecords.LowerCoreRecord Y L R P) : ℕ :=
  Q.tail.totient * ∏ idx, (Q.lower idx - 1)

noncomputable def CoreRecords.LowerCoreRecord.boundedEncoding {Y P : ℝ} {L R : ℕ}
    (Q : CoreRecords.LowerCoreRecord Y L R P) :
    Fin (R + 1) × (Fin L → Fin (⌊CollisionBox.cutoff Y (4 / 5)⌋₊ + 1)) :=
  (⟨Q.tail, by have := Q.tail_le; omega⟩, fun idx => ⟨Q.lower idx, by
    have hcut : 0 ≤ CollisionBox.cutoff Y (4 / 5) := (Real.exp_pos _).le
    have hle := (Nat.le_floor_iff hcut).mpr (Q.upper idx)
    omega⟩)

noncomputable instance CoreRecords.LowerCoreRecord.instFintype {Y P : ℝ} {L R : ℕ} :
    Fintype (CoreRecords.LowerCoreRecord Y L R P) :=
  Fintype.ofInjective CoreRecords.LowerCoreRecord.boundedEncoding (by
    intro Q₁ Q₂ h
    have h1 : Q₁.tail = Q₂.tail := congrArg (fun z => z.1.val) h
    have h2 : Q₁.lower = Q₂.lower := funext fun idx => congrArg (fun z => (z.2 idx).val) h
    cases Q₁
    cases Q₂
    cases h1
    cases h2
    rfl)


structure CoreRecords.CoreSelection (Y : ℝ) (L R : ℕ) (P : ℝ) where
  cores : Finset ℕ
  record : ∀ _b : cores, CoreRecords.LowerCoreRecord Y L R P
  core_eq : ∀ b : cores, (record b).numericalCore = b.val

noncomputable def CoreRecords.CoreSelection.ofRecords {Y P : ℝ} {L R : ℕ}
    (F : Finset (CoreRecords.LowerCoreRecord Y L R P)) : CoreRecords.CoreSelection Y L R P where
  cores := F.image CoreRecords.LowerCoreRecord.numericalCore
  record := fun b => Classical.choose (Finset.mem_image.mp b.property)
  core_eq := fun b => (Classical.choose_spec (Finset.mem_image.mp b.property)).2

noncomputable def CoreRecords.CoreSelection.fullSelection (Y : ℝ) (L R : ℕ) (P : ℝ) :
    CoreRecords.CoreSelection Y L R P :=
  CoreRecords.CoreSelection.ofRecords Finset.univ

noncomputable def CoreRecords.powerRawPairs {Y P : ℝ} {L R : ℕ}
    (S : CoreRecords.CoreSelection Y L R P) : Finset (ℕ × ℕ) :=
  corePairs S.cores (Y ^ (99 / 100 : ℝ)) Y

subgoal_signatures.name: prime_counting_ratio
subgoal_signatures.statement: Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => (Nat.primeCounting ⌊x⌋₊ : ℝ) / (x / Real.log x)) atTop (𝓝 1)

subgoal_signatures.name: prime_reciprocal_mertens
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ, 2 ≤ x →
      |(∑ p ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊x⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, (1 : ℝ) / p) - Real.log (Real.log x)| ≤ C

subgoal_signatures.name: prime_euler_product_asymptotic
subgoal_signatures.statement:
Asymptotics.IsEquivalent atTop
      (fun x : ℝ => ∏ p ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊x⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, (1 - (1 : ℝ) / p))
      (fun x => Real.exp (-Real.eulerMascheroniConstant) / Real.log x)

subgoal_signatures.name: doubling_of_raw_counting_contracts
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(hcontracts : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 →
      ∃ (Q : ℝ → Finset (ℕ × ℕ)) (f : ℝ → ℕ × ℕ → ℕ) (r : ℝ → ℝ),
        (∀ᶠ y : ℝ in atTop, (∀ a ∈ Q y, f y a ∈ totientsUpTo y) ∧
          V y - (((Q y).image (f y)).card : ℝ) ≤ ε * V y + r y) ∧
        r =o[atTop] V ∧
        (fun y => ((collisionPoints (Q y) (f y)).card : ℝ)) =o[atTop] V ∧
        (fun y => ((Q y).card : ℝ) -
            2 * (((Q y).filter (fun a => f y a ∈ totientsUpTo (y / 2))).card : ℝ)) =o[atTop]
          (fun y => ((Q y).card : ℝ))) :
    Tendsto (fun x => V (2 * x) / V x) atTop (𝓝 2)

subgoal_signatures.name: V_lower_bound_and_power_cutoff
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(hPNT : Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => (Nat.primeCounting ⌊x⌋₊ : ℝ) / (x / Real.log x)) atTop (𝓝 1)) :
    (∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop, x / (2 * Real.log x) ≤ V x) ∧
      (fun x : ℝ => V (x ^ (99 / 100 : ℝ))) =o[atTop] V

subgoal_signatures.name: record_cores_and_actual_values
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(R : ℕ) (A : ℝ) :
    ∀ᶠ Y : ℝ in atTop, ∀ (L : ℕ) (P : ℝ) (S : CoreRecords.CoreSelection Y L R P),
      (L : ℝ) ≤ A * Real.log (logLog Y) →
        (∀ b ∈ S.cores, 0 < b ∧
          Real.log b ≤ Real.log R + A * Real.log (logLog Y) * (Real.log Y) ^ (4 / 5 : ℝ)) ∧
        (∀ bp ∈ CoreRecords.powerRawPairs S, corePairValue bp ∈ totientsUpTo Y)

subgoal_signatures.name: power_corePairs_imbalance
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(hPNT : Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => (Nat.primeCounting ⌊x⌋₊ : ℝ) / (x / Real.log x)) atTop (𝓝 1))
    (C : ℝ → Finset ℕ) (R A : ℝ)
    (hC : ∀ᶠ y : ℝ in atTop, ∀ b ∈ C y, 0 < b ∧
      Real.log b ≤ Real.log R + A * Real.log (logLog y) * (Real.log y) ^ (4 / 5 : ℝ))

    have hε12 : min (η / 2) (1 / 4) < 1 / 2 := lt_of_le_of_lt (min_le_right _ _) (by norm_num)
    have hδ0 : 0 < min (η / 6) 1 := lt_min (by linarith) (by norm_num)
    have hδ1 : min (η / 6) 1 ≤ 1 := min_le_right _ _
    have hsum : min (η / 2) (1 / 4) + 3 * min (η / 6) 1 ≤ η := by
      have := min_le_left (η / 2) (1 / 4)
      have := min_le_left (η / 6) 1
      linarith
    obtain ⟨Q, f, r, hev, hr, hC, himb⟩ := hcontracts _ hε0 hε12
    filter_upwards [hev, hr.bound hδ0, hC.bound hδ0, himb.bound hδ0,
      eventually_ge_atTop (1 : ℝ)] with y hy hry hCy hBy hy1
    obtain ⟨hmap, hmiss⟩ := hy
    have hy0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ y := by linarith
    obtain ⟨hs2a, hs2c, hs2b⟩ := s2 y hy0 (Q y) (f y) hmap
    have hs1a := s1 (Q y) (Q y) (f y) (subset_refl _)
    have hs1b := s1 (Q y) ((Q y).filter (fun a => f y a ∈ totientsUpTo (y / 2))) (f y)
      (Finset.filter_subset _ _)
    have hIN := Finset.card_image_le (s := Q y) (f := f y)
    have hI0H := Finset.card_image_le
      (s := (Q y).filter (fun a => f y a ∈ totientsUpTo (y / 2))) (f := f y)
    rw [hVeq y] at hmiss hry hCy
    simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs, Nat.abs_cast] at hry hCy hBy
    rw [hVeq y, hVeq (y / 2)]
    have e1 : ((Q y).card : ℝ) ≤ (((Q y).image (f y)).card : ℝ) +
        ((collisionPoints (Q y) (f y)).card : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hs1a
    have e2 : (((Q y).filter (fun a => f y a ∈ totientsUpTo (y / 2))).card : ℝ) ≤
        ((((Q y).filter (fun a => f y a ∈ totientsUpTo (y / 2))).image (f y)).card : ℝ) +
        ((collisionPoints (Q y) (f y)).card : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hs1b
    have e3 : (((Q y).image (f y)).card : ℝ) ≤ ((Q y).card : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hIN
    have e4 : ((((Q y).filter (fun a => f y a ∈ totientsUpTo (y / 2))).image (f y)).card : ℝ) ≤
        (((Q y).filter (fun a => f y a ∈ totientsUpTo (y / 2))).card : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast hI0H
    have e5 : (((Q y).image (f y)).card : ℝ) ≤ ((totientsUpTo y).card : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast hs2a
    have e6 : ((totientsUpTo (y / 2)).card : ℝ) + (((Q y).image (f y)).card : ℝ) ≤
        ((((Q y).filter (fun a => f y a ∈ totientsUpTo (y / 2))).image (f y)).card : ℝ) +
          ((totientsUpTo y).card : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hs2b
    have e7 : ((((Q y).filter (fun a => f y a ∈ totientsUpTo (y / 2))).image (f y)).card : ℝ) ≤
        ((totientsUpTo (y / 2)).card : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hs2c
    have key := s3 ((totientsUpTo y).card : ℝ) ((totientsUpTo (y / 2)).card : ℝ)
      ((Q y).card : ℝ) (((Q y).filter (fun a => f y a ∈ totientsUpTo (y / 2))).card : ℝ)
      (((Q y).image (f y)).card : ℝ) ((collisionPoints (Q y) (f y)).card : ℝ) (r y)
      (min (η / 2) (1 / 4)) (min (η / 6) 1) (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hε0.le hδ0.le hδ1 e5 hmiss hry
      (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hCy e3 e1 hBy (by linarith) (by linarith)
    exact key.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsum (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
  
  have hW : ∀ᶠ y in atTop, 1 ≤ V y := (eventually_ge_atTop 1).mono fun y hy => s5 y hy
  have hlim := s4 V (fun y => V (y / 2)) hW hmain
  have htwo : Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => 2 * x) atTop atTop :=
    tendsto_id.const_mul_atTop (by norm_num)
  refine (hlim.comp htwo).congr (fun x => ?_)
  simp only [Function.comp]
  rw [show 2 * x / 2 = x by ring]

(hPNT : Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => (Nat.primeCounting ⌊x⌋₊ : ℝ) / (x / Real.log x)) atTop (𝓝 1)) :
    (∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop, x / (2 * Real.log x) ≤ V x) ∧

signature.name: V_lower_bound_and_power_cutoff
signature.statement:
(hPNT : Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => (Nat.primeCounting ⌊x⌋₊ : ℝ) / (x / Real.log x)) atTop (𝓝 1)) :
    (∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop, x / (2 * Real.log x) ≤ V x) ∧
      (fun x : ℝ => V (x ^ (99 / 100 : ℝ))) =o[atTop] V

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have s1 : ∀ x : ℝ, ((Nat.primeCounting ⌊x⌋₊ : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ V x := by
    intro x
    unfold V
    rw [Nat.cast_le, Nat.primeCounting, ← Nat.primesBelow_card_eq_primeCounting']
    apply Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn (fun p => p - 1)
    · intro p hp
      have hp' := hp
      simp only [Finset.mem_coe, Nat.mem_primesBelow] at hp'
      obtain ⟨hlt, hpr⟩ := hp'
      have h2 := hpr.two_le
      simp only [Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc]
      exact ⟨⟨by omega, by omega⟩, p, Nat.totient_prime hpr⟩
    · intro p hp q hq hpq
      simp only [Finset.mem_coe, Nat.mem_primesBelow] at hp hq
      have := hp.2.two_le
      have := hq.2.two_le
      simp only at hpq
      omega
  
  have s2 : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 ≤ y → V y ≤ y := by
    intro y hy
    have h1 : V y ≤ ((Finset.Icc 1 ⌊y⌋₊).card : ℝ) := by
      unfold V
      exact_mod_cast Finset.card_filter_le _ _
    have h2 : ((Finset.Icc 1 ⌊y⌋₊).card : ℝ) = (⌊y⌋₊ : ℝ) := by simp
    have h3 : ((⌊y⌋₊ : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ y := Nat.floor_le hy
    linarith
  
  have s3 : ∀ c : ℝ, 0 < c → ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop,
      x ^ (99 / 100 : ℝ) ≤ c * (x / (2 * Real.log x)) := by
    intro c hc
    have hlo := (isLittleO_log_rpow_atTop (r := (1 / 100 : ℝ)) (by norm_num)).bound
      (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < c / 2)
    filter_upwards [hlo, eventually_gt_atTop (1 : ℝ)] with x hx hx1
    have hx0 : 0 < x := by linarith
    have hlog : 0 < Real.log x := Real.log_pos hx1
    have hr1 : 0 < x ^ (1 / 100 : ℝ) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hx0 _
    have hr99 : 0 < x ^ (99 / 100 : ℝ) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hx0 _
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hlog, abs_of_pos hr1] at hx
    have hid : x ^ (99 / 100 : ℝ) * x ^ (1 / 100 : ℝ) = x := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_add hx0]
      norm_num
    have key : x ^ (99 / 100 : ℝ) * Real.log x ≤ (c / 2) * x := by
      calc x ^ (99 / 100 : ℝ) * Real.log x
            ≤ x ^ (99 / 100 : ℝ) * ((c / 2) * x ^ (1 / 100 : ℝ)) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx hr99.le
        _ = (c / 2) * (x ^ (99 / 100 : ℝ) * x ^ (1 / 100 : ℝ)) := by ring
        _ = (c / 2) * x := by rw [hid]
    have heq : c * (x / (2 * Real.log x)) = (c / 2) * x / Real.log x := by ring
    rw [heq, le_div_iff₀ hlog]
    exact key
  
  have hA : ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop, x / (2 * Real.log x) ≤ V x := by
    filter_upwards [hPNT.eventually_const_le (by norm_num : (1 / 2 : ℝ) < 1),
      eventually_gt_atTop (1 : ℝ)] with x hx hx1
    have hx0 : 0 < x := by linarith
    have hlog : 0 < Real.log x := Real.log_pos hx1
    have hpos : 0 < x / Real.log x := div_pos hx0 hlog
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hpos] at hx
    have := s1 x
    have heq : x / (2 * Real.log x) = 1 / 2 * (x / Real.log x) := by ring
    linarith
  
  refine ⟨hA, ?_⟩
  rw [Asymptotics.isLittleO_iff]
  intro c hc
  filter_upwards [hA, s3 c hc, eventually_gt_atTop (1 : ℝ)] with x ha hs hx1
  have hx0 : 0 < x := by linarith
  have hr : 0 ≤ x ^ (99 / 100 : ℝ) := Real.rpow_nonneg hx0.le _
  have hV1 : 0 ≤ V (x ^ (99 / 100 : ℝ)) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
  have hV2 : 0 ≤ V x := Nat.cast_nonneg _
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hV1, abs_of_nonneg hV2]
  calc V (x ^ (99 / 100 : ℝ)) ≤ x ^ (99 / 100 : ℝ) := s2 _ hr
    _ ≤ c * (x / (2 * Real.log x)) := hs
    _ ≤ c * V x := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ha hc.le

informal_problem.statement:
(R : ℕ) (A : ℝ) :
    ∀ᶠ Y : ℝ in atTop, ∀ (L : ℕ) (P : ℝ) (S : CoreRecords.CoreSelection Y L R P),
      (L : ℝ) ≤ A * Real.log (logLog Y) →
        (∀ b ∈ S.cores, 0 < b ∧
          Real.log b ≤ Real.log R + A * Real.log (logLog Y) * (Real.log Y) ^ (4 / 5 : ℝ)) ∧
        (∀ bp ∈ CoreRecords.powerRawPairs S, corePairValue bp ∈ totientsUpTo Y)

signature.name: record_cores_and_actual_values
signature.statement:
(R : ℕ) (A : ℝ) :
    ∀ᶠ Y : ℝ in atTop, ∀ (L : ℕ) (P : ℝ) (S : CoreRecords.CoreSelection Y L R P),
      (L : ℝ) ≤ A * Real.log (logLog Y) →
        (∀ b ∈ S.cores, 0 < b ∧
          Real.log b ≤ Real.log R + A * Real.log (logLog Y) * (Real.log Y) ^ (4 / 5 : ℝ)) ∧
        (∀ bp ∈ CoreRecords.powerRawPairs S, corePairValue bp ∈ totientsUpTo Y)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have s1 : ∀ {Y P : ℝ} {L : ℕ} (Q : CoreRecords.LowerCoreRecord Y L R P),
      0 < Q.numericalCore ∧ Real.log (Q.numericalCore : ℝ) ≤
        Real.log (R : ℝ) + (L : ℝ) * (Real.log Y) ^ (4 / 5 : ℝ) := by
    intro Y P L Q
    have htpos : 0 < Q.tail.totient := Nat.totient_pos.mpr Q.tail_pos
    have hfac : ∀ idx, 0 < Q.lower idx - 1 := fun idx => by
      have := (Q.prime idx).two_le
      omega
    have hprodpos : 0 < ∏ idx, (Q.lower idx - 1) := Finset.prod_pos fun idx _ => hfac idx
    refine ⟨Nat.mul_pos htpos hprodpos, ?_⟩
    unfold CoreRecords.LowerCoreRecord.numericalCore
    have hne1 : ((Q.tail.totient : ℕ) : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast htpos.ne'
    have hne2 : (∏ idx, ((Q.lower idx - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≠ 0 :=
      (Finset.prod_pos fun i _ => (by exact_mod_cast hfac i : (0:ℝ) < ((Q.lower i - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))).ne'
    rw [Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_prod, Real.log_mul hne1 hne2,
      Real.log_prod (fun i _ => (by exact_mod_cast (hfac i).ne' : ((Q.lower i - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≠ 0))]
    have h1 : Real.log (Q.tail.totient : ℝ) ≤ Real.log R := by
      apply Real.log_le_log (by exact_mod_cast htpos)
      exact_mod_cast (Nat.totient_le _).trans Q.tail_le
    have h2 : ∀ idx ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin L)),
        Real.log ((Q.lower idx - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (Real.log Y) ^ (4 / 5 : ℝ) := by
      intro idx _
      have hle : ((Q.lower idx - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp ((Real.log Y) ^ (4 / 5 : ℝ)) := by
        have hu := Q.upper idx
        unfold CollisionBox.cutoff at hu
        exact le_trans (by exact_mod_cast Nat.sub_le _ _) hu
      calc Real.log ((Q.lower idx - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)
          ≤ Real.log (Real.exp ((Real.log Y) ^ (4 / 5 : ℝ))) :=
            Real.log_le_log (by exact_mod_cast hfac idx) hle
        _ = _ := Real.log_exp _
    have h3 := Finset.sum_le_card_nsmul Finset.univ _ _ h2
    rw [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul] at h3
    linarith
  
  have s2 : ∀ {Y P : ℝ} {L : ℕ} (Q : CoreRecords.LowerCoreRecord Y L R P) (p : ℕ), p.Prime →
      CollisionBox.cutoff Y (4 / 5) < (p : ℝ) →
        (Q.integer * p).totient = Q.numericalCore * (p - 1) := by
    intro Y P L Q p hp hcut
    have hL := Q.length_pos
    have hlow : ∀ idx, largestPrimeFactor Q.tail < Q.lower idx := fun idx =>
      (le_max_right _ _).trans_lt (Q.last_lower.trans_le (Q.order.antitone
        (show idx ≤ ⟨L - 1, by omega⟩ from by
          change idx.val ≤ L - 1
          omega)))
    have hlpf : ∀ r, r.Prime → r ∣ Q.tail → r ≤ largestPrimeFactor Q.tail := by
      intro r hr hrd
      have hmem : r ∈ Q.tail.primeFactors := Nat.mem_primeFactors.mpr ⟨hr, hrd, Q.tail_pos.ne'⟩
      unfold largestPrimeFactor
      exact le_trans (Finset.le_sup (f := id) hmem) (le_max_right _ _)
    have hcop_tail : ∀ idx, Nat.Coprime Q.tail (Q.lower idx) := by
      intro idx
      apply Nat.Coprime.symm
      rw [Nat.Prime.coprime_iff_not_dvd (Q.prime idx)]
      intro hd
      have h1 := hlpf _ (Q.prime idx) hd
      have h2 := hlow idx
      omega
    have hN : (∏ idx, Q.lower idx).totient = ∏ idx, (Q.lower idx - 1) := by
      have key : ∀ s : Finset (Fin L),
          (∏ i ∈ s, Q.lower i).totient = ∏ i ∈ s, (Q.lower i - 1) := by
        intro s
        refine Finset.induction_on s (by simp) ?_
        intro a s ha ih
        rw [Finset.prod_insert ha, Finset.prod_insert ha, Nat.totient_mul,
          Nat.totient_prime (Q.prime a), ih]
        apply Nat.Coprime.prod_right
        intro i hi
        rw [Nat.coprime_primes (Q.prime a) (Q.prime i)]
        intro heq
        have : a = i := Q.order.injective heq
        exact ha (this ▸ hi)
      exact key Finset.univ
    have hint : Q.integer.totient = Q.numericalCore := by
      unfold CoreRecords.LowerCoreRecord.integer CoreRecords.LowerCoreRecord.numericalCore
      rw [Nat.totient_mul (Nat.Coprime.prod_right fun i _ => hcop_tail i), hN]
    have hcopp : Nat.Coprime Q.integer p := by
      apply Nat.Coprime.symm
      rw [Nat.Prime.coprime_iff_not_dvd hp]
      intro hd
      unfold CoreRecords.LowerCoreRecord.integer at hd
      rcases (Nat.Prime.dvd_mul hp).mp hd with h | h
      · have h1 := hlpf p hp h
        have h2 := hlow ⟨L - 1, by omega⟩
        have h3 : (Q.lower ⟨L - 1, by omega⟩ : ℝ) < p := lt_of_le_of_lt (Q.upper _) hcut
        have h4 : Q.lower ⟨L - 1, by omega⟩ < p := by exact_mod_cast h3
        omega
      · obtain ⟨i, _, hi⟩ := (Prime.dvd_finset_prod_iff hp.prime _).mp h
        have heq : p = Q.lower i := (Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq hp (Q.prime i)).mp hi
        have h3 : (Q.lower i : ℝ) < p := lt_of_le_of_lt (Q.upper _) hcut
        rw [heq] at h3
        exact lt_irrefl _ h3
    rw [Nat.totient_mul hcopp, hint, Nat.totient_prime hp]
  
  have s3u : ∀ᶠ u : ℝ in atTop, Real.log R + (A * Real.log (Real.log u) + 1) * u ^ (4 / 5 : ℝ)
      < (99 / 100) * u := by
    have ht : Tendsto (fun u : ℝ => u ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ)) atTop atTop :=
      tendsto_rpow_atTop (by norm_num)
    filter_upwards [ht.eventually_ge_atTop (4 * (10 * |A| + 1)),
      eventually_ge_atTop (Real.exp 1), eventually_ge_atTop (4 * Real.log R + 1)]
      with u hu1 hue hur
    have hu0 : 0 < u := lt_of_lt_of_le (Real.exp_pos 1) hue
    have he1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp 1 := Real.one_le_exp (by norm_num)
    have hu1' : 1 ≤ u := le_trans he1 hue
    have hlogu : 1 ≤ Real.log u := by
      rw [← Real.log_exp 1]
      exact Real.log_le_log (Real.exp_pos 1) hue
    have hll0 : 0 ≤ Real.log (Real.log u) := Real.log_nonneg hlogu
    have hll1 : Real.log (Real.log u) ≤ Real.log u := by
      have := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by linarith : 0 < Real.log u)
      linarith
    have hlu : Real.log u ≤ u ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ) / (1 / 10) :=
      Real.log_le_rpow_div hu0.le (by norm_num)
    have habs := abs_nonneg A
    have hA : A * Real.log (Real.log u) ≤ 10 * |A| * u ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ) := by
      have h1 : A * Real.log (Real.log u) ≤ |A| * Real.log (Real.log u) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self A) hll0
      have h2 : |A| * Real.log (Real.log u) ≤ |A| * (u ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ) / (1 / 10)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hll1.trans hlu) habs
      have h3 : u ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ) / (1 / 10) = 10 * u ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ) := by ring
      rw [h3] at h2
      linarith
    have hc0 : 0 ≤ u ^ (4 / 5 : ℝ) := Real.rpow_nonneg hu0.le _
    have h9 : 0 ≤ u ^ (9 / 10 : ℝ) := Real.rpow_nonneg hu0.le _
    have hmul : u ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ) * u ^ (4 / 5 : ℝ) = u ^ (9 / 10 : ℝ) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_add hu0]; norm_num
    have hmul2 : u ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ) * u ^ (9 / 10 : ℝ) = u := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_add hu0]; norm_num
    have hle : u ^ (4 / 5 : ℝ) ≤ u ^ (9 / 10 : ℝ) :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hu1' (by norm_num)
    have hstep1 : (A * Real.log (Real.log u) + 1) * u ^ (4 / 5 : ℝ) ≤
        (10 * |A| * u ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ) + 1) * u ^ (4 / 5 : ℝ) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) hc0
    have hstep2 : (10 * |A| * u ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ) + 1) * u ^ (4 / 5 : ℝ) =
        10 * |A| * u ^ (9 / 10 : ℝ) + u ^ (4 / 5 : ℝ) := by
      rw [← hmul]; ring
    have hstep3 : 10 * |A| * u ^ (9 / 10 : ℝ) + u ^ (9 / 10 : ℝ) ≤ u / 4 := by
      calc 10 * |A| * u ^ (9 / 10 : ℝ) + u ^ (9 / 10 : ℝ)
          = (10 * |A| + 1) * u ^ (9 / 10 : ℝ) := by ring
        _ ≤ (u ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ) / 4) * u ^ (9 / 10 : ℝ) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) h9
        _ = u / 4 := by rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, hmul2]
    linarith
  have s3 : ∀ᶠ Y : ℝ in atTop, 1 ≤ Y ∧ Real.log (R : ℝ) + (A * Real.log (logLog Y) + 1) *
      (Real.log Y) ^ (4 / 5 : ℝ) < (99 / 100 : ℝ) * Real.log Y := by
    filter_upwards [Real.tendsto_log_atTop.eventually s3u, eventually_ge_atTop (1 : ℝ)]
      with Y hY h1
    refine ⟨h1, ?_⟩
    unfold logLog
    exact hY
  
  filter_upwards [s3] with Y hYs
  obtain ⟨hY1, hroom⟩ := hYs
  intro L P S hL
  have hu : 0 ≤ Real.log Y := Real.log_nonneg hY1
  have hc : 0 ≤ (Real.log Y) ^ (4 / 5 : ℝ) := Real.rpow_nonneg hu _
  have hK1 : (L : ℝ) * (Real.log Y) ^ (4 / 5 : ℝ) ≤
      A * Real.log (logLog Y) * (Real.log Y) ^ (4 / 5 : ℝ) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hL hc
  have hcore : ∀ b ∈ S.cores, 0 < b ∧
      Real.log (b : ℝ) ≤ Real.log R + (L : ℝ) * (Real.log Y) ^ (4 / 5 : ℝ) := by
    intro b hb
    have hQ : (S.record ⟨b, hb⟩).numericalCore = b := S.core_eq ⟨b, hb⟩
    have h := s1 (S.record ⟨b, hb⟩)
    rw [hQ] at h
    exact h
  refine ⟨fun b hb => ⟨(hcore b hb).1, by linarith [(hcore b hb).2]⟩, ?_⟩
  intro bp hbp
  obtain ⟨b, p⟩ := bp
  simp only [CoreRecords.powerRawPairs, corePairs, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.product_eq_sprod,
    Finset.mem_product] at hbp
  obtain ⟨⟨hb, _⟩, hp, hlo, hhi⟩ := hbp
  have hY0 : 0 < Y := by linarith
  have hQ : (S.record ⟨b, hb⟩).numericalCore = b := S.core_eq ⟨b, hb⟩
  have hbpos := (hcore b hb).1
  have hblog := (hcore b hb).2
  have hvpos : (0 : ℝ) < (corePairValue (b, p) : ℝ) :=
    lt_trans (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hY0 _) hlo
  have hcut : CollisionBox.cutoff Y (4 / 5) < (p : ℝ) := by
    by_contra hcon
    push_neg at hcon
    unfold CollisionBox.cutoff at hcon
    have hp0 : (0 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast hp.pos
    have hb0 : (0 : ℝ) < b := by exact_mod_cast hbpos
    have hv_le : (corePairValue (b, p) : ℝ) ≤ (p : ℝ) * (b : ℝ) := by
      have : corePairValue (b, p) ≤ p * b := by
        unfold corePairValue
        exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right b (Nat.sub_le p 1)
      exact_mod_cast this
    have h1 : Real.log (corePairValue (b, p) : ℝ) ≤ Real.log p + Real.log b := by
      rw [← Real.log_mul hp0.ne' hb0.ne']
      exact Real.log_le_log hvpos hv_le
    have h2 : Real.log (p : ℝ) ≤ (Real.log Y) ^ (4 / 5 : ℝ) := by
      calc Real.log (p : ℝ) ≤ Real.log (Real.exp ((Real.log Y) ^ (4 / 5 : ℝ))) :=
            Real.log_le_log hp0 hcon
        _ = _ := Real.log_exp _
    have h3 : Real.log (Y ^ (99 / 100 : ℝ)) < Real.log (corePairValue (b, p) : ℝ) :=
      Real.log_lt_log (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hY0 _) hlo
    rw [Real.log_rpow hY0] at h3
    linarith
  have htot := s2 (S.record ⟨b, hb⟩) p hp hcut
  rw [hQ] at htot
  unfold totientsUpTo
  rw [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc]
  refine ⟨⟨?_, Nat.le_floor hhi⟩, ⟨(S.record ⟨b, hb⟩).integer * p, ?_⟩⟩
  · have : 0 < corePairValue (b, p) := by exact_mod_cast hvpos
    omega
  · rw [htot]
    exact Nat.mul_comm _ _

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have s1 : ∀ (cores : Finset ℕ) (lo hi : ℝ), (∀ b ∈ cores, 0 < b) → 0 ≤ lo → lo ≤ hi →
      ((corePairs cores lo hi).card : ℝ) =
        ∑ b ∈ cores, ((Nat.primeCounting ⌊1 + hi / (b:ℝ)⌋₊ : ℝ) -
          (Nat.primeCounting ⌊1 + lo / (b:ℝ)⌋₊ : ℝ)) := by
    intro cores lo hi hcores hlo hhi
    have hhipos : 0 ≤ hi := hlo.trans hhi
    have hPc : ∀ n, Nat.primeCounting n = ((Finset.range (n+1)).filter Nat.Prime).card := by
      intro n
      rw [Nat.primeCounting, Nat.primeCounting', Nat.count_eq_card_filter_range]
    have hmap : ∀ bp ∈ corePairs cores lo hi, bp.1 ∈ cores := by
      intro bp hbp
      simp only [corePairs, Finset.product_eq_sprod, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product] at hbp
      exact hbp.1.1
    rw [Finset.card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise hmap, Nat.cast_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro b hb
    have hbpos := hcores b hb
    have hbR : (0 : ℝ) < b := by exact_mod_cast hbpos
    have hb1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ b := by exact_mod_cast hbpos
    have hl : 0 ≤ 1 + lo / (b : ℝ) := by positivity
    have hu : 0 ≤ 1 + hi / (b : ℝ) := by positivity
    have hlu : 1 + lo / (b : ℝ) ≤ 1 + hi / (b : ℝ) := by gcongr
    have hac : ⌊1 + lo / (b : ℝ)⌋₊ ≤ ⌊1 + hi / (b : ℝ)⌋₊ := Nat.floor_mono hlu
    have hsub : (Finset.range (⌊1 + lo / (b : ℝ)⌋₊+1)).filter Nat.Prime ⊆
        (Finset.range (⌊1 + hi / (b : ℝ)⌋₊+1)).filter Nat.Prime := by
      intro p hp
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range] at hp ⊢
      exact ⟨by omega, hp.2⟩
    have hval : ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → (corePairValue (b, p) : ℝ) = ((p : ℝ) - 1) * b := by
      intro p hp
      simp only [corePairValue, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_sub hp.one_le, Nat.cast_one]
    have hcard : ((corePairs cores lo hi).filter (fun bp => bp.1 = b)).card =
        (((Finset.range (⌊1 + hi / (b : ℝ)⌋₊+1)).filter Nat.Prime) \
          ((Finset.range (⌊1 + lo / (b : ℝ)⌋₊+1)).filter Nat.Prime)).card := by
      apply Finset.card_bij (fun bp _ => bp.2)
      · intro bp hbp
        rcases bp with ⟨b', p⟩
        simp only [corePairs, Finset.product_eq_sprod, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product,
          Finset.mem_range] at hbp
        obtain ⟨⟨⟨_, _⟩, hp, hlv, huv⟩, hbEq⟩ := hbp
        subst b'
        rw [hval p hp] at hlv huv
        simp only [Finset.mem_sdiff, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range, not_and]
        refine ⟨⟨?_, hp⟩, fun h _ => ?_⟩
        · have h1 : (p:ℝ) ≤ 1 + hi / b := by
            have := (le_div_iff₀ hbR).mpr huv; linarith
          have := (Nat.le_floor_iff hu).mpr h1
          omega
        · have h1 : 1 + lo / b < (p:ℝ) := by
            have := (div_lt_iff₀ hbR).mpr hlv; linarith
          have := (Nat.floor_lt hl).mpr h1
          omega
      · intro x hx x' hx' hxx
        apply Prod.ext _ hxx
        exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx).2.trans (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx').2.symm
      · intro p hp
        simp only [Finset.mem_sdiff, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range, not_and] at hp
        obtain ⟨⟨hpc, hp⟩, hpa⟩ := hp
        have hpa' : ⌊1 + lo / (b : ℝ)⌋₊ < p := by
          by_contra hcon
          exact hpa (by omega) hp
        have h1 : 1 + lo / b < (p:ℝ) := (Nat.floor_lt hl).mp hpa'
        have h2 : (p:ℝ) ≤ 1 + hi / b := (Nat.le_floor_iff hu).mp (by omega)
        have hlv : lo < ((p:ℝ) - 1) * b := (div_lt_iff₀ hbR).mp (by linarith)
        have huv : ((p:ℝ) - 1) * b ≤ hi := (le_div_iff₀ hbR).mp (by linarith)
        refine ⟨(b, p), Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨?_, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
        simp only [corePairs, Finset.product_eq_sprod, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product,
          Finset.mem_range]
        refine ⟨⟨hb, ?_⟩, hp, ?_, ?_⟩
        · have hp1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ p := by exact_mod_cast hp.one_le
          have h3 : (p:ℝ) - 1 ≤ ((p:ℝ) - 1) * b := by nlinarith
          have h4 := Nat.lt_floor_add_one hi
          have h5 : (p:ℝ) < ((⌊hi⌋₊ + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by push_cast; linarith
          exact_mod_cast h5
        · rw [hval p hp]; exact hlv
        · rw [hval p hp]; exact huv
    rw [hcard, Finset.card_sdiff_of_subset hsub, Nat.cast_sub (Finset.card_le_card hsub), hPc, hPc]
  
  have s2 : ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∀ᶠ z : ℝ in atTop,
      |(Nat.primeCounting ⌊z⌋₊ : ℝ) - 2 * (Nat.primeCounting ⌊z / 2⌋₊ : ℝ)| ≤
        δ * (z / Real.log z) ∧
      z / (2 * Real.log z) ≤ (Nat.primeCounting ⌊z⌋₊ : ℝ) := by
    intro δ hδ
    obtain ⟨η, hη0, hη1, hηδ⟩ : ∃ η : ℝ, 0 < η ∧ η ≤ 1/2 ∧ η ≤ δ/6 :=
      ⟨min (δ/6) (1/2), lt_min (by positivity) (by norm_num), min_le_right _ _, min_le_left _ _⟩
    have hbd : ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop, (1 - η) * (x / Real.log x) ≤ (Nat.primeCounting ⌊x⌋₊ : ℝ) ∧
        (Nat.primeCounting ⌊x⌋₊ : ℝ) ≤ (1 + η) * (x / Real.log x) := by
      have hev := (Metric.tendsto_nhds.mp hPNT) η hη0
      filter_upwards [hev, eventually_gt_atTop (1:ℝ)] with x hx hx1
      rw [Real.dist_eq, abs_lt] at hx
      have hL : 0 < x / Real.log x := div_pos (by linarith) (Real.log_pos hx1)
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hx
      constructor
      · have h3 : 1 - η < (Nat.primeCounting ⌊x⌋₊ : ℝ) / (x / Real.log x) := by linarith
        rw [lt_div_iff₀ hL] at h3; linarith
      · have h3 : (Nat.primeCounting ⌊x⌋₊ : ℝ) / (x / Real.log x) < 1 + η := by linarith
        rw [div_lt_iff₀ hL] at h3; linarith
    have hhalf := (tendsto_id.atTop_div_const (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 2)).eventually hbd
    filter_upwards [hbd, hhalf, Real.tendsto_log_atTop.eventually_ge_atTop (Real.log 2 / η),
      eventually_gt_atTop (2:ℝ)] with z h1 h2 hlog hz2
    simp only [id] at h2
    have hl2 : 0 < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
    have hz0 : 0 < z := by linarith
    have hℓ : 0 < Real.log z := Real.log_pos (by linarith)
    have hl2η : Real.log 2 ≤ η * Real.log z := by
      have := (div_le_iff₀ hη0).mp hlog; linarith
    have hℓ2 : Real.log (z/2) = Real.log z - Real.log 2 := Real.log_div hz0.ne' (by norm_num)
    have hℓ2pos : 0 < Real.log (z/2) := by rw [hℓ2]; nlinarith
    have hLX : z / Real.log z ≤ z / Real.log (z/2) := by
      apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hz0.le hℓ2pos
      rw [hℓ2]; linarith
    have hXL : (1 - η) * (z / Real.log (z/2)) ≤ z / Real.log z := by
      rw [mul_div_assoc', div_le_div_iff₀ hℓ2pos hℓ, hℓ2]
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hl2η hz0.le]
    have hhalfX : (z/2) / Real.log (z/2) = (z / Real.log (z/2)) / 2 := by ring
    rw [hhalfX] at h2
    have h2L : z / (2 * Real.log z) = (z / Real.log z) / 2 := by ring
    rw [h2L]
    set L := z / Real.log z with hLdef
    set Xv := z / Real.log (z/2) with hXdef
    have hL0 : 0 < L := div_pos hz0 hℓ
    have hX0 : 0 < Xv := div_pos hz0 hℓ2pos
    have hA1 : (1-η)*L ≤ (1-η)*Xv := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hLX (by linarith)
    have hB1 : (1+4*η)*((1-η)*Xv) ≤ (1+4*η)*L := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hXL (by linarith)
    have hC1 : (1+η)*Xv ≤ (1+4*η)*((1-η)*Xv) := by
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hη0.le hX0.le) (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 - 2*η)]
    have hD1 : η * L ≤ δ/6 * L := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hηδ hL0.le
    obtain ⟨h1a, h1b⟩ := h1
    obtain ⟨h2a, h2b⟩ := h2
    refine ⟨abs_le.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · nlinarith
    · nlinarith
    · nlinarith
  
  have s3 : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε →
      ∃ Z η : ℝ, 0 < η ∧ ∀ z w : ℝ, Z ≤ z → 0 ≤ w → (w + 2) * Real.log z ≤ η * z →
        |((Nat.primeCounting ⌊1 + z⌋₊ : ℝ) - (Nat.primeCounting ⌊1 + w⌋₊ : ℝ)) -
          2 * ((Nat.primeCounting ⌊1 + z / 2⌋₊ : ℝ) - (Nat.primeCounting ⌊1 + w⌋₊ : ℝ))| ≤
          ε * ((Nat.primeCounting ⌊1 + z⌋₊ : ℝ) - (Nat.primeCounting ⌊1 + w⌋₊ : ℝ)) := by
    intro ε hε
    obtain ⟨Z₀, hZ₀⟩ := eventually_atTop.mp (s2 (ε/8) (by positivity))
    obtain ⟨η, hη0, hη1, hηε⟩ : ∃ η : ℝ, 0 < η ∧ η ≤ 1/4 ∧ η ≤ ε/20 :=
      ⟨min (1/4) (ε/20), lt_min (by norm_num) (by positivity), min_le_left _ _, min_le_right _ _⟩
    have hsucc : ∀ n : ℕ, (Nat.primeCounting n : ℝ) ≤ Nat.primeCounting (n+1) ∧
        (Nat.primeCounting (n+1) : ℝ) ≤ Nat.primeCounting n + 1 := by
      intro n
      have h : Nat.primeCounting (n+1) =
          Nat.primeCounting n + if Nat.Prime (n+1) then 1 else 0 := by
        simp only [Nat.primeCounting, Nat.primeCounting']
        rw [Nat.count_succ]
      rw [h]
      split_ifs <;> push_cast <;> constructor <;> linarith
    have hfl : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ x → ⌊1 + x⌋₊ = ⌊x⌋₊ + 1 := by
      intro x hx; rw [add_comm]; exact Nat.floor_add_one hx
    have hle : ∀ m : ℕ, (Nat.primeCounting m : ℝ) ≤ m + 1 := by
      intro m
      have : Nat.primeCounting m ≤ m + 1 := by
        simp only [Nat.primeCounting, Nat.primeCounting']
        exact Nat.count_le _
      exact_mod_cast this
    refine ⟨max Z₀ 2, η, hη0, ?_⟩
    intro z w hz hw hwz
    have hz2 : 2 ≤ z := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hz
    have hzZ : Z₀ ≤ z := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hz
    obtain ⟨hdiff, hlow⟩ := hZ₀ z hzZ
    have hℓ : 0 < Real.log z := Real.log_pos (by linarith)
    have hz0 : 0 < z := by linarith
    have hwL : w + 2 ≤ η * (z / Real.log z) := by
      rw [mul_div_assoc', le_div_iff₀ hℓ]; exact hwz
    have h2L : z / (2 * Real.log z) = (z / Real.log z) / 2 := by ring
    rw [h2L] at hlow
    set L := z / Real.log z with hLdef
    have hL0 : 0 < L := div_pos hz0 hℓ
    rw [hfl z hz0.le, hfl (z/2) (by positivity)]
    obtain ⟨hP1, hP2⟩ := hsucc ⌊z⌋₊
    obtain ⟨hQ1, hQ2⟩ := hsucc ⌊z/2⌋₊
    have hW0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ Nat.primeCounting ⌊1 + w⌋₊ := Nat.cast_nonneg _
    have hW1 : (Nat.primeCounting ⌊1 + w⌋₊ : ℝ) ≤ w + 2 := by
      have h1 := hle ⌊1 + w⌋₊
      have h2 : (⌊1 + w⌋₊ : ℝ) ≤ 1 + w := Nat.floor_le (by linarith)
      linarith
    rw [abs_le] at hdiff
    obtain ⟨hd1, hd2⟩ := hdiff
    have hηL : η * L ≤ ε / 20 * L := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hηε hL0.le
    have hT : L / 4 ≤ (Nat.primeCounting (⌊z⌋₊ + 1) : ℝ) - Nat.primeCounting ⌊1 + w⌋₊ := by
      have : η * L ≤ 1/4 * L := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hη1 hL0.le
      linarith
    have hεT := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hT hε.le
    rw [abs_le]
    constructor <;> linarith
  
  have s4 : ∀ᶠ y : ℝ in atTop,
      Real.log R + A * Real.log (logLog y) * (Real.log y) ^ (4 / 5 : ℝ) ≤
        (1 / 100) * Real.log y := by
    have hu : ∀ᶠ u : ℝ in atTop,
        Real.log R + A * Real.log (Real.log u) * u ^ (4 / 5 : ℝ) ≤ (1 / 100) * u := by
      have hlo := (isLittleO_log_rpow_atTop (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 1/10)).bound
        (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 1)
      filter_upwards [hlo, Real.tendsto_log_atTop.eventually_ge_atTop 1,
        eventually_ge_atTop (1:ℝ),
        (tendsto_rpow_atTop (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 1/10)).eventually_ge_atTop
          (100 * (|A| + |Real.log R|))] with u hlo hlu hu1 hbig
      have hu0 : 0 < u := by linarith
      have hr1 : 0 ≤ u ^ (1/10 : ℝ) := Real.rpow_nonneg hu0.le _
      have hr9 : 1 ≤ u ^ (9/10 : ℝ) := Real.one_le_rpow hu1 (by norm_num)
      have hr45 : 0 ≤ u ^ (4/5 : ℝ) := Real.rpow_nonneg hu0.le _
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (Real.log_nonneg hu1),
        abs_of_nonneg hr1, one_mul] at hlo
      have hg0 : 0 ≤ Real.log (Real.log u) := Real.log_nonneg hlu
      have hg1 : Real.log (Real.log u) ≤ u ^ (1/10 : ℝ) :=
        (Real.log_le_self (by linarith)).trans hlo
      have hmul : u ^ (1/10 : ℝ) * u ^ (4/5 : ℝ) = u ^ (9/10 : ℝ) := by
        rw [← Real.rpow_add hu0]; norm_num
      have hmul2 : u ^ (9/10 : ℝ) * u ^ (1/10 : ℝ) = u := by
        rw [← Real.rpow_add hu0]; norm_num
      have hA : A * Real.log (Real.log u) * u ^ (4 / 5 : ℝ) ≤ |A| * u ^ (9/10 : ℝ) := by
        calc A * Real.log (Real.log u) * u ^ (4 / 5 : ℝ)
            ≤ |A| * Real.log (Real.log u) * u ^ (4 / 5 : ℝ) := by
              apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ hr45
              exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self A) hg0
          _ ≤ |A| * u ^ (1/10 : ℝ) * u ^ (4 / 5 : ℝ) := by
              apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ hr45
              exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hg1 (abs_nonneg A)
          _ = |A| * u ^ (9/10 : ℝ) := by rw [mul_assoc, hmul]
      have hR : Real.log R ≤ |Real.log R| * u ^ (9/10 : ℝ) := by
        have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hr9 (abs_nonneg (Real.log R))
        linarith [le_abs_self (Real.log R)]
      have hKb : (|A| + |Real.log R|) * u ^ (9/10 : ℝ) ≤ (1/100) * u := by
        have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hbig (by positivity : (0:ℝ) ≤ u ^ (9/10 : ℝ))
        rw [hmul2] at this
        linarith
      nlinarith
    filter_upwards [Real.tendsto_log_atTop.eventually hu] with y hy
    unfold logLog
    exact hy
  
  have s5 : ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → ∀ᶠ y : ℝ in atTop, 2 * y ^ (99 / 100 : ℝ) ≤ y ∧
      (y ^ (99 / 100 : ℝ) + 2 * y ^ (1 / 100 : ℝ)) * Real.log y ≤ η * y := by
    intro η hη
    have hlo := (isLittleO_log_rpow_atTop (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 1/100)).bound
      (by positivity : (0:ℝ) < η/3)
    filter_upwards [hlo, eventually_ge_atTop (1:ℝ),
      (tendsto_rpow_atTop (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 1/100)).eventually_ge_atTop 2]
      with y hlo hy1 hbig
    have hy0 : 0 < y := by linarith
    have ha : 0 ≤ y ^ (1/100 : ℝ) := Real.rpow_nonneg hy0.le _
    have hb : 0 ≤ y ^ (99/100 : ℝ) := Real.rpow_nonneg hy0.le _
    have hlog0 : 0 ≤ Real.log y := Real.log_nonneg hy1
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hlog0, abs_of_nonneg ha] at hlo
    have hmul : y ^ (99/100 : ℝ) * y ^ (1/100 : ℝ) = y := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_add hy0]; norm_num
    have hab : y ^ (1/100 : ℝ) ≤ y ^ (99/100 : ℝ) :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hy1 (by norm_num)
    constructor
    · have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hbig hb
      linarith
    · calc (y ^ (99 / 100 : ℝ) + 2 * y ^ (1 / 100 : ℝ)) * Real.log y
          ≤ (3 * y ^ (99 / 100 : ℝ)) * Real.log y := by
            apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ hlog0; linarith
        _ ≤ (3 * y ^ (99 / 100 : ℝ)) * (η / 3 * y ^ (1/100 : ℝ)) := by
            apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlo; linarith
        _ = η * (y ^ (99/100 : ℝ) * y ^ (1/100 : ℝ)) := by ring
        _ = η * y := by rw [hmul]
  
  rw [Asymptotics.isLittleO_iff]
  intro c hc
  obtain ⟨Z, η, hη, hU⟩ := s3 c hc
  filter_upwards [hC, s4, s5 η hη,
    (tendsto_rpow_atTop (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 99/100)).eventually_ge_atTop Z,
    eventually_ge_atTop (1:ℝ)] with y hCy hs4 hs5 hyZ hy1
  obtain ⟨h2lo, hscale⟩ := hs5
  have hy0 : 0 < y := by linarith
  have hlo0 : 0 ≤ y ^ (99/100 : ℝ) := Real.rpow_nonneg hy0.le _
  have hlo1 : 1 ≤ y ^ (99/100 : ℝ) := Real.one_le_rpow hy1 (by norm_num)
  have hloy2 : y ^ (99/100 : ℝ) ≤ y / 2 := by linarith
  have hloy : y ^ (99/100 : ℝ) ≤ y := by linarith
  have hmul : y ^ (99/100 : ℝ) * y ^ (1/100 : ℝ) = y := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_add hy0]; norm_num
  have hCpos : ∀ b ∈ C y, 0 < b := fun b hb => (hCy b hb).1
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs,
    abs_of_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) (corePairs (C y) (y ^ (99 / 100 : ℝ)) y).card),
    s1 (C y) _ y hCpos hlo0 hloy, s1 (C y) _ (y/2) hCpos hlo0 hloy2]
  simp only [Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  refine (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun b hb => ?_)
  obtain ⟨hbpos, hlogb⟩ := hCy b hb
  have hbR : (0:ℝ) < b := by exact_mod_cast hbpos
  have hb1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ b := by exact_mod_cast hbpos
  have hbs : (b:ℝ) ≤ y ^ (1/100 : ℝ) := by
    rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos hy0]
    calc (b:ℝ) = Real.exp (Real.log b) := (Real.exp_log hbR).symm
      _ ≤ Real.exp (Real.log y * (1/100)) := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
  have hz0 : 0 < y / b := div_pos hy0 hbR
  have hzy : y / b ≤ y := div_le_self hy0.le hb1
  have hz1 : y ^ (99/100 : ℝ) ≤ y / b := by
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hbR]
    calc y ^ (99/100 : ℝ) * b ≤ y ^ (99/100 : ℝ) * y ^ (1/100 : ℝ) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hbs hlo0
      _ = y := hmul
  have hzZ : Z ≤ y / b := hyZ.trans hz1
  have hlz0 : 0 ≤ Real.log (y / b) := Real.log_nonneg (hlo1.trans hz1)
  have hlzy : Real.log (y / b) ≤ Real.log y := Real.log_le_log hz0 hzy
  have hw0 : 0 ≤ y ^ (99/100 : ℝ) / b := div_nonneg hlo0 hbR.le
  have hkey : (y ^ (99/100 : ℝ) / b + 2) * Real.log (y / b) ≤ η * (y / b) := by
    have h1 : (y ^ (99/100 : ℝ) + 2 * b) * Real.log (y / b) ≤ η * y := by
      calc (y ^ (99/100 : ℝ) + 2 * b) * Real.log (y / b)
          ≤ (y ^ (99/100 : ℝ) + 2 * y ^ (1/100 : ℝ)) * Real.log y := by
            apply mul_le_mul (by linarith) hlzy hlz0 (by positivity)
        _ ≤ η * y := hscale
    rw [div_add' _ _ _ hbR.ne', div_mul_eq_mul_div, ← mul_div_assoc]
    exact (div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hbR).mpr h1
  have hyb : y / 2 / (b:ℝ) = y / b / 2 := by ring
  rw [hyb]
  exact hU (y / b) (y ^ (99/100 : ℝ) / b) hzZ hw0 hkey

    exact Real.tendsto_exp_atTop.comp (Real.tendsto_exp_atTop.comp

  have hnormal : ∀ q : ℕ, q.Prime → ∀ᶠ S : ℝ in atTop, SNormal S q := by

      (Real.tendsto_log_atTop.comp Real.tendsto_log_atTop).const_mul_atTop (by norm_num)
    filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop (q : ℝ),
      h2.eventually_ge_atTop (ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors (q - 1) : ℝ)] with S hSq hSlog
    refine ⟨hq, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have hle : omegaInterval (q - 1) 1 S ≤ ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors (q - 1) := by
        unfold omegaInterval
        rw [ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors_apply]
        exact List.countP_le_length
      calc (omegaInterval (q - 1) 1 S : ℝ)
          ≤ (ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors (q - 1) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hle

    · intro u v hu huv hv
      exfalso
      have hq1 : 1 ≤ q := hq.one_lt.le
      have hlt : ((q - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) < q := by
        rw [Nat.cast_sub hq1]; simp
      linarith
  have hrn : ∀ r : ℕ, ∀ᶠ Y : ℝ in atTop,
      ∀ q ∈ r.primeFactors, SNormal (normalityScale (logLog Y)) q := by
    intro r
    refine (Filter.eventually_all_finset _).mpr ?_
    intro q hq
    exact hS.eventually (hnormal q (Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hq))
  
  have hfixed : ∀ᶠ Y : ℝ in atTop, ∀ r ∈ Finset.Icc 1 R, ∀ (L : ℕ) (G : Finset ℕ)

        largestPrimeFactor N ≠ p n 0) →
      (G.card : ℝ) ≤ 4 * (Y / (Real.log Y * (logLog Y) ^ 2)) := by
    refine (Filter.eventually_all_finset _).mpr ?_
    intro r hr
    have hr0 : 0 < r := (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hr).1
    filter_upwards [hsize, hrn r, hS.eventually_ge_atTop (largestPrimeFactor r.totient : ℝ),
      retained_pairs_count hPNT hMERT hEULER hA.le P (6 / 5) (4 / 5) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
        r.totient (Nat.totient_pos.mpr hr0),

      nonnormal_totients_count hPNT hMERT hEULER, eventually_ge_atTop (0 : ℝ)]
      with Y hsz hrnY hdS hret h0 h1 h2 hY0
    intro L G p hL hG hlow hwit
    have hmain := rigidity_count_le_exceptions (c := D)
      (B := Y / (Real.log Y * (logLog Y) ^ 2)) hr0 hY0 hsz hrnY
      (fun G' hG' => hret L G' hL hdS hG') G p hL hG hlow hwit
    linarith
  filter_upwards [hfixed, rawPair_power_top_eventually R A, eventually_ge_atTop (0 : ℝ)]
    with Y hfix htopQ hY0
  intro L S hL
  have htop : ∀ bp ∈ CoreRecords.powerRawPairs S, ∀ hb : bp.1 ∈ S.cores,
      Y ^ (9 / 10 : ℝ) < (bp.2 : ℝ) ∧
        (S.record ⟨bp.1, hb⟩).lower ⟨0, (S.record ⟨bp.1, hb⟩).length_pos⟩ < bp.2 := by
    intro bp hbp hb
    have hbp' := hbp
    simp only [CoreRecords.powerRawPairs, corePairs, Finset.mem_filter] at hbp'
    obtain ⟨_, hp, hlo, _⟩ := hbp'
    have hce := S.core_eq ⟨bp.1, hb⟩
    have hval : corePairValue ((S.record ⟨bp.1, hb⟩).numericalCore, bp.2) =
        corePairValue bp := by
      rw [hce]
    exact htopQ L P (S.record ⟨bp.1, hb⟩) hL bp.2 hp (by rw [hval]; exact hlo)

noncomputable def omegaInterval (n : ℕ) (u v : ℝ) : ℕ :=
  n.primeFactorsList.countP (fun p : ℕ => decide (u < (p : ℝ) ∧ (p : ℝ) ≤ v))


def SNormal (S : ℝ) (p : ℕ) : Prop :=
  p.Prime ∧
  (omegaInterval (p - 1) 1 S : ℝ) ≤ 2 * Real.log (Real.log S) ∧
  ∀ u v : ℝ, S ≤ u → u < v → v ≤ (p - 1 : ℕ) →
    |(omegaInterval (p - 1) u v : ℝ) -
      (Real.log (Real.log v) - Real.log (Real.log u))| <
      Real.sqrt (Real.log (Real.log S) * Real.log (Real.log v))


noncomputable def normalityScale (T : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.exp (Real.exp (Real.log T ^ 10))


def NoLargePrimeSquare (n : ℕ) (S : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → S < (p : ℝ) → ¬p ^ 2 ∣ n


noncomputable def CollisionFacet.extend {L : ℕ} (x : Fin (L + 1) → ℝ) (idx : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  if hi : idx < L + 1 then x ⟨idx, hi⟩ else 0


structure Rigidity.Tuple {L : ℕ} (Y P κ θ : ℝ) (r n : ℕ) (p : Fin (L + 1) → ℕ) : Prop where
  integer : (∏ idx, p idx) = n
  prime : ∀ idx, (p idx).Prime
  order : StrictAnti p
  last_lower : max 17 (largestPrimeFactor r) < p (Fin.last L)
  last_upper : (p (Fin.last L) : ℝ) ≤ P
  gaps : ∀ idx : Fin (L + 1), 0 < idx.val → ∀ hi : idx.val + 1 < L + 1,
    κ * logLog (p ⟨idx.val + 1, hi⟩) ≤ logLog (p idx)
  lower_upper : ∀ idx, 0 < idx.val → (p idx : ℝ) ≤ CollisionBox.cutoff Y θ
  top : Y ^ (9 / 10 : ℝ) < (p 0 : ℝ)
  size : ((r.totient * n.totient : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ Y
  facet : (∑ idx ∈ Finset.Icc 1 L, fordWeight idx *
    CollisionFacet.extend (fun j => CollisionBox.primeCoordinate (logLog Y) (p j)) idx) ≤
      1 - (logLog Y) ^ (-1 / 8 : ℝ)


structure CollisionSum.RetainedPair {L : ℕ} (Y P κ θ : ℝ) (d n : ℕ) (p : Fin (L + 1) → ℕ)
    (N : ℕ) : Prop where
  integer : (∏ idx, p idx) = n
  normal_left : ∀ idx, SNormal (normalityScale (logLog Y)) (p idx)
  prime_min : ∀ idx, 17 ≤ p idx
  order : StrictAnti p
  gaps : ∀ idx : Fin (L + 1), 0 < idx.val → ∀ hi : idx.val + 1 < L + 1,
    κ * logLog (p ⟨idx.val + 1, hi⟩) ≤ logLog (p idx)
  lower_upper : ∀ idx, 0 < idx.val → (p idx : ℝ) ≤ CollisionBox.cutoff Y θ
  last_upper : (p (Fin.last L) : ℝ) ≤ P
  top : Y ^ (9 / 10 : ℝ) < (p 0 : ℝ)
  witness_pos : 0 < N
  equation : N.totient = d * ∏ idx, (p idx - 1)
  size : (N.totient : ℝ) ≤ Y
  largest_ne : largestPrimeFactor N ≠ p 0
  normal_right : ∀ q ∈ N.primeFactors, SNormal (normalityScale (logLog Y)) q
  square_witness : NoLargePrimeSquare N (Real.log Y ^ 4)
  square_totient : NoLargePrimeSquare N.totient (Real.log Y ^ 4)
  facet : (∑ idx ∈ Finset.Icc 1 L, fordWeight idx *
    CollisionFacet.extend (fun j => CollisionBox.primeCoordinate (logLog Y) (p j)) idx) ≤
      1 - (logLog Y) ^ (-1 / 8 : ℝ)

noncomputable def fiveLogOmegaTotients (x : ℝ) : Finset ℕ :=
  (totientsUpTo x).filter (fun n : ℕ => 3 ≤ n ∧
    5 * logLog (n : ℝ) < (ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors n : ℝ))


noncomputable def largeSquareTotients (x : ℝ) : Finset ℕ :=
  (totientsUpTo x).filter (fun m : ℕ => ∃ n : ℕ, 0 < n ∧ n.totient = m ∧
    ∃ q : ℕ, q.Prime ∧ Real.log x ^ 4 < (q : ℝ) ∧ (q ^ 2 ∣ n ∨ q ^ 2 ∣ n.totient))


noncomputable def FordGeometry.tailWeight {L : ℕ} (idx j : Fin L) : ℝ :=
  if idx.val < j.val then
    if idx.val + 2 < L then fordWeight (j.val - idx.val) else 1
  else 0


noncomputable def FordGeometry.tailForm {L : ℕ} (idx : Fin L) : (Fin L → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ :=
  weightedForm (FordGeometry.tailWeight idx)


noncomputable def FordGeometry.polytope (L : ℕ) (ξ : ℕ → ℝ) : Set (Fin L → ℝ) :=
  {x | (∀ idx, 0 ≤ x idx) ∧ (∀ idx, x idx ≤ 1) ∧ Antitone x ∧
    FordGeometry.outerForm L x ≤ ξ 0 ∧
    ∀ idx : Fin L, idx.val + 1 < L → FordGeometry.tailForm idx x ≤ ξ (idx.val + 1) * x idx}


noncomputable def FordGeometry.T (L : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  MeasureTheory.volume.real (FordGeometry.polytope L (fun _ => 1))


noncomputable def FordGeometry.expandedParameter (N j : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  1 + (1 / 10000 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(((N : ℝ) - j) / 40))


noncomputable def FordAnalysis.coeff (n : ℕ) : ℝ := if n = 0 then 0 else fordWeight n


noncomputable def FordAnalysis.F (z : ℝ) : ℝ := ∑' n : ℕ, FordAnalysis.coeff n * z ^ n


noncomputable def FordAnalysis.rho : ℝ :=
  Classical.epsilon (fun r : ℝ => 0 < r ∧ r < 3 / 4 ∧ FordAnalysis.F r = 1)


noncomputable def FordAnalysis.C : ℝ := (2 * |Real.log FordAnalysis.rho|)⁻¹


noncomputable def FordScale.optimalDimension (t : ℝ) : ℕ :=
  ⌊2 * FordAnalysis.C * (Real.log t - Real.log (Real.log t))⌋₊


noncomputable def FordScale.coreDimension (M : ℕ) (t : ℝ) : ℕ := FordScale.optimalDimension t - M


noncomputable def FordReciprocal.coreOuterShell (M : ℕ) (t : ℝ) :
    Set (Fin (FordScale.coreDimension M t) → ℝ) :=
  FordGeometry.polytope (FordScale.coreDimension M t)
      (FordGeometry.expandedParameter (FordScale.optimalDimension t)) ∩
    {x | 1 - t ^ (-1 / 8 : ℝ) < FordGeometry.outerForm (FordScale.coreDimension M t) x}


noncomputable def FordRestricted.suffixMargin (k : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  (1 / 10000 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(k : ℝ) / 40)


noncomputable def FordBadFacet.positiveLogLog (x : ℝ) : ℝ := max 0 (logLog x)


noncomputable def FordBadFacet.fordPrimeCoordinate (T : ℝ) (p : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  FordBadFacet.positiveLogLog p / T


abbrev FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeList (N : ℕ) : List ℕ := N.primeFactorsList.reverse


abbrev FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt (N idx : ℕ) : ℕ := (FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeList N).getD idx 1


noncomputable abbrev FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeCoordinate (T : ℝ) (N idx : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  FordBadFacet.fordPrimeCoordinate T (FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N idx)


noncomputable abbrev FordBadFacet.ordinarySuffix (N j : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  ((FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeList N).drop j).prod


noncomputable def FordBadFacet.badFacetValues (x : ℝ) (k : ℕ) (ω : ℝ) : Finset ℕ :=
  (totientsUpTo x).filter (fun m => ∃ N : ℕ, 0 < N ∧ N.totient = m ∧
    1 + ω ≤ ∑ idx : Fin k, fordWeight (idx.val + 1) *
      FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeCoordinate (logLog x) N (idx.val + 1))


noncomputable def FordBadFacet.polytopeFailureValues (x : ℝ) (L : ℕ) (ξ : ℕ → ℝ) : Finset ℕ :=
  (totientsUpTo x).filter (fun m => ∃ N : ℕ, 0 < N ∧ N.totient = m ∧
    (fun idx : Fin L => FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeCoordinate (logLog x) N (idx.val + 1)) ∉
      FordGeometry.polytope L ξ)


noncomputable def FordBadFacet.firstFailedExceptionalValues (x : ℝ) (A : ℕ) : Finset ℕ :=
  totientsUpTo (Real.sqrt x) ∪ FordBadFacet.badFacetValues x 2 (1 / 1000) ∪ fiveLogOmegaTotients x ∪
    largeSquareTotients x ∪ FordBadFacet.badFacetValues x A (FordRestricted.suffixMargin A)


noncomputable def FordBadFacet.retainedGeometricValues (x : ℝ) (D : ℕ)
    (E : Set (Fin D → ℝ)) (Q : ℕ → Prop) : Finset ℕ :=

noncomputable def fiveLogOmegaTotients (x : ℝ) : Finset ℕ :=
  (totientsUpTo x).filter (fun n : ℕ => 3 ≤ n ∧
    5 * logLog (n : ℝ) < (ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors n : ℝ))


noncomputable def largeSquareTotients (x : ℝ) : Finset ℕ :=
  (totientsUpTo x).filter (fun m : ℕ => ∃ n : ℕ, 0 < n ∧ n.totient = m ∧
    ∃ q : ℕ, q.Prime ∧ Real.log x ^ 4 < (q : ℝ) ∧ (q ^ 2 ∣ n ∨ q ^ 2 ∣ n.totient))


noncomputable def FordGeometry.tailWeight {L : ℕ} (idx j : Fin L) : ℝ :=
  if idx.val < j.val then
    if idx.val + 2 < L then fordWeight (j.val - idx.val) else 1
  else 0


noncomputable def FordGeometry.tailForm {L : ℕ} (idx : Fin L) : (Fin L → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ :=
  weightedForm (FordGeometry.tailWeight idx)


noncomputable def FordGeometry.polytope (L : ℕ) (ξ : ℕ → ℝ) : Set (Fin L → ℝ) :=
  {x | (∀ idx, 0 ≤ x idx) ∧ (∀ idx, x idx ≤ 1) ∧ Antitone x ∧
    FordGeometry.outerForm L x ≤ ξ 0 ∧
    ∀ idx : Fin L, idx.val + 1 < L → FordGeometry.tailForm idx x ≤ ξ (idx.val + 1) * x idx}


noncomputable def FordGeometry.T (L : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  MeasureTheory.volume.real (FordGeometry.polytope L (fun _ => 1))


noncomputable def FordGeometry.expandedParameter (N j : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  1 + (1 / 10000 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(((N : ℝ) - j) / 40))


noncomputable def FordAnalysis.coeff (n : ℕ) : ℝ := if n = 0 then 0 else fordWeight n


noncomputable def FordAnalysis.F (z : ℝ) : ℝ := ∑' n : ℕ, FordAnalysis.coeff n * z ^ n


noncomputable def FordAnalysis.rho : ℝ :=
  Classical.epsilon (fun r : ℝ => 0 < r ∧ r < 3 / 4 ∧ FordAnalysis.F r = 1)


noncomputable def FordAnalysis.C : ℝ := (2 * |Real.log FordAnalysis.rho|)⁻¹


noncomputable def FordScale.optimalDimension (t : ℝ) : ℕ :=
  ⌊2 * FordAnalysis.C * (Real.log t - Real.log (Real.log t))⌋₊


noncomputable def FordScale.coreDimension (M : ℕ) (t : ℝ) : ℕ := FordScale.optimalDimension t - M


noncomputable def FordReciprocal.coreOuterShell (M : ℕ) (t : ℝ) :
    Set (Fin (FordScale.coreDimension M t) → ℝ) :=
  FordGeometry.polytope (FordScale.coreDimension M t)
      (FordGeometry.expandedParameter (FordScale.optimalDimension t)) ∩
    {x | 1 - t ^ (-1 / 8 : ℝ) < FordGeometry.outerForm (FordScale.coreDimension M t) x}


noncomputable def FordRestricted.suffixMargin (k : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  (1 / 10000 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(k : ℝ) / 40)


noncomputable def FordBadFacet.positiveLogLog (x : ℝ) : ℝ := max 0 (logLog x)


noncomputable def FordBadFacet.fordPrimeCoordinate (T : ℝ) (p : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  FordBadFacet.positiveLogLog p / T


abbrev FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeList (N : ℕ) : List ℕ := N.primeFactorsList.reverse


abbrev FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt (N idx : ℕ) : ℕ := (FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeList N).getD idx 1


noncomputable abbrev FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeCoordinate (T : ℝ) (N idx : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  FordBadFacet.fordPrimeCoordinate T (FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N idx)


noncomputable abbrev FordBadFacet.ordinarySuffix (N j : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  ((FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeList N).drop j).prod


noncomputable def FordBadFacet.badFacetValues (x : ℝ) (k : ℕ) (ω : ℝ) : Finset ℕ :=
  (totientsUpTo x).filter (fun m => ∃ N : ℕ, 0 < N ∧ N.totient = m ∧

    intro n
    by_cases hp : n.Prime
    · have h2 : (1 : ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hp.one_lt
      have hlog : 0 < Real.log n := Real.log_pos h2
      have hn0 : (n : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
      have hlog0 : Real.log n ≠ 0 := hlog.ne'
      have h0 : T n = 0 := by
        simp only [hTdef, if_pos hp, ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt_apply_prime hp]
        field_simp

    · by_cases hpp : IsPrimePow n
      · obtain ⟨p, k, hpk, hk, rfl⟩ := (isPrimePow_nat_iff _).mp hpp

        have hpos : (0 : ℝ) < (p : ℝ) ^ k := by positivity
        have hpos0 : (p : ℝ) ^ k ≠ 0 := hpos.ne'
        have hkpos : (0 : ℝ) < k := by exact_mod_cast hk
        have hk0 : (k : ℝ) ≠ 0 := hkpos.ne'
        have hval : T (p ^ k) = 1 / (k * (p : ℝ) ^ k) := by
          simp only [hTdef, if_neg hp, ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt_apply_pow (by omega : k ≠ 0),

        have : (2 : ℝ) ≤ k := by exact_mod_cast hk2
        nlinarith
      · have h0 : T n = 0 := by
          simp only [hTdef, if_neg hp, ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt_eq_zero_iff.mpr hpp]
          simp
        exact ⟨h0.ge, Or.inl h0⟩
  
  have hG : ∀ n ∈ Finset.Icc 0 N, T n ≤ ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 2 N, ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 N,
      (if n = m ^ k then 1 / (2 * (m : ℝ) ^ k) else 0) := by
    intro n hn
    have hnN : n ≤ N := (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hn).2
    have hnonneg : ∀ m k : ℕ, 0 ≤ (if n = m ^ k then 1 / (2 * (m : ℝ) ^ k) else 0) := by
      intro m k
      split_ifs <;> positivity
    rcases (hT n).2 with h0 | ⟨m, k, hm, hk, rfl, hle⟩
    · rw [h0]
      exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun m _ => Finset.sum_nonneg fun k _ => hnonneg m k
    · have hmN : m ∈ Finset.Icc 2 N := by
        refine Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨hm, le_trans ?_ hnN⟩
        exact Nat.le_self_pow (by omega) m
      have hkN : k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 N := by
        refine Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨hk, le_trans ?_ hnN⟩
        calc k ≤ 2 ^ k := (Nat.lt_two_pow_self).le
          _ ≤ m ^ k := Nat.pow_le_pow_left hm k
      calc T (m ^ k) ≤ 1 / (2 * (m : ℝ) ^ k) := hle
        _ = (if m ^ k = m ^ k then 1 / (2 * (m : ℝ) ^ k) else 0) := by rw [if_pos rfl]
        _ ≤ ∑ k' ∈ Finset.Icc 2 N, (if m ^ k = m ^ k' then 1 / (2 * (m : ℝ) ^ k') else 0) :=
            Finset.single_le_sum
              (f := fun k' => if m ^ k = m ^ k' then 1 / (2 * (m : ℝ) ^ k') else 0)
              (fun k' _ => hnonneg m k') hkN
        _ ≤ ∑ m' ∈ Finset.Icc 2 N, ∑ k' ∈ Finset.Icc 2 N,
              (if m ^ k = m' ^ k' then 1 / (2 * (m' : ℝ) ^ k') else 0) :=
            Finset.single_le_sum
              (f := fun m' => ∑ k' ∈ Finset.Icc 2 N,
                (if m ^ k = m' ^ k' then 1 / (2 * (m' : ℝ) ^ k') else 0))
              (fun m' _ => Finset.sum_nonneg fun k' _ => hnonneg m' k') hmN
  
  have hswap : ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 0 N, ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 2 N, ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 N,
      (if n = m ^ k then 1 / (2 * (m : ℝ) ^ k) else 0)
      ≤ ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 2 N, ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 N, (1 / 2) * ((m : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ k := by
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro m _
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro k _
    rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq']
    have he : (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ((m : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ k = 1 / (2 * (m : ℝ) ^ k) := by
      rw [inv_pow]; ring
    rw [he]
    split_ifs
    · exact le_rfl
    · positivity
  
  have hgeom : ∀ m ∈ Finset.Icc 2 N, ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 N, (1 / 2) * ((m : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ k ≤
      (1 / 2) * (1 / ((m : ℝ) * ((m : ℝ) - 1))) := by
    intro m hm
    have hm2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ m := by exact_mod_cast (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hm).1
    have hx0 : 0 ≤ (m : ℝ)⁻¹ := by positivity
    have hx1 : (m : ℝ)⁻¹ < 1 := inv_lt_one_of_one_lt₀ (by linarith)
    have hIco : Finset.Icc 2 N = Finset.Ico 2 (N + 1) := by
      ext k; simp only [Finset.mem_Icc, Finset.mem_Ico]; omega
    have h2 := geom_sum_Ico_le_of_lt_one (m := 2) (n := N + 1) hx0 hx1
    have hm0 : (m : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have hm1 : (m : ℝ) - 1 ≠ 0 := by
      have : (0 : ℝ) < (m : ℝ) - 1 := by linarith
      exact this.ne'
    have h3 : ((m : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ 2 / (1 - (m : ℝ)⁻¹) = 1 / ((m : ℝ) * ((m : ℝ) - 1)) := by
      field_simp
    rw [← Finset.mul_sum, hIco]
    rw [h3] at h2
    linarith
  
  have htele : ∀ M : ℕ, ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 2 (M + 1), 1 / ((m : ℝ) * ((m : ℝ) - 1)) =
      1 - 1 / ((M : ℝ) + 1) := by
    intro M
    induction M with
    | zero =>
      rw [Finset.Icc_eq_empty (by norm_num)]
      simp
    | succ M ih =>
      rw [Finset.sum_Icc_succ_top (by omega), ih]
      push_cast
      have h1 : (M : ℝ) + 1 ≠ 0 := by positivity
      have h2 : (M : ℝ) + 1 + 1 ≠ 0 := by positivity
      field_simp
      ring
  have hS : ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 2 N, 1 / ((m : ℝ) * ((m : ℝ) - 1)) ≤ 1 := by
    rcases N with _ | M
    · rw [Finset.Icc_eq_empty (by norm_num)]
      simp
    · rw [htele M]
      have : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / ((M : ℝ) + 1) := by positivity
      linarith
  rw [hsplit]
  refine ⟨Finset.sum_nonneg fun n _ => (hT n).1, ?_⟩
  calc ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 0 N, T n
      ≤ ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 0 N, ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 2 N, ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 N,
          (if n = m ^ k then 1 / (2 * (m : ℝ) ^ k) else 0) := Finset.sum_le_sum hG
    _ ≤ ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 2 N, ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 N, (1 / 2) * ((m : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ k := hswap
    _ ≤ ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 2 N, (1 / 2) * (1 / ((m : ℝ) * ((m : ℝ) - 1))) :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum hgeom
    _ = (1 / 2) * ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 2 N, 1 / ((m : ℝ) * ((m : ℝ) - 1)) := by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    _ ≤ 1 := by linarith

(f : ℕ → ℝ) (A : ℝ) (G : ℂ → ℂ)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := cheby_log_weight_bound f hcheby
  have hK0 : 0 ≤ K :=
    le_trans (tsum_nonneg (fun n => by positivity)) (hK 1 le_rfl).2
  have hM0 : 0 ≤ K + |A| * (2 * Real.pi ^ 2) := by positivity
  
  have fourier_W21_decay : ∀ (h : ℝ → ℂ), ContDiff ℝ 2 h → MeasureTheory.Integrable h →
      MeasureTheory.Integrable (deriv h) → MeasureTheory.Integrable (iteratedDeriv 2 h) →
      Continuous (FourierTransform.fourier h) ∧
      ∀ ξ : ℝ, ‖FourierTransform.fourier h ξ‖ ≤
        ((∫ t : ℝ, ‖h t‖) + (4 * Real.pi ^ 2)⁻¹ * ∫ t : ℝ, ‖iteratedDeriv 2 h t‖) *
          (1 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
    intro h hc hi hd hdd
    have hrep : ∀ k : ℝ → ℂ, FourierTransform.fourier k =
        fun w : ℝ => ∫ v : ℝ, Complex.exp (↑(-2 * Real.pi * v * w) * Complex.I) • k v :=
      fun k => funext (Real.fourier_real_eq_integral_exp_smul k)
    have hbd : ∀ (k : ℝ → ℂ) (w : ℝ), ‖FourierTransform.fourier k w‖ ≤ ∫ t : ℝ, ‖k t‖ := by
      intro k w
      rw [hrep k]
      refine (MeasureTheory.norm_integral_le_integral_norm _).trans (le_of_eq ?_)
      congr 1
      ext v
      rw [norm_smul, Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, one_mul]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hrep h]
      refine MeasureTheory.continuous_of_dominated (bound := fun v => ‖h v‖) ?_ ?_ hi.norm ?_
      · intro w
        exact (Continuous.aestronglyMeasurable (by fun_prop)).smul hi.aestronglyMeasurable
      · intro w
        exact MeasureTheory.ae_of_all _ fun v => by
          rw [norm_smul, Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, one_mul]
      · exact MeasureTheory.ae_of_all _ fun v => by fun_prop
    · intro ξ
      have hdiff : Differentiable ℝ h := hc.differentiable (by norm_num)
      have hdiff' : Differentiable ℝ (deriv h) := by
        have := hc.differentiable_iteratedDeriv 1 (by norm_num)
        rwa [iteratedDeriv_one] at this
      have h2eq : iteratedDeriv 2 h = deriv (deriv h) := by
        rw [iteratedDeriv_succ, iteratedDeriv_one]
      have hdd' : MeasureTheory.Integrable (deriv (deriv h)) := h2eq ▸ hdd
      have hF1 := Real.fourier_deriv hi hdiff hd
      have hF2 := Real.fourier_deriv hd hdiff' hdd'
      have hn : ‖(2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I * (ξ : ℂ))‖ = 2 * Real.pi * |ξ| := by
        rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, norm_mul, Complex.norm_I, Complex.norm_real, Complex.norm_real,
          Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos Real.pi_pos]
        norm_num
      have hval : ‖FourierTransform.fourier (iteratedDeriv 2 h) ξ‖ =
          4 * Real.pi ^ 2 * ξ ^ 2 * ‖FourierTransform.fourier h ξ‖ := by
        rw [h2eq, hF2]
        simp only
        rw [hF1]
        simp only
        rw [norm_smul, norm_smul, hn]
        have e : 2 * Real.pi * |ξ| * (2 * Real.pi * |ξ| * ‖FourierTransform.fourier h ξ‖) =
            4 * Real.pi ^ 2 * |ξ| ^ 2 * ‖FourierTransform.fourier h ξ‖ := by ring
        rw [e, sq_abs]
      have h0 := hbd h ξ
      have h2 := hbd (iteratedDeriv 2 h) ξ
      rw [hval] at h2
      set a := ‖FourierTransform.fourier h ξ‖
      set I0 := ∫ t : ℝ, ‖h t‖
      set I2 := ∫ t : ℝ, ‖iteratedDeriv 2 h t‖
      have hpi : 0 < 4 * Real.pi ^ 2 := by positivity
      have h3 : ξ ^ 2 * a ≤ (4 * Real.pi ^ 2)⁻¹ * I2 := by
        rw [inv_mul_eq_div, le_div_iff₀ hpi]
        linarith [show ξ ^ 2 * a * (4 * Real.pi ^ 2) = 4 * Real.pi ^ 2 * ξ ^ 2 * a by ring]
      rw [← div_eq_mul_inv, le_div_iff₀ (by positivity)]
      linarith [show a * (1 + ξ ^ 2) = a + ξ ^ 2 * a by ring]
  
  have fourier_W21_diff_decay : ∀ (h₁ h₂ : ℝ → ℂ),
      ContDiff ℝ 2 h₁ → MeasureTheory.Integrable h₁ →
      MeasureTheory.Integrable (deriv h₁) → MeasureTheory.Integrable (iteratedDeriv 2 h₁) →
      ContDiff ℝ 2 h₂ → MeasureTheory.Integrable h₂ →
      MeasureTheory.Integrable (deriv h₂) → MeasureTheory.Integrable (iteratedDeriv 2 h₂) →
      ∀ ξ : ℝ, ‖FourierTransform.fourier h₁ ξ - FourierTransform.fourier h₂ ξ‖ ≤
        ((∫ t : ℝ, ‖h₁ t - h₂ t‖) +
          (4 * Real.pi ^ 2)⁻¹ * ∫ t : ℝ, ‖iteratedDeriv 2 h₁ t - iteratedDeriv 2 h₂ t‖) *
          (1 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
    intro h₁ h₂ h₁c h₁i h₁d h₁dd h₂c h₂i h₂d h₂dd ξ
    have hd1 : Differentiable ℝ h₁ := h₁c.differentiable (by norm_num)
    have hd2 : Differentiable ℝ h₂ := h₂c.differentiable (by norm_num)
    have hderiv : deriv (h₁ - h₂) = deriv h₁ - deriv h₂ := by
      funext t
      exact deriv_sub (hd1 t) (hd2 t)
    have hiter : iteratedDeriv 2 (h₁ - h₂) = iteratedDeriv 2 h₁ - iteratedDeriv 2 h₂ := by
      funext t
      exact iteratedDeriv_sub h₁c.contDiffAt h₂c.contDiffAt
    have hfour : ∀ (k : ℝ → ℂ), MeasureTheory.Integrable k →
        MeasureTheory.Integrable
          (fun v : ℝ => Complex.exp (↑(-2 * Real.pi * v * ξ) * Complex.I) • k v) := by
      intro k hk
      refine MeasureTheory.Integrable.mono' hk.norm ?_ ?_
      · refine MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable.smul ?_ hk.aestronglyMeasurable
        exact (Continuous.aestronglyMeasurable (by fun_prop))
      · exact MeasureTheory.ae_of_all _ fun v => by
          rw [norm_smul, Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, one_mul]
    have hsub : FourierTransform.fourier (h₁ - h₂) ξ =
        FourierTransform.fourier h₁ ξ - FourierTransform.fourier h₂ ξ := by
      rw [Real.fourier_real_eq_integral_exp_smul, Real.fourier_real_eq_integral_exp_smul,
        Real.fourier_real_eq_integral_exp_smul,
        ← MeasureTheory.integral_sub (hfour _ h₁i) (hfour _ h₂i)]
      congr 1
      ext v
      simp only [Pi.sub_apply, smul_sub]
    have key := (fourier_W21_decay (h₁ - h₂) (h₁c.sub h₂c) (h₁i.sub h₂i)
      (by rw [hderiv]; exact h₁d.sub h₂d) (by rw [hiter]; exact h₁dd.sub h₂dd)).2 ξ
    rw [hsub, hiter] at key
    simpa using key
  
  have riemann_lebesgue_cpow : ∀ F : ℝ → ℂ,
      Filter.Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => ∫ t : ℝ, F t * (x : ℂ) ^ ((t : ℂ) * Complex.I))
        Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
    intro F
    have hlim : Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => -Real.log x / (2 * Real.pi)) atTop (cocompact ℝ) := by
      refine Tendsto.mono_right ?_ atBot_le_cocompact
      have h1 : Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => -Real.log x) atTop atBot :=
        tendsto_neg_atTop_atBot.comp Real.tendsto_log_atTop
      exact h1.atBot_div_const (by positivity)
    have hF := (Real.zero_at_infty_fourier F).comp hlim
    refine hF.congr' ?_
    filter_upwards [eventually_gt_atTop (0 : ℝ)] with x hx
    simp only [Function.comp]
    rw [Real.fourier_real_eq_integral_exp_smul]
    congr 1
    ext t
    rw [Complex.cpow_def_of_ne_zero (by exact_mod_cast hx.ne'), ← Complex.ofReal_log hx.le,
      smul_eq_mul, mul_comm (F t)]
    congr 1
    congr 1
    push_cast
    field_simp
  
  have sigma_limit_right : ∀ (ψ : ℝ → ℂ), Continuous ψ → HasCompactSupport ψ → ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x →
      Filter.Tendsto (fun σ : ℝ =>
          ∫ t : ℝ, G ((σ : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I) * ψ t * (x : ℂ) ^ ((t : ℂ) * Complex.I))
        (nhdsWithin 1 (Set.Ioi 1))
        (nhds (∫ t : ℝ, G (1 + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I) * ψ t * (x : ℂ) ^ ((t : ℂ) * Complex.I))) := by
    intro ψ hψc hψs x hx
    set S : Set ℂ := (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (p.1 : ℂ) + (p.2 : ℂ) * Complex.I) ''
      (Set.Icc (1 : ℝ) 2 ×ˢ tsupport ψ) with hS
    have hScpt : IsCompact S := (isCompact_Icc.prod hψs).image (by fun_prop)
    have hSsub : S ⊆ {s | 1 ≤ s.re} := by
      rintro _ ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Complex.add_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.mul_re,
        Complex.I_re, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.I_im]
      have := hp.1.1
      linarith
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hScpt.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hG.mono hSsub)
    have hxnorm : ∀ t : ℝ, ‖(x : ℂ) ^ ((t : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ = 1 := by
      intro t
      rw [Complex.norm_cpow_eq_rpow_re_of_pos hx]
      simp
    have hcont : ∀ σ : ℝ, 1 ≤ σ → Continuous (fun t : ℝ =>
        G ((σ : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I) * ψ t * (x : ℂ) ^ ((t : ℂ) * Complex.I)) := by
      intro σ hσ
      refine Continuous.mul (Continuous.mul ?_ hψc) ?_
      · refine hG.comp_continuous (by fun_prop) fun t => ?_
        simp [hσ]
      · exact Continuous.const_cpow (by fun_prop) (Or.inl (by exact_mod_cast hx.ne'))
    have h1 : (1 : ℂ) = ((1 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by simp
    rw [h1]
    refine MeasureTheory.tendsto_integral_filter_of_dominated_convergence
      (fun t => C * ‖ψ t‖) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with σ hσ
      exact (hcont σ (le_of_lt hσ)).aestronglyMeasurable
    · filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhdsGT (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) < 2)] with σ hσ
      refine MeasureTheory.ae_of_all _ fun t => ?_
      rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, hxnorm, mul_one]
      by_cases ht : t ∈ tsupport ψ
      · exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
          (hC _ ⟨(σ, t), ⟨⟨hσ.1.le, hσ.2.le⟩, ht⟩, rfl⟩) (norm_nonneg _)
      · rw [image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport ht]
        simp
    · exact (hψc.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hψs).norm.const_mul C
    · refine MeasureTheory.ae_of_all _ fun t => ?_
      refine Tendsto.mul_const _ (Tendsto.mul_const _ ?_)
      have hw : ContinuousWithinAt G {s | 1 ≤ s.re} (((1 : ℝ) : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I) :=
        hG _ (by simp)
      refine hw.tendsto.comp ?_
      rw [tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff]
      constructor
      · refine Tendsto.mono_left ?_ nhdsWithin_le_nhds
        exact ((Complex.continuous_ofReal.tendsto 1).add_const _)
      · filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with σ hσ
        simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Complex.add_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.mul_re,
          Complex.I_re, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.I_im]
        have : (1 : ℝ) < σ := hσ
        linarith
  
  have decay_functional_diff_bound : ∀ (x K M₁ M₂ D : ℝ) (φ₁ φ₂ : ℝ → ℂ),
      Continuous φ₁ → Continuous φ₂ →
      (∀ ξ : ℝ, ‖φ₁ ξ‖ ≤ M₁ * (1 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹) →
      (∀ ξ : ℝ, ‖φ₂ ξ‖ ≤ M₂ * (1 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹) →
      (∀ ξ : ℝ, ‖φ₁ ξ - φ₂ ξ‖ ≤ D * (1 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹) →
      Summable (fun n : ℕ => |f n| / (n : ℝ) *
        (1 + (1 / (2 * Real.pi) * Real.log ((n : ℝ) / x)) ^ 2)⁻¹) →
      ∑' n : ℕ, |f n| / (n : ℝ) * (1 + (1 / (2 * Real.pi) * Real.log ((n : ℝ) / x)) ^ 2)⁻¹ ≤ K →
      ‖((∑' n : ℕ, (f n : ℂ) / (n : ℂ) * φ₁ (1 / (2 * Real.pi) * Real.log ((n : ℝ) / x))) -
          (A : ℂ) * ∫ u in Set.Ici (-Real.log x), φ₁ (u / (2 * Real.pi))) -
        ((∑' n : ℕ, (f n : ℂ) / (n : ℂ) * φ₂ (1 / (2 * Real.pi) * Real.log ((n : ℝ) / x))) -
          (A : ℂ) * ∫ u in Set.Ici (-Real.log x), φ₂ (u / (2 * Real.pi)))‖ ≤
        D * (K + |A| * (2 * Real.pi ^ 2)) := by
    intro x K M₁ M₂ D φ₁ φ₂ hφ₁c hφ₂c hφ₁ hφ₂ hD hw hK
    have hD0 : 0 ≤ D := by
      have := hD 0
      norm_num at this
      exact le_trans (norm_nonneg _) this
    have hterm : ∀ (Φ : ℝ → ℂ) (M : ℝ), (∀ ξ : ℝ, ‖Φ ξ‖ ≤ M * (1 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹) → ∀ n : ℕ,
        ‖(f n : ℂ) / (n : ℂ) * Φ (1 / (2 * Real.pi) * Real.log ((n : ℝ) / x))‖ ≤
          M * (|f n| / (n : ℝ) * (1 + (1 / (2 * Real.pi) * Real.log ((n : ℝ) / x)) ^ 2)⁻¹) := by
      intro Φ M hΦ n

subgoal_signatures.name: cheby_log_weight_bound
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(f : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hcheby : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ N : ℕ, ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, |f n| ≤ C * N) :
    ∃ K : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ, 1 ≤ x →
      Summable (fun n : ℕ => |f n| / (n : ℝ) *
        (1 + (1 / (2 * Real.pi) * Real.log ((n : ℝ) / x)) ^ 2)⁻¹) ∧
      ∑' n : ℕ, |f n| / (n : ℝ) * (1 + (1 / (2 * Real.pi) * Real.log ((n : ℝ) / x)) ^ 2)⁻¹ ≤ K

subgoal_signatures.name: fourier_identity_sigma_gt_one
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(f : ℕ → ℝ) (A : ℝ) (G : ℂ → ℂ)
    (hf : ∀ σ : ℝ, 1 < σ → LSeriesSummable (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) σ)
    (hG' : Set.EqOn G (fun s => LSeries (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) s - (A : ℂ) / (s - 1)) {s | 1 < s.re})
    (ψ : ℝ → ℂ) (hψc : Continuous ψ) (hψi : MeasureTheory.Integrable ψ)
    (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) (σ : ℝ) (hσ : 1 < σ) :
    (∑' n : ℕ, (f n : ℂ) / (n : ℂ) ^ (σ : ℂ) *
        FourierTransform.fourier ψ (1 / (2 * Real.pi) * Real.log ((n : ℝ) / x))) -
      (A : ℂ) * ((x ^ (1 - σ) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
        ∫ u in Set.Ici (-Real.log x), ((Real.exp (-u * (σ - 1)) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
          FourierTransform.fourier ψ (u / (2 * Real.pi)) =
      ∫ t : ℝ, G ((σ : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I) * ψ t * (x : ℂ) ^ ((t : ℂ) * Complex.I)

subgoal_signatures.name: schwartz_W21_truncation
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(g : SchwartzMap ℝ ℂ) :
    (ContDiff ℝ 2 (g : ℝ → ℂ) ∧ MeasureTheory.Integrable (g : ℝ → ℂ) ∧
      MeasureTheory.Integrable (deriv (g : ℝ → ℂ)) ∧
      MeasureTheory.Integrable (iteratedDeriv 2 (g : ℝ → ℂ))) ∧
    ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ ψ : ℝ → ℂ, ContDiff ℝ 2 ψ ∧ HasCompactSupport ψ ∧
      MeasureTheory.Integrable ψ ∧ MeasureTheory.Integrable (deriv ψ) ∧
      MeasureTheory.Integrable (iteratedDeriv 2 ψ) ∧
      (∫ t, ‖(g : ℝ → ℂ) t - ψ t‖) +
        (4 * Real.pi ^ 2)⁻¹ * ∫ t, ‖iteratedDeriv 2 (g : ℝ → ℂ) t - iteratedDeriv 2 ψ t‖ < ε
