by
  have h0notin : (0 : ℝ) ∉ tsupport Ψ := fun h => lt_irrefl (0 : ℝ) (hplus h)
  have hΨ0 : Ψ 0 = 0 := image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport h0notin
  have hcont : Continuous Ψ := hsmooth.continuous
  have h2pi : (2 * Real.pi) ≠ 0 := Real.two_pi_pos.ne'
  
  have hce : HasCompactSupport (fun u : ℝ => Ψ (Real.exp u)) := by
    have hK : IsCompact (tsupport Ψ) := hsupp
    have hK' : IsCompact (Real.log '' tsupport Ψ) :=
      hK.image_of_continuousOn (Real.continuousOn_log.mono (fun y hy => by
        have : 0 < y := hplus hy
        simpa using this.ne'))
    refine HasCompactSupport.intro hK' ?_
    intro u hu
    apply image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport
    intro hmem
    exact hu ⟨Real.exp u, hmem, Real.log_exp u⟩
  
  set ph : ℝ → ℝ := fun w => Real.exp (2 * Real.pi * w) * Ψ (Real.exp (2 * Real.pi * w)) with hph
  have he : ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) (fun w : ℝ => Real.exp (2 * Real.pi * w)) :=
    (contDiff_const.mul contDiff_id).exp
  have hphs : ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) ph := he.mul (hsmooth.comp he)
  have hphc : HasCompactSupport ph := by
    have h1 : HasCompactSupport (fun w : ℝ => Ψ (Real.exp ((2 * Real.pi) • w))) :=
      hce.comp_smul h2pi
    simp only [smul_eq_mul] at h1
    exact h1.mul_left
  let h : ℝ → ℂ := fun w => ((ph w : ℝ) : ℂ)
  have hhs : ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) h := Complex.ofRealCLM.contDiff.comp hphs
  have hhc : HasCompactSupport h := hphc.comp_left (g := Complex.ofReal) (by simp)
  let H : SchwartzMap ℝ ℂ := hhc.toSchwartzMap hhs
  let g : SchwartzMap ℝ ℂ := FourierTransformInv.fourierInv H
  have hg : ∀ w, FourierTransform.fourier (g : ℝ → ℂ) w = ((ph w : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    intro w
    have h1 : FourierTransform.fourier g = H := FourierTransform.fourier_fourierInv_eq H
    rw [← SchwartzMap.fourier_coe, h1]
    exact HasCompactSupport.toSchwartzMap_toFun hhc hhs w
  
  have hs3 : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → ∫ u in Set.Ici (-Real.log x), Real.exp u * Ψ (Real.exp u) =
      ∫ y in Set.Ioi x⁻¹, Ψ y := by
    intro x hx
    rw [MeasureTheory.integral_Ici_eq_integral_Ioi]
    have l1 : ContinuousOn Real.exp (Set.Ici (-Real.log x)) := Real.continuous_exp.continuousOn
    have l3 : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioi (-Real.log x),
        HasDerivWithinAt Real.exp (Real.exp t) (Set.Ioi t) t :=
      fun t _ => (Real.hasDerivAt_exp t).hasDerivWithinAt
    have l4 : ContinuousOn Ψ (Real.exp '' Set.Ioi (-Real.log x)) := hcont.continuousOn
    have l5 : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn Ψ (Real.exp '' Set.Ici (-Real.log x)) :=
      (hcont.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hsupp).integrableOn
    have l6 : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun u => Real.exp u • (Ψ ∘ Real.exp) u)
        (Set.Ici (-Real.log x)) := by
      refine (Continuous.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport ?_ ?_).integrableOn
      · exact Real.continuous_exp.smul (hcont.comp Real.continuous_exp)
      · change HasCompactSupport (fun u => Real.exp u * Ψ (Real.exp u))
        exact hce.mul_left (f := Real.exp)
    have := MeasureTheory.integral_comp_smul_deriv_Ioi l1 Real.tendsto_exp_atTop l3 l4 l5 l6
    simpa [Real.exp_neg, Real.exp_log hx] using this
  
  have hI : ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop, ∫ y in Set.Ioi x⁻¹, Ψ y = ∫ y in Set.Ioi 0, Ψ y := by
    have h0 : Ψ =ᶠ[𝓝 0] 0 := notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.mp h0notin
    obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp h0
    filter_upwards [eventually_gt_atTop ε⁻¹] with x hx
    have hεinv : 0 < ε⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr hε
    have hx0 : 0 < x := hεinv.trans hx
    have hxinv : x⁻¹ < ε := by rw [inv_lt_comm₀ hx0 hε]; exact hx
    symm
    apply MeasureTheory.setIntegral_eq_of_subset_of_forall_diff_eq_zero measurableSet_Ioi
    · exact Set.Ioi_subset_Ioi (inv_pos.mpr hx0).le
    · intro y hy
      obtain ⟨hy1, hy2⟩ := hy
      simp only [Set.mem_Ioi, not_lt] at hy1 hy2
      apply hball
      rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_pos hy1]
      linarith
  
  have hterm : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → ∀ n : ℕ,
      (f n : ℂ) / (n : ℂ) *
          FourierTransform.fourier (g : ℝ → ℂ) (1 / (2 * Real.pi) * Real.log ((n : ℝ) / x)) =
        ((f n * Ψ (n / x) / x : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    intro x hx n
    rw [hg]
    have hlog : 2 * Real.pi * (1 / (2 * Real.pi) * Real.log ((n : ℝ) / x)) =
        Real.log ((n : ℝ) / x) := by
      field_simp
    simp only [hph, hlog]
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with hn | hn
    · subst hn
      simp [hΨ0]
    · have hnx : 0 < (n : ℝ) / x := by positivity
      rw [Real.exp_log hnx]
      have hn' : (n : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hn.ne'
      have hx' : (x : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hx.ne'
      push_cast
      field_simp
  have hseries : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x →
      (∑' n : ℕ, (f n : ℂ) / (n : ℂ) *
          FourierTransform.fourier (g : ℝ → ℂ) (1 / (2 * Real.pi) * Real.log ((n : ℝ) / x))) =
        (((∑' n : ℕ, f n * Ψ (n / x)) / x : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    intro x hx
    rw [tsum_congr (hterm x hx), ← Complex.ofReal_tsum, tsum_div_const]
  have hintegral : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x →
      (∫ u in Set.Ici (-Real.log x), FourierTransform.fourier (g : ℝ → ℂ) (u / (2 * Real.pi))) =
        ((∫ y in Set.Ioi x⁻¹, Ψ y : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    intro x hx
    have hpt : ∀ u : ℝ, FourierTransform.fourier (g : ℝ → ℂ) (u / (2 * Real.pi)) =
        ((Real.exp u * Ψ (Real.exp u) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      intro u
      rw [hg]
      have : 2 * Real.pi * (u / (2 * Real.pi)) = u := by field_simp
      simp only [hph, this]
    simp_rw [hpt]
    rw [← hs3 x hx]
    exact integral_complex_ofReal
  
  have hC : Filter.Tendsto (fun x : ℝ =>
      ((((∑' n : ℕ, f n * Ψ (n / x)) / x) - A * ∫ y in Set.Ioi 0, Ψ y : ℝ) : ℂ))
      Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
    refine (hS g).congr' ?_
    filter_upwards [eventually_gt_atTop 0, hI] with x hx hIx
    rw [hseries x hx, hintegral x hx, hIx]
    push_cast
    ring
  have hR := (Complex.continuous_re.tendsto 0).comp hC
  simp only [Function.comp_def, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.zero_re] at hR
  exact tendsto_sub_nhds_zero_iff.mp hR

informal_problem.statement:
(f : ℕ → ℝ) (A : ℝ) (hpos : ∀ n, 0 ≤ f n)
    (hcheby : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ N : ℕ, ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, |f n| ≤ C * N)
    (hsmooth : ∀ Ψ : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) Ψ → HasCompactSupport Ψ →
      tsupport Ψ ⊆ Set.Ioi 0 →
      Filter.Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => (∑' n : ℕ, f n * Ψ (n / x)) / x) Filter.atTop
        (nhds (A * ∫ y in Set.Ioi 0, Ψ y))) :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => (∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, f n) / (N : ℝ)) Filter.atTop (nhds A)

signature.name: cumsum_limit_of_smooth_limits
signature.statement:
(f : ℕ → ℝ) (A : ℝ) (hpos : ∀ n, 0 ≤ f n)
    (hcheby : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ N : ℕ, ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, |f n| ≤ C * N)
    (hsmooth : ∀ Ψ : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) Ψ → HasCompactSupport Ψ →
      tsupport Ψ ⊆ Set.Ioi 0 →
      Filter.Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => (∑' n : ℕ, f n * Ψ (n / x)) / x) Filter.atTop
        (nhds (A * ∫ y in Set.Ioi 0, Ψ y))) :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => (∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, f n) / (N : ℝ)) Filter.atTop (nhds A)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have s1 : ∀ (a b δ : ℝ), a < b → 0 < δ →
      ∃ Ψ : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) Ψ ∧ HasCompactSupport Ψ ∧ Continuous Ψ ∧
        (∀ y, 0 ≤ Ψ y) ∧ (∀ y, Ψ y ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ y ∈ Set.Icc a b, Ψ y = 1) ∧
        (∀ y, Ψ y ≠ 0 → a - δ < y ∧ y < b + δ) ∧ tsupport Ψ ⊆ Set.Icc (a - δ) (b + δ) := by
    intro a b δ hab hδ
    let bmp : ContDiffBump ((a + b) / 2) :=
      ⟨(b - a) / 2, (b - a) / 2 + δ, by linarith, by linarith⟩
    have hrIn : bmp.rIn = (b - a) / 2 := rfl
    have hrOut : bmp.rOut = (b - a) / 2 + δ := rfl
    refine ⟨bmp, bmp.contDiff, bmp.hasCompactSupport, bmp.continuous, fun y => bmp.nonneg,
      fun y => bmp.le_one, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro y hy
      apply bmp.one_of_mem_closedBall
      rw [Real.closedBall_eq_Icc, hrIn]
      constructor <;> linarith [hy.1, hy.2]
    · intro y hy
      have hmem : y ∈ Function.support bmp := hy
      rw [bmp.support_eq, Real.ball_eq_Ioo, hrOut] at hmem
      constructor <;> linarith [hmem.1, hmem.2]
    · rw [bmp.tsupport_eq, Real.closedBall_eq_Icc, hrOut]
      intro y hy
      constructor <;> linarith [hy.1, hy.2]
  
  have s2 : ∀ (Ψ : ℝ → ℝ) (a b δ : ℝ), Continuous Ψ → a ≤ b → 0 ≤ δ → 0 < a - δ →
      (∀ y, 0 ≤ Ψ y) → (∀ y, Ψ y ≤ 1) → (∀ y ∈ Set.Icc a b, Ψ y = 1) →
      (∀ y, Ψ y ≠ 0 → a - δ < y ∧ y < b + δ) →
      b - a ≤ ∫ y in Set.Ioi 0, Ψ y ∧ ∫ y in Set.Ioi 0, Ψ y ≤ b - a + 2 * δ := by
    intro Ψ a b δ hcont hab hδ hpos' h0 h1 hone hsupp
    have hJ : Set.Icc (a - δ) (b + δ) ⊆ Set.Ioi 0 := fun x hx => lt_of_lt_of_le hpos' hx.1
    have heq : ∫ y in Set.Ioi 0, Ψ y = ∫ y in Set.Icc (a - δ) (b + δ), Ψ y := by
      apply MeasureTheory.setIntegral_eq_of_subset_of_forall_diff_eq_zero measurableSet_Ioi hJ
      intro x hx
      by_contra hne
      have := hsupp x hne
      exact hx.2 ⟨this.1.le, this.2.le⟩
    have hint : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn Ψ (Set.Icc (a - δ) (b + δ)) := hcont.integrableOn_Icc
    rw [heq]
    constructor
    · have h1' : ∫ y in Set.Icc a b, Ψ y = b - a := by
        rw [MeasureTheory.setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Icc hone]
        simp [Real.volume_real_Icc_of_le hab]
      rw [← h1']
      apply MeasureTheory.setIntegral_mono_set hint
      · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall h0
      · exact (Set.Icc_subset_Icc (by linarith) (by linarith)).eventuallyLE
    · calc ∫ y in Set.Icc (a - δ) (b + δ), Ψ y ≤ ∫ y in Set.Icc (a - δ) (b + δ), (1 : ℝ) :=
            MeasureTheory.setIntegral_mono_on hint continuous_const.integrableOn_Icc
              measurableSet_Icc (fun y _ => h1 y)
        _ = b - a + 2 * δ := by
            simp [Real.volume_real_Icc_of_le (by linarith : a - δ ≤ b + δ)]
            ring
  
  have s3 : ∀ (Ψ : ℝ → ℝ), (∀ y, 2 ≤ y → Ψ y = 0) → ∀ N : ℕ, 0 < N →
      ∑' n : ℕ, f n * Ψ ((n : ℝ) / (N : ℝ)) =
        ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (2 * N), f n * Ψ ((n : ℝ) / (N : ℝ)) := by
    intro Ψ hΨ N hN
    apply tsum_eq_sum
    intro n hn
    rw [Finset.mem_range, not_lt] at hn
    have hN' : (0 : ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast hN
    have h2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ n / N := by
      rw [le_div_iff₀ hN']
      exact_mod_cast hn
    rw [hΨ _ h2, mul_zero]
  
  have s4 : ∀ (C : ℝ), (∀ N : ℕ, ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, |f n| ≤ C * N) →
      ∀ (Ψ : ℝ → ℝ), (∀ y, 0 ≤ Ψ y) → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → (∀ y, ε ≤ y → y ≤ 1 → Ψ y = 1) →
      ∀ N : ℕ, 0 < N →
      ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, f n ≤
        C * (ε * N + 1) + ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (2 * N), f n * Ψ ((n : ℝ) / (N : ℝ)) := by
    intro C hC Ψ hΨ0 ε hε hΨ1 N hN
    have hN' : (0 : ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast hN
    have hC0 : 0 ≤ C := by
      have := hC 1
      simp at this
      linarith [abs_nonneg (f 0)]
    set K := ⌊ε * N⌋₊ + 1 with hK
    have hpt : ∀ n ∈ Finset.range N,
        f n ≤ (if n < K then f n else 0) + f n * Ψ ((n : ℝ) / (N : ℝ)) := by
      intro n hn
      rw [Finset.mem_range] at hn
      split_ifs with h
      · linarith [mul_nonneg (hpos n) (hΨ0 ((n : ℝ) / N))]
      · push_neg at h
        have h1 : ε * N < n := by
          have := Nat.lt_floor_add_one (ε * N)
          have h2 : ((⌊ε * N⌋₊ + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast h
          push_cast at h2
          linarith
        have h2 : ε ≤ (n : ℝ) / N := by rw [le_div_iff₀ hN']; linarith
        have h3 : (n : ℝ) / N ≤ 1 := by rw [div_le_one hN']; exact_mod_cast hn.le
        rw [hΨ1 _ h2 h3]
        simp
    have hsum1 : ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, (if n < K then f n else 0) ≤ C * (ε * N + 1) := by
      calc ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, (if n < K then f n else 0)
            ≤ ∑ n ∈ Finset.range K, f n := by
              rw [← Finset.sum_filter]
              apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg
              · intro n hn
                simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range] at hn ⊢
                exact hn.2
              · intro n _ _
                exact hpos n
        _ = ∑ n ∈ Finset.range K, |f n| :=
              Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun n _ => (abs_of_nonneg (hpos n)).symm)
        _ ≤ C * K := hC K
        _ ≤ C * (ε * N + 1) := by
              apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ hC0
              rw [hK]
              push_cast
              linarith [Nat.floor_le (by positivity : 0 ≤ ε * N)]
    have hsum2 : ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, f n * Ψ ((n : ℝ) / (N : ℝ)) ≤
        ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (2 * N), f n * Ψ ((n : ℝ) / (N : ℝ)) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg
      · intro n hn
        simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hn ⊢
        omega
      · intro n _ _
        exact mul_nonneg (hpos n) (hΨ0 _)
    calc ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, f n
          ≤ ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N,
              ((if n < K then f n else 0) + f n * Ψ ((n : ℝ) / (N : ℝ))) := Finset.sum_le_sum hpt
      _ = ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, (if n < K then f n else 0) +
            ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, f n * Ψ ((n : ℝ) / (N : ℝ)) := Finset.sum_add_distrib
      _ ≤ _ := add_le_add hsum1 hsum2
  
  have s5 : ∀ (Ψ : ℝ → ℝ), (∀ y, Ψ y ≤ 1) → (∀ y, 1 ≤ y → Ψ y = 0) → ∀ N : ℕ, 0 < N →
      ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (2 * N), f n * Ψ ((n : ℝ) / (N : ℝ)) ≤ ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, f n := by
    intro Ψ hΨ1 hΨz N hN
    have hN' : (0 : ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast hN
    rw [two_mul, Finset.sum_range_add]
    have hz : ∑ k ∈ Finset.range N, f (N + k) * Ψ (((N + k : ℕ) : ℝ) / (N : ℝ)) = 0 := by
      apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
      intro k _
      have h1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ((N + k : ℕ) : ℝ) / N := by
        rw [le_div_iff₀ hN']
        push_cast
        linarith [(Nat.cast_nonneg k : (0 : ℝ) ≤ k)]
      rw [hΨz _ h1, mul_zero]
    rw [hz, add_zero]
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro n _
    exact mul_le_of_le_one_right (hpos n) (hΨ1 _)
  
  have s6 : ∀ (a : ℕ → ℝ) (A K : ℝ), 0 ≤ K →
      (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ε < 1 / 4 → ∃ (g u : ℕ → ℝ) (Lg Lu : ℝ),
        Filter.Tendsto g Filter.atTop (nhds Lg) ∧ Filter.Tendsto u Filter.atTop (nhds Lu) ∧
        |Lg - A| ≤ K * ε ∧ |Lu - A| ≤ K * ε ∧
        ∀ᶠ N in Filter.atTop, g N ≤ a N ∧ a N ≤ u N + K * ε) →
      Filter.Tendsto a Filter.atTop (nhds A) := by
    intro a A K hK h
    have hchoose : ∀ d : ℝ, 0 < d → ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ε < 1 / 4 ∧ K * ε < d / 2 := by
      intro d hd
      refine ⟨min (1 / 8) (d / (2 * (K + 1))), lt_min (by norm_num) (by positivity),
        lt_of_le_of_lt (min_le_left _ _) (by norm_num), ?_⟩
      have hle : min (1 / 8) (d / (2 * (K + 1))) ≤ d / (2 * (K + 1)) := min_le_right _ _
      have hK1 : K + 1 ≠ 0 := by linarith
      calc K * min (1 / 8) (d / (2 * (K + 1))) ≤ K * (d / (2 * (K + 1))) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hle hK
        _ < (K + 1) * (d / (2 * (K + 1))) :=
            mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right (by linarith) (by positivity)
        _ = d / 2 := by field_simp
    rw [tendsto_order]
    constructor
    · intro a' ha'
      obtain ⟨ε, hε0, hε1, hKε⟩ := hchoose (A - a') (by linarith)
      obtain ⟨g, u, Lg, Lu, hg, hu, hLg, hLu, hev⟩ := h ε hε0 hε1
      have hLg' : a' < Lg := by
        have := (abs_le.1 hLg).1
        linarith
      filter_upwards [(tendsto_order.1 hg).1 a' hLg', hev] with N h1 h2
      linarith [h2.1]
    · intro b' hb'
      obtain ⟨ε, hε0, hε1, hKε⟩ := hchoose (b' - A) (by linarith)
      obtain ⟨g, u, Lg, Lu, hg, hu, hLg, hLu, hev⟩ := h ε hε0 hε1
      have hLu' : Lu < b' - K * ε := by
        have := (abs_le.1 hLu).2
        linarith
      filter_upwards [(tendsto_order.1 hu).2 (b' - K * ε) hLu', hev] with N h1 h2
      linarith [h2.2]
  
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hcheby
  have hC0 : 0 ≤ C := by
    have := hC 1
    simp at this
    linarith [abs_nonneg (f 0)]
  apply s6 _ A (2 * |A| + C) (by positivity)
  intro ε hε hε4
  obtain ⟨Ψp, hPs, hPc, hPcont, hP0, hP1, hPone, hPsupp, hPts⟩ :=
    s1 ε 1 (ε / 2) (by linarith) (by linarith)
  obtain ⟨Ψm, hMs, hMc, hMcont, hM0, hM1, hMone, hMsupp, hMts⟩ :=
    s1 (3 * ε / 2) (1 - ε / 2) (ε / 2) (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hPt : tsupport Ψp ⊆ Set.Ioi 0 := by
    intro y hy
    have := hPts hy
    simp only [Set.mem_Icc] at this
    show 0 < y
    linarith [this.1]
  have hMt : tsupport Ψm ⊆ Set.Ioi 0 := by
    intro y hy
    have := hMts hy
    simp only [Set.mem_Icc] at this
    show 0 < y
    linarith [this.1]
  have hPz : ∀ y, 2 ≤ y → Ψp y = 0 := by
    intro y hy
    by_contra hne
    have := hPsupp y hne
    linarith [this.2]
  have hMz1 : ∀ y, 1 ≤ y → Ψm y = 0 := by
    intro y hy
    by_contra hne
    have := hMsupp y hne
    linarith [this.2]
  have hMz : ∀ y, 2 ≤ y → Ψm y = 0 := fun y hy => hMz1 y (by linarith)
  obtain ⟨hIP1, hIP2⟩ := s2 Ψp ε 1 (ε / 2) hPcont (by linarith) (by linarith) (by linarith)
    hP0 hP1 hPone hPsupp
  obtain ⟨hIM1, hIM2⟩ := s2 Ψm (3 * ε / 2) (1 - ε / 2) (ε / 2) hMcont (by linarith)
    (by linarith) (by linarith) hM0 hM1 hMone hMsupp
  have hlimP := (hsmooth Ψp hPs hPc hPt).comp tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop
  have hlimM := (hsmooth Ψm hMs hMc hMt).comp tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop
  have hAε : 0 ≤ |A| * ε := mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg A) hε.le

    intro N hN

      have hdd : ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt (N + 1) / (((N:ℝ) + 1) * Real.log ((N:ℝ) + 1)) =
          ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt (N + 1) / ((N:ℝ) + 1) / Real.log ((N:ℝ) + 1) :=

    intro n hn
    have hp := hlogpos n hn
    have h1 : Real.log (n:ℝ) ≤ Real.log ((n:ℝ)+1) := Real.log_le_log (by positivity) (by linarith)
    have := one_div_le_one_div_of_le hp h1
    linarith
  have hsum : ∀ M N : ℕ, 2 ≤ M → M ≤ N → ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ico M N, (B * (1 / Real.log (n:ℝ) - 1 / Real.log ((n:ℝ) + 1)) + 8 * (1 / ((n:ℝ) - 1) - 1 / (n:ℝ))) = B / Real.log M - B / Real.log N + 8 / ((M:ℝ) - 1) - 8 / ((N:ℝ) - 1) := by
    intro M N hM hMN
    induction N, hMN using Nat.le_induction with
    | base => simp
    | succ N hMN ih =>
      rw [Finset.sum_Ico_succ_top hMN, ih, show ((N + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) - 1 = (N : ℝ) by push_cast; ring]
      push_cast
      ring
  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := s3
    (fun n => ((∑ d ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 n, ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d / (d : ℝ)) - Real.log n) * (1 / Real.log n - 1 / Real.log ((n : ℝ) + 1)) - (Real.log (Real.log ((n : ℝ) + 1)) - Real.log (Real.log n) - (1 - Real.log n / Real.log ((n : ℝ) + 1))))
    (fun n => B * (1 / Real.log (n:ℝ) - 1 / Real.log ((n:ℝ) + 1)) + 8 * (1 / ((n:ℝ) - 1) - 1 / (n:ℝ)))
    (fun M => B / Real.log M + 8 / ((M:ℝ) - 1)) 2
    (by
      intro n hn
      beta_reduce
      have hRn := hR n (by omega)
      have hd := hδ n hn
      obtain ⟨he0, he1⟩ := s2 n hn
      have hRd : |((∑ d ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 n, ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d / (d : ℝ)) - Real.log n) * (1 / Real.log n - 1 / Real.log ((n : ℝ) + 1))| ≤ B * (1 / Real.log (n:ℝ) - 1 / Real.log ((n:ℝ) + 1)) := by
        rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hd]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hRn hd
      have := abs_le.mp hRd
      exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩)

      intro M N hM hMN
      beta_reduce
      rw [hsum M N hM hMN]

      linarith)

  obtain ⟨hN2, hll, hlx⟩ := s4 x hx
  have hlogx : 0 < Real.log x := Real.log_pos (by linarith)
  generalize ⌊x⌋₊ = N at hN2 hll hlx ⊢
  have hid := s1 N hN2
  have hRN := hR N (by omega)
  have hLN : |L - ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ico 2 N, (((∑ d ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 n, ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d / (d : ℝ)) - Real.log n) * (1 / Real.log n - 1 / Real.log ((n : ℝ) + 1)) - (Real.log (Real.log ((n : ℝ) + 1)) - Real.log (Real.log n) - (1 - Real.log n / Real.log ((n : ℝ) + 1))))| ≤ B / Real.log N + 8 / ((N:ℝ) - 1) := hL N hN2
  have hp := hlogpos N hN2
  have hNr : (2:ℝ) ≤ N := by exact_mod_cast hN2
  have hRp : |((∑ d ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 N, ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d / (d : ℝ)) - Real.log N) / Real.log N| ≤ B / Real.log N := by
    rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos hp]; exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hRN hp.le
  have h8 : 8 / ((N:ℝ) - 1) ≤ 8 / Real.log N :=
    div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by norm_num) hp
      (by have := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (show (0:ℝ) < N by linarith); linarith)
  have hsplit : (2 * B + 9) / Real.log N = B / Real.log N + B / Real.log N + 8 / Real.log N + 1 / Real.log N := by ring
  have hfin : (2 * B + 9) / Real.log N ≤ (4 * B + 18) / Real.log x := by
    rw [div_le_div_iff₀ hp hlogx]
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlx (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2 * B + 9)]
  rw [hsplit] at hfin
  have a1 := abs_le.mp hLN
  have a2 := abs_le.mp hRp
  have a3 := abs_le.mp hll
  exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩

signature.name: log_riemannZeta_eq_tsum_vonMangoldt

proof.tactics:
by
  intro s hs
  set f : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n / ((n : ℝ) ^ s * Real.log n) with hf
  
  have hsum : Summable f := by
    refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun n => ?_) (fun n => ?_)
      (Real.summable_one_div_nat_rpow.mpr hs)
    · exact div_nonneg ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt_nonneg
        (mul_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg n) s) (Real.log_natCast_nonneg n))
    · show ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n / ((n : ℝ) ^ s * Real.log n) ≤ 1 / (n : ℝ) ^ s
      have hD : 0 ≤ (n : ℝ) ^ s * Real.log n :=
        mul_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg n) s) (Real.log_natCast_nonneg n)
      calc ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n / ((n : ℝ) ^ s * Real.log n)
          ≤ Real.log n / ((n : ℝ) ^ s * Real.log n) :=
            div_le_div_of_nonneg_right ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt_le_log hD
        _ ≤ 1 / (n : ℝ) ^ s := by
          rcases eq_or_ne (Real.log n) 0 with h | h
          · rw [h, zero_div]
            exact div_nonneg zero_le_one (Real.rpow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg n) s)
          · rw [mul_comm, ← div_div, div_self h]
  
  have hterm : ∀ (p k : ℕ), p.Prime →
      f (p ^ (k + 1)) = ((p : ℝ) ^ (-s)) ^ (k + 1) / ((k : ℝ) + 1) := by
    intro p k hp
    show ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt (p ^ (k + 1)) /
      ((((p ^ (k + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ)) ^ s * Real.log (((p ^ (k + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ))) = _
    rw [ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt_apply_pow (Nat.succ_ne_zero k),
      ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt_apply_prime hp]
    have hP : (0 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast hp.pos
    have hlog : 0 < Real.log p := Real.log_pos (by exact_mod_cast hp.one_lt)
    have e1 : ((p : ℝ) ^ (k + 1)) ^ s = (p : ℝ) ^ (s * ((k : ℝ) + 1)) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hP.le]
      push_cast
      ring_nf
    have e2 : ((p : ℝ) ^ (-s)) ^ (k + 1) = ((p : ℝ) ^ (s * ((k : ℝ) + 1)))⁻¹ := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hP.le, ← Real.rpow_neg hP.le]
      push_cast
      ring_nf
    have hpos : 0 < (p : ℝ) ^ (s * ((k : ℝ) + 1)) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hP _
    push_cast
    rw [e1, e2, Real.log_pow]
    push_cast
    field_simp
  
  have hzeta : riemannZeta (s : ℂ) =
      ((Real.exp (∑' p : Nat.Primes, -Real.log (1 - ((p : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (-s))) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    rw [← riemannZeta_eulerProduct_exp_log (by simpa using hs)]
    rw [Complex.ofReal_exp, Complex.ofReal_tsum]
    congr 1
    apply tsum_congr
    intro p
    have hp1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ((p : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast p.2.one_lt.le
    have hx : ((p : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (-s) ≤ 1 :=
      Real.rpow_le_one_of_one_le_of_nonpos hp1 (by linarith)
    have hc : ((p : ℕ) : ℂ) ^ (-(s : ℂ)) = ((((p : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (-s) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      rw [Complex.ofReal_cpow (Nat.cast_nonneg _)]
      push_cast
      rfl
    rw [hc, Complex.ofReal_neg, ← Complex.ofReal_one, ← Complex.ofReal_sub,
      Complex.ofReal_log (by linarith)]
  
  have hinj : Function.Injective (fun q : Nat.Primes × ℕ => (q.1 : ℕ) ^ (q.2 + 1)) := by
    rintro ⟨p, i⟩ ⟨q, j⟩ h
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := Nat.Prime.pow_inj p.2 q.2 h
    simp only [Prod.mk.injEq]
    exact ⟨Subtype.ext h1, h2⟩
  have hsupp : ∀ n ∉ Set.range (fun q : Nat.Primes × ℕ => (q.1 : ℕ) ^ (q.2 + 1)), f n = 0 := by
    intro n hn
    by_contra hne
    have hΛ : ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      apply hne
      show ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n / ((n : ℝ) ^ s * Real.log n) = 0
      rw [h, zero_div]
    rw [Ne, ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt_eq_zero_iff, not_not] at hΛ
    obtain ⟨p, k, hp, hk, rfl⟩ := (isPrimePow_nat_iff _).mp hΛ
    apply hn
    refine ⟨(⟨p, hp⟩, k - 1), ?_⟩
    show p ^ (k - 1 + 1) = p ^ k
    rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel hk]
  have hcomp := (hinj.hasSum_iff hsupp).mpr hsum.hasSum
  have hfib : ∀ p : Nat.Primes,
      HasSum (fun k => (f ∘ fun q : Nat.Primes × ℕ => (q.1 : ℕ) ^ (q.2 + 1)) (p, k))
        (-Real.log (1 - ((p : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (-s))) := by
    intro p
    have hP : (1 : ℝ) < ((p : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast p.2.one_lt
    have hpos : 0 < ((p : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (-s) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by linarith) _
    have hlt : ((p : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (-s) < 1 := Real.rpow_lt_one_of_one_lt_of_neg hP (by linarith)

    funext k
    exact hterm p k p.2
  have hT := hcomp.prod_fiberwise hfib
  rw [hzeta, Complex.ofReal_re, Real.log_exp, hT.tsum_eq]

informal_problem.statement: ∀ s : ℝ, 1 < s → (s - 1) * ∫ x in Set.Ioi (1:ℝ), Real.log (Real.log x) * x ^ (-s) = -Real.log (s - 1) - Real.eulerMascheroniConstant

signature.name: integral_log_log_mul_rpow_neg
signature.statement: ∀ s : ℝ, 1 < s → (s - 1) * ∫ x in Set.Ioi (1:ℝ), Real.log (Real.log x) * x ^ (-s) = -Real.log (s - 1) - Real.eulerMascheroniConstant

proof.tactics:
by
  have s1 : ∫ t in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), Real.log t * Real.exp (-t) = -Real.eulerMascheroniConstant := by
    have hD := Complex.hasDerivAt_GammaIntegral (s := 1) (by norm_num)
    have hev : Complex.Gamma =ᶠ[𝓝 (1:ℂ)] Complex.GammaIntegral := by
      have hU : {z : ℂ | 0 < z.re} ∈ 𝓝 (1:ℂ) :=
        (isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_re).mem_nhds (by simp)
      filter_upwards [hU] with z hz
      exact Complex.Gamma_eq_integral hz
    have h2 := hD.congr_of_eventuallyEq hev
    have h3 := h2.unique Complex.hasDerivAt_Gamma_one
    have h4 : (∫ t in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), (t:ℂ) ^ ((1:ℂ) - 1) * ((Real.log t : ℂ) * (Real.exp (-t) : ℂ)))
        = ((∫ t in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), Real.log t * Real.exp (-t) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      rw [← integral_complex_ofReal]
      congr 1
      funext t
      simp
    rw [h4] at h3
    exact_mod_cast h3
  have s2 : ∀ s : ℝ, ∫ x in Set.Ioi (1:ℝ), Real.log (Real.log x) * x ^ (-s)
      = ∫ u in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), Real.log u * Real.exp (-((s - 1) * u)) := by
    intro s
    have himg : Real.exp '' Set.Ioi 0 = Set.Ioi 1 := by
      ext y
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩
        exact Real.one_lt_exp_iff.mpr hu
      · intro hy
        have hy' : (1:ℝ) < y := hy
        exact ⟨Real.log y, Real.log_pos hy', Real.exp_log (by linarith)⟩
    rw [← himg, MeasureTheory.integral_image_eq_integral_abs_deriv_smul measurableSet_Ioi
      (fun u _ => (Real.hasDerivAt_exp u).hasDerivWithinAt) Real.exp_injective.injOn]
    congr 1
    funext u
    rw [abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos u), smul_eq_mul, Real.log_exp,
      Real.rpow_def_of_pos (Real.exp_pos u), Real.log_exp]
    calc Real.exp u * (Real.log u * Real.exp (u * -s))
        = Real.log u * (Real.exp u * Real.exp (u * -s)) := by ring
      _ = Real.log u * Real.exp (-((s - 1) * u)) := by
        rw [← Real.exp_add]
        congr 2
        ring
  have s3 : ∀ a : ℝ, 0 < a → IntegrableOn (fun t : ℝ => Real.log t * Real.exp (-t)) (Set.Ioi 0) →
      ∫ u in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), Real.log u * Real.exp (-(a * u))
        = a⁻¹ * ((∫ t in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), Real.log t * Real.exp (-t)) - Real.log a) := by
    intro a ha hint
    have h1 := MeasureTheory.integral_comp_mul_left_Ioi
      (fun v => Real.log (v / a) * Real.exp (-v)) 0 ha
    have h2 : ∀ x : ℝ, Real.log (a * x / a) * Real.exp (-(a * x))
        = Real.log x * Real.exp (-(a * x)) := by
      intro x
      rw [mul_div_cancel_left₀ x ha.ne']
    simp only [mul_zero, h2] at h1
    rw [h1, smul_eq_mul]
    congr 1
    rw [MeasureTheory.setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi
      (g := fun v => Real.log v * Real.exp (-v) - Real.log a * Real.exp (-v))]
    · rw [MeasureTheory.integral_sub hint ((integrableOn_exp_neg_Ioi 0).const_mul _),
        MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul, integral_exp_neg_Ioi_zero, mul_one]
    · intro v hv
      have hv' : (0:ℝ) < v := hv
      simp only
      rw [Real.log_div hv'.ne' ha.ne']
      ring
  intro s hs
  have ha : 0 < s - 1 := sub_pos.mpr hs
  have hint : IntegrableOn (fun t : ℝ => Real.log t * Real.exp (-t)) (Set.Ioi 0) := by
    apply MeasureTheory.Integrable.of_integral_ne_zero
    rw [s1]
    intro h
    linarith [Real.one_half_lt_eulerMascheroniConstant]
  rw [s2 s, s3 (s - 1) ha hint, s1]
  field_simp
  ring

signature.name: tsum_vonMangoldt_div_log_eq_integral
signature.statement: ∀ s : ℝ, 1 < s → ∑' n : ℕ, ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n / ((n : ℝ) ^ s * Real.log n) = (s - 1) * ∫ x in Set.Ioi (1:ℝ), (∑ d ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 ⌊x⌋₊, ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d / ((d : ℝ) * Real.log d)) * x ^ (-s)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro s hs
  have hs2 : s - 1 ≠ 0 := by linarith
  have hΛ01 : ∀ n : ℕ, n ≤ 1 → ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n = 0 := by
    intro n hn
    interval_cases n
    · simp
    · simp
  have ha_nonneg : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 ≤ ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n / ((n : ℝ) * Real.log n) :=
    fun n => div_nonneg ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt_nonneg
      (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg n) (Real.log_natCast_nonneg n))
  
  have hsum : Summable (fun n : ℕ => ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n / ((n : ℝ) ^ s * Real.log n)) := by
    refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun n => ?_) (fun n => ?_) (Real.summable_nat_rpow_inv.mpr hs)
    · exact div_nonneg ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt_nonneg
        (mul_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg n) s) (Real.log_natCast_nonneg n))
    · rcases Nat.lt_or_ge n 2 with hn | hn
      · rw [hΛ01 n (by omega), zero_div]
        exact inv_nonneg.mpr (Real.rpow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg n) s)
      · have hn1 : (1:ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hn
        have hL : 0 < Real.log n := Real.log_pos hn1
        have hP : 0 < (n:ℝ) ^ s := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by linarith) s
        calc ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n / ((n : ℝ) ^ s * Real.log n)
            ≤ Real.log n / ((n:ℝ) ^ s * Real.log n) :=
              div_le_div_of_nonneg_right ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt_le_log (by positivity)
          _ = ((n:ℝ) ^ s)⁻¹ := by field_simp
  
  have hF_nonneg : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ x ∈ Set.Ioi (1:ℝ),
      0 ≤ ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n / ((n : ℝ) * Real.log n) *
        Set.indicator (Set.Ici (n : ℝ)) (fun y : ℝ => y ^ (-s)) x := by
    intro n x hx
    have hx1 : (1:ℝ) < x := Set.mem_Ioi.mp hx
    refine mul_nonneg (ha_nonneg n) ?_
    simp only [Set.indicator_apply]
    split_ifs
    · exact Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _
    · exact le_rfl
  have hF_int : ∀ n : ℕ, Integrable (fun x : ℝ => ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n / ((n : ℝ) * Real.log n) *
        Set.indicator (Set.Ici (n : ℝ)) (fun y : ℝ => y ^ (-s)) x) (volume.restrict (Set.Ioi (1:ℝ))) := by
    intro n
    have h1 : IntegrableOn (fun y : ℝ => y ^ (-s)) (Set.Ioi (1:ℝ)) :=
      integrableOn_Ioi_rpow_of_lt (by linarith) one_pos
    exact Integrable.const_mul (h1.indicator measurableSet_Ici) _
  have hF_val : ∀ n : ℕ, ∫ x in Set.Ioi (1:ℝ), ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n / ((n : ℝ) * Real.log n) *
        Set.indicator (Set.Ici (n : ℝ)) (fun y : ℝ => y ^ (-s)) x =
      ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n / ((n : ℝ) ^ s * Real.log n) / (s - 1) := by
    intro n
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge n 2 with hn | hn
    · have h0 := hΛ01 n (by omega)
      simp [h0]
    · have hN : (1:ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hn
      have hN0 : (0:ℝ) < n := by linarith
      rw [integral_const_mul, setIntegral_indicator measurableSet_Ici,
        Set.inter_eq_right.mpr (Set.Ici_subset_Ioi.mpr hN), integral_Ici_eq_integral_Ioi,
        integral_Ioi_rpow_of_lt (by linarith) hN0]
      have hL : 0 < Real.log n := Real.log_pos hN
      have hP : 0 < (n:ℝ) ^ s := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hN0 s
      have hpow : (n:ℝ) ^ (-s + 1) = (n:ℝ) / (n:ℝ) ^ s := by
        rw [show -s + 1 = 1 - s by ring, Real.rpow_sub hN0, Real.rpow_one]
      rw [hpow]
      have hs1' : -s + 1 ≠ 0 := by linarith
      field_simp
      ring
  
  have hpt : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ x →
      (∑ d ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 ⌊x⌋₊, ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d / ((d : ℝ) * Real.log d)) * x ^ (-s) =
        ∑' n : ℕ, ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n / ((n : ℝ) * Real.log n) *
          Set.indicator (Set.Ici (n : ℝ)) (fun y : ℝ => y ^ (-s)) x := by
    intro x hx
    have hvan : ∀ n ∉ Finset.Ioc 0 ⌊x⌋₊, ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n / ((n : ℝ) * Real.log n) *
          Set.indicator (Set.Ici (n : ℝ)) (fun y : ℝ => y ^ (-s)) x = 0 := by
      intro n hn
      rw [Finset.mem_Ioc, not_and_or] at hn
      rcases hn with hn | hn
      · rw [hΛ01 n (by omega), zero_div, zero_mul]
      · have hlt : x < n := (Nat.floor_lt hx).mp (by omega)
        have hnm : x ∉ Set.Ici (n : ℝ) := by
          rw [Set.mem_Ici, not_le]
          exact hlt
        rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hnm, mul_zero]
    rw [tsum_eq_sum hvan, Finset.sum_mul]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun n hn => ?_)
    have hn' := (Finset.mem_Ioc.mp hn).2
    have hnx : (n:ℝ) ≤ x := le_trans (by exact_mod_cast hn') (Nat.floor_le hx)
    rw [Set.indicator_of_mem (Set.mem_Ici.mpr hnx)]
  
  have hint_eq : ∫ x in Set.Ioi (1:ℝ),
      (∑ d ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 ⌊x⌋₊, ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d / ((d : ℝ) * Real.log d)) * x ^ (-s) =
      ∫ x in Set.Ioi (1:ℝ), ∑' n : ℕ, ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n / ((n : ℝ) * Real.log n) *
          Set.indicator (Set.Ici (n : ℝ)) (fun y : ℝ => y ^ (-s)) x :=
    setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi
      (fun x hx => hpt x (by linarith [Set.mem_Ioi.mp hx]))
  have hnorm : (fun n : ℕ => ∫ x in Set.Ioi (1:ℝ), ‖ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n / ((n : ℝ) * Real.log n) *
          Set.indicator (Set.Ici (n : ℝ)) (fun y : ℝ => y ^ (-s)) x‖) =
      fun n : ℕ => ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n / ((n : ℝ) ^ s * Real.log n) / (s - 1) := by
    funext n
    rw [← hF_val n]
    exact setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi
      (fun x hx => Real.norm_of_nonneg (hF_nonneg n x hx))
  have hswap := integral_tsum_of_summable_integral_norm hF_int
    (by rw [hnorm]; exact hsum.div_const _)
  rw [hint_eq, ← hswap]
  simp_rw [hF_val]
  rw [tsum_div_const]
  field_simp

informal_problem.statement: ∀ C K : ℝ, (∀ s : ℝ, 1 < s → Real.log (riemannZeta (s : ℂ)).re = (s - 1) * ∫ x in Set.Ioi (1:ℝ), (∑ d ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 ⌊x⌋₊, ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d / ((d : ℝ) * Real.log d)) * x ^ (-s)) → (∀ s : ℝ, 1 < s → (s - 1) * ∫ x in Set.Ioi (1:ℝ), Real.log (Real.log x) * x ^ (-s) = -Real.log (s - 1) - Real.eulerMascheroniConstant) → (∀ x : ℝ, 2 ≤ x → |(∑ d ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 ⌊x⌋₊, ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d / ((d : ℝ) * Real.log d)) - Real.log (Real.log x) - C| ≤ K / Real.log x) → C = Real.eulerMascheroniConstant

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have s1 : Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => Real.log (riemannZeta (s : ℂ)).re + Real.log (s - 1))
      (𝓝[>] 1) (𝓝 0) := by
    have h1 : Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => (s : ℂ)) (𝓝[>] 1) (𝓝[≠] (1:ℂ)) := by
      apply tendsto_nhdsWithin_of_tendsto_nhds_of_eventually_within
      · have := (Complex.continuous_ofReal.tendsto (1:ℝ))
        rw [Complex.ofReal_one] at this
        exact this.mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds
      · filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with s hs
        simp only [Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
        exact_mod_cast (ne_of_gt hs)
    have h2 := riemannZeta_residue_one.comp h1
    have h3' : Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => (s - 1) * (riemannZeta (s:ℂ)).re) (𝓝[>] 1) (𝓝 1) := by
      have := (Complex.continuous_re.tendsto _).comp h2
      rw [Complex.one_re] at this
      refine this.congr fun s => ?_
      simp [Function.comp]
    have h4 := ((Real.continuousAt_log one_ne_zero).tendsto).comp h3'
    rw [Real.log_one] at h4
    refine h4.congr' ?_
    filter_upwards [h3'.eventually (lt_mem_nhds zero_lt_one), self_mem_nhdsWithin] with s hP hs
    have hs1 : 0 < s - 1 := sub_pos.mpr hs
    have hz : 0 < (riemannZeta (s:ℂ)).re := by
      by_contra h
      push_neg at h
      nlinarith
    simp only [Function.comp]
    rw [Real.log_mul hs1.ne' hz.ne', add_comm]
  
  have s2 : ∀ (R : ℝ → ℝ) (s₀ : ℝ), 1 < s₀ →
      IntegrableOn (fun x => R x * x ^ (-s₀)) (Set.Ioi 1) → Tendsto R atTop (𝓝 0) →
      Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => (s - 1) * ∫ x in Set.Ioi (1:ℝ), R x * x ^ (-s)) (𝓝[>] 1) (𝓝 0) := by
    intro R s₀ hs₀ hint hR
    rw [Metric.tendsto_nhdsWithin_nhds]
    intro ε hε
    obtain ⟨X₀, hX₀⟩ := (Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp hR) (ε/2) (by linarith)
    obtain ⟨X, hXdef⟩ : ∃ X : ℝ, X = max X₀ 1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hX1 : 1 ≤ X := hXdef ▸ le_max_right _ _
    have hXX₀ : X₀ ≤ X := hXdef ▸ le_max_left _ _
    obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ : ∃ M : ℝ, M = ∫ x in Set.Ioi (1:ℝ), |R x * x ^ (-s₀)| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hM0 : 0 ≤ M := hM ▸ setIntegral_nonneg measurableSet_Ioi (fun x _ => abs_nonneg _)
    obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ : ∃ A : ℝ, A = X ^ (s₀ - 1) * M := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hA0 : 0 ≤ A := hA ▸ mul_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _) hM0
    refine ⟨ε / (2 * (A + 1)), by positivity, ?_⟩
    intro s hs hdist
    have hs1 : 1 < s := hs
    have hs1' : 0 < s - 1 := sub_pos.mpr hs1
    rw [Real.dist_eq] at hdist
    have hsd : s - 1 < ε / (2 * (A + 1)) := by rw [abs_lt] at hdist; linarith
    rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero]
    have hIs : IntegrableOn (fun x : ℝ => x ^ (-s)) (Set.Ioi 1) :=
      integrableOn_Ioi_rpow_of_lt (by linarith) one_pos
    have hval : ∫ x in Set.Ioi (1:ℝ), x ^ (-s) = 1 / (s - 1) := by
      rw [integral_Ioi_rpow_of_lt (by linarith) one_pos, Real.one_rpow]
      have : -s + 1 ≠ 0 := by linarith
      field_simp
      ring
    have hg : IntegrableOn (fun x : ℝ => X ^ (s₀ - 1) * |R x * x ^ (-s₀)| + (ε/2) * x ^ (-s))
        (Set.Ioi 1) := (hint.abs.const_mul _).add (hIs.const_mul _)
    have hbound : ∀ x ∈ Set.Ioi (1:ℝ), ‖R x * x ^ (-s)‖ ≤
        X ^ (s₀ - 1) * |R x * x ^ (-s₀)| + (ε/2) * x ^ (-s) := by
      intro x hx
      have hx1 : 1 < x := hx
      have hx0 : 0 < x := by linarith
      have hxs : 0 < x ^ (-s) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hx0 _
      have hxs0 : 0 < x ^ (-s₀) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hx0 _
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hxs]
      have hg1 : 0 ≤ X ^ (s₀ - 1) * |R x * x ^ (-s₀)| :=
        mul_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _) (abs_nonneg _)
      have hg2 : 0 ≤ (ε/2) * x ^ (-s) := by positivity
      by_cases hxX : x ≤ X
      · have e1 : x ^ (-s) = x ^ (s₀ - s) * x ^ (-s₀) := by
          rw [← Real.rpow_add hx0]; congr 1; ring
        have e2 : x ^ (s₀ - s) ≤ x ^ (s₀ - 1) :=
          Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hx1.le (by linarith)
        have e3 : x ^ (s₀ - 1) ≤ X ^ (s₀ - 1) := Real.rpow_le_rpow hx0.le hxX (by linarith)
        have key : |R x| * x ^ (-s) ≤ X ^ (s₀ - 1) * |R x * x ^ (-s₀)| := by
          rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos hxs0, e1]
          have h23 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (e2.trans e3) hxs0.le
          calc |R x| * (x ^ (s₀ - s) * x ^ (-s₀))
              ≤ |R x| * (X ^ (s₀ - 1) * x ^ (-s₀)) :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h23 (abs_nonneg _)
            _ = X ^ (s₀ - 1) * (|R x| * x ^ (-s₀)) := by ring
        linarith
      · push_neg at hxX
        have hxX0 : X₀ ≤ x := hXX₀.trans hxX.le
        have hRx := hX₀ x hxX0
        rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero] at hRx
        have : |R x| * x ^ (-s) ≤ (ε/2) * x ^ (-s) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hRx.le hxs.le
        linarith
    have hnorm := norm_integral_le_of_norm_le hg
      (ae_restrict_of_forall_mem measurableSet_Ioi hbound)
    have hgint : ∫ x in Set.Ioi (1:ℝ), (X ^ (s₀ - 1) * |R x * x ^ (-s₀)| + (ε/2) * x ^ (-s)) =
        A + (ε/2) * (1/(s-1)) := by
      rw [integral_add (hint.abs.const_mul _) (hIs.const_mul _), integral_const_mul,
        integral_const_mul, hval, hA, hM]
    rw [hgint, Real.norm_eq_abs] at hnorm
    rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos hs1']
    have hsd' : (s - 1) * (2 * (A + 1)) < ε := (lt_div_iff₀ (by positivity)).mp hsd
    calc (s-1) * |∫ x in Set.Ioi (1:ℝ), R x * x ^ (-s)|
        ≤ (s-1) * (A + (ε/2) * (1/(s-1))) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hnorm hs1'.le
      _ = (s-1) * A + ε/2 := by field_simp
      _ < ε := by nlinarith
  
  intro C K H1 H2 H3
  have key : ∀ (S : ℝ → ℝ),
      (∀ s : ℝ, 1 < s → Real.log (riemannZeta (s : ℂ)).re =
        (s - 1) * ∫ x in Set.Ioi (1:ℝ), S x * x ^ (-s)) →
      (∀ x : ℝ, 2 ≤ x → |S x - Real.log (Real.log x) - C| ≤ K / Real.log x) →
      C = Real.eulerMascheroniConstant := by
    intro S H1 H3
    have hL : Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => -Real.log (s - 1)) (𝓝[>] 1) atTop := by
      have h0 : Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => s - 1) (𝓝[>] 1) (𝓝[>] 0) := by
        apply tendsto_nhdsWithin_of_tendsto_nhds_of_eventually_within
        · have : Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => s - 1) (𝓝 1) (𝓝 (1 - 1)) := tendsto_id.sub_const 1
          rw [sub_self] at this
          exact this.mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds
        · filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with s hs
          exact sub_pos.mpr (Set.mem_Ioi.mp hs)
      exact tendsto_neg_atBot_atTop.comp (Real.tendsto_log_nhdsGT_zero.comp h0)
    have hF : Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => Real.log (riemannZeta (s : ℂ)).re) (𝓝[>] 1) atTop := by
      have := s1.add_atTop hL
      refine this.congr fun s => ?_
      ring
    have hE : ∀ᶠ s : ℝ in 𝓝[>] (1:ℝ), 1 < s ∧ 0 < Real.log (riemannZeta (s : ℂ)).re ∧
        Real.eulerMascheroniConstant < -Real.log (s - 1) := by
      filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin, hF.eventually_gt_atTop 0,
        hL.eventually_gt_atTop Real.eulerMascheroniConstant] with s h1 h2 h3
      exact ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩
    have hint : ∀ s : ℝ, (1 < s ∧ 0 < Real.log (riemannZeta (s : ℂ)).re ∧
        Real.eulerMascheroniConstant < -Real.log (s - 1)) →
        IntegrableOn (fun x => S x * x ^ (-s)) (Set.Ioi 1) ∧
        IntegrableOn (fun x => Real.log (Real.log x) * x ^ (-s)) (Set.Ioi 1) := by
      rintro s ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩
      constructor
      · by_contra h
        have := H1 s h1
        rw [integral_undef h, mul_zero] at this
        linarith
      · by_contra h
        have := H2 s h1
        rw [integral_undef h, mul_zero] at this
        linarith
    obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ : ∃ R : ℝ → ℝ, R = fun x => S x - Real.log (Real.log x) - C := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hid : ∀ s : ℝ, (1 < s ∧ 0 < Real.log (riemannZeta (s : ℂ)).re ∧
        Real.eulerMascheroniConstant < -Real.log (s - 1)) →
        (s - 1) * ∫ x in Set.Ioi (1:ℝ), R x * x ^ (-s) =
          (Real.log (riemannZeta (s : ℂ)).re + Real.log (s - 1)) +
            (Real.eulerMascheroniConstant - C) := by
      intro s hs
      obtain ⟨hf, hg⟩ := hint s hs
      have h1 := hs.1
      have hc : IntegrableOn (fun x : ℝ => C * x ^ (-s)) (Set.Ioi 1) :=
        (integrableOn_Ioi_rpow_of_lt (by linarith) one_pos).const_mul C
      have hval : ∫ x in Set.Ioi (1:ℝ), x ^ (-s) = 1 / (s - 1) := by
        rw [integral_Ioi_rpow_of_lt (by linarith) one_pos, Real.one_rpow]
        have : -s + 1 ≠ 0 := by linarith
        have : s - 1 ≠ 0 := by linarith
        field_simp
        ring
      have hfg : IntegrableOn (fun x => S x * x ^ (-s) - Real.log (Real.log x) * x ^ (-s))
          (Set.Ioi 1) := hf.sub hg
      have e2 : ∫ x in Set.Ioi (1:ℝ), (S x * x ^ (-s) - Real.log (Real.log x) * x ^ (-s)) =
          (∫ x in Set.Ioi (1:ℝ), S x * x ^ (-s)) -
            ∫ x in Set.Ioi (1:ℝ), Real.log (Real.log x) * x ^ (-s) := integral_sub hf hg
      have e1 : ∫ x in Set.Ioi (1:ℝ),
          ((S x * x ^ (-s) - Real.log (Real.log x) * x ^ (-s)) - C * x ^ (-s)) =
          (∫ x in Set.Ioi (1:ℝ), (S x * x ^ (-s) - Real.log (Real.log x) * x ^ (-s))) -
            ∫ x in Set.Ioi (1:ℝ), C * x ^ (-s) := integral_sub hfg hc
      have e : ∫ x in Set.Ioi (1:ℝ), R x * x ^ (-s) =
          (∫ x in Set.Ioi (1:ℝ), S x * x ^ (-s)) -
            (∫ x in Set.Ioi (1:ℝ), Real.log (Real.log x) * x ^ (-s)) -
              ∫ x in Set.Ioi (1:ℝ), C * x ^ (-s) := by
        rw [← e2, ← e1]
        congr 1
        ext x
        rw [hR]
        ring
      have hs1' : s - 1 ≠ 0 := by linarith
      rw [e, integral_const_mul, hval, mul_sub, mul_sub, ← H1 s h1, H2 s h1]
      field_simp
      ring
    obtain ⟨s₀, hs₀⟩ := hE.exists
    obtain ⟨hf0, hg0⟩ := hint s₀ hs₀
    have hR0 : IntegrableOn (fun x => R x * x ^ (-s₀)) (Set.Ioi 1) := by
      have hc : IntegrableOn (fun x : ℝ => C * x ^ (-s₀)) (Set.Ioi 1) :=
        (integrableOn_Ioi_rpow_of_lt (by linarith [hs₀.1]) one_pos).const_mul C
      have h3 : IntegrableOn (fun x : ℝ => (S x * x ^ (-s₀) -
          Real.log (Real.log x) * x ^ (-s₀)) - C * x ^ (-s₀)) (Set.Ioi 1) :=
        (hf0.sub hg0).sub hc
      refine IntegrableOn.congr_fun h3 (fun x _ => ?_) measurableSet_Ioi
      simp only [hR]
      ring
    have hRt : Tendsto R atTop (𝓝 0) := by
      have hK : Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => K / Real.log x) atTop (𝓝 0) :=
        tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop Real.tendsto_log_atTop
      apply squeeze_zero_norm' _ hK
      filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop (2:ℝ)] with x hx
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, hR]
      exact H3 x hx
    have hG := s2 R s₀ hs₀.1 hR0 hRt
    have hG' : Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => (Real.log (riemannZeta (s : ℂ)).re + Real.log (s - 1)) +
        (Real.eulerMascheroniConstant - C)) (𝓝[>] 1) (𝓝 0) := by
      refine hG.congr' ?_
      filter_upwards [hE] with s hs
      exact hid s hs
    have hG'' := s1.add_const (Real.eulerMascheroniConstant - C)
    have := tendsto_nhds_unique hG'' hG'
    linarith
  exact key _ H1 H3

informal_problem.statement: (R : ℕ) (A : ℝ) : ∀ᶠ Y : ℝ in atTop, ∀ (L : ℕ) (P : ℝ) (Q : CoreRecords.LowerCoreRecord Y L R P), (L : ℝ) ≤ A * Real.log (logLog Y) → ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → Y ^ (99 / 100 : ℝ) < (corePairValue (Q.numericalCore, p) : ℝ) → Y ^ (9 / 10 : ℝ) < (p : ℝ) ∧ Q.lower ⟨0, Q.length_pos⟩ < p

signature.statement: (R : ℕ) (A : ℝ) : ∀ᶠ Y : ℝ in atTop, ∀ (L : ℕ) (P : ℝ) (Q : CoreRecords.LowerCoreRecord Y L R P), (L : ℝ) ≤ A * Real.log (logLog Y) → ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → Y ^ (99 / 100 : ℝ) < (corePairValue (Q.numericalCore, p) : ℝ) → Y ^ (9 / 10 : ℝ) < (p : ℝ) ∧ Q.lower ⟨0, Q.length_pos⟩ < p

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨c', hc'def⟩ : ∃ c' : ℝ, c' = 1 / (100 * (|A| + 1)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hc' : 0 < c' := by rw [hc'def]; positivity
  have hE3 : ∀ᶠ Y : ℝ in atTop,
      ‖Real.log (Real.log Y)‖ ≤ c' * ‖(Real.log Y) ^ (1 / 5 : ℝ)‖ :=
    Real.tendsto_log_atTop.eventually
      ((isLittleO_log_rpow_atTop (r := 1 / 5) (by norm_num)).bound hc')
  have hLL : Tendsto logLog atTop atTop :=
    Real.tendsto_log_atTop.comp Real.tendsto_log_atTop
  filter_upwards [eventually_gt_atTop (1 : ℝ),
    Real.tendsto_log_atTop.eventually_ge_atTop (32 : ℝ), hLL.eventually_ge_atTop 1, hE3,
    Real.tendsto_log_atTop.eventually_ge_atTop (100 * Real.log R)]
    with Y hY1 ht32 hu1 hE3Y hE4
  intro L P Q hL p _hp hval
  have hY : 0 < Y := by linarith
  have ht0 : 0 < Real.log Y := by linarith
  
  have h15 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ (Real.log Y) ^ (1 / 5 : ℝ) := by
    have h32 : (32 : ℝ) ^ (1 / 5 : ℝ) = 2 := by
      rw [show (32 : ℝ) = 2 ^ (5 : ℕ) by norm_num, ← Real.rpow_natCast,
        ← Real.rpow_mul (by norm_num)]
      norm_num
    calc (2 : ℝ) = 32 ^ (1 / 5 : ℝ) := h32.symm
      _ ≤ (Real.log Y) ^ (1 / 5 : ℝ) := Real.rpow_le_rpow (by norm_num) ht32 (by norm_num)
  have hsplit : Real.log Y = (Real.log Y) ^ (1 / 5 : ℝ) * (Real.log Y) ^ (4 / 5 : ℝ) := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_add ht0]; norm_num
  have h45nn : 0 ≤ (Real.log Y) ^ (4 / 5 : ℝ) := Real.rpow_nonneg ht0.le _
  have h15nn : 0 ≤ (Real.log Y) ^ (1 / 5 : ℝ) := Real.rpow_nonneg ht0.le _
  have hi : (Real.log Y) ^ (4 / 5 : ℝ) ≤ Real.log Y / 2 := by
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h15 h45nn
    linarith
  have hcut_eq : CollisionBox.cutoff Y (4 / 5) = Real.exp ((Real.log Y) ^ (4 / 5 : ℝ)) := rfl
  have hcut : CollisionBox.cutoff Y (4 / 5) < Y ^ (9 / 10 : ℝ) := by
    rw [hcut_eq, Real.rpow_def_of_pos hY]
    exact Real.exp_lt_exp.mpr (by linarith)
  
  have hlogu : 0 ≤ Real.log (logLog Y) := Real.log_nonneg hu1
  have hlogu_le : Real.log (logLog Y) ≤ logLog Y := by
    have := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by linarith : 0 < logLog Y)
    linarith
  have huE : logLog Y ≤ c' * (Real.log Y) ^ (1 / 5 : ℝ) := by
    have h1 : logLog Y ≤ ‖Real.log (Real.log Y)‖ := by
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact le_abs_self _
    have h2 : ‖(Real.log Y) ^ (1 / 5 : ℝ)‖ = (Real.log Y) ^ (1 / 5 : ℝ) := by
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg h15nn]
    rw [h2] at hE3Y
    exact h1.trans hE3Y
  have hAc : |A| * c' ≤ 1 / 100 := by
    rw [hc'def, mul_one_div, div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by norm_num)]
    linarith [abs_nonneg A]
  have hLt : (L : ℝ) ≤ (1 / 100) * (Real.log Y) ^ (1 / 5 : ℝ) := by
    calc (L : ℝ) ≤ A * Real.log (logLog Y) := hL
      _ ≤ |A| * Real.log (logLog Y) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self A) hlogu
      _ ≤ |A| * logLog Y := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlogu_le (abs_nonneg A)
      _ ≤ |A| * (c' * (Real.log Y) ^ (1 / 5 : ℝ)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left huE (abs_nonneg A)
      _ = (|A| * c') * (Real.log Y) ^ (1 / 5 : ℝ) := by ring
      _ ≤ (1 / 100) * (Real.log Y) ^ (1 / 5 : ℝ) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hAc h15nn
  have hii : (L : ℝ) * (Real.log Y) ^ (4 / 5 : ℝ) ≤ Real.log Y / 100 := by
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hLt h45nn
    linarith
  
  have hbound : (R : ℝ) * CollisionBox.cutoff Y (4 / 5) ^ L ≤ Y ^ (9 / 100 : ℝ) := by
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos R with hR | hR
    · rw [hR, Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul]; exact Real.rpow_nonneg hY.le _
    · have hRpos : (0 : ℝ) < R := by exact_mod_cast hR
      rw [hcut_eq, ← Real.exp_nat_mul, Real.rpow_def_of_pos hY, ← Real.exp_log hRpos,
        ← Real.exp_add]
      apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
      linarith
  
  have hb1 : (Q.numericalCore : ℝ) ≤ (R : ℝ) * CollisionBox.cutoff Y (4 / 5) ^ L := by

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hfpos : ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → 0 < (p : ℝ) / ((p : ℝ) - 1) := by
    intro p hp
    have hp1 : (1 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast hp.one_lt
    exact div_pos (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hfone : ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → 1 ≤ (p : ℝ) / ((p : ℝ) - 1) := by
    intro p hp
    have hp1 : (1 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast hp.one_lt
    rw [le_div_iff₀ (show (0 : ℝ) < p - 1 by linarith)]
    linarith
  have hfinv : ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → (p : ℝ) / ((p : ℝ) - 1) = (1 - (1 : ℝ) / p)⁻¹ := by
    intro p hp
    have hp1 : (1 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast hp.one_lt
    have hp0 : (p : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by linarith
    rw [one_sub_div hp0, inv_div]
  have hfexp : ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → (p : ℝ) / ((p : ℝ) - 1) ≤ Real.exp (2 / (p : ℝ)) := by
    intro p hp
    have hp2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ p := by exact_mod_cast hp.two_le
    have hfrac : (1 : ℝ) / ((p : ℝ) - 1) ≤ 2 / p := by
      apply (div_le_div_iff₀ (by linarith) (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) < p)).mpr
      linarith
    have heq : (p : ℝ) / ((p : ℝ) - 1) = 1 + (1 : ℝ) / ((p : ℝ) - 1) := by
      field_simp [show (p : ℝ) - 1 ≠ 0 by linarith]
      ring
    rw [heq]
    have := Real.add_one_le_exp (2 / (p : ℝ))
    linarith
  
  have hratio_eq : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n →
      (n : ℝ) / n.totient = ∏ p ∈ n.primeFactors, (p : ℝ) / ((p : ℝ) - 1) := by
    intro n hn
    have hφ : (n.totient : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.totient_pos.mpr hn).ne'
    have hprod : (∏ p ∈ n.primeFactors, ((p : ℝ) - 1)) ≠ 0 := by
      apply Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr
      intro p hp
      have hp1 : (1 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp).one_lt
      linarith
    have h := congrArg (fun a : ℕ => (a : ℝ)) (Nat.totient_mul_prod_primeFactors n)
    simp only [Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_prod] at h
    have hpred : (∏ p ∈ n.primeFactors, ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) =
        ∏ p ∈ n.primeFactors, ((p : ℝ) - 1) := by
      apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
      intro p hp
      rw [Nat.cast_sub (Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp).one_le, Nat.cast_one]
    rw [hpred] at h
    rw [Finset.prod_div_distrib]
    exact (div_eq_div_iff hφ hprod).mpr (h.symm.trans (mul_comm _ _))
  
  have hcardlog : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → (n.primeFactors.card : ℝ) * Real.log 2 ≤ Real.log n := by
    intro n hn
    have hpow : 2 ^ n.primeFactors.card ≤ n := by
      calc
        _ = ∏ _ ∈ n.primeFactors, 2 := (Finset.prod_const 2).symm
        _ ≤ ∏ p ∈ n.primeFactors, p :=
          Finset.prod_le_prod' fun p hp => (Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp).two_le
        _ ≤ n := Nat.le_of_dvd hn (Nat.prod_primeFactors_dvd n)
    have hR : (2 : ℝ) ^ n.primeFactors.card ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast hpow
    simpa only [Real.log_pow] using Real.log_le_log (by positivity) hR
  have hlarge : ∀ n : ℕ, 1 < n →
      (∏ p ∈ n.primeFactors.filter (fun p : ℕ => ¬ (p : ℝ) ≤ Real.log n),
        (p : ℝ) / ((p : ℝ) - 1)) ≤ Real.exp (2 / Real.log 2) := by
    intro n hn
    have hn1 : (1 : ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hn
    have hlog : 0 < Real.log n := Real.log_pos hn1
    have hlog2 : 0 < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
    set s := n.primeFactors.filter fun p : ℕ => ¬ (p : ℝ) ≤ Real.log n with hs_def
    have hcard : (s.card : ℝ) ≤ n.primeFactors.card := by
      exact_mod_cast (Finset.card_le_card (Finset.filter_subset _ _) : s.card ≤ n.primeFactors.card)
    have hcl := hcardlog n (by omega)
    calc
      _ ≤ ∏ _ ∈ s, Real.exp (2 / Real.log n) := by
        apply Finset.prod_le_prod
        · intro p hp
          exact (hfpos p (Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors (Finset.mem_filter.mp hp).1)).le
        · intro p hp
          obtain ⟨hpn, hp⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hp
          apply (hfexp p (Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hpn)).trans
          apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
          exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by norm_num) hlog (le_of_not_ge hp)
      _ = Real.exp ((s.card : ℝ) * (2 / Real.log n)) := by
        rw [← Real.exp_sum]
        simp
      _ ≤ Real.exp (2 / Real.log 2) := by
        apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
        have hcardbound : (s.card : ℝ) * Real.log 2 ≤ Real.log n :=
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcard hlog2.le).trans hcl
        rw [le_div_iff₀ hlog2]
        rw [mul_div_assoc', div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_le_iff₀ hlog]
        nlinarith
  
  obtain ⟨C0, hC0, hEb⟩ : ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop,
      (∏ p ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊x⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, (p : ℝ) / ((p : ℝ) - 1)) ≤ C * Real.log x := by
    obtain ⟨B, hB, hbound⟩ := hEULER.inv.isBigO.exists_pos
    refine ⟨B / Real.exp (-Real.eulerMascheroniConstant), by positivity, ?_⟩
    filter_upwards [hbound.bound, eventually_gt_atTop (1 : ℝ)] with x h hx
    have heq : (∏ p ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊x⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, (p : ℝ) / ((p : ℝ) - 1)) =
        (∏ p ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊x⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, (1 - (1 : ℝ) / p))⁻¹ := by
      rw [← Finset.prod_inv_distrib]
      exact Finset.prod_congr rfl fun p hp => hfinv p (Finset.mem_filter.mp hp).2
    have hprod : 0 < ∏ p ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊x⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, (p : ℝ) / ((p : ℝ) - 1) :=
      Finset.prod_pos fun p hp => hfpos p (Finset.mem_filter.mp hp).2
    change ‖(∏ p ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊x⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, (1 - (1 : ℝ) / p))⁻¹‖ ≤
      B * ‖(Real.exp (-Real.eulerMascheroniConstant) / Real.log x)⁻¹‖ at h
    rw [← heq, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hprod, inv_div,
      Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (div_pos (Real.log_pos hx) (Real.exp_pos _))] at h
    convert h using 1
    ring
  
  have hsmall : ∀ n : ℕ,
      (∏ p ∈ n.primeFactors.filter (fun p : ℕ => (p : ℝ) ≤ Real.log n),
        (p : ℝ) / ((p : ℝ) - 1)) ≤
      ∏ p ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊Real.log n⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, (p : ℝ) / ((p : ℝ) - 1) := by
    intro n
    have hsub : n.primeFactors.filter (fun p : ℕ => (p : ℝ) ≤ Real.log n) ⊆
        (Finset.Iic ⌊Real.log n⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime := by
      intro p hp
      obtain ⟨hpn, hpl⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hp
      exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr
        ⟨Finset.mem_Iic.mpr (Nat.le_floor hpl), Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hpn⟩
    rw [← Finset.prod_sdiff hsub]
    have h1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ∏ p ∈ ((Finset.Iic ⌊Real.log n⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime) \
        n.primeFactors.filter (fun p : ℕ => (p : ℝ) ≤ Real.log n), (p : ℝ) / ((p : ℝ) - 1) := by
      calc (1 : ℝ) = ∏ _ ∈ ((Finset.Iic ⌊Real.log n⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime) \
            n.primeFactors.filter (fun p : ℕ => (p : ℝ) ≤ Real.log n), (1 : ℝ) := by simp
        _ ≤ _ := Finset.prod_le_prod (fun _ _ => zero_le_one)
            (fun p hp => hfone p (Finset.mem_filter.mp (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hp).1).2)
    have h2 : 0 ≤ ∏ p ∈ n.primeFactors.filter (fun p : ℕ => (p : ℝ) ≤ Real.log n),
        (p : ℝ) / ((p : ℝ) - 1) :=
      Finset.prod_nonneg fun p hp =>
        (hfpos p (Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors (Finset.mem_filter.mp hp).1)).le
    exact le_mul_of_one_le_left h2 h1
  
  have hsqrtb : ∀ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C → ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop,
      C * Real.log (Real.log x) ≤ Real.sqrt x := by
    intro C hC
    have h := isLittleO_log_rpow_atTop (show (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2 by norm_num)
    filter_upwards [h.bound (show (0 : ℝ) < 1 / (C + 1) by positivity),
      eventually_gt_atTop (1 : ℝ)] with x hx hx1
    have hl : 0 < Real.log x := Real.log_pos hx1
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hl,
      abs_of_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _), ← Real.sqrt_eq_rpow] at hx
    have h2 : Real.log x * (C + 1) ≤ Real.sqrt x := by
      rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, one_mul, le_div_iff₀ (by positivity)] at hx
      exact hx
    have h3 : Real.log (Real.log x) ≤ Real.log x := Real.log_le_self hl.le
    have h4 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h3 hC
    nlinarith
  
  obtain ⟨C, hC, hratio⟩ : ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧
      ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, (n : ℝ) / n.totient ≤ C * Real.log (Real.log n) := by
    refine ⟨C0 * Real.exp (2 / Real.log 2), by positivity, ?_⟩
    filter_upwards [(Real.tendsto_log_atTop.comp tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop).eventually hEb,
      eventually_gt_atTop (1 : ℕ)] with n hsm hn
    rw [hratio_eq n (by omega)]
    rw [← Finset.prod_filter_mul_prod_filter_not n.primeFactors
      (fun p : ℕ => (p : ℝ) ≤ Real.log n)]
    have hs := (hsmall n).trans hsm
    have hl := hlarge n hn
    calc
      _ ≤ (C0 * Real.log (Real.log n)) * Real.exp (2 / Real.log 2) := by
        exact mul_le_mul hs hl (Finset.prod_nonneg fun p hp =>
          (hfpos p (Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors (Finset.mem_filter.mp hp).1)).le)
          ((Finset.prod_pos fun p hp =>
            hfpos p (Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors (Finset.mem_filter.mp hp).1)).le.trans hs)
      _ = _ := by ring
  
  have hsqrt := tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop.eventually (hsqrtb C hC.le)
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := eventually_atTop.mp ((hratio.and hsqrt).and (eventually_gt_atTop (1 : ℕ)))
  refine ⟨max (2 * C) 1, by positivity, ?_⟩
  have hD1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ max (2 * C) 1 := le_max_right _ _
  have hDC : 2 * C ≤ max (2 * C) 1 := le_max_left _ _
  filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop (N : ℝ), eventually_gt_atTop (1 : ℝ),
    (Real.tendsto_log_atTop.comp Real.tendsto_log_atTop).eventually_ge_atTop 1]
    with y hNy hy hLLy
  dsimp only [Function.comp_apply] at hLLy
  intro n hn hφy
  unfold logLog
  set D := max (2 * C) 1 with hD_def
  have hy0 : 0 < y := by linarith
  by_cases hnN : n < N
  · have hny : (n : ℝ) ≤ y := (by exact_mod_cast hnN.le : (n : ℝ) ≤ N).trans hNy
    apply hny.trans
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hD1 hy0.le,
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hLLy (show 0 ≤ D * y by positivity)]
  · obtain ⟨⟨hr, hs⟩, hn1⟩ := hN n (by omega)

    have hφR : (0 : ℝ) < n.totient := by exact_mod_cast Nat.totient_pos.mpr hn
    have hnr : (n : ℝ) ≤ C * Real.log (Real.log n) * n.totient := (div_le_iff₀ hφR).mp hr
    have hnroot : (n : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt n * y :=
      hnr.trans (mul_le_mul hs hφy hφR.le (Real.sqrt_nonneg _))
    have hsroot : Real.sqrt n ≤ y := by
      have hspos : 0 < Real.sqrt n := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hnR
      have hsq := Real.sq_sqrt hnR.le
      nlinarith
    have hnysq : (n : ℝ) ≤ y ^ 2 := by
      have hsq := Real.sq_sqrt hnR.le
      nlinarith [mul_self_le_mul_self (Real.sqrt_nonneg n) hsroot]
    have hn1R : (1 : ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hn1
    have hlogn : Real.log n ≤ 2 * Real.log y := by
      have := Real.log_le_log hnR hnysq
      rw [Real.log_pow] at this
      push_cast at this
      linarith
    have hLLn : Real.log (Real.log n) ≤ Real.log 2 + Real.log (Real.log y) := by
      rw [← Real.log_mul (by norm_num) (ne_of_gt (Real.log_pos hy))]
      exact Real.log_le_log (Real.log_pos hn1R) hlogn
    have hlog2 : Real.log 2 ≤ 1 := by
      have := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)
      linarith
    have hLL : Real.log (Real.log n) ≤ 2 * Real.log (Real.log y) := by linarith
    have hCd : C * Real.log (Real.log n) ≤ D * Real.log (Real.log y) := by
      have h₁ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hLL hC.le
      have h₂ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hDC (show 0 ≤ Real.log (Real.log y) by linarith)
      nlinarith
    calc
      (n : ℝ) ≤ C * Real.log (Real.log n) * n.totient := hnr
      _ ≤ (D * Real.log (Real.log y)) * y :=
        mul_le_mul hCd hφy hφR.le (by positivity)
      _ = _ := by ring

by
  have he2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp 1 := by linarith [Real.add_one_le_exp (1 : ℝ)]
  
  have hcheb_ex : ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ x : ℝ, 2 ≤ x →
      (Nat.primeCounting ⌊x⌋₊ : ℝ) ≤ C * x / Real.log x := by
    have hev : ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop, (Nat.primeCounting ⌊x⌋₊ : ℝ) / (x / Real.log x) < 2 :=
      hPNT.eventually (gt_mem_nhds (by norm_num))
    obtain ⟨X₀, hX₀⟩ := (hev.and (eventually_ge_atTop (2 : ℝ))).exists_forall_of_atTop
    obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ : ∃ M : ℝ, M = (Nat.primeCounting ⌊X₀⌋₊ : ℝ) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hmax2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ max 2 M := le_max_left _ _
    refine ⟨max 2 M + 1, by linarith, ?_⟩
    intro x hx
    have hlogx : 0 < Real.log x := Real.log_pos (by linarith)
    have hxl : 0 < x / Real.log x := div_pos (by linarith) hlogx

    rcases le_total X₀ x with h | h

      rw [div_lt_iff₀ hxl] at h1
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hmax2 hxl.le]
    · have hmono : Nat.primeCounting ⌊x⌋₊ ≤ Nat.primeCounting ⌊X₀⌋₊ :=
        Nat.monotone_primeCounting (Nat.floor_le_floor h)
      have hge1 : 1 ≤ x / Real.log x := by

noncomputable def commonIndices {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (p q : ι → ℕ) : Finset ι :=

noncomputable def CollisionClass.remaining {a : ℕ} (C : Finset (Fin a)) : Finset (Fin a) :=
  Finset.univ \ C

noncomputable def CollisionClass.index {a : ℕ} (C : Finset (Fin a))
    (idx : Fin (CollisionClass.remaining C).card) : Fin a :=
  ((CollisionClass.remaining C).orderIsoOfFin rfl idx).val

structure CollisionClass.Conditions {a l : ℕ} (C : Finset (Fin a)) (d M n : ℕ) (S Y : ℝ) (v W : ℕ → ℝ)
    (p q : Fin a → ℕ) (t : Fin l → ℕ) (e : ℕ) : Prop where
  normal_left : ∀ idx, SNormal S (p idx)
  normal_right : ∀ idx, SNormal S (q idx)
  normal_tail : ∀ idx, SNormal S (t idx)
  left_injective : Function.Injective p
  residual_pos : 0 < e
  common : C = commonIndices Finset.univ p q
  common_product : (∏ idx ∈ C, p idx) = M
  integer : (∏ idx, p idx)*(∏ j, t j) = n
  equation : d*((∏ idx, (p idx-1))*(∏ j, (t j-1))) = (∏ idx, (q idx-1))*e
  size : ((d*((∏ idx, (p idx-1))*(∏ j, (t j-1))) : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ Y
  square_exclusion : NoLargePrimeSquare (d*((∏ idx, (p idx-1))*(∏ j, (t j-1))))
    (v (CollisionClass.remaining C).card)
  largest_left : ∀ idx : Fin (CollisionClass.remaining C).card,
    W idx.val ≤ (largestPrimeFactor (p (CollisionClass.index C idx)-1) : ℝ) ∧
      (largestPrimeFactor (p (CollisionClass.index C idx)-1) : ℝ) ≤ v idx.val
  largest_right : ∀ idx : Fin (CollisionClass.remaining C).card,
    W idx.val ≤ (largestPrimeFactor (q (CollisionClass.index C idx)-1) : ℝ) ∧
      (largestPrimeFactor (q (CollisionClass.index C idx)-1) : ℝ) ≤ v idx.val
  tail_support : ∀ idx : Fin l, ∀ z ∈ (t idx-1).primeFactorsList,
    (z : ℝ) ≤ v (CollisionClass.remaining C).card
  residual_support : ∀ z ∈ e.primeFactorsList, (z : ℝ) ≤ v (CollisionClass.remaining C).card

noncomputable def CollisionBox.roundUp (ε w : ℝ) : ℝ := ε * (⌈w / ε⌉₊ : ℝ)

noncomputable def CollisionBox.rounded {L : ℕ} (ε : ℝ) (w : Fin (L + 1) → ℝ)
    (idx : Fin (L + 1)) : ℝ := if idx.val = 0 then 1 else CollisionBox.roundUp ε (w idx)

noncomputable def CollisionBox.tailCoordinate {L : ℕ} (ε h b : ℝ)
    (w : Fin (L + 1) → ℝ) (J : Fin (L + 1)) : ℝ :=
  min b (CollisionBox.rounded ε w J - 2 * h)

noncomputable def CollisionBox.shiftedCoordinate (T : ℝ) (p : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  logLog (largestPrimeFactor (p - 1)) / T

noncomputable def CollisionCutoff.nu {k : ℕ} (L : ℕ) (δ : ℝ) (z : Fin k → ℝ) (zstar : ℝ) (idx : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  if idx = 0 then 1 else if hi : idx < k then z ⟨idx, hi⟩ + (2 * L + 1) * δ
  else zstar + (2 * L + 3) * δ

noncomputable def CollisionCutoff.mu {k : ℕ} (L : ℕ) (δ ε : ℝ) (z : Fin k → ℝ) (zstar : ℝ) (idx : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  CollisionCutoff.nu L δ z zstar idx - (4 * L + 2) * δ - ε

noncomputable def CollisionCutoff.upper {k : ℕ} (Y : ℝ) (L : ℕ) (δ : ℝ) (z : Fin k → ℝ)
    (zstar : ℝ) (idx : ℕ) : ℝ := CollisionBox.cutoff Y (CollisionCutoff.nu L δ z zstar idx)

noncomputable def CollisionCutoff.lower {k : ℕ} (Y : ℝ) (L : ℕ) (δ ε : ℝ) (z : Fin k → ℝ)
    (zstar : ℝ) (idx : ℕ) : ℝ := CollisionBox.cutoff Y (CollisionCutoff.mu L δ ε z zstar idx)

noncomputable def CollisionCutoff.selectedIndex {L : ℕ} (J : Fin (L + 1))
    (C : Finset (Fin (J.val + 1))) (idx : Fin (CollisionClass.remaining C).card) : Fin (L + 1) :=
  Fin.castLE (by have := J.isLt; omega) (CollisionClass.index C idx)

noncomputable def CollisionCutoff.selectedZeta {L : ℕ} (J : Fin (L + 1)) (C : Finset (Fin (J.val + 1)))
    (ε : ℝ) (w : Fin (L + 1) → ℝ) (idx : Fin (CollisionClass.remaining C).card) : ℝ :=
  CollisionBox.rounded ε w (CollisionCutoff.selectedIndex J C idx)

structure CollisionCutoff.SieveCutoffs (k : ℕ) (Y δ : ℝ) (v W : ℕ → ℝ) : Prop where
  antitone : Antitone v
  zero : v 0 = Y
  interleaving : ∀ idx, idx < k → v (idx + 1) < W idx ∧ W idx ≤ v idx
  gaps : ∀ idx, 2 ≤ idx → idx ≤ k → δ ≤ logLog (v (idx - 1)) / logLog Y - logLog (v idx) / logLog Y
  normality : normalityScale (logLog Y) ≤ v k
  initial : v 1 ≤ Y ^ (1 / (10 * logLog Y))

def CollisionMatching.prefixIndex {L : ℕ} (J : Fin (L + 1)) (idx : Fin (J.val + 1)) : Fin (L + 1) :=
  Fin.castLE (by have := J.isLt; omega) idx

def CollisionRecord.tailIndex {L : ℕ} (J : Fin (L + 1)) (idx : Fin (L - J.val)) : Fin (L + 1) :=
  ⟨J.val + 1 + idx.val, by have := idx.isLt; have := J.isLt; omega⟩

abbrev CollisionRecord.leftPrimes {L : ℕ} (J : Fin (L + 1)) (p : Fin (L + 1) → ℕ) : Fin (J.val + 1) → ℕ :=
  fun idx => p (CollisionMatching.prefixIndex J idx)

abbrev CollisionRecord.tailPrimes {L : ℕ} (J : Fin (L + 1)) (p : Fin (L + 1) → ℕ) : Fin (L - J.val) → ℕ :=
  fun idx => p (CollisionRecord.tailIndex J idx)

noncomputable def CollisionRecord.commonProduct {L : ℕ} (J : Fin (L + 1)) (p : Fin (L + 1) → ℕ)
    (C : Finset (Fin (J.val + 1))) : ℕ := ∏ idx ∈ C, CollisionRecord.leftPrimes J p idx

noncomputable def CollisionRecord.upper {L : ℕ} (Y : ℝ) (p : Fin (L + 1) → ℕ) (ε h b : ℝ)
    (J : Fin (L + 1)) (C : Finset (Fin (J.val + 1))) : ℕ → ℝ :=
  let w := fun idx => CollisionBox.shiftedCoordinate (logLog Y) (p idx)
  CollisionCutoff.upper Y L (normalityDelta (logLog Y))
    (CollisionCutoff.selectedZeta J C ε w) (CollisionBox.tailCoordinate ε h b w J)

noncomputable def CollisionRecord.lower {L : ℕ} (Y : ℝ) (p : Fin (L + 1) → ℕ) (ε h b : ℝ)
    (J : Fin (L + 1)) (C : Finset (Fin (J.val + 1))) : ℕ → ℝ :=
  let w := fun idx => CollisionBox.shiftedCoordinate (logLog Y) (p idx)
  CollisionCutoff.lower Y L (normalityDelta (logLog Y)) ε
    (CollisionCutoff.selectedZeta J C ε w) (CollisionBox.tailCoordinate ε h b w J)

noncomputable abbrev CollisionSum.upper {L : ℕ} (Y : ℝ) (p : Fin (L + 1) → ℕ) (J : Fin (L + 1))
    (C : Finset (Fin (J.val + 1))) : ℕ → ℝ :=
  CollisionRecord.upper Y p (1 / logLog Y) ((logLog Y) ^ (-2 / 5 : ℝ)) ((logLog Y) ^ (-1 / 3 : ℝ)) J C

noncomputable abbrev CollisionSum.lower {L : ℕ} (Y : ℝ) (p : Fin (L + 1) → ℕ) (J : Fin (L + 1))
    (C : Finset (Fin (J.val + 1))) : ℕ → ℝ :=
  CollisionRecord.lower Y p (1 / logLog Y) ((logLog Y) ^ (-2 / 5 : ℝ)) ((logLog Y) ^ (-1 / 3 : ℝ)) J C

noncomputable def CollisionSum.box {L : ℕ} (Y : ℝ) (p : Fin (L + 1) → ℕ) : Fin (L + 1) → ℝ :=
  CollisionBox.rounded (1 / logLog Y) (fun idx => CollisionBox.shiftedCoordinate (logLog Y) (p idx))

def CollisionSum.prefixEmbedding {L : ℕ} (J : Fin (L + 1)) : Fin (J.val + 1) ↪ Fin (L + 1) where
  toFun := CollisionMatching.prefixIndex J
  inj' := by
    intro idx j hij
    exact Fin.ext (congrArg (fun k : Fin (L + 1) => k.val) hij)

noncomputable def CollisionSum.commonCode {L : ℕ} (J : Fin (L + 1)) (C : Finset (Fin (J.val + 1))) :
    Finset (Fin (L + 1)) :=
  C.map (CollisionSum.prefixEmbedding J)

structure CollisionSum.Record (Y : ℝ) (L d : ℕ) where
  integer : ℕ
  primes : Fin (L + 1) → ℕ
  J : Fin (L + 1)
  common : Finset (Fin (J.val + 1))
  right : Fin (J.val + 1) → ℕ
  residual : ℕ
  prefix_lt : J.val < L
  zero_survives : ∀ idx : Fin (J.val + 1), idx.val = 0 → idx ∉ common
  cutoffs : CollisionCutoff.SieveCutoffs (CollisionClass.remaining common).card Y (normalityDelta (logLog Y))
    (CollisionSum.upper Y primes J common) (CollisionSum.lower Y primes J common)
  conditions : CollisionClass.Conditions common d (CollisionRecord.commonProduct J primes common) integer
    (normalityScale (logLog Y)) Y (CollisionSum.upper Y primes J common) (CollisionSum.lower Y primes J common)
    (CollisionRecord.leftPrimes J primes) right (CollisionRecord.tailPrimes J primes) residual
  prime_min : ∀ idx, 17 ≤ primes idx
  order : Antitone primes
  facet : (∑ idx ∈ Finset.Icc 1 L, fordWeight idx *
    CollisionFacet.extend (fun j => CollisionBox.primeCoordinate (logLog Y) (primes j)) idx) ≤
      1 - (logLog Y) ^ (-1 / 8 : ℝ)

abbrev CollisionSum.Label (L : ℕ) :=
  (Fin (L + 1) × (Fin (L + 1) → ℝ)) × Finset (Fin (L + 1)) × ℕ

noncomputable def CollisionSum.Record.label {Y : ℝ} {L d : ℕ} (r : CollisionSum.Record Y L d) :
    CollisionSum.Label L :=
  ((r.J, CollisionSum.box Y r.primes), CollisionSum.commonCode r.J r.common,
    CollisionRecord.commonProduct r.J r.primes r.common)

subgoal_signatures.name: inverse_totient_size_bound
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(hPNT : Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => (Nat.primeCounting ⌊x⌋₊ : ℝ) / (x / Real.log x)) atTop (𝓝 1))
    (hMERT : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ, 2 ≤ x →
      |(∑ p ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊x⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, (1 : ℝ) / p) - Real.log (Real.log x)| ≤ C)
    (hEULER : Asymptotics.IsEquivalent atTop
      (fun x : ℝ => ∏ p ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊x⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, (1 - (1 : ℝ) / p))
      (fun x => Real.exp (-Real.eulerMascheroniConstant) / Real.log x)) :
    ∃ D : ℝ, 0 < D ∧ ∀ᶠ Y : ℝ in atTop, ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → (n.totient : ℝ) ≤ Y → (n : ℝ) ≤ D * Y * logLog Y

subgoal_signatures.statement:
(A P κ θ : ℝ) (hκ : 1 < κ) (hθ : θ < 1)
    (hsize : ∃ D : ℝ, 0 < D ∧ ∀ᶠ Y : ℝ in atTop, ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → (n.totient : ℝ) ≤ Y →
      (n : ℝ) ≤ D * Y * logLog Y) :
    ∀ᶠ Y : ℝ in atTop, ∀ (L d n : ℕ) (p : Fin (L + 1) → ℕ) (N : ℕ),
      (L : ℝ) ≤ A * Real.log (logLog Y) → 0 < d →
      (largestPrimeFactor d : ℝ) ≤ normalityScale (logLog Y) →
      CollisionSum.RetainedPair Y P κ θ d n p N →
      ∃ r : CollisionSum.Record Y L d, r.integer = n
