proof.tactics:
by
  
  have lpf_le : ∀ {m q : ℕ}, 0 < m → q.Prime → q ∣ m → q ≤ largestPrimeFactor m := by
    intro m q hm hq hqm
    exact (Finset.le_sup (f := id) (hq.mem_primeFactors hqm (Nat.ne_of_gt hm))).trans
      (le_max_right _ _)
  have lpf_mul : ∀ {a b : ℕ}, 0 < a → 0 < b →
      largestPrimeFactor (a * b) = max (largestPrimeFactor a) (largestPrimeFactor b) := by
    intro a b ha hb
    simp [largestPrimeFactor, Nat.primeFactors_mul (Nat.ne_of_gt ha) (Nat.ne_of_gt hb),
      Finset.sup_union, max_assoc, max_left_comm, max_comm]
  have totprod : ∀ s : Finset ℕ, (∀ q ∈ s, q.Prime) →
      (∏ q ∈ s, q).totient = ∏ q ∈ s, (q - 1) := by
    intro s
    induction s using Finset.induction with
    | empty => intro _; simp
    | @insert q s hqs ih =>
      intro hs
      have hq : q.Prime := hs q (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _)
      have hs' : ∀ x ∈ s, x.Prime := fun x hx => hs x (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hx)
      have hcop : q.Coprime (∏ x ∈ s, x) := by
        apply Nat.coprime_prod_right_iff.mpr
        intro x hx
        rw [hq.coprime_iff_not_dvd]
        intro hdvd
        have heq : q = x := (Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq hq (hs' x hx)).mp hdvd
        exact hqs (heq.symm ▸ hx)
      rw [Finset.prod_insert hqs, Nat.totient_mul hcop, Nat.totient_prime hq,
        ih hs', Finset.prod_insert hqs]
  have sqfprod : ∀ s : Finset ℕ, (∀ q ∈ s, q.Prime) → Squarefree (∏ q ∈ s, q) := by
    intro s h
    refine Nat.squarefree_iff_prime_squarefree.mpr ?_
    intro x hx h_dvd
    by_cases hxs : x ∈ s
    · rw [← Finset.mul_prod_erase (a := x) (h := hxs),
        mul_dvd_mul_iff_left (Nat.Prime.ne_zero hx)] at h_dvd
      obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hx.prime.exists_mem_finset_dvd h_dvd
      rw [Finset.mem_erase] at hq
      exact hq.1.1 ((Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq hx (h q hq.1.2)).mp hq.2).symm
    · have hx' : x ∣ ∏ q ∈ s, q := (dvd_mul_right x x).trans h_dvd
      obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hx.prime.exists_mem_finset_dvd hx'
      have heq : x = q := (Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq hx (h q hq.1)).mp hq.2
      rw [heq] at hxs
      exact hxs hq.1
  have cardsf : ∀ {m : ℕ}, Squarefree m →
      ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors m = m.primeFactors.card := by
    intro m hm
    rw [← (ArithmeticFunction.cardDistinctFactors_eq_cardFactors_iff_squarefree hm.ne_zero).mpr hm,
      ArithmeticFunction.cardDistinctFactors_apply, ← Nat.toFinset_factors, List.card_toFinset]
  
  have T_pos : ∀ {n : ℕ} {q : Fin (L + 1) → ℕ}, Rigidity.Tuple Y P κ θ r n q → 0 < n := by
    intro n q h
    rw [← h.integer]
    exact Finset.prod_pos (fun idx _ => (h.prime idx).pos)
  have T_min : ∀ {n : ℕ} {q : Fin (L + 1) → ℕ}, Rigidity.Tuple Y P κ θ r n q →
      ∀ idx, 17 ≤ q idx := fun h idx =>
    ((le_max_left _ _).trans h.last_lower.le).trans (h.order.antitone (Fin.le_last idx))
  have T_tail : ∀ {n : ℕ} {q : Fin (L + 1) → ℕ}, Rigidity.Tuple Y P κ θ r n q →
      ∀ idx, largestPrimeFactor r < q idx := fun h idx =>
    ((le_max_right _ _).trans_lt h.last_lower).trans_le (h.order.antitone (Fin.le_last idx))
  have T_imgprime : ∀ {n : ℕ} {q : Fin (L + 1) → ℕ}, Rigidity.Tuple Y P κ θ r n q →
      ∀ v ∈ Finset.univ.image q, v.Prime := by
    intro n q h v hv
    obtain ⟨idx, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hv
    exact h.prime idx
  have T_prod : ∀ {n : ℕ} {q : Fin (L + 1) → ℕ}, Rigidity.Tuple Y P κ θ r n q →
      (∏ v ∈ Finset.univ.image q, v) = n := fun h =>
    (Finset.prod_image h.order.injective.injOn).trans h.integer
  have T_tot : ∀ {n : ℕ} {q : Fin (L + 1) → ℕ}, Rigidity.Tuple Y P κ θ r n q →
      n.totient = ∏ idx, (q idx - 1) := by
    intro n q h
    have h1 := totprod _ (T_imgprime h)
    rw [T_prod h, Finset.prod_image h.order.injective.injOn] at h1
    exact h1
  have T_pf : ∀ {n : ℕ} {q : Fin (L + 1) → ℕ}, Rigidity.Tuple Y P κ θ r n q →
      n.primeFactors = Finset.univ.image q := by
    intro n q h
    rw [← T_prod h]
    exact Nat.primeFactors_prod (T_imgprime h)
  have T_sqf : ∀ {n : ℕ} {q : Fin (L + 1) → ℕ}, Rigidity.Tuple Y P κ θ r n q →
      Squarefree n := by
    intro n q h
    rw [← T_prod h]
    exact sqfprod _ (T_imgprime h)
  have T_card : ∀ {n : ℕ} {q : Fin (L + 1) → ℕ}, Rigidity.Tuple Y P κ θ r n q →
      ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors n = L + 1 := by
    intro n q h
    rw [cardsf (T_sqf h), T_pf h, Finset.card_image_of_injective _ h.order.injective]
    simp
  have T_dvd : ∀ {n : ℕ} {q : Fin (L + 1) → ℕ}, Rigidity.Tuple Y P κ θ r n q →
      ∀ idx, q idx ∣ n := by
    intro n q h idx
    rw [← h.integer]
    exact Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem q (Finset.mem_univ idx)
  have T_largest : ∀ {n : ℕ} {q : Fin (L + 1) → ℕ}, Rigidity.Tuple Y P κ θ r n q →
      largestPrimeFactor n = q 0 := by
    intro n q h
    apply le_antisymm
    · unfold largestPrimeFactor
      rw [T_pf h]
      refine max_le (h.prime 0).one_le (Finset.sup_le ?_)
      intro v hv
      obtain ⟨idx, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hv
      exact h.order.antitone (Fin.zero_le idx)
    · exact lpf_le (T_pos h) (h.prime 0) (T_dvd h 0)
  have T_cop : ∀ {n : ℕ} {q : Fin (L + 1) → ℕ}, Rigidity.Tuple Y P κ θ r n q →
      n.Coprime r := by
    intro n q h
    rw [← h.integer]
    exact Nat.coprime_prod_left_iff.mpr (fun idx _ => by
      rw [(h.prime idx).coprime_iff_not_dvd]
      intro hdvd
      exact (not_le_of_gt (T_tail h idx)) (lpf_le hr (h.prime idx) hdvd))
  have T_cantot : ∀ {n : ℕ} {q : Fin (L + 1) → ℕ}, Rigidity.Tuple Y P κ θ r n q →
      (r * n).totient = r.totient * n.totient := fun h => Nat.totient_mul (T_cop h).symm
  have T_canlpf : ∀ {n : ℕ} {q : Fin (L + 1) → ℕ}, Rigidity.Tuple Y P κ θ r n q →
      largestPrimeFactor (r * n) = q 0 := by
    intro n q h
    rw [lpf_mul hr (T_pos h), T_largest h, max_eq_right (T_tail h 0).le]
  have T_totsize : ∀ {n : ℕ} {q : Fin (L + 1) → ℕ}, Rigidity.Tuple Y P κ θ r n q →
      (n.totient : ℝ) ≤ Y := by
    intro n q h
    have hd : 1 ≤ r.totient := Nat.totient_pos.mpr hr
    have hle : n.totient ≤ r.totient * n.totient := by nlinarith
    exact (Nat.cast_le.mpr hle).trans h.size
  
  have T_rigid : ∀ {n m : ℕ}, n ∈ F → m ∈ F → n.totient = m.totient → p n 0 = p m 0 → n = m := by
    intro n m hn hm hφ h0
    have hnT := hF n hn
    have hmT := hF m hm
    rw [T_tot hnT, T_tot hmT, Fin.prod_univ_succ, Fin.prod_univ_succ, ← h0] at hφ
    have hlow := hlower n hn m hm
      (Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left (Nat.sub_pos_of_lt (hnT.prime 0).one_lt) hφ)
    have hpq : p n = p m := funext (fun idx => Fin.cases h0 hlow idx)
    rw [← hnT.integer, ← hmT.integer, hpq]
  
  let E₀ : Finset ℕ :=
    F.filter (fun n => ∃ q : ℕ, q.Prime ∧ q ∣ n ∧ ¬ SNormal (normalityScale (logLog Y)) q)
  let F₁ : Finset ℕ := F \ E₀
  have hF₁ : F₁ ⊆ F := Finset.sdiff_subset
  have hnF₁ : ∀ n ∈ F₁, ∀ q : ℕ, q.Prime → q ∣ n → SNormal (normalityScale (logLog Y)) q := by
    intro n hn q hq hqn
    by_contra hbad
    exact (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hn).2
      (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨(Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hn).1, q, hq, hqn, hbad⟩)
  have hzero : (E₀.card : ℝ) ≤ (((Finset.Icc 1 ⌊c * Y * logLog Y⌋₊).filter (fun n => Squarefree n ∧
          ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors n ≤ ⌊A * Real.log (logLog Y)⌋₊ + 1 ∧
          ∃ q : ℕ, q.Prime ∧ q ∣ n ∧ ¬ SNormal (normalityScale (logLog Y)) q)).card : ℝ) := by
    apply Nat.cast_le.mpr
    apply Finset.card_le_card
    intro n hn
    obtain ⟨hnF, hbad⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hn
    have ht := hF n hnF
    have hnk : ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors n ≤ ⌊A * Real.log (logLog Y)⌋₊ + 1 := by
      rw [T_card ht]
      exact Nat.add_le_add_right (Nat.le_floor hL) 1
    exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨T_pos ht,
      Nat.le_floor (hsize n (T_pos ht) (T_totsize ht))⟩, T_sqf ht, hnk, hbad⟩
  
  let f : F₁ → ℕ := fun a => r.totient * a.val.totient
  have hfib : ∀ b : ℕ, ∃ σ : Equiv.Perm {a : F₁ // f a = b}, ∀ x y, x ≠ y → σ x ≠ x := by
    intro b
    obtain ⟨σ, hσ, _⟩ := (Finset.univ : Finset {a : F₁ // f a = b}).exists_cycleOn
    refine ⟨σ, fun x y hxy => hσ.apply_ne ?_ (by simp)⟩
    exact ⟨x, by simp, y, by simp, hxy⟩
  choose σ hσ using hfib
  let e := Equiv.sigmaFiberEquiv f
  let pm : Equiv.Perm F₁ := e.symm.trans ((Equiv.sigmaCongrRight σ).trans e)
  have hpmval : ∀ a, f (pm a) = f a := by
    intro a
    change f (σ (f a) ⟨a, rfl⟩).val = f a
    exact (σ (f a) ⟨a, rfl⟩).property
  have hpmmove : ∀ a : F₁, (∃ b, f b = f a ∧ b ≠ a) → pm a ≠ a := by
    intro a ⟨b, hfb, hba⟩ hpm
    have hne : (⟨a, rfl⟩ : {a' : F₁ // f a' = f a}) ≠ ⟨b, hfb⟩ := by
      intro h
      exact hba (congrArg Subtype.val h).symm
    apply hσ (f a) ⟨a, rfl⟩ ⟨b, hfb⟩ hne
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact hpm
  have hwit : ∀ a : F₁, ∃ N : ℕ, 0 < N ∧ N.totient = f a ∧ largestPrimeFactor N ≠ p a.val 0 :=
    fun a => hwitness a.val (hF₁ a.property)
  choose init hinitpos hinittot hinitlpf using hwit
  let w₀ : F₁ → ℕ := fun a => if (∃ b, f b = f a ∧ b ≠ a) then r * (pm a).val else init a
  have hcanpos : ∀ a : F₁, 0 < r * a.val := fun a =>
    Nat.mul_pos hr (T_pos (hF a.val (hF₁ a.property)))
  have hcantot : ∀ a : F₁, (r * a.val).totient = f a := fun a =>
    T_cantot (hF a.val (hF₁ a.property))
  have hw₀tot : ∀ a, (w₀ a).totient = f a := by
    intro a
    by_cases ha : ∃ b, f b = f a ∧ b ≠ a
    · show (if (∃ b, f b = f a ∧ b ≠ a) then r * (pm a).val else init a).totient = f a
      rw [if_pos ha, hcantot, hpmval]
    · show (if (∃ b, f b = f a ∧ b ≠ a) then r * (pm a).val else init a).totient = f a
      rw [if_neg ha]
      exact hinittot a
  have hw₀pos : ∀ a, 0 < w₀ a := by
    intro a
    by_cases ha : ∃ b, f b = f a ∧ b ≠ a
    · show 0 < (if (∃ b, f b = f a ∧ b ≠ a) then r * (pm a).val else init a)
      rw [if_pos ha]
      exact hcanpos (pm a)
    · show 0 < (if (∃ b, f b = f a ∧ b ≠ a) then r * (pm a).val else init a)
      rw [if_neg ha]
      exact hinitpos a
  have hw₀lpf : ∀ a, largestPrimeFactor (w₀ a) ≠ p a.val 0 := by
    intro a
    by_cases ha : ∃ b, f b = f a ∧ b ≠ a
    · show largestPrimeFactor (if (∃ b, f b = f a ∧ b ≠ a) then r * (pm a).val else init a) ≠
        p a.val 0
      rw [if_pos ha, T_canlpf (hF (pm a).val (hF₁ (pm a).property))]
      intro htop
      apply hpmmove a ha
      apply Subtype.ext
      apply T_rigid (hF₁ (pm a).property) (hF₁ a.property) _ htop
      exact Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left (Nat.totient_pos.mpr hr) (hpmval a)
    · show largestPrimeFactor (if (∃ b, f b = f a ∧ b ≠ a) then r * (pm a).val else init a) ≠
        p a.val 0
      rw [if_neg ha]
      exact hinitlpf a
  have hw₀inj : Function.Injective w₀ := by
    intro a b hab
    by_contra hne
    have hfab : f a = f b := by
      have h := congrArg Nat.totient hab
      rwa [hw₀tot, hw₀tot] at h
    have ha : ∃ c, f c = f a ∧ c ≠ a := ⟨b, hfab.symm, Ne.symm hne⟩
    have hb : ∃ c, f c = f b ∧ c ≠ b := ⟨a, hfab, hne⟩
    have h2 : r * (pm a).val = r * (pm b).val := by
      have h := hab
      change (if (∃ c, f c = f a ∧ c ≠ a) then r * (pm a).val else init a) =
        (if (∃ c, f c = f b ∧ c ≠ b) then r * (pm b).val else init b) at h
      rwa [if_pos ha, if_pos hb] at h
    exact hne (pm.injective (Subtype.ext (Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left hr h2)))
  have hw₀peer : ∀ a, (∃ b, f b = f a ∧ b ≠ a) → ∃ b : F₁, w₀ a = r * b.val := by
    intro a ha
    refine ⟨pm a, ?_⟩
    show (if (∃ b, f b = f a ∧ b ≠ a) then r * (pm a).val else init a) = r * (pm a).val
    rw [if_pos ha]
  let w : ℕ → ℕ := fun n => if hn : n ∈ F₁ then w₀ ⟨n, hn⟩ else 0
  have hw : ∀ n (hn : n ∈ F₁), w n = w₀ ⟨n, hn⟩ := fun n hn => dif_pos hn
  have A1 : Set.InjOn w (F₁ : Set ℕ) := by
    intro n hn m hm heq
    rw [hw n hn, hw m hm] at heq
    exact congrArg Subtype.val (hw₀inj heq)
  have A2 : ∀ n ∈ F₁, 0 < w n := fun n hn => by rw [hw n hn]; exact hw₀pos _
  have A3 : ∀ n ∈ F₁, (w n).totient = r.totient * n.totient := fun n hn => by
    rw [hw n hn]; exact hw₀tot _
  have A4 : ∀ n ∈ F₁, largestPrimeFactor (w n) ≠ p n 0 := fun n hn => by
    rw [hw n hn]; exact hw₀lpf _
  have A5 : ∀ n ∈ F₁, (∃ m ∈ F₁, m.totient = n.totient ∧ m ≠ n) → ∃ m ∈ F₁, w n = r * m := by
    intro n hn ⟨m, hm, hφ, hmn⟩
    have hpeer : ∃ b : F₁, f b = f ⟨n, hn⟩ ∧ b ≠ ⟨n, hn⟩ :=
      ⟨⟨m, hm⟩, congrArg (fun z : ℕ => r.totient * z) hφ,
        fun heq => hmn (congrArg Subtype.val heq)⟩
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hw₀peer ⟨n, hn⟩ hpeer
    exact ⟨b.val, b.property, (hw n hn).trans hb⟩
  have A6 : ∀ n ∈ F₁, ((w n).totient : ℝ) ≤ Y := by
    intro n hn
    rw [A3 n hn]
    exact (hF n (hF₁ hn)).size
  
  let E₁ : Finset ℕ := F₁.filter (fun n => ∃ q : ℕ, q.Prime ∧ Real.log Y ^ 4 < (q : ℝ) ∧
    (q ^ 2 ∣ w n ∨ q ^ 2 ∣ (w n).totient))
  have hone : (E₁.card : ℝ) ≤ (((Finset.Icc 1 ⌊c * Y * logLog Y⌋₊).filter (fun n => ∃ q : ℕ, q.Prime ∧
          Real.log Y ^ 4 < (q : ℝ) ∧ (q ^ 2 ∣ n ∨ q ^ 2 ∣ n.totient))).card : ℝ) := by
    apply Nat.cast_le.mpr
    apply Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn w
    · intro n hn
      obtain ⟨hnF1, hbad⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hn
      exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨A2 n hnF1,
        Nat.le_floor (hsize (w n) (A2 n hnF1) (A6 n hnF1))⟩, hbad⟩
    · intro n hn m hm hnm
      exact A1 (Finset.mem_filter.mp hn).1 (Finset.mem_filter.mp hm).1 hnm
  
  let E₂ : Finset ℕ := F₁.filter (fun n => ∃ q : ℕ, q.Prime ∧ q ∣ w n ∧
    ¬ SNormal (normalityScale (logLog Y)) q)
  have htwo : (E₂.card : ℝ) ≤ (((totientsUpTo Y).filter (fun m => ∃ n : ℕ, 0 < n ∧ n.totient = m ∧
          ∃ q : ℕ, q.Prime ∧ q ∣ n ∧ ¬ SNormal (normalityScale (logLog Y)) q)).card : ℝ) := by
    apply Nat.cast_le.mpr
    apply Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn (fun n => (w n).totient)
    · intro n hn
      obtain ⟨hnF1, hbad⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hn
      have hmem : (w n).totient ∈ totientsUpTo Y := by
        unfold totientsUpTo
        exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨Nat.totient_pos.mpr (A2 n hnF1),
          Nat.le_floor (A6 n hnF1)⟩, w n, rfl⟩
      exact Finset.mem_coe.mpr (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hmem, w n, A2 n hnF1, rfl, hbad⟩)
    · intro n hn m hm hnm
      obtain ⟨hnF1, q, hq, hqn, hqbad⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hn
      have hmF1 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hm).1
      by_contra hne
      have hφ : m.totient = n.totient := Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left (Nat.totient_pos.mpr hr) (by
        rw [← A3 m hmF1, ← A3 n hnF1]
        exact hnm.symm)
      obtain ⟨m', hm', hwm⟩ := A5 n hnF1 ⟨m, hmF1, hφ, Ne.symm hne⟩
      rw [hwm] at hqn
      rcases hq.dvd_mul.mp hqn with hqr | hqm
      · exact hqbad (hrnormal q (hq.mem_primeFactors hqr hr.ne'))
      · exact hqbad (hnF₁ m' hm' q hq hqm)
  
  let G : Finset ℕ := F₁ \ (E₁ ∪ E₂)
  have hG : (G.card : ℝ) ≤ B := by
    apply hretained G
    intro n hn
    obtain ⟨hnF1, hnex⟩ := Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hn
    have hnF := hF₁ hnF1
    have ht := hF n hnF
    have hnE₁ : n ∉ E₁ := fun h => hnex (Finset.mem_union_left _ h)
    have hnE₂ : n ∉ E₂ := fun h => hnex (Finset.mem_union_right _ h)
    refine ⟨p n, w n, {
      integer := ht.integer
      normal_left := fun idx => hnF₁ n hnF1 (p n idx) (ht.prime idx) (T_dvd ht idx)
      prime_min := T_min ht
      order := ht.order
      gaps := ht.gaps
      lower_upper := ht.lower_upper
      last_upper := ht.last_upper
      top := ht.top
      witness_pos := A2 n hnF1
      equation := (A3 n hnF1).trans (congrArg (fun z : ℕ => r.totient * z) (T_tot ht))
      size := A6 n hnF1
      largest_ne := A4 n hnF1
      normal_right := ?_
      square_witness := ?_
      square_totient := ?_
      facet := ht.facet }⟩
    · intro q hq
      by_contra hbad
      exact hnE₂ (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hnF1, q, Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hq,
        Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactors hq, hbad⟩)
    · intro q hq hH hdiv
      exact hnE₁ (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hnF1, q, hq, hH, Or.inl hdiv⟩)
    · intro q hq hH hdiv
      exact hnE₁ (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hnF1, q, hq, hH, Or.inr hdiv⟩)
  
  have hcover : F ⊆ ((E₀ ∪ E₁) ∪ E₂) ∪ G := by
    intro n hn
    by_cases h₀ : n ∈ E₀
    · exact Finset.mem_union_left _ (Finset.mem_union_left _ (Finset.mem_union_left _ h₀))
    by_cases h₁ : n ∈ E₁
    · exact Finset.mem_union_left _ (Finset.mem_union_left _ (Finset.mem_union_right _ h₁))
    by_cases h₂ : n ∈ E₂
    · exact Finset.mem_union_left _ (Finset.mem_union_right _ h₂)
    exact Finset.mem_union_right _ (Finset.mem_sdiff.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_sdiff.mpr ⟨hn, h₀⟩,
      fun h => (Finset.mem_union.mp h).elim h₁ h₂⟩)
  have hcard : F.card ≤ E₀.card + E₁.card + E₂.card + G.card := by
    calc
      F.card ≤ (((E₀ ∪ E₁) ∪ E₂) ∪ G).card := Finset.card_le_card hcover
      _ ≤ ((E₀ ∪ E₁) ∪ E₂).card + G.card := Finset.card_union_le _ _
      _ ≤ (E₀ ∪ E₁).card + E₂.card + G.card := by gcongr; exact Finset.card_union_le _ _
      _ ≤ E₀.card + E₁.card + E₂.card + G.card := by gcongr; exact Finset.card_union_le _ _
  have hcardR : (F.card : ℝ) ≤ E₀.card + E₁.card + E₂.card + G.card := by exact_mod_cast hcard
  exact hcardR.trans (add_le_add (add_le_add (add_le_add hzero hone) htwo) hG)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have lpf_ge : ∀ {n q : ℕ}, 0 < n → q.Prime → q ∣ n → q ≤ largestPrimeFactor n := by
    intro n q hn hq hqn
    exact (Finset.le_sup (f := id) (hq.mem_primeFactors hqn (Nat.ne_of_gt hn))).trans
      (le_max_right _ _)
  have lpf_lt : ∀ {n p : ℕ}, 1 < p → (∀ q, q.Prime → q ∣ n → q < p) →
      largestPrimeFactor n < p := by
    intro n p hp h
    unfold largestPrimeFactor
    apply max_lt hp
    exact (Finset.sup_lt_iff (show (⊥ : ℕ) < p from by show 0 < p; omega)).mpr
      (fun q hq => h q (Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hq) (Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactors hq))
  have coprime_of_lt : ∀ {n p : ℕ}, 0 < n → p.Prime → largestPrimeFactor n < p →
      p.Coprime n := by
    intro n p hn hp h
    rw [hp.coprime_iff_not_dvd]
    intro hdvd
    exact (not_le_of_gt h) (lpf_ge hn hp hdvd)
  have top_ext : ∀ {a p : ℕ}, 0 < a → p.Prime → largestPrimeFactor a < p →
      (p * a).totient = (p - 1) * a.totient ∧ largestPrimeFactor (p * a) = p := by
    intro a p ha hp h
    refine ⟨by rw [Nat.totient_mul (coprime_of_lt ha hp h), Nat.totient_prime hp], ?_⟩
    apply le_antisymm
    · have : largestPrimeFactor (p * a) < p + 1 := by
        apply lpf_lt (by have := hp.one_lt; omega)
        intro q hq hqd
        rcases (Nat.Prime.dvd_mul hq).mp hqd with h1 | h1
        · exact Nat.lt_succ_of_le (Nat.le_of_dvd hp.pos h1)
        · have := (lpf_ge ha hq h1).trans_lt h
          omega
      omega
    · exact lpf_ge (Nat.mul_pos hp.pos ha) hp (dvd_mul_right p a)
  have totient_primes : ∀ s : Finset ℕ, (∀ p ∈ s, p.Prime) →
      (∏ p ∈ s, p).totient = ∏ p ∈ s, (p - 1) := by
    intro s
    induction s using Finset.induction with
    | empty => intro _; simp
    | @insert p s hps ih =>
      intro hs
      have hp : p.Prime := hs p (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _)
      have hs' : ∀ q ∈ s, q.Prime := fun q hq => hs q (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hq)
      have hcop : p.Coprime (∏ q ∈ s, q) := by
        apply Nat.coprime_prod_right_iff.mpr
        intro q hq
        rw [hp.coprime_iff_not_dvd]
        intro hdvd
        have heq : p = q := (Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq hp (hs' q hq)).mp hdvd
        exact hps (heq.symm ▸ hq)
      rw [Finset.prod_insert hps, Nat.totient_mul hcop, Nat.totient_prime hp,
        ih hs', Finset.prod_insert hps]
  have totient_inj : ∀ (s : Finset (Fin L)) (f : Fin L → ℕ), (∀ i ∈ s, (f i).Prime) →
      Set.InjOn f s → (∏ i ∈ s, f i).totient = ∏ i ∈ s, (f i - 1) := by
    intro s f hp hinj
    have hprime : ∀ q ∈ s.image f, q.Prime := by
      intro q hq
      obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hq
      exact hp i hi
    have h := totient_primes (s.image f) hprime
    rw [Finset.prod_image hinj, Finset.prod_image hinj] at h
    exact h
  
  have hrec : ∀ (Q : CoreRecords.LowerCoreRecord Y L R P) (p : ℕ), p.Prime →
      Q.lower ⟨0, Q.length_pos⟩ < p →
      Q.tail.totient * (p * ∏ idx, Q.lower idx).totient = (p - 1) * Q.numericalCore ∧
      largestPrimeFactor (p * ∏ idx, Q.lower idx) = p ∧
      0 < p * Q.integer ∧
      (p * Q.integer).totient = (p - 1) * Q.numericalCore ∧
      largestPrimeFactor (p * Q.integer) = p := by
    intro Q p hp hsep
    have hlow : ∀ idx, Q.lower idx ≤ Q.lower ⟨0, Q.length_pos⟩ := fun idx =>
      Q.order.antitone (show (⟨0, Q.length_pos⟩ : Fin L) ≤ idx from Nat.zero_le _)
    have hhigh : ∀ idx, largestPrimeFactor Q.tail < Q.lower idx := fun idx =>
      (le_max_right _ _).trans_lt (Q.last_lower.trans_le (Q.order.antitone
        (show idx ≤ ⟨L - 1, by have := Q.length_pos; omega⟩ from by
          change idx.val ≤ L - 1
          have := idx.isLt
          omega)))
    have hMpos : 0 < ∏ idx, Q.lower idx := Finset.prod_pos fun idx _ => (Q.prime idx).pos
    have hMdiv : ∀ q, q.Prime → q ∣ ∏ idx, Q.lower idx → q < p := by
      intro q hq hqd
      obtain ⟨idx, _, hidx⟩ := (Prime.dvd_finset_prod_iff hq.prime _).mp hqd
      have := (Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq hq (Q.prime idx)).mp hidx
      rw [this]
      exact (hlow idx).trans_lt hsep
    have hIdiv : ∀ q, q.Prime → q ∣ Q.integer → q < p := by
      intro q hq hqd
      unfold CoreRecords.LowerCoreRecord.integer at hqd
      rcases (Nat.Prime.dvd_mul hq).mp hqd with h | h
      · exact ((lpf_ge Q.tail_pos hq h).trans_lt (hhigh ⟨0, Q.length_pos⟩)).trans hsep
      · exact hMdiv q hq h
    have hIpos : 0 < Q.integer := Nat.mul_pos Q.tail_pos hMpos
    have hMtot : (∏ idx, Q.lower idx).totient = ∏ idx, (Q.lower idx - 1) :=
      totient_inj Finset.univ Q.lower (fun idx _ => Q.prime idx) Q.order.injective.injOn
    have hcopTM : Nat.Coprime Q.tail (∏ idx, Q.lower idx) := by
      apply Nat.coprime_prod_right_iff.mpr
      intro idx _
      exact (coprime_of_lt Q.tail_pos (Q.prime idx) (hhigh idx)).symm
    have hItot : Q.integer.totient = Q.numericalCore := by
      unfold CoreRecords.LowerCoreRecord.integer CoreRecords.LowerCoreRecord.numericalCore
      rw [Nat.totient_mul hcopTM, hMtot]
    have hpM := top_ext hMpos hp (lpf_lt hp.one_lt hMdiv)
    have hpI := top_ext hIpos hp (lpf_lt hp.one_lt hIdiv)
    refine ⟨?_, hpM.2, Nat.mul_pos hp.pos hIpos, ?_, hpI.2⟩
    · rw [hpM.1, hMtot]
      unfold CoreRecords.LowerCoreRecord.numericalCore
      ring
    · rw [hpI.1, hItot]
  
  have hreindex : ∀ (f : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ),
      (∑ idx : Fin n, f (idx.val + 1)) = ∑ idx ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, f idx := by
    intro f n
    induction n with
    | zero => simp
    | succ n ih =>
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_castSucc, Finset.sum_Icc_succ_top (by omega)]
      simpa only [Fin.val_castSucc, Fin.val_last] using congrArg (fun z => z + f (n + 1)) ih
  have hfacet : ∀ (x : Fin (L + 1) → ℝ),
      FordGeometry.outerForm L (fun idx : Fin L => x idx.succ) =
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 L, fordWeight j * CollisionFacet.extend x j := by
    intro x
    calc FordGeometry.outerForm L (fun idx : Fin L => x idx.succ)
        = ∑ idx : Fin L, fordWeight (idx.val + 1) * CollisionFacet.extend x (idx.val + 1) := by
          show ∑ idx : Fin L, fordWeight (idx.val + 1) * x idx.succ = _
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro idx _
          simp only [CollisionFacet.extend, dif_pos (Nat.add_lt_add_right idx.isLt 1)]
          rfl
      _ = _ := hreindex (fun j => fordWeight j * CollisionFacet.extend x j) L
  
  have htuple : ∀ (Q : CoreRecords.LowerCoreRecord Y L R P) (p : ℕ), p.Prime →
      Q.lower ⟨0, Q.length_pos⟩ < p → Y ^ (9 / 10 : ℝ) < (p : ℝ) →
      ((Q.tail.totient * (p * ∏ idx, Q.lower idx).totient : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ Y →
      Rigidity.Tuple Y P (6 / 5) (4 / 5) Q.tail (p * ∏ idx, Q.lower idx)
        (Fin.cons p Q.lower : Fin (L + 1) → ℕ) := by
    intro Q p hp hsep htop' hsize
    have hlast : (Fin.cons p Q.lower : Fin (L + 1) → ℕ) (Fin.last L) =
        Q.lower ⟨L - 1, by have := Q.length_pos; omega⟩ := by
      have he : Fin.last L = (⟨L - 1, by have := Q.length_pos; omega⟩ : Fin L).succ := by
        apply Fin.ext
        simp only [Fin.val_last, Fin.val_succ]
        have := Q.length_pos
        omega
      rw [he, Fin.cons_succ]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, hsize, ?_⟩
    · simp only [Fin.prod_univ_succ, Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_succ]
    · intro idx
      cases idx using Fin.cases with
      | zero => simpa using hp
      | succ j => simpa using Q.prime j
    · intro idx j hij
      cases idx using Fin.cases with
      | zero =>
        cases j using Fin.cases with
        | zero => exact (lt_irrefl _ hij).elim
        | succ j =>
          simp only [Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_succ]
          exact (Q.order.antitone
            (show (⟨0, Q.length_pos⟩ : Fin L) ≤ j from Nat.zero_le _)).trans_lt hsep
      | succ idx =>
        cases j using Fin.cases with
        | zero =>
          have h : idx.val + 1 < 0 := hij
          omega
        | succ j =>
          simp only [Fin.cons_succ]
          exact Q.order (Fin.succ_lt_succ_iff.mp hij)
    · rw [hlast]; exact Q.last_lower
    · rw [hlast]; exact Q.last_upper
    · intro idx hi hij
      cases idx using Fin.cases with
      | zero => simp at hi
      | succ idx =>
        have hj : idx.val + 1 < L := by simp only [Fin.val_succ] at hij; omega

      refine ⟨fun n => if h : ∃ a ∈ (collisionPoints (CoreRecords.powerRawPairs S)

          (Fin.cons (Classical.choose h).2 (lowerOf (Classical.choose h).1) : Fin (L + 1) → ℕ)
        else fun _ => 1, ?_⟩
      intro a ha

          a'.2 * ∏ idx, lowerOf a'.1 idx = a.2 * ∏ idx, lowerOf a.1 idx := ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
      simp only [dif_pos h]
      have hs := Classical.choose_spec h
      have : Classical.choose h = a :=
        hinj (Finset.mem_coe.mpr hs.1) (Finset.mem_coe.mpr ha) hs.2
      rw [this]

    rw [← hcard]

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hb : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 ≤ FordAnalysis.coeff n ∧ FordAnalysis.coeff n ≤ (n : ℝ) ∧
      Real.log (n : ℝ) ≤ FordAnalysis.coeff n := by
    intro n
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with rfl | hn
    · simp [FordAnalysis.coeff]
    · have hne : n ≠ 0 := by omega
      simp only [FordAnalysis.coeff, if_neg hne, fordWeight]
      have hx1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hn
      have hx0 : 0 < (n : ℝ) := by linarith
      have hx10 : 0 < (n : ℝ) + 1 := by linarith
      have hlogx : 0 ≤ Real.log (n : ℝ) := Real.log_nonneg hx1
      have hA : Real.log (n : ℝ) - Real.log ((n : ℝ) + 1) ≤ (n : ℝ) / ((n : ℝ) + 1) - 1 := by
        rw [← Real.log_div hx0.ne' hx10.ne']
        exact Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by positivity)
      have hA' : (Real.log (n : ℝ) - Real.log ((n : ℝ) + 1)) * ((n : ℝ) + 1) ≤ -1 := by
        have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hA hx10.le
        have he : ((n : ℝ) / ((n : ℝ) + 1) - 1) * ((n : ℝ) + 1) = -1 := by
          field_simp
          ring
        linarith
      have hB : Real.log ((n : ℝ) + 1) - Real.log (n : ℝ) ≤ ((n : ℝ) + 1) / (n : ℝ) - 1 := by
        rw [← Real.log_div hx10.ne' hx0.ne']
        exact Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by positivity)
      have hB' : (Real.log ((n : ℝ) + 1) - Real.log (n : ℝ)) * (n : ℝ) ≤ 1 := by
        have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hB hx0.le
        have he : (((n : ℝ) + 1) / (n : ℝ) - 1) * (n : ℝ) = 1 := by
          field_simp
          ring
        linarith
      have hC : Real.log ((n : ℝ) + 1) ≤ (n : ℝ) := by
        have := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos hx10
        linarith
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · nlinarith
      · nlinarith
      · nlinarith
  
  have hsum : Summable (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ) * (3 / 4 : ℝ) ^ n) := by
    have h := summable_pow_mul_geometric_of_norm_lt_one 1 (r := (3 / 4 : ℝ))
      (by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (by norm_num)]; norm_num)
    simpa using h
  
  have hcont : ContinuousOn FordAnalysis.F (Set.Icc 0 (3 / 4)) := by
    unfold FordAnalysis.F
    refine continuousOn_tsum (fun n => (continuous_const.mul (continuous_pow n)).continuousOn)
      hsum ?_
    intro n z hz
    rw [norm_mul, norm_pow, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hb n).1,
      abs_of_nonneg hz.1]
    exact mul_le_mul (hb n).2.1 (pow_le_pow_left₀ hz.1 hz.2 n) (pow_nonneg hz.1 n)
      (Nat.cast_nonneg n)

    have hg0 : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 ≤ FordAnalysis.coeff n * (3 / 4 : ℝ) ^ n :=
      fun n => mul_nonneg (hb n).1 (by positivity)
    have hgs : Summable (fun n : ℕ => FordAnalysis.coeff n * (3 / 4 : ℝ) ^ n) :=
      Summable.of_nonneg_of_le hg0
        (fun n => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hb n).2.1 (by positivity)) hsum
    have hle := hgs.sum_le_tsum ({2, 3, 4} : Finset ℕ) (fun i _ => hg0 i)
    have hs3 : ∑ i ∈ ({2, 3, 4} : Finset ℕ), FordAnalysis.coeff i * (3 / 4 : ℝ) ^ i =
        FordAnalysis.coeff 2 * (9 / 16) + FordAnalysis.coeff 3 * (27 / 64) +
          FordAnalysis.coeff 4 * (81 / 256) := by
      rw [Finset.sum_insert (by norm_num), Finset.sum_insert (by norm_num),
        Finset.sum_singleton]
      ring
    have h2 := (hb 2).2.2
    have h3 := (hb 3).2.2
    have h4 := (hb 4).2.2
    push_cast at h2 h3 h4
    have hl3 : Real.log 2 ≤ Real.log 3 := Real.log_le_log (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
    have hl4 : Real.log 4 = 2 * Real.log 2 := by
      rw [show (4 : ℝ) = 2 ^ 2 by norm_num, Real.log_pow]
      norm_num
    have hl2 := Real.log_two_gt_d9

    linarith

    unfold FordAnalysis.F

      funext n

  have hivt := intermediate_value_Ioo (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 3 / 4) hcont
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hFr⟩ := hivt ⟨by rw [hF0]; norm_num, hgt⟩

by

    intro M t ht hadd' hM

ford_core_order_lower_bound.definitions:
noncomputable def coreLowerFraction (y : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  1 / Real.sqrt (Real.log (Real.log y))

noncomputable def FordReciprocal.tuplePoint {L : ℕ} (t : ℝ) (q : Fin L → ℕ) : Fin L → ℝ :=
  fun idx => max 0 (logLog (q idx)) / t

noncomputable def FordReciprocal.tupleIntegers (L : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (E : Set (Fin L → ℝ)) : Finset ℕ :=
  (Finset.Icc 1 (⌊Real.exp (Real.exp t)⌋₊ ^ L)).filter (fun n =>
    ∃ q : Fin L → ℕ, (∏ idx, q idx) = n ∧
      (∀ idx, (q idx).Prime ∨ q idx = 1) ∧ Antitone q ∧ FordReciprocal.tuplePoint t q ∈ E)

def FordGeometry.separatedCap {L : ℕ} (ξ : ℕ → ℝ) (p : Fin L) (α : ℝ) : Set (Fin L → ℝ) :=
  {x | x ∈ FordGeometry.polytope L ξ ∧
    (∀ idx j : Fin L, j.val = idx.val + 1 → x j ≤ ξ (idx.val + 1) * x idx) ∧ α ≤ x p}

noncomputable def FordInner.baseLoss (M d : ℕ) : ℝ := 1 / (10 * ((M + d : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 3)

noncomputable def FordInner.targetParameter (L M j : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  1 - (if j < L then FordInner.baseLoss M (L - j) else 0)

def FordInner.innerSeed {L : ℕ} (ξ : ℕ → ℝ) (p : Fin L) (α : ℝ) : Set (Fin L → ℝ) :=
  FordGeometry.separatedCap ξ p α ∩ {x | ∀ idx : Fin L, idx.val = 0 → x idx ≤ ξ 0}

noncomputable def FordLower.topLoss (t : ℝ) : ℝ := 1 / (10 * (FordScale.optimalDimension t : ℝ) ^ 3)

noncomputable def FordLower.lowerPrimeChoices (y : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : Finset ℕ :=
  (corePairs {n.totient} (coreLowerFraction y * y) y).image Prod.snd

noncomputable def FordLower.primeProducts (F : Finset ℕ) (y : ℝ) : Finset ℕ :=
  (F.sigma (FordLower.lowerPrimeChoices y)).image (fun np => np.2 * np.1)

structure FordLower.PrimeProductRecord (M : ℕ) (A y : ℝ)
    (p : Fin (FordScale.coreDimension M (logLog y))) (N : ℕ) where
  leading : ℕ
  lower : Fin (FordScale.coreDimension M (logLog y)) → ℕ
  terminal : p.val + 1 = FordScale.coreDimension M (logLog y)
  leading_prime : leading.Prime
  lower_prime : ∀ idx, (lower idx).Prime
  lower_order : StrictAnti lower
  point : FordReciprocal.tuplePoint (logLog y) lower ∈
    FordInner.innerSeed (FordInner.targetParameter (FordScale.coreDimension M (logLog y)) M) p
      (A / logLog y)
  integer : N = leading * (∏ idx, lower idx)
  leading_size : y ^ (19 / 20 : ℝ) < (leading : ℝ)
  lower_separated : ∀ idx, lower idx < leading
  lower_minimum : ∀ idx, Real.exp (Real.exp A) ≤ (lower idx : ℝ)
  lower_gaps : ∀ idx j, j.val = idx.val + 1 →
    (1 + FordInner.baseLoss M (FordScale.coreDimension M (logLog y) - (idx.val + 1))) *
      logLog (lower j) ≤ logLog (lower idx)
  leading_gap : ∀ idx, idx.val = 0 →
    (1 + FordLower.topLoss (logLog y)) * logLog (lower idx) ≤ logLog leading
  totient_range : coreLowerFraction y * y < (N.totient : ℝ) ∧ (N.totient : ℝ) ≤ y

noncomputable def FordLower.PrimeProductRecord.fullTuple {M : ℕ} {A y : ℝ}
    {p : Fin (FordScale.coreDimension M (logLog y))} {N : ℕ}
    (R : FordLower.PrimeProductRecord M A y p N) :
    Fin (FordScale.coreDimension M (logLog y) + 1) → ℕ :=
  Fin.cons R.leading R.lower

def FordLower.prefixProduct {k : ℕ} (p : Fin k → ℕ) (j : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  ∏ idx ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun idx : Fin k => idx.val < j), p idx

def FordLower.suffixProduct {k : ℕ} (p : Fin k → ℕ) (j : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  ∏ idx ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun idx : Fin k => j ≤ idx.val), p idx

def FordLower.PrefixAgreement {k : ℕ} (p : Fin k → ℕ) (j m : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∃ w : ℕ, 0 < w ∧ m = FordLower.prefixProduct p j * w ∧
    ∀ idx : Fin k, idx.val < j → largestPrimeFactor w < p idx

def FordLower.nontrivialPreimages (n : ℕ) : Set ℕ :=
  {m | 0 < m ∧ m.totient = n.totient ∧ ¬ n ∣ m}

noncomputable def FordLower.externalTotientCollisions (F : Finset ℕ) : Finset ℕ :=
  F.filter (fun n => (FordLower.nontrivialPreimages n).Nonempty)

noncomputable def FordLower.prefixDepths {k : ℕ} (p : Fin k → ℕ) (n : ℕ) : Finset ℕ :=
  (Finset.range (k + 1)).filter (fun j =>
    ∃ m ∈ FordLower.nontrivialPreimages n, FordLower.PrefixAgreement p j m)

noncomputable def FordLower.prefixDepth {k : ℕ} (p : Fin k → ℕ) (n : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  if h : (FordLower.prefixDepths p n).Nonempty then (FordLower.prefixDepths p n).max' h else 0

noncomputable def FordLower.prefixCollisionClass {k : ℕ} (F : Finset ℕ) (p : ℕ → Fin k → ℕ)
    (j : ℕ) : Finset ℕ :=
  (FordLower.externalTotientCollisions F).filter (fun n => FordLower.prefixDepth (p n) n = j)

noncomputable def FordLower.suffixCollisionFamily {k : ℕ} (F : Finset ℕ) (p : ℕ → Fin k → ℕ)
    (j : ℕ) : Finset ℕ :=
  (FordLower.prefixCollisionClass F p j).image (fun n => FordLower.suffixProduct (p n) j)

noncomputable def FordLower.suffixesUpTo {k : ℕ} (F : Finset ℕ) (q : ℕ → Fin k → ℕ)
    (j : ℕ) (Z : ℝ) : Finset ℕ :=
  (FordLower.suffixCollisionFamily F q j).filter (fun s => (s.totient : ℝ) ≤ Z)

noncomputable def FordAnalysis.g : ℕ → ℝ
  | 0 => 1
  | n + 1 => ∑ idx ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), FordAnalysis.coeff (idx + 1) * FordAnalysis.g (n - idx)
termination_by n => n
decreasing_by omega

noncomputable def FordAnalysis.gStar : ℕ → ℝ
  | 0 => 1
  | n + 1 => FordAnalysis.g (n + 1) + (1 - FordAnalysis.coeff 1) * FordAnalysis.g n

noncomputable def FordAnalysis.renewalDenominator (L : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  (∏ n ∈ Finset.range L, FordAnalysis.g n) * FordAnalysis.gStar L

noncomputable def FordGeometry.modelVolume (K : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  1 / ((K.factorial : ℝ) * FordAnalysis.renewalDenominator K)

noncomputable def FordGeometry.prefixDecay (M : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  4 * FordAnalysis.rho ^ M * Real.exp ((M : ℝ) / 9)

  leading : ℕ
  lower : Fin (FordScale.coreDimension M (logLog y)) → ℕ
  terminal : p.val + 1 = FordScale.coreDimension M (logLog y)
  leading_prime : leading.Prime
  lower_prime : ∀ idx, (lower idx).Prime
  lower_order : StrictAnti lower
  point : FordReciprocal.tuplePoint (logLog y) lower ∈
    FordInner.innerSeed (FordInner.targetParameter (FordScale.coreDimension M (logLog y)) M) p

noncomputable def FordLower.PrimeProductRecord.fullTuple {M : ℕ} {A y : ℝ}
    {p : Fin (FordScale.coreDimension M (logLog y))} {N : ℕ}

  Fin.cons R.leading R.lower

def FordLower.prefixProduct {k : ℕ} (p : Fin k → ℕ) (j : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  ∏ idx ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun idx : Fin k => idx.val < j), p idx

def FordLower.suffixProduct {k : ℕ} (p : Fin k → ℕ) (j : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  ∏ idx ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun idx : Fin k => j ≤ idx.val), p idx

def FordLower.PrefixAgreement {k : ℕ} (p : Fin k → ℕ) (j m : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∃ w : ℕ, 0 < w ∧ m = FordLower.prefixProduct p j * w ∧
    ∀ idx : Fin k, idx.val < j → largestPrimeFactor w < p idx

def FordLower.nontrivialPreimages (n : ℕ) : Set ℕ :=
  {m | 0 < m ∧ m.totient = n.totient ∧ ¬ n ∣ m}

noncomputable def FordLower.externalTotientCollisions (F : Finset ℕ) : Finset ℕ :=
  F.filter (fun n => (FordLower.nontrivialPreimages n).Nonempty)

noncomputable def FordLower.prefixDepths {k : ℕ} (p : Fin k → ℕ) (n : ℕ) : Finset ℕ :=
  (Finset.range (k + 1)).filter (fun j =>
    ∃ m ∈ FordLower.nontrivialPreimages n, FordLower.PrefixAgreement p j m)

noncomputable def FordLower.prefixDepth {k : ℕ} (p : Fin k → ℕ) (n : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  if h : (FordLower.prefixDepths p n).Nonempty then (FordLower.prefixDepths p n).max' h else 0

noncomputable def FordLower.prefixCollisionClass {k : ℕ} (F : Finset ℕ) (p : ℕ → Fin k → ℕ)
    (j : ℕ) : Finset ℕ :=
  (FordLower.externalTotientCollisions F).filter (fun n => FordLower.prefixDepth (p n) n = j)

noncomputable def FordLower.suffixCollisionFamily {k : ℕ} (F : Finset ℕ) (p : ℕ → Fin k → ℕ)
    (j : ℕ) : Finset ℕ :=
  (FordLower.prefixCollisionClass F p j).image (fun n => FordLower.suffixProduct (p n) j)

noncomputable def FordLower.suffixesUpTo {k : ℕ} (F : Finset ℕ) (q : ℕ → Fin k → ℕ)
    (j : ℕ) (Z : ℝ) : Finset ℕ :=
  (FordLower.suffixCollisionFamily F q j).filter (fun s => (s.totient : ℝ) ≤ Z)

noncomputable def FordAnalysis.g : ℕ → ℝ
  | 0 => 1
  | n + 1 => ∑ idx ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), FordAnalysis.coeff (idx + 1) * FordAnalysis.g (n - idx)
termination_by n => n
decreasing_by omega

noncomputable def FordAnalysis.gStar : ℕ → ℝ
  | 0 => 1
  | n + 1 => FordAnalysis.g (n + 1) + (1 - FordAnalysis.coeff 1) * FordAnalysis.g n

noncomputable def FordAnalysis.renewalDenominator (L : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  (∏ n ∈ Finset.range L, FordAnalysis.g n) * FordAnalysis.gStar L

noncomputable def FordGeometry.modelVolume (K : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  1 / ((K.factorial : ℝ) * FordAnalysis.renewalDenominator K)

noncomputable def FordGeometry.prefixDecay (M : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  4 * FordAnalysis.rho ^ M * Real.exp ((M : ℝ) / 9)

noncomputable def FordBadFacet.shiftedFacet (q : ℕ → ℝ) (j k : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ idx : Fin k, fordWeight (idx.val + 1) * q (j + idx.val + 1)


def FordBadFacet.RowHolds (L : ℕ) (ξ q : ℕ → ℝ) (j : ℕ) : Prop :=
  if j = 0 then FordBadFacet.shiftedFacet q 0 L ≤ ξ 0
  else FordBadFacet.shiftedFacet q j (L - j) ≤ ξ j * q j


def FordBadFacet.FirstFailedRow (L : ℕ) (ξ q : ℕ → ℝ) (j : ℕ) : Prop :=
  j + 1 < L ∧ ¬ FordBadFacet.RowHolds L ξ q j ∧ ∀ idx < j, FordBadFacet.RowHolds L ξ q idx


noncomputable def FordBadFacet.firstFailedFacetValues (x : ℝ) (L : ℕ) (ξ : ℕ → ℝ) (j : ℕ) :
    Finset ℕ :=
  (totientsUpTo x).filter (fun m => ∃ N : ℕ, 0 < N ∧ N.totient = m ∧
    FordBadFacet.FirstFailedRow L ξ (FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeCoordinate (logLog x) N) j)


noncomputable def FordBadFacet.retainedFirstFailedValues (x : ℝ) (A L j : ℕ) : Finset ℕ :=
  (FordBadFacet.firstFailedFacetValues x L (FordGeometry.expandedParameter A) j).filter (fun m =>
    Real.sqrt x ≤ (m : ℝ) ∧ m ∉ FordBadFacet.badFacetValues x 2 (1 / 1000) ∧
      m ∉ fiveLogOmegaTotients x ∧ m ∉ largeSquareTotients x)


noncomputable def FordBadFacet.retainedFirstFailedSuffixes (x : ℝ) (A L j : ℕ) : Finset ℕ :=
  (totientsUpTo x).filter (fun m => ∃ N : ℕ, 0 < N ∧
    N.totient ∈ FordBadFacet.retainedFirstFailedValues x A L j ∧
    FordBadFacet.FirstFailedRow L (FordGeometry.expandedParameter A)
      (FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeCoordinate (logLog x) N) j ∧
    (FordBadFacet.ordinarySuffix N j).totient = m)


def FordBadFacet.IsFirstFailedSuffixValue (T : ℝ) (A L j m : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∃ N : ℕ, 0 < N ∧ (FordBadFacet.ordinarySuffix N j).totient = m ∧
    FordBadFacet.FirstFailedRow L (FordGeometry.expandedParameter A)
      (FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeCoordinate T N) j

    have hδ : 0 < δ := by rw [hδdef]; positivity

      rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos hPpos]
      congr 1
      rw [hδdef]
      field_simp
    have he : Real.exp (1 / 2) < 7 / 4 := by
      have h1 : Real.exp (1 / 2) * Real.exp (1 / 2) = Real.exp 1 := by
        rw [← Real.exp_add]; norm_num
      have h2 := Real.exp_one_lt_d9
      have h3 := Real.exp_pos (1 / 2)

    have hw : ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → 0 ≤ w p ∧ w p ≤ 7 / 4 := by

      by_cases h : (p : ℝ) ≤ P

          _ ≤ 7 / 4 := he.le
      · simp only [w, if_neg h]
        norm_num
    set K₀ : ℝ := Real.exp ((∑ p ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊P⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, w p / p) + 36) with hK₀
    filter_upwards [(tendsto_rpow_atTop hδ).eventually_ge_atTop (K₀ / η),
      eventually_gt_atTop (0 : ℝ)] with R hRlarge hRpos
    intro x

    have hf : ∀ m ∈ W, 0 < f m ∧ (f m).totient = m ∧

      rw [Finset.sum_image hinj]

      intro m hm
      rw [(hf m hm).2.1]

    have hE := weighted_totient_euler_bound w hw P (W.image f) (by
      intro n hn
      obtain ⟨hpos, -, hp⟩ := hsmooth n hn
      exact ⟨hpos, fun p hp' => hp p (Nat.mem_primeFactors_iff_mem_primeFactorsList.mp hp')⟩)

    have hS0 : 0 ≤ ∑ m ∈ W, (1 : ℝ) / m :=
      Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => div_nonneg zero_le_one (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
    nlinarith

  obtain ⟨Cm, hCm, hpc⟩ := pc_tupleIntegers_reciprocal_mass_upper prime_reciprocal_log_error

    have hU' : U ≤ Cm * Pw * (K7 * T) :=

      _ ≤ C1 * X * (Cm * Pw * (K7 * T)) * (ε / 2 / (C1 * Cm * K7 / c)) :=
          mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hU' (by positivity)) hS hS0 (by positivity)

          field_simp
      _ ≤ ε / 2 * Vx := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hV (by positivity)
  filter_upwards [hA, eventually_gt_atTop (1 : ℝ), hLL.eventually hvolM, hFM,
    hLL.eventually_gt_atTop 0, hFIRST.bound (half_pos hε)] with x hAx hx1 hV7 hFx hT hex
  have hE : FordGeometry.polytope (FordScale.coreDimension M (logLog x))
      (FordGeometry.expandedParameter (FordScale.optimalDimension (logLog x))) ⊆

    fun u hu => ⟨hu.1, hu.2.1⟩

      have hxne : x ≠ 0 := hx.ne'
      generalize 1 / (2 * Real.pi) = c
      generalize Real.log (t / x) = L
      field_simp
      ring
    have hmono : MonotoneOn
        (fun t : ℝ => t * (1 + (1 / (2 * Real.pi) * Real.log (t / x)) ^ 2)) (Set.Ioi 0) := by
      refine monotoneOn_of_hasDerivWithinAt_nonneg (convex_Ioi 0)
        (f' := fun t => 1 + (1 / (2 * Real.pi) * Real.log (t / x)) ^ 2 +
          2 * (1 / (2 * Real.pi)) * (1 / (2 * Real.pi) * Real.log (t / x))) ?_ ?_ ?_
      · intro t ht
        exact (hderiv t ht).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
      · intro t ht
        rw [interior_Ioi] at ht
        exact (hderiv t ht).hasDerivWithinAt
      · intro t _
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (1 / (2 * Real.pi) * Real.log (t / x) + 1 / (2 * Real.pi))]
    have ht : 0 < t := lt_of_lt_of_le hs hst
    have hq := hmono (Set.mem_Ioi.mpr hs) (Set.mem_Ioi.mpr ht) hst
    simp only at hq
    have hqs : 0 < s * (1 + (1 / (2 * Real.pi) * Real.log (s / x)) ^ 2) := by positivity
    have e : ∀ t : ℝ, 1 / t * (1 + (1 / (2 * Real.pi) * Real.log (t / x)) ^ 2)⁻¹ =
        1 / (t * (1 + (1 / (2 * Real.pi) * Real.log (t / x)) ^ 2)) := by
      intro t
      simp only [one_div, mul_inv]
    rw [e t, e s]
    exact one_div_le_one_div_of_le hqs hq
  
  have s2 : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t →
      HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => 2 * Real.pi * Real.arctan (1 / (2 * Real.pi) * Real.log (t / x)))
        (1 / t * (1 + (1 / (2 * Real.pi) * Real.log (t / x)) ^ 2)⁻¹) t := by
    intro x hx t ht
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => t / x) (1 / x) t := (hasDerivAt_id' t).div_const x
    have h2 := h1.log (div_ne_zero ht.ne' hx.ne')
    have h3 := ((h2.const_mul (1 / (2 * Real.pi))).arctan).const_mul (2 * Real.pi)
    convert h3 using 1
    have hpi : Real.pi ≠ 0 := Real.pi_ne_zero
    have hpos : 0 < 1 + (1 / (2 * Real.pi) * Real.log (t / x)) ^ 2 := by positivity
    field_simp
  
  have s3 : ∀ (g G : ℝ → ℝ), (∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → HasDerivAt G (g t) t) →
      (∀ s t : ℝ, 0 < s → s ≤ t → g t ≤ g s) →
      ∀ M : ℕ, 1 ≤ M → ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 2 M, g (n : ℝ) ≤ G (M : ℝ) - G 1 := by
    intro g G hG hanti M hM
    induction M, hM using Nat.le_induction with
    | base => simp
    | succ M hM ih =>
      rw [Finset.sum_Icc_succ_top (by omega : 2 ≤ M + 1)]
      have hM1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ M := by exact_mod_cast hM
      obtain ⟨c, hc, hgc⟩ := exists_hasDerivAt_eq_slope G g
        (a := (M : ℝ)) (b := (M : ℝ) + 1) (by linarith)
        (fun t ht => (hG t (by linarith [ht.1])).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt)
        (fun t ht => hG t (by linarith [ht.1]))
      have h1 : g ((M : ℝ) + 1) ≤ g c := hanti c _ (by linarith [hc.1]) hc.2.le
      have e : ((M : ℝ) + 1 - M) = 1 := by ring
      rw [hgc, e, div_one] at h1
      push_cast
      linarith
  
  have s4 : ∀ (a g : ℕ → ℝ) (C : ℝ), (∀ n, 0 ≤ a n) →
      (∀ N : ℕ, ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, a n ≤ C * N) →
      (∀ n, 1 ≤ n → 0 ≤ g n) → (∀ n, 1 ≤ n → g (n + 1) ≤ g n) →
      ∀ M : ℕ, ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 M, a n * g n ≤ C * (g 1 + ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 M, g n) := by
    intro a g C ha hS hg hanti
    have hC : 0 ≤ C := by
      have := hS 1
      simp at this
      linarith [ha 0]
    have hD : ∀ M : ℕ, 0 ≤ C * ((M : ℝ) + 1) - ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (M + 1), a n := by
      intro M
      have := hS (M + 1)
      push_cast at this
      linarith
    have P : ∀ M : ℕ, 1 ≤ M → ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 M, a n * g n +
        (C * ((M : ℝ) + 1) - ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (M + 1), a n) * g M ≤
        C * (g 1 + ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 M, g n) := by
      intro M hM
      induction M, hM using Nat.le_induction with
      | base =>
        simp [Finset.sum_range_succ]
        nlinarith [mul_nonneg (ha 0) (hg 1 le_rfl)]
      | succ M hM ih =>
        rw [Finset.sum_Icc_succ_top (by omega : 1 ≤ M + 1),
          Finset.sum_Icc_succ_top (by omega : 1 ≤ M + 1),
          Finset.sum_range_succ _ (M + 1)]
        have hE : 0 ≤ g M - g (M + 1) := by linarith [hanti M hM]
        have := mul_nonneg (hD M) hE
        push_cast
        nlinarith
    intro M
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos M with h | h
    · subst h
      simp
      exact mul_nonneg hC (hg 1 le_rfl)
    · have h1 := P M h
      have := mul_nonneg (hD M) (hg M h)
      linarith
  
  have reindex : ∀ (w : ℕ → ℝ), w 0 = 0 →
      ∀ M : ℕ, ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (M + 1), w n = ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 M, w n := by
    intro w hw M
    induction M with
    | zero => simp [hw]
    | succ M ih =>
      rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, ih, Finset.sum_Icc_succ_top (by omega : 1 ≤ M + 1)]
  have split1 : ∀ (g : ℕ → ℝ) (M : ℕ), 1 ≤ M →
      ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 M, g n = g 1 + ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 2 M, g n := by
    intro g M hM
    induction M, hM using Nat.le_induction with
    | base => simp
    | succ M hM ih =>
      rw [Finset.sum_Icc_succ_top (by omega : 1 ≤ M + 1),
        Finset.sum_Icc_succ_top (by omega : 2 ≤ M + 1), ih]
      ring
  
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hcheby
  have hC0 : 0 ≤ C := by
    have := hC 1
    simp at this
    linarith [abs_nonneg (f 0)]
  refine ⟨C * (2 + 2 * Real.pi ^ 2), fun x hx => ?_⟩
  have hx0 : 0 < x := by linarith
  have hw0 : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 ≤ |f n| / (n : ℝ) *
      (1 + (1 / (2 * Real.pi) * Real.log ((n : ℝ) / x)) ^ 2)⁻¹ := fun n => by positivity
  have hsum_g : ∀ M : ℕ, 1 ≤ M → ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 2 M,
      1 / (n : ℝ) * (1 + (1 / (2 * Real.pi) * Real.log ((n : ℝ) / x)) ^ 2)⁻¹ ≤
        2 * Real.pi ^ 2 := by
    intro M hM
    have h3 := s3 (fun t : ℝ => 1 / t * (1 + (1 / (2 * Real.pi) * Real.log (t / x)) ^ 2)⁻¹)
      (fun t : ℝ => 2 * Real.pi * Real.arctan (1 / (2 * Real.pi) * Real.log (t / x)))
      (fun t ht => s2 x hx0 t ht) (fun s t hs hst => s1 x hx0 s t hs hst) M hM
    simp only at h3
    have ha := Real.arctan_lt_pi_div_two (1 / (2 * Real.pi) * Real.log ((M : ℝ) / x))
    have hb := Real.neg_pi_div_two_lt_arctan (1 / (2 * Real.pi) * Real.log (1 / x))
    nlinarith [Real.pi_pos]
  have hg1 : 1 / ((1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (1 + (1 / (2 * Real.pi) * Real.log (((1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / x)) ^ 2)⁻¹
      ≤ 1 := by
    rw [Nat.cast_one, div_one, one_mul]
    exact inv_le_one_of_one_le₀ (le_add_of_nonneg_right (sq_nonneg _))
  have hsum_g1 : ∀ M : ℕ, ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 M,
      1 / (n : ℝ) * (1 + (1 / (2 * Real.pi) * Real.log ((n : ℝ) / x)) ^ 2)⁻¹ ≤
        1 + 2 * Real.pi ^ 2 := by
    intro M
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos M with h | h
    · subst h
      simp
      positivity
    · rw [split1 (fun n : ℕ => 1 / (n : ℝ) *
        (1 + (1 / (2 * Real.pi) * Real.log ((n : ℝ) / x)) ^ 2)⁻¹) M h]
      linarith [hsum_g M h, hg1]
  have hpart : ∀ N : ℕ, ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, |f n| / (n : ℝ) *
      (1 + (1 / (2 * Real.pi) * Real.log ((n : ℝ) / x)) ^ 2)⁻¹ ≤ C * (2 + 2 * Real.pi ^ 2) := by
    intro N
    rcases N with _ | M
    · simp
      positivity
    · rw [reindex _ (by simp) M]
      have h4 := s4 (fun n => |f n|)
        (fun n : ℕ => 1 / (n : ℝ) * (1 + (1 / (2 * Real.pi) * Real.log ((n : ℝ) / x)) ^ 2)⁻¹) C
        (fun n => abs_nonneg _) hC (fun n _ => by positivity)
        (fun n hn => by
          have hn' : (0 : ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hn
          have := s1 x hx0 n (n + 1) hn' (by linarith)
          push_cast
          exact this) M
      have heq : ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 M, |f n| / (n : ℝ) *
          (1 + (1 / (2 * Real.pi) * Real.log ((n : ℝ) / x)) ^ 2)⁻¹ =
          ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 M, |f n| * (1 / (n : ℝ) *
            (1 + (1 / (2 * Real.pi) * Real.log ((n : ℝ) / x)) ^ 2)⁻¹) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro n _
        ring
      rw [heq]
      refine h4.trans ?_
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ hC0
      linarith [hsum_g1 M, hg1]
  exact ⟨summable_of_sum_range_le hw0 hpart, Real.tsum_le_of_sum_range_le hw0 hpart⟩

informal_problem.statement:
(f : ℕ → ℝ) (A : ℝ) (G : ℂ → ℂ)
    (hf : ∀ σ : ℝ, 1 < σ → LSeriesSummable (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) σ)
    (hG' : Set.EqOn G (fun s => LSeries (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) s - (A : ℂ) / (s - 1)) {s | 1 < s.re})
    (ψ : ℝ → ℂ) (hψc : Continuous ψ) (hψi : MeasureTheory.Integrable ψ)
    (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) (σ : ℝ) (hσ : 1 < σ) :
    (∑' n : ℕ, (f n : ℂ) / (n : ℂ) ^ (σ : ℂ) *
        FourierTransform.fourier ψ (1 / (2 * Real.pi) * Real.log ((n : ℝ) / x))) -
      (A : ℂ) * ((x ^ (1 - σ) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
        ∫ u in Set.Ici (-Real.log x), ((Real.exp (-u * (σ - 1)) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
          FourierTransform.fourier ψ (u / (2 * Real.pi)) =
      ∫ t : ℝ, G ((σ : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I) * ψ t * (x : ℂ) ^ ((t : ℂ) * Complex.I)

proof.tactics:
by
  have hx0 : (x : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hx.ne'
  have hfσ := hf σ hσ
  have hσ0 : (σ : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (show σ ≠ 0 by linarith)
  
  have he : ∀ t : ℝ, ‖(x : ℂ) ^ ((t : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ = 1 := by
    intro t
    rw [Complex.norm_cpow_eq_rpow_re_of_pos hx]
    simp
  have hecont : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => (x : ℂ) ^ ((t : ℂ) * Complex.I)) :=
    Continuous.const_cpow (by fun_prop) (Or.inl hx0)
  have hterm_norm : ∀ (t : ℝ) (n : ℕ),
      ‖LSeries.term (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) ((σ : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I) n‖ =
        ‖LSeries.term (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) (σ : ℂ) n‖ := by
    intro t n
    rw [LSeries.norm_term_eq, LSeries.norm_term_eq]
    simp
  have hsum_norm : Summable (fun n => ‖LSeries.term (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) (σ : ℂ) n‖) :=
    hfσ.norm
  have hterm_cont : ∀ n : ℕ, Continuous (fun t : ℝ =>
      LSeries.term (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) ((σ : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I) n) := by
    intro n
    rcases eq_or_ne n 0 with rfl | hn
    · simp only [LSeries.term_zero]
      exact continuous_const
    · have hn' : (n : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hn
      simp only [LSeries.term_of_ne_zero hn]
      refine continuous_const.div (Continuous.const_cpow (by fun_prop) (Or.inl hn')) (fun t => ?_)
      rw [Complex.cpow_def_of_ne_zero hn']
      exact Complex.exp_ne_zero _
  
  have hL_cont : Continuous (fun t : ℝ =>
      LSeries (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) ((σ : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I)) :=
    continuous_tsum hterm_cont hsum_norm (fun n t => (hterm_norm t n).le)
  have hL_bd : ∀ t : ℝ, ‖LSeries (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) ((σ : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ ≤
      ∑' n, ‖LSeries.term (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) (σ : ℂ) n‖ := by
    intro t
    have hfun : (fun n => ‖LSeries.term (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) ((σ : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I) n‖) =
        fun n => ‖LSeries.term (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) (σ : ℂ) n‖ := funext (hterm_norm t)
    have hs : Summable (fun n =>
        ‖LSeries.term (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) ((σ : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I) n‖) := by
      rw [hfun]; exact hsum_norm
    calc ‖LSeries (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) ((σ : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖
        ≤ ∑' n, ‖LSeries.term (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) ((σ : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I) n‖ :=
          norm_tsum_le_tsum_norm hs
      _ = ∑' n, ‖LSeries.term (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) (σ : ℂ) n‖ := by rw [hfun]
  have h3 : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun t : ℝ =>
      LSeries (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) ((σ : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I) * ψ t *
        (x : ℂ) ^ ((t : ℂ) * Complex.I)) := by
    refine MeasureTheory.Integrable.mono'
      (hψi.norm.const_mul (∑' n, ‖LSeries.term (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) (σ : ℂ) n‖))
      ((hL_cont.mul hψc).mul hecont).aestronglyMeasurable
      (MeasureTheory.ae_of_all _ fun t => ?_)
    rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, he, mul_one]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hL_bd t) (norm_nonneg _)
  
  have hd_ne : ∀ t : ℝ, (σ : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I - 1 ≠ 0 := by
    intro t h
    have := congrArg Complex.re h
    simp at this
    linarith
  have hd_norm : ∀ t : ℝ, σ - 1 ≤ ‖(σ : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I - 1‖ := by
    intro t
    have := Complex.re_le_norm ((σ : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I - 1)
    simpa using this
  have h4 : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun t : ℝ =>
      ψ t * (x : ℂ) ^ ((t : ℂ) * Complex.I) / ((σ : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I - 1)) := by
    refine MeasureTheory.Integrable.mono' (hψi.norm.const_mul (σ - 1)⁻¹) ?_
      (MeasureTheory.ae_of_all _ fun t => ?_)
    · exact ((hψc.mul hecont).div (by fun_prop) hd_ne).aestronglyMeasurable
    · rw [norm_div, norm_mul, he, mul_one, div_eq_inv_mul]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (inv_anti₀ (by linarith) (hd_norm t)) (norm_nonneg _)
  
  have h1 : (∑' n : ℕ, (f n : ℂ) / (n : ℂ) ^ (σ : ℂ) *
        FourierTransform.fourier ψ (1 / (2 * Real.pi) * Real.log ((n : ℝ) / x))) =
      ∫ t : ℝ, LSeries (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) ((σ : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I) * ψ t *
        (x : ℂ) ^ ((t : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
    have hFi : ∀ n : ℕ, MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun t : ℝ =>
        LSeries.term (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) ((σ : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I) n * ψ t *
          (x : ℂ) ^ ((t : ℂ) * Complex.I)) := by
      intro n
      refine MeasureTheory.Integrable.mono'
        (hψi.norm.const_mul ‖LSeries.term (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) (σ : ℂ) n‖)
        (((hterm_cont n).mul hψc).mul hecont).aestronglyMeasurable
        (MeasureTheory.ae_of_all _ fun t => ?_)
      rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, he, mul_one, hterm_norm]
    have hFs : Summable (fun n : ℕ => ∫ t : ℝ,
        ‖LSeries.term (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) ((σ : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I) n * ψ t *
          (x : ℂ) ^ ((t : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖) := by
      have hfun : (fun n : ℕ => ∫ t : ℝ,
          ‖LSeries.term (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) ((σ : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I) n * ψ t *
            (x : ℂ) ^ ((t : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖) =
          fun n => ‖LSeries.term (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) (σ : ℂ) n‖ * ∫ t : ℝ, ‖ψ t‖ := by
        funext n
        rw [← MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul]
        congr 1
        funext t
        rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, he, mul_one, hterm_norm]
      rw [hfun]
      exact hsum_norm.mul_right _
    have hswap := MeasureTheory.integral_tsum_of_summable_integral_norm hFi hFs
    have hinner : ∀ t : ℝ, (∑' n : ℕ,
        LSeries.term (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) ((σ : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I) n * ψ t *
          (x : ℂ) ^ ((t : ℂ) * Complex.I)) =
        LSeries (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) ((σ : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I) * ψ t *
          (x : ℂ) ^ ((t : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
      intro t
      rw [tsum_mul_right, tsum_mul_right]
      rfl
    have hsummand : ∀ n : ℕ, (f n : ℂ) / (n : ℂ) ^ (σ : ℂ) *
        FourierTransform.fourier ψ (1 / (2 * Real.pi) * Real.log ((n : ℝ) / x)) =
        ∫ t : ℝ, LSeries.term (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) ((σ : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I) n * ψ t *
          (x : ℂ) ^ ((t : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
      intro n
      rcases eq_or_ne n 0 with rfl | hn
      · simp [LSeries.term_zero, Complex.zero_cpow hσ0]
      · have hn' : (n : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hn
        have hnr : (n : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hn
        rw [Real.fourier_real_eq_integral_exp_smul, ← MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul]
        congr 1
        funext t
        have hk : -2 * Real.pi * t * (1 / (2 * Real.pi) * Real.log ((n : ℝ) / x)) =
            -(t * Real.log n) + t * Real.log x := by
          rw [Real.log_div hnr hx.ne']
          field_simp
          ring
        have hlogn : Complex.log (n : ℂ) = ((Real.log n : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
          rw [Complex.ofReal_log (Nat.cast_nonneg n)]
          simp
        have hexp : Complex.exp (((-2 * Real.pi * t *
            (1 / (2 * Real.pi) * Real.log ((n : ℝ) / x)) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) =
            (Complex.exp (((Real.log n : ℝ) : ℂ) * ((t : ℂ) * Complex.I)))⁻¹ *
              Complex.exp (((Real.log x : ℝ) : ℂ) * ((t : ℂ) * Complex.I)) := by
          rw [← Complex.exp_neg, ← Complex.exp_add, hk]
          congr 1
          push_cast
          ring
        rw [smul_eq_mul, hexp, LSeries.term_of_ne_zero hn, Complex.cpow_add _ _ hn',
          Complex.cpow_def_of_ne_zero hn' ((t : ℂ) * Complex.I), hlogn,
          Complex.cpow_def_of_ne_zero hx0, ← Complex.ofReal_log hx.le]
        ring
    calc (∑' n : ℕ, (f n : ℂ) / (n : ℂ) ^ (σ : ℂ) *
          FourierTransform.fourier ψ (1 / (2 * Real.pi) * Real.log ((n : ℝ) / x)))
        = ∑' n : ℕ, ∫ t : ℝ,
            LSeries.term (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) ((σ : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I) n * ψ t *
              (x : ℂ) ^ ((t : ℂ) * Complex.I) := tsum_congr hsummand
      _ = ∫ t : ℝ, ∑' n : ℕ,
            LSeries.term (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) ((σ : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I) n * ψ t *
              (x : ℂ) ^ ((t : ℂ) * Complex.I) := hswap
      _ = _ := by
          congr 1
          funext t
          exact hinner t
  
  have h2 : ((x ^ (1 - σ) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
        ∫ u in Set.Ici (-Real.log x), ((Real.exp (-u * (σ - 1)) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
          FourierTransform.fourier ψ (u / (2 * Real.pi)) =
      ∫ t : ℝ, ψ t * (x : ℂ) ^ ((t : ℂ) * Complex.I) /
        ((σ : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I - 1) := by
    have hc : 0 < σ - 1 := by linarith
    have hunfold : ∀ u : ℝ, ((Real.exp (-u * (σ - 1)) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
        FourierTransform.fourier ψ (u / (2 * Real.pi)) =
        ∫ t : ℝ, ((Real.exp (-u * (σ - 1)) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
          (Complex.exp (((-2 * Real.pi * t * (u / (2 * Real.pi))) : ℝ) * Complex.I) * ψ t) := by
      intro u
      rw [Real.fourier_real_eq_integral_exp_smul, ← MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul]
      rfl
    have hexpint : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun u : ℝ => Real.exp (-u * (σ - 1)))
        (Set.Ici (-Real.log x)) := by
      have := exp_neg_integrableOn_Ioi (-Real.log x) hc
      rw [integrableOn_Ici_iff_integrableOn_Ioi]
      refine this.congr_fun (fun u _ => ?_) measurableSet_Ioi
      ring_nf
    have hKint : MeasureTheory.Integrable (Function.uncurry fun (u t : ℝ) =>
        ((Real.exp (-u * (σ - 1)) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
          (Complex.exp (((-2 * Real.pi * t * (u / (2 * Real.pi))) : ℝ) * Complex.I) * ψ t))
        ((MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.Ici (-Real.log x))).prod MeasureTheory.volume) := by
      have hprod : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun z : ℝ × ℝ =>
          Real.exp (-z.1 * (σ - 1)) * ‖ψ z.2‖)
          ((MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.Ici (-Real.log x))).prod MeasureTheory.volume) :=
        hexpint.mul_prod hψi.norm
      refine hprod.mono' ?_ (MeasureTheory.ae_of_all _ fun z => ?_)
      · have hcont : Continuous (fun z : ℝ × ℝ =>
            ((Real.exp (-z.1 * (σ - 1)) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
              (Complex.exp (((-2 * Real.pi * z.2 * (z.1 / (2 * Real.pi))) : ℝ) * Complex.I) *
                ψ z.2)) := by fun_prop
        exact hcont.aestronglyMeasurable
      · simp only [Function.uncurry]
        rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, one_mul,
          Real.norm_of_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le]
    rw [MeasureTheory.integral_congr_ae (MeasureTheory.ae_of_all _ hunfold),
      MeasureTheory.integral_integral_swap hKint, ← MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul]
    congr 1
    funext t
    have hb : ((1 : ℂ) - σ - (t : ℂ) * Complex.I).re < 0 := by
      simp
      linarith
    have hb_ne : ((1 : ℂ) - σ - (t : ℂ) * Complex.I) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      rw [h] at hb
      simp at hb
    have hK : ∀ u : ℝ, ((Real.exp (-u * (σ - 1)) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
        (Complex.exp (((-2 * Real.pi * t * (u / (2 * Real.pi))) : ℝ) * Complex.I) * ψ t) =
        ψ t * Complex.exp (((1 : ℂ) - σ - (t : ℂ) * Complex.I) * u) := by
      intro u
      rw [Complex.ofReal_exp, mul_left_comm, ← mul_assoc, ← Complex.exp_add, mul_comm]
      congr 2
      have hpi : (Real.pi : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Real.pi_ne_zero
      push_cast
      field_simp
      ring
    rw [MeasureTheory.integral_congr_ae (MeasureTheory.ae_of_all _ hK),
      MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul, MeasureTheory.integral_Ici_eq_integral_Ioi,
      integral_exp_mul_complex_Ioi hb]
    have hxr : ((x ^ (1 - σ) : ℝ) : ℂ) =
        Complex.exp (((Real.log x : ℝ) : ℂ) * ((1 - σ : ℝ) : ℂ)) := by
      rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos hx, Complex.ofReal_exp]
      push_cast
      ring_nf
    have hexpb : Complex.exp (((1 : ℂ) - σ - (t : ℂ) * Complex.I) * ((-Real.log x : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
        Complex.exp (((Real.log x : ℝ) : ℂ) * ((t : ℂ) * Complex.I)) *
          (Complex.exp (((Real.log x : ℝ) : ℂ) * ((1 - σ : ℝ) : ℂ)))⁻¹ := by
      rw [← Complex.exp_neg, ← Complex.exp_add]
      congr 1
      push_cast
      ring
    have hd : (σ : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I - 1 = -((1 : ℂ) - σ - (t : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by ring
    rw [hxr, hexpb, hd, Complex.cpow_def_of_ne_zero hx0, ← Complex.ofReal_log hx.le]
    field_simp
  
  rw [h1, mul_assoc, h2, ← MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul,
    ← MeasureTheory.integral_sub h3 (h4.const_mul (A : ℂ))]
  congr 1
  funext t
  have hmem : (σ : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I ∈ {s : ℂ | 1 < s.re} := by
    simp [hσ]
  rw [hG' hmem]
  ring

signature.statement:
(g : SchwartzMap ℝ ℂ) :
    (ContDiff ℝ 2 (g : ℝ → ℂ) ∧ MeasureTheory.Integrable (g : ℝ → ℂ) ∧
      MeasureTheory.Integrable (deriv (g : ℝ → ℂ)) ∧
      MeasureTheory.Integrable (iteratedDeriv 2 (g : ℝ → ℂ))) ∧

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have h1 : deriv (g : ℝ → ℂ) = ⇑(SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℂ g) :=
    funext fun x => (SchwartzMap.derivCLM_apply ℝ g x).symm
  have h2 : iteratedDeriv 2 (g : ℝ → ℂ) =
      ⇑(SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℂ (SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℂ g)) := by
    rw [iteratedDeriv_succ, iteratedDeriv_one, h1]
    exact funext fun x => (SchwartzMap.derivCLM_apply ℝ _ x).symm
  have hgc : ContDiff ℝ 2 (g : ℝ → ℂ) := g.smooth 2
  have hgi : MeasureTheory.Integrable (g : ℝ → ℂ) := g.integrable
  have hgd : MeasureTheory.Integrable (deriv (g : ℝ → ℂ)) := by
    rw [h1]; exact SchwartzMap.integrable _
  have hgdd : MeasureTheory.Integrable (iteratedDeriv 2 (g : ℝ → ℂ)) := by
    rw [h2]; exact SchwartzMap.integrable _
  refine ⟨⟨hgc, hgi, hgd, hgdd⟩, ?_⟩
  
  have s2_cut : ∃ (χ : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (M : ℝ), ∀ n : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ 2 (χ n) ∧
      HasCompactSupport (χ n) ∧
      (∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ χ n t ∧ χ n t ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ t : ℝ, |t| ≤ (n : ℝ) + 1 → χ n t = 1) ∧
      (∀ t : ℝ, ‖deriv (χ n) t‖ ≤ M) ∧ (∀ t : ℝ, ‖iteratedDeriv 2 (χ n) t‖ ≤ M) := by
    let bump : ContDiffBump (0 : ℝ) := ⟨1, 2, one_pos, one_lt_two⟩
    have hφinf : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (bump : ℝ → ℝ) := bump.contDiff
    have hφ1 : ContDiff ℝ ((1 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) (bump : ℝ → ℝ) := contDiff_infty.mp hφinf 1
    have hφ2 : ContDiff ℝ ((2 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) (bump : ℝ → ℝ) := contDiff_infty.mp hφinf 2
    obtain ⟨M1, hM1⟩ := (bump.hasCompactSupport.deriv).exists_bound_of_continuous
      (hφ2.continuous_deriv (by norm_num))
    have hd2s : HasCompactSupport (iteratedDeriv 2 (bump : ℝ → ℝ)) := by
      rw [iteratedDeriv_succ, iteratedDeriv_one]
      exact bump.hasCompactSupport.deriv.deriv
    obtain ⟨M2, hM2⟩ :=
      hd2s.exists_bound_of_continuous (hφ2.continuous_iteratedDeriv 2 le_rfl)
    refine ⟨fun n t => bump (((n : ℝ) + 1)⁻¹ * t), max M1 M2, fun n => ?_⟩
    have hc0 : 0 < ((n : ℝ) + 1)⁻¹ := by positivity
    have hc1 : ((n : ℝ) + 1)⁻¹ ≤ 1 :=
      inv_le_one_of_one_le₀ (by have := (Nat.cast_nonneg n : (0 : ℝ) ≤ n); linarith)
    refine ⟨hφ2.comp (contDiff_const.mul contDiff_id), ?_,
      fun t => ⟨bump.nonneg, bump.le_one⟩, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have := bump.hasCompactSupport.comp_smul hc0.ne'
      simpa only [smul_eq_mul] using this
    · intro t ht
      apply bump.one_of_mem_closedBall
      rw [mem_closedBall_zero_iff, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hc0]
      have hpos : (0 : ℝ) < (n : ℝ) + 1 := by positivity
      calc ((n : ℝ) + 1)⁻¹ * |t| ≤ ((n : ℝ) + 1)⁻¹ * ((n : ℝ) + 1) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ht hc0.le
        _ = 1 := inv_mul_cancel₀ hpos.ne'
    · intro t
      have e := iteratedDeriv_comp_const_mul hφ1 ((n : ℝ) + 1)⁻¹
      rw [iteratedDeriv_one, iteratedDeriv_one] at e
      rw [congrFun e t, norm_mul, norm_pow, Real.norm_of_nonneg hc0.le]
      calc ((n : ℝ) + 1)⁻¹ ^ 1 * ‖deriv (bump : ℝ → ℝ) (((n : ℝ) + 1)⁻¹ * t)‖
            ≤ 1 * max M1 M2 :=
            mul_le_mul (pow_le_one₀ hc0.le hc1) ((hM1 _).trans (le_max_left _ _))
              (norm_nonneg _) zero_le_one
        _ = max M1 M2 := one_mul _
    · intro t
      have e := iteratedDeriv_comp_const_mul hφ2 ((n : ℝ) + 1)⁻¹
      rw [congrFun e t, norm_mul, norm_pow, Real.norm_of_nonneg hc0.le]
      calc ((n : ℝ) + 1)⁻¹ ^ 2 * ‖iteratedDeriv 2 (bump : ℝ → ℝ) (((n : ℝ) + 1)⁻¹ * t)‖
            ≤ 1 * max M1 M2 :=
            mul_le_mul (pow_le_one₀ hc0.le hc1) ((hM2 _).trans (le_max_right _ _))
              (norm_nonneg _) zero_le_one
        _ = max M1 M2 := one_mul _
  
  have s3_bounds : ∀ (h : ℝ → ℂ), ContDiff ℝ 2 h → MeasureTheory.Integrable h →
      MeasureTheory.Integrable (deriv h) → MeasureTheory.Integrable (iteratedDeriv 2 h) →
      ∀ (χ : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (M : ℝ), (∀ n : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ 2 (χ n) ∧ HasCompactSupport (χ n) ∧
        (∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ χ n t ∧ χ n t ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ t : ℝ, |t| ≤ (n : ℝ) + 1 → χ n t = 1) ∧
        (∀ t : ℝ, ‖deriv (χ n) t‖ ≤ M) ∧ (∀ t : ℝ, ‖iteratedDeriv 2 (χ n) t‖ ≤ M)) →
      ∃ B : ℝ → ℝ, MeasureTheory.Integrable B ∧
        (∀ n t, ‖h t - χ n t • h t‖ ≤ B t) ∧
        (∀ n t, ‖iteratedDeriv 2 h t - iteratedDeriv 2 (fun s => χ n s • h s) t‖ ≤ B t) ∧
        (∀ t : ℝ, ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, (fun s => χ n s • h s) =ᶠ[𝓝 t] h) := by
    intro h hgc hgi hgd hgdd χ M hχ
    have hM0 : 0 ≤ M := (norm_nonneg _).trans ((hχ 0).2.2.2.2.1 0)
    refine ⟨fun t => ‖h t‖ + 2 * ‖iteratedDeriv 2 h t‖ + 2 * M * ‖deriv h t‖ + M * ‖h t‖,
      ((hgi.norm.add (hgdd.norm.const_mul 2)).add (hgd.norm.const_mul (2 * M))).add
        (hgi.norm.const_mul M), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro n t
      have h01 := (hχ n).2.2.1 t
      have e : h t - χ n t • h t = (1 - χ n t) • h t := by rw [sub_smul, one_smul]
      rw [e, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (by linarith [h01.2])]
      have : (1 - χ n t) * ‖h t‖ ≤ ‖h t‖ :=
        mul_le_of_le_one_left (norm_nonneg _) (by linarith [h01.1])
      have p1 := norm_nonneg (iteratedDeriv 2 h t)
      have p2 := mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg zero_le_two hM0) (norm_nonneg (deriv h t))
      have p3 := mul_nonneg hM0 (norm_nonneg (h t))
      linarith
    · intro n t
      have hL := norm_iteratedFDeriv_smul_le (hχ n).1 hgc t (n := 2) le_rfl
      simp only [norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv, Finset.sum_range_succ,
        Finset.sum_range_zero] at hL
      norm_num at hL
      have h01 := (hχ n).2.2.1 t
      have hχn : |χ n t| ≤ 1 := by rw [abs_of_nonneg h01.1]; exact h01.2
      have hd1 : |deriv (χ n) t| ≤ M := by
        rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact (hχ n).2.2.2.2.1 t
      have hd2 : |iteratedDeriv 2 (χ n) t| ≤ M := by
        rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact (hχ n).2.2.2.2.2 t
      have a1 : |χ n t| * ‖iteratedDeriv 2 h t‖ ≤ ‖iteratedDeriv 2 h t‖ :=
        mul_le_of_le_one_left (norm_nonneg _) hχn
      have a2 : |deriv (χ n) t| * ‖deriv h t‖ ≤ M * ‖deriv h t‖ :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hd1 (norm_nonneg _)
      have a3 : |iteratedDeriv 2 (χ n) t| * ‖h t‖ ≤ M * ‖h t‖ :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hd2 (norm_nonneg _)
      have e : (fun s => χ n s • h s) = fun y => ((χ n y : ℝ) : ℂ) * h y :=
        funext fun y => Complex.real_smul
      have htri :=
        norm_sub_le (iteratedDeriv 2 h t) (iteratedDeriv 2 (fun s => χ n s • h s) t)
      rw [e] at htri
      have p0 := norm_nonneg (h t)
      show _ ≤ ‖h t‖ + 2 * ‖iteratedDeriv 2 h t‖ + 2 * M * ‖deriv h t‖ + M * ‖h t‖
      rw [e]
      linarith
    · intro t
      filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop ⌈|t|⌉₊] with n hn
      have hN : (⌈|t|⌉₊ : ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast hn
      have hc' := Nat.le_ceil |t|
      filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhds (show -(|t| + 1) < t by linarith [neg_abs_le t])
        (show t < |t| + 1 by linarith [le_abs_self t])] with s hs
      have hs' : |s| ≤ (n : ℝ) + 1 := abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith [hs.1], by linarith [hs.2]⟩
      show χ n s • h s = h s
      rw [(hχ n).2.2.2.1 s hs', one_smul]
  
  have s4_dct : ∀ (h : ℝ → ℂ), ContDiff ℝ 2 h → ∀ (ψ : ℕ → ℝ → ℂ),
      (∀ n, ContDiff ℝ 2 (ψ n)) → (∀ n, HasCompactSupport (ψ n)) →
      (∀ t : ℝ, ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, ψ n =ᶠ[𝓝 t] h) →
      ∀ (B : ℝ → ℝ), MeasureTheory.Integrable B →
      (∀ n t, ‖h t - ψ n t‖ ≤ B t) →
      (∀ n t, ‖iteratedDeriv 2 h t - iteratedDeriv 2 (ψ n) t‖ ≤ B t) →
      ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ w : ℝ → ℂ, ContDiff ℝ 2 w ∧ HasCompactSupport w ∧
        MeasureTheory.Integrable w ∧ MeasureTheory.Integrable (deriv w) ∧
        MeasureTheory.Integrable (iteratedDeriv 2 w) ∧
        (∫ t, ‖h t - w t‖) + (4 * Real.pi ^ 2)⁻¹ *
          ∫ t, ‖iteratedDeriv 2 h t - iteratedDeriv 2 w t‖ < ε := by
    intro h hh ψ hψ hψs hloc B hB hb0 hb2 ε hε
    have hF : Tendsto (fun n => ∫ t, ‖h t - ψ n t‖) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
      have := MeasureTheory.tendsto_integral_of_dominated_convergence
        (μ := MeasureTheory.volume)
        (F := fun n t => ‖h t - ψ n t‖) (f := fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) B
        (fun n => (hh.continuous.sub (hψ n).continuous).norm.aestronglyMeasurable) hB
        (fun n => MeasureTheory.ae_of_all _ fun t => by rw [norm_norm]; exact hb0 n t)
        (MeasureTheory.ae_of_all _ fun t => by
          apply tendsto_const_nhds.congr'
          filter_upwards [hloc t] with n hn
          rw [hn.eq_of_nhds, sub_self, norm_zero])
      simpa using this
    have hG : Tendsto (fun n => ∫ t, ‖iteratedDeriv 2 h t - iteratedDeriv 2 (ψ n) t‖)
        atTop (𝓝 0) := by
      have := MeasureTheory.tendsto_integral_of_dominated_convergence
        (μ := MeasureTheory.volume)
        (F := fun n t => ‖iteratedDeriv 2 h t - iteratedDeriv 2 (ψ n) t‖)
        (f := fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) B
        (fun n => ((hh.continuous_iteratedDeriv 2 le_rfl).sub
          ((hψ n).continuous_iteratedDeriv 2 le_rfl)).norm.aestronglyMeasurable) hB
        (fun n => MeasureTheory.ae_of_all _ fun t => by rw [norm_norm]; exact hb2 n t)
        (MeasureTheory.ae_of_all _ fun t => by
          apply tendsto_const_nhds.congr'
          filter_upwards [hloc t] with n hn
          rw [hn.iteratedDeriv_eq 2, sub_self, norm_zero])
      simpa using this
    have hT : Tendsto (fun n => (∫ t, ‖h t - ψ n t‖) + (4 * Real.pi ^ 2)⁻¹ *
        ∫ t, ‖iteratedDeriv 2 h t - iteratedDeriv 2 (ψ n) t‖) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
      have := hF.add (hG.const_mul (4 * Real.pi ^ 2)⁻¹)
      rwa [mul_zero, add_zero] at this
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := (hT.eventually_lt_const hε).exists
    refine ⟨ψ n, hψ n, hψs n, (hψ n).continuous.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport (hψs n),
      ((hψ n).continuous_deriv (by norm_num)).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport (hψs n).deriv,
      ((hψ n).continuous_iteratedDeriv 2 le_rfl).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport ?_, hn⟩
    rw [iteratedDeriv_succ, iteratedDeriv_one]
    exact (hψs n).deriv.deriv
  
  obtain ⟨χ, M, hχ⟩ := s2_cut
  obtain ⟨B, hB, hb0, hb2, hloc⟩ := s3_bounds (g : ℝ → ℂ) hgc hgi hgd hgdd χ M hχ
  exact s4_dct (g : ℝ → ℂ) hgc (fun n s => χ n s • (g : ℝ → ℂ) s)
    (fun n => (hχ n).1.smul hgc) (fun n => (hχ n).2.1.smul_right) hloc B hB hb0 hb2

    (hMERT : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ, 2 ≤ x →
      |(∑ p ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊x⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, (1 : ℝ) / p) - Real.log (Real.log x)| ≤ C)
    (hEULER : Asymptotics.IsEquivalent atTop
      (fun x : ℝ => ∏ p ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊x⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, (1 - (1 : ℝ) / p))
      (fun x => Real.exp (-Real.eulerMascheroniConstant) / Real.log x)) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ S x : ℝ, Real.exp 1 ≤ S → 3 ≤ x →
      (((Finset.Iic ⌊x⌋₊).filter (fun p => p.Prime ∧ ¬ SNormal S p)).card : ℝ) ≤
        C * x / Real.log x * (1 + Real.log (Real.log x)) ^ 5 *
          Real.exp (-Real.log (Real.log S) / 6)

signature.statement:
(hPNT : Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => (Nat.primeCounting ⌊x⌋₊ : ℝ) / (x / Real.log x)) atTop (𝓝 1))
    (hMERT : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ, 2 ≤ x →

  have hex : Real.exp 1 ≤ x := by have := Real.exp_one_lt_d9; linarith
  have hlx1 : 1 ≤ Real.log x := by
    have := Real.log_le_log (Real.exp_pos 1) hex; rwa [Real.log_exp] at this
  have hlx0 : 0 < Real.log x := by linarith
  have hllx : 0 ≤ Real.log (Real.log x) := Real.log_nonneg hlx1
  have hs16 : Real.sqrt 16 = 4 := by
    rw [show (16:ℝ) = 4 ^ 2 by norm_num, Real.sqrt_sq (by norm_num)]
  have hr4 : 4 ≤ Real.sqrt x := by
    rw [← hs16]; exact Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hx
  have hrr : Real.sqrt x * Real.sqrt x = x := Real.mul_self_sqrt hx0.le
  have hr2x : 2 * Real.sqrt x ≤ x := by nlinarith
  have hl2x : Real.log x ≤ Real.log (2 * x) := Real.log_le_log hx0 (by linarith)
  have hℓ₂0 : 0 ≤ Real.log (Real.log (2 * x)) := Real.log_nonneg (by linarith)
  have hE0 : 0 ≤ Real.exp (-Real.log (Real.log S) / 6) := (Real.exp_pos _).le
  set ℓ₂ := Real.log (Real.log (2 * x)) with hℓ₂
  set E := Real.exp (-Real.log (Real.log S) / 6) with hE
  set D := C * (1 + ℓ₂) ^ 5 * E with hD
  have hD0 : 0 ≤ D := by positivity
  set Q := (Finset.Iic ⌊2 * x⌋₊).filter (fun p => p.Prime ∧ ¬ SNormal S p) with hQ
  set P := (Q ×ˢ totientsUpTo x).filter
    (fun pt : ℕ × ℕ => (((pt.1 - 1) * pt.2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ x) with hP
  have h1 := s1 S x (by linarith)
  have hsplit : (P.card : ℝ) = ((P.filter (fun pt : ℕ × ℕ => (pt.1 : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt x)).card : ℝ) +
      ((P.filter (fun pt : ℕ × ℕ => ¬ (pt.1 : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt x)).card : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast (Finset.card_filter_add_card_filter_not _).symm
  have h2 := s2 x A Q hx (by linarith) (fun p hp => (Finset.mem_filter.mp hp).2.1.two_le) henv
  have hd := s5 S x C hS (by linarith) hC hdens
  have h3 := s3 x D Q hx hD0 hd
  have hQdata : ∀ q ∈ Q, 2 ≤ q ∧ (q : ℝ) ≤ 2 * x := by
    intro q hq
    rw [hQ, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Iic] at hq
    exact ⟨hq.2.1.two_le, (Nat.le_floor_iff (by linarith)).mp hq.1⟩
  have hRQ := hR Q (2 * x) D (by linarith) hD0 hQdata hd
  have hsub : ∑ p ∈ Q.filter (fun p : ℕ => (p : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt x), (1 : ℝ) / p ≤
      ∑ q ∈ Q, (1 : ℝ) / q :=
    Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.filter_subset _ _) (fun _ _ _ => by positivity)
  have hT := s4 (2 * Real.sqrt x) A (by have := Real.exp_one_lt_d9; linarith) hA
    (fun u hu2 hu => henv u hu2 (hu.trans hr2x))
  have hℓr : Real.log (Real.log (2 * Real.sqrt x)) ≤ ℓ₂ :=
    Real.log_le_log (Real.log_pos (by linarith)) (Real.log_le_log (by linarith) hr2x)
      |>.trans (Real.log_le_log (Real.log_pos (by linarith)) (Real.log_le_log hx0 (by linarith)))
  have hT' : ∑ t ∈ totientsUpTo (2 * Real.sqrt x), (1 : ℝ) / t ≤ (1 + K₁) * A * (1 + ℓ₂) := by
    refine hT.trans ?_
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (by positivity)
    linarith
  have hℓ₂le : 1 + ℓ₂ ≤ 2 * (1 + Real.log (Real.log x)) := by
    have hlog2 : Real.log (2 * x) = Real.log 2 + Real.log x :=
      Real.log_mul (by norm_num) (by linarith)
    have hl2 : Real.log 2 ≤ Real.log x := Real.log_le_log (by norm_num) (by linarith)
    have hstep : ℓ₂ ≤ Real.log (2 * Real.log x) := by
      rw [hℓ₂]
      exact Real.log_le_log (by linarith) (by linarith)
    have hstep2 : Real.log (2 * Real.log x) = Real.log 2 + Real.log (Real.log x) :=
      Real.log_mul (by norm_num) (by linarith)
    have := Real.log_two_lt_d9
    linarith
  have hM0 : 0 ≤ 4 * A * x / Real.log x := by positivity
  have hN0 : 0 ≤ 8 * D * x / Real.log x := by positivity
  have hA2 : ((P.filter (fun pt : ℕ × ℕ => (pt.1 : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt x)).card : ℝ) ≤
      4 * A * x / Real.log x * (K₁ * D * (1 + ℓ₂)) :=
    h2.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hsub.trans hRQ) hM0)
  have hA3 : ((P.filter (fun pt : ℕ × ℕ => ¬ (pt.1 : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt x)).card : ℝ) ≤
      8 * D * x / Real.log x * ((1 + K₁) * A * (1 + ℓ₂)) :=
    h3.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hT' hN0)
  have hpow6 : (1 + ℓ₂) ^ 6 ≤ 64 * (1 + Real.log (Real.log x)) ^ 6 := by
    calc (1 + ℓ₂) ^ 6 ≤ (2 * (1 + Real.log (Real.log x))) ^ 6 :=
          pow_le_pow_left₀ (by linarith) hℓ₂le 6
      _ = 64 * (1 + Real.log (Real.log x)) ^ 6 := by ring
  have hW0 : 0 ≤ 2 * (4 * K₁ + 8 * (1 + K₁)) * (C * A * x / Real.log x * E) := by positivity
  calc _ ≤ 2 * (P.card : ℝ) := h1
    _ = 2 * (((P.filter (fun pt : ℕ × ℕ => (pt.1 : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt x)).card : ℝ) +
      ((P.filter (fun pt : ℕ × ℕ => ¬ (pt.1 : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt x)).card : ℝ)) := by rw [hsplit]
    _ ≤ 2 * (4 * A * x / Real.log x * (K₁ * D * (1 + ℓ₂)) +
          8 * D * x / Real.log x * ((1 + K₁) * A * (1 + ℓ₂))) := by linarith
    _ = 2 * (4 * K₁ + 8 * (1 + K₁)) * (C * A * x / Real.log x * E) * (1 + ℓ₂) ^ 6 := by
          rw [hD]; ring
    _ ≤ 2 * (4 * K₁ + 8 * (1 + K₁)) * (C * A * x / Real.log x * E) *
          (64 * (1 + Real.log (Real.log x)) ^ 6) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpow6 hW0
    _ = 128 * (4 * K₁ + 8 * (1 + K₁)) * C * A * x / Real.log x *
          (1 + Real.log (Real.log x)) ^ 6 * E := by ring

subgoal_signatures.name: reciprocal_sum_of_density
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∃ K : ℝ, 0 < K ∧ ∀ (Q : Finset ℕ) (z D : ℝ), Real.exp 1 ≤ z → 0 ≤ D →
      (∀ q ∈ Q, 2 ≤ q ∧ (q : ℝ) ≤ z) →
      (∀ x : ℝ, 2 ≤ x → x ≤ z → ((Q.filter (fun q : ℕ => (q : ℝ) ≤ x)).card : ℝ) ≤ D * x / Real.log x) →

informal_problem.statement:
(hPNT : Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => (Nat.primeCounting ⌊x⌋₊ : ℝ) / (x / Real.log x)) atTop (𝓝 1))
    (hMERT : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ, 2 ≤ x →
      |(∑ p ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊x⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, (1 : ℝ) / p) - Real.log (Real.log x)| ≤ C)

      (fun x => Real.exp (-Real.eulerMascheroniConstant) / Real.log x)) :
    ∃ B : ℝ, 0 < B ∧ ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop, ∀ u : ℝ, 2 ≤ u → u ≤ x →

signature.statement:
(hPNT : Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => (Nat.primeCounting ⌊x⌋₊ : ℝ) / (x / Real.log x)) atTop (𝓝 1))
    (hMERT : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ, 2 ≤ x →
