proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨K₅, hK₅, hret⟩ := envelope_retained_totients_bound hPNT hMERT
  obtain ⟨D, hD, hsize⟩ := inverse_totient_size_bound hPNT hMERT hEULER
  
  have hbig : ∀ x : ℝ, Real.exp (Real.exp 1) ≤ x →
      0 < x ∧ Real.exp 1 ≤ Real.log x ∧ 1 ≤ logLog x := by
    intro x hx
    have hx0 : 0 < x := lt_of_lt_of_le (Real.exp_pos _) hx
    have hL : Real.exp 1 ≤ Real.log x := by
      have := Real.log_le_log (Real.exp_pos _) hx
      rwa [Real.log_exp] at this
    refine ⟨hx0, hL, ?_⟩
    have := Real.log_le_log (Real.exp_pos _) hL
    rw [Real.log_exp] at this
    exact this
  
  have hLS : ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop, ((largeSquareTotients x).card : ℝ) ≤ x / Real.log x := by
    filter_upwards [hsize, large_prime_square_count hD,
      eventually_ge_atTop (Real.exp (Real.exp 1))] with x hs hl hx
    obtain ⟨hx0, hLx, hT⟩ := hbig x hx
    have hlog0 : 0 < Real.log x := lt_of_lt_of_le (Real.exp_pos _) hLx
    have key : ∀ m ∈ largeSquareTotients x, ∃ n : ℕ, 0 < n ∧ n.totient = m ∧
        ∃ q : ℕ, q.Prime ∧ Real.log x ^ 4 < (q : ℝ) ∧ (q ^ 2 ∣ n ∨ q ^ 2 ∣ n.totient) :=
      fun m hm => (Finset.mem_filter.mp hm).2
    let f : ℕ → ℕ := fun m => Classical.epsilon (fun n : ℕ => 0 < n ∧ n.totient = m ∧
        ∃ q : ℕ, q.Prime ∧ Real.log x ^ 4 < (q : ℝ) ∧ (q ^ 2 ∣ n ∨ q ^ 2 ∣ n.totient))
    have hf : ∀ m ∈ largeSquareTotients x, 0 < f m ∧ (f m).totient = m ∧
        ∃ q : ℕ, q.Prime ∧ Real.log x ^ 4 < (q : ℝ) ∧ (q ^ 2 ∣ f m ∨ q ^ 2 ∣ (f m).totient) :=
      fun m hm => Classical.epsilon_spec (key m hm)
    have hcard : (largeSquareTotients x).card ≤
        ((Finset.Icc 1 ⌊D * x * logLog x⌋₊).filter (fun n => ∃ q : ℕ, q.Prime ∧
          Real.log x ^ 4 < (q : ℝ) ∧ (q ^ 2 ∣ n ∨ q ^ 2 ∣ n.totient))).card := by
      refine Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn f ?_ ?_
      · intro m hm
        have hm' : m ∈ largeSquareTotients x := hm
        obtain ⟨hpos, htot, hq⟩ := hf m hm'
        have hmx : m ∈ totientsUpTo x := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hm').1
        have hmle : m ≤ ⌊x⌋₊ := (Finset.mem_Icc.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp hmx).1).2
        have hmr : (m : ℝ) ≤ x := (Nat.le_floor_iff hx0.le).mp hmle
        have hnle : ((f m : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ D * x * logLog x :=
          hs (f m) hpos (by rw [htot]; exact hmr)
        rw [Finset.coe_filter, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Finset.mem_Icc]
        refine ⟨⟨hpos, ?_⟩, hq⟩
        exact Nat.le_floor hnle
      · intro m hm m' hm' heq
        have h1 := (hf m hm).2.1
        have h2 := (hf m' hm').2.1
        rw [← h1, ← h2]
        exact congrArg Nat.totient heq
    have hT2 : 1 ≤ logLog x ^ 2 := one_le_pow₀ hT
    calc ((largeSquareTotients x).card : ℝ)
        ≤ (((Finset.Icc 1 ⌊D * x * logLog x⌋₊).filter (fun n => ∃ q : ℕ, q.Prime ∧
          Real.log x ^ 4 < (q : ℝ) ∧ (q ^ 2 ∣ n ∨ q ^ 2 ∣ n.totient))).card : ℝ) := by
          exact_mod_cast hcard
      _ ≤ x / (Real.log x * (logLog x) ^ 2) := hl
      _ ≤ x / Real.log x := by
          apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hx0.le hlog0
          nlinarith
  apply envelope_bootstrap (K₅ + 5) (by linarith)
  filter_upwards [envelope_growth_cover, envelope_five_log_omega_small hMERT,
    envelope_three_large_normal_small hPNT hMERT, hret, envelope_nonnormal_absorbed hPNT hMERT hEULER,
    hLS, eventually_ge_atTop (Real.exp (Real.exp 1))] with x hcov h1 h3 h5 h2 h4 hx
  intro A A' hA hA' henvx henvY
  obtain ⟨hx0, hLx, hT⟩ := hbig x hx
  have hlog0 : 0 < Real.log x := lt_of_lt_of_le (Real.exp_pos _) hLx
  set A0 := totientsUpTo (Real.sqrt x) with hA0
  set E1 := fiveLogOmegaTotients x with hE1
  set E2 := (totientsUpTo x).filter (fun m => ∃ n : ℕ, 0 < n ∧ n.totient = m ∧
        ∃ q : ℕ, q.Prime ∧ q ∣ n ∧ ¬ SNormal (envelopeNormalityScale (logLog x)) q) with hE2
  set E3 := envelopeThreeLargeNormalTotients x with hE3
  set E4 := largeSquareTotients x with hE4
  set E5 := envelopeRetainedTotients x with hE5
  have hc : (totientsUpTo x).card ≤
      A0.card + E1.card + E2.card + E3.card + E4.card + E5.card := by
    have c0 := Finset.card_le_card hcov
    have u1 := Finset.card_union_le (A0 ∪ E1 ∪ E2 ∪ E3 ∪ E4) E5
    have u2 := Finset.card_union_le (A0 ∪ E1 ∪ E2 ∪ E3) E4
    have u3 := Finset.card_union_le (A0 ∪ E1 ∪ E2) E3
    have u4 := Finset.card_union_le (A0 ∪ E1) E2
    have u5 := Finset.card_union_le A0 E1
    omega
  have hcR : ((totientsUpTo x).card : ℝ) ≤
      (A0.card : ℝ) + E1.card + E2.card + E3.card + E4.card + E5.card := by
    exact_mod_cast hc
  
  have hsq0 : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt x := Real.sqrt_nonneg x
  have hA0le : (A0.card : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt x := by
    have hsub : A0 ⊆ Finset.Icc 1 ⌊Real.sqrt x⌋₊ := Finset.filter_subset _ _
    have hc1 := Finset.card_le_card hsub
    rw [Nat.card_Icc] at hc1
    have hc2 : A0.card ≤ ⌊Real.sqrt x⌋₊ := by omega
    calc (A0.card : ℝ) ≤ (⌊Real.sqrt x⌋₊ : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hc2
      _ ≤ Real.sqrt x := Nat.floor_le hsq0
  have hsqpos : 0 < Real.sqrt x := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hx0
  have hlogsq : Real.log x ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt x := by
    have h1 : Real.log (Real.sqrt x) = Real.log x / 2 := Real.log_sqrt hx0.le
    have h2 := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos hsqpos
    linarith
  have hsqx : Real.sqrt x * Real.sqrt x = x := Real.mul_self_sqrt hx0.le
  have hA0q : Real.sqrt x ≤ 2 * (x / Real.log x) := by
    rw [mul_div_assoc', le_div_iff₀ hlog0]
    nlinarith
  
  set q := x / Real.log x with hq
  have hq0 : 0 ≤ q := div_nonneg hx0.le hlog0.le
  have hT2 : 1 ≤ logLog x ^ 2 := one_le_pow₀ hT
  have hTA : 1 ≤ logLog x ^ 2 * A' := by nlinarith
  have e2 : (1 / 4 : ℝ) * A * x / Real.log x = (1 / 4 : ℝ) * A * q := by rw [hq]; ring
  have e5 : K₅ * x / Real.log x * logLog x ^ 2 * A' = K₅ * q * (logLog x ^ 2 * A') := by
    rw [hq]; ring
  have e6 : (K₅ + 5) * x / Real.log x * logLog x ^ 2 * A' = (K₅ + 5) * q * (logLog x ^ 2 * A') := by
    rw [hq]; ring
  have hE2b := h2 A hA henvx
  have hE5b := h5 A' hA' henvY
  rw [e2] at hE2b ⊢
  rw [e5] at hE5b
  rw [e6]
  have hqq : q ≤ q * (logLog x ^ 2 * A') := by nlinarith
  nlinarith

totient_envelope_growth.definitions:
noncomputable def envelopeNormalityScale (T : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.exp (Real.exp (100 * Real.log T))

noncomputable def envelopeLargePrimeCutoff (T : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.exp (Real.exp ((4 / 5 : ℝ) * T))

noncomputable def envelopeTailEndpoint (T : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.exp (Real.exp ((9 / 10 : ℝ) * T))

noncomputable def envelopeThreeLargeNormalTotients (x : ℝ) : Finset ℕ :=
  (totientsUpTo x).filter (fun m : ℕ => Real.sqrt x ≤ (m : ℝ) ∧
    (ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors m : ℝ) ≤ 5 * logLog x ∧
    ∃ n : ℕ, 0 < n ∧ n.totient = m ∧ ∃ P : Finset ℕ, P.card = 3 ∧
      ∀ p ∈ P, SNormal (envelopeNormalityScale (logLog x)) p ∧ p ∣ n ∧
        envelopeLargePrimeCutoff (logLog x) < (p : ℝ))

noncomputable def envelopeRetainedTotients (x : ℝ) : Finset ℕ :=
  (totientsUpTo x).filter (fun m : ℕ => Real.sqrt x ≤ (m : ℝ) ∧
    (ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors m : ℝ) ≤ 5 * logLog x ∧
    ∃ n : ℕ, 0 < n ∧ n.totient = m ∧
      NoLargePrimeSquare n (envelopeLargePrimeCutoff (logLog x)) ∧
      (n.primeFactors.filter (fun p : ℕ => envelopeLargePrimeCutoff (logLog x) < (p : ℝ))).card ≤ 2)

subgoal_signatures.statement:
(hPNT : Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => (Nat.primeCounting ⌊x⌋₊ : ℝ) / (x / Real.log x)) atTop (𝓝 1))
    (hMERT : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ, 2 ≤ x →
      |(∑ p ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊x⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, (1 : ℝ) / p) - Real.log (Real.log x)| ≤ C)
    (hEULER : Asymptotics.IsEquivalent atTop
      (fun x : ℝ => ∏ p ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊x⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, (1 - (1 : ℝ) / p))
      (fun x => Real.exp (-Real.eulerMascheroniConstant) / Real.log x)) :
    ∃ D : ℝ, 0 < D ∧ ∀ᶠ Y : ℝ in atTop, ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → (n.totient : ℝ) ≤ Y → (n : ℝ) ≤ D * Y * logLog Y

subgoal_signatures.name: large_prime_square_count
subgoal_signatures.statement:
{c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    ∀ᶠ Y : ℝ in atTop, (((Finset.Icc 1 ⌊c * Y * logLog Y⌋₊).filter (fun n => ∃ q : ℕ, q.Prime ∧
      Real.log Y ^ 4 < (q : ℝ) ∧ (q ^ 2 ∣ n ∨ q ^ 2 ∣ n.totient))).card : ℝ) ≤
        Y / (Real.log Y * (logLog Y) ^ 2)

subgoal_signatures.name: envelope_bootstrap
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(K : ℝ) (hK : 0 < K)
    (hstep : ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop, ∀ A A' : ℝ, 1 ≤ A → 1 ≤ A' →
      (∀ u : ℝ, 2 ≤ u → u ≤ x → ((totientsUpTo u).card : ℝ) ≤ A * u / Real.log u) →
      (∀ u : ℝ, 2 ≤ u → u ≤ envelopeTailEndpoint (logLog x) →
        ((totientsUpTo u).card : ℝ) ≤ A' * u / Real.log u) →
      ((totientsUpTo x).card : ℝ) ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) * A * x / Real.log x +
        K * x / Real.log x * logLog x ^ 2 * A') :
    ∃ B : ℝ, 0 < B ∧ ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop, ∀ u : ℝ, 2 ≤ u → u ≤ x →
      ((totientsUpTo u).card : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp (B * Real.log (logLog x) ^ 2) * u / Real.log u

subgoal_signatures.statement:
(hMERT : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ, 2 ≤ x →
      |(∑ p ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊x⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, (1 : ℝ) / p) - Real.log (Real.log x)| ≤ C) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop, ((fiveLogOmegaTotients x).card : ℝ) ≤ x / Real.log x

        simp [logLog]
      rw [h4, h4T]

    exact (Real.log_lt_log_iff (by positivity) (Real.exp_pos _)).mp hlt
  
  have c6 : ∀ᶠ T : ℝ in atTop, Real.log (6 * T) / T ≤ normalityDelta T := by

    have h5 : Real.log T ^ 5 = Real.log T * Real.log T ^ 4 := by ring
    have h1 : Real.log T ≤ Real.log T ^ 5 := by

    have h2 : Real.log T ^ 5 ≤ Real.log T ^ 5 * Real.sqrt T :=
      le_mul_of_one_le_right (by positivity) hs1
    have hmain : Real.log 6 + Real.log T ≤ 2 * Real.log T ^ 5 * Real.sqrt T := by
      nlinarith
    unfold normalityDelta
    rw [Real.log_mul (by norm_num) hTpos.ne', div_le_div_iff₀ hTpos hspos]

          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hmain hspos.le
      _ = 2 * Real.log T ^ 5 * T := by rw [mul_assoc _ (Real.sqrt T), hsq]
  
  have c2 : ∀ᶠ Y : ℝ in atTop, ∀ N p : ℕ, 0 < N → (N.totient : ℝ) ≤ Y →

    have hlo := (isLittleO_log_rpow_atTop (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 4 / 5)).bound

    have hYpos : 0 < Y := by linarith
    have hlogpos : 0 < Real.log Y := Real.log_pos hY
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hlogpos,

    have hDl : D * Real.log Y ≤ Y ^ (4 / 5 : ℝ) := by

      rw [← mul_assoc, mul_one_div_cancel hD.ne', one_mul] at this

    have hpow1 : Y ^ (9 / 5 : ℝ) = Y * Y ^ (4 / 5 : ℝ) := by

    intro N p hN hsz htop

      unfold logLog
      exact Real.log_le_self hlogpos.le
    have hreal : (N : ℝ) ≤ (p : ℝ) ^ 2 := by

        _ = Y * (D * Real.log Y) := by ring

  have hS : 1 ≤ normalityScale (logLog Y) := by

  have hsqN : NoLargePrimeSquare N (normalityScale (logLog Y)) :=

  have hsqPhi : NoLargePrimeSquare N.totient (normalityScale (logLog Y)) :=

  have hphipos : 0 < N.totient := Nat.totient_pos.mpr hR.witness_pos
  have hshift : ∀ idx, ((p idx - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ Y := by
    intro idx

    nlinarith
  have B := hpdata L p hR.normal_left hR.prime_min hpsize hR.order.antitone hR.gaps

subgoal_signatures.name: rph_exists_normalPreimageList
subgoal_signatures.statement:
{n : ℕ} {S : ℝ} (hn : 0 < n) (hS : 1 ≤ S)
    (hnormal : ∀ p ∈ n.primeFactors, SNormal S p)
    (hsquareN : NoLargePrimeSquare n S)
    (hsquarePhi : NoLargePrimeSquare n.totient S) :
    ∃ (K s : ℕ) (q : Fin K → ℕ),
      K = (n.primeFactors.filter fun r => S < (largestPrimeFactor (r - 1) : ℝ)).card ∧
      s = (∏ r ∈ n.primeFactors with (largestPrimeFactor (r - 1) : ℝ) ≤ S,
        r ^ (n.factorization r - 1) * (r - 1)) ∧
      (∀ idx, SNormal S (q idx)) ∧ Function.Injective q ∧
      StrictAnti (fun idx => largestPrimeFactor (q idx - 1)) ∧
      (∀ idx, S < (largestPrimeFactor (q idx - 1) : ℝ)) ∧
      (∀ idx, n.factorization (q idx) = 1) ∧
      n.totient = s * (∏ idx, (q idx - 1)) ∧ 0 < s ∧ (largestPrimeFactor s : ℝ) ≤ S

        show ((r.primes (CollisionMatching.prefixIndex r.J i) : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ Y + 1
        linarith
      · calc (r.common.image (CollisionRecord.leftPrimes r.J r.primes)).card
            ≤ r.common.card := Finset.card_image_le
          _ ≤ Fintype.card (Fin (r.J.val + 1)) := Finset.card_le_univ _
          _ = r.J.val + 1 := Fintype.card_fin _
          _ ≤ L := r.prefix_lt
    · exact Finset.prod_image (fun a _ b _ h => r.conditions.left_injective h)
  
  have s8 : ∀ (G : Finset (CollisionSum.Label L)) (B : Finset (Fin (L + 1) → ℝ)) (Ms : Finset ℕ),
      (∀ l ∈ G, l.1.2 ∈ B ∧ l.2.2 ∈ Ms) →
      (∑ l ∈ G, invTotient l.2.2) ≤
        ((L : ℝ) + 1) * (B.card : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ (L + 1) * ∑ M ∈ Ms, invTotient M := by
    intro G B Ms hG
    have hsub : G ⊆ ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (L + 1))) ×ˢ B) ×ˢ
        ((Finset.univ : Finset (Finset (Fin (L + 1)))) ×ˢ Ms) := by
      intro l hl
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hG l hl
      simp only [Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
      exact ⟨h1, h2⟩
    calc _ ≤ ∑ l ∈ ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (L + 1))) ×ˢ B) ×ˢ
          ((Finset.univ : Finset (Finset (Fin (L + 1)))) ×ˢ Ms), invTotient l.2.2 :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hsub (by intro l _ _; unfold invTotient; positivity)
      _ = _ := by
          simp only [Finset.sum_product, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_finset,
            Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul, Finset.card_product]
          push_cast
          ring
  
  have hmem : ∀ l ∈ F.image CollisionSum.Record.label,
      l.1.2 ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (L + 1) → Fin (⌈logLog Y⌉₊ + 1))).image
        (fun k : Fin (L + 1) → Fin (⌈logLog Y⌉₊ + 1) => fun idx : Fin (L + 1) =>
          if idx.val = 0 then (1 : ℝ) else (1 / logLog Y) * ((k idx : ℕ) : ℝ)) ∧
      l.2.2 ∈ ((((Finset.Iic ⌊Y + 1⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime).powerset.filter
          (fun s => s.card ≤ L)).image (fun s : Finset ℕ => ∏ q ∈ s, q)) := by
    intro l hl
    obtain ⟨r, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hl
    exact ⟨s4 r.primes r.prime_min (s3 r), s5 r⟩
  have h8 := s8 _ _ _ hmem
  have hBcard : (((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (L + 1) → Fin (⌈logLog Y⌉₊ + 1))).image
        (fun k : Fin (L + 1) → Fin (⌈logLog Y⌉₊ + 1) => fun idx : Fin (L + 1) =>
          if idx.val = 0 then (1 : ℝ) else (1 / logLog Y) * ((k idx : ℕ) : ℝ))).card : ℝ) ≤
      (((⌈logLog Y⌉₊ : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1) ^ (L + 1) := by
    have h : ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (L + 1) → Fin (⌈logLog Y⌉₊ + 1))).image
        (fun k : Fin (L + 1) → Fin (⌈logLog Y⌉₊ + 1) => fun idx : Fin (L + 1) =>
          if idx.val = 0 then (1 : ℝ) else (1 / logLog Y) * ((k idx : ℕ) : ℝ))).card ≤
        (⌈logLog Y⌉₊ + 1) ^ (L + 1) := by
      refine Finset.card_image_le.trans ?_
      simp [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_fin]
    exact_mod_cast h
  have h9 : ∑ M ∈ ((((Finset.Iic ⌊Y + 1⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime).powerset.filter
          (fun s => s.card ≤ L)).image (fun s : Finset ℕ => ∏ q ∈ s, q)), invTotient M ≤
      (1 + ∑ q ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊Y + 1⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, (((q - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))⁻¹) ^ L := by
    calc _ ≤ ∑ s ∈ ((Finset.Iic ⌊Y + 1⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime).powerset.filter (fun s => s.card ≤ L),
          invTotient (∏ q ∈ s, q) :=
          Finset.sum_image_le_of_nonneg (fun u _ => by unfold invTotient; positivity)
      _ = ∑ s ∈ ((Finset.Iic ⌊Y + 1⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime).powerset.filter (fun s => s.card ≤ L),
          ∏ q ∈ s, (((q - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))⁻¹ := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro s hs
          have hsP := Finset.mem_powerset.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp hs).1
          have hprime : ∀ q ∈ s, q.Prime := fun q hq => (Finset.mem_filter.mp (hsP hq)).2
          unfold invTotient
          rw [s2 s hprime, Nat.cast_prod, Finset.prod_inv_distrib]
      _ ≤ _ := s1 (fun q => (((q - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))⁻¹) _ (fun q _ => by positivity) L
  have h9' := h9.trans (pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) h6 L)
  calc _ ≤ _ := h8
    _ ≤ ((L : ℝ) + 1) * (((⌈logLog Y⌉₊ : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1) ^ (L + 1) * (2 : ℝ) ^ (L + 1) *
          (logLog Y ^ 2) ^ L := by
        apply mul_le_mul _ h9' (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun M _ => by unfold invTotient; positivity))
          (by positivity)
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (by positivity)
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hBcard (by positivity)
    _ ≤ _ := s7 (logLog Y) hT4 hu L hL

informal_problem.statement:
{Y K : ℝ} {L d : ℕ} (hY : 1 < Y) (hT : 0 < logLog Y)
    (hK : 0 ≤ K)
    (hclass : ∀ (J : Fin (L + 1)) (C : Finset (Fin (J.val + 1)))
      (M : ℕ) (F : Finset ℕ) (pstar : Fin (L + 1) → ℕ)
      (p q : ℕ → Fin (J.val + 1) → ℕ) (t : ℕ → Fin (L - J.val) → ℕ) (e : ℕ → ℕ),
      J.val < L →
      (∀ idx : Fin (J.val + 1), idx.val = 0 → idx ∉ C) →
      CollisionCutoff.SieveCutoffs (CollisionClass.remaining C).card Y (normalityDelta (logLog Y))
        (CollisionSum.upper Y pstar J C) (CollisionSum.lower Y pstar J C) →
      (∀ idx, 17 ≤ pstar idx) → Antitone pstar →
      (∑ idx ∈ Finset.Icc 1 L, fordWeight idx *
        CollisionFacet.extend (fun j => CollisionBox.primeCoordinate (logLog Y) (pstar j)) idx) ≤
          1 - (logLog Y) ^ (-1 / 8 : ℝ) →
      (∀ n ∈ F, CollisionClass.Conditions C d M n (normalityScale (logLog Y)) Y
        (CollisionSum.upper Y pstar J C) (CollisionSum.lower Y pstar J C) (p n) (q n) (t n) (e n)) →
      (F.card : ℝ) ≤ Y / ((d : ℝ) * M.totient * Real.log Y) *
        Real.exp (-(1 / 4 : ℝ) * (logLog Y) ^ (7 / 8 : ℝ) - K * sieveErrorEnvelope (logLog Y)))
    (F : Finset (CollisionSum.Record Y L d))
    (hinj : Set.InjOn CollisionSum.Record.integer (F : Set (CollisionSum.Record Y L d)))
    (hlabels : (∑ l ∈ F.image CollisionSum.Record.label, invTotient l.2.2) ≤
      Real.exp (K * Real.log (logLog Y) ^ 2)) :
    (F.card : ℝ) ≤ Y / ((d : ℝ) * Real.log Y) * Real.exp (-(1 / 4 : ℝ) * (logLog Y) ^ (7 / 8 : ℝ))

signature.statement:

    (hclass : ∀ (J : Fin (L + 1)) (C : Finset (Fin (J.val + 1)))

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hcong : ∀ (p p' : Fin (L + 1) → ℕ) (J : Fin (L + 1)) (C : Finset (Fin (J.val + 1))),
      CollisionSum.box Y p = CollisionSum.box Y p' →
      CollisionSum.upper Y p J C = CollisionSum.upper Y p' J C ∧
        CollisionSum.lower Y p J C = CollisionSum.lower Y p' J C := by
    intro p q J C heq
    have hselected : CollisionCutoff.selectedZeta J C (1 / logLog Y)
        (fun idx => CollisionBox.shiftedCoordinate (logLog Y) (p idx)) =
        CollisionCutoff.selectedZeta J C (1 / logLog Y)
          (fun idx => CollisionBox.shiftedCoordinate (logLog Y) (q idx)) := by
      funext idx
      exact congrFun heq (CollisionCutoff.selectedIndex J C idx)
    have htail : CollisionBox.tailCoordinate (1 / logLog Y) ((logLog Y) ^ (-2 / 5 : ℝ))
        ((logLog Y) ^ (-1 / 3 : ℝ)) (fun idx => CollisionBox.shiftedCoordinate (logLog Y) (p idx)) J =
        CollisionBox.tailCoordinate (1 / logLog Y) ((logLog Y) ^ (-2 / 5 : ℝ))
          ((logLog Y) ^ (-1 / 3 : ℝ)) (fun idx => CollisionBox.shiftedCoordinate (logLog Y) (q idx)) J := by
      unfold CollisionBox.tailCoordinate
      rw [show CollisionBox.rounded (1 / logLog Y)
        (fun idx => CollisionBox.shiftedCoordinate (logLog Y) (p idx)) J =
        CollisionBox.rounded (1 / logLog Y)
          (fun idx => CollisionBox.shiftedCoordinate (logLog Y) (q idx)) J from congrFun heq J]
    constructor <;> simp only [CollisionSum.upper, CollisionSum.lower, CollisionRecord.upper,
      CollisionRecord.lower, hselected, htail]
  
  have htrans : ∀ (r s : CollisionSum.Record Y L d), r.label = s.label →
      ∃ (p q : Fin (s.J.val + 1) → ℕ) (t : Fin (L - s.J.val) → ℕ) (e : ℕ),
        CollisionClass.Conditions s.common d (CollisionRecord.commonProduct s.J s.primes s.common)
          r.integer (normalityScale (logLog Y)) Y (CollisionSum.upper Y s.primes s.J s.common)
          (CollisionSum.lower Y s.primes s.J s.common) p q t e := by
    intro r s heq
    rcases r with ⟨n, p, J, C, q, e, hJ, hzero, hcuts, hconditions, hp17, horder, hfacet⟩
    rcases s with ⟨nstar, pstar, Jstar, Cstar, qstar, estar, hJstar, hzerostar, hcutsstar,
      hconditionsstar, hp17star, horderstar, hfacetstar⟩
    change ((J, CollisionSum.box Y p), CollisionSum.commonCode J C,
        CollisionRecord.commonProduct J p C) =
      ((Jstar, CollisionSum.box Y pstar), CollisionSum.commonCode Jstar Cstar,
        CollisionRecord.commonProduct Jstar pstar Cstar) at heq
    have hJJ : J = Jstar := congrArg (fun l : CollisionSum.Label L => l.1.1) heq
    subst Jstar
    have hCC : C = Cstar :=
      Finset.map_injective (CollisionSum.prefixEmbedding J)
        (congrArg (fun l : CollisionSum.Label L => l.2.1) heq)
    subst Cstar
    have hb : CollisionSum.box Y p = CollisionSum.box Y pstar :=
      congrArg (fun l : CollisionSum.Label L => l.1.2) heq
    have hM : CollisionRecord.commonProduct J p C = CollisionRecord.commonProduct J pstar C :=
      congrArg (fun l : CollisionSum.Label L => l.2.2) heq
    have hcut := hcong p pstar J C hb
    refine ⟨CollisionRecord.leftPrimes J p, q, CollisionRecord.tailPrimes J p, e, ?_⟩
    simpa only [hM, hcut.1, hcut.2] using hconditions
  set T := logLog Y with hTdef
  set β := Y / ((d : ℝ) * Real.log Y) *
    Real.exp (-(1 / 4 : ℝ) * T ^ (7 / 8 : ℝ) - K * sieveErrorEnvelope T) with hβdef
  have hYpos : 0 < Y := by linarith
  have hlogY : 0 < Real.log Y := Real.log_pos hY
  have hβ : 0 ≤ β := by rw [hβdef]; positivity
  have hfiber : ∀ l ∈ F.image CollisionSum.Record.label,
      ((F.filter (fun r => r.label = l)).card : ℝ) ≤ β * invTotient l.2.2 := by
    intro l hl
    obtain ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hl
    set G := F.filter (fun r => r.label = s.label) with hGdef
    set U := G.image CollisionSum.Record.integer with hUdef
    have hU : ∀ n ∈ U,
        ∃ (p q : Fin (s.J.val + 1) → ℕ) (t : Fin (L - s.J.val) → ℕ) (e : ℕ),
          CollisionClass.Conditions s.common d (CollisionRecord.commonProduct s.J s.primes s.common) n
            (normalityScale (logLog Y)) Y (CollisionSum.upper Y s.primes s.J s.common)
            (CollisionSum.lower Y s.primes s.J s.common) p q t e := by
      intro n hn
      obtain ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hn
      exact htrans r s (Finset.mem_filter.mp hr).2
    choose! p q t e hconditions using hU
    have hcount := hclass s.J s.common (CollisionRecord.commonProduct s.J s.primes s.common)
      U s.primes p q t e s.prefix_lt s.zero_survives s.cutoffs s.prime_min s.order s.facet
      hconditions
    have hcard : U.card = G.card := Finset.card_image_of_injOn
      (hinj.mono (show (G : Set (CollisionSum.Record Y L d)) ⊆ F from
        fun r hr => (Finset.mem_filter.mp hr).1))
    rw [hcard] at hcount
    calc
      ((F.filter (fun r => r.label = s.label)).card : ℝ) ≤
          Y / ((d : ℝ) * (CollisionRecord.commonProduct s.J s.primes s.common).totient *
            Real.log Y) *
            Real.exp (-(1 / 4 : ℝ) * T ^ (7 / 8 : ℝ) - K * sieveErrorEnvelope T) := hcount
      _ = β * invTotient s.label.2.2 := by
        simp only [hβdef, CollisionSum.Record.label, invTotient]; ring
  have hsum : (F.card : ℝ) =
      ∑ l ∈ F.image CollisionSum.Record.label, ((F.filter (fun r => r.label = l)).card : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast Finset.card_eq_sum_card_image CollisionSum.Record.label F
  have henv : Real.log T ^ 2 ≤ sieveErrorEnvelope T := by
    unfold sieveErrorEnvelope
    have h₁ : 0 ≤ Real.log T ^ 2 * T ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ) :=
      mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (Real.rpow_nonneg hT.le _)
    have h₂ : 0 ≤ Real.log T ^ 8 * T ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) :=
      mul_nonneg (by positivity) (Real.rpow_nonneg hT.le _)
    linarith
  calc
    (F.card : ℝ) = ∑ l ∈ F.image CollisionSum.Record.label,
        ((F.filter (fun r => r.label = l)).card : ℝ) := hsum
    _ ≤ ∑ l ∈ F.image CollisionSum.Record.label, β * invTotient l.2.2 := Finset.sum_le_sum hfiber
    _ = β * ∑ l ∈ F.image CollisionSum.Record.label, invTotient l.2.2 := (Finset.mul_sum _ _ _).symm
    _ ≤ β * Real.exp (K * Real.log T ^ 2) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlabels hβ
    _ = Y / ((d : ℝ) * Real.log Y) * Real.exp
        (-(1 / 4 : ℝ) * T ^ (7 / 8 : ℝ) - K * sieveErrorEnvelope T +
          K * Real.log T ^ 2) := by rw [Real.exp_add, hβdef]; ring
    _ ≤ _ := by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (by positivity)
      apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
      have hcost := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left henv hK
      linarith

informal_problem.statement:
{C₀ : ℝ} (hC₀ : 0 < C₀)
    (hcheb : ∀ x : ℝ, 2 ≤ x → (Nat.primeCounting ⌊x⌋₊ : ℝ) ≤ C₀ * x / Real.log x)
    (F Q : Finset ℕ) (z D : ℝ) (k : ℕ) (hz : 4 ≤ z) (hD : 0 ≤ D) (hk : 0 < k)
    (hQ : ∀ q ∈ Q, q.Prime)
    (hF : ∀ n ∈ F, Squarefree n ∧ (n : ℝ) ≤ z ∧ ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors n ≤ k ∧ ∃ q ∈ Q, q ∣ n)
    (hdensity : ∀ x : ℝ, 2 ≤ x → x ≤ z →
      ((Q.filter (fun q : ℕ => (q : ℝ) ≤ x)).card : ℝ) ≤ D * x / Real.log x) :
    (F.card : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt z + (2 * k * z / Real.log z) *
      (Real.exp 1 * (1 + ∑ p ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊z⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, (1 : ℝ) / ((p : ℝ) - 1)) ^ k) *
      (D + C₀ * ∑ q ∈ Q, (1 : ℝ) / q)

signature.name: squarefree_exceptional_count_bound
signature.statement:
{C₀ : ℝ} (hC₀ : 0 < C₀)
    (hcheb : ∀ x : ℝ, 2 ≤ x → (Nat.primeCounting ⌊x⌋₊ : ℝ) ≤ C₀ * x / Real.log x)
    (F Q : Finset ℕ) (z D : ℝ) (k : ℕ) (hz : 4 ≤ z) (hD : 0 ≤ D) (hk : 0 < k)
    (hQ : ∀ q ∈ Q, q.Prime)
    (hF : ∀ n ∈ F, Squarefree n ∧ (n : ℝ) ≤ z ∧ ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors n ≤ k ∧ ∃ q ∈ Q, q ∣ n)
    (hdensity : ∀ x : ℝ, 2 ≤ x → x ≤ z →
      ((Q.filter (fun q : ℕ => (q : ℝ) ≤ x)).card : ℝ) ≤ D * x / Real.log x) :
    (F.card : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt z + (2 * k * z / Real.log z) *
      (Real.exp 1 * (1 + ∑ p ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊z⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, (1 : ℝ) / ((p : ℝ) - 1)) ^ k) *

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have hzpos : 0 < z := by linarith
  have hlog : 0 < Real.log z := Real.log_pos (by linarith)
  have hkR : (0 : ℝ) < k := by exact_mod_cast hk
  
  have hlpf_ge : ∀ {n p : ℕ}, 0 < n → p.Prime → p ∣ n → p ≤ largestPrimeFactor n :=
    fun {n p} hn hp hpn =>
      (Finset.le_sup (f := id) (hp.mem_primeFactors hpn (Nat.ne_of_gt hn))).trans
        (le_max_right _ _)
  have hlpf_pow : ∀ {n : ℕ}, n ≠ 0 →
      n ≤ largestPrimeFactor n ^ ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors n := by
    intro n hn
    have h := List.prod_le_pow_card n.primeFactorsList (largestPrimeFactor n)
      (fun p hp => by
        obtain ⟨hprime, hdvd, hn'⟩ := Nat.mem_primeFactorsList'.mp hp
        exact hlpf_ge (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn') hprime hdvd)
    simpa only [Nat.prod_primeFactorsList hn, ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors_apply] using h
  have hlpf_one_lt : ∀ {n : ℕ}, 1 < n → 1 < largestPrimeFactor n := by
    intro n hn
    have hbound := hlpf_pow (by omega : n ≠ 0)
    have hbase : 1 ≤ largestPrimeFactor n := le_max_left _ _
    by_contra h
    have heq : largestPrimeFactor n = 1 := by omega
    simp only [heq, one_pow] at hbound
    omega
  have hlpf_mem : ∀ {n : ℕ}, 1 < largestPrimeFactor n →
      largestPrimeFactor n ∈ n.primeFactors := by
    intro n h
    have hs : n.primeFactors.Nonempty := by
      apply Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr
      intro hs
      simp [largestPrimeFactor, hs] at h
    obtain ⟨p, hp, hsup⟩ := Finset.exists_mem_eq_sup n.primeFactors hs id
    have hprime := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp
    simpa only [largestPrimeFactor, hsup, id_eq, max_eq_right hprime.one_le] using hp
  have hlpf_dvd : ∀ n : ℕ, largestPrimeFactor n ∣ n := by
    intro n
    by_cases h : largestPrimeFactor n = 1
    · rw [h]; exact one_dvd n
    · have hlarge : 1 < largestPrimeFactor n := by
        have : 1 ≤ largestPrimeFactor n := le_max_left _ _
        omega
      exact Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactors (hlpf_mem hlarge)
  have hlog_lpf : ∀ {n : ℕ}, 0 < n →
      Real.log n ≤ ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors n * Real.log (largestPrimeFactor n) := by
    intro n hn
    have hbound : (n : ℝ) ≤ (largestPrimeFactor n : ℝ) ^ ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors n := by
      exact_mod_cast hlpf_pow hn.ne'
    have hlg := Real.log_le_log (by exact_mod_cast hn) hbound
    simpa only [Real.log_pow] using hlg
  
  have hs5 : ∀ {n : ℕ}, Real.sqrt z < (n : ℝ) → ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors n ≤ k →
      0 < n ∧ (largestPrimeFactor n).Prime ∧
        Real.log z / (2 * (k : ℝ)) ≤ Real.log (largestPrimeFactor n) := by
    intro n hn hΩ
    have hsqrt2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt z := Real.le_sqrt_of_sq_le (by norm_num; exact hz)
    have hn1 : 1 < n := by exact_mod_cast (show (1 : ℝ) < n by linarith)
    have hnpos : 0 < n := by omega
    have hp := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors (hlpf_mem (hlpf_one_lt hn1))
    refine ⟨hnpos, hp, ?_⟩
    have hln : Real.log z / 2 ≤ Real.log n := by
      have h := Real.log_le_log (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hzpos) hn.le
      simpa only [Real.log_sqrt hzpos.le] using h

      obtain ⟨hnF, hnsmall⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hn
      exact Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (hF n hnF).1.ne_zero,
        Nat.le_floor (le_of_not_gt hnsmall)⟩
    calc
      _ ≤ ((Finset.Icc 1 ⌊Real.sqrt z⌋₊).card : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast Finset.card_le_card hsub
      _ = (⌊Real.sqrt z⌋₊ : ℝ) := by simp
      _ ≤ _ := Nat.floor_le (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
  have hcardG : (A.card : ℝ) + B.card = G.card := by
    exact_mod_cast Finset.card_filter_add_card_filter_not (s := G)
      (fun n => largestPrimeFactor n ∈ Q)
  have hcardF : (G.card : ℝ) + E.card = F.card := by
    exact_mod_cast Finset.card_filter_add_card_filter_not (s := F)
      (fun n : ℕ => Real.sqrt z < n)
  have htotal : (F.card : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt z +
      (D * z / a) * W + (C₀ * z / a) * ((∑ q ∈ Q, (1 : ℝ) / q) * W) := by linarith
  apply htotal.trans_eq
  rw [ha_def]
  field_simp
  ring

signature.name: reciprocal_sum_of_density
signature.statement:
∃ K : ℝ, 0 < K ∧ ∀ (Q : Finset ℕ) (z D : ℝ), Real.exp 1 ≤ z → 0 ≤ D →
      (∀ q ∈ Q, 2 ≤ q ∧ (q : ℝ) ≤ z) →

proof.tactics:
by
  refine ⟨8, by norm_num, ?_⟩
  intro Q z D hz hD hQ hdens
  have he2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp 1 := by linarith [Real.add_one_le_exp (1 : ℝ)]
  have hz2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ z := le_trans he2 hz
  have hz0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ z := by linarith
  have hlog2 : 0 < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  have hlog2' : 1 / 2 < Real.log 2 := by have := Real.log_two_gt_d9; linarith
  have hlog2'' : Real.log 2 < 1 := by have := Real.log_two_lt_d9; linarith
  have hlz : 1 ≤ Real.log z := by
    have := Real.log_le_log (Real.exp_pos 1) hz
    rwa [Real.log_exp] at this
  have hllz : 0 ≤ Real.log (Real.log z) := Real.log_nonneg hlz
  
  have hblock : ∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k →
      (∑ q ∈ Q.filter (fun q : ℕ => Nat.log 2 q = k), (1 : ℝ) / q) ≤ 2 * D / (k * Real.log 2) := by
    intro k hk
    have hk' : (1 : ℝ) ≤ k := by exact_mod_cast hk
    have hkl : 0 < (k : ℝ) * Real.log 2 := mul_pos (by linarith) hlog2
    have hkne : (k : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by linarith
    have hl2ne : Real.log 2 ≠ 0 := hlog2.ne'
    have hmemB : ∀ q ∈ Q.filter (fun q : ℕ => Nat.log 2 q = k),
        q ∈ Q ∧ (2 : ℝ) ^ k ≤ q ∧ (q : ℝ) < 2 ^ (k + 1) := by
      intro q hq
      rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hq
      obtain ⟨hqQ, hqk⟩ := hq
      have hq2 := (hQ q hqQ).1
      have hq0 : q ≠ 0 := by omega
      have h1 : 2 ^ k ≤ q := by rw [← hqk]; exact Nat.pow_log_le_self 2 hq0
      have h2 : q < 2 ^ (k + 1) := by rw [← hqk]; exact Nat.lt_pow_succ_log_self (by norm_num) q
      refine ⟨hqQ, by exact_mod_cast h1, by exact_mod_cast h2⟩
    rcases (Q.filter (fun q : ℕ => Nat.log 2 q = k)).eq_empty_or_nonempty with hBe | ⟨q0, hq0⟩
    · rw [hBe, Finset.sum_empty]; exact div_nonneg (by linarith) hkl.le
    obtain ⟨hq0Q, hq0k, _⟩ := hmemB q0 hq0
    have h2kz : (2 : ℝ) ^ k ≤ z := le_trans hq0k (hQ q0 hq0Q).2
    have hpk : (0 : ℝ) < 2 ^ k := by positivity
    have h2k1 : (2 : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) = 2 * 2 ^ k := by ring
    have h2k2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ 2 ^ k := by
      calc (2 : ℝ) = 2 ^ 1 := by norm_num
        _ ≤ 2 ^ k := pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) hk
    have hx2 : 2 ≤ min ((2 : ℝ) ^ (k + 1)) z := le_min (by linarith) hz2
    have hxz : min ((2 : ℝ) ^ (k + 1)) z ≤ z := min_le_right _ _
    have hxu : min ((2 : ℝ) ^ (k + 1)) z ≤ 2 ^ (k + 1) := min_le_left _ _
    have hxl : (2 : ℝ) ^ k ≤ min ((2 : ℝ) ^ (k + 1)) z := le_min (by linarith) h2kz
    have hsub : Q.filter (fun q : ℕ => Nat.log 2 q = k) ⊆
        Q.filter (fun q : ℕ => (q : ℝ) ≤ min ((2 : ℝ) ^ (k + 1)) z) := by
      intro q hq
      obtain ⟨hqQ, _, hqu⟩ := hmemB q hq
      rw [Finset.mem_filter]
      exact ⟨hqQ, le_min hqu.le (hQ q hqQ).2⟩
    have hcard : ((Q.filter (fun q : ℕ => Nat.log 2 q = k)).card : ℝ) ≤
        D * min ((2 : ℝ) ^ (k + 1)) z / Real.log (min ((2 : ℝ) ^ (k + 1)) z) := by
      have := Finset.card_le_card hsub
      calc ((Q.filter (fun q : ℕ => Nat.log 2 q = k)).card : ℝ)
          ≤ ((Q.filter (fun q : ℕ => (q : ℝ) ≤ min ((2 : ℝ) ^ (k + 1)) z)).card : ℝ) := by
            exact_mod_cast this
        _ ≤ _ := hdens _ hx2 hxz
    have hlogx : (k : ℝ) * Real.log 2 ≤ Real.log (min ((2 : ℝ) ^ (k + 1)) z) := by
      have := Real.log_le_log hpk hxl
      rwa [Real.log_pow] at this
    have hcard2 : ((Q.filter (fun q : ℕ => Nat.log 2 q = k)).card : ℝ) ≤
        D * 2 ^ (k + 1) / (k * Real.log 2) := by
      calc ((Q.filter (fun q : ℕ => Nat.log 2 q = k)).card : ℝ)
          ≤ D * min ((2 : ℝ) ^ (k + 1)) z / Real.log (min ((2 : ℝ) ^ (k + 1)) z) := hcard
        _ ≤ D * 2 ^ (k + 1) / (k * Real.log 2) :=
          div_le_div₀ (mul_nonneg hD (by positivity)) (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hxu hD) hkl hlogx
    have hterm : ∀ q ∈ Q.filter (fun q : ℕ => Nat.log 2 q = k), (1 : ℝ) / q ≤ 1 / 2 ^ k := by
      intro q hq
      exact one_div_le_one_div_of_le hpk (hmemB q hq).2.1
    calc (∑ q ∈ Q.filter (fun q : ℕ => Nat.log 2 q = k), (1 : ℝ) / q)
        ≤ ∑ q ∈ Q.filter (fun q : ℕ => Nat.log 2 q = k), (1 : ℝ) / 2 ^ k :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum hterm
      _ = ((Q.filter (fun q : ℕ => Nat.log 2 q = k)).card : ℝ) * (1 / 2 ^ k) := by
          rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
      _ ≤ (D * 2 ^ (k + 1) / (k * Real.log 2)) * (1 / 2 ^ k) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcard2 (by positivity)
      _ = 2 * D / (k * Real.log 2) := by
          rw [h2k1]; field_simp
  
  have hfl2 : 2 ≤ ⌊z⌋₊ := Nat.le_floor (by exact_mod_cast hz2)
  have hM1 : 1 ≤ Nat.log 2 ⌊z⌋₊ := Nat.log_pos (by norm_num) hfl2
  have hharm : (∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (Nat.log 2 ⌊z⌋₊), (1 : ℝ) / k) ≤
      2 * (1 + Real.log (Real.log z)) := by
    have hH : (∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (Nat.log 2 ⌊z⌋₊), (1 : ℝ) / k) =
        (harmonic (Nat.log 2 ⌊z⌋₊) : ℝ) := by
      rw [harmonic_eq_sum_Icc]; push_cast; simp [one_div]
    rw [hH]
    have h1 := harmonic_le_one_add_log (Nat.log 2 ⌊z⌋₊)
    have hMpos : (0 : ℝ) < (Nat.log 2 ⌊z⌋₊ : ℕ) := by exact_mod_cast hM1
    have h2M : (2 : ℝ) ^ (Nat.log 2 ⌊z⌋₊) ≤ z := by
      have : 2 ^ (Nat.log 2 ⌊z⌋₊) ≤ ⌊z⌋₊ := Nat.pow_log_le_self 2 (by omega)
      calc (2 : ℝ) ^ (Nat.log 2 ⌊z⌋₊) = ((2 ^ (Nat.log 2 ⌊z⌋₊) : ℕ) : ℝ) := by push_cast; ring
        _ ≤ (⌊z⌋₊ : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast this
        _ ≤ z := Nat.floor_le hz0
    have hMlog : ((Nat.log 2 ⌊z⌋₊ : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log 2 ≤ Real.log z := by
      have := Real.log_le_log (by positivity) h2M
      rwa [Real.log_pow] at this
    have hM2 : ((Nat.log 2 ⌊z⌋₊ : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ 2 * Real.log z := by nlinarith
    have hlogM : Real.log ((Nat.log 2 ⌊z⌋₊ : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ Real.log 2 + Real.log (Real.log z) := by
      rw [← Real.log_mul (by norm_num) (by linarith)]
      exact Real.log_le_log hMpos hM2
    linarith
  
  have hmaps : ∀ q ∈ Q, Nat.log 2 q ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (Nat.log 2 ⌊z⌋₊) := by
    intro q hq
    obtain ⟨hq2, hqz⟩ := hQ q hq
    rw [Finset.mem_Icc]
    exact ⟨Nat.log_pos (by norm_num) hq2, Nat.log_mono_right (Nat.le_floor hqz)⟩
  rw [← Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to hmaps]
  calc (∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (Nat.log 2 ⌊z⌋₊), ∑ q ∈ Q with Nat.log 2 q = k, (1 : ℝ) / q)
      ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (Nat.log 2 ⌊z⌋₊), 2 * D / (k * Real.log 2) := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro k hk
        exact hblock k (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hk).1
    _ = (2 * D / Real.log 2) * ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (Nat.log 2 ⌊z⌋₊), (1 : ℝ) / k := by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro k hk
        have hk1 := (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hk).1
        have : (k : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (by omega)
        have : Real.log 2 ≠ 0 := hlog2.ne'
        field_simp
    _ ≤ (2 * D / Real.log 2) * (2 * (1 + Real.log (Real.log z))) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hharm (div_nonneg (by linarith) hlog2.le)
    _ ≤ 8 * D * (1 + Real.log (Real.log z)) := by
        have hinv : 1 / Real.log 2 ≤ 2 := by
          rw [div_le_iff₀ hlog2]; linarith
        have hX : 0 ≤ D * (1 + Real.log (Real.log z)) := mul_nonneg hD (by linarith)
        calc (2 * D / Real.log 2) * (2 * (1 + Real.log (Real.log z)))
            = 4 * (1 / Real.log 2) * (D * (1 + Real.log (Real.log z))) := by ring
          _ ≤ 4 * 2 * (D * (1 + Real.log (Real.log z))) := by
              apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ hX; linarith
          _ = 8 * D * (1 + Real.log (Real.log z)) := by ring

informal_problem.statement:
∀ (w : ℕ → ℝ), (∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → 0 ≤ w p ∧ w p ≤ 7 / 4) →
    ∀ (x : ℝ) (F : Finset ℕ), (∀ n ∈ F, 0 < n ∧ ∀ p ∈ n.primeFactors, (p : ℝ) ≤ x) →
    (∑ n ∈ F, (n.primeFactorsList.map w).prod / (n.totient : ℝ)) ≤
      Real.exp ((∑ p ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊x⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, w p / p) + 36)

signature.name: weighted_totient_euler_bound
signature.statement:
∀ (w : ℕ → ℝ), (∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → 0 ≤ w p ∧ w p ≤ 7 / 4) →
    ∀ (x : ℝ) (F : Finset ℕ), (∀ n ∈ F, 0 < n ∧ ∀ p ∈ n.primeFactors, (p : ℝ) ≤ x) →
    (∑ n ∈ F, (n.primeFactorsList.map w).prod / (n.totient : ℝ)) ≤
      Real.exp ((∑ p ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊x⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, w p / p) + 36)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have s1 : ∀ (p : ℕ), p.Prime → ∀ (w : ℝ), 0 ≤ w → w ≤ 7 / 4 → ∀ e : ℕ,
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (e + 1), w ^ i / ((p ^ i).totient : ℝ)) ≤
        1 + w * (p : ℝ) / (((p : ℝ) - 1) * ((p : ℝ) - w)) := by
    intro p hp w hw0 hw1 e
    have hq : (2:ℝ) ≤ p := by exact_mod_cast hp.two_le
    have hq1 : (0:ℝ) < (p:ℝ) - 1 := by linarith
    have hqw : (0:ℝ) < (p:ℝ) - w := by linarith
    have hq0 : (0:ℝ) < p := by linarith
    set r := w / (p:ℝ) with hr
    have hr0 : 0 ≤ r := div_nonneg hw0 hq0.le
    have hr1 : r < 1 := by rw [hr, div_lt_one hq0]; linarith
    have hterm : ∀ i : ℕ, w ^ (i+1) / ((p ^ (i+1)).totient : ℝ) = (w / ((p:ℝ) - 1)) * r ^ i := by
      intro i
      rw [Nat.totient_prime_pow_succ hp, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_sub hp.one_le,
        Nat.cast_one, hr, div_pow]
      field_simp
      ring
    rw [Finset.sum_range_succ']
    simp only [hterm, pow_zero, Nat.totient_one, Nat.cast_one, div_one]
    rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
    have hkey : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range e, r ^ i) * (1 - r) ≤ 1 := by
      rw [geom_sum_mul_neg]
      linarith [pow_nonneg hr0 e]
    have hpw : (p:ℝ) - w = (1 - r) * p := by rw [hr]; field_simp
    have hgeom : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range e, r ^ i ≤ (p:ℝ) / ((p:ℝ) - w) := by
      rw [le_div_iff₀ hqw, hpw]
      nlinarith
    have hc : 0 ≤ w / ((p:ℝ) - 1) := div_nonneg hw0 hq1.le
    calc w / ((p:ℝ) - 1) * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range e, r ^ i + 1
        ≤ w / ((p:ℝ) - 1) * ((p:ℝ) / ((p:ℝ) - w)) + 1 := by gcongr
      _ = 1 + w * (p : ℝ) / (((p : ℝ) - 1) * ((p : ℝ) - w)) := by
        field_simp
        ring
  
  have s2 : ∀ (p w : ℝ), 2 ≤ p → 0 ≤ w → w ≤ 7 / 4 →
      w * p / ((p - 1) * (p - w)) ≤ w / p + 28 / (p * (p - 1)) := by
    intro p w hp hw0 hw1
    have h1 : 0 < p - 1 := by linarith
    have h2 : 0 < p - w := by linarith
    have h0 : 0 < p := by linarith
    have hid : w / p + 28 / (p * (p - 1)) - w * p / ((p - 1) * (p - w)) =
        (28 * (p - w) - w * (p * w + p - w)) / (p * (p - 1) * (p - w)) := by
      field_simp
      ring
    have hnum : 0 ≤ 28 * (p - w) - w * (p * w + p - w) := by
      have ha : 0 ≤ (p - 2) * (28 - w ^ 2 - w) := by
        apply mul_nonneg (by linarith); nlinarith
      nlinarith
    have : 0 ≤ (28 * (p - w) - w * (p * w + p - w)) / (p * (p - 1) * (p - w)) := by
      apply div_nonneg hnum; positivity
    linarith
  
  have s3 : ∀ (P : Finset ℕ), (∀ p ∈ P, 2 ≤ p) →
      (∑ p ∈ P, (1 : ℝ) / ((p : ℝ) * ((p : ℝ) - 1))) ≤ 1 := by
    intro P hP
    have tele : ∀ M : ℕ, ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 2 (M+1), (1:ℝ) / ((n:ℝ) * ((n:ℝ) - 1)) =
        1 - 1 / ((M:ℝ)+1) := by
      intro M
      induction M with
      | zero => simp
      | succ k ih =>
        rw [Finset.sum_Icc_succ_top (by omega : 2 ≤ k + 1 + 1), ih]
        push_cast
        have e1 : ((k:ℝ) + 1 + 1) - 1 = (k:ℝ) + 1 := by ring
        rw [e1]
        field_simp
        ring
    set M := P.sup id
    have hsub : P ⊆ Finset.Icc 2 (M+1) := by
      intro p hp
      rw [Finset.mem_Icc]
      refine ⟨hP p hp, ?_⟩
      have := Finset.le_sup (f := id) hp
      simp only [id] at this
      omega
    calc _ ≤ ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 2 (M+1), (1:ℝ) / ((n:ℝ) * ((n:ℝ) - 1)) := by
          apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hsub
          intro n hn _
          rw [Finset.mem_Icc] at hn
          have : (2:ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast hn.1
          apply div_nonneg zero_le_one
          nlinarith
      _ = 1 - 1/((M:ℝ)+1) := tele M
      _ ≤ 1 := by
          have : 0 ≤ 1/((M:ℝ)+1) := by positivity
          linarith
  
  have s4 : ∀ (w : ℕ → ℝ), (∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → 0 ≤ w p) → ∀ (P F : Finset ℕ) (B : ℕ → ℝ),
      (∀ p ∈ P, p.Prime) → (∀ n ∈ F, 0 < n ∧ n.primeFactors ⊆ P) →
      (∀ p ∈ P, ∀ e : ℕ, (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (e + 1), (w p) ^ i / ((p ^ i).totient : ℝ)) ≤ B p) →
      (∑ n ∈ F, (n.primeFactorsList.map w).prod / (n.totient : ℝ)) ≤ ∏ p ∈ P, B p := by
    intro w hw P F B hP hF hB
    let f : ArithmeticFunction ℝ :=
      ⟨fun n => (n.primeFactorsList.map w).prod / (n.totient : ℝ), by simp⟩
    have hfapp : ∀ n, f n = (n.primeFactorsList.map w).prod / (n.totient : ℝ) := fun n => rfl
    have hfnn : ∀ n, 0 ≤ f n := by
      intro n
      rw [hfapp]
      apply div_nonneg _ (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
      apply List.prod_nonneg
      intro a ha
      rw [List.mem_map] at ha
      obtain ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩ := ha
      exact hw q (Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactorsList hq)
    have hfmul : f.IsMultiplicative := by
      rw [ArithmeticFunction.IsMultiplicative.iff_ne_zero]
      refine ⟨by simp [hfapp], ?_⟩
      intro m n hm hn hmn
      rw [hfapp, hfapp, hfapp, ((Nat.perm_primeFactorsList_mul hm hn).map w).prod_eq,
        List.map_append, List.prod_append, Nat.totient_mul hmn, Nat.cast_mul, div_mul_div_comm]
    have hfpow : ∀ p, p.Prime → ∀ i : ℕ, f (p ^ i) = (w p) ^ i / ((p ^ i).totient : ℝ) := by
      intro p hp i
      rw [hfapp, hp.primeFactorsList_pow, List.map_replicate, List.prod_replicate]
    set K := F.sup id
    set N := (∏ p ∈ P, p) ^ (K + 1) with hNdef
    have hN0 : N ≠ 0 := by
      apply pow_ne_zero
      rw [Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff]
      intro p hp
      exact (hP p hp).ne_zero
    have hNpf : N.primeFactors = P := by
      rw [hNdef, Nat.primeFactors_pow _ (by omega), Nat.primeFactors_prod hP]
    have hFsub : F ⊆ N.divisors := by
      intro n hn
      obtain ⟨hn0, hnP⟩ := hF n hn
      rw [Nat.mem_divisors]
      refine ⟨?_, hN0⟩
      have hnK : n ≤ K := by
        have := Finset.le_sup (f := id) hn
        simpa using this
      have h1 : n ∣ ∏ q ∈ n.primeFactors, q ^ (K + 1) := by
        conv_lhs => rw [← Nat.factorization_prod_pow_eq_self hn0.ne']
        rw [Finsupp.prod, Nat.support_factorization]
        apply Finset.prod_dvd_prod_of_dvd
        intro q _
        apply pow_dvd_pow
        have := Nat.factorization_lt q hn0.ne'
        omega
      rw [Finset.prod_pow] at h1
      exact h1.trans (pow_dvd_pow_of_dvd (Finset.prod_dvd_prod_of_subset _ _ _ hnP) _)
    have hzmul : (f * (ArithmeticFunction.zeta : ArithmeticFunction ℝ)).IsMultiplicative :=
      hfmul.mul ArithmeticFunction.isMultiplicative_zeta.natCast
    calc (∑ n ∈ F, (n.primeFactorsList.map w).prod / (n.totient : ℝ))
        = ∑ n ∈ F, f n := rfl
      _ ≤ ∑ n ∈ N.divisors, f n :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hFsub (fun n _ _ => hfnn n)
      _ = (f * (ArithmeticFunction.zeta : ArithmeticFunction ℝ)) N :=
          ArithmeticFunction.coe_mul_zeta_apply.symm
      _ = ∏ p ∈ P, (f * (ArithmeticFunction.zeta : ArithmeticFunction ℝ))
            (p ^ (N.factorization p)) := by
          rw [hzmul.multiplicative_factorization _ hN0, Finsupp.prod, Nat.support_factorization,
            hNpf]
      _ ≤ ∏ p ∈ P, B p := by
          apply Finset.prod_le_prod
          · intro p _
            rw [ArithmeticFunction.coe_mul_zeta_apply]
            exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun n _ => hfnn n)
          · intro p hp
            rw [ArithmeticFunction.coe_mul_zeta_apply, Nat.sum_divisors_prime_pow (hP p hp)]
            simp only [hfpow p (hP p hp)]
            exact hB p hp _

    have h := (abs_sub
      ((∑ p ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊v⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, (1 : ℝ) / p) - Real.log (Real.log v))
      ((∑ p ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊u⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, (1 : ℝ) / p) - Real.log (Real.log u))).trans
        (add_le_add h₁ h₂)
    have heq : (∑ p ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊v⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, (1 : ℝ) / p) -
        (∑ p ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊u⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, (1 : ℝ) / p) -
        (Real.log (Real.log v) - Real.log (Real.log u)) =
        ((∑ p ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊v⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, (1 : ℝ) / p) - Real.log (Real.log v)) -
        ((∑ p ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊u⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, (1 : ℝ) / p) - Real.log (Real.log u)) := by
      ring
    rw [heq]
    linarith
  
  have hmoment : ∀ (x u v z : ℝ) (F : Finset ℕ), 2 ≤ u → u ≤ v → v ≤ x → 0 ≤ z → z ≤ 7 / 4 →
      (∀ n ∈ F, 0 < n ∧ ∀ p ∈ n.primeFactors, (p : ℝ) ≤ x) →
      (∑ n ∈ F, z ^ omegaInterval n u v / (n.totient : ℝ)) ≤
        Real.exp (36 + 3 * |B|) * Real.log x *
          Real.exp ((z - 1) * (Real.log (Real.log v) - Real.log (Real.log u))) := by
    intro x u v z F hu huv hvx hz0 hz hF
    have hx2 : 2 ≤ x := (hu.trans huv).trans hvx
    have hlog : 0 < Real.log x := Real.log_pos (by linarith)
    let w : ℕ → ℝ := fun p => if u < (p : ℝ) ∧ (p : ℝ) ≤ v then z else 1
    have hw : ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → 0 ≤ w p ∧ w p ≤ 7 / 4 := by
      intro p _
      simp only [w]
      split_ifs <;> constructor <;> linarith
    have hbound := hEuler w hw x F hF
    have hprod : ∀ l : List ℕ, (l.map w).prod =
        z ^ (l.countP (fun p : ℕ => decide (u < (p : ℝ) ∧ (p : ℝ) ≤ v))) := by
      intro l
      induction l with
      | nil => simp
      | cons q l ih =>
        rw [List.map_cons, List.prod_cons, ih, List.countP_cons]
        by_cases hq : u < (q : ℝ) ∧ (q : ℝ) ≤ v
        · have hwq : w q = z := if_pos hq
          rw [hwq, if_pos (by simpa using hq), pow_succ, mul_comm]
        · have hwq : w q = 1 := if_neg hq
          rw [hwq, if_neg (by simpa using hq), one_mul, add_zero]
    have hsum : (∑ n ∈ F, (n.primeFactorsList.map w).prod / (n.totient : ℝ)) =
        ∑ n ∈ F, z ^ omegaInterval n u v / (n.totient : ℝ) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro n _
      rw [hprod]
      rfl
    have htilt : ∀ P : Finset ℕ, (∑ p ∈ P, w p / p) = (∑ p ∈ P, (1 : ℝ) / p) +
        (z - 1) * ∑ p ∈ P.filter (fun p : ℕ => u < (p : ℝ) ∧ (p : ℝ) ≤ v), (1 : ℝ) / p := by
      intro P
      rw [Finset.sum_filter, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro p _
      by_cases h : u < (p : ℝ) ∧ (p : ℝ) ≤ v
      · simp only [w, if_pos h]
        ring
      · simp only [w, if_neg h]
        ring
    rw [hsum, htilt] at hbound
    have hIμ := hI u v x hu huv hvx
    have hzabs : |z - 1| ≤ 1 := by rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith
    have hperturb : (z - 1) * ((∑ p ∈ ((Finset.Iic ⌊x⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime).filter
          (fun p : ℕ => u < (p : ℝ) ∧ (p : ℝ) ≤ v), (1 : ℝ) / p) -
        (Real.log (Real.log v) - Real.log (Real.log u))) ≤ 2 * |B| := by
      refine (le_abs_self _).trans ?_
      rw [abs_mul]
      calc _ ≤ 1 * (2 * |B|) := mul_le_mul hzabs hIμ (abs_nonneg _) zero_le_one
        _ = _ := one_mul _
    have hbase := (abs_le.mp (hB x hx2)).2
    have hexponent : (∑ p ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊x⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, (1 : ℝ) / p) +
        (z - 1) * (∑ p ∈ ((Finset.Iic ⌊x⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime).filter
          (fun p : ℕ => u < (p : ℝ) ∧ (p : ℝ) ≤ v), (1 : ℝ) / p) + 36 ≤
        (36 + 3 * |B|) + Real.log (Real.log x) +
          (z - 1) * (Real.log (Real.log v) - Real.log (Real.log u)) := by
      nlinarith [le_abs_self B]
    calc
      _ ≤ _ := hbound
      _ ≤ Real.exp ((36 + 3 * |B|) + Real.log (Real.log x) +
          (z - 1) * (Real.log (Real.log v) - Real.log (Real.log u))) :=
        Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hexponent
      _ = _ := by rw [Real.exp_add, Real.exp_add, Real.exp_log hlog]
  
  have hchern : ∀ (H : Finset ℕ) (a wt : ℕ → ℝ) (C μ M θ : ℝ), (∀ i ∈ H, 0 ≤ wt i) → 0 ≤ C →
      0 ≤ μ → μ ≤ M → |θ| ≤ 1 → (∀ i ∈ H, 2 * M * θ ^ 2 ≤ θ * (a i - μ)) →
      (∑ i ∈ H, wt i * Real.exp (θ * a i)) ≤ C * Real.exp ((Real.exp θ - 1) * μ) →
      (∑ i ∈ H, wt i) ≤ C * Real.exp (-M * θ ^ 2) := by
    intro H a wt C μ M θ hw hC hμ0 hμM hθ hF hmom
    have hweighted : Real.exp (θ * μ + 2 * M * θ ^ 2) * (∑ i ∈ H, wt i) ≤
        ∑ i ∈ H, wt i * Real.exp (θ * a i) := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro i hi
      have h := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (show θ * μ + 2 * M * θ ^ 2 ≤ θ * a i by
        nlinarith [hF i hi])
      have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h (hw i hi)
      linarith [mul_comm (Real.exp (θ * μ + 2 * M * θ ^ 2)) (wt i),
        mul_comm (Real.exp (θ * a i)) (wt i)]
    have hexp : Real.exp θ - 1 - θ ≤ θ ^ 2 :=
      (le_abs_self _).trans (Real.abs_exp_sub_one_sub_id_le hθ)
    have hexponent : (Real.exp θ - 1) * μ - (θ * μ + 2 * M * θ ^ 2) ≤ -M * θ ^ 2 := by
      have h₁ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hexp hμ0
      have h₂ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hμM (sq_nonneg θ)
      nlinarith
    calc
      _ ≤ C * Real.exp ((Real.exp θ - 1) * μ) / Real.exp (θ * μ + 2 * M * θ ^ 2) := by
        apply (le_div_iff₀ (Real.exp_pos _)).mpr
        have := hweighted.trans hmom
        linarith [mul_comm (Real.exp (θ * μ + 2 * M * θ ^ 2)) (∑ i ∈ H, wt i)]
      _ = C * Real.exp ((Real.exp θ - 1) * μ - (θ * μ + 2 * M * θ ^ 2)) := by
        rw [Real.exp_sub]
        ring
      _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hexponent) hC
  
  have hK : 0 < Real.exp (36 + 3 * |B|) := Real.exp_pos _
  refine ⟨2 * Real.exp (36 + 3 * |B|), by positivity, ?_⟩
  intro x u v h M F hu huv hvx hh hhM hΔM hF hdev
  have hΔ0 : 0 ≤ Real.log (Real.log v) - Real.log (Real.log u) := sub_nonneg.mpr
    (Real.log_le_log (Real.log_pos (by linarith)) (Real.log_le_log (by linarith) huv))
  have hx2 : 2 ≤ x := (hu.trans huv).trans hvx
  have hlog : 0 < Real.log x := Real.log_pos (by linarith)
  have hM : 0 < M := hh.trans_le hhM
  have htail : ∀ (H : Finset ℕ), H ⊆ F → ∀ (θ : ℝ), |θ| ≤ 1 / 2 →
      (∀ n ∈ H, 2 * M * θ ^ 2 ≤ θ * ((omegaInterval n u v : ℝ) -
        (Real.log (Real.log v) - Real.log (Real.log u)))) →
      (∑ n ∈ H, (1 : ℝ) / (n.totient : ℝ)) ≤
        (Real.exp (36 + 3 * |B|) * Real.log x) * Real.exp (-M * θ ^ 2) := by
    intro H hHF θ hθhalf hH
    have hθ1 : |θ| ≤ 1 := hθhalf.trans (by norm_num)
    have hexp : Real.exp θ ≤ 7 / 4 := by
      have h1 := (abs_le.mp (Real.abs_exp_sub_one_sub_id_le hθ1)).2
      have hθupper := (abs_le.mp hθhalf).2
      have hθlower := (abs_le.mp hθhalf).1
      nlinarith
    have hm := hmoment x u v (Real.exp θ) H hu huv hvx (Real.exp_pos _).le hexp
      (fun n hn => hF n (hHF hn))
    have hm' : (∑ n ∈ H, (1 : ℝ) / (n.totient : ℝ) * Real.exp (θ * (omegaInterval n u v : ℝ))) ≤
        (Real.exp (36 + 3 * |B|) * Real.log x) *
          Real.exp ((Real.exp θ - 1) * (Real.log (Real.log v) - Real.log (Real.log u))) := by
      convert hm using 1
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro n _
      rw [show θ * (omegaInterval n u v : ℝ) = (omegaInterval n u v : ℝ) * θ by ring,
        Real.exp_nat_mul]
      ring
    exact hchern H (fun n => (omegaInterval n u v : ℝ)) (fun n => (1 : ℝ) / (n.totient : ℝ))
      _ _ M θ (fun n _ => div_nonneg zero_le_one (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
      (mul_nonneg hK.le hlog.le) hΔ0 hΔM hθ1 hH hm'
  set Δ := Real.log (Real.log v) - Real.log (Real.log u) with hΔdef
  set α := h / (2 * M) with hαdef
  have hα : 0 < α := div_pos hh (by positivity)
  have hαhalf : α ≤ 1 / 2 := (div_le_iff₀ (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * M)).mpr (by linarith)
  have hαabs : |α| ≤ 1 / 2 := by rwa [abs_of_pos hα]
  have hαeq : 2 * M * α ^ 2 = α * h := by
    rw [hαdef]; field_simp; try ring
  have hαexp : -M * α ^ 2 = -h ^ 2 / (4 * M) := by
    rw [hαdef]; field_simp; try ring
  have hplus := htail (F.filter (fun n => Δ ≤ (omegaInterval n u v : ℝ)))
    (Finset.filter_subset _ _) α hαabs (by
      intro n hn
      have hdata := Finset.mem_filter.mp hn
      have hnonneg : 0 ≤ (omegaInterval n u v : ℝ) - Δ := sub_nonneg.mpr hdata.2
      have hd := hdev n hdata.1
      rw [abs_of_nonneg hnonneg] at hd
      rw [hαeq]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hd hα.le)
  have hminus := htail (F.filter (fun n => ¬ (Δ ≤ (omegaInterval n u v : ℝ))))
    (Finset.filter_subset _ _) (-α) (by rwa [abs_neg]) (by
      intro n hn
      have hdata := Finset.mem_filter.mp hn
      have hnonpos : (omegaInterval n u v : ℝ) - Δ ≤ 0 := by
        have hlt : (omegaInterval n u v : ℝ) < Δ := lt_of_not_ge hdata.2
        linarith
      have hd := hdev n hdata.1
      rw [abs_of_nonpos hnonpos] at hd
      rw [neg_sq, hαeq]
      calc
        _ ≤ α * -((omegaInterval n u v : ℝ) - Δ) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hd hα.le
        _ = _ := by ring)
  rw [hαexp] at hplus
  rw [neg_sq, hαexp] at hminus
  calc
    _ = (∑ n ∈ F.filter (fun n => Δ ≤ (omegaInterval n u v : ℝ)), (1 : ℝ) / (n.totient : ℝ)) +
        (∑ n ∈ F.filter (fun n => ¬ (Δ ≤ (omegaInterval n u v : ℝ))),
          (1 : ℝ) / (n.totient : ℝ)) :=
      (Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not F _ _).symm
    _ ≤ (Real.exp (36 + 3 * |B|) * Real.log x) * Real.exp (-h ^ 2 / (4 * M)) +
        (Real.exp (36 + 3 * |B|) * Real.log x) * Real.exp (-h ^ 2 / (4 * M)) :=
      add_le_add hplus hminus
    _ = _ := by ring

informal_problem.statement:
(hMERT : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ, 2 ≤ x →
      |(∑ p ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊x⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, (1 : ℝ) / p) - Real.log (Real.log x)| ≤ C)
    (hEuler : ∀ (w : ℕ → ℝ), (∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → 0 ≤ w p ∧ w p ≤ 7 / 4) →
      ∀ (x : ℝ) (F : Finset ℕ), (∀ n ∈ F, 0 < n ∧ ∀ p ∈ n.primeFactors, (p : ℝ) ≤ x) →
      (∑ n ∈ F, (n.primeFactorsList.map w).prod / (n.totient : ℝ)) ≤
        Real.exp ((∑ p ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊x⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, w p / p) + 36)) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ (x S : ℝ) (F : Finset ℕ), 2 ≤ x → Real.exp 1 ≤ S →
      (∀ n ∈ F, 0 < n ∧ ∀ p ∈ n.primeFactors, (p : ℝ) ≤ x) →
      (∀ n ∈ F, 2 * Real.log (Real.log S) - 1 ≤ (omegaInterval n 1 S : ℝ)) →
      (∑ n ∈ F, (1 : ℝ) / (n.totient : ℝ)) ≤ C * Real.log x * Real.exp (-Real.log (Real.log S) / 6)

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := hMERT
  obtain ⟨K, hKdef⟩ : ∃ K : ℝ, K = Real.exp (36 + 2 * |B|) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hK : 0 < K := by rw [hKdef]; exact Real.exp_pos _
  refine ⟨(3 / 2 : ℝ) * K, by positivity, ?_⟩
  intro x S F hx hS hF hdev
  have hS2 : 2 ≤ S := by linarith [Real.add_one_le_exp (1 : ℝ)]
  have hlog : 0 < Real.log x := Real.log_pos (by linarith)
  have hlogS : 1 ≤ Real.log S := by
    simpa only [Real.log_exp] using Real.log_le_log (Real.exp_pos 1) hS
  have hL : 0 ≤ Real.log (Real.log S) := Real.log_nonneg hlogS
  have hlogthree : (1 / 3 : ℝ) ≤ Real.log (3 / 2) := by
    have h := Real.one_sub_inv_le_log_of_pos (show (0 : ℝ) < 3 / 2 by norm_num)
    norm_num at h
    linarith
  
  obtain ⟨w, hwdef⟩ : ∃ w : ℕ → ℝ,
      w = fun p : ℕ => if (1 : ℝ) < (p : ℝ) ∧ (p : ℝ) ≤ S then (3 / 2 : ℝ) else 1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hw : ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → 0 ≤ w p ∧ w p ≤ 7 / 4 := by
    intro p _
    simp only [hwdef]
    split_ifs <;> norm_num
  have hlist : ∀ l : List ℕ, (l.map w).prod =
      (3 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (l.countP (fun p : ℕ => decide ((1 : ℝ) < (p : ℝ) ∧ (p : ℝ) ≤ S))) := by
    intro l
    induction l with
    | nil => simp
    | cons a t ih =>
      rw [List.map_cons, List.prod_cons, ih, List.countP_cons]
      by_cases h : (1 : ℝ) < (a : ℝ) ∧ (a : ℝ) ≤ S
      · simp only [decide_eq_true_eq, if_pos h, hwdef]
        rw [pow_succ, mul_comm]
      · simp only [decide_eq_true_eq, if_neg h, hwdef, add_zero, one_mul]
  have htilt : ∀ n : ℕ, (n.primeFactorsList.map w).prod = (3 / 2 : ℝ) ^ omegaInterval n 1 S := by
    intro n
    rw [hlist]
    rfl
  have hbound := hEuler w hw x F hF
  
  have hsplitP : ∀ P : Finset ℕ, (∑ p ∈ P, w p / p) =
      (∑ p ∈ P, (1 : ℝ) / p) +
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ p ∈ P.filter
          (fun p : ℕ => (1 : ℝ) < (p : ℝ) ∧ (p : ℝ) ≤ S), (1 : ℝ) / p := by
    intro P
    rw [Finset.sum_filter, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro p _
    simp only [hwdef]
    by_cases h : (1 : ℝ) < (p : ℝ) ∧ (p : ℝ) ≤ S
    · rw [if_pos h, if_pos h]; ring
    · rw [if_neg h, if_neg h]; ring
  have hsub : ((Finset.Iic ⌊x⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime).filter
      (fun p : ℕ => (1 : ℝ) < (p : ℝ) ∧ (p : ℝ) ≤ S) ⊆ (Finset.Iic ⌊S⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime := by
    intro p hp
    rw [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_filter] at hp
    rw [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Iic]
    exact ⟨Nat.le_floor hp.2.2, hp.1.2⟩
  have hprefix : (∑ p ∈ ((Finset.Iic ⌊x⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime).filter
      (fun p : ℕ => (1 : ℝ) < (p : ℝ) ∧ (p : ℝ) ≤ S), (1 : ℝ) / p) ≤
      Real.log (Real.log S) + |B| := by
    have hsumle := Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hsub
      (f := fun p : ℕ => (1 : ℝ) / p) (fun _ _ _ => by positivity)
    have h := (abs_le.mp (hB S hS2)).2
    linarith [le_abs_self B]
  have hbase := (abs_le.mp (hB x hx)).2
  have hexponent : (∑ p ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊x⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, w p / p) + 36 ≤
      (36 + 2 * |B|) + Real.log (Real.log x) + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log (Real.log S) := by
    rw [hsplitP]
    linarith [le_abs_self B, abs_nonneg B]
  have hmoment : (∑ n ∈ F, (3 / 2 : ℝ) ^ omegaInterval n 1 S / (n.totient : ℝ)) ≤
      K * Real.log x * Real.exp ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log (Real.log S)) := by
    have hsum : (∑ n ∈ F, (n.primeFactorsList.map w).prod / (n.totient : ℝ)) =
        ∑ n ∈ F, (3 / 2 : ℝ) ^ omegaInterval n 1 S / (n.totient : ℝ) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro n _
      rw [htilt]
    rw [← hsum]
    calc _ ≤ Real.exp ((∑ p ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊x⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, w p / p) + 36) := hbound
      _ ≤ Real.exp ((36 + 2 * |B|) + Real.log (Real.log x) +
          (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log (Real.log S)) := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hexponent
      _ = _ := by rw [Real.exp_add, Real.exp_add, Real.exp_log hlog, hKdef]
  
  have hweighted : (3 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (2 * Real.log (Real.log S) - 1) *
      (∑ n ∈ F, (1 : ℝ) / (n.totient : ℝ)) ≤
      ∑ n ∈ F, (3 / 2 : ℝ) ^ omegaInterval n 1 S / (n.totient : ℝ) := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]

    rw [Real.rpow_natCast] at hpow
    have hnn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / (n.totient : ℝ) := by positivity
    have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hpow hnn
    calc (3 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (2 * Real.log (Real.log S) - 1) * (1 / (n.totient : ℝ))
        ≤ (3 / 2 : ℝ) ^ omegaInterval n 1 S * (1 / (n.totient : ℝ)) := h2
      _ = (3 / 2 : ℝ) ^ omegaInterval n 1 S / (n.totient : ℝ) := by ring
  have hexponent2 : (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log (Real.log S) -
      Real.log (3 / 2) * (2 * Real.log (Real.log S) - 1) ≤
      Real.log (3 / 2) - Real.log (Real.log S) / 6 := by
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hlogthree hL]
  calc
    _ ≤ K * Real.log x * Real.exp ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log (Real.log S)) /
        (3 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (2 * Real.log (Real.log S) - 1) := by
      apply (le_div_iff₀ (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 3 / 2) _)).mpr
      rw [mul_comm]
      exact hweighted.trans hmoment
    _ = K * Real.log x * Real.exp ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log (Real.log S) -
        Real.log (3 / 2) * (2 * Real.log (Real.log S) - 1)) := by
      rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 3 / 2), mul_div_assoc, ← Real.exp_sub]
    _ ≤ K * Real.log x * Real.exp (Real.log (3 / 2) - Real.log (Real.log S) / 6) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hexponent2) (mul_nonneg hK.le hlog.le)
    _ = _ := by
      rw [sub_eq_add_neg, Real.exp_add, Real.exp_log (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 3 / 2), neg_div]

proof.tactics:
by
  intro x T F hx hT hF
  have hx0 : 0 < x := by linarith
  have hlog : 0 < Real.log x := Real.log_pos hx
  
  have hdata : ∀ p : ℕ, 3 ≤ p →
      0 < (p - 1) / largestPrimeFactor (p - 1) ∧ (largestPrimeFactor (p - 1)).Prime ∧
        (p - 1) / largestPrimeFactor (p - 1) * largestPrimeFactor (p - 1) + 1 = p := by
    intro p hp
    have hne : (p - 1).primeFactors.Nonempty := by
      obtain ⟨q, hq, hqd⟩ := Nat.exists_prime_and_dvd (show p - 1 ≠ 1 by omega)
      exact ⟨q, hq.mem_primeFactors hqd (by omega)⟩
    obtain ⟨q, hqmem, hqsup⟩ := Finset.exists_mem_eq_sup _ hne id
    have hqp : q.Prime := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hqmem
    have hP : largestPrimeFactor (p - 1) = q := by
      unfold largestPrimeFactor
      rw [hqsup]
      exact max_eq_right hqp.one_lt.le
    have hdvd : q ∣ p - 1 := Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactors hqmem
    rw [hP]
    refine ⟨Nat.div_pos (Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) hdvd) hqp.pos, hqp, ?_⟩
    rw [Nat.div_mul_cancel hdvd]
    omega
  
  have hlogP : ∀ p : ℕ, 17 ≤ p → (ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors (p - 1) : ℝ) ≤ 12 * T →
      Real.sqrt x ≤ (p : ℝ) → Real.log x / (30 * T) ≤ Real.log (largestPrimeFactor (p - 1)) := by
    intro p hp hΩ hsq
    have hn0 : (p - 1) ≠ 0 := by omega
    have hle : ∀ r ∈ (p - 1).primeFactorsList, r ≤ largestPrimeFactor (p - 1) := by
      intro r hr
      have hrp := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactorsList hr
      have hrd := Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactorsList hr
      exact (Finset.le_sup (f := id) (hrp.mem_primeFactors hrd hn0)).trans (le_max_right _ _)
    have hpow : p - 1 ≤ largestPrimeFactor (p - 1) ^ ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors (p - 1) := by
      rw [ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors_apply]
      calc p - 1 = (p - 1).primeFactorsList.prod := (Nat.prod_primeFactorsList hn0).symm
        _ ≤ _ := List.prod_le_pow_card _ _ hle
    have hP1 : 1 < largestPrimeFactor (p - 1) := by
      by_contra h
      have h1 : largestPrimeFactor (p - 1) = 1 := le_antisymm (by omega) (le_max_left _ _)
      rw [h1, one_pow] at hpow
      omega
    have hPlog : 0 < Real.log (largestPrimeFactor (p - 1)) :=
      Real.log_pos (by exact_mod_cast hP1)
    have hnpos : (0 : ℝ) < ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < p - 1 by omega)
    have hlogn : Real.log ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
        (ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors (p - 1) : ℝ) * Real.log (largestPrimeFactor (p - 1)) := by
      have hcast : ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
          ((largestPrimeFactor (p - 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors (p - 1) := by
        exact_mod_cast hpow
      have := Real.log_le_log hnpos hcast
      rwa [Real.log_pow] at this
    have hlogn' : Real.log ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ 12 * T * Real.log (largestPrimeFactor (p - 1)) :=
      hlogn.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hΩ hPlog.le)
    have hshift : (p : ℝ) ≤ 2 * ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast (show p ≤ 2 * (p - 1) by omega)
    have hlogp := Real.log_le_log (by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < p by omega)) hshift
    rw [Real.log_mul (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0) hnpos.ne'] at hlogp
    have h16 : (16 : ℝ) ≤ ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (show 16 ≤ p - 1 by omega)
    have hbase : (2 : ℝ) ^ 4 ≤ ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
      calc (2 : ℝ) ^ 4 = 16 := by norm_num
        _ ≤ _ := h16
    have hlogbase := Real.log_le_log (by norm_num) hbase
    rw [Real.log_pow] at hlogbase
    push_cast at hlogbase
    have hlx := Real.log_le_log (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hx0) hsq
    rw [Real.log_sqrt hx0.le] at hlx
    rw [div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
    nlinarith
  
  set a : ℝ := Real.log x / (30 * T) with ha_def
  have ha : 0 < a := by positivity
  set B : Finset ℕ := F.image (fun p => (p - 1) / largestPrimeFactor (p - 1)) with hB_def
  let Q : ℕ → Finset ℕ := fun b =>
    (F.filter (fun p => (p - 1) / largestPrimeFactor (p - 1) = b)).image
      (fun p => largestPrimeFactor (p - 1))
  have hBpos : ∀ b ∈ B, 0 < b := by
    intro b hb
    obtain ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hb
    exact (hdata p (by have := (hF p hp).2.1; omega)).1
  have hQ : ∀ b ∈ B, ∀ q ∈ Q b, q.Prime ∧ (b * q + 1).Prime ∧
      ((b * q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ x ∧ a ≤ Real.log q := by
    intro b hb q hq
    obtain ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hq
    obtain ⟨hpF, hpb⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hp
    obtain ⟨hprime, h17, hsq, hpx, hΩ⟩ := hF p hpF
    have hd := hdata p (by omega)
    have heq : b * largestPrimeFactor (p - 1) + 1 = p := by rw [← hpb]; exact hd.2.2
    rw [heq]
    exact ⟨hd.2.1, hprime, hpx, hlogP p h17 hΩ hsq⟩

    apply Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn
      (fun p => (⟨(p - 1) / largestPrimeFactor (p - 1), largestPrimeFactor (p - 1)⟩ : Σ _ : ℕ, ℕ))
    · intro p hp
      exact Finset.mem_sigma.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩,
        Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨p, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hp, rfl⟩, rfl⟩⟩
    · intro p hp r hr heq
      have hb : (p - 1) / largestPrimeFactor (p - 1) = (r - 1) / largestPrimeFactor (r - 1) :=
        congrArg Sigma.fst heq
      have hq : largestPrimeFactor (p - 1) = largestPrimeFactor (r - 1) :=
        congrArg (fun z : Σ _ : ℕ, ℕ => z.2) heq
      have hp3 : 3 ≤ p := by have := (hF p hp).2.1; omega
      have hr3 : 3 ≤ r := by have := (hF r hr).2.1; omega
      calc
        p = (p - 1) / largestPrimeFactor (p - 1) * largestPrimeFactor (p - 1) + 1 :=
          (hdata p hp3).2.2.symm
        _ = (r - 1) / largestPrimeFactor (r - 1) * largestPrimeFactor (r - 1) + 1 := by
          rw [hb, hq]
        _ = r := (hdata r hr3).2.2
  have hsum : (F.card : ℝ) ≤ ∑ b ∈ B, ((Q b).card : ℝ) := by
    have h : (F.card : ℝ) ≤ (B.sigma Q).card := by exact_mod_cast hcard
    simpa only [Finset.card_sigma, Nat.cast_sum] using h
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ b ∈ B, ((Q b).card : ℝ) := hsum
    _ ≤ ∑ b ∈ B, C₀ * x / ((b.totient : ℝ) * a ^ 2) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro b hb
      exact hsieve b x a (Q b) (hBpos b hb) hx0.le ha (hQ b hb)

      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro b hb

        exact_mod_cast Nat.totient_pos.mpr (hBpos b hb)
      rw [ha_def]
      field_simp
      ring

  have he60 : 0 < e6 := by rw [he6def]; positivity
  have ht0 : 0 < t := by rw [htdef]; exact ht

      (144 + Ka + Cr * Cs + 4 * Real.exp 1 * Cr * Cd) * (Q * (1 + t) ^ 5 * e6) := by
    rw [hQdef, htdef, he6def]; ring

  linarith [hA, hBo, hR1, hR2]

subgoal_signatures.name: weighted_totient_euler_bound
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (w : ℕ → ℝ), (∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → 0 ≤ w p ∧ w p ≤ 7 / 4) →
    ∀ (x : ℝ) (F : Finset ℕ), (∀ n ∈ F, 0 < n ∧ ∀ p ∈ n.primeFactors, (p : ℝ) ≤ x) →
    (∑ n ∈ F, (n.primeFactorsList.map w).prod / (n.totient : ℝ)) ≤
      Real.exp ((∑ p ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊x⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, w p / p) + 36)

subgoal_signatures.name: cardFactors_totient_tail
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(hMERT : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ, 2 ≤ x →
      |(∑ p ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊x⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, (1 : ℝ) / p) - Real.log (Real.log x)| ≤ C)
    (hEuler : ∀ (w : ℕ → ℝ), (∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → 0 ≤ w p ∧ w p ≤ 7 / 4) →
      ∀ (x : ℝ) (F : Finset ℕ), (∀ n ∈ F, 0 < n ∧ ∀ p ∈ n.primeFactors, (p : ℝ) ≤ x) →
      (∑ n ∈ F, (n.primeFactorsList.map w).prod / (n.totient : ℝ)) ≤
        Real.exp ((∑ p ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊x⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, w p / p) + 36)) :
    ∃ K : ℝ, 0 < K ∧ ∀ (x z a : ℝ) (F : Finset ℕ), 2 ≤ x → 1 ≤ z → z ≤ 7 / 4 →
      (∀ n ∈ F, 0 < n ∧ ∀ p ∈ n.primeFactors, (p : ℝ) ≤ x) →
      (∀ n ∈ F, a ≤ (ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors n : ℝ)) →
      (∑ n ∈ F, (1 : ℝ) / (n.totient : ℝ)) ≤ K * Real.log x ^ z / z ^ a

informal_problem.statement:
(hPNT : Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => (Nat.primeCounting ⌊x⌋₊ : ℝ) / (x / Real.log x)) atTop (𝓝 1))

      |(∑ p ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊x⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, (1 : ℝ) / p) - Real.log (Real.log x)| ≤ C) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop, ((envelopeThreeLargeNormalTotients x).card : ℝ) ≤ x / Real.log x

proof.tactics:
by
  have hs6 : ∀ (n : ℕ), 0 < n → ∀ (P : Finset ℕ) (S Z : ℝ), S < Z →
      (∀ p ∈ P, SNormal S p ∧ p ∣ n ∧ Z ≤ ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) →
      (P.card : ℝ) * (logLog Z - logLog S - Real.sqrt (logLog S * logLog Z)) ≤
        (omegaInterval n.totient S Z : ℝ) := by
    intro n hn P S Z hSZ hP
    have hadd : ∀ a b : ℕ, a ≠ 0 → b ≠ 0 →
        omegaInterval (a * b) S Z = omegaInterval a S Z + omegaInterval b S Z := by
      intro a b ha hb
      unfold omegaInterval
      rw [(Nat.perm_primeFactorsList_mul ha hb).countP_eq, List.countP_append]
    have key : ∀ Q : Finset ℕ, (∀ p ∈ Q, p.Prime) →
        (∏ p ∈ Q, p).totient = ∏ p ∈ Q, (p - 1) ∧
        omegaInterval (∏ p ∈ Q, (p - 1)) S Z = ∑ p ∈ Q, omegaInterval (p - 1) S Z := by
      intro Q
      refine Finset.induction_on Q ?_ ?_
      · intro _
        simp [omegaInterval]
      · intro a s ha ih hQ
        have hapr : a.Prime := hQ a (Finset.mem_insert_self a s)
        have hs : ∀ p ∈ s, p.Prime := fun p hp => hQ p (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hp)
        obtain ⟨ih1, ih2⟩ := ih hs
        have hcop : Nat.Coprime a (∏ p ∈ s, p) :=
          Nat.Coprime.prod_right (fun p hp => (Nat.coprime_primes hapr (hs p hp)).mpr
            (by rintro rfl; exact ha hp))
        have hne : (∏ p ∈ s, (p - 1)) ≠ 0 :=
          Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr (fun p hp => by have := (hs p hp).two_le; omega)
        have ha1 : a - 1 ≠ 0 := by have := hapr.two_le; omega
        refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [Finset.prod_insert ha, Finset.prod_insert ha, Nat.totient_mul hcop,
            Nat.totient_prime hapr, ih1]
        · rw [Finset.prod_insert ha, Finset.sum_insert ha, hadd _ _ ha1 hne, ih2]
    have hPprime : ∀ p ∈ P, p.Prime := fun p hp => (hP p hp).1.1
    obtain ⟨k1, k2⟩ := key P hPprime
    have hdvd : (∏ p ∈ P, p) ∣ n :=
      Finset.prod_primes_dvd n (fun p hp => (hPprime p hp).prime) (fun p hp => (hP p hp).2.1)
    have htd := Nat.totient_dvd_of_dvd hdvd
    rw [k1] at htd
    have htpos : n.totient ≠ 0 := (Nat.totient_pos.mpr hn).ne'
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := htd
    have hcne : c ≠ 0 := by
      rintro rfl
      rw [mul_zero] at hc
      exact htpos hc
    have hMne : (∏ p ∈ P, (p - 1)) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      rw [h, zero_mul] at hc
      exact htpos hc
    have hle : ∑ p ∈ P, omegaInterval (p - 1) S Z ≤ omegaInterval n.totient S Z := by
      rw [hc, hadd _ _ hMne hcne, k2]
      omega
    have hlow : ∀ p ∈ P, logLog Z - logLog S - Real.sqrt (logLog S * logLog Z) ≤
        (omegaInterval (p - 1) S Z : ℝ) := by
      intro p hp
      obtain ⟨hN, _, hZp⟩ := hP p hp
      have h := hN.2.2 S Z le_rfl hSZ hZp
      unfold logLog
      have := (abs_lt.mp h).1
      linarith
    calc (P.card : ℝ) * (logLog Z - logLog S - Real.sqrt (logLog S * logLog Z))
        = ∑ p ∈ P, (logLog Z - logLog S - Real.sqrt (logLog S * logLog Z)) := by
          rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
      _ ≤ ∑ p ∈ P, (omegaInterval (p - 1) S Z : ℝ) := Finset.sum_le_sum hlow
      _ = ((∑ p ∈ P, omegaInterval (p - 1) S Z : ℕ) : ℝ) := by push_cast; rfl
      _ ≤ _ := by exact_mod_cast hle
  have hs7 : ∀ K : ℝ, ∀ᶠ T : ℝ in atTop, K * T * Real.exp (2 * ((79 / 100 : ℝ) * T - 100 * Real.log T) -
      (3 * ((79 / 100 : ℝ) * T - 100 * Real.log T - Real.sqrt (79 * T * Real.log T)) - 1) *
        Real.log 3) ≤ Real.exp (-T) := by
    intro K
    have hL3 : (23 / 21 : ℝ) ≤ Real.log 3 := by
      have h := Real.sum_range_le_log_div (x := 1 / 2) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) 3
      have h3 : (1 + 1 / 2 : ℝ) / (1 - 1 / 2) = 3 := by norm_num
      rw [h3] at h
      norm_num [Finset.sum_range_succ] at h
      linarith
    have hlogo := Real.isLittleO_log_id_atTop.def (show (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 316000000 by norm_num)
    filter_upwards [hlogo, eventually_ge_atTop (40000 * (|K| + 1)),
      eventually_ge_atTop (100000 : ℝ)] with T hlo hTK hT
    have hT0 : 0 < T := by linarith
    have hl0 : 0 ≤ Real.log T := Real.log_nonneg (by linarith)
    have hl : Real.log T ≤ T / 316000000 := by
      simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs, id] at hlo
      rw [abs_of_nonneg hl0, abs_of_pos hT0] at hlo
      linarith
    have hr : Real.sqrt (79 * T * Real.log T) ≤ T / 2000 := by
      have h1 : 79 * T * Real.log T ≤ (T / 2000) ^ 2 := by
        nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hl (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 79 * T)]
      calc Real.sqrt (79 * T * Real.log T) ≤ Real.sqrt ((T / 2000) ^ 2) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt h1
        _ = T / 2000 := Real.sqrt_sq (by linarith)
    have hc : 0 ≤ 3 * ((79 / 100 : ℝ) * T - 100 * Real.log T - Real.sqrt (79 * T * Real.log T)) - 1 := by
      linarith
    have hE : 2 * ((79 / 100 : ℝ) * T - 100 * Real.log T) -
        (3 * ((79 / 100 : ℝ) * T - 100 * Real.log T - Real.sqrt (79 * T * Real.log T)) - 1) *
          Real.log 3 ≤ -T - T / 100 := by
      linarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hL3 hc]
    have hexpE := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hE
    have hexp_split : Real.exp (-T - T / 100) = Real.exp (-T) * Real.exp (-(T / 100)) := by
      rw [← Real.exp_add]; congr 1 <;> ring
    have hdecay : |K| * T * Real.exp (-(T / 100)) ≤ 1 := by
      have hy := Real.add_one_le_exp (T / 200)
      have hsq : Real.exp (T / 100) = Real.exp (T / 200) ^ 2 := by
        rw [sq, ← Real.exp_add]; congr 1 <;> ring
      have hbig : T ^ 2 / 40000 ≤ Real.exp (T / 100) := by
        rw [hsq]; nlinarith
      have hKT : |K| * T ≤ Real.exp (T / 100) := by
        have hK0 := abs_nonneg K
        nlinarith
      have hu : Real.exp (-(T / 100)) * Real.exp (T / 100) = 1 := by
        rw [← Real.exp_add]; simp
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hKT (le_of_lt (Real.exp_pos (-(T / 100))))]
    calc _ ≤ |K| * T * Real.exp (-T - T / 100) :=
          mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self K) hT0.le) hexpE
            (Real.exp_pos _).le (mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg K) hT0.le)
      _ = Real.exp (-T) * (|K| * T * Real.exp (-(T / 100))) := by rw [hexp_split]; ring
      _ ≤ Real.exp (-T) * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdecay (Real.exp_pos _).le
      _ = Real.exp (-T) := mul_one _
  have hcheb0 : ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ y : ℝ, 2 ≤ y →
      (Nat.primeCounting ⌊y⌋₊ : ℝ) ≤ C * y / Real.log y := by
    have hev := hPNT.eventually (gt_mem_nhds (show (1 : ℝ) < 2 by norm_num))
    obtain ⟨X, hX⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.mp hev
    refine ⟨(Nat.primeCounting ⌊max 2 X⌋₊ : ℝ) + 2, by positivity, ?_⟩
    intro y hy
    have hlog : 0 < Real.log y := Real.log_pos (by linarith)
    have hyl : 0 < y / Real.log y := div_pos (by linarith) hlog
    have hπ0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ Nat.primeCounting ⌊max 2 X⌋₊ := Nat.cast_nonneg _
    rw [mul_div_assoc]
    by_cases hyY : max 2 X ≤ y
    · have h := hX y (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hyY)
      rw [div_lt_iff₀ hyl] at h
      nlinarith
    · push_neg at hyY
      have hmono : (Nat.primeCounting ⌊y⌋₊ : ℝ) ≤ Nat.primeCounting ⌊max 2 X⌋₊ := by
        exact_mod_cast Nat.monotone_primeCounting (Nat.floor_mono hyY.le)
      have hy1 : 1 ≤ y / Real.log y := by
        rw [le_div_iff₀ hlog]
        have := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by linarith : 0 < y)
        linarith
      nlinarith
  obtain ⟨C, hC, hcheb⟩ := hcheb0
  have hEuler3 : ∀ (w : ℕ → ℝ),
      (∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → 0 ≤ w p ∧ w p ≤ 3 ∧ 8 * w p ≤ 7 * (p : ℝ)) →
      ∀ (x : ℝ) (F : Finset ℕ), (∀ n ∈ F, 0 < n ∧ ∀ p ∈ n.primeFactors, (p : ℝ) ≤ x) →
      (∑ n ∈ F, (n.primeFactorsList.map w).prod / (n.totient : ℝ)) ≤
        Real.exp ((∑ p ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊x⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, w p / p) + 96) := by
    
    have s1 : ∀ (p : ℕ), p.Prime → ∀ (w : ℝ), 0 ≤ w → 8 * w ≤ 7 * (p : ℝ) → ∀ e : ℕ,
        (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (e + 1), w ^ i / ((p ^ i).totient : ℝ)) ≤
          1 + w * (p : ℝ) / (((p : ℝ) - 1) * ((p : ℝ) - w)) := by
      intro p hp w hw0 hw1 e
      have hq : (2:ℝ) ≤ p := by exact_mod_cast hp.two_le
      have hq1 : (0:ℝ) < (p:ℝ) - 1 := by linarith
      have hqw : (0:ℝ) < (p:ℝ) - w := by linarith
      have hq0 : (0:ℝ) < p := by linarith
      set r := w / (p:ℝ) with hr
      have hr0 : 0 ≤ r := div_nonneg hw0 hq0.le
      have hr1 : r < 1 := by rw [hr, div_lt_one hq0]; linarith
      have hterm : ∀ i : ℕ, w ^ (i+1) / ((p ^ (i+1)).totient : ℝ) = (w / ((p:ℝ) - 1)) * r ^ i := by
        intro i
        rw [Nat.totient_prime_pow_succ hp, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_sub hp.one_le,
          Nat.cast_one, hr, div_pow]

  have hdense : ∀ (x u v H a : ℝ) (F : Finset ℕ), 4 ≤ x → 7 ≤ u → u ≤ v → v ≤ x → 0 < H →

    have hlpf : ∀ n ∈ F, (largestPrimeFactor n).Prime ∧ largestPrimeFactor n ∣ n ∧

    have hBdata : ∀ b ∈ F.image (fun n => n / largestPrimeFactor n), 0 < b ∧

      obtain ⟨_, hnx, _, han⟩ := hF n hn
      have hbpos : 0 < n / largestPrimeFactor n := Nat.div_pos (Nat.le_of_dvd hn0 hqd) hqp.pos
      refine ⟨hbpos, ?_, ?_⟩

        have hbn : n / largestPrimeFactor n ≤ n := Nat.div_le_self n _
        have : (p : ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast hple.trans hbn
        linarith
      · have heq : n / largestPrimeFactor n * largestPrimeFactor n = n := Nat.div_mul_cancel hqd
        have hsplit : omegaInterval (n / largestPrimeFactor n * largestPrimeFactor n) u v =

      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro b hb
      have hb0 := (hBdata b hb).1
      have ht0 : (0 : ℝ) < b.totient := by exact_mod_cast Nat.totient_pos.mpr hb0
      have htle : (b.totient : ℝ) ≤ b := by exact_mod_cast Nat.totient_le b
      exact one_div_le_one_div_of_le ht0 htle
    have hsum2 := htail x u v (a - 1) (F.image (fun n => n / largestPrimeFactor n)) hu huv hvx
      (fun b hb => ⟨(hBdata b hb).1, (hBdata b hb).2.1⟩) (fun b hb => (hBdata b hb).2.2)

      div_nonneg (mul_nonneg hC.le hx0.le) hbnd0.le
    have hl0 : Real.log x ≠ 0 := hlogx.ne'
    have hH0 : H ≠ 0 := hH.ne'

        ≤ C * x / (Real.log x / (2 * H)) *
            ∑ b ∈ F.image (fun n => n / largestPrimeFactor n), (1 : ℝ) / b := hcount
      _ ≤ C * x / (Real.log x / (2 * H)) * (K * Real.log x * Real.exp (2 * (logLog v - logLog u)) *
            Real.exp (-((a - 1) * Real.log 3))) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hsum1.trans hsum2) hCx
      _ = 2 * C * K * H * x * Real.exp (2 * (logLog v - logLog u)) *
            Real.exp (-((a - 1) * Real.log 3)) := by
          field_simp <;> ring
  have hLL : Tendsto logLog atTop atTop :=
    Real.tendsto_log_atTop.comp Real.tendsto_log_atTop
  have hpar0 : ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop, 4 ≤ x ∧ 1 ≤ logLog x ∧
      7 ≤ envelopeNormalityScale (logLog x) ∧
      envelopeNormalityScale (logLog x) < Real.exp (Real.exp ((79 / 100 : ℝ) * logLog x)) ∧
      Real.exp (Real.exp ((79 / 100 : ℝ) * logLog x)) ≤ x ∧
      Real.exp (Real.exp ((79 / 100 : ℝ) * logLog x)) + 1 ≤
        envelopeLargePrimeCutoff (logLog x) := by
    have hlogo := Real.isLittleO_log_id_atTop.def (show (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 200 by norm_num)

      hLL.eventually hlogo] with x hx4 hT100 hlo
    have hx0 : 0 < x := by linarith
    have hlx : 0 < Real.log x := Real.log_pos (by linarith)
    have hTx : Real.exp (Real.exp (logLog x)) = x := by
      rw [logLog, Real.exp_log hlx, Real.exp_log hx0]
    set T := logLog x with hT
    have hT0 : 0 < T := by linarith
    have hlogT : Real.log T ≤ T / 200 := by
      have h := hlo
      simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs, id] at h

      linarith
    have hlogT1 : 1 ≤ Real.log T := by
      have he : Real.exp 1 ≤ T := by linarith [Real.exp_one_lt_d9]
      have := Real.log_le_log (Real.exp_pos 1) he

    · unfold envelopeNormalityScale
      have h1 := Real.add_one_le_exp (100 * Real.log T)
      have h2 := Real.add_one_le_exp (Real.exp (100 * Real.log T))
      linarith
    · unfold envelopeNormalityScale
      apply Real.exp_lt_exp.mpr
      apply Real.exp_lt_exp.mpr
      linarith
    · calc Real.exp (Real.exp ((79 / 100 : ℝ) * T)) ≤ Real.exp (Real.exp T) := by
            apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
            apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
            linarith

    · unfold envelopeLargePrimeCutoff
      set E := Real.exp ((79 / 100 : ℝ) * T) with hEdef
