        have := Real.add_one_le_exp ((1 / 100 : ℝ) * T)
        linarith
      have hsplit : Real.exp ((4 / 5 : ℝ) * T) = E * Real.exp ((1 / 100 : ℝ) * T) := by
        rw [hEdef, ← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; ring
      have hE : E + 1 ≤ Real.exp ((4 / 5 : ℝ) * T) := by
        rw [hsplit]; nlinarith
      have hZ1 : 1 ≤ Real.exp E := Real.one_le_exp (by linarith)
      have he2 : 2 ≤ Real.exp 1 := by
        have := Real.add_one_le_exp (1 : ℝ)
        linarith
      calc Real.exp E + 1 ≤ Real.exp E * Real.exp 1 := by nlinarith
        _ = Real.exp (E + 1) := by rw [Real.exp_add]
        _ ≤ Real.exp (Real.exp ((4 / 5 : ℝ) * T)) := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hE
  filter_upwards [hpar0, hLL.eventually (hs7 (10 * C * K))]
    with x hpar hsave
  obtain ⟨hx4, hT1, hS7, hSZ, hZx, hZH⟩ := hpar
  have hx0 : 0 < x := by linarith
  have hlogx : 0 < Real.log x := Real.log_pos (by linarith)
  have hLS : logLog (envelopeNormalityScale (logLog x)) = 100 * Real.log (logLog x) := by
    simp only [envelopeNormalityScale, logLog, Real.log_exp]
  have hLZ : logLog (Real.exp (Real.exp ((79 / 100 : ℝ) * logLog x))) =
      (79 / 100 : ℝ) * logLog x := by
    simp only [logLog, Real.log_exp]
  set T := logLog x with hT
  set S := envelopeNormalityScale T with hS
  set Z := Real.exp (Real.exp ((79 / 100 : ℝ) * T)) with hZ
  have hT0 : 0 < T := by linarith
  have hsq : Real.sqrt (logLog S * logLog Z) = Real.sqrt (79 * T * Real.log T) := by
    rw [hLS, hLZ]; congr 1; ring
  set thr := 3 * ((79 / 100 : ℝ) * T - 100 * Real.log T - Real.sqrt (79 * T * Real.log T))
    with hthr
  have hF : ∀ m ∈ envelopeThreeLargeNormalTotients x, Real.sqrt x ≤ (m : ℝ) ∧ (m : ℝ) ≤ x ∧

    intro m hm
    rw [envelopeThreeLargeNormalTotients, Finset.mem_filter] at hm
    obtain ⟨hmt, hsqm, hom, n, hn, hφ, P, hPc, hP⟩ := hm
    have hmx : (m : ℝ) ≤ x := by
      rw [totientsUpTo, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc] at hmt
      exact (Nat.le_floor_iff hx0.le).mp hmt.1.2
    refine ⟨hsqm, hmx, hom, ?_⟩
    have hP' : ∀ p ∈ P, SNormal S p ∧ p ∣ n ∧ Z ≤ ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
      intro p hp
      obtain ⟨hpn, hpd, hpH⟩ := hP p hp
      refine ⟨hpn, hpd, ?_⟩
      have hp1 : 1 ≤ p := hpn.1.one_lt.le
      rw [Nat.cast_sub hp1]
      push_cast
      linarith
    have h6 := hs6 n hn P S Z hSZ hP'
    rw [hPc, hφ, hsq, hLS, hLZ] at h6
    push_cast at h6
    rw [hthr]
    linarith
  have hmain := hdense x S Z (5 * T) thr _ hx4 hS7 hSZ.le hZx (by linarith) hF
  rw [hLS, hLZ] at hmain
  have hexpT : Real.exp (-T) = 1 / Real.log x := by
    rw [Real.exp_neg, hT, logLog, Real.exp_log hlogx, one_div]
  have hcomb : 2 * C * K * (5 * T) * x * Real.exp (2 * ((79 / 100 : ℝ) * T - 100 * Real.log T)) *
      Real.exp (-((thr - 1) * Real.log 3)) =
      x * (10 * C * K * T * Real.exp (2 * ((79 / 100 : ℝ) * T - 100 * Real.log T) -
        (thr - 1) * Real.log 3)) := by
    rw [sub_eq_add_neg _ ((thr - 1) * Real.log 3), Real.exp_add]; ring
  calc ((envelopeThreeLargeNormalTotients x).card : ℝ)
      ≤ _ := hmain
    _ = _ := hcomb
    _ ≤ x * Real.exp (-T) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsave hx0.le
    _ = x / Real.log x := by rw [hexpT, mul_one_div]

informal_problem.statement:
(hPNT : Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => (Nat.primeCounting ⌊x⌋₊ : ℝ) / (x / Real.log x)) atTop (𝓝 1))
    (hMERT : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ, 2 ≤ x →
      |(∑ p ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊x⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, (1 : ℝ) / p) - Real.log (Real.log x)| ≤ C) :
    ∃ K : ℝ, 0 < K ∧ ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop, ∀ A : ℝ, 1 ≤ A →
      (∀ u : ℝ, 2 ≤ u → u ≤ envelopeTailEndpoint (logLog x) →
        ((totientsUpTo u).card : ℝ) ≤ A * u / Real.log u) →
      ((envelopeRetainedTotients x).card : ℝ) ≤ K * x / Real.log x * logLog x ^ 2 * A

by
  
  have retained_chebyshev_bound :
      (Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => (Nat.primeCounting ⌊x⌋₊ : ℝ) / (x / Real.log x)) atTop (𝓝 1)) →
      ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ y : ℝ, 2 ≤ y → (Nat.primeCounting ⌊y⌋₊ : ℝ) ≤ C * y / Real.log y := by
    intro hPNT
    have hev := hPNT.eventually (ge_mem_nhds (show (1 : ℝ) < 2 by norm_num))
    obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.mp hev
    have hπle : ∀ N : ℕ, Nat.primeCounting N ≤ N := by
      intro N
      have hsub : Nat.primesBelow (N + 1) ⊆ Finset.Icc 1 N := by
        intro p hp
        rw [Nat.mem_primesBelow] at hp
        rw [Finset.mem_Icc]
        exact ⟨hp.2.one_lt.le, by omega⟩
      have h := Finset.card_le_card hsub
      rw [Nat.primesBelow_card_eq_primeCounting', Nat.card_Icc] at h
      have : Nat.primeCounting N = Nat.primeCounting' (N + 1) := rfl
      omega
    refine ⟨max 2 (Real.log (max y₀ 2)), lt_max_of_lt_left (by norm_num), ?_⟩
    intro y hy
    have hlogy : 0 < Real.log y := Real.log_pos (by linarith)
    have hyl : 0 < y / Real.log y := div_pos (by linarith) hlogy
    by_cases hyy : max y₀ 2 ≤ y
    · have h := hy₀ y (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hyy)
      rw [div_le_iff₀ hyl] at h
      calc (Nat.primeCounting ⌊y⌋₊ : ℝ) ≤ 2 * (y / Real.log y) := h
        _ ≤ max 2 (Real.log (max y₀ 2)) * (y / Real.log y) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_left _ _) hyl.le
        _ = _ := by ring
    · push_neg at hyy
      have hπ : (Nat.primeCounting ⌊y⌋₊ : ℝ) ≤ y := by
        calc (Nat.primeCounting ⌊y⌋₊ : ℝ) ≤ (⌊y⌋₊ : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hπle _
          _ ≤ y := Nat.floor_le (by linarith)
      have hll : Real.log y ≤ Real.log (max y₀ 2) := Real.log_le_log (by linarith) hyy.le
      have hC' : Real.log y ≤ max 2 (Real.log (max y₀ 2)) := hll.trans (le_max_right _ _)
      rw [le_div_iff₀ hlogy]
      have hπ0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (Nat.primeCounting ⌊y⌋₊ : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul hπ hC' hlogy.le (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ y)]
  
  have shifted_prime_pair_count : ∀ {C : ℝ}, 0 < C →
      (∀ y : ℝ, 2 ≤ y → (Nat.primeCounting ⌊y⌋₊ : ℝ) ≤ C * y / Real.log y) →
      ∀ (M B : Finset ℕ) (x a : ℝ), 0 < x → 0 < a → (∀ b ∈ B, 0 < b) →
      (∀ m ∈ M, (m : ℝ) ≤ x ∧ ∃ b ∈ B, ∃ p : ℕ, p.Prime ∧ a ≤ Real.log (p : ℝ) ∧ m = (p - 1) * b) →
      (M.card : ℝ) ≤ 2 * C * x / a * ∑ b ∈ B, (1 : ℝ) / b := by
    intro C hC hcheb M B x a hx ha hB hM
    have hfib : ∀ b ∈ B, ∀ F : Finset ℕ,
        (∀ p ∈ F, p.Prime ∧ a ≤ Real.log p ∧ ((p : ℝ) - 1) * b ≤ x) →
        (F.card : ℝ) ≤ 2 * C * x / a / b := by
      intro b hb F hF
      have hbR : (0 : ℝ) < b := by exact_mod_cast hB b hb
      by_cases hne : F.Nonempty
      · obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hne
        have hupper : ∀ q ∈ F, (q : ℝ) ≤ 1 + x / b := by
          intro q hq
          have h := (le_div_iff₀ hbR).mpr (hF q hq).2.2
          linarith
        have htwo : (2 : ℝ) ≤ 1 + x / b :=
          (by exact_mod_cast (hF p hp).1.two_le : (2 : ℝ) ≤ p).trans (hupper p hp)
        have hlog : a ≤ Real.log (1 + x / b) :=
          (hF p hp).2.1.trans (Real.log_le_log (by exact_mod_cast (hF p hp).1.pos) (hupper p hp))
        have hnum : 1 + x / b ≤ 2 * (x / b) := by linarith
        have hsub : F ⊆ Nat.primesBelow (⌊1 + x / b⌋₊ + 1) := by
          intro q hq
          rw [Nat.mem_primesBelow]

          have := Nat.le_floor (hupper q hq)

          have h := Finset.card_le_card hsub

          rw [e]

          _ ≤ C * (1 + x / b) / a := div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by positivity) ha hlog

          _ = _ := by ring
      · rw [Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hne]
        simp only [Finset.card_empty, Nat.cast_zero]
        positivity
    have hM' : ∀ m ∈ M, ∃ bp : ℕ × ℕ, bp.1 ∈ B ∧ bp.2.Prime ∧ a ≤ Real.log (bp.2 : ℝ) ∧
        m = (bp.2 - 1) * bp.1 := by
      intro m hm
      obtain ⟨_, b, hb, p, hp, hap, hmp⟩ := hM m hm
      exact ⟨(b, p), hb, hp, hap, hmp⟩
    choose! g hg using hM'
    have hinj : Set.InjOn g M := by
      intro m hm m' hm' h
      have e1 := (hg m hm).2.2.2
      have e2 := (hg m' hm').2.2.2
      rw [e1, e2, h]
    have hcardM : M.card = (M.image g).card := (Finset.card_image_of_injOn hinj).symm
    have hfibre : ∀ b ∈ B, ((((M.image g).filter (fun bp => bp.1 = b)).card : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
        2 * C * x / a / b := by
      intro b hb
      obtain ⟨F, hFdef⟩ : ∃ F : Finset (ℕ × ℕ), F = (M.image g).filter (fun bp => bp.1 = b) :=
        ⟨_, rfl⟩
      rw [← hFdef]
      have hcard : F.card ≤ (F.image Prod.snd).card := by
        apply Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn Prod.snd
        · intro bp hbp
          exact Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ hbp
        · intro bp hbp cp hcp heq

subgoal_signatures.statement:
∃ K : ℝ, 0 < K ∧ ∀ (Q : Finset ℕ) (z D : ℝ), Real.exp 1 ≤ z → 0 ≤ D →
      (∀ q ∈ Q, 2 ≤ q ∧ (q : ℝ) ≤ z) →
      (∀ x : ℝ, 2 ≤ x → x ≤ z → ((Q.filter (fun q : ℕ => (q : ℝ) ≤ x)).card : ℝ) ≤ D * x / Real.log x) →
      (∑ q ∈ Q, (1 : ℝ) / q) ≤ K * D * (1 + Real.log (Real.log z))

(hPNT : Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => (Nat.primeCounting ⌊x⌋₊ : ℝ) / (x / Real.log x)) atTop (𝓝 1))

have pf_innerSeed_tuple_structure : ∀ {L M : ℕ} {t A : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) (hA : 0 < A)
    {q : Fin L → ℕ} (hq : ∀ idx, (q idx).Prime ∨ q idx = 1) (p : Fin L) (hp : p.val + 1 = L)
    (hx : FordReciprocal.tuplePoint t q ∈ FordInner.innerSeed (FordInner.targetParameter L M) p (A / t)),
    (∀ idx, (q idx).Prime) ∧ StrictAnti q ∧ (∀ idx, Real.exp (Real.exp A) ≤ (q idx : ℝ)) ∧
      (∀ idx j : Fin L, j.val = idx.val + 1 →
        (1 + FordInner.baseLoss M (L - (idx.val + 1))) * logLog (q j) ≤ logLog (q idx)) := by
  intro L M t A ht hA q hq p hp hx
  have hlow : ∀ idx : Fin L, A ≤ logLog (q idx) := by
    intro idx
    have hip : idx ≤ p := by change idx.val ≤ p.val; have := idx.isLt; omega
    have hAi : A / t ≤ FordReciprocal.tuplePoint t q idx := hx.1.2.2.trans (hx.1.1.2.2.1 hip)
    have hm : A ≤ max 0 (logLog (q idx)) := (div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right ht).mp hAi
    by_cases hlog : 0 ≤ logLog (q idx)
    · simpa only [max_eq_right hlog] using hm
    · have hbad : A ≤ 0 := by simpa only [max_eq_left (le_of_not_ge hlog)] using hm
      linarith
  have hprime : ∀ idx, (q idx).Prime := by
    intro idx
    rcases hq idx with hi | hi
    · exact hi
    · have hlog := hlow idx
      simp only [hi, Nat.cast_one, logLog, Real.log_one, Real.log_zero] at hlog
      linarith
  have heq : ∀ idx, FordReciprocal.tuplePoint t q idx = logLog (q idx) / t := by
    intro idx
    have hlog : 0 ≤ logLog (q idx) := hA.le.trans (hlow idx)
    simp only [FordReciprocal.tuplePoint, max_eq_right hlog]
  have hbase : ∀ d, 0 ≤ FordInner.baseLoss M d := by
    intro d
    unfold FordInner.baseLoss
    positivity
  have hlt1 : ∀ j, j < L → FordInner.targetParameter L M j < 1 := by
    intro j hj
    have hN : (0 : ℝ) < ((M + (L - j) : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast (show 0 < M + (L - j) by omega)
    have hδ : 0 < FordInner.baseLoss M (L - j) := by
      unfold FordInner.baseLoss
      positivity
    simp only [FordInner.targetParameter, if_pos hj]
    linarith
  have hpos : ∀ idx, 0 < FordReciprocal.tuplePoint t q idx := by
    intro idx
    rw [heq idx]
    exact div_pos (hA.trans_le (hlow idx)) ht
  have hsa : ∀ {K : ℕ} {x : Fin K → ℝ},
      (∀ idx j : Fin K, j.val = idx.val + 1 → x j < x idx) → StrictAnti x := by
    intro K x h
    cases K with
    | zero => intro idx; exact Fin.elim0 idx
    | succ k => exact Fin.strictAnti_iff_succ_lt.mpr (fun idx => h idx.castSucc idx.succ rfl)
  have hs : StrictAnti (FordReciprocal.tuplePoint t q) := by
    apply hsa
    intro idx j hij
    have hj : idx.val + 1 < L := by have := j.isLt; omega
    have hgap := hx.1.2.1 idx j hij
    have hxi := hlt1 _ hj
    nlinarith [hpos idx]
  have hanti : StrictAnti q := by
    intro idx j hij
    by_contra hnot
    have hqi : (1 : ℝ) < q idx := by exact_mod_cast (hprime idx).one_lt
    have hqij : q idx ≤ q j := by omega
    have hmono : logLog (q idx) ≤ logLog (q j) := by
      unfold logLog

      have hc : (q idx : ℝ) ≤ q j := by exact_mod_cast hqij
      exact Real.log_le_log (Real.log_pos hqi) (Real.log_le_log h1 hc)
    have h2 := hs hij
    rw [heq, heq] at h2
    have h3 := (div_lt_div_iff_of_pos_right ht).mp h2
    linarith
  have hentry : ∀ idx, Real.exp (Real.exp A) ≤ (q idx : ℝ) := by
    intro idx
    have hq1 : (1 : ℝ) < q idx := by exact_mod_cast (hprime idx).one_lt
    have hlog := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (hlow idx)
    simp only [logLog, Real.exp_log (Real.log_pos hq1)] at hlog
    have h := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hlog
    simpa only [Real.exp_log (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) < q idx)] using h
  have hgaps : ∀ idx j : Fin L, j.val = idx.val + 1 →
      (1 + FordInner.baseLoss M (L - (idx.val + 1))) * logLog (q j) ≤ logLog (q idx) := by
    intro idx j hij
    have hj : idx.val + 1 < L := by have := j.isLt; omega
    have hg := hx.1.2.1 idx j hij
    rw [heq idx, heq j] at hg
    have hg' : logLog (q j) ≤
        (1 - FordInner.baseLoss M (L - (idx.val + 1))) * logLog (q idx) := by
      apply (div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right ht).mp
      simpa only [FordInner.targetParameter, if_pos hj, mul_div_assoc] using hg
    have hδ := hbase (L - (idx.val + 1))
    calc _ ≤ (1 + FordInner.baseLoss M (L - (idx.val + 1))) *

      _ ≤ _ := mul_le_of_le_one_left (hA.le.trans (hlow idx))
          (by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (FordInner.baseLoss M (L - (idx.val + 1)))])
  exact ⟨hprime, hanti, hentry, hgaps⟩

have pf_record_of_mem : ∀ (M : ℕ) (A y : ℝ) (a : Fin (FordScale.coreDimension M (logLog y)))
    (ha : a.val + 1 = FordScale.coreDimension M (logLog y)) (hA : 0 < A) (ht : 0 < logLog y)
    (hsmall : ∀ n ∈ FordReciprocal.tupleIntegers (FordScale.coreDimension M (logLog y)) (logLog y)
        (FordInner.innerSeed (FordInner.targetParameter (FordScale.coreDimension M (logLog y)) M)
          a (A / logLog y)), (n : ℝ) ≤ y ^ (1 / 40 : ℝ))
    (hlarge : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → (n : ℝ) ≤ y ^ (1 / 40 : ℝ) →
        ∀ p ∈ FordLower.lowerPrimeChoices y n, y ^ (19 / 20 : ℝ) < (p : ℝ) ∧ n < p)
    (hgap : ∀ (q : Fin (FordScale.coreDimension M (logLog y)) → ℕ) (P : ℕ),
        FordReciprocal.tuplePoint (logLog y) q ∈
          FordInner.innerSeed (FordInner.targetParameter (FordScale.coreDimension M (logLog y)) M)
            a (A / logLog y) →
        y ^ (19 / 20 : ℝ) < (P : ℝ) →
        ∀ idx : Fin (FordScale.coreDimension M (logLog y)), idx.val = 0 →
          (1 + FordLower.topLoss (logLog y)) * logLog (q idx) ≤ logLog (P : ℝ))
    (hstruct : ∀ q : Fin (FordScale.coreDimension M (logLog y)) → ℕ,
        (∀ idx, (q idx).Prime ∨ q idx = 1) →
        FordReciprocal.tuplePoint (logLog y) q ∈
          FordInner.innerSeed (FordInner.targetParameter (FordScale.coreDimension M (logLog y)) M)
            a (A / logLog y) →
        (∀ idx, (q idx).Prime) ∧ StrictAnti q ∧ (∀ idx, Real.exp (Real.exp A) ≤ (q idx : ℝ)) ∧
          (∀ idx j : Fin (FordScale.coreDimension M (logLog y)), j.val = idx.val + 1 →
            (1 + FordInner.baseLoss M (FordScale.coreDimension M (logLog y) - (idx.val + 1))) *
              logLog (q j) ≤ logLog (q idx)))
    (N : ℕ)
    (hN : N ∈ FordLower.primeProducts (FordReciprocal.tupleIntegers
        (FordScale.coreDimension M (logLog y)) (logLog y)
        (FordInner.innerSeed (FordInner.targetParameter (FordScale.coreDimension M (logLog y)) M)
          a (A / logLog y))) y),
    Nonempty (FordLower.PrimeProductRecord M A y a N) := by
  intro M A y a ha hA ht hsmall hlarge hgap hstruct N hN
  obtain ⟨⟨n, P⟩, hnP, hNeq⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hN
  obtain ⟨hn, hP⟩ := Finset.mem_sigma.mp hnP
  have hNeq' : P * n = N := hNeq
  have hn' := hn
  simp only [FordReciprocal.tupleIntegers, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc] at hn'
  obtain ⟨⟨hn1, _⟩, q, hprod, hq, _, hpoint⟩ := hn'
  have hn0 : 0 < n := hn1
  have hleading := hlarge n hn0 (hsmall n hn) P hP
  have hPfacts : P.Prime ∧ coreLowerFraction y * y < (corePairValue (n.totient, P) : ℝ) ∧
      (corePairValue (n.totient, P) : ℝ) ≤ y := by
    obtain ⟨⟨b, P'⟩, hbp, hbpP⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hP
    simp only [corePairs, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.product_eq_sprod, Finset.mem_product,
      Finset.mem_singleton] at hbp
    obtain ⟨⟨hb, _⟩, hpr, hlo, hhi⟩ := hbp
    have hPe : P' = P := hbpP
    rw [hPe, hb] at hlo hhi
    rw [hPe] at hpr
    exact ⟨hpr, hlo, hhi⟩
  have hcop : Nat.Coprime P n :=
    (Nat.Prime.coprime_iff_not_dvd hPfacts.1).mpr (Nat.not_dvd_of_pos_of_lt hn0 hleading.2)
  have hφ : N.totient = corePairValue (n.totient, P) := by
    rw [← hNeq', Nat.totient_mul hcop, Nat.totient_prime hPfacts.1]
    rfl
  have hsep : ∀ idx, q idx < P := by
    intro idx
    have hdvd : q idx ∣ n := hprod ▸ Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem q (Finset.mem_univ idx)
    exact (Nat.le_of_dvd hn0 hdvd).trans_lt hleading.2
  obtain ⟨hpr, hanti, hmin, hgaps⟩ := hstruct q hq hpoint
  exact ⟨{
    leading := P
    lower := q
    terminal := ha
    leading_prime := hPfacts.1
    lower_prime := hpr
    lower_order := hanti
    point := hpoint
    integer := by rw [hprod]; exact hNeq'.symm
    leading_size := hleading.1
    lower_separated := hsep
    lower_minimum := hmin
    lower_gaps := hgaps
    leading_gap := hgap q P hpoint hleading.1
    totient_range := by rw [hφ]; exact ⟨hPfacts.2.1, hPfacts.2.2⟩ }⟩

have pf_card_le_V_add_collisions : ∀ (F : Finset ℕ) (y : ℝ)
    (hF : ∀ n ∈ F, 0 < n ∧ (n.totient : ℝ) ≤ y),
    (F.card : ℝ) ≤ V y + ((collisionPoints F Nat.totient).card : ℝ) := by
  intro F y hF
  have hCsub : collisionPoints F Nat.totient ⊆ F := by
    intro x hx
    simp only [collisionPoints, Finset.mem_filter] at hx
    exact hx.1
  have hmaps : ∀ n ∈ F \ collisionPoints F Nat.totient, n.totient ∈ totientsUpTo y := by
    intro n hn
    have hnF := (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hn).1
    obtain ⟨hpos, hle⟩ := hF n hnF
    simp only [totientsUpTo, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc]
    exact ⟨⟨Nat.totient_pos.mpr hpos, Nat.le_floor hle⟩, n, rfl⟩
  have hinj : Set.InjOn Nat.totient ((F \ collisionPoints F Nat.totient : Finset ℕ) : Set ℕ) := by
    intro a ha b hb hab
    by_contra hne
    have ha' := Finset.mem_sdiff.mp (Finset.mem_coe.mp ha)
    have hb' := Finset.mem_sdiff.mp (Finset.mem_coe.mp hb)
    apply ha'.2
    simp only [collisionPoints, Finset.mem_filter]
    exact ⟨ha'.1, b, hb'.1, fun h => hne h.symm, hab.symm⟩
  have h1 : (F \ collisionPoints F Nat.totient).card ≤ (totientsUpTo y).card :=
    Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn Nat.totient (fun n hn => hmaps n hn) hinj
  have h2 : (F \ collisionPoints F Nat.totient).card + (collisionPoints F Nat.totient).card =
      F.card := Finset.card_sdiff_add_card_eq_card hCsub
  have hV : V y = ((totientsUpTo y).card : ℝ) := rfl
  rw [hV]
  have h3 : F.card ≤ (totientsUpTo y).card + (collisionPoints F Nat.totient).card := by omega
  exact_mod_cast h3

have pf_collisions_le_prefix_classes : ∀ {k : ℕ} (F : Finset ℕ) (q : ℕ → Fin k → ℕ)
    (hprime : ∀ n ∈ F, ∀ idx, (q n idx).Prime)
    (hprod : ∀ n ∈ F, (∏ idx, q n idx) = n),
    ((collisionPoints F Nat.totient).card : ℝ) ≤
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range k, ((FordLower.prefixCollisionClass F q j).card : ℝ) := by
  intro k F q hprime hprod
  have hOmega : ∀ (f : Fin k → ℕ), (∀ i, (f i).Prime) → ∀ (s : Finset (Fin k)),
      ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors (∏ i ∈ s, f i) = s.card := by
    intro f hf s
    refine Finset.induction_on s ?_ ?_
    · simp
    · intro a s ha ih
      rw [Finset.prod_insert ha, ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors_mul (hf a).ne_zero
        (Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr (fun i _ => (hf i).ne_zero)),
        ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors_apply_prime (hf a), ih, Finset.card_insert_of_notMem ha]
      ring
  have hΩ : ∀ n ∈ F, ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors n = k := by
    intro n hn
    have h := hOmega (q n) (hprime n hn) Finset.univ
    rw [hprod n hn, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] at h
    exact h
  have hpos : ∀ n ∈ F, 0 < n := by
    intro n hn
    rw [← hprod n hn]
    exact Finset.prod_pos (fun i _ => (hprime n hn i).pos)
  have hnodvd : ∀ n ∈ F, ∀ m ∈ F, n ∣ m → n = m := by
    intro n hn m hm hd
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hd
    have hm0 := hpos m hm
    have hn0 : n ≠ 0 := (hpos n hn).ne'
    have hc0 : c ≠ 0 := by
      rintro rfl
      rw [mul_zero] at hc
      omega
    have h := ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors_mul hn0 hc0
    rw [← hc, hΩ m hm, hΩ n hn] at h
    have hc1 : ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors c = 0 := by omega
    rcases ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors_eq_zero_iff_eq_zero_or_one.mp hc1 with h0 | h1
    · exact absurd h0 hc0
    · rw [hc, h1, mul_one]
  have hsub : collisionPoints F Nat.totient ⊆ FordLower.externalTotientCollisions F := by
    intro n hn
    simp only [collisionPoints, Finset.mem_filter] at hn
    obtain ⟨hnF, m, hmF, hne, hφ⟩ := hn
    refine Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hnF, m, ?_⟩
    show 0 < m ∧ m.totient = n.totient ∧ ¬ n ∣ m
    exact ⟨hpos m hmF, hφ, fun hd => hne (hnodvd n hnF m hmF hd).symm⟩
  have hdepth : ∀ n ∈ FordLower.externalTotientCollisions F,
      FordLower.prefixDepth (q n) n < k := by
    intro n hn
    obtain ⟨hnF, m, hm⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hn
    have hm' : 0 < m ∧ m.totient = n.totient ∧ ¬ n ∣ m := hm
    have h0 : 0 ∈ FordLower.prefixDepths (q n) n := by
      simp only [FordLower.prefixDepths, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range]
      refine ⟨Nat.succ_pos _, m, hm, ?_⟩
      refine ⟨m, hm'.1, ?_, fun idx h => absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)⟩
      simp [FordLower.prefixProduct]
    have hne : (FordLower.prefixDepths (q n) n).Nonempty := ⟨0, h0⟩
    have hmem : FordLower.prefixDepth (q n) n ∈ FordLower.prefixDepths (q n) n := by
      rw [FordLower.prefixDepth, dif_pos hne]
      exact Finset.max'_mem _ _
    simp only [FordLower.prefixDepths, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range] at hmem
    obtain ⟨hlt, m₂, hm₂, w, hw, hm₂eq, _⟩ := hmem
    have hm₂' : 0 < m₂ ∧ m₂.totient = n.totient ∧ ¬ n ∣ m₂ := hm₂
    rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.mp hlt with h | h
    · exact h
    · exfalso
      rw [h] at hm₂eq
      have hpp : FordLower.prefixProduct (q n) k = n := by
        rw [FordLower.prefixProduct, Finset.filter_true_of_mem (fun idx _ => idx.isLt)]
        exact hprod n hnF
      apply hm₂'.2.2
      rw [hm₂eq, hpp]
      exact Dvd.intro w rfl
  have hcard := Finset.card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise (f := fun n => FordLower.prefixDepth (q n) n)
    (s := FordLower.externalTotientCollisions F) (t := Finset.range k)
    (fun n hn => Finset.mem_range.mpr (hdepth n hn))
  calc ((collisionPoints F Nat.totient).card : ℝ)
      ≤ ((FordLower.externalTotientCollisions F).card : ℝ) := by
        exact_mod_cast Finset.card_le_card hsub
    _ = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range k, ((FordLower.prefixCollisionClass F q j).card : ℝ) := by
        rw [hcard, Nat.cast_sum]
        rfl
by
  have hLL : Tendsto logLog atTop atTop :=
    Real.tendsto_log_atTop.comp Real.tendsto_log_atTop
  filter_upwards [pf_tupleIntegers_rpow_small hRHO M, pf_lowerPrimeChoices_large,
    pf_top_log_gap hRHO M, hLL.eventually_gt_atTop 0] with y hsmall hlarge hgap ht
  intro a ha A hA
  have hR : ∀ N ∈ FordLower.primeProducts (FordReciprocal.tupleIntegers
      (FordScale.coreDimension M (logLog y)) (logLog y)
      (FordInner.innerSeed (FordInner.targetParameter (FordScale.coreDimension M (logLog y)) M)
        a (A / logLog y))) y, Nonempty (FordLower.PrimeProductRecord M A y a N) :=
    fun N hN => pf_record_of_mem M A y a ha hA ht (hsmall a A) hlarge (hgap a A)
      (fun q hq hx => pf_innerSeed_tuple_structure ht hA hq a ha hx) N hN
  let q : ℕ → Fin (FordScale.coreDimension M (logLog y) + 1) → ℕ := fun N =>
    if hN : N ∈ FordLower.primeProducts (FordReciprocal.tupleIntegers
      (FordScale.coreDimension M (logLog y)) (logLog y)
      (FordInner.innerSeed (FordInner.targetParameter (FordScale.coreDimension M (logLog y)) M)
        a (A / logLog y))) y then (Classical.choice (hR N hN)).fullTuple else fun _ => 2
  have hq : ∀ N ∈ FordLower.primeProducts (FordReciprocal.tupleIntegers
      (FordScale.coreDimension M (logLog y)) (logLog y)
      (FordInner.innerSeed (FordInner.targetParameter (FordScale.coreDimension M (logLog y)) M)
        a (A / logLog y))) y, ∃ R : FordLower.PrimeProductRecord M A y a N, R.fullTuple = q N := by
    intro N hN
    exact ⟨Classical.choice (hR N hN), by simp only [q, dif_pos hN]⟩
  have hfacts : ∀ N ∈ FordLower.primeProducts (FordReciprocal.tupleIntegers
      (FordScale.coreDimension M (logLog y)) (logLog y)
      (FordInner.innerSeed (FordInner.targetParameter (FordScale.coreDimension M (logLog y)) M)
        a (A / logLog y))) y,
      (∀ idx, (q N idx).Prime) ∧ (∏ idx, q N idx) = N ∧ 0 < N ∧ (N.totient : ℝ) ≤ y := by
    intro N hN
    obtain ⟨R, hRq⟩ := hq N hN
    rw [← hRq]
    have hpr : ∀ idx, (R.fullTuple idx).Prime := by
      intro idx
      refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) idx
      · simp only [FordLower.PrimeProductRecord.fullTuple, Fin.cons_zero]
        exact R.leading_prime
      · simp only [FordLower.PrimeProductRecord.fullTuple, Fin.cons_succ]
        exact R.lower_prime j
    have hprod : (∏ idx, R.fullTuple idx) = N := by
      simp only [FordLower.PrimeProductRecord.fullTuple, Fin.prod_univ_succ, Fin.cons_zero,
        Fin.cons_succ]
      exact R.integer.symm
    refine ⟨hpr, hprod, ?_, R.totient_range.2⟩
    rw [← hprod]
    exact Finset.prod_pos (fun idx _ => (hpr idx).pos)
  have h6 := pf_card_le_V_add_collisions _ y
    (fun N hN => ⟨(hfacts N hN).2.2.1, (hfacts N hN).2.2.2⟩)
  have h7 := pf_collisions_le_prefix_classes
    (k := FordScale.coreDimension M (logLog y) + 1) _ q
    (fun N hN => (hfacts N hN).1) (fun N hN => (hfacts N hN).2.1)
  exact ⟨q, hq, h6.trans (by linarith)⟩

informal_problem.statement:
(hPNT : Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => (Nat.primeCounting ⌊x⌋₊ : ℝ) / (x / Real.log x)) atTop (𝓝 1))
    (hMERT : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ, 2 ≤ x →
      |(∑ p ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊x⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, (1 : ℝ) / p) - Real.log (Real.log x)| ≤ C)
    (hEULER : Asymptotics.IsEquivalent atTop
      (fun x : ℝ => ∏ p ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊x⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, (1 - (1 : ℝ) / p))
      (fun x => Real.exp (-Real.eulerMascheroniConstant) / Real.log x))
    (hRHO : 0 < FordAnalysis.rho ∧ FordAnalysis.rho < 3 / 4 ∧ FordAnalysis.F FordAnalysis.rho = 1) :
    ∀ᶠ Z : ℝ in atTop,
      ∀ (M : ℕ) (A y : ℝ) (a : Fin (FordScale.coreDimension M (logLog y)))
        (F : Finset ℕ) (q : ℕ → Fin (FordScale.coreDimension M (logLog y) + 1) → ℕ),
        2 ≤ M → 4 ≤ A → 1 < y → 0 < logLog y →
        (M : ℝ) ≤ 10 * Real.log (logLog Z) →
        (∀ n ∈ F, ∃ R : FordLower.PrimeProductRecord M A y a n, R.fullTuple = q n) →
        ∀ j : ℕ, ((FordLower.suffixesUpTo F q j Z).card : ℝ) ≤
          5 * (Z / (Real.log Z * (logLog Z) ^ 2))

by
  obtain ⟨D, hD, hsizeD⟩ := inverse_totient_size_bound hPNT hMERT hEULER
  have hLL : Tendsto logLog atTop atTop :=
    Real.tendsto_log_atTop.comp Real.tendsto_log_atTop
  
  have h11E : ∀ᶠ Y : ℝ in atTop, Y ^ (19 / 20 : ℝ) ≤ Y / (Real.log Y * (logLog Y) ^ 2) := by
    have hlo := (isLittleO_log_rpow_rpow_atTop (3 : ℝ) (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 20)).bound
      (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1)
    filter_upwards [hlo, hLL.eventually_ge_atTop 1, eventually_gt_atTop (1 : ℝ)] with Y hY hT hY1
    have hlog : 0 < Real.log Y := Real.log_pos hY1
    have hY0 : 0 < Y := by linarith
    have hl3 : 0 ≤ Real.log Y ^ (3 : ℝ) := Real.rpow_nonneg hlog.le _
    have hy20 : 0 ≤ Y ^ (1 / 20 : ℝ) := Real.rpow_nonneg hY0.le _
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, one_mul, abs_of_nonneg hl3, abs_of_nonneg hy20] at hY
    have hTle : logLog Y ≤ Real.log Y := by
      unfold logLog
      exact Real.log_le_self hlog.le
    have hcube : Real.log Y * (logLog Y) ^ 2 ≤ Real.log Y ^ (3 : ℝ) := by
      rw [show (3 : ℝ) = ((3 : ℕ) : ℝ) by norm_num, Real.rpow_natCast]
      have hsq : (logLog Y) ^ 2 ≤ (Real.log Y) ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (by linarith) hTle 2
      nlinarith
    have hpos : 0 < Real.log Y * (logLog Y) ^ 2 := by positivity
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hpos]
    calc Y ^ (19 / 20 : ℝ) * (Real.log Y * (logLog Y) ^ 2)
        ≤ Y ^ (19 / 20 : ℝ) * Y ^ (1 / 20 : ℝ) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hcube.trans hY) (Real.rpow_nonneg hY0.le _)
      _ = Y := by rw [← Real.rpow_add hY0]; norm_num
  
  have h12E : ∀ᶠ T : ℝ in atTop, Real.exp (-(1 / 4 : ℝ) * T ^ (7 / 8 : ℝ)) ≤ 1 / T ^ 2 := by
    have hlo := (isLittleO_log_rpow_rpow_atTop (1 : ℝ) (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 7 / 8)).bound
      (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 8)
    filter_upwards [hlo, eventually_gt_atTop (1 : ℝ)] with T hT hT1

    rw [Real.rpow_one, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hlogT,
      abs_of_pos (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hT0 _)] at hT
    have heq : Real.exp (-(2 * Real.log T)) = 1 / T ^ 2 := by
      rw [Real.exp_neg, show 2 * Real.log T = ((2 : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log T by norm_num,
        Real.exp_nat_mul, Real.exp_log hT0, one_div]
    rw [← heq]
    apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
    linarith
  filter_upwards [record_suffix_factor_count_eventually hPNT hMERT hEULER hRHO,
    record_suffix_count_data_eventually hPNT hMERT hEULER hRHO, hsizeD,
    squarefree_nonnormal_count hPNT hMERT hEULER (A := 5) (c := D) (by norm_num) hD,
    large_prime_square_count hD,
    nonnormal_totients_count hPNT hMERT hEULER,
    survivor_record_eventually hPNT hMERT hEULER hRHO 5,
    records_with_empty_tail_count_eventually hPNT hMERT hEULER hRHO (A := 5) (by norm_num) 1 one_pos,
    tuple_small_of_small_head_eventually (A := 5) (by norm_num),
    h11E, hLL.eventually h12E,
    eventually_gt_atTop (1 : ℝ), hLL.eventually_ge_atTop 1]
    with Z h3 h7 hsz h5 hlps hnnt h8 h9 h10 h11 h12 hZ1 hT1
  intro M A y a F q hM hA hy ht hMZ hrec j
  have hZ0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ Z := by linarith
  have hlogZ : 0 < Real.log Z := Real.log_pos hZ1
  have hT0 : 0 < logLog Z := by linarith
  have hE0 : 0 ≤ Z / (Real.log Z * (logLog Z) ^ 2) := by positivity
  
  have hbasicR : ∀ (n : ℕ) (R : FordLower.PrimeProductRecord M A y a n),
      (∀ idx, (R.fullTuple idx).Prime) ∧ StrictAnti R.fullTuple ∧ (∏ idx, R.fullTuple idx) = n := by
    intro n R
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro idx

      · simpa [FordLower.PrimeProductRecord.fullTuple] using R.lower_prime i

      | zero => exact absurd hik (Fin.not_lt_zero _)
      | succ k' =>
        induction i using Fin.cases with
        | zero => simpa [FordLower.PrimeProductRecord.fullTuple] using R.lower_separated k'

    · rw [FordLower.PrimeProductRecord.fullTuple, Fin.prod_univ_succ, Fin.cons_zero]
      simp only [Fin.cons_succ]

  have hbasic : ∀ n ∈ F, (∀ idx, (q n idx).Prime) ∧ StrictAnti (q n) ∧ (∏ idx, q n idx) = n := by
    intro n hn
    obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ := hrec n hn

  have hmemS : ∀ s ∈ FordLower.suffixesUpTo F q j Z,
      s ∈ FordLower.suffixCollisionFamily F q j ∧ (s.totient : ℝ) ≤ Z ∧
      ∃ n ∈ F, ∃ R : FordLower.PrimeProductRecord M A y a n,
        R.fullTuple = q n ∧ s = FordLower.suffixProduct R.fullTuple j := by
    intro s hs
    unfold FordLower.suffixesUpTo at hs
    obtain ⟨hfam, htot⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hs
    refine ⟨hfam, htot, ?_⟩
    unfold FordLower.suffixCollisionFamily at hfam
    obtain ⟨n, hn, hns⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hfam
    unfold FordLower.prefixCollisionClass FordLower.externalTotientCollisions at hn
    have hnF : n ∈ F := (Finset.mem_filter.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp hn).1).1
    obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ := hrec n hnF
    exact ⟨n, hnF, R, hR, by rw [hR, hns]⟩
  have hprop : ∀ s ∈ FordLower.suffixesUpTo F q j Z,
      j < FordScale.coreDimension M (logLog y) + 1 ∧ 0 < s ∧ Squarefree s ∧
      ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors s = FordScale.coreDimension M (logLog y) + 1 - j ∧
      (FordLower.nontrivialPreimages s).Nonempty ∧
      ∀ w ∈ FordLower.nontrivialPreimages s, largestPrimeFactor w ≠ largestPrimeFactor s := by
    intro s hs
    exact suffix_family_properties F q (fun n hn => (hbasic n hn).1) (fun n hn => (hbasic n hn).2.1)
      (fun n hn => (hbasic n hn).2.2) j (hmemS s hs).1
  have hΩ : ∀ s ∈ FordLower.suffixesUpTo F q j Z,
      (ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors s : ℝ) ≤ 5 * Real.log (logLog Z) := by
    intro s hs
    obtain ⟨_, htot, n, _, R, _, hsR⟩ := hmemS s hs
    have hj := (hprop s hs).1
    rw [hsR] at htot ⊢
    exact h3 M A y a n R (by linarith) ht j hj htot
  have hdim : ∀ s ∈ FordLower.suffixesUpTo F q j Z,

    have hle : FordScale.coreDimension M (logLog y) - j ≤ ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors s := by

    exact le_trans (by exact_mod_cast hle) (hΩ s hs)
  have hdata : ∀ s ∈ FordLower.suffixesUpTo F q j Z,
      ∃ pr : Fin (FordScale.coreDimension M (logLog y) - j + 1) → ℕ,
        (∏ idx, pr idx) = s ∧
        (∀ idx, (pr idx).Prime) ∧ (∀ idx, 17 ≤ pr idx) ∧ StrictAnti pr ∧

    intro s hs

    have hj := (hprop s hs).1
    have hΩs := hΩ s hs
    rw [hsR] at htot hΩs ⊢
    exact h7 M A y a n R hM hA hy ht hMZ j hj htot hΩs
  
  obtain ⟨G, w, hGS, _, hsurv, hcard⟩ := suffix_pruning_finite_explicit (B := 5) (c := D) hZ0 hsz
    (FordLower.suffixesUpTo F q j Z) (FordScale.coreDimension M (logLog y) + 1 - j)
    (fun n hn => ⟨(hprop n hn).2.1, (hprop n hn).2.2.1, (hprop n hn).2.2.2.1,

  generalize FordScale.coreDimension M (logLog y) - j = L' at hdim hdata
  choose! pr hpr using hdata
  have hG₁ : ((G.filter (fun s => Z ^ (9 / 10 : ℝ) < (pr s 0 : ℝ))).card : ℝ) ≤
      Z / (Real.log Z * (logLog Z) ^ 2) := by
    rcases (G.filter (fun s => Z ^ (9 / 10 : ℝ) < (pr s 0 : ℝ))).eq_empty_or_nonempty with he | ⟨s₀, hs₀⟩
    · rw [he, Finset.card_empty, Nat.cast_zero]; exact hE0
    · have hs₀S := hGS (Finset.mem_filter.mp hs₀).1
      have hlpf : (largestPrimeFactor 1 : ℝ) ≤ normalityScale (logLog Z) := by
        have h1 : largestPrimeFactor 1 = 1 := by simp [largestPrimeFactor]
        rw [h1, Nat.cast_one]
        exact Real.one_le_exp (Real.exp_pos _).le
      have hc := h9 L' (G.filter (fun s => Z ^ (9 / 10 : ℝ) < (pr s 0 : ℝ))) (hdim s₀ hs₀S) hlpf
        (fun n hn => by
          obtain ⟨hnG, htop⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hn
          have hnS := hGS hnG
          obtain ⟨hi, hpri, hmin, hord, hgap, hfac⟩ := hpr n hnS
          exact h8 L' n (w n) (pr n) (hdim n hnS) hi hpri hmin hord hgap hfac (hsurv n hnG) htop)
      calc _ ≤ Z / (((1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log Z) *
            Real.exp (-(1 / 4 : ℝ) * (logLog Z) ^ (7 / 8 : ℝ)) := hc
        _ ≤ Z / (((1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log Z) * (1 / (logLog Z) ^ 2) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h12 (by rw [Nat.cast_one, one_mul]; positivity)
        _ = Z / (Real.log Z * (logLog Z) ^ 2) := by
          rw [Nat.cast_one, one_mul]; field_simp
  have hG₀ : ((G.filter (fun s => ¬ Z ^ (9 / 10 : ℝ) < (pr s 0 : ℝ))).card : ℝ) ≤
      Z / (Real.log Z * (logLog Z) ^ 2) := by
    have hsub : G.filter (fun s => ¬ Z ^ (9 / 10 : ℝ) < (pr s 0 : ℝ)) ⊆
        Finset.Icc 1 ⌊Z ^ (19 / 20 : ℝ)⌋₊ := by
      intro n hn
      obtain ⟨hnG, htop⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hn
      have hnS := hGS hnG
      obtain ⟨hi, hpri, hmin, hord, hgap, _⟩ := hpr n hnS
      have hpos := (hprop n hnS).2.1
      have htot := (hmemS n hnS).2.1
      have hsmall := h10 L' (pr n) (hdim n hnS) hpri (fun idx => le_trans (by norm_num) (hmin idx))
        hord (by rw [hi]; exact htot) hgap (not_lt.mp htop)
      rw [hi] at hsmall

    have h1 := Finset.card_le_card hsub
    rw [Nat.card_Icc, Nat.add_sub_cancel] at h1
    have h2 : ((G.filter (fun s => ¬ Z ^ (9 / 10 : ℝ) < (pr s 0 : ℝ))).card : ℝ) ≤

    exact h2.trans ((Nat.floor_le (Real.rpow_nonneg hZ0 _)).trans h11)
  have hsplit := Finset.card_filter_add_card_filter_not (s := G)
    (fun s => Z ^ (9 / 10 : ℝ) < (pr s 0 : ℝ))
  have hsplitR : ((G.filter (fun s => Z ^ (9 / 10 : ℝ) < (pr s 0 : ℝ))).card : ℝ) +
      ((G.filter (fun s => ¬ Z ^ (9 / 10 : ℝ) < (pr s 0 : ℝ))).card : ℝ) = (G.card : ℝ) := by

by
  
  have suffixMass_abel_tail : ∀ (G : Finset ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℕ) {u z D : ℝ},
      Real.exp (Real.exp 1) ≤ u → u ≤ z → 0 ≤ D →
      (∀ s ∈ G, u ≤ (w s : ℝ) ∧ (w s : ℝ) ≤ z) →
      (∀ t : ℝ, u ≤ t → t ≤ z →
        ((G.filter (fun s => (w s : ℝ) ≤ t)).card : ℝ) ≤ D * (t / (Real.log t * (logLog t) ^ 2))) →
      (∑ s ∈ G, ((w s : ℝ))⁻¹) ≤ 2 * D / logLog u := by
    intro G w u z D hu huz hD hG hdensity
    have he1 : (1 : ℝ) + 1 ≤ Real.exp 1 := Real.add_one_le_exp 1
    have hee : Real.exp 1 + 1 ≤ Real.exp (Real.exp 1) := Real.add_one_le_exp _
    have hpos : ∀ t, u ≤ t → 0 < t := fun t ht => by linarith
    have hlogt : ∀ t, u ≤ t → Real.exp 1 ≤ Real.log t := by
      intro t ht
      have := Real.log_le_log (Real.exp_pos _) (hu.trans ht)
      rwa [Real.log_exp] at this
    have hLLt : ∀ t, u ≤ t → 1 ≤ Real.log (Real.log t) := by
      intro t ht
      have := Real.log_le_log (Real.exp_pos _) (hlogt t ht)
      rwa [Real.log_exp] at this
    have hLLmono : Real.log (Real.log u) ≤ Real.log (Real.log z) :=
      Real.log_le_log (by linarith [hlogt u le_rfl]) (Real.log_le_log (hpos u le_rfl) huz)
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ : ∃ g : ℝ → ℝ, g = fun t => (t ^ 2)⁻¹ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hgcont : ∀ a b : ℝ, u ≤ a → ContinuousOn g (Set.Icc a b) := by
      intro a b ha
      rw [hg]
      exact ContinuousOn.inv₀ (continuous_pow 2).continuousOn
        (fun t ht => pow_ne_zero 2 (ne_of_gt (hpos t (ha.trans ht.1))))
    have hgderiv : ∀ t, u ≤ t → HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => -y⁻¹) (g t) t := by
      intro t ht
      have h := (hasDerivAt_inv (ne_of_gt (hpos t ht))).neg
      rw [neg_neg] at h
      rw [hg]
      exact h
    have hA : ∀ a, u ≤ a → a ≤ z →
        ∫ t in u..z, (Set.Ioi a).indicator g t = a⁻¹ - z⁻¹ := by
      intro a hua haz
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le huz, MeasureTheory.setIntegral_indicator measurableSet_Ioi,
        Set.Ioc_inter_Ioi, max_eq_right hua, ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le haz]
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt (f := fun y : ℝ => -y⁻¹)]
      · ring
      · intro t ht
        rw [Set.uIcc_of_le haz] at ht
        exact hgderiv t (hua.trans ht.1)
      · exact (hgcont a z hua).intervalIntegrable_of_Icc haz
    have hind : ∀ s ∈ G, IntervalIntegrable ((Set.Ioi (w s : ℝ)).indicator g) volume u z := by
      intro s _
      rw [intervalIntegrable_iff_integrableOn_Ioc_of_le huz]
      exact (((hgcont u z le_rfl).integrableOn_Icc).mono_set Set.Ioc_subset_Icc_self).indicator
        measurableSet_Ioi
    have hsumeq : (∑ s ∈ G, ((w s : ℝ))⁻¹) =
        (G.card : ℝ) * z⁻¹ + ∫ t in u..z, ∑ s ∈ G, (Set.Ioi (w s : ℝ)).indicator g t := by
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_finset_sum hind]
      have hc : (∑ s ∈ G, ∫ t in u..z, (Set.Ioi (w s : ℝ)).indicator g t) =
          ∑ s ∈ G, (((w s : ℝ))⁻¹ - z⁻¹) :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun s hs => hA (w s) (hG s hs).1 (hG s hs).2)
      rw [hc, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
      ring
    obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ : ∃ f : ℝ → ℝ,
        f = fun t => -(D * (-(t⁻¹ / Real.log t) / Real.log (Real.log t) ^ 2)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hΦ : ∀ t, u ≤ t → HasDerivAt (fun y => -(D * (Real.log (Real.log y))⁻¹)) (f t) t := by
      intro t ht
      have ht0 := hpos t ht
      have hlog0 : Real.log t ≠ 0 := (show (0 : ℝ) < Real.log t by linarith [hlogt t ht]).ne'
      have hLL0 : Real.log (Real.log t) ≠ 0 :=
        (show (0 : ℝ) < Real.log (Real.log t) by linarith [hLLt t ht]).ne'
      rw [hf]
      exact ((((Real.hasDerivAt_log ht0.ne').log hlog0).inv hLL0).const_mul D).neg
    have hfcont : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc u z) := by
      intro t ht
      apply ContinuousAt.continuousWithinAt
      have ht0 := hpos t ht.1
      have hlog0 : Real.log t ≠ 0 := (show (0 : ℝ) < Real.log t by linarith [hlogt t ht.1]).ne'
      have hLL0 : Real.log (Real.log t) ≠ 0 :=
        (show (0 : ℝ) < Real.log (Real.log t) by linarith [hLLt t ht.1]).ne'
      rw [hf]
      have h1 : ContinuousAt (fun y : ℝ => y⁻¹) t := continuousAt_inv₀ ht0.ne'
      have h2 : ContinuousAt Real.log t := Real.continuousAt_log ht0.ne'
      have h3 : ContinuousAt (fun y => Real.log (Real.log y)) t := h2.log hlog0
      exact (continuousAt_const.mul
        (((h1.div h2 hlog0).neg).div (h3.pow 2) (pow_ne_zero 2 hLL0))).neg
    have hFTC : ∫ t in u..z, f t = D / logLog u - D / logLog z := by
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt
        (fun t ht => hΦ t (by rw [Set.uIcc_of_le huz] at ht; exact ht.1))
        (hfcont.intervalIntegrable_of_Icc huz)]
      unfold logLog
      ring
    have hint_le : ∫ t in u..z, ∑ s ∈ G, (Set.Ioi (w s : ℝ)).indicator g t ≤

      apply intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on huz
      · convert IntervalIntegrable.sum G hind using 1
        ext t
        simp [Finset.sum_apply]
      · exact hfcont.intervalIntegrable_of_Icc huz
      · intro t ht
        have ht0 := hpos t ht.1
        have ht0' : t ≠ 0 := ht0.ne'
        have hlog0 : Real.log t ≠ 0 := (show (0 : ℝ) < Real.log t by linarith [hlogt t ht.1]).ne'
        have hLL0 : Real.log (Real.log t) ≠ 0 :=
          (show (0 : ℝ) < Real.log (Real.log t) by linarith [hLLt t ht.1]).ne'
        have hrw : (∑ s ∈ G, (Set.Ioi (w s : ℝ)).indicator g t) =
            ((G.filter (fun s => (w s : ℝ) < t)).card : ℝ) * (t ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
          rw [Finset.natCast_card_filter, Finset.sum_mul]
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro s _
          simp only [Set.indicator_apply, Set.mem_Ioi, hg]
          split_ifs <;> simp
        rw [hrw]
        have hcard : ((G.filter (fun s => (w s : ℝ) < t)).card : ℝ) ≤
            ((G.filter (fun s => (w s : ℝ) ≤ t)).card : ℝ) := by
          exact_mod_cast Finset.card_le_card (fun x hx => by
            simp only [Finset.mem_filter] at hx ⊢
            exact ⟨hx.1, hx.2.le⟩)
        have hd := hdensity t ht.1 ht.2
        have hg0 : 0 ≤ (t ^ 2)⁻¹ := by positivity
        calc _ ≤ D * (t / (Real.log t * (logLog t) ^ 2)) * (t ^ 2)⁻¹ :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hcard.trans hd) hg0
          _ = f t := by
              simp only [hf]
              unfold logLog
              field_simp
    have hcardG : (G.card : ℝ) ≤ D * (z / (Real.log z * (logLog z) ^ 2)) := by
      have hfil : G.filter (fun s => (w s : ℝ) ≤ z) = G :=
        Finset.filter_true_of_mem (fun s hs => (hG s hs).2)
      have := hdensity z huz le_rfl
      rwa [hfil] at this
    have hend : (G.card : ℝ) * z⁻¹ ≤ D / logLog u := by
      have hz0 := hpos z huz
      have hz0' : z ≠ 0 := hz0.ne'
      have hlz := hlogt z huz
      have hLLz := hLLt z huz
      have hLLu := hLLt u le_rfl
      unfold logLog at hcardG ⊢
      have h1 : Real.log (Real.log z) ≤ Real.log (Real.log z) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
      have h2 : Real.log (Real.log z) ^ 2 ≤ Real.log z * Real.log (Real.log z) ^ 2 := by
        nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (show (1 : ℝ) ≤ Real.log z by linarith)
          (sq_nonneg (Real.log (Real.log z)))]
      have hX : Real.log (Real.log u) ≤ Real.log z * Real.log (Real.log z) ^ 2 := by linarith
      have hX0 : Real.log z * Real.log (Real.log z) ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by
        have : 0 < Real.log z * Real.log (Real.log z) ^ 2 := by linarith
        exact this.ne'
      calc (G.card : ℝ) * z⁻¹ ≤ D * (z / (Real.log z * Real.log (Real.log z) ^ 2)) * z⁻¹ :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcardG (inv_nonneg.mpr hz0.le)
        _ = D / (Real.log z * Real.log (Real.log z) ^ 2) := by field_simp
        _ ≤ D / Real.log (Real.log u) :=
            div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hD (by linarith) hX
    have hFTCle : ∫ t in u..z, f t ≤ D / logLog u := by
      rw [hFTC]
      have : 0 ≤ D / logLog z := div_nonneg hD (by unfold logLog; linarith [hLLt z huz])
      linarith
    rw [hsumeq]
    have h2 : 2 * D / logLog u = D / logLog u + D / logLog u := by ring
    linarith [hint_le, hFTCle, hend]
  
  have suffixMass_squarefree_sum : ∀ (S P : Finset ℕ) (k : ℕ), (∀ p ∈ P, p.Prime) →
      (∀ n ∈ S, (∏ p ∈ n.primeFactors, p) = n ∧ n.primeFactors ⊆ P ∧ n.primeFactors.card ≤ k) →
      (∑ n ∈ S, ((n.totient : ℝ))⁻¹) ≤
        Real.exp 1 * (1 + ∑ p ∈ P, (1 : ℝ) / ((p : ℝ) - 1)) ^ k := by
    intro S P k hP hS
    have htot : ∀ n ∈ S, ((n.totient : ℝ))⁻¹ = ∏ p ∈ n.primeFactors, (1 : ℝ) / ((p : ℝ) - 1) := by
      intro n hn
      obtain ⟨hprod, -, -⟩ := hS n hn
      have hn0 : n ≠ 0 := by
        rintro rfl
        simp at hprod
      have hkey := Nat.totient_mul_prod_primeFactors n
      rw [hprod] at hkey
      have hφ : n.totient = ∏ p ∈ n.primeFactors, (p - 1) := by
        have h2 : n.totient * n = (∏ p ∈ n.primeFactors, (p - 1)) * n := by
          rw [hkey]; ring
        exact Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_right (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn0) h2

      apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
      intro p hp
      have hp1 : 1 ≤ p := (Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp).one_le
      rw [Nat.cast_sub hp1, Nat.cast_one, one_div]
    have hinj : Set.InjOn Nat.primeFactors (S : Set ℕ) := by
      intro n hn m hm h

      intro p hp
      have : (2 : ℝ) ≤ p := by exact_mod_cast (hP p hp).two_le
      apply div_nonneg zero_le_one
      linarith
    have hsum0 : 0 ≤ ∑ p ∈ P, (1 : ℝ) / ((p : ℝ) - 1) := Finset.sum_nonneg hw0
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ : ∃ a : ℝ, a = 1 + ∑ p ∈ P, (1 : ℝ) / ((p : ℝ) - 1) := ⟨_, rfl⟩

    have ha1 : 1 ≤ a := by rw [ha]; linarith
    have ha0 : 0 < a := by linarith
    calc (∑ n ∈ S, ((n.totient : ℝ))⁻¹)
        = ∑ n ∈ S, ∏ p ∈ n.primeFactors, (1 : ℝ) / ((p : ℝ) - 1) := Finset.sum_congr rfl htot

          (Finset.sum_image (f := fun T : Finset ℕ => ∏ p ∈ T, (1 : ℝ) / ((p : ℝ) - 1)) hinj).symm

          apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg

            obtain ⟨n, hn, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hT
            exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_powerset.mpr (hS n hn).2.1, (hS n hn).2.2⟩
          · intro T hT _
            exact Finset.prod_nonneg fun p hp =>
              hw0 p (Finset.mem_powerset.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp hT).1 hp)

            a ^ k * ∏ p ∈ T, ((1 : ℝ) / ((p : ℝ) - 1) / a) := by
          apply Finset.sum_le_sum

          obtain ⟨hTP, hTk⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hT

              (∏ p ∈ T, (1 : ℝ) / ((p : ℝ) - 1)) / a ^ T.card := by
            rw [Finset.prod_div_distrib, Finset.prod_const]
          have hprod0 : 0 ≤ ∏ p ∈ T, (1 : ℝ) / ((p : ℝ) - 1) :=
            Finset.prod_nonneg fun p hp => hw0 p (hTP' hp)
          have hpow : a ^ T.card ≤ a ^ k := pow_le_pow_right₀ ha1 hTk

          rw [hdiv, mul_div_assoc', le_div_iff₀ hTpos]
          nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpow hprod0]
      _ = a ^ k * ∑ T ∈ P.powerset.filter (fun T => T.card ≤ k),
            ∏ p ∈ T, ((1 : ℝ) / ((p : ℝ) - 1) / a) := (Finset.mul_sum _ _ _).symm
      _ ≤ a ^ k * ∑ T ∈ P.powerset, ∏ p ∈ T, ((1 : ℝ) / ((p : ℝ) - 1) / a) := by
          apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (pow_nonneg ha0.le _)
          apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.filter_subset _ _)

            div_nonneg (hw0 p (Finset.mem_powerset.mp hT hp)) ha0.le

          rw [Finset.prod_one_add]

          apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (pow_nonneg ha0.le _)

  have suffixMass_record_tuple : ∀ {M' : ℕ} {A' y' : ℝ} {a' : Fin (FordScale.coreDimension M' (logLog y'))}

      (∀ idx, (R.fullTuple idx).Prime) ∧ StrictAnti R.fullTuple := by
    intro M' A' y' a' n' R

      · simp only [FordLower.PrimeProductRecord.fullTuple, Fin.cons_zero]
        exact R.leading_prime
      · simp only [FordLower.PrimeProductRecord.fullTuple, Fin.cons_succ]
        exact R.lower_prime i
    · intro i i' hii'
      induction i using Fin.cases with
      | zero =>
        induction i' using Fin.cases with
        | zero => exact absurd hii' (lt_irrefl _)
        | succ j0 =>
          simp only [FordLower.PrimeProductRecord.fullTuple, Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_succ]
          exact R.lower_separated j0
      | succ i0 =>

  have suffixMass_family_support : ∀ {k : ℕ} (F : Finset ℕ) (q : ℕ → Fin k → ℕ),

      (∏ p ∈ s.primeFactors, p) = s ∧ s.primeFactors.card ≤ k - j ∧
        ∀ p ∈ s.primeFactors, p ≤ s.totient + 1 := by
    intro k F q hp ho j s hs
    unfold FordLower.suffixCollisionFamily at hs
    obtain ⟨n, hn, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hs
    have hnF : n ∈ F := by
      unfold FordLower.prefixCollisionClass FordLower.externalTotientCollisions at hn
      exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp hn).1).1
    have hinj : Function.Injective (q n) := (ho n hnF).injective
    have hprod : FordLower.suffixProduct (q n) j =
        ∏ p ∈ (Finset.univ.filter (fun idx : Fin k => j ≤ idx.val)).image (q n), p := by
      unfold FordLower.suffixProduct
      rw [Finset.prod_image (fun a _ b _ h => hinj h)]
    have hprimes : ∀ p ∈ (Finset.univ.filter (fun idx : Fin k => j ≤ idx.val)).image (q n),
        p.Prime := by
      intro p hpm
      obtain ⟨idx, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hpm
      exact hp n hnF idx
    have hpf : (FordLower.suffixProduct (q n) j).primeFactors =
        (Finset.univ.filter (fun idx : Fin k => j ≤ idx.val)).image (q n) := by
      rw [hprod]
      exact Nat.primeFactors_prod hprimes
    have hI : (Finset.univ.filter (fun idx : Fin k => j ≤ idx.val)).card ≤ k - j := by
      have hsub : (Finset.univ.filter (fun idx : Fin k => j ≤ idx.val)).map Fin.valEmbedding ⊆
          Finset.Ico j k := by
        intro x hx
        rw [Finset.mem_map] at hx
        obtain ⟨idx, hidx, rfl⟩ := hx
        rw [Finset.mem_Ico]
        exact ⟨(Finset.mem_filter.mp hidx).2, idx.isLt⟩
      have := Finset.card_le_card hsub
      rwa [Finset.card_map, Nat.card_Ico] at this
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hpf, hprod]
    · rw [hpf]
      exact Finset.card_image_le.trans hI
    · intro p hps
      obtain ⟨hpp, hd, hs0⟩ := Nat.mem_primeFactors.mp hps
      have h := Nat.le_of_dvd (Nat.totient_pos.mpr (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hs0))
        (Nat.totient_dvd_of_dvd hd)
      rw [Nat.totient_prime hpp] at h
      omega
  
  have suffixMass_shifted_prime_sum : ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ x : ℝ, Real.exp (Real.exp 1) ≤ x →
      (∑ p ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊x⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, (1 : ℝ) / ((p : ℝ) - 1)) ≤
        C * Real.log (Real.log x) := by
    obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := hMERT

    intro x hx

    have hee : Real.exp 1 + 1 ≤ Real.exp (Real.exp 1) := Real.add_one_le_exp _
    have hx2 : 2 ≤ x := by linarith
    have hlogx : Real.exp 1 ≤ Real.log x := by
      have := Real.log_le_log (Real.exp_pos _) hx
      rwa [Real.log_exp] at this
    have hLL : 1 ≤ Real.log (Real.log x) := by
      have := Real.log_le_log (Real.exp_pos _) hlogx
      rwa [Real.log_exp] at this
    have hterm : ∀ p ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊x⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime,

      intro p hp
      have hp2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ p := by exact_mod_cast (Finset.mem_filter.mp hp).2.two_le
      have h := one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) < p / 2)
        (by linarith : (p : ℝ) / 2 ≤ p - 1)
      rw [one_div_div] at h
      rw [mul_one_div]
      exact h
    have hsum := Finset.sum_le_sum hterm
    rw [← Finset.mul_sum] at hsum
    have hM := (abs_le.mp (hB x hx2)).2
    nlinarith [le_abs_self B, mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hLL (abs_nonneg B)]
  obtain ⟨Z₀, hZ⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.mp hSUFFIX
  obtain ⟨C, hC, hprime⟩ := suffixMass_shifted_prime_sum
  have hu_t : Tendsto (fun M : ℕ => Real.exp (Real.exp (Real.exp ((M : ℝ) / 10)))) atTop atTop :=
    Real.tendsto_exp_atTop.comp (Real.tendsto_exp_atTop.comp
      (Real.tendsto_exp_atTop.comp ((tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).atTop_div_const
        (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 10))))
  have hgrow : Tendsto (fun M : ℕ => Real.exp ((M : ℝ) / 90)) atTop atTop :=
    Real.tendsto_exp_atTop.comp ((tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).atTop_div_const
      (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 90))
  filter_upwards [hu_t.eventually_ge_atTop Z₀,
    hgrow.eventually_ge_atTop (Real.exp 1 * (1 + 2 * C)), eventually_ge_atTop 2]
    with M hMZ hconst hM2
  intro A y a F q hA hy ht hrec j hj
  have hM0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ M := Nat.cast_nonneg M
  have hE1 : 1 ≤ Real.exp ((M : ℝ) / 10) := Real.one_le_exp (by positivity)
  have hLLu : logLog (Real.exp (Real.exp (Real.exp ((M : ℝ) / 10)))) = Real.exp ((M : ℝ) / 10) := by
    simp only [logLog, Real.log_exp]
  have hee : Real.exp (Real.exp 1) ≤ Real.exp (Real.exp (Real.exp ((M : ℝ) / 10))) :=
    Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hE1)
  have hMZ' : Z₀ ≤ Real.exp (Real.exp (Real.exp ((M : ℝ) / 10))) := hMZ
  generalize Real.exp (Real.exp (Real.exp ((M : ℝ) / 10))) = u at hLLu hee hMZ'
  have hMu : (M : ℝ) = 10 * Real.log (logLog u) := by
    rw [hLLu, Real.log_exp]; ring
  have he2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp (Real.exp 1) := by
    have h1 := Real.add_one_le_exp (Real.exp 1)
    have h2 := Real.add_one_le_exp (1 : ℝ)
    linarith
  have hu2 : 2 ≤ u := he2.trans hee
  have hu1 : 1 < u := by linarith
  have hLLpos : 0 < logLog u := by rw [hLLu]; exact Real.exp_pos _
  
  have hp : ∀ n ∈ F, ∀ idx, (q n idx).Prime := by
    intro n hn
    obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ := hrec n hn
    rw [← hR]
    exact (suffixMass_record_tuple R).1
  have ho : ∀ n ∈ F, StrictAnti (q n) := by
    intro n hn
    obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ := hrec n hn
    rw [← hR]
    exact (suffixMass_record_tuple R).2
  
  have hlogmono : ∀ t : ℝ, u ≤ t → logLog u ≤ logLog t := by
    intro t hut
    have hlu : 0 < Real.log u := Real.log_pos hu1
    unfold logLog
    exact Real.log_le_log hlu (Real.log_le_log (by linarith) hut)
  have hlarge : (∑ s ∈ (FordLower.suffixCollisionFamily F q j).filter
      (fun s => u ≤ (s.totient : ℝ)), ((s.totient : ℝ))⁻¹) ≤ 10 := by
    have hGmem : ∀ s ∈ (FordLower.suffixCollisionFamily F q j).filter
        (fun s => u ≤ (s.totient : ℝ)),
        u ≤ (s.totient : ℝ) ∧ (s.totient : ℝ) ≤ max u ((((FordLower.suffixCollisionFamily F q j).filter
          (fun s => u ≤ (s.totient : ℝ))).sup Nat.totient : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
      intro s hs
      exact ⟨(Finset.mem_filter.mp hs).2,
        (Nat.cast_le.mpr (Finset.le_sup (f := Nat.totient) hs)).trans (le_max_right _ _)⟩
    have hdensity : ∀ t : ℝ, u ≤ t →
        t ≤ max u ((((FordLower.suffixCollisionFamily F q j).filter
          (fun s => u ≤ (s.totient : ℝ))).sup Nat.totient : ℕ) : ℝ) →
        ((((FordLower.suffixCollisionFamily F q j).filter
          (fun s => u ≤ (s.totient : ℝ))).filter (fun s => (s.totient : ℝ) ≤ t)).card : ℝ) ≤

      intro t hut _
      have hMt : (M : ℝ) ≤ 10 * Real.log (logLog t) := by
        rw [hMu]
        have := Real.log_le_log hLLpos (hlogmono t hut)
        linarith
      have hcount := hZ t (hMZ'.trans hut) M A y a F q hM2 hA hy ht hMt hrec j
      have hsub : ((FordLower.suffixCollisionFamily F q j).filter
          (fun s => u ≤ (s.totient : ℝ))).filter (fun s => (s.totient : ℝ) ≤ t) ⊆
          FordLower.suffixesUpTo F q j t := by

        rw [Finset.mem_filter]

    have h := suffixMass_abel_tail _ Nat.totient hee (le_max_left _ _)

  have hm1 : 1 ≤ FordScale.coreDimension M (logLog y) + 1 - j := by omega
  generalize hm : FordScale.coreDimension M (logLog y) + 1 - j = m at hm1 ⊢
  have hHmem : ∀ n ∈ (FordLower.suffixCollisionFamily F q j).filter

        n.primeFactors.card ≤ m := by
    intro s hs
    obtain ⟨hsS, hsu⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hs
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := suffixMass_family_support F q hp ho j s hsS
    refine ⟨h1, ?_, hm ▸ h2⟩
    intro p hps
    have hppr := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hps
    have hle := h3 p hps
    have hleR : (p : ℝ) ≤ u + 1 := by
      have hcast : (p : ℝ) ≤ (s.totient : ℝ) + 1 := by exact_mod_cast hle

      linarith
    exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_Iic.mpr (Nat.le_floor hleR), hppr⟩
  have hsmall := suffixMass_squarefree_sum _ _ m (fun p hp => (Finset.mem_filter.mp hp).2) hHmem
  have hb0 : 0 ≤ ∑ p ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊u + 1⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, (1 : ℝ) / ((p : ℝ) - 1) := by
    apply Finset.sum_nonneg
    intro p hp
    have hp1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ p := by exact_mod_cast (Finset.mem_filter.mp hp).2.one_le
    exact div_nonneg zero_le_one (sub_nonneg.mpr hp1)
  have hLLadd : logLog (u + 1) ≤ logLog u + 1 := by
    have hlog : 0 < Real.log u := Real.log_pos hu1
    have hsq : u + 1 ≤ u ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    have h1 : Real.log (u + 1) ≤ 2 * Real.log u := by
      have := Real.log_le_log (by linarith) hsq
      simpa only [Real.log_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat] using this
    have h2 : 0 < Real.log (u + 1) := Real.log_pos (by linarith)
    have h3 : Real.log (Real.log (u + 1)) ≤ Real.log (2 * Real.log u) := Real.log_le_log h2 h1

    have h4 := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)
    unfold logLog
    linarith
  have hb : ∑ p ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊u + 1⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, (1 : ℝ) / ((p : ℝ) - 1) ≤
      C * (Real.exp ((M : ℝ) / 10) + 1) := by
    have h := hprime (u + 1) (by linarith)

  generalize ∑ p ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊u + 1⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, (1 : ℝ) / ((p : ℝ) - 1) = b
    at hb0 hb hsmall
  have hbase : Real.exp 1 * (1 + b) ≤ Real.exp ((M : ℝ) / 9) := by
    calc
      _ ≤ Real.exp 1 * (1 + C * (Real.exp ((M : ℝ) / 10) + 1)) := by
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (Real.exp_pos 1).le
        linarith
      _ ≤ (Real.exp 1 * (1 + 2 * C)) * Real.exp ((M : ℝ) / 10) := by

      _ ≤ Real.exp ((M : ℝ) / 90) * Real.exp ((M : ℝ) / 10) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hconst (Real.exp_pos _).le
      _ = _ := by rw [← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; ring
  have hdim : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (m : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hm1
  have hsmall' : (∑ s ∈ (FordLower.suffixCollisionFamily F q j).filter

  linarith

(hPNT : Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => (Nat.primeCounting ⌊x⌋₊ : ℝ) / (x / Real.log x)) atTop (𝓝 1))
    (hMERT : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ, 2 ≤ x →

      (a : Fin (FordScale.coreDimension M (logLog y))) (F : Finset ℕ)

        ((FordLower.prefixCollisionClass F q (K + 1)).card : ℝ) ≤
          C * (y / Real.log y) * ((logLog y) ^ K * FordGeometry.modelVolume K) *
            ∑ s ∈ FordLower.suffixCollisionFamily F q (K + 1), ((s.totient : ℝ))⁻¹

by
  obtain ⟨C₃, hC₃, h3⟩ := pc_two_factor_prime_count_bound hPNT
  obtain ⟨C₄, hC₄, h4⟩ := pc_tupleIntegers_reciprocal_mass_upper prime_reciprocal_log_error
  have hREN := ford_renewal_scaled_bounds hRHO
  have hB : 0 < C₄ * (3 + Real.exp 80) := mul_pos hC₄ (by positivity)
  
  have hs8 : ∀ (M : ℕ) (t : ℝ), Real.exp 1 ≤ t → ∀ K : ℕ, K ≤ FordScale.coreDimension M t →
      (∑ n ∈ FordReciprocal.tupleIntegers K t (FordGeometry.polytope K (fun _ => 1)),
        ((n.totient : ℝ))⁻¹) ≤ (C₄ * (3 + Real.exp 80)) * t ^ K * FordGeometry.modelVolume K := by
    intro M t ht K hK

    have ht1 : 1 ≤ t := (Real.one_le_exp zero_le_one).trans ht
    have hτ0 : 0 ≤ 1 / t := one_div_nonneg.mpr ht0.le
    have hτ1 : 1 / t ≤ 1 := (div_le_one ht0).mpr ht1

      _ ≤ C₄ * t ^ K * ((3 + Real.exp 80) * FordGeometry.modelVolume K) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hv (mul_nonneg hC₄.le (pow_nonneg ht0.le K))
      _ = (C₄ * (3 + Real.exp 80)) * t ^ K * FordGeometry.modelVolume K := by ring
  
  refine ⟨C₃ * (C₄ * (3 + Real.exp 80)) * (20 / 19), mul_pos (mul_pos hC₃ hB) (by norm_num), ?_⟩
  intro M A y a F q hy ht hrec K hK
  have ht0 : 0 < logLog y := (Real.exp_pos 1).trans_le ht
  have hy0 : 0 < y := by linarith
  have hlog : 0 < Real.log y := Real.log_pos hy
  have ha : 0 < (19 / 20 : ℝ) * Real.log y := mul_pos (by norm_num) hlog
  have hsub : ∀ n ∈ FordLower.prefixCollisionClass F q (K + 1), n ∈ F := by
    intro n hn

noncomputable def FordOrder.unordered (L : ℕ) : Set (Fin L → ℝ) :=
  {x | FordGeometry.outerForm L x ≤ 1 ∧ ∀ idx, FordGeometry.tailForm idx x ≤ x idx}

noncomputable def FordOrder.slack {L : ℕ} (x : Fin L → ℝ) : Fin L → ℝ :=
  fun j => x j - FordGeometry.tailForm j x

noncomputable def FordOrder.weight (L : ℕ) (j : Fin L) : ℝ :=
  if j.val + 1 < L then FordAnalysis.g (j.val + 1) else FordAnalysis.gStar (j.val + 1)

noncomputable def FordOrder.invWeight (L : ℕ) (i j : Fin L) : ℝ :=
  if i.val ≤ j.val then
    (if j.val + 1 < L then FordAnalysis.g (j.val - i.val) else FordAnalysis.gStar (j.val - i.val))
  else 0

noncomputable def FordOrder.topCoeff (L : ℕ) (j : Fin L) : ℝ :=
  if j.val = 0 then 0
  else if j.val + 1 < L then FordAnalysis.g (j.val + 1) - FordAnalysis.g j.val
  else FordAnalysis.gStar (j.val + 1) - FordAnalysis.gStar j.val

noncomputable def FordOrder.adjCoeff (L : ℕ) (p j : Fin L) : ℝ :=
  if j.val + 1 = p.val then 1
  else if p.val < j.val then
    (if j.val + 1 < L then FordAnalysis.g (j.val - p.val + 1) - FordAnalysis.g (j.val - p.val)
     else FordAnalysis.gStar (j.val - p.val + 1) - FordAnalysis.gStar (j.val - p.val))
  else 0

noncomputable def FordOrder.cutWeight {n : ℕ} (b c : Fin n → ℝ) (d : ℝ) (p j : Fin n) : ℝ :=
  if j = p then b p / d else b j + (b p / d) * c j

        1 / ((n ! : ℝ) * ((∏ i ∈ Finset.range n, FordAnalysis.g i) * FordAnalysis.g n)) := by
      field_simp
    rw [e]
    apply one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by positivity)
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ hF0.le
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hgle n) hP.le
  
  set a : ℕ → ℝ := fun k => FordAnalysis.coeff k * ρ ^ k with ha_def
  have ha : ∀ k, 0 ≤ a k := fun k => mul_nonneg (hnn k) (pow_nonneg hρ0.le k)
  have ha0 : a 0 = 0 := by simp [ha_def, hc0]
  have hFa : ∑' k, a k = 1 := hF
  have hsum : Summable a := by
    by_contra hns
    rw [tsum_eq_zero_of_not_summable hns] at hFa
    norm_num at hFa
  set T : ℕ → ℝ := fun m => ∑' j, a (j + m) with hT_def
  have hT : ∀ m, (∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, a i) + T m = 1 := by
    intro m
    rw [hT_def]
    simp only
    rw [hsum.sum_add_tsum_nat_add m, hFa]
  have hratio : ∀ m, ρ * T m ≤ T (m + 1) := by
    intro m
    simp only [hT_def]
    rw [← tsum_mul_left]

    · intro j
      simp only [ha_def]
      calc ρ * (FordAnalysis.coeff (j + m) * ρ ^ (j + m))
          = FordAnalysis.coeff (j + m) * ρ ^ (j + (m + 1)) := by ring
        _ ≤ FordAnalysis.coeff (j + (m + 1)) * ρ ^ (j + (m + 1)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hmono (j + m)) (pow_nonneg hρ0.le _)
    · exact ((summable_nat_add_iff m).mpr hsum).mul_left ρ
    · exact (summable_nat_add_iff (m + 1)).mpr hsum
  have hrec : ∀ n, FordAnalysis.g (n + 1) * ρ ^ (n + 1) =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), a (i + 1) * (FordAnalysis.g (n - i) * ρ ^ (n - i)) := by
    intro n
    rw [hgs n, Finset.sum_mul]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    have hi' := Finset.mem_range.mp hi
    have hp : ρ ^ (n + 1) = ρ ^ (i + 1) * ρ ^ (n - i) := by
      rw [← pow_add]; congr 1; omega
    rw [hp]
    simp only [ha_def]
    ring
  have hh : ∀ n, 1 ≤ n → FordAnalysis.g n * ρ ^ n ≤ 1 - ρ := by
    intro n
    induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | _ n ih =>
      intro hn
      obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, n = m + 1 := ⟨n - 1, by omega⟩
      rw [hrec m, Finset.sum_range_succ, Nat.sub_self, hg0, pow_zero, mul_one]
      have hbound : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, a (i + 1) * (FordAnalysis.g (m - i) * ρ ^ (m - i))) ≤
          ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, a (i + 1) * (1 - ρ) := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro i hi
        have hi' := Finset.mem_range.mp hi
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (ih (m - i) (by omega) (by omega)) (ha _)
      rw [← Finset.sum_mul] at hbound
      set S := ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, a (i + 1) with hS
      have hS1 : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), a i) = S := by
        rw [Finset.sum_range_succ', ha0, add_zero]
      have hT1 := hT (m + 1)
      rw [hS1] at hT1
      have hT2 := hT (m + 2)
      rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, hS1] at hT2
      have hr := hratio (m + 1)
      have hTS : T (m + 1) = 1 - S := by linarith
      rw [hTS] at hr
      nlinarith
  
  have hgS : ∀ n, FordAnalysis.gStar (n + 1) * ρ ^ (n + 1) ≤ 1 := by
    intro n
    cases n with
    | zero =>
      have hg1 : FordAnalysis.g 1 = FordAnalysis.coeff 1 := by
        rw [hgs 0]; simp [hg0]
      rw [hgSs 0, hg1, hg0]
      simp only [zero_add, pow_one]
      nlinarith
    | succ m =>
      rw [hgSs (m + 1)]
      have hA := hh (m + 2) (by omega)
      have hB := hh (m + 1) (by omega)
      have hcoef : 0 ≤ (1 - FordAnalysis.coeff 1) * ρ := mul_nonneg (by linarith) hρ0.le
      have hB' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hB hcoef
      have heq : (FordAnalysis.g (m + 1 + 1) + (1 - FordAnalysis.coeff 1) * FordAnalysis.g (m + 1)) *
          ρ ^ (m + 1 + 1) = FordAnalysis.g (m + 2) * ρ ^ (m + 2) +
            (1 - FordAnalysis.coeff 1) * ρ * (FordAnalysis.g (m + 1) * ρ ^ (m + 1)) := by
        ring
      rw [heq]
      have : 0 ≤ FordAnalysis.coeff 1 * ρ * (1 - ρ) :=
        mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hc1pos.le hρ0.le) (by linarith)
      nlinarith
  
  have ht0 : 0 < t := lt_of_lt_of_le (Real.exp_pos 1) ht
  set L := FordScale.coreDimension M t with hL
  set r : ℝ := (L : ℝ) / (t * ρ ^ L) with hr_def
  have htρ : 0 < t * ρ ^ L := mul_pos ht0 (pow_pos hρ0 L)
  have hr0 : 0 ≤ r := div_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg L) htρ.le
  
  have hstep : ∀ n, n < L → t ^ n * FordGeometry.modelVolume n ≤
      r * (t ^ (n + 1) * FordGeometry.modelVolume (n + 1)) := by
    intro n hn
    have hnL : n + 1 ≤ L := hn
    have hcoef : ((n : ℝ) + 1) * FordAnalysis.gStar (n + 1) ≤ (L : ℝ) / ρ ^ L := by
      rw [le_div_iff₀ (pow_pos hρ0 L)]
      have h1 : FordAnalysis.gStar (n + 1) * ρ ^ L ≤ FordAnalysis.gStar (n + 1) * ρ ^ (n + 1) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (pow_le_pow_of_le_one hρ0.le hρ1.le hnL) (hgSpos _).le
      have h2 := hgS n
      have h3 : ((n : ℝ) + 1) ≤ (L : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hnL
      have h4 : 0 ≤ FordAnalysis.gStar (n + 1) * ρ ^ L :=
        mul_nonneg (hgSpos _).le (pow_nonneg hρ0.le _)
      calc ((n : ℝ) + 1) * FordAnalysis.gStar (n + 1) * ρ ^ L
          = ((n : ℝ) + 1) * (FordAnalysis.gStar (n + 1) * ρ ^ L) := by ring
        _ ≤ ((n : ℝ) + 1) * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h1.trans h2) (by positivity)

      rw [hr_def, pow_succ]
      field_simp

    have hu1 : 1 ≤ Real.log t := by
      have := Real.log_le_log (Real.exp_pos 1) ht

    set u := Real.log t with hu
    have hu0 : 0 < u := by linarith
    have hlu0 : 0 ≤ Real.log u := Real.log_nonneg hu1
    have hlu1 : Real.log u ≤ u - 1 := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos hu0
    have hlogρ : Real.log ρ < 0 := Real.log_neg hρ0 hρ1
    have hlog34 : Real.log (3 / 4) < -1 / 4 := by
      rw [Real.log_lt_iff_lt_exp (by norm_num)]
      have := Real.add_one_lt_exp (x := (-1 / 4 : ℝ)) (by norm_num)
      linarith
    have hlρ : Real.log ρ < Real.log (3 / 4) := Real.log_lt_log hρ0 hρ34
    have hCdef : FordAnalysis.C = (2 * |Real.log ρ|)⁻¹ := rfl
    rw [abs_of_neg hlogρ] at hCdef
    have hapos : 0 < 2 * -Real.log ρ := by linarith
    have hCpos : 0 < FordAnalysis.C := by rw [hCdef]; exact inv_pos.mpr hapos
    have hCmul : FordAnalysis.C * (2 * -Real.log ρ) = 1 := by

      have : 0 ≤ u - Real.log u := by linarith
      positivity
    have hopt : ((FordScale.optimalDimension t : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ 2 * FordAnalysis.C * (u - Real.log u) := by
      unfold FordScale.optimalDimension
      exact Nat.floor_le harg

      have : ((L + M : ℕ) : ℝ) = ((FordScale.optimalDimension t : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
        rw [hadd]
      push_cast at this
      linarith
    have hmul : 2 * FordAnalysis.C * (u - Real.log u) * Real.log ρ ≤ ((L : ℝ) + M) * Real.log ρ :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonpos_right hLM hlogρ.le
    have hid : 2 * FordAnalysis.C * (u - Real.log u) * Real.log ρ = Real.log u - u := by
      have : 2 * FordAnalysis.C * Real.log ρ = -1 := by linarith
      calc 2 * FordAnalysis.C * (u - Real.log u) * Real.log ρ

        _ = Real.log u - u := by rw [this]; ring
    rw [hid] at hmul
    have hpow : ρ ^ (L + M) = Real.exp (((L : ℝ) + M) * Real.log ρ) := by
      rw [← Real.exp_log hρ0]
      rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul, Real.log_exp]
      push_cast
      ring_nf
    have hexp : u / t ≤ ρ ^ (L + M) := by
      rw [hpow]

            rw [Real.exp_sub, Real.exp_log hu0, hu, Real.exp_log ht0]

    have hu_le : u ≤ t * ρ ^ L * ρ ^ M := by
      rw [div_le_iff₀ ht0] at hexp
      rw [pow_add] at hexp
      linarith
    have hL4 : (L : ℝ) ≤ 4 * u := by
      have hM0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ M := Nat.cast_nonneg M
      nlinarith
    rw [hr_def, div_le_iff₀ htρ]
    have hρM : 0 ≤ ρ ^ M := pow_nonneg hρ0.le M
    nlinarith
  
  have hiter : ∀ (f : ℕ → ℝ) (q : ℝ), 0 ≤ q → ∀ N k : ℕ, k ≤ N →
      (∀ i, k ≤ i → i < N → f i ≤ q * f (i + 1)) → f k ≤ q ^ (N - k) * f N := by
    intro f q hq N
    induction N with
    | zero =>
      intro k hk _
      have : k = 0 := by omega
      subst this; simp
    | succ N ih =>
      intro k hk hs
      by_cases hkN : k ≤ N

        have h2 := hs N hkN (by omega)
        have h3 : q ^ (N - k) * f N ≤ q ^ (N - k) * (q * f (N + 1)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 (pow_nonneg hq _)
        have he : N + 1 - k = (N - k) + 1 := by omega
        rw [he, pow_succ]
        linarith [h1, h3, show q ^ (N - k) * (q * f (N + 1)) = q ^ (N - k) * q * f (N + 1) by ring]
      · have : k = N + 1 := by omega
        subst this; simp
  have hmain := hiter (fun i => t ^ i * FordGeometry.modelVolume i) r hr0 L K hK
    (fun i _ hi => hstep i hi)
  simp only at hmain
  refine hmain.trans ?_
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg ht0.le _) (hmVpos _).le)
  exact pow_le_pow_left₀ hr0 hrate _

(hPNT : Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => (Nat.primeCounting ⌊x⌋₊ : ℝ) / (x / Real.log x)) atTop (𝓝 1))
    (hMERT : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ, 2 ≤ x →
      |(∑ p ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊x⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, (1 : ℝ) / p) - Real.log (Real.log x)| ≤ C)
    (hEULER : Asymptotics.IsEquivalent atTop
      (fun x : ℝ => ∏ p ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊x⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, (1 - (1 : ℝ) / p))
      (fun x => Real.exp (-Real.eulerMascheroniConstant) / Real.log x))
    (hRHO : 0 < FordAnalysis.rho ∧ FordAnalysis.rho < 3 / 4 ∧ FordAnalysis.F FordAnalysis.rho = 1)
    (hSUFFIX : ∀ᶠ Z : ℝ in atTop,
      ∀ (M : ℕ) (A y : ℝ) (a : Fin (FordScale.coreDimension M (logLog y)))
        (F : Finset ℕ) (q : ℕ → Fin (FordScale.coreDimension M (logLog y) + 1) → ℕ),

        ∀ j : ℕ, ((FordLower.suffixesUpTo F q j Z).card : ℝ) ≤
          5 * (Z / (Real.log Z * (logLog Z) ^ 2)))
    (M : ℕ) : ∀ᶠ y : ℝ in atTop,
      ∀ (A : ℝ) (a : Fin (FordScale.coreDimension M (logLog y))) (F : Finset ℕ)
        (q : ℕ → Fin (FordScale.coreDimension M (logLog y) + 1) → ℕ),
        2 ≤ M → 4 ≤ A →
        (∀ n ∈ F, ∃ R : FordLower.PrimeProductRecord M A y a n, R.fullTuple = q n) →
        ((FordLower.prefixCollisionClass F q 0).card : ℝ) ≤ 5 * (y / (Real.log y * (logLog y) ^ 2))

      rw [div_le_div_iff₀ hpos1 (by norm_num)]; linarith

      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdiv hpos.le

      field_simp; ring
    rw [e] at key
    nlinarith
  have hc1 : FordAnalysis.coeff 1 ≤ 1 := by
    simp only [FordAnalysis.coeff, one_ne_zero, if_false, fordWeight]
    norm_num
    linarith

  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ : ∃ w : ℕ → ℝ, ∀ d, w d = if d ∣ s.prodPrimes then

          ∑ m ∈ s.prodPrimes.divisors,
            (if ((d * m : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ s.level ∧ m.Coprime d then h m else 0)
      else 0 := ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨hpos, hGpos, hw1, hsupp⟩ := selbergWeights_basic s h G w hh hG hw
  have hdiag := selbergWeights_diagonalisation s h G w hh hG hw
  have habs := selbergWeights_abs_le_one s h G w hh hG hw
  have H1 := lambdaSq_upperMoebius_bound s.toBoundingSieve w hw1
  have H2 := lambdaSq_errSum_le s w habs hsupp
  have H4 := lambdaSq_mainSum_eq_diag s.toBoundingSieve w (fun l => 1 / h l)

      rw [nu_inv_eq_sum_inv_selbergTerms s.toBoundingSieve e he]
      simp only [hh])

      if (l : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ s.level then s.nu l * ∏ p ∈ l.primeFactors, 1 / (1 - s.nu p) else 0) = G := by
    rw [hG]
    simp only [hh]

      1 / h l * (∑ d ∈ s.prodPrimes.divisors, if l ∣ d then s.nu d * w d else 0) ^ 2 =

        (BoundingSieve.squarefree_of_dvd_prodPrimes hl')
      exact_mod_cast this

            ring

    · simp
  have Hmain : BoundingSieve.mainSum (s := s.toBoundingSieve)
      (fun n => ∑ d1 ∈ n.divisors, ∑ d2 ∈ n.divisors,
        if n = Nat.lcm d1 d2 then w d1 * w d2 else 0) = G⁻¹ := by
    rw [H4, Finset.sum_congr rfl hterm, ← Finset.sum_mul, ← hG]

            if n = Nat.lcm d1 d2 then w d1 * w d2 else 0) := H1
    _ ≤ _ := by
      rw [Hmain, ← div_eq_mul_inv]
      linarith [H2]

subgoal_signatures.name: lambdaSq_upperMoebius_bound
subgoal_signatures.statement:

      s.totalMass * BoundingSieve.mainSum (s := s) (fun n => ∑ d1 ∈ n.divisors, ∑ d2 ∈ n.divisors,
          if n = Nat.lcm d1 d2 then w d1 * w d2 else 0) +
        BoundingSieve.errSum (s := s) (fun n => ∑ d1 ∈ n.divisors, ∑ d2 ∈ n.divisors,
          if n = Nat.lcm d1 d2 then w d1 * w d2 else 0)

subgoal_signatures.name: lambdaSq_errSum_le
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (s : SelbergSieve) (w : ℕ → ℝ), (∀ d, |w d| ≤ 1) →
    (∀ d : ℕ, ¬ (d : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ s.level → w d = 0) →
    BoundingSieve.errSum (s := s.toBoundingSieve) (fun n => ∑ d1 ∈ n.divisors, ∑ d2 ∈ n.divisors,
        if n = Nat.lcm d1 d2 then w d1 * w d2 else 0) ≤
      ∑ d ∈ s.prodPrimes.divisors,
        if (d : ℝ) ≤ s.level then
          (3 : ℝ) ^ ArithmeticFunction.cardDistinctFactors d *
            |BoundingSieve.rem (s := s.toBoundingSieve) d|
        else 0

subgoal_signatures.name: nu_inv_eq_sum_inv_selbergTerms
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (s : BoundingSieve) (e : ℕ), e ∣ s.prodPrimes →
    (s.nu e)⁻¹ = ∑ l ∈ s.prodPrimes.divisors,
      if l ∣ e then 1 / (s.nu l * ∏ p ∈ l.primeFactors, 1 / (1 - s.nu p)) else 0

subgoal_signatures.name: lambdaSq_mainSum_eq_diag
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (s : BoundingSieve) (w F : ℕ → ℝ),
    (∀ e, e ∣ s.prodPrimes → (s.nu e)⁻¹ = ∑ l ∈ s.prodPrimes.divisors, if l ∣ e then F l else 0) →
    BoundingSieve.mainSum (s := s) (fun n => ∑ d1 ∈ n.divisors, ∑ d2 ∈ n.divisors,
        if n = Nat.lcm d1 d2 then w d1 * w d2 else 0) =
      ∑ l ∈ s.prodPrimes.divisors,
        F l * (∑ d ∈ s.prodPrimes.divisors, if l ∣ d then s.nu d * w d else 0) ^ 2

subgoal_signatures.name: selbergWeights_diagonalisation
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (s : SelbergSieve) (h : ℕ → ℝ) (G : ℝ) (w : ℕ → ℝ),
    (∀ l, h l = s.nu l * ∏ p ∈ l.primeFactors, 1 / (1 - s.nu p)) →
    G = ∑ l ∈ s.prodPrimes.divisors, (if (l : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ s.level then h l else 0) →
    (∀ d, w d = if d ∣ s.prodPrimes then
        (s.nu d)⁻¹ * h d * (ArithmeticFunction.moebius d : ℝ) * G⁻¹ *
          ∑ m ∈ s.prodPrimes.divisors,
            (if ((d * m : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ s.level ∧ m.Coprime d then h m else 0)
      else 0) →
    ∀ l ∈ s.prodPrimes.divisors,
      (∑ d ∈ s.prodPrimes.divisors, if l ∣ d then s.nu d * w d else 0) =
        if (l : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ s.level then h l * (ArithmeticFunction.moebius l : ℝ) * G⁻¹ else 0

subgoal_signatures.name: selbergWeights_abs_le_one
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (s : SelbergSieve) (h : ℕ → ℝ) (G : ℝ) (w : ℕ → ℝ),
    (∀ l, h l = s.nu l * ∏ p ∈ l.primeFactors, 1 / (1 - s.nu p)) →
    G = ∑ l ∈ s.prodPrimes.divisors, (if (l : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ s.level then h l else 0) →
    (∀ d, w d = if d ∣ s.prodPrimes then
        (s.nu d)⁻¹ * h d * (ArithmeticFunction.moebius d : ℝ) * G⁻¹ *
          ∑ m ∈ s.prodPrimes.divisors,
            (if ((d * m : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ s.level ∧ m.Coprime d then h m else 0)
      else 0) →
    ∀ d, |w d| ≤ 1

subgoal_signatures.name: selbergWeights_basic
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (s : SelbergSieve) (h : ℕ → ℝ) (G : ℝ) (w : ℕ → ℝ),
    (∀ l, h l = s.nu l * ∏ p ∈ l.primeFactors, 1 / (1 - s.nu p)) →
    G = ∑ l ∈ s.prodPrimes.divisors, (if (l : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ s.level then h l else 0) →
    (∀ d, w d = if d ∣ s.prodPrimes then
        (s.nu d)⁻¹ * h d * (ArithmeticFunction.moebius d : ℝ) * G⁻¹ *
          ∑ m ∈ s.prodPrimes.divisors,
            (if ((d * m : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ s.level ∧ m.Coprime d then h m else 0)
      else 0) →
    (∀ l, l ∣ s.prodPrimes → 0 < h l) ∧ 0 < G ∧ w 1 = 1 ∧
      (∀ d : ℕ, ¬ (d : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ s.level → w d = 0)

      have hs' : ∀ p ∈ s, p.Prime := fun p hp => hs p (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hp)
      have ih' := ih hs'
      have hone := hstep s a hap.pos
      set A := (Finset.Icc 1 M).filter (fun k => ∀ q ∈ s, ¬ q ∣ k) with hA
      have hset : (Finset.Icc 1 M).filter (fun k => ∀ q ∈ insert a s, ¬ q ∣ k) =
          A.filter (fun k => ¬ a ∣ k) := by
        ext k
        simp only [hA, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.forall_mem_insert]
        tauto
      rw [hset, Finset.prod_insert ha]
      have hsplit := Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not A (fun k => a ∣ k) (fun k => (k : ℝ)⁻¹)
      have ha1 : (a : ℝ)⁻¹ ≤ 1 := inv_le_one_of_one_le₀ (by exact_mod_cast hap.one_lt.le)
      have hnn : 0 ≤ 1 - (a : ℝ)⁻¹ := by linarith
      have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ih' hnn
      rw [mul_assoc]
      nlinarith
  
  have hcop : (Finset.Icc 1 M).filter (fun k => k.Coprime b) =
      (Finset.Icc 1 M).filter (fun k => ∀ q ∈ b.primeFactors, ¬ q ∣ k) := by
    apply Finset.filter_congr
    intro k _
    constructor
    · intro h q hq hqk
      have hqb : q ∣ b := Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactors hq
      have h1 : q = 1 := Nat.eq_one_of_dvd_coprimes h hqk hqb
      exact (Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hq).one_lt.ne' h1
    · intro h
      apply Nat.coprime_of_dvd
      intro r hr hrk hrb
      exact h r (Nat.mem_primeFactors.mpr ⟨hr, hrb, hb.ne'⟩) hrk
  
  have htot : (b.totient : ℝ) / b = ∏ p ∈ b.primeFactors, (1 - (p : ℝ)⁻¹) := by
    have h := Nat.totient_eq_mul_prod_factors b
    have h2 : (b.totient : ℝ) = (b : ℝ) * ∏ p ∈ b.primeFactors, (1 - (p : ℝ)⁻¹) := by
      have := congrArg (fun x : ℚ => (x : ℝ)) h
      push_cast at this
      exact this
    have hb0 : (b : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    rw [h2, mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ hb0]
  rw [hcop, htot]
  exact hind _ (fun p hp => Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp)

informal_problem.statement:
∀ (b M : ℕ), 0 < b →
    (b.totient : ℝ) / b * (∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 M, (k : ℝ)⁻¹) ≤
      ∑ k ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 M).filter (fun k => k.Coprime b), (k : ℝ)⁻¹ →
    (b.totient : ℝ) / b * (∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 M, (k : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ 2 ≤

signature.name: twoForm_density_sum_lower_bound
signature.statement:
∀ (b M : ℕ), 0 < b →
    (b.totient : ℝ) / b * (∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 M, (k : ℝ)⁻¹) ≤
      ∑ k ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 M).filter (fun k => k.Coprime b), (k : ℝ)⁻¹ →
