proof.tactics:
by
  intro b M hb hcop
  
  have s1 : ∀ m : ℕ, 0 < m →
      ((m.divisors.filter (fun d => d.Coprime b)).card : ℝ) ≤
        ∏ p ∈ m.primeFactors, (if p ∣ b then 1 else 2 : ℝ) ^ m.factorization p := by
    intro m hm
    have hm0 : m ≠ 0 := hm.ne'
    let t : ℕ → Finset ℕ := fun p =>
      if p ∣ b then ({0} : Finset ℕ) else Finset.range (m.factorization p + 1)
    have hcard : (m.divisors.filter (fun d => d.Coprime b)).card ≤
        (m.primeFactors.pi t).card := by
      apply Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn
        (fun d => fun p (_ : p ∈ m.primeFactors) => d.factorization p)
      · intro d hd
        obtain ⟨hdm, hcopd⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp (Finset.mem_coe.mp hd)
        have hdvd := Nat.dvd_of_mem_divisors hdm
        have hd0 : d ≠ 0 := ne_zero_of_dvd_ne_zero hm0 hdvd
        rw [Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_pi]
        intro p hp
        have hpp := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp
        simp only [t]
        split_ifs with hpb
        · rw [Finset.mem_singleton]
          apply Nat.factorization_eq_zero_of_not_dvd
          intro hpd
          exact hpp.not_dvd_one (hcopd ▸ Nat.dvd_gcd hpd hpb)
        · rw [Finset.mem_range]
          have := (Nat.factorization_le_iff_dvd hd0 hm0).mpr hdvd p
          omega
      · intro d hd d' hd' heq
        have hd1 := Finset.mem_filter.mp (Finset.mem_coe.mp hd)
        have hd1' := Finset.mem_filter.mp (Finset.mem_coe.mp hd')
        have hdvd := Nat.dvd_of_mem_divisors hd1.1
        have hdvd' := Nat.dvd_of_mem_divisors hd1'.1
        have hd0 : d ≠ 0 := ne_zero_of_dvd_ne_zero hm0 hdvd
        have hd0' : d' ≠ 0 := ne_zero_of_dvd_ne_zero hm0 hdvd'
        apply Nat.eq_of_factorization_eq hd0 hd0'
        intro p
        by_cases hp : p ∈ m.primeFactors
        · exact congrFun (congrFun heq p) hp
        · have hmp : m.factorization p = 0 := by
            rwa [← Nat.support_factorization, Finsupp.mem_support_iff, not_not] at hp
          have h1 := (Nat.factorization_le_iff_dvd hd0 hm0).mpr hdvd p
          have h2 := (Nat.factorization_le_iff_dvd hd0' hm0).mpr hdvd' p
          omega
    rw [Finset.card_pi] at hcard
    calc ((m.divisors.filter (fun d => d.Coprime b)).card : ℝ)
        ≤ ((∏ p ∈ m.primeFactors, (t p).card : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hcard
      _ = ∏ p ∈ m.primeFactors, ((t p).card : ℝ) := by push_cast; rfl
      _ ≤ ∏ p ∈ m.primeFactors, (if p ∣ b then 1 else 2 : ℝ) ^ m.factorization p := by
        apply Finset.prod_le_prod
        · intro p _
          positivity
        · intro p _
          simp only [t]
          split_ifs with hpb
          · simp
          · rw [Finset.card_range]
            have h := Nat.succ_le_of_lt (Nat.lt_two_pow_self (n := m.factorization p))
            exact_mod_cast h
  
  have s2 : ∀ m : ℕ, 0 < m →
      ∏ p ∈ m.primeFactors, ((if p ∣ b then 1 else 2 : ℝ) / p) ^ m.factorization p =
        (∏ p ∈ m.primeFactors, (if p ∣ b then 1 else 2 : ℝ) ^ m.factorization p) / m := by
    intro m hm
    have hden : (∏ p ∈ m.primeFactors, (p : ℝ) ^ m.factorization p) = m := by
      have h := Nat.factorization_prod_pow_eq_self hm.ne'
      rw [Finsupp.prod, Nat.support_factorization] at h
      exact_mod_cast h
    simp_rw [div_pow]
    rw [Finset.prod_div_distrib, hden]
  
  let F := Finset.Icc 1 M
  let B := F.filter (fun n => n.Coprime b)
  let P := F ×ˢ B
  let Q : Finset (Σ _ : ℕ, ℕ) :=
    (Finset.Icc 1 (M ^ 2)).sigma (fun n => n.divisors.filter (fun d => d.Coprime b))
  let f : ℕ × ℕ → (Σ _ : ℕ, ℕ) := fun v => ⟨v.1 * v.2, v.2⟩
  have hP (v : ℕ × ℕ) (hv : v ∈ P) :
      0 < v.1 ∧ v.1 ≤ M ∧ 0 < v.2 ∧ v.2 ≤ M ∧ v.2.Coprime b := by
    obtain ⟨hv1, hvB⟩ := Finset.mem_product.mp hv
    obtain ⟨hv2, hc⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hvB
    exact ⟨(Finset.mem_Icc.mp hv1).1, (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hv1).2,
      (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hv2).1, (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hv2).2, hc⟩
  have hsub : P.image f ⊆ Q := by
    intro v hv
    obtain ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hv
    obtain ⟨hw1, hwN1, hw2, hwN2, hc⟩ := hP w hw
    apply Finset.mem_sigma.mpr
    refine ⟨Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨Nat.mul_pos hw1 hw2, ?_⟩,
      Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Nat.mem_divisors.mpr ⟨dvd_mul_left _ _, (Nat.mul_pos hw1 hw2).ne'⟩,
        hc⟩⟩
    simpa only [pow_two] using Nat.mul_le_mul hwN1 hwN2
  have hinj : Set.InjOn f (P : Set (ℕ × ℕ)) := by
    intro v hv w hw heq
    have hprod : v.1 * v.2 = w.1 * w.2 := congrArg Sigma.fst heq
    have hsecond : v.2 = w.2 := congrArg (fun x : Σ _ : ℕ, ℕ => x.2) heq
    have hfirst : v.1 = w.1 := by
      rw [hsecond] at hprod
      exact Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_right (hP w hw).2.2.1 hprod
    exact Prod.ext hfirst hsecond
  have hmass : (∑ n ∈ F, (n : ℝ)⁻¹) * (∑ n ∈ B, (n : ℝ)⁻¹) ≤
      ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (M ^ 2),
        ∏ p ∈ m.primeFactors, ((if p ∣ b then 1 else 2 : ℝ) / p) ^ m.factorization p := by
    calc
      _ = ∑ v ∈ P, ((v.1 * v.2 : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
        rw [Finset.sum_mul_sum]
        symm
        calc
          _ = ∑ n ∈ F, ∑ m ∈ B, ((n * m : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹ :=
            Finset.sum_product F B (fun v : ℕ × ℕ => ((v.1 * v.2 : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹)
          _ = _ := by simp only [Nat.cast_mul, mul_inv_rev, mul_comm]
      _ = ∑ v ∈ P.image f, (v.1 : ℝ)⁻¹ :=
        (Finset.sum_image (f := fun v : Σ _ : ℕ, ℕ => (v.1 : ℝ)⁻¹) hinj).symm
      _ ≤ ∑ v ∈ Q, (v.1 : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hsub
        intro v _ _
        positivity
      _ = ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (M ^ 2),
          ((n.divisors.filter (fun d => d.Coprime b)).card : ℝ) / n := by
        calc
          _ = ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (M ^ 2), ∑ d ∈ n.divisors.filter (fun d => d.Coprime b),
              (n : ℝ)⁻¹ := Finset.sum_sigma _ _ (fun v : Σ _ : ℕ, ℕ => (v.1 : ℝ)⁻¹)
          _ = _ := by simp only [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, div_eq_mul_inv]
      _ ≤ _ := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro n hn
        have hn0 : 0 < n := (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hn).1
        rw [s2 n hn0]
        exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (s1 n hn0) (Nat.cast_nonneg n)
  have hHN : 0 ≤ ∑ n ∈ F, (n : ℝ)⁻¹ := Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => by positivity
  have hcop' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcop hHN
  have hstart : (b.totient : ℝ) / b * (∑ n ∈ F, (n : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ 2 ≤
      (∑ n ∈ F, (n : ℝ)⁻¹) * (∑ n ∈ B, (n : ℝ)⁻¹) := by
    calc
      _ = (∑ n ∈ F, (n : ℝ)⁻¹) * ((b.totient : ℝ) / b * (∑ n ∈ F, (n : ℝ)⁻¹)) := by ring
      _ ≤ _ := hcop'
  exact hstart.trans hmass

informal_problem.statement:
∀ (P k : ℕ) (x : ℝ), 1 ≤ x → Squarefree P →
    (∑ d ∈ P.divisors, if (d : ℝ) ≤ x then (k : ℝ) ^ ArithmeticFunction.cardDistinctFactors d else 0) ≤
      x * (1 + Real.log x) ^ k

signature.name: sum_pow_omega_divisors_le
signature.statement:
∀ (P k : ℕ) (x : ℝ), 1 ≤ x → Squarefree P →
    (∑ d ∈ P.divisors, if (d : ℝ) ≤ x then (k : ℝ) ^ ArithmeticFunction.cardDistinctFactors d else 0) ≤
      x * (1 + Real.log x) ^ k

proof.tactics:
by
  intro P k x hx hP
  have hx_pos : 0 < x := by linarith
  
  have hH : (∑ d ∈ P.divisors, if (d : ℝ) ≤ x then (d : ℝ)⁻¹ else 0) ≤ 1 + Real.log x := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_filter]
    have hn1 : 1 ≤ ⌊x⌋₊ := (Nat.one_le_floor_iff _).mpr hx
    calc (∑ d ∈ P.divisors.filter (fun d : ℕ => (d : ℝ) ≤ x), (d : ℝ)⁻¹)
        ≤ ∑ d ∈ Finset.Icc 1 ⌊x⌋₊, (d : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
          apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg
          · intro d hd
            rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hd
            rw [Finset.mem_Icc]
            exact ⟨Nat.pos_of_mem_divisors hd.1, (Nat.le_floor_iff hx_pos.le).mpr hd.2⟩
          · intro i _ _; positivity
      _ = ((harmonic ⌊x⌋₊ : ℚ) : ℝ) := by
          rw [harmonic_eq_sum_Icc]; push_cast; rfl
      _ ≤ 1 + Real.log (⌊x⌋₊ : ℝ) := harmonic_le_one_add_log _
      _ ≤ 1 + Real.log x := by
          linarith [Real.log_le_log (Nat.cast_pos.mpr hn1) (Nat.floor_le hx_pos.le)]
  have hH0 : 0 ≤ (∑ d ∈ P.divisors, if (d : ℝ) ≤ x then (d : ℝ)⁻¹ else 0) := by
    apply Finset.sum_nonneg
    intro d _
    split_ifs
    · positivity
    · exact le_refl 0
  
  have hT : (∑ d ∈ P.divisors, if (d : ℝ) ≤ x then
      (k : ℝ) ^ ArithmeticFunction.cardDistinctFactors d / (d : ℝ) else 0) ≤
      (∑ d ∈ P.divisors, if (d : ℝ) ≤ x then (d : ℝ)⁻¹ else 0) ^ k := by
    calc
      _ = ∑ d ∈ P.divisors,
            ∑ a ∈ Fintype.piFinset fun _i : Fin k => P.divisors,
              if ∏ idx, a idx = d ∧ d ∣ P then if (d : ℝ) ≤ x then (d : ℝ)⁻¹ else 0 else 0 := ?_
      _ = ∑ a ∈ Fintype.piFinset fun _i : Fin k => P.divisors,
            if ∏ idx, a idx ∣ P then
              if ((∏ idx, a idx : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ x then ∏ idx, (a idx : ℝ)⁻¹ else 0 else 0 := ?_
      _ ≤ ∑ a ∈ Fintype.piFinset fun _i : Fin k => P.divisors,
            if ((∏ idx, a idx : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ x then ∏ idx, (a idx : ℝ)⁻¹ else 0 := ?_
      _ ≤ ∑ a ∈ Fintype.piFinset fun _i : Fin k => P.divisors,
            ∏ idx, if ((a idx : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ x then (a idx : ℝ)⁻¹ else 0 := ?_
      _ = ∏ _i : Fin k, ∑ d ∈ P.divisors, if (d : ℝ) ≤ x then (d : ℝ)⁻¹ else 0 := by
          rw [Finset.prod_univ_sum]
      _ = (∑ d ∈ P.divisors, if (d : ℝ) ≤ x then (d : ℝ)⁻¹ else 0) ^ k := by
          rw [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_fin]
    · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro d hd
      rw [Nat.mem_divisors] at hd
      simp_rw [ite_and]
      rw [← Finset.sum_filter, Finset.sum_const,
        ← Nat.finMulAntidiag_eq_piFinset_divisors_filter hd.1 hd.2,
        Nat.card_finMulAntidiag_of_squarefree (hP.squarefree_of_dvd hd.1), if_pos hd.1]
      simp only [div_eq_mul_inv, nsmul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_pow, mul_ite, mul_zero]
    · rw [Finset.sum_comm]; apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro a _
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (∏ idx, a idx)]
      · apply if_ctx_congr _ _ (fun _ => rfl)
        · rw [Iff.comm, iff_and_self]; exact fun _ => rfl
        · intro; rw [Nat.cast_prod, ← Finset.prod_inv_distrib]
      · exact fun d _ hd_ne ↦ if_neg fun h => hd_ne.symm h.1
      · exact fun h ↦ if_neg fun h' => h (Nat.mem_divisors.mpr ⟨h'.2, hP.ne_zero⟩)
    · apply Finset.sum_le_sum; intro a _
      by_cases h : (∏ idx, a idx ∣ P)
      · rw [if_pos h]
      rw [if_neg h]
      split_ifs with h'
      · apply Finset.prod_nonneg; intro idx _; positivity
      · exact le_refl 0
    · apply Finset.sum_le_sum; intro a ha
      split_ifs with h
      · apply le_of_eq
        apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
        intro idx hi
        rw [if_pos]
        apply le_trans _ h
        norm_cast
        rw [← Finset.prod_erase_mul (a := idx) (h := hi)]
        apply Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left
        rw [Fintype.mem_piFinset] at ha
        apply Finset.prod_pos; intro j _; exact Nat.pos_of_mem_divisors (ha j)
      · apply Finset.prod_nonneg; intro j _
        split_ifs
        · positivity
        · exact le_refl 0
  
  calc (∑ d ∈ P.divisors, if (d : ℝ) ≤ x then (k : ℝ) ^ ArithmeticFunction.cardDistinctFactors d else 0)
      ≤ ∑ d ∈ P.divisors, x * (if (d : ℝ) ≤ x then
          (k : ℝ) ^ ArithmeticFunction.cardDistinctFactors d / (d : ℝ) else 0) := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro d hd
        have hd0 : (0 : ℝ) < d := Nat.cast_pos.mpr (Nat.pos_of_mem_divisors hd)
        split_ifs with h
        · have hk0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℝ) ^ ArithmeticFunction.cardDistinctFactors d := by positivity
          rw [mul_div_assoc']
          rw [le_div_iff₀ hd0]
          rw [mul_comm]
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h hk0
        · simp
    _ = x * ∑ d ∈ P.divisors, (if (d : ℝ) ≤ x then
          (k : ℝ) ^ ArithmeticFunction.cardDistinctFactors d / (d : ℝ) else 0) := by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    _ ≤ x * (∑ d ∈ P.divisors, if (d : ℝ) ≤ x then (d : ℝ)⁻¹ else 0) ^ k :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hT hx_pos.le
    _ ≤ x * (1 + Real.log x) ^ k :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (pow_le_pow_left₀ hH0 hH k) hx_pos.le

signature.name: twoForm_count_error
signature.statement:
∀ (b N d : ℕ), Squarefree d →
    |(((Finset.range N).filter (fun n => d ∣ n * (b * n + 1))).card : ℝ) -
        (∏ p ∈ d.primeFactors, (if p ∣ b then 1 else 2 : ℝ) / p) * N| ≤

proof.tactics:
by
  intro b N d hd
  have hd0 : 0 < d := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hd.ne_zero
  
  have hdiv : ∀ (k x : ℕ), k ∣ x * (b * x + 1) ↔
      (x : ZMod k) * ((b : ZMod k) * (x : ZMod k) + 1) = 0 := by
    intro k x
    rw [← ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff]
    simp only [Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
  
  have hzmod : ∀ (k : ℕ) [NeZero k],
      ((Finset.range k).filter (fun x => k ∣ x * (b * x + 1))).card =
        ((Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod k)).filter
          (fun t => t * ((b : ZMod k) * t + 1) = 0)).card := by
    intro k _
    have heq : ((Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod k)).filter
        (fun t => t * ((b : ZMod k) * t + 1) = 0)).image ZMod.val =
        (Finset.range k).filter (fun x => k ∣ x * (b * x + 1)) := by
      ext n
      constructor
      · intro hn
        obtain ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hn
        apply Finset.mem_filter.mpr
        refine ⟨Finset.mem_range.mpr (ZMod.val_lt t), ?_⟩
        apply (hdiv k t.val).mpr
        simpa only [ZMod.natCast_zmod_val] using (Finset.mem_filter.mp ht).2
      · intro hn
        obtain ⟨hnlt, hn⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hn
        refine Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨(n : ZMod k), ?_, ?_⟩
        · exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, (hdiv k n).mp hn⟩
        · exact ZMod.val_natCast_of_lt (Finset.mem_range.mp hnlt)
    rw [← heq, Finset.card_image_of_injective _ (ZMod.val_injective k)]
  
  have hprime : ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime →
      ((Finset.range p).filter (fun x => p ∣ x * (b * x + 1))).card =
        if p ∣ b then 1 else 2 := by
    intro p hp
    haveI : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
    rw [hzmod p]
    by_cases hpb : p ∣ b
    · have hb : (b : ZMod p) = 0 := (ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff b p).mpr hpb
      have hset : (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod p)).filter
          (fun t => t * ((b : ZMod p) * t + 1) = 0) = {0} := by
        ext t
        simp [hb]
      rw [hset, Finset.card_singleton, if_pos hpb]
    · have hb : (b : ZMod p) ≠ 0 := fun h => hpb ((ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff b p).mp h)
      have hset : (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod p)).filter
          (fun t => t * ((b : ZMod p) * t + 1) = 0) = {0, -(b : ZMod p)⁻¹} := by
        ext t
        simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_insert,
          Finset.mem_singleton, mul_eq_zero]
        apply or_congr_right
        constructor
        · intro h
          apply mul_left_cancel₀ hb
          calc (b : ZMod p) * t = -1 := eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left h
            _ = (b : ZMod p) * -(b : ZMod p)⁻¹ := by simp [hb]
        · rintro rfl
          simp [hb]
      have hneq : (0 : ZMod p) ≠ -(b : ZMod p)⁻¹ :=
        fun h => inv_ne_zero hb (neg_eq_zero.mp h.symm)
      rw [hset, Finset.card_pair hneq, if_neg hpb]
  
  have hcardk : ∀ (k : ℕ) [NeZero k],
      Nat.card {t : ZMod k // t * ((b : ZMod k) * t + 1) = 0} =
        ((Finset.range k).filter (fun x => k ∣ x * (b * x + 1))).card := by
    intro k _
    rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_subtype, hzmod]
  have hmul : ∀ m n : ℕ, 0 < m → 0 < n → m.Coprime n →
      ((Finset.range (m * n)).filter (fun x => m * n ∣ x * (b * x + 1))).card =
        ((Finset.range m).filter (fun x => m ∣ x * (b * x + 1))).card *
          ((Finset.range n).filter (fun x => n ∣ x * (b * x + 1))).card := by
    intro m n hm hn hcop
    haveI : NeZero m := ⟨hm.ne'⟩
    haveI : NeZero n := ⟨hn.ne'⟩
    haveI : NeZero (m * n) := ⟨(Nat.mul_pos hm hn).ne'⟩
    let e := ZMod.chineseRemainder hcop
    have hmap : ∀ t : ZMod (m * n), t * ((b : ZMod (m * n)) * t + 1) = 0 ↔
        (e t).1 * ((b : ZMod m) * (e t).1 + 1) = 0 ∧
        (e t).2 * ((b : ZMod n) * (e t).2 + 1) = 0 := by
      intro t
      constructor
      · intro ht
        have h := congrArg e ht
        simp only [map_mul, map_add, map_natCast, map_one, map_zero] at h
        exact ⟨congrArg (fun x : ZMod m × ZMod n => x.1) h,
          congrArg (fun x : ZMod m × ZMod n => x.2) h⟩
      · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
        apply e.injective
        simp only [map_mul, map_add, map_natCast, map_one, map_zero]
        exact Prod.ext h1 h2
    let E : {t : ZMod (m * n) // t * ((b : ZMod (m * n)) * t + 1) = 0} ≃
        {t : ZMod m // t * ((b : ZMod m) * t + 1) = 0} ×
        {t : ZMod n // t * ((b : ZMod n) * t + 1) = 0} :=
      (e.toEquiv.subtypeEquiv hmap).trans
        (Equiv.subtypeProdEquivProd (p := fun t : ZMod m => t * ((b : ZMod m) * t + 1) = 0)
          (q := fun t : ZMod n => t * ((b : ZMod n) * t + 1) = 0))
    rw [← hcardk (m * n), ← hcardk m, ← hcardk n, ← Nat.card_prod]
    exact Nat.card_congr E
  
  let ρ : ArithmeticFunction ℕ :=
    ⟨fun k => ((Finset.range k).filter (fun x => k ∣ x * (b * x + 1))).card, by simp⟩
  have hρ : ∀ k, ρ k = ((Finset.range k).filter (fun x => k ∣ x * (b * x + 1))).card :=
    fun k => rfl
  have hρmult : ρ.IsMultiplicative := by
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hρ]
      simp
    · intro m n hcop
      rw [hρ, hρ, hρ]
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos m with rfl | hm
      · simp
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with rfl | hn
      · simp
      exact hmul m n hm hn hcop
  have hρd : ((Finset.range d).filter (fun x => d ∣ x * (b * x + 1))).card =
      ∏ p ∈ d.primeFactors, (if p ∣ b then 1 else 2 : ℕ) := by
    rw [← hρ d, ← hρmult.prod_primeFactors hd]
    exact Finset.prod_congr rfl (fun p hp => hprime p (Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp))
  have hdc : (d : ℝ) = ∏ p ∈ d.primeFactors, (p : ℝ) := by
    rw [← Nat.cast_prod, Nat.prod_primeFactors_of_squarefree hd]
  have hcoef : (((Finset.range d).filter (fun x => d ∣ x * (b * x + 1))).card : ℝ) / d =
      ∏ p ∈ d.primeFactors, (if p ∣ b then 1 else 2 : ℝ) / p := by
    rw [Finset.prod_div_distrib, hρd, hdc]
    push_cast
    rfl
  have hle : (((Finset.range d).filter (fun x => d ∣ x * (b * x + 1))).card : ℝ) ≤
      (2 : ℝ) ^ ArithmeticFunction.cardDistinctFactors d := by
    have h1 : ((Finset.range d).filter (fun x => d ∣ x * (b * x + 1))).card ≤
        2 ^ ArithmeticFunction.cardDistinctFactors d := by
      rw [hρd]
      have hcard : d.primeFactors.card = ArithmeticFunction.cardDistinctFactors d := by
        rw [ArithmeticFunction.cardDistinctFactors_apply, ← Nat.toFinset_factors,
          List.card_toFinset]
      rw [← hcard]
      apply Finset.prod_le_pow_card
      intro p _
      split_ifs <;> omega
    exact_mod_cast h1
  
  have hcount_err : ∀ (P : ℕ → Prop) [DecidablePred P], Function.Periodic P d → ∀ M : ℕ,
      |(Nat.count P M : ℝ) - (Nat.count P d : ℝ) / d * M| ≤ Nat.count P d := by
    intro P _ hP M
    have hmulc : ∀ k : ℕ, Nat.count P (k * d) = k * Nat.count P d := by
      intro k
      induction k with
      | zero => simp
      | succ k ih =>
        have hshift : (fun n => P (n + k * d)) = P := funext (hP.nat_mul k)
        simp only [Nat.succ_mul, Nat.add_comm (k * d) d, Nat.count_add', hshift, ih]
        omega
    have hdm : Nat.count P M = (M / d) * Nat.count P d + Nat.count P (M % d) := by
      have hshift : (fun n => P (n + (M / d) * d)) = P := funext (hP.nat_mul (M / d))
      calc
        _ = Nat.count P (M % d + (M / d) * d) := by rw [Nat.mod_add_div']
        _ = _ := by simp only [Nat.count_add', hshift, hmulc]; omega
    have hdR : (0 : ℝ) < d := by exact_mod_cast hd0
    have hrem : (M % d : ℕ) ≤ d := (Nat.mod_lt M hd0).le
    have hremR : ((M % d : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ d := by exact_mod_cast hrem
    have hcount : (Nat.count P (M % d) : ℝ) ≤ Nat.count P d := by
      exact_mod_cast Nat.count_monotone P hrem
    have hterm : 0 ≤ (Nat.count P d : ℝ) / d * (M % d : ℕ) := by positivity
    have htermle : (Nat.count P d : ℝ) / d * (M % d : ℕ) ≤ Nat.count P d := by
      calc
        _ ≤ (Nat.count P d : ℝ) / d * d :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hremR (by positivity)
        _ = _ := div_mul_cancel₀ _ hdR.ne'
    have hN : (M : ℝ) = (M / d : ℕ) * (d : ℝ) + (M % d : ℕ) := by
      exact_mod_cast (by simpa only [Nat.mul_comm] using (Nat.div_add_mod M d).symm)
    have hdec : (Nat.count P M : ℝ) =
        (M / d : ℕ) * (Nat.count P d : ℝ) + (Nat.count P (M % d) : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast hdm
    have heq : (Nat.count P M : ℝ) - (Nat.count P d : ℝ) / d * M =
        (Nat.count P (M % d) : ℝ) - (Nat.count P d : ℝ) / d * (M % d : ℕ) := by
      rw [hdec, hN]
      field_simp
      ring
    rw [heq, abs_le]
    constructor <;> linarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (Nat.count P (M % d)) (α := ℝ)]
  have hper : Function.Periodic (fun n => d ∣ n * (b * n + 1)) d := by
    intro n
    apply propext
    show d ∣ (n + d) * (b * (n + d) + 1) ↔ d ∣ n * (b * n + 1)
    have h : (n + d) * (b * (n + d) + 1) = d * (2 * b * n + b * d + 1) + n * (b * n + 1) := by
      ring
    rw [h]
    exact Nat.dvd_add_right (dvd_mul_right d _)
  have herr := hcount_err (fun n => d ∣ n * (b * n + 1)) hper N
  simp only [Nat.count_eq_card_filter_range] at herr
  rw [hcoef] at herr
  exact herr.trans hle

informal_problem.statement:
(∀ s : SelbergSieve,
      BoundingSieve.siftedSum (s := s.toBoundingSieve) ≤
        s.totalMass / (∑ l ∈ s.prodPrimes.divisors,
            if (l : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ s.level then s.nu l * ∏ p ∈ l.primeFactors, 1 / (1 - s.nu p) else 0) +
          ∑ d ∈ s.prodPrimes.divisors,
            if (d : ℝ) ≤ s.level then
              (3 : ℝ) ^ ArithmeticFunction.cardDistinctFactors d *
                |BoundingSieve.rem (s := s.toBoundingSieve) d|
            else 0) →
    (∀ (g : ℕ → ℝ) (P : ℕ) (y : ℝ), 1 ≤ y → Squarefree P →
      (∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → (p : ℝ) ≤ y → p ∣ P) →
      (∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → 0 ≤ g p ∧ g p < 1) →
      (∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 ⌊Real.sqrt y⌋₊, ∏ p ∈ m.primeFactors, g p ^ m.factorization p) ≤
        ∑ l ∈ P.divisors, if (l : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ y then ∏ p ∈ l.primeFactors, g p / (1 - g p) else 0) →
    (∀ (b M : ℕ), 0 < b →
      (b.totient : ℝ) / b * (∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 M, (k : ℝ)⁻¹) ≤
        ∑ k ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 M).filter (fun k => k.Coprime b), (k : ℝ)⁻¹) →
    (∀ (b M : ℕ), 0 < b →
      (b.totient : ℝ) / b * (∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 M, (k : ℝ)⁻¹) ≤
        ∑ k ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 M).filter (fun k => k.Coprime b), (k : ℝ)⁻¹ →
      (b.totient : ℝ) / b * (∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 M, (k : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ 2 ≤
        ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (M ^ 2),
          ∏ p ∈ m.primeFactors, ((if p ∣ b then 1 else 2 : ℝ) / p) ^ m.factorization p) →
    (∀ (P k : ℕ) (x : ℝ), 1 ≤ x → Squarefree P →
      (∑ d ∈ P.divisors, if (d : ℝ) ≤ x then (k : ℝ) ^ ArithmeticFunction.cardDistinctFactors d else 0) ≤
        x * (1 + Real.log x) ^ k) →
    (∀ (b N d : ℕ), Squarefree d →
      |(((Finset.range N).filter (fun n => d ∣ n * (b * n + 1))).card : ℝ) -
          (∏ p ∈ d.primeFactors, (if p ∣ b then 1 else 2 : ℝ) / p) * N| ≤
        (2 : ℝ) ^ ArithmeticFunction.cardDistinctFactors d) →
    ∀ (b N : ℕ) (L : ℝ), 0 < b → 2 ∣ b → 1 < L →
      (((Finset.range N).filter (fun n => ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → (p : ℝ) ≤ L → ¬ p ∣ n * (b * n + 1))).card : ℝ) ≤
        16 * ((b : ℝ) / b.totient) * N / Real.log L ^ 2 + L * (1 + Real.log L) ^ 6

proof.tactics:
by
  intro hS hL1 hcop hL2 hE hR b N L hb hbe hL
  have hL0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ L := by linarith
  have hL1' : (1 : ℝ) ≤ L := hL.le
  
  have hprim_dvd : ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → (p ∣ primorial ⌊L⌋₊ ↔ (p : ℝ) ≤ L) := by
    intro p hp
    rw [← Nat.le_floor_iff hL0]
    unfold primorial
    constructor
    · intro h
      obtain ⟨q, hq, hpq⟩ := (Prime.dvd_finset_prod_iff hp.prime _).mp h
      rw [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range] at hq
      have := (Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq hp hq.2).mp hpq
      omega
    · intro h
      exact Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem _
        (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega), hp⟩)
  have hsqprod : ∀ T : Finset ℕ, (∀ q ∈ T, q.Prime) → Squarefree (∏ q ∈ T, q) := by
    intro T
    refine Finset.induction_on T ?_ ?_
    · intro _
      simp
    · intro a T ha ih hT
      rw [Finset.prod_insert ha, Nat.squarefree_mul_iff]
      have haP : a.Prime := hT a (Finset.mem_insert_self a T)
      refine ⟨?_, haP.prime.squarefree, ih (fun q hq => hT q (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hq))⟩
      apply Nat.Coprime.prod_right
      intro q hq
      have hqP : q.Prime := hT q (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hq)
      exact (Nat.coprime_primes haP hqP).mpr (fun h => ha (h ▸ hq))
  have hPsq : Squarefree (primorial ⌊L⌋₊) := by
    unfold primorial
    exact hsqprod _ (fun q hq => (Finset.mem_filter.mp hq).2)
  have hPy : ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → (p : ℝ) ≤ L → p ∣ primorial ⌊L⌋₊ :=
    fun p hp hpL => (hprim_dvd p hp).mpr hpL
  
  set g : ℕ → ℝ := fun p => (if p ∣ b then 1 else 2 : ℝ) / p with hg_def
  have hgp : ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → 0 < g p ∧ g p < 1 := by
    intro p hp
    have hp2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ p := by exact_mod_cast hp.two_le
    simp only [hg_def]
    by_cases hpb : p ∣ b
    · rw [if_pos hpb]
      refine ⟨by positivity, ?_⟩
      rw [div_lt_one (by linarith)]
      linarith
    · rw [if_neg hpb]
      have hp3 : 3 ≤ p := by
        have h2 := hp.two_le
        rcases Nat.lt_or_ge p 3 with h | h
        · have : p = 2 := by omega
          exact absurd (this ▸ hbe) hpb
        · exact h
      have hp3' : (3 : ℝ) ≤ p := by exact_mod_cast hp3
      refine ⟨by positivity, ?_⟩
      rw [div_lt_one (by linarith)]
      linarith
  have hnup : ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → ArithmeticFunction.prodPrimeFactors g p = g p := by
    intro p hp
    rw [ArithmeticFunction.prodPrimeFactors_apply hp.ne_zero, hp.primeFactors,
      Finset.prod_singleton]
  
  obtain ⟨s, hsupp, hprod, hw, htot, hnu, hlev⟩ : ∃ s : SelbergSieve,
      s.support = (Finset.range N).image (fun n => n * (b * n + 1)) ∧
      s.prodPrimes = primorial ⌊L⌋₊ ∧ s.weights = (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) ∧
      s.totalMass = (N : ℝ) ∧ s.nu = ArithmeticFunction.prodPrimeFactors g ∧ s.level = L :=
    ⟨{ support := (Finset.range N).image (fun n => n * (b * n + 1))
       prodPrimes := primorial ⌊L⌋₊
       prodPrimes_squarefree := hPsq
       weights := fun _ => 1
       weights_nonneg := fun _ => zero_le_one
       totalMass := N
       nu := ArithmeticFunction.prodPrimeFactors g
       nu_mult := ArithmeticFunction.IsMultiplicative.prodPrimeFactors g
       nu_pos_of_prime := fun p hp _ => by rw [hnup p hp]; exact (hgp p hp).1
       nu_lt_one_of_prime := fun p hp _ => by rw [hnup p hp]; exact (hgp p hp).2
       level := L
       one_le_level := hL1' }, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
  have hinj : Set.InjOn (fun n : ℕ => n * (b * n + 1)) ↑(Finset.range N) := by
    have hmono : StrictMono (fun n : ℕ => n * (b * n + 1)) := by
      intro m n hmn
      show m * (b * m + 1) < n * (b * n + 1)
      calc
        _ < n * (b * m + 1) := Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hmn (by omega)
        _ ≤ _ := Nat.mul_le_mul_left n (Nat.add_le_add_right (Nat.mul_le_mul_left b hmn.le) 1)
    exact fun x _ y _ h => hmono.injective h
  
  have hsift : BoundingSieve.siftedSum (s := s.toBoundingSieve) =
      (((Finset.range N).filter
        (fun n => ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → (p : ℝ) ≤ L → ¬ p ∣ n * (b * n + 1))).card : ℝ) := by
    rw [BoundingSieve.siftedSum, hsupp, hprod, hw, Finset.sum_image hinj, Finset.sum_boole]
    congr 2
    apply Finset.filter_congr
    intro n _
    constructor
    · intro h p hp hpL hpm
      have := Nat.Coprime.coprime_dvd_left ((hprim_dvd p hp).mpr hpL) h
      exact (Nat.Prime.coprime_iff_not_dvd hp).mp this hpm
    · intro h
      apply Nat.coprime_of_dvd
      intro k hk hkP hkm
      exact h k hk ((hprim_dvd k hk).mp hkP) hkm
  
  have hrem : ∀ d ∈ (primorial ⌊L⌋₊).divisors,
      |BoundingSieve.rem (s := s.toBoundingSieve) d| ≤
        (2 : ℝ) ^ ArithmeticFunction.cardDistinctFactors d := by
    intro d hd
    have hdP : d ∣ primorial ⌊L⌋₊ := Nat.dvd_of_mem_divisors hd
    have hdsq : Squarefree d := Squarefree.squarefree_of_dvd hdP hPsq
    have hmult : BoundingSieve.multSum (s := s.toBoundingSieve) d =
        (((Finset.range N).filter (fun n => d ∣ n * (b * n + 1))).card : ℝ) := by
      rw [BoundingSieve.multSum, hsupp, hw, Finset.sum_image hinj, Finset.sum_boole]
    rw [BoundingSieve.rem, hmult, hnu, htot,
      ArithmeticFunction.prodPrimeFactors_apply hdsq.ne_zero]
    exact hR b N d hdsq
  
  have hGeq : (∑ l ∈ (primorial ⌊L⌋₊).divisors,
      if (l : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ L then ArithmeticFunction.prodPrimeFactors g l *
        ∏ p ∈ l.primeFactors, 1 / (1 - ArithmeticFunction.prodPrimeFactors g p) else 0) =
      ∑ l ∈ (primorial ⌊L⌋₊).divisors,
        if (l : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ L then ∏ p ∈ l.primeFactors, g p / (1 - g p) else 0 := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro l hl
    have hl0 : l ≠ 0 := Nat.ne_of_gt (Nat.pos_of_mem_divisors hl)
    split_ifs
    · rw [ArithmeticFunction.prodPrimeFactors_apply hl0, ← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
      apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
      intro p hp
      rw [hnup p (Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp), mul_one_div]
    · rfl
  
  set M := ⌊Real.sqrt (Real.sqrt L)⌋₊ with hM
  have hMK : M ^ 2 ≤ ⌊Real.sqrt L⌋₊ := by
    apply Nat.le_floor
    push_cast
    have hfloor : (M : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt (Real.sqrt L) := Nat.floor_le (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
    have hsq : Real.sqrt (Real.sqrt L) ^ 2 = Real.sqrt L := Real.sq_sqrt (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
    nlinarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) M]
  have hlogH : Real.log L / 4 ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 M, (k : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
    have h := log_le_harmonic_floor (Real.sqrt (Real.sqrt L)) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
    rw [Real.log_sqrt (Real.sqrt_nonneg _), Real.log_sqrt hL0, harmonic_eq_sum_Icc] at h
    push_cast at h
    rw [← hM] at h
    linarith
  have hT0 : ∀ m : ℕ, 0 ≤ ∏ p ∈ m.primeFactors, g p ^ m.factorization p := by
    intro m
    apply Finset.prod_nonneg
    intro p hp
    exact pow_nonneg (hgp p (Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp)).1.le _

        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro k _
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro d _
        split_ifs <;> ring
    _ = ∑ k ∈ s.prodPrimes.divisors,

        rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq, if_pos hl]
    _ = _ := by
        rw [hg l]
        split_ifs <;> ring

    have hHsum := hHm.prodPrimeFactors_one_add_of_squarefree hsqf
    have hLHS : ∑ e ∈ d.divisors, h e = ∏ p ∈ d.primeFactors, (1 / (1 - s.nu p)) := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun e _ => hHh e), ← hHsum]
      apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
      intro p hp
      have hpp := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp
      have hpP : p ∣ s.prodPrimes := (Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactors hp).trans hd
      have hlt := s.nu_lt_one_of_prime p hpp hpP
      have hne : (1 - s.nu p) ≠ 0 := by linarith
      rw [hHh p, hh p, hpp.primeFactors, Finset.prod_singleton]
      field_simp
      ring
    rw [hLHS, hh d, inv_mul_cancel_left₀ (BoundingSieve.nu_pos_of_dvd_prodPrimes hd).ne']
  
  have hd0 : d ≠ 0 := fun h0 => hP (by rw [h0] at hd; exact zero_dvd_iff.mp hd)
  set S := ∑ m ∈ s.prodPrimes.divisors,
      (if ((d * m : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ s.level ∧ m.Coprime d then h m else 0) with hSdef
  have hS0 : 0 ≤ S := by
    apply Finset.sum_nonneg
    intro m hm
    split_ifs
    · exact (hpos m (Nat.dvd_of_mem_divisors hm)).le
    · exact le_refl _
  
  have hineq : (∑ e ∈ d.divisors, h e) * S ≤ G := by
    set E := d.divisors with hE
    set M := s.prodPrimes.divisors.filter
      (fun m => ((d * m : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ s.level ∧ m.Coprime d) with hM
    set T := s.prodPrimes.divisors.filter (fun l : ℕ => (l : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ s.level) with hT
    have hS' : S = ∑ m ∈ M, h m := by rw [hSdef, hM, Finset.sum_filter]
    have hG' : G = ∑ l ∈ T, h l := by rw [hG, hT, Finset.sum_filter]
    rw [hS', hG', Finset.sum_mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_product']
    have hmerge : ∀ x ∈ E ×ˢ M, h x.1 * h x.2 = h (x.1 * x.2) := by
      intro x hx
      rw [Finset.mem_product] at hx
      have he : x.1 ∣ d := Nat.dvd_of_mem_divisors hx.1
      have hm := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx.2).2.2
      exact (hmul x.1 x.2 (Nat.Coprime.coprime_dvd_left he hm.symm)).symm
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hmerge]
    have hinj : Set.InjOn (fun x : ℕ × ℕ => x.1 * x.2) (E ×ˢ M : Finset (ℕ × ℕ)) := by
      have key : ∀ x ∈ E ×ˢ M, Nat.gcd d (x.1 * x.2) = x.1 := by
        intro x hx
        rw [Finset.mem_product] at hx
        have he : x.1 ∣ d := Nat.dvd_of_mem_divisors hx.1
        have hm := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx.2).2.2
        rw [Nat.Coprime.gcd_mul d (Nat.Coprime.coprime_dvd_left he hm.symm), Nat.gcd_eq_right he,
          Nat.Coprime.gcd_eq_one hm.symm, mul_one]
      intro x hx y hy hxy
      have hx' : x ∈ E ×ˢ M := hx
      have hy' : y ∈ E ×ˢ M := hy
      simp only at hxy
      have h1eq : x.1 = y.1 := by rw [← key x hx', ← key y hy', hxy]
      have hxpos : 0 < x.1 := Nat.pos_of_mem_divisors (Finset.mem_product.mp hx').1
      have h2eq : x.2 = y.2 := by
        rw [h1eq] at hxy
        exact Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left (h1eq ▸ hxpos) hxy
      exact Prod.ext h1eq h2eq
    rw [← Finset.sum_image (f := h) hinj]
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg
    · intro l hl
      rw [Finset.mem_image] at hl
      obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := hl
      rw [Finset.mem_product] at hx
      have he : x.1 ∣ d := Nat.dvd_of_mem_divisors hx.1
      have hmD := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx.2).1
      have hm := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx.2).2
      have hmP : x.2 ∣ s.prodPrimes := Nat.dvd_of_mem_divisors hmD
      rw [hT, Finset.mem_filter, Nat.mem_divisors]
      refine ⟨⟨Nat.Coprime.mul_dvd_of_dvd_of_dvd
        (Nat.Coprime.coprime_dvd_left he hm.2.symm) (he.trans hd) hmP, hP⟩, ?_⟩
      have hle : x.1 * x.2 ≤ d * x.2 := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (Nat.le_of_dvd (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hd0) he)
      have hle' : ((x.1 * x.2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ ((d * x.2 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hle
      calc ((x.1 * x.2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ ((d * x.2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 :=
            pow_le_pow_left₀ (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hle' 2
        _ ≤ s.level := hm.1
    · intro l hl _
      exact (hpos l (Nat.dvd_of_mem_divisors (Finset.mem_filter.mp hl).1)).le
  
  have hG1 : 1 ≤ G := by
    rw [hG]
    have h1mem : 1 ∈ s.prodPrimes.divisors := Nat.one_mem_divisors.mpr hP
    have hterm : (if ((1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ s.level then h 1 else 0) = 1 := by
      rw [if_pos (by rw [Nat.cast_one, one_pow]; exact s.one_le_level), h1]
    rw [← hterm]
    apply Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun l : ℕ => if (l : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ s.level then h l else 0) _ h1mem
    intro l hl
    dsimp only
    split_ifs
    · exact (hpos l (Nat.dvd_of_mem_divisors hl)).le
    · exact le_refl _
  have hGpos : 0 < G := by linarith
  have hmu : |((ArithmeticFunction.moebius d : ℤ) : ℝ)| = 1 := by
    rw [← Int.cast_abs, ArithmeticFunction.abs_moebius_eq_one_of_squarefree
      (BoundingSieve.squarefree_of_dvd_prodPrimes hd), Int.cast_one]
  have hnu : 0 < (s.nu d)⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr (BoundingSieve.nu_pos_of_dvd_prodPrimes hd)
  rw [hw d, if_pos hd, ← hSdef, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_mul, hmu, abs_of_pos hnu,
    abs_of_pos (hpos d hd), abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hGpos), abs_of_nonneg hS0]
  rw [hsum] at hineq
  have : (s.nu d)⁻¹ * h d * 1 * G⁻¹ * S = ((s.nu d)⁻¹ * h d * S) / G := by ring
  rw [this, div_le_one hGpos]
  exact hineq

informal_problem.statement:
∀ (s : SelbergSieve) (h : ℕ → ℝ) (G : ℝ) (w : ℕ → ℝ),
    (∀ l, h l = s.nu l * ∏ p ∈ l.primeFactors, 1 / (1 - s.nu p)) →
    G = ∑ l ∈ s.prodPrimes.divisors, (if (l : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ s.level then h l else 0) →
    (∀ d, w d = if d ∣ s.prodPrimes then
        (s.nu d)⁻¹ * h d * (ArithmeticFunction.moebius d : ℝ) * G⁻¹ *
          ∑ m ∈ s.prodPrimes.divisors,
            (if ((d * m : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ s.level ∧ m.Coprime d then h m else 0)
      else 0) →
    (∀ l, l ∣ s.prodPrimes → 0 < h l) ∧ 0 < G ∧ w 1 = 1 ∧
      (∀ d : ℕ, ¬ (d : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ s.level → w d = 0)

signature.name: selbergWeights_basic
signature.statement:
∀ (s : SelbergSieve) (h : ℕ → ℝ) (G : ℝ) (w : ℕ → ℝ),
    (∀ l, h l = s.nu l * ∏ p ∈ l.primeFactors, 1 / (1 - s.nu p)) →
    G = ∑ l ∈ s.prodPrimes.divisors, (if (l : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ s.level then h l else 0) →
    (∀ d, w d = if d ∣ s.prodPrimes then
        (s.nu d)⁻¹ * h d * (ArithmeticFunction.moebius d : ℝ) * G⁻¹ *
          ∑ m ∈ s.prodPrimes.divisors,
            (if ((d * m : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ s.level ∧ m.Coprime d then h m else 0)
      else 0) →
    (∀ l, l ∣ s.prodPrimes → 0 < h l) ∧ 0 < G ∧ w 1 = 1 ∧

proof.tactics:
by
  intro s h G w hh hG hw
  have hP0 : s.prodPrimes ≠ 0 := BoundingSieve.prodPrimes_ne_zero (s := s.toBoundingSieve)
  have hnu1 : s.nu 1 = 1 := s.toBoundingSieve.nu_mult.map_one
  have hpos : ∀ l, l ∣ s.prodPrimes → 0 < h l := by
    intro l hl
    rw [hh l]
    apply mul_pos (BoundingSieve.nu_pos_of_dvd_prodPrimes hl)
    apply Finset.prod_pos
    intro p hp
    have hpp : p.Prime := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp
    have hpP : p ∣ s.prodPrimes := dvd_trans (Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactors hp) hl
    have hlt : s.nu p < 1 := s.toBoundingSieve.nu_lt_one_of_prime p hpp hpP
    apply one_div_pos.mpr
    linarith
  have h1 : h 1 = 1 := by
    rw [hh 1, hnu1, Nat.primeFactors_one, Finset.prod_empty, mul_one]
  have hGge : 1 ≤ G := by
    rw [hG]
    have hmem : 1 ∈ s.prodPrimes.divisors := Nat.one_mem_divisors.mpr hP0
    have hnn : ∀ l ∈ s.prodPrimes.divisors,
        0 ≤ (if (l : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ s.level then h l else 0) := by
      intro l hl
      have := hpos l (Nat.mem_divisors.mp hl).1
      split_ifs
      · exact this.le
      · exact le_refl 0
    have hle := Finset.single_le_sum hnn hmem
    have hval : (if ((1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ s.level then h 1 else 0) = 1 := by
      have hy : ((1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ s.level := by
        simp only [Nat.cast_one, one_pow]
        exact s.one_le_level
      rw [if_pos hy, h1]
    rw [hval] at hle
    exact hle
  have hGpos : 0 < G := lt_of_lt_of_le one_pos hGge
  refine ⟨hpos, hGpos, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hw 1, if_pos (one_dvd _), hnu1, h1, ArithmeticFunction.moebius_apply_one]
    have hsum : (∑ m ∈ s.prodPrimes.divisors,
        (if ((1 * m : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ s.level ∧ m.Coprime 1 then h m else 0)) = G := by
      rw [hG]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro m _
      simp [Nat.one_mul, Nat.coprime_one_right_eq_true]
    rw [hsum]
    simp only [inv_one, one_mul, Int.cast_one]
    exact inv_mul_cancel₀ hGpos.ne'
  · intro d hd
    rw [hw d]
    split_ifs with hdP
    · have hz : (∑ m ∈ s.prodPrimes.divisors,
          (if ((d * m : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ s.level ∧ m.Coprime d then h m else 0)) = 0 := by
        apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
        intro m hm
        apply if_neg
        rintro ⟨hyp, _⟩
        have hmpos : 0 < m := Nat.pos_of_mem_divisors hm
        have hdm : d ≤ d * m := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right d hmpos
        have hdm2 : d ^ 2 ≤ (d * m) ^ 2 := Nat.pow_le_pow_left hdm 2
        have hR : (d : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ ((d * m : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 := by exact_mod_cast hdm2
        exact hd (le_trans hR hyp)
      rw [hz, mul_zero]
    · rfl

informal_problem.statement:
∃ B K : ℝ, 0 < K ∧ ∀ x : ℝ, 2 ≤ x →
      |(∑ p ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊x⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, (1 : ℝ) / p) - Real.log (Real.log x) - B| ≤
        K / Real.log x

signature.name: prime_reciprocal_log_error
signature.statement:
∃ B K : ℝ, 0 < K ∧ ∀ x : ℝ, 2 ≤ x →
      |(∑ p ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊x⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, (1 : ℝ) / p) - Real.log (Real.log x) - B| ≤

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨C, K₁, hrate⟩ :=
    vonMangoldt_div_log_sum_rate (Real.log 4 + 4) vonMangoldt_div_sum_sub_log_abs_le
  
  set W : ℕ → ℝ := fun n =>
    if n.Prime then (0 : ℝ) else ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n / (n : ℝ) with hWdef
  have hW : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 ≤ W n ∧ (W n = 0 ∨ ∃ m k : ℕ, 2 ≤ m ∧ 2 ≤ k ∧ n = m ^ k ∧
      W n = Real.log m / (m : ℝ) ^ k) := by
    intro n
    by_cases hp : n.Prime
    · have h0 : W n = 0 := by simp only [hWdef, if_pos hp]
      exact ⟨h0.ge, Or.inl h0⟩
    · by_cases hpp : IsPrimePow n
      · obtain ⟨p, k, hpk, hk, rfl⟩ := (isPrimePow_nat_iff _).mp hpp
        have hk2 : 2 ≤ k := by
          rcases Nat.lt_or_ge k 2 with h | h
          · exfalso
            have hk1 : k = 1 := by omega
            subst hk1
            exact hp (by simpa using hpk)
          · exact h
        have hp1 : (1 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast hpk.one_lt
        have hlogp : 0 < Real.log p := Real.log_pos hp1
        have hval : W (p ^ k) = Real.log p / (p : ℝ) ^ k := by
          simp only [hWdef, if_neg hp, ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt_apply_pow (by omega : k ≠ 0),
            ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt_apply_prime hpk, Nat.cast_pow]
        refine ⟨by rw [hval]; positivity, Or.inr ⟨p, k, hpk.two_le, hk2, rfl, hval⟩⟩
      · have h0 : W n = 0 := by
          simp only [hWdef, if_neg hp, ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt_eq_zero_iff.mpr hpp]
          simp
        exact ⟨h0.ge, Or.inl h0⟩
  
  have hQ : ∀ N : ℕ, ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), W n ≤ 2 := by
    intro N
    have hnonneg : ∀ n m k : ℕ, 0 ≤ (if n = m ^ k then Real.log m / (m : ℝ) ^ k else 0) := by
      intro n m k
      split_ifs
      · exact div_nonneg (Real.log_natCast_nonneg m) (by positivity)
      · exact le_rfl
    have hG : ∀ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), W n ≤ ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 2 N, ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 N,
        (if n = m ^ k then Real.log m / (m : ℝ) ^ k else 0) := by
      intro n hn
      have hnN : n ≤ N := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hn)
      rcases (hW n).2 with h0 | ⟨m, k, hm, hk, rfl, hle⟩
      · rw [h0]
        exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun m _ => Finset.sum_nonneg fun k _ => hnonneg _ m k
      · have hmN : m ∈ Finset.Icc 2 N := by
          refine Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨hm, le_trans ?_ hnN⟩
          exact Nat.le_self_pow (by omega) m
        have hkN : k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 N := by
          refine Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨hk, le_trans ?_ hnN⟩
          calc k ≤ 2 ^ k := (Nat.lt_two_pow_self).le
            _ ≤ m ^ k := Nat.pow_le_pow_left hm k
        calc W (m ^ k) = Real.log m / (m : ℝ) ^ k := hle
          _ = (if m ^ k = m ^ k then Real.log m / (m : ℝ) ^ k else 0) := by rw [if_pos rfl]
          _ ≤ ∑ k' ∈ Finset.Icc 2 N, (if m ^ k = m ^ k' then Real.log m / (m : ℝ) ^ k' else 0) :=
              Finset.single_le_sum
                (f := fun k' => if m ^ k = m ^ k' then Real.log m / (m : ℝ) ^ k' else 0)
                (fun k' _ => hnonneg _ m k') hkN
          _ ≤ ∑ m' ∈ Finset.Icc 2 N, ∑ k' ∈ Finset.Icc 2 N,
                (if m ^ k = m' ^ k' then Real.log m' / (m' : ℝ) ^ k' else 0) :=
              Finset.single_le_sum
                (f := fun m' => ∑ k' ∈ Finset.Icc 2 N,
                  (if m ^ k = m' ^ k' then Real.log m' / (m' : ℝ) ^ k' else 0))
                (fun m' _ => Finset.sum_nonneg fun k' _ => hnonneg _ m' k') hmN
    have hswap : ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 2 N, ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 N,
        (if n = m ^ k then Real.log m / (m : ℝ) ^ k else 0)
        ≤ ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 2 N, ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 N, Real.log m * ((m : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ k := by
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro m _
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro k _
      rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq']
      have he : Real.log m * ((m : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ k = Real.log m / (m : ℝ) ^ k := by
        rw [inv_pow]; ring
      rw [he]
      split_ifs
      · exact le_rfl
      · exact div_nonneg (Real.log_natCast_nonneg m) (by positivity)
    have hgeom : ∀ m ∈ Finset.Icc 2 N, ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 N, Real.log m * ((m : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ k ≤
        Real.log m / ((m : ℝ) * ((m : ℝ) - 1)) := by
      intro m hm
      have hm2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ m := by exact_mod_cast (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hm).1
      have hx0 : 0 ≤ (m : ℝ)⁻¹ := by positivity
      have hx1 : (m : ℝ)⁻¹ < 1 := inv_lt_one_of_one_lt₀ (by linarith)
      have hIco : Finset.Icc 2 N = Finset.Ico 2 (N + 1) := by
        ext k; simp only [Finset.mem_Icc, Finset.mem_Ico]; omega
      have h2 := geom_sum_Ico_le_of_lt_one (m := 2) (n := N + 1) hx0 hx1
      have hm0 : (m : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
      have hm1 : (m : ℝ) - 1 ≠ 0 := by
        have : (0 : ℝ) < (m : ℝ) - 1 := by linarith
        exact this.ne'
      have h3 : ((m : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ 2 / (1 - (m : ℝ)⁻¹) = 1 / ((m : ℝ) * ((m : ℝ) - 1)) := by
        field_simp
      rw [← Finset.mul_sum, hIco]
      rw [h3] at h2
      have hl : 0 ≤ Real.log m := Real.log_natCast_nonneg m
      calc Real.log m * ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico 2 (N + 1), ((m : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ k
          ≤ Real.log m * (1 / ((m : ℝ) * ((m : ℝ) - 1))) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 hl
        _ = Real.log m / ((m : ℝ) * ((m : ℝ) - 1)) := by ring
    have htele : ∀ M : ℕ, ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 2 (M + 1), Real.log m / ((m : ℝ) * ((m : ℝ) - 1)) ≤
        2 - (2 + Real.log ((M : ℝ) + 1)) / ((M : ℝ) + 1) := by
      intro M
      induction M with
      | zero =>
        rw [Finset.Icc_eq_empty (by norm_num)]
        simp
      | succ M ih =>
        rw [Finset.sum_Icc_succ_top (by omega)]
        push_cast
        set n : ℝ := (M : ℝ) + 1 with hn
        have hn1 : 1 ≤ n := by rw [hn]; have : (0 : ℝ) ≤ M := Nat.cast_nonneg M; linarith
        have hn0 : 0 < n := by linarith
        have hsh : (M : ℝ) + 1 + 1 = n + 1 := by rw [hn]
        rw [hsh]
        have hsh2 : n + 1 - 1 = n := by ring
        rw [hsh2]
        set a := Real.log n with ha
        set b := Real.log (n + 1) with hb
        have hba : 0 ≤ b - a := by
          have := Real.log_le_log hn0 (by linarith : n ≤ n + 1)
          linarith
        have hdiff : b - a ≤ 1 / n := by
          have h1 := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by positivity : 0 < (n + 1) / n)
          rw [Real.log_div (by positivity) hn0.ne'] at h1
          have h2 : (n + 1) / n - 1 = 1 / n := by field_simp; ring
          linarith
        have hmul : (b - a) * n ≤ 1 := (le_div_iff₀ hn0).mp hdiff
        have hkey : 2 - (2 + a) / n + b / ((n + 1) * n) - (2 - (2 + b) / (n + 1)) =
            ((n + 1) * (b - a) - 2) / (n * (n + 1)) := by
          field_simp
          ring
        have hnum : (n + 1) * (b - a) - 2 ≤ 0 := by
          nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hn1 hba]
        have hfrac : ((n + 1) * (b - a) - 2) / (n * (n + 1)) ≤ 0 :=
          div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg hnum (by positivity)
        linarith
    have hS : ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 2 N, Real.log m / ((m : ℝ) * ((m : ℝ) - 1)) ≤ 2 := by
      rcases N with _ | M
      · rw [Finset.Icc_eq_empty (by norm_num)]
        simp
      · have h := htele M
        have hM : (0 : ℝ) < (M : ℝ) + 1 := by positivity
        have hl : 0 ≤ Real.log ((M : ℝ) + 1) := Real.log_nonneg (by
          have : (0 : ℝ) ≤ M := Nat.cast_nonneg M; linarith)
        have : 0 ≤ (2 + Real.log ((M : ℝ) + 1)) / ((M : ℝ) + 1) := by positivity
        linarith
    calc ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), W n
        ≤ ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 2 N, ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 N,
            (if n = m ^ k then Real.log m / (m : ℝ) ^ k else 0) := Finset.sum_le_sum hG
      _ ≤ ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 2 N, ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 N, Real.log m * ((m : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ k := hswap
      _ ≤ ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 2 N, Real.log m / ((m : ℝ) * ((m : ℝ) - 1)) :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum hgeom
      _ ≤ 2 := hS
  
  set T : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n / (n : ℝ) / Real.log n -
      (if n.Prime then (1 : ℝ) / n else 0) with hTdef
  have hTW : ∀ n : ℕ, T n = W n / Real.log n := by
    intro n
    by_cases hp : n.Prime
    · have h2 : (1 : ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hp.one_lt
      have hlog : 0 < Real.log n := Real.log_pos h2
      have hn0 : (n : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
      simp only [hTdef, hWdef, if_pos hp, ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt_apply_prime hp]
      field_simp
      ring
    · simp only [hTdef, hWdef, if_neg hp, sub_zero]
  have hT0 : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 ≤ T n := fun n => by
    rw [hTW n]; exact div_nonneg (hW n).1 (Real.log_natCast_nonneg n)
  set D : ℕ → ℝ := fun N => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), T n with hDdef
  have hDdiff : ∀ N M : ℕ, N ≤ M → D M - D N = ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ico (N + 1) (M + 1), T n := by
    intro N M h
    simp only [hDdef]
    rw [← Finset.sum_range_add_sum_Ico T (by omega : N + 1 ≤ M + 1)]
    ring
  have hmono : ∀ N M : ℕ, N ≤ M → D N ≤ D M := by
    intro N M h
    have := hDdiff N M h
    have h0 : 0 ≤ ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ico (N + 1) (M + 1), T n := Finset.sum_nonneg fun n _ => hT0 n
    linarith
  have htail : ∀ N M : ℕ, 2 ≤ N → N ≤ M → D M - D N ≤ 2 / Real.log N := by
    intro N M h2 h
    rw [hDdiff N M h]
    have hN : (1 : ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 1 < N)
    have hlogN : 0 < Real.log N := Real.log_pos hN
    calc ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ico (N + 1) (M + 1), T n
        ≤ ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ico (N + 1) (M + 1), W n / Real.log N := by
          apply Finset.sum_le_sum
          intro n hn
          have hnN : N ≤ n := by have := (Finset.mem_Ico.mp hn).1; omega
          have hNn : (N : ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast hnN
          have hle : Real.log N ≤ Real.log n := Real.log_le_log (by positivity) hNn
          rw [hTW n]
          exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (hW n).1 hlogN hle
      _ = (∑ n ∈ Finset.Ico (N + 1) (M + 1), W n) / Real.log N := by rw [Finset.sum_div]
      _ ≤ (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (M + 1), W n) / Real.log N := by
          apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ hlogN.le
          apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg
          · intro n hn
            simp only [Finset.mem_Ico] at hn
            exact Finset.mem_range.mpr hn.2
          · intro n _ _; exact (hW n).1
      _ ≤ 2 / Real.log N := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (hQ M) hlogN.le
  
  have hlog2 : 0 < Real.log (2 : ℕ) := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  have hbdd : BddAbove (Set.range D) := by
    refine ⟨D 2 + 2 / Real.log (2 : ℕ), ?_⟩
    rintro _ ⟨M, rfl⟩
    have hpos : 0 ≤ 2 / Real.log (2 : ℕ) := by positivity
    rcases le_total 2 M with h | h
    · have := htail 2 M le_rfl h
      linarith
    · have := hmono M 2 h
      linarith
  set L : ℝ := ⨆ M, D M with hLdef
  have hL : ∀ N : ℕ, 2 ≤ N → D N ≤ L ∧ L - D N ≤ 2 / Real.log N := by
    intro N hN
    have hN1 : (1 : ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 1 < N)
    have hpos : 0 ≤ 2 / Real.log N := div_nonneg (by norm_num) (Real.log_pos hN1).le
    refine ⟨le_ciSup hbdd N, ?_⟩
    have : L ≤ D N + 2 / Real.log N := by
      apply ciSup_le
      intro M
      rcases le_total N M with h | h
      · have := htail N M hN h
        linarith
      · have := hmono M N h
        linarith
    linarith
  
  refine ⟨C - L, |K₁| + 4, by positivity, ?_⟩
  intro x hx
  set N := ⌊x⌋₊ with hNdef
  have hx0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ x := by linarith
  have h2N : 2 ≤ N := Nat.le_floor (by exact_mod_cast hx)
  have hA : (∑ d ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 N, ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt d / ((d : ℝ) * Real.log d)) =
      ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n / (n : ℝ) / Real.log n := by
    rw [Finset.sum_subset (s₁ := Finset.Ioc 0 N) (s₂ := Finset.range (N + 1))]
    · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro n _
      rw [div_div]
    · intro n hn
      simp only [Finset.mem_Ioc] at hn
      exact Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega)
    · intro n hn hn'
      have h0 : n = 0 := by
        simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hn
        simp only [Finset.mem_Ioc, not_and, not_le] at hn'
        by_contra hne
        have := hn' (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hne)
        omega
      subst h0
      simp
  have hP : (∑ p ∈ (Finset.Iic N).filter Nat.Prime, (1 : ℝ) / p) =
      (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n / (n : ℝ) / Real.log n) - D N := by
    have hIic : Finset.Iic N = Finset.range (N + 1) := by
      ext n; simp
    simp only [hDdef, hTdef]
    rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, hIic, Finset.sum_filter]
    ring
  have hr := hrate x hx
  rw [hA] at hr
  obtain ⟨hL1, hL2⟩ := hL N h2N
  have hlogx : 0 < Real.log x := Real.log_pos (by linarith)
  have hN1 : (1 : ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 1 < N)
  have hlogN : 0 < Real.log N := Real.log_pos hN1
  have hxN : Real.log x ≤ 2 * Real.log N := by
    have hlt : x < (N : ℝ) + 1 := Nat.lt_floor_add_one x
    have hN2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ N := by exact_mod_cast h2N
    have hsq : (N : ℝ) + 1 ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    have := Real.log_le_log (by linarith) (hlt.le.trans hsq)
    rw [Real.log_pow] at this
    push_cast at this
    linarith
  have h4 : 2 / Real.log N ≤ 4 / Real.log x := by
    rw [div_le_div_iff₀ hlogN hlogx]
    linarith
  have hK : K₁ / Real.log x ≤ |K₁| / Real.log x :=
    div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self K₁) hlogx.le
  rw [hP]
  have hid : (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n / (n : ℝ) / Real.log n) -
      D N - Real.log (Real.log x) - (C - L) =
      ((∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n / (n : ℝ) / Real.log n) -
        Real.log (Real.log x) - C) + (L - D N) := by ring
  rw [hid]
  calc _ ≤ |(∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n / (n : ℝ) / Real.log n) -
        Real.log (Real.log x) - C| + |L - D N| := abs_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ K₁ / Real.log x + 2 / Real.log N := by
        rw [abs_of_nonneg (by linarith : 0 ≤ L - D N)]
        linarith
    _ ≤ (|K₁| + 4) / Real.log x := by
        rw [add_div]
        linarith

by
  
  have hwinmass : ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ m : ℕ, Real.exp (-C * Real.exp (-(m : ℝ))) ≤
      ∑ p ∈ FordReciprocal.primeWindow m, (1 : ℝ) / p := by
    obtain ⟨B, K, hK, hM⟩ := hMERT2
    refine ⟨2 * (2 * K + 1) + 4 * (2 * K + 1) ^ 2, by positivity, ?_⟩
    intro m

    have hX2 : 2 ≤ Real.exp (Real.exp (m : ℝ)) :=

      Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith))

    have hSnn : ∀ p ∈ FordReciprocal.primeWindow m, (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / p := fun p _ => by positivity
    have hmemW : ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → Real.exp (Real.exp (m : ℝ)) ≤ p →
        (p : ℝ) < Real.exp (Real.exp ((m : ℝ) + 1)) → p ∈ FordReciprocal.primeWindow m :=
      fun p hp h1 h2 => Finset.mem_filter.mpr

    have hz0 : 0 < Real.exp (-(m : ℝ)) := Real.exp_pos _

    have hmert : 1 - (2 * K + 1) * Real.exp (-(m : ℝ)) ≤

      have hsub : (Finset.Iic ⌊Real.exp (Real.exp (m : ℝ))⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime ⊆

        intro p hp

        · have heq : Real.exp (Real.exp ((m : ℝ) + 1)) = (p : ℝ) :=

      have hceil : (1 : ℝ) / (⌈Real.exp (Real.exp ((m : ℝ) + 1))⌉₊ : ℝ) ≤

        one_div_le_one_div_of_le hX'0 (Nat.le_ceil _)
      have hsumW : ∑ p ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊Real.exp (Real.exp ((m : ℝ) + 1))⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime \
          (Finset.Iic ⌊Real.exp (Real.exp (m : ℝ))⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, (1 : ℝ) / p ≤
          (∑ p ∈ FordReciprocal.primeWindow m, (1 : ℝ) / p) +
            1 / Real.exp (Real.exp ((m : ℝ) + 1)) := by
        calc _ ≤ ∑ p ∈ FordReciprocal.primeWindow m ∪ {⌈Real.exp (Real.exp ((m : ℝ) + 1))⌉₊},

          _ ≤ (∑ p ∈ FordReciprocal.primeWindow m, (1 : ℝ) / p) +
              ∑ p ∈ ({⌈Real.exp (Real.exp ((m : ℝ) + 1))⌉₊} : Finset ℕ), (1 : ℝ) / p := by
              rw [← Finset.sum_union_inter]

      rw [Finset.sum_sdiff_eq_sub hsub] at hsumW
      have hlo := (abs_le.mp (hM _ (hX2.trans hXX'))).1
      have hhi := (abs_le.mp (hM _ hX2)).2
      simp only [Real.log_exp] at hlo hhi

        rw [Real.exp_neg, div_eq_mul_inv]

    by_cases hv : (2 * K + 1) * Real.exp (-(m : ℝ)) ≤ 1 / 2
    · have hv0 : 0 ≤ (2 * K + 1) * Real.exp (-(m : ℝ)) := by positivity
      have h1 : Real.exp (-2 * ((2 * K + 1) * Real.exp (-(m : ℝ)))) ≤

        have hpos : 0 < 1 - (2 * K + 1) * Real.exp (-(m : ℝ)) := by linarith
        apply (Real.le_log_iff_exp_le hpos).mp
        have hinv : (1 - (2 * K + 1) * Real.exp (-(m : ℝ)))⁻¹ ≤

      calc Real.exp (-(2 * (2 * K + 1) + 4 * (2 * K + 1) ^ 2) * Real.exp (-(m : ℝ)))

    · push_neg at hv

        Nat.exists_prime_lt_and_le_two_mul ⌊Real.exp (Real.exp (m : ℝ))⌋₊ (by omega)

      have hp2X : (p : ℝ) ≤ 2 * Real.exp (Real.exp (m : ℝ)) := by
        have h1 : (p : ℝ) ≤ 2 * (⌊Real.exp (Real.exp (m : ℝ))⌋₊ : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hpu
        have h2 := Nat.floor_le (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp (Real.exp (m : ℝ)))
        linarith
      have harg : Real.exp (m : ℝ) + 1 < Real.exp ((m : ℝ) + 1) := by
        rw [Real.exp_add]
        nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hem) (sub_nonneg.mpr he2.le)]
      have h2XX' : 2 * Real.exp (Real.exp (m : ℝ)) < Real.exp (Real.exp ((m : ℝ) + 1)) := by
        calc 2 * Real.exp (Real.exp (m : ℝ)) < Real.exp 1 * Real.exp (Real.exp (m : ℝ)) :=

      have hSp : (1 : ℝ) / p ≤ ∑ q ∈ FordReciprocal.primeWindow m, (1 : ℝ) / q :=
        Finset.single_le_sum hSnn hpW
      have hp0 : (0 : ℝ) < p := by linarith
      have h1p : 1 / (2 * Real.exp (Real.exp (m : ℝ))) ≤ 1 / (p : ℝ) :=
        one_div_le_one_div_of_le hp0 hp2X
      refine le_trans ?_ (h1p.trans hSp)
      have hlog2 : Real.log 2 < 1 := by linarith [Real.log_two_lt_d9]

      have hid : Real.log 2 + Real.exp (m : ℝ) =
          (Real.exp (m : ℝ) * Real.log 2 + Real.exp (m : ℝ) ^ 2) * Real.exp (-(m : ℝ)) := by
        calc Real.log 2 + Real.exp (m : ℝ)

  obtain ⟨C, hC, hS⟩ := hwinmass
  
  have hfact : ∀ (L : ℕ) (q q' : Fin L → ℕ), (∀ i, (q i).Prime) → (∀ i, (q' i).Prime) →

    intro L q q' hq hq' hs hs' h

      (List.forall_mem_ofFn_iff.mpr hq')
    exact List.ofFn_injective (List.Perm.eq_of_sortedGE hs.antitone.sortedGE_ofFn
      hs'.antitone.sortedGE_ofFn (h1.trans h2.symm))
  set D : ℝ := ∑' m : ℕ, Real.exp (-(m : ℝ)) with hD
  refine ⟨Real.exp (-C * D), Real.exp_pos _, ?_⟩
  intro L t E ht hE hanti
  
  have hprodlow : ∀ k : Fin L → ℕ, Function.Injective k →
      Real.exp (-C * D) ≤ ∏ i, ∑ p ∈ FordReciprocal.primeWindow (k i), (1 : ℝ) / p := by
    intro k hk
    have hsum : (∑ i, Real.exp (-((k i : ℕ) : ℝ))) ≤ D := by
      calc (∑ i, Real.exp (-((k i : ℕ) : ℝ)))
          = ∑ m ∈ Finset.univ.image k, Real.exp (-(m : ℝ)) :=
            (Finset.sum_image (f := fun m : ℕ => Real.exp (-(m : ℝ)))
              (fun a _ b _ hab => hk hab)).symm
        _ ≤ D := Real.summable_exp_neg_nat.sum_le_tsum _ (fun _ _ => (Real.exp_pos _).le)
    calc Real.exp (-C * D) ≤ Real.exp (∑ i, -C * Real.exp (-((k i : ℕ) : ℝ))) := by
          apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
          rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
          nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsum hC.le]
      _ = ∏ i, Real.exp (-C * Real.exp (-((k i : ℕ) : ℝ))) := Real.exp_sum _ _
      _ ≤ _ := Finset.prod_le_prod (fun i _ => (Real.exp_pos _).le) (fun i _ => hS (k i))
  set Kset := (Fintype.piFinset (fun _ : Fin L => Finset.range (⌊t⌋₊ + 1))).filter
      (fun k => ∃ x ∈ FordReciprocal.cubeErosion E (1 / t), ∀ i, ⌊t * x i⌋₊ = k i) with hKset
  have htne : t ≠ 0 := ht.ne'
  have htτ : t * (1 / t) = 1 := by field_simp
  have hτ0 : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / t := by positivity
  
  have hvol : t ^ L * MeasureTheory.volume.real (FordReciprocal.cubeErosion E (1 / t)) ≤
      (Kset.card : ℝ) := by
    have hcover : FordReciprocal.cubeErosion E (1 / t) ⊆
        ⋃ k ∈ Kset, Set.univ.pi (fun i => Set.Ico ((k i : ℝ) / t) (((k i : ℝ) + 1) / t)) := by
      intro x hx
      have hxE : x ∈ E := by
        simpa only [add_zero] using hx 0 ⟨fun _ => neg_nonpos.mpr hτ0.le, fun _ => hτ0.le⟩
      have h01 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ x i ∧ x i ≤ 1 := fun i => ⟨(hE hxE).1 i, (hE hxE).2 i⟩
      have hk : (fun i => ⌊t * x i⌋₊) ∈ Kset := by
        refine Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Fintype.mem_piFinset.mpr (fun i => ?_), x, hx, fun i => rfl⟩
        refine Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le (Nat.floor_le_floor ?_))
        nlinarith [(h01 i).2]
      refine Set.mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨_, hk, Set.mem_univ_pi.mpr (fun i => ⟨?_, ?_⟩)⟩
      · rw [div_le_iff₀ ht]
        have := Nat.floor_le (mul_nonneg ht.le (h01 i).1)
        linarith
      · rw [lt_div_iff₀ ht]
        have := Nat.lt_floor_add_one (t * x i)
        linarith
    have hcellvol : ∀ k : Fin L → ℕ, MeasureTheory.volume
        (Set.univ.pi (fun i => Set.Ico ((k i : ℝ) / t) (((k i : ℝ) + 1) / t))) =
        ENNReal.ofReal (1 / t) ^ L := by
      intro k
      rw [Real.volume_pi_Ico]
      have h1 : ∀ i, (((k i : ℝ) + 1) / t - (k i : ℝ) / t) = 1 / t := fun i => by ring
      simp only [h1, Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
    have hU : MeasureTheory.volume (⋃ k ∈ Kset,
        Set.univ.pi (fun i => Set.Ico ((k i : ℝ) / t) (((k i : ℝ) + 1) / t))) ≤
        (Kset.card : ENNReal) * ENNReal.ofReal (1 / t) ^ L := by
      calc _ ≤ ∑ k ∈ Kset, MeasureTheory.volume
              (Set.univ.pi (fun i => Set.Ico ((k i : ℝ) / t) (((k i : ℝ) + 1) / t))) :=
            MeasureTheory.measure_biUnion_finset_le _ _
        _ = ∑ k ∈ Kset, ENNReal.ofReal (1 / t) ^ L := Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => hcellvol k)
        _ = _ := by rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
    have hE'vol : MeasureTheory.volume (FordReciprocal.cubeErosion E (1 / t)) ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal ((Kset.card : ℝ) * (1 / t) ^ L) := by
      refine (MeasureTheory.measure_mono hcover).trans (hU.trans (le_of_eq ?_))
      rw [ENNReal.ofReal_mul (Nat.cast_nonneg _), ENNReal.ofReal_pow hτ0.le, ENNReal.ofReal_natCast]
    have hreal : MeasureTheory.volume.real (FordReciprocal.cubeErosion E (1 / t)) ≤
        (Kset.card : ℝ) * (1 / t) ^ L :=
      ENNReal.toReal_le_of_le_ofReal (by positivity) hE'vol
    have hinv : t ^ L * (1 / t) ^ L = 1 := by rw [← mul_pow, htτ, one_pow]
    calc t ^ L * MeasureTheory.volume.real (FordReciprocal.cubeErosion E (1 / t))
        ≤ t ^ L * ((Kset.card : ℝ) * (1 / t) ^ L) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hreal (pow_nonneg ht.le L)
      _ = (Kset.card : ℝ) * (t ^ L * (1 / t) ^ L) := by ring
      _ = _ := by rw [hinv, mul_one]
  
  have hcellprop : ∀ x ∈ FordReciprocal.cubeErosion E (1 / t),
      (∀ i, (⌊t * x i⌋₊ : ℝ) + 1 ≤ t) ∧
      (∀ i j : Fin L, i < j → ⌊t * x j⌋₊ + 2 ≤ ⌊t * x i⌋₊) ∧
      (∀ y : Fin L → ℝ, (∀ i, (⌊t * x i⌋₊ : ℝ) ≤ t * y i ∧ t * y i < (⌊t * x i⌋₊ : ℝ) + 1) →
        y ∈ E) := by
    intro x hx
    have hτ : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / t := by positivity
    have hmv : ∀ e : Fin L → ℝ, (∀ j, -(1 / t) ≤ e j ∧ e j ≤ 1 / t) → x + e ∈ E :=
      fun e he => hx e ⟨fun j => (he j).1, fun j => (he j).2⟩
    have hbd : ∀ e : Fin L → ℝ, (∀ j, -(1 / t) ≤ e j ∧ e j ≤ 1 / t) →
        ∀ j, 0 ≤ x j + e j ∧ x j + e j ≤ 1 := fun e he j =>
      ⟨(hE (hmv e he)).1 j, (hE (hmv e he)).2 j⟩
    have hlo : ∀ i, 1 ≤ t * x i := by
      intro i
      have h : 0 ≤ x i + (if i = i then -(1 / t) else 0) :=
        (hbd (fun j => if j = i then -(1 / t) else 0) (fun j => by
          dsimp only; split_ifs <;> constructor <;> linarith) i).1
      rw [if_pos rfl] at h
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg ht.le h]
    have hx0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ t * x i := fun i => by linarith [hlo i]
    have hfl : ∀ i, (⌊t * x i⌋₊ : ℝ) ≤ t * x i ∧ t * x i < (⌊t * x i⌋₊ : ℝ) + 1 :=
      fun i => ⟨Nat.floor_le (hx0 i), Nat.lt_floor_add_one _⟩
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro i
      have h : x i + (if i = i then 1 / t else 0) ≤ 1 :=
        (hbd (fun j => if j = i then 1 / t else 0) (fun j => by
          dsimp only; split_ifs <;> constructor <;> linarith) i).2
      rw [if_pos rfl] at h
      have h2 : t * x i + 1 ≤ t := by nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h ht.le]
      linarith [(hfl i).1]
    · intro i j hij
      have he : ∀ l, -(1 / t) ≤ (fun l => if l = i then -(1 / t) else if l = j then 1 / t else 0) l ∧
          (fun l => if l = i then -(1 / t) else if l = j then 1 / t else 0) l ≤ 1 / t := by
        intro l
        simp only
        split_ifs <;> constructor <;> linarith
      have h : x j + (if j = i then -(1 / t) else if j = j then 1 / t else 0) ≤
          x i + (if i = i then -(1 / t) else if i = j then 1 / t else 0) :=
        hanti _ (hmv _ he) hij.le
      rw [if_neg hij.ne', if_pos rfl, if_pos rfl] at h
      have h2 : t * x j + 2 ≤ t * x i := by nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h ht.le]
      apply Nat.le_floor
      push_cast
      linarith [(hfl j).1]
    · intro y hy
      have he : ∀ l, -(1 / t) ≤ (y - x) l ∧ (y - x) l ≤ 1 / t := by
        intro l
        have h1 := hy l
        have h2 := hfl l
        simp only [Pi.sub_apply]
        constructor
        · have : t * (-(1 / t)) ≤ t * (y l - x l) := by
            rw [mul_neg, htτ, mul_sub]; linarith
          exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left this ht
        · have : t * (y l - x l) ≤ t * (1 / t) := by
            rw [htτ, mul_sub]; linarith
          exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left this ht
      simpa using hmv (y - x) he
  have hprop : ∀ k ∈ Kset, (∀ i, (k i : ℝ) + 1 ≤ t) ∧
      (∀ i j : Fin L, i < j → k j + 2 ≤ k i) ∧
      (∀ y : Fin L → ℝ, (∀ i, (k i : ℝ) ≤ t * y i ∧ t * y i < (k i : ℝ) + 1) → y ∈ E) := by
    intro k hk
    obtain ⟨_, x, hx, hxk⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hk
    have hkx : k = fun i => ⌊t * x i⌋₊ := funext fun i => (hxk i).symm
    subst hkx
    exact hcellprop x hx
  have hgap : ∀ k ∈ Kset, ∀ i j : Fin L, i < j → k j < k i := by
    intro k hk i j hij
    have := (hprop k hk).2.1 i j hij
    omega
  
  have hwin : ∀ k ∈ Kset, ∀ q ∈ Fintype.piFinset (fun i => FordReciprocal.primeWindow (k i)),
      (∏ i, q i) ∈ FordReciprocal.tupleIntegers L t E ∧ StrictAnti q ∧ ∀ i, (q i).Prime := by
    intro k hk q hq
    obtain ⟨hkt, _, hcell⟩ := hprop k hk
    have hq' : ∀ i, (q i).Prime ∧ Real.exp (Real.exp (k i : ℝ)) ≤ (q i : ℝ) ∧
        (q i : ℝ) < Real.exp (Real.exp ((k i : ℝ) + 1)) :=
      fun i => (Finset.mem_filter.mp (Fintype.mem_piFinset.mp hq i)).2
    have hsa : StrictAnti q := by
      intro i j hij
      have hlt := hgap k hk i j hij
      have hcast : (k j : ℝ) + 1 ≤ k i := by exact_mod_cast hlt
      have : (q j : ℝ) < q i := (hq' j).2.2.trans_le
        ((Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hcast)).trans (hq' i).2.1)
      exact_mod_cast this
    refine ⟨?_, hsa, fun i => (hq' i).1⟩
    have hbound : ∀ i, q i ≤ ⌊Real.exp (Real.exp t)⌋₊ := fun i =>
      Nat.le_floor ((hq' i).2.2.le.trans
        (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (hkt i))))
    have hpoint : FordReciprocal.tuplePoint t q ∈ E := by
      apply hcell
      intro i
      have hq0 : (0 : ℝ) < q i := by exact_mod_cast (hq' i).1.pos
      have hl1 : Real.exp (k i : ℝ) ≤ Real.log (q i) := by
        have := Real.log_le_log (Real.exp_pos _) (hq' i).2.1
        rwa [Real.log_exp] at this
      have hlpos : 0 < Real.log (q i) := lt_of_lt_of_le (Real.exp_pos _) hl1
      have hl2 : Real.log (q i) < Real.exp ((k i : ℝ) + 1) := by
        have := Real.log_lt_log hq0 (hq' i).2.2
        rwa [Real.log_exp] at this
      have hll1 : (k i : ℝ) ≤ logLog (q i) := by
        have := Real.log_le_log (Real.exp_pos _) hl1
        rwa [Real.log_exp] at this
      have hll2 : logLog (q i) < (k i : ℝ) + 1 := by
        have := Real.log_lt_log hlpos hl2
        rwa [Real.log_exp] at this
      have hmax : max 0 (logLog (q i)) = logLog (q i) :=
        max_eq_right ((Nat.cast_nonneg _).trans hll1)
      have heq : t * FordReciprocal.tuplePoint t q i = logLog (q i) := by
        simp only [FordReciprocal.tuplePoint, hmax]
        field_simp
      rw [heq]
      exact ⟨hll1, hll2⟩
    unfold FordReciprocal.tupleIntegers
    refine Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩, q, rfl,
      fun i => Or.inl (hq' i).1, hsa.antitone, hpoint⟩
    · exact Finset.prod_pos (fun i _ => (hq' i).1.pos)
    · have h := Finset.prod_le_prod (s := Finset.univ) (fun i _ => Nat.zero_le (q i))
        (fun i _ => hbound i)
      simpa only [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] using h
  
  have hwdisj : ∀ (a b p : ℕ), p ∈ FordReciprocal.primeWindow a →
      p ∈ FordReciprocal.primeWindow b → a = b := by
    intro a b p ha hb
    have ha' := (Finset.mem_filter.mp ha).2
    have hb' := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hb).2
    have key : ∀ a b : ℕ, Real.exp (Real.exp (a : ℝ)) ≤ (p : ℝ) →
        (p : ℝ) < Real.exp (Real.exp ((b : ℝ) + 1)) → a ≤ b := by
      intro a b h1 h2
      by_contra hlt
      have hlt' : b + 1 ≤ a := by omega
      have hc : (b : ℝ) + 1 ≤ a := by exact_mod_cast hlt'
      exact lt_irrefl _ (h2.trans_le ((Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hc)).trans h1))
    exact le_antisymm (key a b ha'.2.1 hb'.2.2) (key b a hb'.2.1 ha'.2.2)
  
  have hsum : ∑ k ∈ Kset, ∏ i, ∑ p ∈ FordReciprocal.primeWindow (k i), (1 : ℝ) / p ≤
      ∑ n ∈ FordReciprocal.tupleIntegers L t E, invTotient n := by
    have hinjk : ∀ k ∈ Kset, Set.InjOn (fun q : Fin L → ℕ => ∏ i, q i)
        (Fintype.piFinset (fun i => FordReciprocal.primeWindow (k i)) : Set (Fin L → ℕ)) := by
      intro k hk q hq q' hq' h
      exact hfact L q q' (hwin k hk q hq).2.2 (hwin k hk q' hq').2.2 (hwin k hk q hq).2.1
        (hwin k hk q' hq').2.1 h
    have hdisj : Set.PairwiseDisjoint (Kset : Set (Fin L → ℕ)) (fun k : Fin L → ℕ =>
        (Fintype.piFinset (fun i => FordReciprocal.primeWindow (k i))).image
          (fun q : Fin L → ℕ => ∏ i, q i)) := by
      intro k hk k' hk' hne
      simp only [Function.onFun]
      rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
      intro n hn hn'
      obtain ⟨q, hq, hqn⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hn
      obtain ⟨q', hq', hqn'⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hn'
      have heq : q = q' := hfact L q q' (hwin k hk q hq).2.2 (hwin k' hk' q' hq').2.2
        (hwin k hk q hq).2.1 (hwin k' hk' q' hq').2.1 (hqn.trans hqn'.symm)
      subst heq
      apply hne
      funext i
      exact hwdisj _ _ _ (Fintype.mem_piFinset.mp hq i) (Fintype.mem_piFinset.mp hq' i)
    calc ∑ k ∈ Kset, ∏ i, ∑ p ∈ FordReciprocal.primeWindow (k i), (1 : ℝ) / p
        = ∑ k ∈ Kset, ∑ q ∈ Fintype.piFinset (fun i => FordReciprocal.primeWindow (k i)),
            ∏ i, (1 : ℝ) / (q i : ℝ) := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro k _
          exact Finset.prod_univ_sum (fun i => FordReciprocal.primeWindow (k i))
            (fun _ p => (1 : ℝ) / (p : ℝ))
      _ ≤ ∑ k ∈ Kset, ∑ q ∈ Fintype.piFinset (fun i => FordReciprocal.primeWindow (k i)),
            invTotient (∏ i, q i) := by
          apply Finset.sum_le_sum
          intro k hk
          apply Finset.sum_le_sum
          intro q hq
          have hpr : ∀ i, (q i).Prime := (hwin k hk q hq).2.2
          have hn : 0 < ∏ i, q i := Finset.prod_pos (fun i _ => (hpr i).pos)
          calc ∏ i, (1 : ℝ) / (q i : ℝ) = 1 / ((∏ i, q i : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
                rw [Nat.cast_prod, Finset.prod_div_distrib, Finset.prod_const_one]
            _ ≤ invTotient (∏ i, q i) := by
                unfold invTotient
                rw [← one_div]
                exact one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by exact_mod_cast Nat.totient_pos.mpr hn)
                  (by exact_mod_cast Nat.totient_le _)
      _ = ∑ k ∈ Kset, ∑ n ∈ (Fintype.piFinset (fun i => FordReciprocal.primeWindow (k i))).image
            (fun q : Fin L → ℕ => ∏ i, q i), invTotient n := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro k hk
          exact (Finset.sum_image (hinjk k hk)).symm
      _ = ∑ n ∈ Kset.biUnion (fun k =>
            (Fintype.piFinset (fun i => FordReciprocal.primeWindow (k i))).image
              (fun q : Fin L → ℕ => ∏ i, q i)), invTotient n :=
          (Finset.sum_biUnion hdisj).symm
      _ ≤ _ := by
          apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg
          · intro n hn
            obtain ⟨k, hk, hn'⟩ := Finset.mem_biUnion.mp hn
            obtain ⟨q, hq, hqn⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hn'
            rw [← hqn]
            exact (hwin k hk q hq).1
          · intro n _ _
            unfold invTotient
            positivity
  have hlow : (Kset.card : ℝ) * Real.exp (-C * D) ≤
      ∑ k ∈ Kset, ∏ i, ∑ p ∈ FordReciprocal.primeWindow (k i), (1 : ℝ) / p := by
    rw [← nsmul_eq_mul]
    exact Finset.card_nsmul_le_sum _ _ _ (fun k hk =>
      hprodlow k (StrictAnti.injective (fun i j hij => hgap k hk i j hij)))
  calc Real.exp (-C * D) * t ^ L * MeasureTheory.volume.real (FordReciprocal.cubeErosion E (1 / t))
      = Real.exp (-C * D) *
          (t ^ L * MeasureTheory.volume.real (FordReciprocal.cubeErosion E (1 / t))) := by ring
    _ ≤ Real.exp (-C * D) * (Kset.card : ℝ) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hvol (Real.exp_pos _).le
    _ = (Kset.card : ℝ) * Real.exp (-C * D) := by ring
    _ ≤ _ := hlow.trans hsum

by
  obtain ⟨hρ0, hρ34, hF⟩ := hRHO
  have hρ1 : FordAnalysis.rho < 1 := by linarith
  
  
  have coeff_log_sandwich : ∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → Real.log (k : ℝ) ≤ FordAnalysis.coeff k ∧
      FordAnalysis.coeff k ≤ Real.log ((k : ℝ) + 1) := by
    intro k hk
    have hk1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ k := by exact_mod_cast hk
    have hkpos : (0 : ℝ) < k := by linarith
    have hk0 : (k : ℝ) ≠ 0 := hkpos.ne'
    have hk10 : (k : ℝ) + 1 ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have hceq : FordAnalysis.coeff k =
        ((k : ℝ) + 1) * Real.log ((k : ℝ) + 1) - k * Real.log k - 1 := by
      simp only [FordAnalysis.coeff, fordWeight, if_neg (by omega : k ≠ 0)]
    have hx : Real.log (((k : ℝ) + 1) / k) = Real.log ((k : ℝ) + 1) - Real.log k :=
      Real.log_div hk10 hk0
    have hup : Real.log (((k : ℝ) + 1) / k) ≤ ((k : ℝ) + 1) / k - 1 :=
      Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by positivity)
    have hlo : 1 - (((k : ℝ) + 1) / k)⁻¹ ≤ Real.log (((k : ℝ) + 1) / k) :=
      Real.one_sub_inv_le_log_of_pos (by positivity)
    have e1 : ((k : ℝ) + 1) / k - 1 = 1 / k := by field_simp; ring
    have e2 : 1 - (((k : ℝ) + 1) / k)⁻¹ = 1 / ((k : ℝ) + 1) := by field_simp; ring
    rw [hx, e1] at hup
    rw [hx, e2] at hlo
    have h1 : (k : ℝ) * (Real.log ((k : ℝ) + 1) - Real.log k) ≤ 1 := by

    have hLle : ((FordScale.coreDimension M t : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ 2 * FordAnalysis.C * Real.log t := by
      have h : 2 * FordAnalysis.C * (Real.log t - Real.log (Real.log t)) ≤

        t * FordAnalysis.rho ^ (FordScale.coreDimension M t) := by

    linarith
  
  have hmain : ∀ (L : ℕ) (p : Fin L), p.val + 1 = L → ∀ (ε : ℝ), 0 ≤ ε →

    have hεle : ε ≤ FordAnalysis.rho ^ L := by nlinarith

      linarith

      have he : (1 + -(ε / FordAnalysis.rho ^ L)) = 1 - ε / FordAnalysis.rho ^ L := by ring
      rw [he] at hbern
      linarith
    unfold FordGeometry.T
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hhalf hT0]
  
  intro β hβ
  have hev : ∀ᶠ M : ℕ in atTop, 4 * FordAnalysis.C * β * FordAnalysis.rho ^ M ≤ 1 := by
    have h := (tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one hρ0.le hρ1).const_mul (4 * FordAnalysis.C * β)

  filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop (Real.exp 1)] with t ht
  intro p hp
  have hL1 : 1 ≤ FordScale.coreDimension M t := by omega
  have ht0 : 0 < t := lt_of_lt_of_le (Real.exp_pos 1) ht
  exact hmain _ p hp (β / t) (div_nonneg hβ ht0.le) (hscale β hβ M t ht hL1 hM)

          linarith

        rw [hT]

          nlinarith

            ≤ (FordScale.coreDimension M t : ℝ) * (Real.exp t / t) :=

          _ ≤ (4 * Real.log t) * (Real.exp t / t) :=

          _ = (4 * Real.log t / t) * Real.exp t := by ring
  
  have hLL : Tendsto logLog atTop atTop := Real.tendsto_log_atTop.comp Real.tendsto_log_atTop

          ((((Finset.Iic ⌊c * X + 1⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime).card : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
