    rw [← hpc, ← hpc] at hcardR
    have hhalf : X / (2 * Real.log y) = (1 / 2) * (X / Real.log y) := by
      field_simp
    rw [hhalf]
    linarith
  
  have hsub4 : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 ≤ y → ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n →
      (Finset.Iic ⌊y / (n.totient : ℝ)⌋₊).filter
          (fun p : ℕ => p.Prime ∧ coreLowerFraction y * (y / (n.totient : ℝ)) + 1 < (p : ℝ)) ⊆
        FordLower.lowerPrimeChoices y n := by
    intro y hy n hn p hp
    rw [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Iic] at hp
    obtain ⟨hpX, hpp, hlt⟩ := hp
    have hm1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ n.totient := by exact_mod_cast Nat.totient_pos.mpr hn
    have hm0 : (0 : ℝ) < n.totient := by linarith
    have hX0 : 0 ≤ y / (n.totient : ℝ) := div_nonneg hy hm0.le
    have hpX' : (p : ℝ) ≤ y / n.totient := (Nat.le_floor_iff hX0).mp hpX
    have hXy : y / (n.totient : ℝ) ≤ y := div_le_self hy hm1
    have hcast : ((corePairValue (n.totient, p) : ℕ) : ℝ) = ((p : ℝ) - 1) * n.totient := by
      show (((p - 1) * n.totient : ℕ) : ℝ) = _
      rw [Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_sub hpp.one_lt.le, Nat.cast_one]
    have hmul : y / (n.totient : ℝ) * n.totient = y := div_mul_cancel₀ y hm0.ne'
    have hple : p ≤ ⌊y⌋₊ := Nat.le_floor (hpX'.trans hXy)
    unfold FordLower.lowerPrimeChoices corePairs
    rw [Finset.mem_image]
    refine ⟨(n.totient, p), ?_, rfl⟩
    refine Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_singleton_self _,
      Finset.mem_range.mpr (by show p < ⌊y⌋₊ + 2; omega)⟩, hpp, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hcast]
      have h1 : coreLowerFraction y * (y / n.totient) < (p : ℝ) - 1 := by linarith
      calc coreLowerFraction y * y = coreLowerFraction y * (y / n.totient) * n.totient := by
            rw [mul_assoc, hmul]
        _ < ((p : ℝ) - 1) * n.totient := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right h1 hm0
    · rw [hcast]
      calc ((p : ℝ) - 1) * n.totient ≤ (y / n.totient) * n.totient :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) hm0.le
        _ = y := hmul
  
  have hmemL : ∀ y : ℝ, ∀ n p : ℕ, p ∈ FordLower.lowerPrimeChoices y n →
      p.Prime ∧ coreLowerFraction y * y < ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (n.totient : ℝ) := by
    intro y n p hp
    unfold FordLower.lowerPrimeChoices corePairs at hp
    obtain ⟨⟨b, q⟩, hbq, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hp
    obtain ⟨hprod, hq, hlo, -⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hbq
    have hb : b = n.totient := Finset.mem_singleton.mp (Finset.mem_product.mp hprod).1
    subst hb
    refine ⟨hq, ?_⟩
    have hc : ((corePairValue (n.totient, q) : ℕ) : ℝ) = ((q - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (n.totient : ℝ) := by
      show (((q - 1) * n.totient : ℕ) : ℝ) = _
      rw [Nat.cast_mul]
    rw [hc] at hlo
    exact hlo
  
  have hcard3 : ∀ (y : ℝ) (F : Finset ℕ), 0 < y →
      y ^ (1 / 40 : ℝ) * y ^ (1 / 40 : ℝ) ≤ coreLowerFraction y * y →
      (∀ n ∈ F, 0 < n) → (∀ n ∈ F, (n : ℝ) ≤ y ^ (1 / 40 : ℝ)) →
      (FordLower.primeProducts F y).card = ∑ n ∈ F, (FordLower.lowerPrimeChoices y n).card := by
    intro y F hy hgap hF hs
    have he0 : 0 < y ^ (1 / 40 : ℝ) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hy _
    have hbig : ∀ n ∈ F, ∀ p ∈ FordLower.lowerPrimeChoices y n, ∀ n' ∈ F, n' < p := by
      intro n hn p hp n' hn'
      obtain ⟨hpp, hlo⟩ := hmemL y n p hp
      have hφ : (n.totient : ℝ) ≤ y ^ (1 / 40 : ℝ) :=
        (Nat.cast_le.mpr (Nat.totient_le n)).trans (hs n hn)
      have hp0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
      have h1 : y ^ (1 / 40 : ℝ) * y ^ (1 / 40 : ℝ) < ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * y ^ (1 / 40 : ℝ) :=
        lt_of_le_of_lt hgap (lt_of_lt_of_le hlo (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hφ hp0))
      have h2 : y ^ (1 / 40 : ℝ) < ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := lt_of_mul_lt_mul_right h1 he0.le
      have h3 : (n' : ℝ) < ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := lt_of_le_of_lt (hs n' hn') h2
      have h4 : n' < p - 1 := by exact_mod_cast h3
      omega
    have hinj : Set.InjOn (fun np : (Σ _ : ℕ, ℕ) => np.2 * np.1)
        ↑(F.sigma (FordLower.lowerPrimeChoices y)) := by
      rintro ⟨n, p⟩ ha ⟨m, q⟩ hb heq
      obtain ⟨hn, hp⟩ := Finset.mem_sigma.mp ha
      obtain ⟨hm, hq⟩ := Finset.mem_sigma.mp hb
      have hpP := (hmemL y n p hp).1
      have hqP := (hmemL y m q hq).1
      change p * n = q * m at heq
      have hdvd : p ∣ q * m := ⟨n, by rw [← heq]⟩
      have hpq : p = q := by
        rcases (Nat.Prime.dvd_mul hpP).mp hdvd with h | h
        · exact (Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq hpP hqP).mp h
        · exfalso
          have hle := Nat.le_of_dvd (hF m hm) h
          have hlt := hbig n hn p hp m hm
          omega
      subst hpq
      have hnm := Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left hpP.pos heq
      subst hnm
      rfl
    unfold FordLower.primeProducts
    rw [Finset.card_image_of_injOn hinj, Finset.card_sigma]
  
  have hs1 : ∀ᶠ y : ℝ in atTop, 1 < y ∧ 0 ≤ coreLowerFraction y ∧
      coreLowerFraction y ≤ 1 / 11 ∧ y ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * y ^ (1 / 40 : ℝ) ≤ coreLowerFraction y * y := by
    filter_upwards [hLL.eventually_ge_atTop 121, eventually_gt_atTop (1 : ℝ),
      (tendsto_rpow_atTop (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 9 / 40)).eventually_ge_atTop 4] with y hT hy hy9
    have hy0 : 0 < y := by linarith
    have hu : 0 < Real.log y := Real.log_pos hy
    have hTdef : logLog y = Real.log (Real.log y) := rfl
    have h11 : (11 : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt (logLog y) :=
      (Real.le_sqrt (by norm_num) (by linarith)).mpr (by linarith)
    have hsq0 : 0 < Real.sqrt (logLog y) := by linarith
    have hcdef : coreLowerFraction y = 1 / Real.sqrt (logLog y) := rfl
    have hsqT : Real.sqrt (logLog y) ≤ logLog y := by
      have hs := Real.sq_sqrt (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ logLog y by linarith)
      nlinarith
    have hTu : logLog y ≤ Real.log y := by rw [hTdef]; exact Real.log_le_self hu.le
    have hu4 : Real.log y ≤ y ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ) / (1 / 4) := Real.log_le_rpow_div hy0.le (by norm_num)
    have hsplit : y ^ (19 / 40 : ℝ) = y ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ) * y ^ (9 / 40 : ℝ) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_add hy0]; norm_num
    have hq0 : 0 ≤ y ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ) := (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hy0 _).le
    have h4 : y ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ) / (1 / 4) ≤ y ^ (19 / 40 : ℝ) := by
      rw [hsplit]
      have : y ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ) / (1 / 4) = y ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ) * 4 := by ring
      rw [this]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hy9 hq0
    have hsqy : Real.sqrt (logLog y) ≤ y ^ (19 / 40 : ℝ) := by linarith
    have hexp : y ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * y ^ (1 / 40 : ℝ) * y ^ (19 / 40 : ℝ) = y := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_add hy0, ← Real.rpow_add hy0]; norm_num
    have ha0 : 0 ≤ y ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * y ^ (1 / 40 : ℝ) :=
      mul_nonneg (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hy0 _).le (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hy0 _).le
    refine ⟨hy, by rw [hcdef]; positivity, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hcdef]
      exact one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by norm_num) h11
    · rw [hcdef, one_div_mul_eq_div, le_div_iff₀ hsq0]
      calc y ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * y ^ (1 / 40 : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (logLog y)
          ≤ y ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * y ^ (1 / 40 : ℝ) * y ^ (19 / 40 : ℝ) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsqy ha0
        _ = y := hexp
  
  filter_upwards [hs1, (tendsto_rpow_atTop (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2)).eventually_ge_atTop x₀]
    with y hy hx0
  obtain ⟨hy1, hc0, hc1, hgap⟩ := hy
  intro F hF hs _hlog
  have hy0 : 0 < y := by linarith
  have hgap' : y ^ (1 / 40 : ℝ) * y ^ (1 / 40 : ℝ) ≤ coreLowerFraction y * y := by
    have h1 : y ^ (1 / 40 : ℝ) ≤ y ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hy1.le (by norm_num)
    exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hy0 _).le).trans hgap
  rw [hcard3 y F hy0 hgap' hF hs, Nat.cast_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro n hn
  have hn0 := hF n hn
  have hm1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ n.totient := by exact_mod_cast Nat.totient_pos.mpr hn0
  have hm0 : (0 : ℝ) < n.totient := by linarith
  have hmn : (n.totient : ℝ) ≤ y ^ (1 / 40 : ℝ) :=
    (Nat.cast_le.mpr (Nat.totient_le n)).trans (hs n hn)
  have hX1 : y ≤ (y / (n.totient : ℝ)) * y ^ (1 / 40 : ℝ) := by
    calc y = (y / (n.totient : ℝ)) * n.totient := (div_mul_cancel₀ y hm0.ne').symm
      _ ≤ (y / (n.totient : ℝ)) * y ^ (1 / 40 : ℝ) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmn (div_nonneg hy0.le hm0.le)
  have hX2 : y / (n.totient : ℝ) ≤ y := div_le_self hy0.le hm1
  have h := hwin y (coreLowerFraction y) (y / (n.totient : ℝ)) hy1 hx0 hc0 hc1 hgap hX1 hX2
  have hsub := Finset.card_le_card (hsub4 y hy0.le n hn0)
  have hsubR : ((((Finset.Iic ⌊y / (n.totient : ℝ)⌋₊).filter
      (fun p : ℕ => p.Prime ∧ coreLowerFraction y * (y / (n.totient : ℝ)) + 1 < (p : ℝ))).card : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
      (((FordLower.lowerPrimeChoices y n).card : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hsub
  have heq : y / (2 * Real.log y) * invTotient n = (y / (n.totient : ℝ)) / (2 * Real.log y) := by
    unfold invTotient
    ring
  rw [heq]
  exact h.trans hsubR

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hw : ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → 0 < fordWeight n := by
    intro n hn
    unfold fordWeight
    have ha : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hn
    have hb : (0 : ℝ) < (n : ℝ) + 1 := by linarith
    have h1 : Real.log ((n : ℝ) / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) ≤ (n : ℝ) / ((n : ℝ) + 1) - 1 :=
      Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by positivity)
    rw [Real.log_div (by linarith) (by linarith)] at h1
    have hq : (n : ℝ) / ((n : ℝ) + 1) = 1 - 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) := by
      field_simp
      ring
    have h3 : Real.log 2 ≤ Real.log ((n : ℝ) + 1) := Real.log_le_log (by norm_num) (by linarith)
    have h4 := Real.log_two_gt_d9
    have h5 : 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) ≤ 1 / 2 := by
      rw [div_le_div_iff₀ hb (by norm_num)]
      linarith
    have h6 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ))
    rw [mul_sub, hq] at h6
    have h7 : (n : ℝ) * (1 - 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) - 1) = -1 + 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) := by
      field_simp
      ring
    rw [h7] at h6
    nlinarith
  
  have hg0 : FordAnalysis.g 0 = 1 := by rw [FordAnalysis.g]
  have hg : ∀ n : ℕ, FordAnalysis.g (n + 1) =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), fordWeight (i + 1) * FordAnalysis.g (n - i) := by
    intro n
    rw [FordAnalysis.g]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    simp [FordAnalysis.coeff]
  have hgs : ∀ n : ℕ, FordAnalysis.gStar (n + 1) =
      FordAnalysis.g (n + 1) + (1 - fordWeight 1) * FordAnalysis.g n := by
    intro n
    rw [FordAnalysis.gStar]
    simp [FordAnalysis.coeff]
  have hgs0 : FordAnalysis.gStar 0 = 1 := by rw [FordAnalysis.gStar]
  have hgs1 : FordAnalysis.gStar 1 = 1 := by
    have e1 := hgs 0
    have e2 := hg 0
    simp only [zero_add, Finset.sum_range_one, Nat.sub_zero] at e1 e2
    rw [e1, e2, hg0]
    ring
  
  have hconv : ∀ n : ℕ, ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 2),
      fordWeight (i + 1) * FordAnalysis.gStar (n + 2 - 1 - i) = FordAnalysis.gStar (n + 2) := by
    intro n
    have e1 : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), fordWeight (i + 1) * FordAnalysis.gStar (n + 2 - 1 - i) =
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), fordWeight (i + 1) * FordAnalysis.g (n + 1 - i) +
          (1 - fordWeight 1) * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), fordWeight (i + 1) * FordAnalysis.g (n - i) := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i hi
      have hi' := Finset.mem_range.mp hi
      have h1 : n + 2 - 1 - i = (n - i) + 1 := by omega
      have h2 : n + 1 - i = (n - i) + 1 := by omega
      rw [h1, h2, hgs]
      ring
    have e2 : FordAnalysis.g (n + 2) =
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1 + 1), fordWeight (i + 1) * FordAnalysis.g (n + 1 - i) := hg (n + 1)
    rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, Nat.sub_self, hg0, mul_one] at e2
    have e3 : FordAnalysis.gStar (n + 2) =
        FordAnalysis.g (n + 2) + (1 - fordWeight 1) * FordAnalysis.g (n + 1) := hgs (n + 1)
    have e4 := hg n
    have e5 : n + 2 - 1 - (n + 1) = 0 := by omega
    rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, e1, e5, hgs0, e3, e4, e2]
    ring
  
  have hre : ∀ (L a d : ℕ), L = a + 1 + d →
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range L, (if a < j then fordWeight (j - a) * FordAnalysis.gStar (L - 1 - j) else 0) =
        ∑ k ∈ Finset.range d, fordWeight (k + 1) * FordAnalysis.gStar (d - 1 - k) := by
    intro L a d hL
    subst hL
    rw [Finset.sum_range_add]
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun j hj => by
      have := Finset.mem_range.mp hj
      rw [if_neg (by omega)]), zero_add]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro k _
    rw [if_pos (by omega)]
    have e1 : a + 1 + k - a = k + 1 := by omega
    have e2 : a + 1 + d - 1 - (a + 1 + k) = d - 1 - k := by omega
    rw [e1, e2]
  
  intro L x hx p hp idx
  have hform : ∀ i : Fin L, FordGeometry.tailForm i x =
      ∑ j : Fin L, FordGeometry.tailWeight i j * x j := fun i => rfl
  suffices H : ∀ d : ℕ, ∀ i : Fin L, p.val - i.val = d →
      FordAnalysis.gStar d * x p ≤ x i from H _ idx rfl
  intro d
  induction d using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ d ih =>
    intro i hd
    have hi := i.isLt
    rcases (by omega : d = 0 ∨ d = 1 ∨ 2 ≤ d) with h0 | h1 | h2
    · subst h0
      have hip : i = p := Fin.ext (by omega)
      subst hip
      rw [hgs0, one_mul]
    · subst h1
      have hpen : FordGeometry.tailForm i x = x p := by
        rw [hform, Finset.sum_eq_single p]
        · unfold FordGeometry.tailWeight
          rw [if_pos (by omega), if_neg (by omega), one_mul]
        · intro j _ hj
          unfold FordGeometry.tailWeight
          have hjL := j.isLt
          have hjv : j.val ≠ p.val := fun h => hj (Fin.ext h)
          rw [if_neg (by omega), zero_mul]
        · intro h
          exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ p) h
      rw [hgs1, one_mul, ← hpen]
      exact hx i
    · have hlt : i.val + 2 < L := by omega
      have hsum : FordGeometry.tailForm i x =
          ∑ j : Fin L, (if i.val < j.val then fordWeight (j.val - i.val) * x j else 0) := by
        rw [hform]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro j _
        unfold FordGeometry.tailWeight
        by_cases hij : i.val < j.val
        · rw [if_pos hij, if_pos hij, if_pos hlt]
        · rw [if_neg hij, if_neg hij, zero_mul]
      have hle : ∑ j : Fin L, (if i.val < j.val then
            fordWeight (j.val - i.val) * FordAnalysis.gStar (L - 1 - j.val) else 0) * x p ≤
          ∑ j : Fin L, (if i.val < j.val then fordWeight (j.val - i.val) * x j else 0) := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro j _
        by_cases hij : i.val < j.val
        · rw [if_pos hij, if_pos hij]
          have hj := j.isLt
          have hwp := (hw (j.val - i.val) (by omega)).le
          have hih := ih (p.val - j.val) (by omega) j rfl
          have e : L - 1 - j.val = p.val - j.val := by omega
          rw [e, mul_assoc]
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hih hwp
        · rw [if_neg hij, if_neg hij, zero_mul]
      have hval : ∑ j : Fin L, (if i.val < j.val then
            fordWeight (j.val - i.val) * FordAnalysis.gStar (L - 1 - j.val) else 0) =
          FordAnalysis.gStar d := by
        rw [show (∑ j : Fin L, (if i.val < j.val then
            fordWeight (j.val - i.val) * FordAnalysis.gStar (L - 1 - j.val) else 0)) =
            ∑ j ∈ Finset.range L, (if i.val < j then
              fordWeight (j - i.val) * FordAnalysis.gStar (L - 1 - j) else 0) from
          Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun j => if i.val < j then
              fordWeight (j - i.val) * FordAnalysis.gStar (L - 1 - j) else 0) L]
        rw [hre L i.val d (by omega)]
        obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ : ∃ n, d = n + 2 := ⟨d - 2, by omega⟩
        exact hconv n
      calc FordAnalysis.gStar d * x p
          = (∑ j : Fin L, (if i.val < j.val then
              fordWeight (j.val - i.val) * FordAnalysis.gStar (L - 1 - j.val) else 0)) * x p := by
            rw [hval]
        _ = ∑ j : Fin L, (if i.val < j.val then
              fordWeight (j.val - i.val) * FordAnalysis.gStar (L - 1 - j.val) else 0) * x p :=
            Finset.sum_mul _ _ _
        _ ≤ _ := hle
        _ = FordGeometry.tailForm i x := hsum.symm
        _ ≤ x i := hx i

    have ha0 : (0 : ℝ) < (n : ℝ) := by linarith
    have hb0 : (0 : ℝ) < (n : ℝ) + 1 := by linarith
    have h1 := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (div_pos ha0 hb0)
    rw [Real.log_div ha0.ne' hb0.ne'] at h1
    have h2 := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hb0)
    rw [Real.log_inv] at h2
    have hu : ((n : ℝ) + 1)⁻¹ ≤ 1 / 2 := by
      rw [inv_le_comm₀ hb0 (by norm_num)]
      linarith
    have hau : (n : ℝ) / ((n : ℝ) + 1) = 1 - ((n : ℝ) + 1)⁻¹ := by
      field_simp
      ring
    rw [hau] at h1
    have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 ha0.le
    have hau2 : (n : ℝ) * ((n : ℝ) + 1)⁻¹ = 1 - ((n : ℝ) + 1)⁻¹ := by
      rw [← div_eq_mul_inv, hau]
    unfold fordWeight
    nlinarith
  
  obtain ⟨P, hPdef⟩ : ∃ P : ℕ → ℝ, P = fun k => ∏ j ∈ Finset.range k, ξ j := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hPn : ∀ k, P k = ∏ j ∈ Finset.range k, ξ j := fun k => by rw [hPdef]
  have hPpos : ∀ k, 0 < P k := fun k => by
    rw [hPn]; exact Finset.prod_pos (fun j _ => (hξ j).1)
  have hPsucc : ∀ k, P (k + 1) = P k * ξ k := fun k => by
    rw [hPn, hPn]; exact Finset.prod_range_succ _ _
  have hP0 : P 0 = 1 := by rw [hPn]; simp
  have hP1 : P 1 = ξ 0 := by rw [hPsucc, hP0, one_mul]
  have hPanti : Antitone P := by
    apply antitone_nat_of_succ_le
    intro k
    rw [hPsucc]
    exact mul_le_of_le_one_right (hPpos k).le (hξ k).2
  have hPle1 : ∀ k, P k ≤ 1 := fun k => by
    simpa [hP0] using hPanti (Nat.zero_le k)
  
  have hprod : ∀ n : ℕ, (∏ i ∈ Finset.range n, P (i + 1)) =
      ∏ j ∈ Finset.range n, ξ j ^ (n - j) := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => simp
    | succ n ih =>
      rw [Finset.prod_range_succ, ih, Finset.prod_range_succ (fun j => ξ j ^ (n + 1 - j))]
      have hinner : (∏ j ∈ Finset.range n, ξ j ^ (n + 1 - j)) =
          (∏ j ∈ Finset.range n, ξ j ^ (n - j)) * P n := by
        rw [hPn n, ← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
        apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
        intro j hj
        have hjn := Finset.mem_range.mp hj
        rw [show n + 1 - j = (n - j) + 1 by omega, pow_succ]
      rw [hinner, hPsucc n]
      simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel_left, pow_one]
      ring
  have hH : 0 ≤ ∏ j ∈ Finset.range L, ξ j ^ (L - j) :=
    Finset.prod_nonneg (fun j _ => pow_nonneg (hξ j).1.le _)
  
  obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ : ∃ D : (Fin L → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] (Fin L → ℝ),
      D = Matrix.toLin' (Matrix.diagonal (fun i : Fin L => P (i.val + 1))) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hDapply : ∀ (y : Fin L → ℝ) (i : Fin L), D y i = P (i.val + 1) * y i := by
    intro y i
    rw [hD, Matrix.toLin'_apply, Matrix.mulVec_diagonal]
  have hdet : LinearMap.det D = ∏ j ∈ Finset.range L, ξ j ^ (L - j) := by
    rw [hD, LinearMap.det_toLin', Matrix.det_diagonal]
    exact (Fin.prod_univ_eq_prod_range (fun k => P (k + 1)) L).trans (hprod L)
  have hvol : ∀ E : Set (Fin L → ℝ), MeasureTheory.volume.real (D '' E) =
      (∏ j ∈ Finset.range L, ξ j ^ (L - j)) * MeasureTheory.volume.real E := by
    intro E
    rw [MeasureTheory.measureReal_def, MeasureTheory.measureReal_def,
      MeasureTheory.Measure.addHaar_image_linearMap, hdet, abs_of_nonneg hH,
      ENNReal.toReal_mul, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hH]
  
  have htw : ∀ idx j : Fin L, 0 ≤ FordGeometry.tailWeight idx j := by
    intro idx j
    unfold FordGeometry.tailWeight
    split_ifs with h1 h2
    · exact hw _ (by omega)
    · norm_num
    · exact le_rfl
  have htw0 : ∀ idx j : Fin L, ¬ idx.val < j.val → FordGeometry.tailWeight idx j = 0 := by
    intro idx j h
    unfold FordGeometry.tailWeight
    rw [if_neg h]
  
  have hPL : (∏ j ∈ Finset.range L, ξ j) = P L := (hPn L).symm
  rw [hPL]
  have hsub : D '' (FordGeometry.polytope L (fun _ => 1) ∩ {y | α / P L ≤ y p}) ⊆
      FordInner.innerSeed ξ p α := by
    rintro x ⟨y, ⟨hyP, hyα⟩, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨h0, h1, hanti, hout, htail⟩ := hyP
    have hyα' : α / P L ≤ y p := hyα
    refine ⟨⟨⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩, ?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · intro i
      rw [hDapply]
      exact mul_nonneg (hPpos _).le (h0 i)
    · intro i
      rw [hDapply]
      exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h1 i) (hPpos _).le).trans
        (by rw [mul_one]; exact hPle1 _)
    · intro i k hik
      simp only [hDapply]
      exact mul_le_mul (hPanti (Nat.add_le_add_right hik 1)) (hanti hik) (h0 k) (hPpos _).le
    · have hout' : (∑ i : Fin L, fordWeight (i.val + 1) * y i) ≤ 1 := hout
      show (∑ i : Fin L, fordWeight (i.val + 1) * D y i) ≤ ξ 0
      calc
        (∑ i : Fin L, fordWeight (i.val + 1) * D y i)
            ≤ ∑ i : Fin L, ξ 0 * (fordWeight (i.val + 1) * y i) := by
          apply Finset.sum_le_sum
          intro i _
          have hi : P (i.val + 1) ≤ ξ 0 := by
            rw [← hP1]; exact hPanti (by omega)
          have hwi := hw (i.val + 1) (by omega)
          have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hi (mul_nonneg hwi (h0 i))
          rw [hDapply]
          calc
            fordWeight (i.val + 1) * (P (i.val + 1) * y i)
                = P (i.val + 1) * (fordWeight (i.val + 1) * y i) := by ring
            _ ≤ _ := hm
        _ = ξ 0 * ∑ i : Fin L, fordWeight (i.val + 1) * y i := (Finset.mul_sum _ _ _).symm
        _ ≤ ξ 0 * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hout' (hξ 0).1.le
        _ = ξ 0 := mul_one _
    · intro idx hi
      have ht : (∑ j : Fin L, FordGeometry.tailWeight idx j * y j) ≤ 1 * y idx :=
        htail idx hi
      show (∑ j : Fin L, FordGeometry.tailWeight idx j * D y j) ≤ ξ (idx.val + 1) * D y idx
      calc
        (∑ j : Fin L, FordGeometry.tailWeight idx j * D y j)
            ≤ ∑ j : Fin L, P (idx.val + 1 + 1) * (FordGeometry.tailWeight idx j * y j) := by
          apply Finset.sum_le_sum
          intro j _
          by_cases hij : idx.val < j.val
          · have hle : P (j.val + 1) ≤ P (idx.val + 1 + 1) := hPanti (by omega)
            have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hle (mul_nonneg (htw idx j) (h0 j))
            rw [hDapply]
            calc
              FordGeometry.tailWeight idx j * (P (j.val + 1) * y j)
                  = P (j.val + 1) * (FordGeometry.tailWeight idx j * y j) := by ring
              _ ≤ _ := hm
          · rw [htw0 idx j hij]
            simp
        _ = P (idx.val + 1 + 1) * ∑ j : Fin L, FordGeometry.tailWeight idx j * y j :=
          (Finset.mul_sum _ _ _).symm
        _ ≤ P (idx.val + 1 + 1) * (1 * y idx) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ht (hPpos _).le
        _ = ξ (idx.val + 1) * D y idx := by
          rw [hDapply, hPsucc (idx.val + 1)]
          ring
    · intro idx j hij
      rw [hDapply, hDapply, hij, hPsucc (idx.val + 1)]
      have hyj : y j ≤ y idx := hanti (show idx ≤ j by rw [Fin.le_def]; omega)
      have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hyj
        (mul_nonneg (hPpos (idx.val + 1)).le (hξ (idx.val + 1)).1.le)
      calc
        P (idx.val + 1) * ξ (idx.val + 1) * y j
            ≤ P (idx.val + 1) * ξ (idx.val + 1) * y idx := hm
        _ = ξ (idx.val + 1) * (P (idx.val + 1) * y idx) := by ring
    · show α ≤ D y p
      rw [hDapply, hp]
      have h := (div_le_iff₀ (hPpos L)).mp hyα'
      linarith [mul_comm (y p) (P L)]
    · intro idx h0idx
      rw [hDapply, h0idx, zero_add, hP1]
      exact mul_le_of_le_one_right (hξ 0).1.le (h1 idx)
  have hfin : MeasureTheory.volume (FordInner.innerSeed ξ p α) ≠ ⊤ :=
    MeasureTheory.measure_ne_top_of_subset
      (fun x hx => ⟨fun i => hx.1.1.1 i, fun i => hx.1.1.2.1 i⟩ :
        FordInner.innerSeed ξ p α ⊆ Set.Icc (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) (fun _ => 1))
      isCompact_Icc.measure_lt_top.ne
  rw [← hvol]
  exact MeasureTheory.measureReal_mono hsub hfin

(hρ : 0 < FordAnalysis.rho ∧ FordAnalysis.rho < 1) {M : ℕ} (hM : 2 ≤ M) (L : ℕ) :
    (∀ j : ℕ, 0 < FordInner.tightParameter L M j ∧ FordInner.tightParameter L M j ≤ 1) ∧
      Real.exp (-1) ≤ ∏ j ∈ Finset.range L, FordInner.tightParameter L M j ^ (L - j)

signature.name: tightParameter_bounds_H_lower
signature.statement:
(hρ : 0 < FordAnalysis.rho ∧ FordAnalysis.rho < 1) {M : ℕ} (hM : 2 ≤ M) (L : ℕ) :
    (∀ j : ℕ, 0 < FordInner.tightParameter L M j ∧ FordInner.tightParameter L M j ≤ 1) ∧
      Real.exp (-1) ≤ ∏ j ∈ Finset.range L, FordInner.tightParameter L M j ^ (L - j)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  obtain ⟨hρ0, hρ1⟩ := hρ
  
  have hr : ‖FordAnalysis.rho‖ < 1 := by
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hρ0]; exact hρ1
  have hsum : Summable (fun d : ℕ => (d : ℝ) * FordInner.innerRadius d * FordAnalysis.rho ^ d) := by
    have h1 := summable_pow_mul_geometric_of_norm_lt_one 1 hr
    have h2 := summable_pow_mul_geometric_of_norm_lt_one 2 hr
    have h3 := summable_pow_mul_geometric_of_norm_lt_one 3 hr
    apply (h3.add ((h2.mul_left 2).add (h1.mul_left 5))).congr
    intro d
    simp only [FordInner.innerRadius]
    ring
  have hRpos : ∀ d : ℕ, 0 < FordInner.innerRadius d := fun d => by
    unfold FordInner.innerRadius; positivity
  have hunn : ∀ d : ℕ, 0 ≤ (d : ℝ) * FordInner.innerRadius d * FordAnalysis.rho ^ d :=
    fun d => mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg d) (hRpos d).le) (pow_nonneg hρ0.le d)
  have hS : 0 ≤ FordInner.radiusMass := tsum_nonneg hunn
  have hεpos : 0 < FordInner.innerEpsilon := by
    unfold FordInner.innerEpsilon; positivity
  have hεS : FordInner.innerEpsilon * FordInner.radiusMass ≤ 1 / 8 := by
    have hden : 0 < 8 * (FordInner.radiusMass + 1) := by positivity
    have heq : FordInner.innerEpsilon * (8 * (FordInner.radiusMass + 1)) = 1 := by
      unfold FordInner.innerEpsilon
      exact div_mul_cancel₀ _ hden.ne'
    nlinarith
  have hextra : ∀ I : Finset ℕ, (∑ d ∈ I, (d : ℝ) * FordInner.extraLoss d) ≤ 1 / 8 := by
    intro I
    have h := hsum.sum_le_tsum I (fun d _ => hunn d)
    calc (∑ d ∈ I, (d : ℝ) * FordInner.extraLoss d)
        = FordInner.innerEpsilon *
            (∑ d ∈ I, (d : ℝ) * FordInner.innerRadius d * FordAnalysis.rho ^ d) := by
          rw [Finset.mul_sum]
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro d _
          unfold FordInner.extraLoss
          ring
      _ ≤ FordInner.innerEpsilon * FordInner.radiusMass := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h hεpos.le
      _ ≤ 1 / 8 := hεS
  
  have hbase_aux : ∀ N : ℕ, (∑ d ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, (d : ℝ) * FordInner.baseLoss M d) ≤
      1 / 20 - 1 / (10 * ((N : ℝ) + 2)) := by
    intro N
    induction N with
    | zero => norm_num
    | succ N ih =>
      rw [Finset.sum_Icc_succ_top (by omega : 1 ≤ N + 1)]
      have hMr : (2 : ℝ) ≤ (M : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hM
      have hx : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg N
      have hstep : ((N + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * FordInner.baseLoss M (N + 1) ≤
          1 / (10 * ((N : ℝ) + 2)) - 1 / (10 * (((N + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 2)) := by
        unfold FordInner.baseLoss
        push_cast
        have hn : (N : ℝ) + 3 ≤ (M : ℝ) + ((N : ℝ) + 1) := by linarith
        have hn3 : ((N : ℝ) + 3) ^ 3 ≤ ((M : ℝ) + ((N : ℝ) + 1)) ^ 3 :=
          pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) hn 3
        have hpoly : ((N : ℝ) + 1) * ((N : ℝ) + 2) * ((N : ℝ) + 3) ≤ ((N : ℝ) + 3) ^ 3 := by
          nlinarith
        have heq : 1 / (10 * ((N : ℝ) + 2)) - 1 / (10 * ((N : ℝ) + 1 + 2)) =
            1 / (10 * ((N : ℝ) + 2) * ((N : ℝ) + 3)) := by
          field_simp
          ring
        rw [heq, mul_one_div, div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by positivity)]
        nlinarith
      have hcast : ((N + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) = (N : ℝ) + 1 := by push_cast; ring
      rw [hcast] at hstep ⊢
      linarith
  have hbase : ∀ N : ℕ, (∑ d ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, (d : ℝ) * FordInner.baseLoss M d) ≤ 1 / 4 := by
    intro N
    have h := hbase_aux N
    have hpos : 0 ≤ 1 / (10 * ((N : ℝ) + 2)) := by positivity
    linarith
  
  have hrev : ∀ f : ℕ → ℝ, (∑ j ∈ Finset.range L, f (L - j)) = ∑ d ∈ Finset.Icc 1 L, f d := by
    intro f
    refine Finset.sum_bij (fun j _ => L - j) ?_ ?_ ?_ (fun _ _ => rfl)
    · intro j hj
      have := Finset.mem_range.mp hj
      simp only [Finset.mem_Icc]
      omega
    · intro j hj k hk heq
      have := Finset.mem_range.mp hj
      have := Finset.mem_range.mp hk
      simp only at heq
      omega
    · intro d hd
      obtain ⟨hd1, hdL⟩ := Finset.mem_Icc.mp hd
      refine ⟨L - d, Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega), ?_⟩
      simp only
      omega
  
  have hb_nn : ∀ d : ℕ, 0 ≤ FordInner.baseLoss M d := fun d => by
    unfold FordInner.baseLoss; positivity
  have he_nn : ∀ d : ℕ, 0 ≤ FordInner.extraLoss d := fun d =>
    mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hεpos.le (hRpos d).le) (pow_nonneg hρ0.le d)
  have hloss_nn : ∀ j, 0 ≤ FordInner.lossSeq L M j := by
    intro j
    unfold FordInner.lossSeq
    split_ifs
    · exact add_nonneg (hb_nn _) (he_nn _)
    · exact le_rfl
  
  have hW : (∑ j ∈ Finset.range L, ((L - j : ℕ) : ℝ) * FordInner.lossSeq L M j) ≤ 3 / 8 := by
    calc (∑ j ∈ Finset.range L, ((L - j : ℕ) : ℝ) * FordInner.lossSeq L M j)
        = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range L, (((L - j : ℕ) : ℝ) * FordInner.baseLoss M (L - j) +
            ((L - j : ℕ) : ℝ) * FordInner.extraLoss (L - j)) := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro j hj
          simp only [FordInner.lossSeq, if_pos (Finset.mem_range.mp hj)]
          ring
      _ = ∑ d ∈ Finset.Icc 1 L, ((d : ℝ) * FordInner.baseLoss M d +
            (d : ℝ) * FordInner.extraLoss d) :=
          hrev (fun d => (d : ℝ) * FordInner.baseLoss M d + (d : ℝ) * FordInner.extraLoss d)
      _ = (∑ d ∈ Finset.Icc 1 L, (d : ℝ) * FordInner.baseLoss M d) +
            ∑ d ∈ Finset.Icc 1 L, (d : ℝ) * FordInner.extraLoss d := Finset.sum_add_distrib
      _ ≤ 1 / 4 + 1 / 8 := add_le_add (hbase L) (hextra _)
      _ = 3 / 8 := by norm_num
  have hloss_le : ∀ j, FordInner.lossSeq L M j ≤ 3 / 8 := by
    intro j
    by_cases hj : j < L
    · have hd : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ((L - j : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (show 1 ≤ L - j by omega)
      have hterm := Finset.single_le_sum (s := Finset.range L)
        (f := fun k => ((L - k : ℕ) : ℝ) * FordInner.lossSeq L M k)
        (fun k _ => mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (hloss_nn k)) (Finset.mem_range.mpr hj)
      exact (le_mul_of_one_le_left (hloss_nn j) hd).trans (hterm.trans hW)
    · simp only [FordInner.lossSeq, if_neg hj]
      norm_num
  have hi : ∀ j : ℕ, 0 < FordInner.tightParameter L M j ∧ FordInner.tightParameter L M j ≤ 1 := by
    intro j
    have h1 := hloss_nn j
    have h2 := hloss_le j
    unfold FordInner.tightParameter
    constructor <;> linarith
  
  have hs3 : ∀ a : ℝ, 0 ≤ a → a ≤ 1 / 2 → Real.exp (-2 * a) ≤ 1 - a := by
    intro a ha0 ha
    have h1 := Real.add_one_le_exp (2 * a)
    have h2 : Real.exp (-2 * a) * Real.exp (2 * a) = 1 := by
      rw [← Real.exp_add]; simp
    have h3 := Real.exp_pos (-2 * a)
    have h4 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 h3.le
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg ha0 (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 - 2 * a), (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) < 1 + 2 * a)]
  have hexp : (∏ j ∈ Finset.range L, Real.exp (-2 * FordInner.lossSeq L M j) ^ (L - j)) =
      Real.exp (-2 * (∑ j ∈ Finset.range L, ((L - j : ℕ) : ℝ) * FordInner.lossSeq L M j)) := by
    simp_rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul]
    rw [← Real.exp_sum]
    congr 1
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j _
    ring
  refine ⟨hi, ?_⟩
  calc Real.exp (-1)
      ≤ Real.exp (-2 * (∑ j ∈ Finset.range L, ((L - j : ℕ) : ℝ) * FordInner.lossSeq L M j)) :=
        Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
    _ = ∏ j ∈ Finset.range L, Real.exp (-2 * FordInner.lossSeq L M j) ^ (L - j) := hexp.symm
    _ ≤ ∏ j ∈ Finset.range L, FordInner.tightParameter L M j ^ (L - j) :=
        Finset.prod_le_prod (fun j _ => pow_nonneg (Real.exp_nonneg _) _)
          (fun j _ => pow_le_pow_left₀ (Real.exp_nonneg _)
            (hs3 _ (hloss_nn j) (by linarith [hloss_le j])) _)

informal_problem.statement:
(hρ : 0 < FordAnalysis.rho ∧ FordAnalysis.rho < 1)
    (hgs : ∀ n : ℕ, (1 / 4 : ℝ) ≤ FordAnalysis.gStar n * FordAnalysis.rho ^ n)
    (hgrow : ∀ (L : ℕ) (x : Fin L → ℝ), (∀ idx : Fin L, FordGeometry.tailForm idx x ≤ x idx) →
      ∀ p : Fin L, p.val + 1 = L → ∀ idx : Fin L,
        FordAnalysis.gStar (p.val - idx.val) * x p ≤ x idx)

    (p : Fin L) (hp : p.val + 1 = L) {τ A B : ℝ} (hτ : 0 ≤ τ)
    (hB : 8 ≤ B) (hεB : 8 ≤ FordInner.innerEpsilon * B) (hAB : A + 1 ≤ B)
    (houter : τ * FordInner.innerRadius L ≤ FordInner.extraLoss L) :
    FordInner.innerSeed (FordInner.tightParameter L M) p (B * τ) ⊆
      FordReciprocal.cubeErosion (FordInner.innerSeed (FordInner.targetParameter L M) p (A * τ)) τ

(hρ : 0 < FordAnalysis.rho ∧ FordAnalysis.rho < 1)
    (hgs : ∀ n : ℕ, (1 / 4 : ℝ) ≤ FordAnalysis.gStar n * FordAnalysis.rho ^ n)
    (hgrow : ∀ (L : ℕ) (x : Fin L → ℝ), (∀ idx : Fin L, FordGeometry.tailForm idx x ≤ x idx) →
      ∀ p : Fin L, p.val + 1 = L → ∀ idx : Fin L,

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hfw : ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → 0 ≤ fordWeight n ∧ fordWeight n ≤ (n : ℝ) := by
    intro n hn
    have ha : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hn
    have ha0 : (0 : ℝ) < (n : ℝ) := by linarith
    have ha1 : (0 : ℝ) < (n : ℝ) + 1 := by linarith
    have hn0 : (n : ℝ) ≠ 0 := ha0.ne'
    have hn1 : (n : ℝ) + 1 ≠ 0 := ha1.ne'
    have hq : (0 : ℝ) < ((n : ℝ) + 1) / (n : ℝ) := div_pos ha1 ha0
    have hu : Real.log (((n : ℝ) + 1) / (n : ℝ)) = Real.log ((n : ℝ) + 1) - Real.log (n : ℝ) :=
      Real.log_div hn1 hn0
    have h1 := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos hq
    have h2 := Real.one_sub_inv_le_log_of_pos hq

      MeasurableSet {x : Fin m → ℝ | (∀ i, 0 ≤ x i) ∧ ∑ i, x i ≤ u} := by
    intro m u
    have heq : {x : Fin m → ℝ | (∀ i, 0 ≤ x i) ∧ ∑ i, x i ≤ u} =
        (⋂ i, {x : Fin m → ℝ | 0 ≤ x i}) ∩ {x | ∑ i, x i ≤ u} := by
      ext x
      simp
    rw [heq]
    exact ((isClosed_iInter fun i => isClosed_le continuous_const (continuous_apply i)).inter
      (isClosed_le (continuous_finset_sum _ fun i _ => continuous_apply i)
        continuous_const)).measurableSet
  have hΔ : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t →
      MeasureTheory.volume {x : Fin n → ℝ | (∀ i, 0 ≤ x i) ∧ ∑ i, x i ≤ t} =
        ENNReal.ofReal (t ^ n / (n.factorial : ℝ)) := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro t ht
      simp [ht, MeasureTheory.volume_pi]
    | succ n ih =>
      intro t ht
      let e : (ℝ × (Fin n → ℝ)) ≃ᵐ (Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) :=
        (MeasurableEquiv.piFinSuccAbove (fun _ => ℝ) 0).symm
      have he : MeasureTheory.MeasurePreserving e :=
        (MeasureTheory.volume_preserving_piFinSuccAbove (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => ℝ) 0).symm _
      have he_apply : ∀ (s : ℝ) (x : Fin n → ℝ), e (s, x) = Fin.cons s x := by
        intro s x
        simp [e, MeasurableEquiv.piFinSuccAbove_symm_apply, Fin.insertNthEquiv,
          Fin.insertNth_zero']
      have hcons : ∀ (s : ℝ) (x : Fin n → ℝ),
          (Fin.cons s x : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) ∈
              {x : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ | (∀ i, 0 ≤ x i) ∧ ∑ i, x i ≤ t} ↔
            0 ≤ s ∧ x ∈ {x : Fin n → ℝ | (∀ i, 0 ≤ x i) ∧ ∑ i, x i ≤ t - s} := by
        intro s x
        simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Fin.forall_fin_succ, Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_succ,
          Fin.sum_univ_succ]
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨⟨hs, hx⟩, hsum⟩
          exact ⟨hs, hx, by linarith⟩
        · rintro ⟨hs, hx, hsum⟩
          exact ⟨⟨hs, hx⟩, by linarith⟩
      have hm : MeasurableSet (e ⁻¹' {x : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ | (∀ i, 0 ≤ x i) ∧ ∑ i, x i ≤ t}) :=
        e.measurable (hmeasΔ _ _)
      have hslice : ∀ s : ℝ, MeasureTheory.volume
          (Prod.mk s ⁻¹' (e ⁻¹' {x : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ | (∀ i, 0 ≤ x i) ∧ ∑ i, x i ≤ t})) =
            (Set.Icc 0 t).indicator
              (fun s : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal ((t - s) ^ n / n.factorial)) s := by
        intro s
        by_cases hs : s ∈ Set.Icc 0 t
        · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hs]
          have hset : Prod.mk s ⁻¹' (e ⁻¹' {x : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ | (∀ i, 0 ≤ x i) ∧ ∑ i, x i ≤ t}) =
              {x : Fin n → ℝ | (∀ i, 0 ≤ x i) ∧ ∑ i, x i ≤ t - s} := by
            ext x
            simp only [Set.mem_preimage, he_apply, hcons, hs.1, true_and]
          rw [hset, ih (t - s) (sub_nonneg.mpr hs.2)]
        · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hs]
          have hset : Prod.mk s ⁻¹' (e ⁻¹' {x : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ | (∀ i, 0 ≤ x i) ∧ ∑ i, x i ≤ t}) =
              ∅ := by
            apply Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
            intro x hx
            have hx' := (hcons s x).mp (by simpa only [Set.mem_preimage, he_apply] using hx)
            apply hs
            refine ⟨hx'.1, ?_⟩
            have hsum := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun idx (_ : idx ∈ Finset.univ) => hx'.2.1 idx)
            have hbound := hx'.2.2
            linarith
          rw [hset, MeasureTheory.measure_empty]
      have hc : Continuous (fun s : ℝ => (t - s) ^ n / (n.factorial : ℝ)) := by fun_prop
      have hi : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun s : ℝ => (t - s) ^ n / (n.factorial : ℝ))
          (Set.Icc 0 t) := hc.integrableOn_Icc
      have hn : 0 ≤ᵐ[MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.Icc 0 t)]
          (fun s : ℝ => (t - s) ^ n / (n.factorial : ℝ)) := by
        filter_upwards [MeasureTheory.ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Icc] with s hs
        exact div_nonneg (pow_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hs.2) _) (by positivity)
      have hint : (∫ s in Set.Icc 0 t, (t - s) ^ n / (n.factorial : ℝ)) =
          t ^ (n + 1) / ((n + 1).factorial : ℝ) := by
        rw [MeasureTheory.integral_Icc_eq_integral_Ioc, ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le ht,
          intervalIntegral.integral_div,
          intervalIntegral.integral_comp_sub_left (fun x : ℝ => x ^ n) t]
        simp only [sub_self, sub_zero, integral_pow, zero_pow (by omega : n + 1 ≠ 0),
          sub_zero, Nat.factorial_succ, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
        rw [div_div]
      calc
        MeasureTheory.volume {x : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ | (∀ i, 0 ≤ x i) ∧ ∑ i, x i ≤ t} =
            MeasureTheory.volume (e ⁻¹' {x : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ | (∀ i, 0 ≤ x i) ∧ ∑ i, x i ≤ t}) :=
          (he.measure_preimage (hmeasΔ _ _).nullMeasurableSet).symm
        _ = ∫⁻ s : ℝ, MeasureTheory.volume
            (Prod.mk s ⁻¹' (e ⁻¹' {x : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ | (∀ i, 0 ≤ x i) ∧ ∑ i, x i ≤ t})) := by
          rw [MeasureTheory.Measure.volume_eq_prod, MeasureTheory.Measure.prod_apply hm]
        _ = ∫⁻ s in Set.Icc 0 t, ENNReal.ofReal ((t - s) ^ n / n.factorial) := by
          simp_rw [hslice]
          exact MeasureTheory.lintegral_indicator measurableSet_Icc _
        _ = ENNReal.ofReal (∫ s in Set.Icc 0 t, (t - s) ^ n / (n.factorial : ℝ)) :=
          (MeasureTheory.ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hi hn).symm
        _ = _ := by rw [hint]
  have hW : ∀ (n : ℕ) (b : Fin n → ℝ), (∀ i, 0 < b i) → ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t →
      MeasureTheory.volume {x : Fin n → ℝ | (∀ i, 0 ≤ x i) ∧ ∑ i, b i * x i ≤ t} =
        ENNReal.ofReal (t ^ n / ((n.factorial : ℝ) * ∏ i, b i)) := by
    intro n b hb t ht
    have hp : 0 < ∏ i, b i := Finset.prod_pos (fun i _ => hb i)
    have hR : ∀ x i, Matrix.toLin' (Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (b i)⁻¹)) x i = (b i)⁻¹ * x i := by
      intro x i
      simp [Matrix.toLin'_apply, Matrix.mulVec_diagonal]
    have hdet : LinearMap.det (Matrix.toLin' (Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (b i)⁻¹))) =
        (∏ i, b i)⁻¹ := by
      rw [LinearMap.det_toLin', Matrix.det_diagonal, Finset.prod_inv_distrib]
    have himg : Matrix.toLin' (Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (b i)⁻¹)) ''
        {x : Fin n → ℝ | (∀ i, 0 ≤ x i) ∧ ∑ i, x i ≤ t} =
          {x | (∀ i, 0 ≤ x i) ∧ ∑ i, b i * x i ≤ t} := by
      ext y
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
        refine ⟨fun i => ?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [hR]
          exact mul_nonneg (inv_pos.mpr (hb i)).le (hx.1 i)
        · simpa only [hR, ← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ (hb _).ne', one_mul] using hx.2
      · intro hy
        refine ⟨fun i => b i * y i, ⟨fun i => mul_nonneg (hb i).le (hy.1 i), hy.2⟩, ?_⟩
        ext i
        rw [hR]
        field_simp [(hb i).ne']
    rw [← himg, MeasureTheory.Measure.addHaar_image_linearMap, hdet, hΔ n t ht,
      ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (abs_nonneg _), abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hp)]
    congr 1
    rw [inv_mul_eq_div, div_div]
  
  obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ : ∃ A : Matrix (Fin K) (Fin K) ℝ,
      A = fun i j => (if i = j then 1 else 0) - FordGeometry.tailWeight i j := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hAapply : ∀ (z : Fin K → ℝ) (i : Fin K),
      Matrix.toLin' A z i = z i - ∑ j, FordGeometry.tailWeight i j * z j := by
    intro z i
    rw [Matrix.toLin'_apply, hA]
    simp [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, sub_mul, ite_mul, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  have hdetA : LinearMap.det (Matrix.toLin' A) = 1 := by
    rw [LinearMap.det_toLin', Matrix.det_of_upperTriangular]
    · apply Finset.prod_eq_one
      intro i _
      rw [hA]
      simp [htw0 i i le_rfl]
    · intro i j hij
      simp only [id] at hij
      rw [hA]
      have hji : j.val ≤ i.val := le_of_lt hij
      simp [htw0 i j hji, ne_of_gt hij]
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ : ∃ c : Fin K → ℝ,
      c = fun i => τ * (1 + ∑ j, FordGeometry.tailWeight i j) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hvolΦ : ∀ s : Set (Fin K → ℝ),
      MeasureTheory.volume ((fun z => Matrix.toLin' A z + c) '' s) = MeasureTheory.volume s := by
    intro s
    have h1 : (fun z => Matrix.toLin' A z + c) '' s =
        (fun y => y + c) '' (Matrix.toLin' A '' s) := by
      rw [Set.image_image]
    rw [h1, Set.image_add_right, MeasureTheory.measure_preimage_add_right,
      MeasureTheory.Measure.addHaar_image_linearMap, hdetA, abs_one, ENNReal.ofReal_one, one_mul]
  
  have hkey : ∀ z : Fin K → ℝ,
      ∑ i, w i * (z i - ∑ j, FordGeometry.tailWeight i j * z j) =
        ∑ j, fordWeight (j.val + 1) * z j := by
    intro z
    have h1 : ∀ j : Fin K, fordWeight (j.val + 1) * z j =
        w j * z j - ∑ i, w i * FordGeometry.tailWeight i j * z j := by
      intro j
      rw [← hcol j, sub_mul, Finset.sum_mul]
    simp_rw [h1, mul_sub, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    congr 1
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    simp only [mul_assoc]
  have hT : ∑ i, w i * (1 + ∑ j, FordGeometry.tailWeight i j) =
      2 * ∑ i, w i - ∑ j : Fin K, fordWeight (j.val + 1) := by
    have h1 := hkey (fun _ => 1)
    simp only [mul_one] at h1
    have h2 : ∑ i, w i * (1 + ∑ j, FordGeometry.tailWeight i j) +
        ∑ i, w i * (1 - ∑ j, FordGeometry.tailWeight i j) = 2 * ∑ i, w i := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      ring
    linarith
  have hincl : (fun z => Matrix.toLin' A z + c) ''
      (FordGeometry.polytope K (fun _ => 1) + Set.Icc (fun _ : Fin K => -τ) (fun _ => τ)) ⊆
        {y | (∀ i, 0 ≤ y i) ∧ ∑ i, w i * y i ≤ 1 + 2 * τ * ∑ i, w i} := by
    rintro y ⟨z, ⟨x, hx, e, he, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    have hei : ∀ i, -τ ≤ e i ∧ e i ≤ τ := fun i => ⟨he.1 i, he.2 i⟩
    have hbnd : ∀ a : Fin K → ℝ, (∀ j, 0 ≤ a j) →
        ∑ j, a j * e j ≤ (∑ j, a j) * τ ∧ -((∑ j, a j) * τ) ≤ ∑ j, a j * e j := by
      intro a ha
      rw [Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
      exact ⟨Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hei j).2 (ha j),
        Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => by nlinarith [(hei j).1, ha j]⟩
    have htfx : ∀ i : Fin K, ∑ j, FordGeometry.tailWeight i j * x j ≤ x i := by
      intro i
      by_cases hi : i.val + 1 < K
      · have h := hx.2.2.2.2 i hi
        have h' : FordGeometry.tailForm i x = ∑ j, FordGeometry.tailWeight i j * x j := rfl
        rw [h'] at h
        linarith
      · rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun j _ => by
          rw [htw0 i j (by have := j.isLt; omega), zero_mul])]
        exact hx.1 i
    have hΦ : ∀ i, (Matrix.toLin' A (x + e) + c) i =
        (x i - ∑ j, FordGeometry.tailWeight i j * x j) +
          (e i - ∑ j, FordGeometry.tailWeight i j * e j) +
            τ * (1 + ∑ j, FordGeometry.tailWeight i j) := by
      intro i
      rw [Pi.add_apply, hAapply, hc]
      simp only [Pi.add_apply, mul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      ring
    refine ⟨fun i => ?_, ?_⟩
    · show 0 ≤ (Matrix.toLin' A (x + e) + c) i
      rw [hΦ]
      have h1 := htfx i
      have h2 := (hbnd _ (htwnn i)).1
      have h3 := (hei i).1
      nlinarith
    · show ∑ i, w i * (Matrix.toLin' A (x + e) + c) i ≤ 1 + 2 * τ * ∑ i, w i
      have e1 : ∑ i, w i * (Matrix.toLin' A (x + e) + c) i =
          ∑ i, (w i * (x i - ∑ j, FordGeometry.tailWeight i j * x j) +
            w i * (e i - ∑ j, FordGeometry.tailWeight i j * e j) +
              τ * (w i * (1 + ∑ j, FordGeometry.tailWeight i j))) :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => by rw [hΦ]; ring)
      rw [e1, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, hkey x, hkey e, hT]
      have ho : FordGeometry.outerForm K x = ∑ j, fordWeight (j.val + 1) * x j := rfl
      have hox := hx.2.2.2.1
      rw [ho] at hox
      have hoe := (hbnd (fun j => fordWeight (j.val + 1)) (fun j => hfw _ (by omega))).1
      simp only at hox hoe
      linarith
  
  have hS0 : 0 ≤ ∑ i, w i := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => (hwpos i).le)
  have hwρ : ∀ j : Fin K, w j * FordAnalysis.rho ^ (j.val + 1) ≤ 1 := by
    intro j
    rw [hw]
    dsimp only
    split_ifs with hj
    · linarith [(hgb (j.val + 1)).2.2.1 (by omega)]
    · have hlast : j.val + 1 = K := by have := j.isLt; omega
      rw [hlast]
      linarith [(hgb K).2.2.2.2.1 hK]
  have hSρ : (∑ i, w i) * FordAnalysis.rho ^ K ≤ 4 := by
    have hgeom : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range K, FordAnalysis.rho ^ i ≤ 4 := by
      have h := geom_sum_mul FordAnalysis.rho K
      have hpos : 0 ≤ FordAnalysis.rho ^ K := by positivity
      have hsnn : 0 ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range K, FordAnalysis.rho ^ i :=
        Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => by positivity)
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg hsnn (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 3 / 4 - FordAnalysis.rho)]
    calc (∑ i, w i) * FordAnalysis.rho ^ K =
          ∑ j : Fin K, (w j * FordAnalysis.rho ^ (j.val + 1)) * FordAnalysis.rho ^ (K - 1 - j.val) := by
          rw [Finset.sum_mul]
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro j _
          rw [mul_assoc, ← pow_add, show j.val + 1 + (K - 1 - j.val) = K by have := j.isLt; omega]
      _ ≤ ∑ j : Fin K, FordAnalysis.rho ^ (K - 1 - j.val) := by
          apply Finset.sum_le_sum
          intro j _
          have h := hwρ j
          have hp : 0 ≤ FordAnalysis.rho ^ (K - 1 - j.val) := by positivity
          nlinarith
      _ = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range K, FordAnalysis.rho ^ (K - 1 - j) :=
          Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun j => FordAnalysis.rho ^ (K - 1 - j)) K
      _ = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range K, FordAnalysis.rho ^ j :=
          Finset.sum_range_reflect (fun j => FordAnalysis.rho ^ j) K
      _ ≤ 4 := hgeom
  have hpow : (1 + 2 * τ * ∑ i, w i) ^ K ≤ Real.exp 80 := by
    have hKpos : (0 : ℝ) < K := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < K by omega)
    have hτK := (le_div_iff₀ hKpos).mp (hsmall hK)
    have hprod' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hτK hS0
    have hexp : (K : ℝ) * (2 * τ * ∑ i, w i) ≤ 80 := by nlinarith
    calc (1 + 2 * τ * ∑ i, w i) ^ K ≤ (Real.exp (2 * τ * ∑ i, w i)) ^ K :=
          pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity)
            (by linarith [Real.add_one_le_exp (2 * τ * ∑ i, w i)]) K
      _ = Real.exp ((K : ℝ) * (2 * τ * ∑ i, w i)) := by rw [Real.exp_nat_mul]
      _ ≤ Real.exp 80 := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hexp
  
  have hs : 0 ≤ 1 + 2 * τ * ∑ i, w i := by positivity
  have hWv := hW K w hwpos _ hs
  have hle := ((hvolΦ (FordGeometry.polytope K (fun _ => 1) +
      Set.Icc (fun _ : Fin K => -τ) (fun _ => τ))).symm.le).trans
    ((MeasureTheory.measure_mono hincl).trans hWv.le)
  have hden : 0 < (K.factorial : ℝ) * ∏ i, w i :=
    mul_pos (by positivity) (Finset.prod_pos (fun i _ => hwpos i))
  have hreal := ENNReal.toReal_le_of_le_ofReal (div_nonneg (pow_nonneg hs _) hden.le) hle
  rw [hprod] at hreal
  have hmVeq : (1 + 2 * τ * ∑ i, w i) ^ K /
      ((K.factorial : ℝ) * FordAnalysis.renewalDenominator K) =
        (1 + 2 * τ * ∑ i, w i) ^ K * FordGeometry.modelVolume K := by
    rw [FordGeometry.modelVolume, mul_one_div]
  rw [hmVeq] at hreal
  rw [MeasureTheory.measureReal_def]
  calc _ ≤ (1 + 2 * τ * ∑ i, w i) ^ K * FordGeometry.modelVolume K := hreal
    _ ≤ Real.exp 80 * FordGeometry.modelVolume K :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hpow hmVpos.le
    _ ≤ (3 + Real.exp 80) * FordGeometry.modelVolume K :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) hmVpos.le

informal_problem.statement:
(hRHO : 0 < FordAnalysis.rho ∧ FordAnalysis.rho < 3 / 4 ∧ FordAnalysis.F FordAnalysis.rho = 1)
    (M : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (ht : Real.exp 1 ≤ t) (K : ℕ) (hK : 1 ≤ K)
    (hKL : K ≤ FordScale.coreDimension M t) :
    1 / t ≤ 10 * FordAnalysis.rho ^ K / (K : ℝ)

signature.statement:
(hRHO : 0 < FordAnalysis.rho ∧ FordAnalysis.rho < 3 / 4 ∧ FordAnalysis.F FordAnalysis.rho = 1)
    (M : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (ht : Real.exp 1 ≤ t) (K : ℕ) (hK : 1 ≤ K)
    (hKL : K ≤ FordScale.coreDimension M t) :
    1 / t ≤ 10 * FordAnalysis.rho ^ K / (K : ℝ)

proof.tactics:
by
  have hρ0 : 0 < FordAnalysis.rho := hRHO.1
  have ht0 : 0 < t := lt_of_lt_of_le (Real.exp_pos 1) ht
  have hlogt : 1 ≤ Real.log t := by
    have := Real.log_le_log (Real.exp_pos 1) ht
    rwa [Real.log_exp] at this
  have hℓ0 : 0 < Real.log t := by linarith
  have hll0 : 0 ≤ Real.log (Real.log t) := Real.log_nonneg hlogt
  have hllle : Real.log (Real.log t) ≤ Real.log t - 1 := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos hℓ0
  have hlog34 : Real.log (3 / 4) < -1 / 4 := by
    rw [Real.log_lt_iff_lt_exp (by norm_num)]
    have := Real.add_one_lt_exp (x := (-1 / 4 : ℝ)) (by norm_num)
    linarith
  have hlρ : Real.log FordAnalysis.rho < Real.log (3 / 4) := Real.log_lt_log hρ0 hRHO.2.1
  have ha4 : 1 / 4 < -Real.log FordAnalysis.rho := by linarith
  have habs : |Real.log FordAnalysis.rho| = -Real.log FordAnalysis.rho := abs_of_neg (by linarith)
  have hCdef : FordAnalysis.C = (2 * |Real.log FordAnalysis.rho|)⁻¹ := rfl
  have hapos : 0 < 2 * -Real.log FordAnalysis.rho := by linarith
  have hane : -Real.log FordAnalysis.rho ≠ 0 := by linarith
  have hCa : 2 * FordAnalysis.C * -Real.log FordAnalysis.rho = 1 := by
    rw [hCdef, habs, mul_inv, ← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ two_ne_zero, one_mul,
      inv_mul_cancel₀ hane]
  have hCpos : 0 < FordAnalysis.C := by rw [hCdef, habs]; exact inv_pos.mpr hapos
  have hKr : (1 : ℝ) ≤ K := by exact_mod_cast hK
  have hK0 : (0 : ℝ) < K := by linarith
  have hKopt : (K : ℝ) ≤ (FordScale.optimalDimension t : ℝ) := by
    have : K ≤ FordScale.optimalDimension t := hKL.trans (Nat.sub_le _ _)
    exact_mod_cast this
  have hx : 0 ≤ 2 * FordAnalysis.C * (Real.log t - Real.log (Real.log t)) := by
    have : 0 ≤ Real.log t - Real.log (Real.log t) := by linarith
    positivity
  have hfl : (FordScale.optimalDimension t : ℝ) ≤
      2 * FordAnalysis.C * (Real.log t - Real.log (Real.log t)) := by
    unfold FordScale.optimalDimension
    exact Nat.floor_le hx
  have hKa : (K : ℝ) * -Real.log FordAnalysis.rho ≤ Real.log t - Real.log (Real.log t) := by
    have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hKopt.trans hfl)
      (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ -Real.log FordAnalysis.rho)
    calc (K : ℝ) * -Real.log FordAnalysis.rho
        ≤ 2 * FordAnalysis.C * (Real.log t - Real.log (Real.log t)) *
            -Real.log FordAnalysis.rho := h1
      _ = (2 * FordAnalysis.C * -Real.log FordAnalysis.rho) *
            (Real.log t - Real.log (Real.log t)) := by ring
      _ = Real.log t - Real.log (Real.log t) := by rw [hCa, one_mul]
  have hpow : FordAnalysis.rho ^ K = Real.exp ((K : ℝ) * Real.log FordAnalysis.rho) := by
    rw [Real.exp_nat_mul, Real.exp_log hρ0]
  have hexp : Real.log t / t ≤ FordAnalysis.rho ^ K := by
    rw [hpow]
    have heq : Real.log t / t = Real.exp (Real.log (Real.log t) - Real.log t) := by
      rw [Real.exp_sub, Real.exp_log hℓ0, Real.exp_log ht0]
    rw [heq]
    apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
    linarith

    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ : ∃ b : ℕ → ℝ, ∀ k, b k = β k * ρ ^ k := ⟨_, fun k => rfl⟩

informal_problem.statement:
(∀ (n : ℕ) (b : Fin n → ℝ) (t : ℝ), (∀ j, 0 < b j) → 0 ≤ t →
      MeasureTheory.volume {x : Fin n → ℝ | (∀ j, 0 ≤ x j) ∧ ∑ j, b j * x j ≤ t} ≠ ⊤ ∧
      MeasureTheory.volume.real {x : Fin n → ℝ | (∀ j, 0 ≤ x j) ∧ ∑ j, b j * x j ≤ t} =
        t ^ n / ((n.factorial : ℝ) * ∏ j, b j)) ∧
    (∀ (n : ℕ) (b c : Fin n → ℝ) (d t : ℝ) (p : Fin n), (∀ j, 0 < b j) → (∀ j, 0 ≤ c j) →
      c p = 0 → 0 < d → 0 ≤ t →

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hmeas : ∀ (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ),
      MeasurableSet {x : Fin n → ℝ | (∀ j, 0 ≤ x j) ∧ ∑ j, x j ≤ t} := by
    intro n t
    apply IsClosed.measurableSet
    have hEq : {x : Fin n → ℝ | (∀ j, 0 ≤ x j) ∧ ∑ j, x j ≤ t} =
        (⋂ j, {x : Fin n → ℝ | 0 ≤ x j}) ∩ {x | ∑ j, x j ≤ t} := by
      ext x; simp
    rw [hEq]
    exact (isClosed_iInter fun j => isClosed_le continuous_const (continuous_apply j)).inter
      (isClosed_le (continuous_finset_sum _ fun j _ => continuous_apply j) continuous_const)
  have hcons : ∀ (n : ℕ) (t s : ℝ) (x : Fin n → ℝ),
      (Fin.cons s x : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) ∈
          {x : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ | (∀ j, 0 ≤ x j) ∧ ∑ j, x j ≤ t} ↔
        0 ≤ s ∧ x ∈ {x : Fin n → ℝ | (∀ j, 0 ≤ x j) ∧ ∑ j, x j ≤ t - s} := by
    intro n t s x
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Fin.forall_fin_succ, Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_succ,
      Fin.sum_univ_succ]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨⟨hs, hx⟩, hsum⟩
      exact ⟨hs, hx, by linarith⟩
    · rintro ⟨hs, hx, hsum⟩
      exact ⟨⟨hs, hx⟩, by linarith⟩
  have hU : ∀ (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ), 0 ≤ t →
      MeasureTheory.volume {x : Fin n → ℝ | (∀ j, 0 ≤ x j) ∧ ∑ j, x j ≤ t} =
        ENNReal.ofReal (t ^ n / (n.factorial : ℝ)) := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro t ht
      simp [ht, MeasureTheory.volume_pi]
    | succ n ih =>
      intro t ht
      let e : (ℝ × (Fin n → ℝ)) ≃ᵐ (Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) :=
        (MeasurableEquiv.piFinSuccAbove (fun _ => ℝ) 0).symm
      have he : MeasurePreserving e :=
        (volume_preserving_piFinSuccAbove (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => ℝ) 0).symm _
      have he_apply (s : ℝ) (x : Fin n → ℝ) : e (s, x) = Fin.cons s x := by
        simp [e, MeasurableEquiv.piFinSuccAbove_symm_apply, Fin.insertNthEquiv,
          Fin.insertNth_zero']
      have hm : MeasurableSet (e ⁻¹' {x : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ | (∀ j, 0 ≤ x j) ∧ ∑ j, x j ≤ t}) :=
        e.measurable (hmeas _ _)
      have hslice (s : ℝ) :
          volume (Prod.mk s ⁻¹' (e ⁻¹' {x : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ | (∀ j, 0 ≤ x j) ∧ ∑ j, x j ≤ t})) =
            (Set.Icc 0 t).indicator
              (fun s : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal ((t - s) ^ n / n.factorial)) s := by
        by_cases hs : s ∈ Set.Icc 0 t
        · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hs]
          have hset : Prod.mk s ⁻¹' (e ⁻¹' {x : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ | (∀ j, 0 ≤ x j) ∧ ∑ j, x j ≤ t}) =
              {x : Fin n → ℝ | (∀ j, 0 ≤ x j) ∧ ∑ j, x j ≤ t - s} := by
            ext x
            rw [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_preimage, he_apply, hcons]
            simp only [hs.1, true_and]
          rw [hset, ih (t - s) (sub_nonneg.mpr hs.2)]
        · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hs]
          have hset : Prod.mk s ⁻¹' (e ⁻¹' {x : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ | (∀ j, 0 ≤ x j) ∧ ∑ j, x j ≤ t}) =
              ∅ := by
            apply Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
            intro x hx
            rw [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_preimage, he_apply, hcons] at hx
            apply hs
            refine ⟨hx.1, ?_⟩
            have hsum := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun idx (_ : idx ∈ Finset.univ) => hx.2.1 idx)
            have hbound := hx.2.2
            linarith
          rw [hset, measure_empty]
      have hc : Continuous (fun s : ℝ => (t - s) ^ n / (n.factorial : ℝ)) := by fun_prop
      have hi : IntegrableOn (fun s : ℝ => (t - s) ^ n / (n.factorial : ℝ)) (Set.Icc 0 t) :=
        hc.integrableOn_Icc
      have hn : 0 ≤ᵐ[volume.restrict (Set.Icc 0 t)]
          (fun s : ℝ => (t - s) ^ n / (n.factorial : ℝ)) := by
        filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Icc] with s hs
        exact div_nonneg (pow_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hs.2) _) (by positivity)
      have hint : (∫ s in Set.Icc 0 t, (t - s) ^ n / (n.factorial : ℝ)) =
          t ^ (n + 1) / ((n + 1).factorial : ℝ) := by
        rw [integral_Icc_eq_integral_Ioc, ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le ht,
          intervalIntegral.integral_div,
          intervalIntegral.integral_comp_sub_left (fun x : ℝ => x ^ n) t]
        simp only [sub_self, sub_zero, integral_pow, zero_pow (by omega : n + 1 ≠ 0),
          sub_zero, Nat.factorial_succ, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
        rw [div_div]
      calc
        volume {x : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ | (∀ j, 0 ≤ x j) ∧ ∑ j, x j ≤ t}
            = volume (e ⁻¹' {x : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ | (∀ j, 0 ≤ x j) ∧ ∑ j, x j ≤ t}) :=
          (he.measure_preimage (hmeas _ _).nullMeasurableSet).symm
        _ = ∫⁻ s : ℝ, volume (Prod.mk s ⁻¹'
              (e ⁻¹' {x : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ | (∀ j, 0 ≤ x j) ∧ ∑ j, x j ≤ t})) := by
          rw [Measure.volume_eq_prod, Measure.prod_apply hm]
        _ = ∫⁻ s in Set.Icc 0 t, ENNReal.ofReal ((t - s) ^ n / n.factorial) := by
          simp_rw [hslice]
          exact lintegral_indicator measurableSet_Icc _
        _ = ENNReal.ofReal (∫ s in Set.Icc 0 t, (t - s) ^ n / (n.factorial : ℝ)) :=
          (ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hi hn).symm
        _ = _ := by rw [hint]
  
  have hP1 : ∀ (n : ℕ) (b : Fin n → ℝ) (t : ℝ), (∀ j, 0 < b j) → 0 ≤ t →
      MeasureTheory.volume {x : Fin n → ℝ | (∀ j, 0 ≤ x j) ∧ ∑ j, b j * x j ≤ t} =
        ENNReal.ofReal |(∏ j, b j)⁻¹| * ENNReal.ofReal (t ^ n / (n.factorial : ℝ)) := by
    intro n b t hb ht
    have hset : {x : Fin n → ℝ | (∀ j, 0 ≤ x j) ∧ ∑ j, b j * x j ≤ t} =
        (Matrix.toLin' (Matrix.diagonal b)) ⁻¹'
          {x : Fin n → ℝ | (∀ j, 0 ≤ x j) ∧ ∑ j, x j ≤ t} := by
      ext x
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_preimage, Matrix.toLin'_apply, Matrix.mulVec_diagonal]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
        exact ⟨fun j => mul_nonneg (hb j).le (h1 j), h2⟩
      · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
        exact ⟨fun j => (mul_nonneg_iff_of_pos_left (hb j)).mp (h1 j), h2⟩
    have hdet : LinearMap.det (Matrix.toLin' (Matrix.diagonal b)) = ∏ j, b j := by
      rw [LinearMap.det_toLin', Matrix.det_diagonal]
    have hP : 0 < ∏ j, b j := Finset.prod_pos (fun j _ => hb j)
    rw [hset, MeasureTheory.Measure.addHaar_preimage_linearMap _ (by rw [hdet]; exact hP.ne'),
      hdet, hU n t ht]
  have part1 : ∀ (n : ℕ) (b : Fin n → ℝ) (t : ℝ), (∀ j, 0 < b j) → 0 ≤ t →
      MeasureTheory.volume {x : Fin n → ℝ | (∀ j, 0 ≤ x j) ∧ ∑ j, b j * x j ≤ t} ≠ ⊤ ∧
      MeasureTheory.volume.real {x : Fin n → ℝ | (∀ j, 0 ≤ x j) ∧ ∑ j, b j * x j ≤ t} =
        t ^ n / ((n.factorial : ℝ) * ∏ j, b j) := by
    intro n b t hb ht
    have hP : 0 < ∏ j, b j := Finset.prod_pos (fun j _ => hb j)
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hP1 n b t hb ht]
      exact ENNReal.mul_ne_top ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top
    · rw [MeasureTheory.measureReal_def, hP1 n b t hb ht, ENNReal.toReal_mul,
        ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (abs_nonneg _),
        ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (div_nonneg (pow_nonneg ht n) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)),
        abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hP)]
      have hf : (0 : ℝ) < (n.factorial : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_pos n
      field_simp
  refine ⟨part1, ?_⟩
  
  intro n b c d t p hb hc hcp hd ht
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ : ∃ r : Fin n → ℝ, r = fun j => (if p = j then d else 0) - c j := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Φ, hΦ⟩ : ∃ Φ : (Fin n → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] (Fin n → ℝ),
      Φ = Matrix.toLin' ((1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).updateRow p r) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hΦp : ∀ x, Φ x p = d * x p - ∑ j, c j * x j := by
    intro x
    subst hΦ hr
    simp [Matrix.toLin'_apply, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, sub_mul, ite_mul,
      Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  have hΦne : ∀ x j, j ≠ p → Φ x j = x j := by
    intro x j hj
    subst hΦ
    simp [Matrix.toLin'_apply, Matrix.updateRow_mulVec, hj]
  have hdet : LinearMap.det Φ = d := by
    subst hΦ
    rw [LinearMap.det_toLin', ← Matrix.cramer_transpose_apply, Matrix.transpose_one,
      Matrix.cramer_one]
    subst hr
    simp [hcp]
  have hw : ∀ j, 0 < FordOrder.cutWeight b c d p j := by
    intro j
    unfold FordOrder.cutWeight
    split_ifs
    · exact div_pos (hb p) hd
    · exact add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg (hb j) (mul_nonneg (div_pos (hb p) hd).le (hc j))
  have hid : ∀ x, ∑ j, FordOrder.cutWeight b c d p j * Φ x j = ∑ j, b j * x j := by
    intro x
    have hcut : (∑ j, FordOrder.cutWeight b c d p j * Φ x j) =
        (∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase p, (b j + (b p / d) * c j) * x j) +
          (b p / d) * (d * x p - ∑ j, c j * x j) := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_erase_add _ _ (Finset.mem_univ p)]
      congr 1
      · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro j hj
        have hne := (Finset.mem_erase.mp hj).1
        rw [FordOrder.cutWeight, if_neg hne, hΦne _ _ hne]
      · rw [FordOrder.cutWeight, if_pos rfl, hΦp]
    have hcs : (∑ j, c j * x j) = ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase p, c j * x j := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_erase_add _ _ (Finset.mem_univ p), hcp, zero_mul, add_zero]
    have hbs : (∑ j, b j * x j) = (∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase p, b j * x j) + b p * x p :=
      (Finset.sum_erase_add _ _ (Finset.mem_univ p)).symm
    rw [hcut, hcs, hbs]
    simp only [add_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib, mul_assoc, ← Finset.mul_sum]
    rw [mul_sub, ← mul_assoc, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hd.ne']
    ring
  have hset : {x : Fin n → ℝ | ((∀ j, 0 ≤ x j) ∧ ∑ j, b j * x j ≤ t) ∧
      ∑ j, c j * x j ≤ d * x p} =
      Φ ⁻¹' {y : Fin n → ℝ | (∀ j, 0 ≤ y j) ∧ ∑ j, FordOrder.cutWeight b c d p j * y j ≤ t} := by
    ext x
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_preimage]
    rw [hid x]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, h3⟩
      refine ⟨fun j => ?_, h2⟩
      by_cases hj : j = p
      · subst hj
        rw [hΦp]
        linarith
      · rw [hΦne _ _ hj]
        exact h1 j
    · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
      have hn : ∀ j, j ≠ p → 0 ≤ x j := by
        intro j hj
        have h := h1 j
        rwa [hΦne _ _ hj] at h
      have hcp' : 0 ≤ ∑ j, c j * x j := by
        apply Finset.sum_nonneg
        intro j _
        by_cases hj : j = p
        · subst hj
          simp only [hcp, zero_mul, le_refl]
        · exact mul_nonneg (hc j) (hn j hj)
      have hp : ∑ j, c j * x j ≤ d * x p := by
        have h := h1 p
        rw [hΦp] at h
        linarith
      refine ⟨⟨fun j => ?_, h2⟩, hp⟩
      by_cases hj : j = p
      · subst hj
        exact nonneg_of_mul_nonneg_right (hcp'.trans hp) hd
      · exact hn j hj
  rw [hset, MeasureTheory.measureReal_def,
    MeasureTheory.Measure.addHaar_preimage_linearMap _ (by rw [hdet]; exact hd.ne'), hdet,
    ENNReal.toReal_mul, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (abs_nonneg _), ← MeasureTheory.measureReal_def,
    (part1 n _ t hw ht).2, abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hd)]
  have hf : (0 : ℝ) < (n.factorial : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_pos n
  have hW : 0 < ∏ j, FordOrder.cutWeight b c d p j := Finset.prod_pos (fun j _ => hw j)
  field_simp

informal_problem.statement:
(L : ℕ) :
    (2 ≤ L → ∀ x : Fin L → ℝ,
      ∑ j, FordOrder.weight L j * FordOrder.slack x j = FordGeometry.outerForm L x) ∧
    (∀ (x : Fin L → ℝ) (i : Fin L),
      ∑ j, FordOrder.invWeight L i j * FordOrder.slack x j = x i) ∧
    (∀ A : Set (Fin L → ℝ),
      MeasureTheory.volume ((fun x : Fin L → ℝ => FordOrder.slack x) ⁻¹' A) = MeasureTheory.volume A) ∧
    (∀ (hL : 2 ≤ L) (x : Fin L → ℝ),
      ∑ j, FordOrder.topCoeff L j * FordOrder.slack x j =
        FordGeometry.outerForm L x - x ⟨0, lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) hL⟩ +
          (1 - FordAnalysis.coeff 1) * FordOrder.slack x ⟨0, lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) hL⟩) ∧
    (∀ (p : Fin L), 1 ≤ p.val → p.val + 1 < L → ∀ x : Fin L → ℝ,
      ∑ j, FordOrder.adjCoeff L p j * FordOrder.slack x j =
        x ⟨p.val - 1, lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.sub_le _ _) p.isLt⟩ - x p +
          (1 - FordAnalysis.coeff 1) * FordOrder.slack x p)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hg0 : FordAnalysis.g 0 = 1 := by simp [FordAnalysis.g]
  have hgS0 : FordAnalysis.gStar 0 = 1 := by simp [FordAnalysis.gStar]
  have hgsucc : ∀ m, FordAnalysis.g (m + 1) = ∑ idx ∈ Finset.range (m + 1),
      FordAnalysis.coeff (idx + 1) * FordAnalysis.g (m - idx) := by
    intro m; rw [FordAnalysis.g]
  have hg1 : FordAnalysis.g 1 = FordAnalysis.coeff 1 := by
    rw [hgsucc 0]; simp [hg0]
  have hcw : ∀ n : ℕ, n ≠ 0 → FordAnalysis.coeff n = fordWeight n := by
    intro n hn; simp [FordAnalysis.coeff, hn]
  have R1 : ∀ m : ℕ, FordAnalysis.g (m + 1) =
      ∑ d ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), FordAnalysis.g d * FordAnalysis.coeff (m + 1 - d) := by
    intro m
    rw [hgsucc m, ← Finset.sum_range_reflect]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro d hd
    have hd' := Finset.mem_range.mp hd
    rw [mul_comm]
    congr 2 <;> omega
  have R2 : ∀ m : ℕ, FordAnalysis.gStar (m + 1) =
      ∑ d ∈ Finset.range m, FordAnalysis.g d * FordAnalysis.coeff (m + 1 - d) + FordAnalysis.g m := by
    intro m
    rw [FordAnalysis.gStar, R1 m, Finset.sum_range_succ, show m + 1 - m = 1 by omega]
    ring
  
  have K : ∀ n k : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → n ≤ k + 1 → k < L →
      (if k + 1 < L then FordAnalysis.g n else FordAnalysis.gStar n) =
        ∑ d ∈ Finset.range n, FordAnalysis.g d *
          (if k + 2 - n + d < L then FordAnalysis.coeff (n - d) else 1) := by
    intro n k hn hnk hk
    obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, n = m + 1 := ⟨n - 1, by omega⟩
    split_ifs with hkL
    · rw [R1 m]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro d hd
      have hd' := Finset.mem_range.mp hd
      rw [if_pos (by omega)]
    · rw [R2 m, Finset.sum_range_succ, if_neg (by omega), mul_one]
      congr 1
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro d hd
      have hd' := Finset.mem_range.mp hd
      rw [if_pos (by omega)]
  
  have swap : ∀ (a x : Fin L → ℝ), ∑ j, a j * FordOrder.slack x j =
      ∑ k, (a k - ∑ j, a j * FordGeometry.tailWeight j k) * x k := by
    intro a x
    simp only [FordOrder.slack, FordGeometry.tailForm, weightedForm, LinearMap.coe_mk,
      AddHom.coe_mk, mul_sub, sub_mul, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
    congr 1
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => by ring
  
  have s1 : 2 ≤ L → ∀ x : Fin L → ℝ,
      ∑ j, FordOrder.weight L j * FordOrder.slack x j = FordGeometry.outerForm L x := by
    intro hL x
    rw [swap]
    simp only [FordGeometry.outerForm, weightedForm, LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro k _
    congr 1
    have hk := k.isLt
    set F : ℕ → ℝ := fun m => if m < k.val then FordAnalysis.g (m + 1) *
      (if m + 2 < L then fordWeight (k.val - m) else 1) else 0 with hF
    have hterm : ∀ j : Fin L, FordOrder.weight L j * FordGeometry.tailWeight j k = F j.val := by
      intro j
      have hj := j.isLt
      simp only [hF, FordOrder.weight, FordGeometry.tailWeight]
      by_cases hjk : j.val < k.val
      · rw [if_pos hjk, if_pos hjk, if_pos (by omega)]
      · rw [if_neg hjk, if_neg hjk, mul_zero]
    have hconv : ∑ j : Fin L, FordOrder.weight L j * FordGeometry.tailWeight j k =
        ∑ m ∈ Finset.range k.val, FordAnalysis.g (m + 1) *
          (if m + 2 < L then fordWeight (k.val - m) else 1) := by
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => hterm j), Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range F L]
      rw [← Finset.sum_subset (s₁ := Finset.range k.val)]
      · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro m hm
        simp only [hF]
        rw [if_pos (Finset.mem_range.mp hm)]
      · intro m hm
        simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hm ⊢
        omega
      · intro m _ hm
        simp only [hF]
        rw [if_neg]
        intro h
        exact hm (Finset.mem_range.mpr h)
    rw [hconv]
    have hW : FordOrder.weight L k =
        (if k.val + 1 < L then FordAnalysis.g (k.val + 1) else FordAnalysis.gStar (k.val + 1)) := rfl
    rw [hW, K (k.val + 1) k.val (by omega) le_rfl hk, Finset.sum_range_succ', hg0,
      if_pos (by omega : k.val + 2 - (k.val + 1) + 0 < L), Nat.sub_zero, hcw _ (by omega), one_mul]
    have hsum : ∑ m ∈ Finset.range k.val, FordAnalysis.g (m + 1) *
        (if k.val + 2 - (k.val + 1) + (m + 1) < L then FordAnalysis.coeff (k.val + 1 - (m + 1)) else 1) =
        ∑ m ∈ Finset.range k.val, FordAnalysis.g (m + 1) *
          (if m + 2 < L then fordWeight (k.val - m) else 1) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro m hm
      have hm' := Finset.mem_range.mp hm
      rw [show k.val + 2 - (k.val + 1) + (m + 1) = m + 2 by omega,
        show k.val + 1 - (m + 1) = k.val - m by omega, hcw _ (by omega)]
    rw [hsum]
    ring
  
  have s2 : ∀ (x : Fin L → ℝ) (i : Fin L),
      ∑ j, FordOrder.invWeight L i j * FordOrder.slack x j = x i := by
    intro x i
    rw [swap]
    have hcoef : ∀ k : Fin L, FordOrder.invWeight L i k -
        ∑ j, FordOrder.invWeight L i j * FordGeometry.tailWeight j k = if k = i then 1 else 0 := by
      intro k
      have hk := k.isLt
      by_cases hik : i.val < k.val
      · set G : ℕ → ℝ := fun m => if i.val ≤ m ∧ m < k.val then FordAnalysis.g (m - i.val) *
          (if m + 2 < L then fordWeight (k.val - m) else 1) else 0 with hG
        have hterm : ∀ j : Fin L,
            FordOrder.invWeight L i j * FordGeometry.tailWeight j k = G j.val := by
          intro j
          have hj := j.isLt
          simp only [hG, FordOrder.invWeight, FordGeometry.tailWeight]
          by_cases hij : i.val ≤ j.val
          · by_cases hjk : j.val < k.val
            · rw [if_pos (show i.val ≤ j.val ∧ j.val < k.val from ⟨hij, hjk⟩), if_pos hij,
                if_pos hjk, if_pos (show j.val + 1 < L by omega)]
            · rw [if_neg (show ¬ (i.val ≤ j.val ∧ j.val < k.val) from fun h => hjk h.2),
                if_neg hjk, mul_zero]
          · rw [if_neg (show ¬ (i.val ≤ j.val ∧ j.val < k.val) from fun h => hij h.1),
              if_neg hij, zero_mul]
        have hconv : ∑ j : Fin L, FordOrder.invWeight L i j * FordGeometry.tailWeight j k =
            ∑ d ∈ Finset.range (k.val - i.val), FordAnalysis.g d *
              (if i.val + d + 2 < L then fordWeight (k.val - i.val - d) else 1) := by
          rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => hterm j), Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range G L]
          rw [← Finset.sum_subset (s₁ := Finset.Ico i.val k.val)]
          · rw [Finset.sum_Ico_eq_sum_range]
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro d hd
            have hd' := Finset.mem_range.mp hd
            simp only [hG]
            rw [if_pos (show i.val ≤ i.val + d ∧ i.val + d < k.val by omega),
              show i.val + d - i.val = d by omega,
              show k.val - (i.val + d) = k.val - i.val - d by omega]
          · intro m hm
            simp only [Finset.mem_Ico, Finset.mem_range] at hm ⊢
            omega
          · intro m _ hm
            simp only [hG]
            rw [if_neg]
            intro h
            exact hm (Finset.mem_Ico.mpr h)
        rw [hconv]
        have hV : FordOrder.invWeight L i k = (if k.val + 1 < L then FordAnalysis.g (k.val - i.val)
            else FordAnalysis.gStar (k.val - i.val)) := by
          simp only [FordOrder.invWeight]
          rw [if_pos hik.le]
        rw [hV, K (k.val - i.val) k.val (by omega) (by omega) hk,
          if_neg (fun h => by rw [h] at hik; exact lt_irrefl _ hik), sub_eq_zero]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro d hd
        have hd' := Finset.mem_range.mp hd
        rw [show k.val + 2 - (k.val - i.val) + d = i.val + d + 2 by omega, hcw _ (by omega)]
      · have hzero : ∑ j, FordOrder.invWeight L i j * FordGeometry.tailWeight j k = 0 := by
          apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
          intro j _
          simp only [FordOrder.invWeight, FordGeometry.tailWeight]
          by_cases hij : i.val ≤ j.val
          · rw [if_neg (by omega : ¬ j.val < k.val), mul_zero]
          · rw [if_neg hij, zero_mul]
        rw [hzero, sub_zero]
        by_cases hki : k = i
        · subst hki
          simp only [FordOrder.invWeight, le_refl, if_true, Nat.sub_self, hg0, hgS0]
          split_ifs <;> rfl
        · rw [if_neg hki]
          simp only [FordOrder.invWeight]
          rw [if_neg]
          intro h
          exact hki (Fin.ext (by omega))
    simp only [hcoef, ite_mul, one_mul, zero_mul, Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
  
  have s3 : ∀ A : Set (Fin L → ℝ),
      MeasureTheory.volume ((fun x : Fin L → ℝ => FordOrder.slack x) ⁻¹' A) =
        MeasureTheory.volume A := by
    intro A
    let M : Matrix (Fin L) (Fin L) ℝ :=
      fun j k => (if j = k then 1 else 0) - FordGeometry.tailWeight j k
    have hfun : (fun x : Fin L → ℝ => FordOrder.slack x) = ⇑(Matrix.toLin' M) := by
      funext x j
      rw [Matrix.toLin'_apply]
      simp only [FordOrder.slack, FordGeometry.tailForm, weightedForm, LinearMap.coe_mk,
        AddHom.coe_mk, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, M, sub_mul, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ite_mul,
        one_mul, zero_mul, Finset.sum_ite_eq, Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
    have hbt : M.BlockTriangular id := by
      intro j k hjk
      simp only [id] at hjk
      have hne : j ≠ k := fun h => by rw [h] at hjk; exact lt_irrefl _ hjk
      simp only [M, FordGeometry.tailWeight, if_neg hne]
      rw [if_neg (by rw [Fin.lt_def] at hjk; omega)]
      simp
    have hdet : M.det = 1 := by
      rw [Matrix.det_of_upperTriangular hbt]
      apply Finset.prod_eq_one
      intro j _
      simp [M, FordGeometry.tailWeight]
    have hdet' : LinearMap.det (Matrix.toLin' M) = 1 := by rw [LinearMap.det_toLin', hdet]
    rw [hfun, MeasureTheory.Measure.addHaar_preimage_linearMap _ (by rw [hdet']; norm_num), hdet']
    simp
  
  have s4 : ∀ (hL : 2 ≤ L) (j : Fin L), FordOrder.topCoeff L j =
      FordOrder.weight L j - FordOrder.invWeight L ⟨0, lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) hL⟩ j +
        (if j.val = 0 then 1 - FordAnalysis.coeff 1 else 0) := by
    intro hL j
    have hj := j.isLt
    simp only [FordOrder.topCoeff, FordOrder.weight, FordOrder.invWeight,
      Nat.zero_le, if_true, Nat.sub_zero]
    by_cases h0 : j.val = 0
    · rw [if_pos h0, if_pos h0, h0, if_pos (by omega), if_pos (by omega), hg1, hg0]
      ring
    · rw [if_neg h0, if_neg h0, add_zero]
      split_ifs <;> ring
  have s5 : ∀ (p : Fin L), 1 ≤ p.val → p.val + 1 < L → ∀ j : Fin L, FordOrder.adjCoeff L p j =
      FordOrder.invWeight L ⟨p.val - 1, lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.sub_le _ _) p.isLt⟩ j -
        FordOrder.invWeight L p j + (if j = p then 1 - FordAnalysis.coeff 1 else 0) := by
    intro p hp1 hp2 j
    have hj := j.isLt
    simp only [FordOrder.adjCoeff, FordOrder.invWeight]
    by_cases c1 : j.val + 1 = p.val
    · have hne : j ≠ p := fun h => by rw [h] at c1; omega
      rw [if_pos c1, if_pos (show p.val - 1 ≤ j.val by omega),
        if_neg (show ¬ p.val ≤ j.val by omega), if_neg hne,
        show j.val - (p.val - 1) = 0 by omega]
      split_ifs <;> simp [hg0, hgS0]
    · by_cases c2 : p.val < j.val
      · have hne : j ≠ p := fun h => by rw [h] at c2; exact lt_irrefl _ c2
        rw [if_neg c1, if_pos c2, if_pos (show p.val - 1 ≤ j.val by omega), if_pos c2.le,
          if_neg hne, show j.val - (p.val - 1) = j.val - p.val + 1 by omega]
        split_ifs <;> ring
      · by_cases c3 : j = p
        · subst c3
          rw [if_neg c1, if_neg c2, if_pos (show j.val - 1 ≤ j.val by omega), if_pos le_rfl,
            if_pos rfl, show j.val - (j.val - 1) = 1 by omega, Nat.sub_self]
          simp only [if_pos hp2, hg1, hg0]
          ring
        · have hne : j.val ≠ p.val := fun h => c3 (Fin.ext h)
          rw [if_neg c1, if_neg c2, if_neg (show ¬ p.val - 1 ≤ j.val by omega),
            if_neg (show ¬ p.val ≤ j.val by omega), if_neg c3]
          ring
  refine ⟨s1, s2, s3, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro hL x
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => by rw [s4 hL j])]
    simp only [add_mul, sub_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ite_mul, zero_mul]
    rw [s1 hL x, s2 x ⟨0, lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) hL⟩]
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single ⟨0, lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) hL⟩]
    · simp
    · intro j _ hj
      rw [if_neg]
      intro h
      exact hj (Fin.ext h)
    · simp
  · intro p hp1 hp2 x
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => by rw [s5 p hp1 hp2 j])]
    simp only [add_mul, sub_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ite_mul, zero_mul,
      Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
    rw [s2 x p, s2 x ⟨p.val - 1, lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.sub_le _ _) p.isLt⟩]

informal_problem.statement:
(L : ℕ) (hL : 2 ≤ L) :
    FordGeometry.polytope L (fun _ => 1) ⊆ FordOrder.unordered L ∧
    FordOrder.unordered L ⊆ FordGeometry.polytope L (fun _ => 1) ∪
      {x | x ∈ FordOrder.unordered L ∧ 1 ≤ x ⟨0, lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) hL⟩} ∪
      ⋃ p ∈ (Finset.univ.filter (fun p : Fin L => 1 ≤ p.val ∧ p.val + 1 < L)),
        {x | x ∈ FordOrder.unordered L ∧
          x ⟨p.val - 1, lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.sub_le _ _) p.isLt⟩ ≤ x p}
