proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have hform : ∀ (idx : Fin L) (x : Fin L → ℝ),
      FordGeometry.tailForm idx x = ∑ j, FordGeometry.tailWeight idx j * x j := fun _ _ => rfl
  have hlast : ∀ (idx : Fin L) (x : Fin L → ℝ), idx.val + 1 = L →
      FordGeometry.tailForm idx x = 0 := by
    intro idx x h
    rw [hform]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro j _
    have hj := j.isLt
    have hn : ¬ idx.val < j.val := by omega
    simp [FordGeometry.tailWeight, hn]
  have hpen : ∀ (idx j : Fin L) (x : Fin L → ℝ), idx.val + 2 = L → j.val = idx.val + 1 →
      FordGeometry.tailForm idx x = x j := by
    intro idx j x h hj
    rw [hform, Finset.sum_eq_single j]
    · have h1 : idx.val < j.val := by omega
      have h2 : ¬ idx.val + 2 < L := by omega
      simp [FordGeometry.tailWeight, h1, h2]
    · intro b _ hb
      have hbl := b.isLt
      have hn : ¬ idx.val < b.val := by
        intro hlt
        apply hb
        apply Fin.ext
        omega
      simp [FordGeometry.tailWeight, hn]
    · intro hj'
      exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ j) hj'
  have hanti : ∀ x : Fin L → ℝ, (∀ i j : Fin L, j.val = i.val + 1 → x j ≤ x i) → Antitone x := by
    intro x h
    have key : ∀ d : ℕ, ∀ a b : Fin L, b.val = a.val + d → x b ≤ x a := by
      intro d
      induction d with
      | zero =>
        intro a b hab
        rw [show b = a from Fin.ext (by omega)]
      | succ d ih =>
        intro a b hab
        have hb := b.isLt
        exact le_trans (h ⟨a.val + d, by omega⟩ b (by simp only; omega))
          (ih a ⟨a.val + d, by omega⟩ rfl)
    intro a b hab
    exact key (b.val - a.val) a b (by have := Fin.le_def.mp hab; omega)
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x hx
    obtain ⟨h0, _, _, hout, htail⟩ := hx
    refine ⟨hout, ?_⟩
    intro idx
    by_cases hi : idx.val + 1 < L
    · simpa using htail idx hi
    · have hidx := idx.isLt
      rw [hlast idx x (by omega)]
      exact h0 idx
  · intro x hx
    obtain ⟨hout, hU⟩ := hx
    by_cases htop : 1 ≤ x ⟨0, lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) hL⟩
    · exact Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨⟨hout, hU⟩, htop⟩)
    by_cases hadj : ∃ p : Fin L, (1 ≤ p.val ∧ p.val + 1 < L) ∧
        x ⟨p.val - 1, lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.sub_le _ _) p.isLt⟩ ≤ x p
    · obtain ⟨p, hp, hle⟩ := hadj
      right
      rw [Set.mem_iUnion₂]
      exact ⟨p, by simpa using hp, ⟨hout, hU⟩, hle⟩
    push_neg at htop hadj
    left
    left
    have hcons : ∀ i j : Fin L, j.val = i.val + 1 → x j ≤ x i := by
      intro i j hij
      by_cases hj : j.val + 1 < L
      · have hlt := hadj j ⟨by omega, hj⟩
        have heq : (⟨j.val - 1, lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.sub_le _ _) j.isLt⟩ : Fin L) = i :=
          Fin.ext (by simp only; omega)
        rw [heq] at hlt
        exact hlt.le
      · have hjl := j.isLt
        have hr := hU i
        rw [hpen i j x (by omega) hij] at hr
        exact hr
    have hA := hanti x hcons
    have hℓ : 0 ≤ x ⟨L - 1, by omega⟩ := by
      have hr := hU ⟨L - 1, by omega⟩
      rw [hlast ⟨L - 1, by omega⟩ x (by simp only; omega)] at hr
      exact hr
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, hA, hout, ?_⟩
    · intro idx
      have hidx := idx.isLt
      exact le_trans hℓ (hA (Fin.le_def.mpr (by simp only; omega)))
    · intro idx
      exact le_trans (hA (Fin.le_def.mpr (Nat.zero_le _))) htop.le
    · intro idx _
      simpa using hU idx

informal_problem.statement:
(r : ℝ)
    (hr : (217 / 400 : ℝ) < r ∧ r < 2713 / 5000)
    (hc1 : (38629 / 100000 : ℝ) < FordAnalysis.coeff 1 ∧ FordAnalysis.coeff 1 < 1 / 2)
    (hA : ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → FordAnalysis.g n * r ^ n < 17 / 50)
    (hB : ∀ n : ℕ, 2 ≤ n → (31 / 100 : ℝ) < FordAnalysis.g n * r ^ n)
    (hC : ∀ n : ℕ, 2 ≤ n → (147 / 1000 : ℝ) < (FordAnalysis.g n - FordAnalysis.g (n - 1)) * r ^ n)
    (L : ℕ) (hL : 2 ≤ L) :
    (∀ j, 0 ≤ FordOrder.topCoeff L j) ∧
    (∏ j, FordOrder.weight L j /
        FordOrder.cutWeight (FordOrder.weight L) (FordOrder.topCoeff L) (1 - FordAnalysis.coeff 1)
          ⟨0, lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) hL⟩ j) ≤
      (1 - FordAnalysis.coeff 1) * (4 / 5 : ℝ) ^ (L - 2)

signature.name: ford_top_weight_ratio
signature.statement:
(r : ℝ)
    (hr : (217 / 400 : ℝ) < r ∧ r < 2713 / 5000)
    (hc1 : (38629 / 100000 : ℝ) < FordAnalysis.coeff 1 ∧ FordAnalysis.coeff 1 < 1 / 2)
    (hA : ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → FordAnalysis.g n * r ^ n < 17 / 50)
    (hB : ∀ n : ℕ, 2 ≤ n → (31 / 100 : ℝ) < FordAnalysis.g n * r ^ n)
    (hC : ∀ n : ℕ, 2 ≤ n → (147 / 1000 : ℝ) < (FordAnalysis.g n - FordAnalysis.g (n - 1)) * r ^ n)
    (L : ℕ) (hL : 2 ≤ L) :
    (∀ j, 0 ≤ FordOrder.topCoeff L j) ∧
    (∏ j, FordOrder.weight L j /
        FordOrder.cutWeight (FordOrder.weight L) (FordOrder.topCoeff L) (1 - FordAnalysis.coeff 1)
          ⟨0, lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) hL⟩ j) ≤
      (1 - FordAnalysis.coeff 1) * (4 / 5 : ℝ) ^ (L - 2)

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨hr1, hr2⟩ := hr
  obtain ⟨hc1a, hc1b⟩ := hc1
  have hr0 : 0 < r := by linarith
  have hd : 0 < 1 - FordAnalysis.coeff 1 := by linarith
  have hcpos : 0 < FordAnalysis.coeff 1 := by linarith
  have hg0 : FordAnalysis.g 0 = 1 := by simp [FordAnalysis.g]
  have hg1 : FordAnalysis.g 1 = FordAnalysis.coeff 1 := by simp [FordAnalysis.g, hg0]
  have hgpos : ∀ n, 0 < FordAnalysis.g n := by
    intro n
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge n 2 with h | h
    · interval_cases n
      · rw [hg0]; norm_num
      · rw [hg1]; exact hcpos
    · have h31 := hB n h
      have hpn := pow_pos hr0 n
      by_contra hneg
      push_neg at hneg
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg (neg_nonneg.mpr hneg) hpn.le]
  have hstep : ∀ n, 2 ≤ n → 0 < FordAnalysis.g n - FordAnalysis.g (n - 1) := by
    intro n hn
    have h := hC n hn
    have hpn := pow_pos hr0 n
    by_contra hneg
    push_neg at hneg
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (neg_nonneg.mpr hneg) hpn.le]
  have hS : ∀ n, FordAnalysis.gStar (n + 1) =
      FordAnalysis.g (n + 1) + (1 - FordAnalysis.coeff 1) * FordAnalysis.g n := fun n => rfl
  have hgSpos : ∀ n, 0 < FordAnalysis.gStar n := by
    intro n
    cases n with
    | zero => simp [FordAnalysis.gStar]
    | succ n =>
      rw [hS n]
      have h1 := hgpos (n + 1)
      have h2 := mul_pos hd (hgpos n)
      linarith
  have hg2 : 1 < FordAnalysis.g 2 := by
    have h := hB 2 le_rfl
    have hpn := pow_pos hr0 2
    have hrr : r ^ 2 < 31 / 100 := by nlinarith
    by_contra hneg
    push_neg at hneg
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hneg) hpn.le]
  have hstepS : ∀ n, 2 ≤ n → 0 ≤ FordAnalysis.gStar n - FordAnalysis.gStar (n - 1) := by
    intro n hn
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge n 3 with h3 | h3
    · obtain rfl : n = 2 := by omega
      have e2 : FordAnalysis.gStar 2 =
          FordAnalysis.g 2 + (1 - FordAnalysis.coeff 1) * FordAnalysis.g 1 := hS 1
      have e1 : FordAnalysis.gStar 1 =
          FordAnalysis.g 1 + (1 - FordAnalysis.coeff 1) * FordAnalysis.g 0 := hS 0
      show 0 ≤ FordAnalysis.gStar 2 - FordAnalysis.gStar 1
      rw [e2, e1, hg1, hg0]
      nlinarith [mul_pos hd hcpos]
    · obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, n = k + 3 := ⟨n - 3, by omega⟩
      have e3 : FordAnalysis.gStar (k + 3) =
          FordAnalysis.g (k + 3) + (1 - FordAnalysis.coeff 1) * FordAnalysis.g (k + 2) := hS (k + 2)
      have e2 : FordAnalysis.gStar (k + 2) =
          FordAnalysis.g (k + 2) + (1 - FordAnalysis.coeff 1) * FordAnalysis.g (k + 1) := hS (k + 1)
      have s3 := hstep (k + 3) (by omega)
      have s2 := hstep (k + 2) (by omega)
      rw [show k + 3 - 1 = k + 2 by omega] at s3 ⊢
      rw [show k + 2 - 1 = k + 1 by omega] at s2
      rw [e3, e2]
      nlinarith [mul_pos hd s2]
  have hmidf : ∀ G D s : ℝ, 0 < s → 0 < G → G * s < 17 / 50 → 147 / 1000 < D * s →
      G / (G + FordAnalysis.coeff 1 / (1 - FordAnalysis.coeff 1) * D) ≤ 4 / 5 := by
    intro G D s hs hG hGs hDs
    have hD : 0 < D := by nlinarith
    have hden : 0 < G + FordAnalysis.coeff 1 / (1 - FordAnalysis.coeff 1) * D := by
      have := mul_pos (div_pos hcpos hd) hD
      linarith
    have h1 : G * s * (1 - FordAnalysis.coeff 1) < 17 / 50 * (1 - FordAnalysis.coeff 1) :=
      mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hGs hd
    have h3 : (38629 / 100000 : ℝ) * (147 / 1000) < FordAnalysis.coeff 1 * (D * s) :=
      mul_lt_mul'' hc1a hDs (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
    have h4 : (G * (1 - FordAnalysis.coeff 1)) * s < (4 * FordAnalysis.coeff 1 * D) * s := by
      linarith
    have hkey : G * (1 - FordAnalysis.coeff 1) < 4 * FordAnalysis.coeff 1 * D :=
      lt_of_mul_lt_mul_right h4 hs.le
    have h5 : 4 * (FordAnalysis.coeff 1 / (1 - FordAnalysis.coeff 1) * D) =
        4 * FordAnalysis.coeff 1 * D / (1 - FordAnalysis.coeff 1) := by ring
    have h6 : G < 4 * FordAnalysis.coeff 1 * D / (1 - FordAnalysis.coeff 1) := by
      rw [lt_div_iff₀ hd]; exact hkey
    rw [div_le_iff₀ hden]
    linarith
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, L = m + 2 := ⟨L - 2, by omega⟩
  have hw : ∀ j : Fin (m + 2), 0 < FordOrder.weight (m + 2) j := by
    intro j
    unfold FordOrder.weight
    split_ifs
    · exact hgpos _
    · exact hgSpos _
  have htc : ∀ j : Fin (m + 2), 0 ≤ FordOrder.topCoeff (m + 2) j := by
    intro j
    unfold FordOrder.topCoeff
    split_ifs with h0 h1
    · exact le_rfl
    · have := hstep (j.val + 1) (by omega)
      rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel] at this
      exact this.le
    · have := hstepS (j.val + 1) (by omega)
      rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel] at this
      exact this
  have hprod : ∀ (f : Fin (m + 2) → ℝ) (D : ℝ), (∀ j, 0 ≤ f j) → f 0 ≤ D →
      (∀ i : Fin m, f (Fin.castSucc i).succ ≤ 4 / 5) → f (Fin.last m).succ ≤ 1 →
      ∏ j, f j ≤ D * (4 / 5 : ℝ) ^ m := by
    intro f D hnn h0 hmid hlast
    rw [Fin.prod_univ_succ, Fin.prod_univ_castSucc]
    have hP : ∏ i : Fin m, f (Fin.castSucc i).succ ≤ (4 / 5 : ℝ) ^ m := by
      calc ∏ i : Fin m, f (Fin.castSucc i).succ ≤ ∏ _i : Fin m, (4 / 5 : ℝ) :=
            Finset.prod_le_prod (fun i _ => hnn _) (fun i _ => hmid i)
        _ = (4 / 5 : ℝ) ^ m := by rw [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
    have hP0 : 0 ≤ ∏ i : Fin m, f (Fin.castSucc i).succ := Finset.prod_nonneg (fun i _ => hnn _)
    have hD : 0 ≤ D := (hnn 0).trans h0
    calc _ ≤ D * ((4 / 5 : ℝ) ^ m * 1) :=
          mul_le_mul h0 (mul_le_mul hP hlast (hnn _) (by positivity)) (mul_nonneg hP0 (hnn _)) hD
      _ = D * (4 / 5 : ℝ) ^ m := by ring
  have key : ∀ p0 : Fin (m + 2), p0.val = 0 →
      (∏ j, FordOrder.weight (m + 2) j /
        FordOrder.cutWeight (FordOrder.weight (m + 2)) (FordOrder.topCoeff (m + 2))
          (1 - FordAnalysis.coeff 1) p0 j) ≤ (1 - FordAnalysis.coeff 1) * (4 / 5 : ℝ) ^ m := by
    intro p0 hp0
    have hw0 : FordOrder.weight (m + 2) p0 = FordAnalysis.coeff 1 := by
      unfold FordOrder.weight
      rw [if_pos (by omega), hp0]
      exact hg1
    have hκ : 0 < FordOrder.weight (m + 2) p0 / (1 - FordAnalysis.coeff 1) := by
      rw [hw0]; exact div_pos hcpos hd
    have hcw_ne : ∀ j : Fin (m + 2), j ≠ p0 →
        FordOrder.cutWeight (FordOrder.weight (m + 2)) (FordOrder.topCoeff (m + 2))
          (1 - FordAnalysis.coeff 1) p0 j =
        FordOrder.weight (m + 2) j +
          (FordOrder.weight (m + 2) p0 / (1 - FordAnalysis.coeff 1)) * FordOrder.topCoeff (m + 2) j := by
      intro j hj
      unfold FordOrder.cutWeight
      rw [if_neg hj]
    have hcwp : FordOrder.cutWeight (FordOrder.weight (m + 2)) (FordOrder.topCoeff (m + 2))
          (1 - FordAnalysis.coeff 1) p0 p0 =
        FordOrder.weight (m + 2) p0 / (1 - FordAnalysis.coeff 1) := by
      unfold FordOrder.cutWeight
      rw [if_pos rfl]
    have hcwpos : ∀ j, 0 < FordOrder.cutWeight (FordOrder.weight (m + 2)) (FordOrder.topCoeff (m + 2))
          (1 - FordAnalysis.coeff 1) p0 j := by
      intro j
      by_cases hj : j = p0
      · rw [hj, hcwp]; exact hκ
      · rw [hcw_ne j hj]
        have := mul_nonneg hκ.le (htc j)
        linarith [hw j]
    apply hprod
    · intro j
      exact div_nonneg (hw j).le (hcwpos j).le
    · have h0p : (0 : Fin (m + 2)) = p0 := Fin.ext (by simp [hp0])
      rw [h0p, hcwp, hw0, div_div_cancel₀ hcpos.ne']
    · intro i
      have hi := i.isLt
      have hjv : ((Fin.castSucc i).succ : Fin (m + 2)).val = i.val + 1 := by simp
      have hne : (Fin.castSucc i).succ ≠ p0 := by
        intro h
        have := congrArg Fin.val h
        rw [hjv, hp0] at this
        omega
      have hwj : FordOrder.weight (m + 2) (Fin.castSucc i).succ = FordAnalysis.g (i.val + 1 + 1) := by
        unfold FordOrder.weight
        rw [hjv, if_pos (by omega)]
      have htj : FordOrder.topCoeff (m + 2) (Fin.castSucc i).succ =
          FordAnalysis.g (i.val + 1 + 1) - FordAnalysis.g (i.val + 1) := by
        unfold FordOrder.topCoeff
        rw [hjv, if_neg (by omega), if_pos (by omega)]
      rw [hcw_ne _ hne, hw0, hwj, htj]
      have hGs := hA (i.val + 1 + 1) (by omega)
      have hDs := hC (i.val + 1 + 1) (by omega)
      rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel] at hDs
      exact hmidf _ _ _ (pow_pos hr0 _) (hgpos _) hGs hDs
    · have hne : (Fin.last m).succ ≠ p0 := by
        intro h
        have := congrArg Fin.val h
        rw [hp0] at this
        simp at this
      rw [div_le_one (hcwpos _), hcw_ne _ hne]
      have := mul_nonneg hκ.le (htc (Fin.last m).succ)
      linarith
  refine ⟨htc, ?_⟩
  rw [show m + 2 - 2 = m by omega]
  exact key _ rfl

informal_problem.statement:
(r : ℝ)
    (hr : (217 / 400 : ℝ) < r ∧ r < 2713 / 5000)
    (hc1 : (38629 / 100000 : ℝ) < FordAnalysis.coeff 1 ∧ FordAnalysis.coeff 1 < 1 / 2)
    (hA : ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → FordAnalysis.g n * r ^ n < 17 / 50)
    (hB : ∀ n : ℕ, 2 ≤ n → (31 / 100 : ℝ) < FordAnalysis.g n * r ^ n)
    (hC : ∀ n : ℕ, 2 ≤ n → (147 / 1000 : ℝ) < (FordAnalysis.g n - FordAnalysis.g (n - 1)) * r ^ n)
    (L : ℕ) (p : Fin L) (hp0 : 1 ≤ p.val) (hp1 : p.val + 1 < L) :
    (∀ j, 0 ≤ FordOrder.adjCoeff L p j) ∧
    (∏ j, FordOrder.weight L j /
        FordOrder.cutWeight (FordOrder.weight L) (FordOrder.adjCoeff L p) (1 - FordAnalysis.coeff 1) p j) ≤
      (1 - FordAnalysis.coeff 1) * ((20 / 77 : ℝ) * (5 / 7 : ℝ) ^ (L - p.val - 2))

proof.tactics:
by

  obtain ⟨hr1, hr2⟩ := hr
  obtain ⟨hc1a, hc1b⟩ := hc1
  have hr0 : (0 : ℝ) < r := by linarith
  have hd : 0 < 1 - FordAnalysis.coeff 1 := by linarith
  have hrd0 : 0 < r * (1 - FordAnalysis.coeff 1) := mul_pos hr0 hd
  have hrd : r * (1 - FordAnalysis.coeff 1) < 1 / 3 := by
    nlinarith [mul_pos (sub_pos.2 hr2) hd]
  have hg0 : FordAnalysis.g 0 = 1 := by simp [FordAnalysis.g]
  have hg1 : FordAnalysis.g 1 = FordAnalysis.coeff 1 := by simp [FordAnalysis.g, hg0]
  have hgS : ∀ n : ℕ, FordAnalysis.gStar (n + 1) =
      FordAnalysis.g (n + 1) + (1 - FordAnalysis.coeff 1) * FordAnalysis.g n := by
    intro n

  have hgpos : ∀ n, 0 < FordAnalysis.g n := by
    intro n

    · interval_cases n
      · rw [hg0]; norm_num
      · rw [hg1]; linarith
    · have h31 := hB n h
      have hpn := pow_pos hr0 n
      by_contra hneg
      push_neg at hneg

  have hgSpos : ∀ n, 0 < FordAnalysis.gStar n := by
    intro n

    | succ n =>

      have h1 := hgpos (n + 1)

  have hS : ∀ k : ℕ, 2 ≤ k →
      (2 / 25 : ℝ) < (FordAnalysis.gStar k - FordAnalysis.gStar (k - 1)) * r ^ k := by
    intro k hk
    obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, k = m + 1 + 1 := ⟨k - 2, by omega⟩
    rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel, hgS (m + 1), hgS m]
    rcases m with _ | m
    · have hg1' : FordAnalysis.g (0 + 1) = FordAnalysis.coeff 1 := hg1
      rw [hg1', hg0]
      have hB2 := hB (0 + 1 + 1) (by norm_num)
      have hQ : 1 - FordAnalysis.coeff 1 + FordAnalysis.coeff 1 ^ 2 < 76293 / 100000 := by
        nlinarith [mul_pos (sub_pos.2 hc1a)
          (show (0 : ℝ) < 61371 / 100000 - FordAnalysis.coeff 1 by linarith)]
      have hQ0 : 0 < 1 - FordAnalysis.coeff 1 + FordAnalysis.coeff 1 ^ 2 := by
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (FordAnalysis.coeff 1 - 1 / 2)]
      have hrr : r * r < (2713 / 5000) * (2713 / 5000) := mul_lt_mul'' hr2 hr2 hr0.le hr0.le
      have hQrr : (1 - FordAnalysis.coeff 1 + FordAnalysis.coeff 1 ^ 2) * (r * r) <

    · have h3 := hC (m + 1 + 1 + 1) (by omega)

          ((FordAnalysis.g (m + 1 + 1) - FordAnalysis.g (m + 1)) * r ^ (m + 1 + 1)) :=
        mul_pos hrd0 (by linarith)
      have hid : (FordAnalysis.g (m + 1 + 1 + 1) +

          (FordAnalysis.g (m + 1 + 1) + (1 - FordAnalysis.coeff 1) * FordAnalysis.g (m + 1))) *
            r ^ (m + 1 + 1 + 1) =
          (FordAnalysis.g (m + 1 + 1 + 1) - FordAnalysis.g (m + 1 + 1)) * r ^ (m + 1 + 1 + 1) +
          r * (1 - FordAnalysis.coeff 1) *
            ((FordAnalysis.g (m + 1 + 1) - FordAnalysis.g (m + 1)) * r ^ (m + 1 + 1)) := by ring
      rw [hid]
      linarith
  
  have hadj : ∀ j, 0 ≤ FordOrder.adjCoeff L p j := by
    intro j
    unfold FordOrder.adjCoeff
    split_ifs with h1 h2 h3
    · norm_num
    · have h := hC (j.val - p.val + 1) (by omega)
      rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel] at h
      have hpn := pow_pos hr0 (j.val - p.val + 1)
      by_contra hneg
      push_neg at hneg
      nlinarith
    · have h := hS (j.val - p.val + 1) (by omega)
      rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel] at h
      have hpn := pow_pos hr0 (j.val - p.val + 1)
      by_contra hneg
      push_neg at hneg
      nlinarith
    · exact le_rfl
  
  have hs2 : 5 * (1 - FordAnalysis.coeff 1) * FordAnalysis.g p.val ≤
      2 * FordAnalysis.g (p.val + 1) := by
    have hA' := hA p.val hp0
    have hB' := hB (p.val + 1) (by omega)
    have h1 : r * (1 - FordAnalysis.coeff 1) * (FordAnalysis.g p.val * r ^ p.val) <
        r * (1 - FordAnalysis.coeff 1) * (17 / 50) := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hA' hrd0
    have hpos := pow_pos hr0 (p.val + 1)
    have hid : (5 * (1 - FordAnalysis.coeff 1) * FordAnalysis.g p.val -
        2 * FordAnalysis.g (p.val + 1)) * r ^ (p.val + 1) =
        5 * (r * (1 - FordAnalysis.coeff 1) * (FordAnalysis.g p.val * r ^ p.val)) -
          2 * (FordAnalysis.g (p.val + 1) * r ^ (p.val + 1)) := by ring
    have hneg : (5 * (1 - FordAnalysis.coeff 1) * FordAnalysis.g p.val -
        2 * FordAnalysis.g (p.val + 1)) * r ^ (p.val + 1) < 0 := by
      rw [hid]; linarith
    by_contra hcon
    push_neg at hcon
    have := mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 hcon.le) hpos.le
    linarith
  
  have hs3 : ∀ q : ℕ, 1 ≤ q → 2 * (1 - FordAnalysis.coeff 1) * FordAnalysis.g (p.val + q + 1) ≤
      5 * FordAnalysis.g (p.val + 1) * (FordAnalysis.g (q + 1) - FordAnalysis.g q) := by
    intro q hq
    have hA' := hA (p.val + q + 1) (by omega)
    have hB' := hB (p.val + 1) (by omega)
    have hE := hC (q + 1) (by omega)
    rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel] at hE
    have h1 : r * (1 - FordAnalysis.coeff 1) *
        (FordAnalysis.g (p.val + q + 1) * r ^ (p.val + q + 1)) <
        r * (1 - FordAnalysis.coeff 1) * (17 / 50) := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hA' hrd0
    have hBE : (31 / 100 : ℝ) * (147 / 1000) < (FordAnalysis.g (p.val + 1) * r ^ (p.val + 1)) *
        ((FordAnalysis.g (q + 1) - FordAnalysis.g q) * r ^ (q + 1)) :=
      mul_lt_mul'' hB' hE (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
    have hpos := pow_pos hr0 (p.val + q + 1 + 1)
    have hid : (2 * (1 - FordAnalysis.coeff 1) * FordAnalysis.g (p.val + q + 1) -
        5 * FordAnalysis.g (p.val + 1) * (FordAnalysis.g (q + 1) - FordAnalysis.g q)) *
          r ^ (p.val + q + 1 + 1) =
        2 * (r * (1 - FordAnalysis.coeff 1) *
          (FordAnalysis.g (p.val + q + 1) * r ^ (p.val + q + 1))) -
          5 * ((FordAnalysis.g (p.val + 1) * r ^ (p.val + 1)) *
            ((FordAnalysis.g (q + 1) - FordAnalysis.g q) * r ^ (q + 1))) := by ring
    have hneg : (2 * (1 - FordAnalysis.coeff 1) * FordAnalysis.g (p.val + q + 1) -
        5 * FordAnalysis.g (p.val + 1) * (FordAnalysis.g (q + 1) - FordAnalysis.g q)) *

      rw [hid]; linarith
    by_contra hcon
    push_neg at hcon
    have := mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 hcon.le) hpos.le
    linarith
  
  have hs4 : ∀ q : ℕ, 1 ≤ q →
      (1 - FordAnalysis.coeff 1) * FordAnalysis.gStar (p.val + q + 1) ≤

    intro q hq
    have hA1 := hA (p.val + q + 1) (by omega)
    have hA0 := hA (p.val + q) (by omega)
    have hB' := hB (p.val + 1) (by omega)
    have hE := hS (q + 1) (by omega)
    rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel] at hE
    rw [hgS (p.val + q)]
    have h0 : r * (1 - FordAnalysis.coeff 1) * (FordAnalysis.g (p.val + q) * r ^ (p.val + q)) <
        r * (1 - FordAnalysis.coeff 1) * (17 / 50) := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hA0 hrd0
    have hU : FordAnalysis.g (p.val + q + 1) * r ^ (p.val + q + 1) +
        r * (1 - FordAnalysis.coeff 1) * (FordAnalysis.g (p.val + q) * r ^ (p.val + q)) <
        34 / 75 := by linarith
    have h1 : r * (1 - FordAnalysis.coeff 1) *
        (FordAnalysis.g (p.val + q + 1) * r ^ (p.val + q + 1) +
          r * (1 - FordAnalysis.coeff 1) * (FordAnalysis.g (p.val + q) * r ^ (p.val + q))) <
        r * (1 - FordAnalysis.coeff 1) * (34 / 75) := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hU hrd0
    have hBE : (31 / 100 : ℝ) * (2 / 25) < (FordAnalysis.g (p.val + 1) * r ^ (p.val + 1)) *
        ((FordAnalysis.gStar (q + 1) - FordAnalysis.gStar q) * r ^ (q + 1)) :=
      mul_lt_mul'' hB' hE (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
    have hpos := pow_pos hr0 (p.val + q + 1 + 1)

        10 * FordAnalysis.g (p.val + 1) * (FordAnalysis.gStar (q + 1) - FordAnalysis.gStar q)) *
          r ^ (p.val + q + 1 + 1) =
        r * (1 - FordAnalysis.coeff 1) *
          (FordAnalysis.g (p.val + q + 1) * r ^ (p.val + q + 1) +
            r * (1 - FordAnalysis.coeff 1) * (FordAnalysis.g (p.val + q) * r ^ (p.val + q))) -
          10 * ((FordAnalysis.g (p.val + 1) * r ^ (p.val + 1)) *
            ((FordAnalysis.gStar (q + 1) - FordAnalysis.gStar q) * r ^ (q + 1))) := by ring
    have hneg : ((1 - FordAnalysis.coeff 1) * (FordAnalysis.g (p.val + q + 1) +
        (1 - FordAnalysis.coeff 1) * FordAnalysis.g (p.val + q)) -

      rw [hid]; linarith
    by_contra hcon
    push_neg at hcon

    linarith
  
  have hred : ∀ (w X α β : ℝ), 0 < w → 0 ≤ X → 0 < α → 0 < β → α * w ≤ β * X →
      w / (w + X) ≤ β / (α + β) := by
    intro w X α β hw hX hα hβ h
    rw [div_le_iff₀ (by linarith)]
    rw [show β / (α + β) * (w + X) = (β * (w + X)) / (α + β) by ring,
      le_div_iff₀ (by linarith)]
    nlinarith
  have hclear : ∀ α β w G Δ : ℝ, α * (1 - FordAnalysis.coeff 1) * w ≤ β * G * Δ →
      α * w ≤ β * (G / (1 - FordAnalysis.coeff 1) * Δ) := by
    intro α β w G Δ h
    rw [show β * (G / (1 - FordAnalysis.coeff 1) * Δ) =
      (β * G * Δ) / (1 - FordAnalysis.coeff 1) by ring, le_div_iff₀ hd]
    linarith
  
  have heval : ∀ (P m : ℕ) (D : ℝ) (H : ℕ → ℝ), 1 ≤ P → H P = D → H (P - 1) = 2 / 7 →
      (∀ i, i + 1 < P → H i = 1) → (∀ x, x < m → H (P + 1 + x) = 5 / 7) →
      H (P + 1 + m) = 10 / 11 →
      ∏ i ∈ Finset.range (P + 1 + m + 1), H i = D * ((20 / 77 : ℝ) * (5 / 7 : ℝ) ^ m) := by
    intro P m D H hP h0 h1 hlow hmid hlast
    obtain ⟨Q, rfl⟩ : ∃ Q, P = Q + 1 := ⟨P - 1, by omega⟩
    rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel] at h1
    have e1 : ∏ i ∈ Finset.range Q, H i = 1 :=
      Finset.prod_eq_one (fun i hi => hlow i (by rw [Finset.mem_range] at hi; omega))
    have e2 : ∏ x ∈ Finset.range m, H (Q + 1 + 1 + x) = (5 / 7 : ℝ) ^ m := by
      rw [Finset.prod_congr rfl (fun x hx => hmid x (Finset.mem_range.mp hx)), Finset.prod_const,
        Finset.card_range]
    rw [Finset.prod_range_succ, Finset.prod_range_add, Finset.prod_range_succ,
      Finset.prod_range_succ, e1, e2, hlast, h0, h1]
    ring
  
  have hbook : ∀ (f : Fin L → ℝ) (D : ℝ), (∀ j, 0 ≤ f j) → f p ≤ D →
      (∀ j : Fin L, j.val + 1 = p.val → f j ≤ 2 / 7) →
      (∀ j : Fin L, j.val + 1 < p.val → f j ≤ 1) →
      (∀ j : Fin L, p.val < j.val → j.val + 1 < L → f j ≤ 5 / 7) →
      (∀ j : Fin L, j.val + 1 = L → f j ≤ 10 / 11) →
      ∏ j, f j ≤ D * ((20 / 77 : ℝ) * (5 / 7 : ℝ) ^ (L - p.val - 2)) := by
    intro f D hnn hfp hprev hlow hmid hlast
    obtain ⟨H, hH⟩ : ∃ H : ℕ → ℝ, ∀ i, H i = if i = p.val then D else if i + 1 = p.val then 2 / 7
        else if p.val < i then (if i + 1 < L then 5 / 7 else 10 / 11) else 1 :=
      ⟨_, fun i => rfl⟩
    have hpt : ∀ j : Fin L, f j ≤ H j.val := by
      intro j
      rw [hH]
      split_ifs with h1 h2 h3 h4
      · have : j = p := Fin.ext h1
        subst this
        exact hfp
      · exact hprev j h2
      · exact hmid j h3 h4
      · exact hlast j (by have := j.isLt; omega)
      · exact hlow j (by omega)
    have h1 : ∏ j, f j ≤ ∏ j : Fin L, H j.val :=
      Finset.prod_le_prod (fun j _ => hnn j) (fun j _ => hpt j)
    rw [Fin.prod_univ_eq_prod_range H L] at h1
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ : ∃ m, L = p.val + 1 + m + 1 := ⟨L - p.val - 2, by omega⟩
    have hm2 : L - p.val - 2 = m := by omega
    have hev := heval p.val m D H hp0
      (by rw [hH]; split_ifs <;> first | (exfalso; omega) | rfl)
      (by rw [hH]; split_ifs <;> first | (exfalso; omega) | rfl)
      (fun i hi => by rw [hH]; split_ifs <;> first | (exfalso; omega) | rfl)
      (fun x hx => by rw [hH]; split_ifs <;> first | (exfalso; omega) | rfl)
      (by rw [hH]; split_ifs <;> first | (exfalso; omega) | rfl)
    rw [← hm] at hev
    rw [hm2]
    exact h1.trans (le_of_eq hev)
  
  have hwp : FordOrder.weight L p = FordAnalysis.g (p.val + 1) := by
    unfold FordOrder.weight
    rw [if_pos hp1]
  have hw : ∀ j, 0 < FordOrder.weight L j := by
    intro j
    unfold FordOrder.weight
    split_ifs
    · exact hgpos _
    · exact hgSpos _
  have hG : 0 < FordAnalysis.g (p.val + 1) / (1 - FordAnalysis.coeff 1) := div_pos (hgpos _) hd
  have hcwp : FordOrder.cutWeight (FordOrder.weight L) (FordOrder.adjCoeff L p)
      (1 - FordAnalysis.coeff 1) p p = FordAnalysis.g (p.val + 1) / (1 - FordAnalysis.coeff 1) := by
    unfold FordOrder.cutWeight
    rw [if_pos rfl, hwp]
  have hcw : ∀ j, j ≠ p → FordOrder.cutWeight (FordOrder.weight L) (FordOrder.adjCoeff L p)
      (1 - FordAnalysis.coeff 1) p j = FordOrder.weight L j +
        FordAnalysis.g (p.val + 1) / (1 - FordAnalysis.coeff 1) * FordOrder.adjCoeff L p j := by
    intro j hj
    unfold FordOrder.cutWeight
    rw [if_neg hj, hwp]
  refine ⟨hadj, hbook _ _ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_⟩
  · intro j
    by_cases hj : j = p
    · subst hj
      rw [hcwp]
      exact div_nonneg (hw _).le hG.le
    · rw [hcw j hj]
      exact div_nonneg (hw j).le (by have := mul_nonneg hG.le (hadj j); linarith [hw j])
  · rw [hcwp, hwp, div_div_cancel₀ (hgpos _).ne']
  · intro j hj
    have hne : j ≠ p := fun h => by rw [h] at hj; omega
    have haj : FordOrder.adjCoeff L p j = 1 := by
      unfold FordOrder.adjCoeff
      rw [if_pos hj]
    have hwj : FordOrder.weight L j = FordAnalysis.g p.val := by
      unfold FordOrder.weight
      split_ifs <;> first | (exfalso; omega) | rfl | (congr 1 <;> omega)
    rw [hcw j hne, haj, hwj]
    refine (hred _ _ 5 2 (hgpos _) (by positivity) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) ?_).trans
      (by norm_num)
    exact hclear 5 2 _ _ 1 (by linarith [hs2])
  · intro j hj
    have hne : j ≠ p := fun h => by rw [h] at hj; omega
    have haj : FordOrder.adjCoeff L p j = 0 := by
      unfold FordOrder.adjCoeff
      split_ifs <;> first | (exfalso; omega) | rfl
    rw [hcw j hne, haj, mul_zero, add_zero, div_self (hw j).ne']
  · intro j h3 h4
    have hne : j ≠ p := fun h => by rw [h] at h3; omega
    have haj : FordOrder.adjCoeff L p j =
        FordAnalysis.g (j.val - p.val + 1) - FordAnalysis.g (j.val - p.val) := by
      unfold FordOrder.adjCoeff
      split_ifs <;> first | (exfalso; omega) | rfl
    have hwj : FordOrder.weight L j = FordAnalysis.g (p.val + (j.val - p.val) + 1) := by
      unfold FordOrder.weight
      split_ifs <;> first | (exfalso; omega) | rfl | (congr 1 <;> omega)
    rw [hcw j hne, haj, hwj]
    refine (hred _ _ 2 5 (hgpos _) (mul_nonneg hG.le ?_) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) ?_).trans
      (by norm_num)
    · rw [← haj]; exact hadj j
    · exact hclear 2 5 _ _ _ (hs3 (j.val - p.val) (by omega))
  · intro j hj
    have hne : j ≠ p := fun h => by rw [h] at hj; omega
    have haj : FordOrder.adjCoeff L p j =
        FordAnalysis.gStar (j.val - p.val + 1) - FordAnalysis.gStar (j.val - p.val) := by
      unfold FordOrder.adjCoeff
      split_ifs <;> first | (exfalso; omega) | rfl
    have hwj : FordOrder.weight L j = FordAnalysis.gStar (p.val + (j.val - p.val) + 1) := by
      unfold FordOrder.weight
      split_ifs <;> first | (exfalso; omega) | rfl | (congr 1 <;> omega)
    rw [hcw j hne, haj, hwj]
    refine (hred _ _ 1 10 (hgSpos _) (mul_nonneg hG.le ?_) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) ?_).trans
      (by norm_num)
    · rw [← haj]; exact hadj j
    · have h4 := hs4 (j.val - p.val) (by omega)
      exact hclear 1 10 _ _ _ (by linarith)

informal_problem.statement:
(L : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (E : Set (Fin L → ℝ))
    (K : Finset (Fin L → ℕ)) (ht : 0 < t) (hE : E ⊆ Set.Icc (fun _ => 0) (fun _ => 1))
    (hK : ∀ k ∈ K, ∃ x ∈ E, ∀ i, (k i : ℝ) ≤ t * x i ∧ t * x i < (k i : ℝ) + 1) :
    (K.card : ℝ) ≤ t ^ L * MeasureTheory.volume.real
      (E + Set.Icc (fun _ : Fin L => -(1 / t)) (fun _ => 1 / t))

signature.name: cell_count_le_thickened_volume
signature.statement:
(L : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (E : Set (Fin L → ℝ))
    (K : Finset (Fin L → ℕ)) (ht : 0 < t) (hE : E ⊆ Set.Icc (fun _ => 0) (fun _ => 1))
    (hK : ∀ k ∈ K, ∃ x ∈ E, ∀ i, (k i : ℝ) ≤ t * x i ∧ t * x i < (k i : ℝ) + 1) :
    (K.card : ℝ) ≤ t ^ L * MeasureTheory.volume.real
      (E + Set.Icc (fun _ : Fin L => -(1 / t)) (fun _ => 1 / t))

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  set cell : (Fin L → ℕ) → Set (Fin L → ℝ) := fun k =>
    Set.univ.pi (fun i : Fin L => Set.Ico ((k i : ℝ) / t) (((k i : ℝ) + 1) / t)) with hcell
  set S := E + Set.Icc (fun _ : Fin L => -(1 / t)) (fun _ => 1 / t) with hS
  have hmeas : ∀ k ∈ K, MeasurableSet (cell k) := fun k _ =>
    MeasurableSet.univ_pi (fun _ => measurableSet_Ico)
  have hdisj : (K : Set (Fin L → ℕ)).PairwiseDisjoint cell := by
    intro a _ b _ hab
    rw [Function.onFun, Set.disjoint_left]
    intro y hya hyb
    apply hab
    funext i
    obtain ⟨h1a, h1b⟩ := hya i (Set.mem_univ i)
    obtain ⟨h2a, h2b⟩ := hyb i (Set.mem_univ i)
    rw [div_le_iff₀ ht] at h1a h2a
    rw [lt_div_iff₀ ht] at h1b h2b
    have e1 : (a i : ℝ) < (b i : ℝ) + 1 := by linarith
    have e2 : (b i : ℝ) < (a i : ℝ) + 1 := by linarith
    have e1' : a i < b i + 1 := by exact_mod_cast e1
    have e2' : b i < a i + 1 := by exact_mod_cast e2
    omega
  have hvolcell : ∀ k, MeasureTheory.volume (cell k) = ENNReal.ofReal (1 / t) ^ L := by
    intro k
    simp only [hcell]
    rw [Real.volume_pi_Ico]
    have h : ∀ i : Fin L, ((k i : ℝ) + 1) / t - (k i : ℝ) / t = 1 / t := by
      intro i
      field_simp
      ring
    simp only [h, Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
  have hU : MeasureTheory.volume (⋃ k ∈ K, cell k) =
      (K.card : ENNReal) * ENNReal.ofReal (1 / t) ^ L := by
    rw [MeasureTheory.measure_biUnion_finset hdisj hmeas]
    simp only [hvolcell, Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
  have hsub : (⋃ k ∈ K, cell k) ⊆ S := by
    refine Set.iUnion₂_subset (fun k hk => ?_)
    obtain ⟨x, hxE, hx⟩ := hK k hk
    intro y hy
    rw [hS, Set.mem_add]
    refine ⟨x, hxE, y - x, ⟨fun i => ?_, fun i => ?_⟩, add_sub_cancel x y⟩
    · obtain ⟨h1a, h1b⟩ := hy i (Set.mem_univ i)
      rw [div_le_iff₀ ht] at h1a
      rw [lt_div_iff₀ ht] at h1b
      obtain ⟨hxa, hxb⟩ := hx i
      show -(1 / t) ≤ y i - x i
      rw [neg_div', div_le_iff₀ ht]
      have hm : (y i - x i) * t = y i * t - t * x i := by ring
      rw [hm]
      linarith
    · obtain ⟨h1a, h1b⟩ := hy i (Set.mem_univ i)
      rw [div_le_iff₀ ht] at h1a
      rw [lt_div_iff₀ ht] at h1b
      obtain ⟨hxa, hxb⟩ := hx i
      show y i - x i ≤ 1 / t
      rw [le_div_iff₀ ht]
      have hm : (y i - x i) * t = y i * t - t * x i := by ring
      rw [hm]
      linarith
  have hfin : MeasureTheory.volume S ≠ ⊤ := by
    have h1 : S ⊆ Set.Icc ((fun _ : Fin L => (0 : ℝ)) + fun _ => -(1 / t))
        ((fun _ : Fin L => (1 : ℝ)) + fun _ => 1 / t) :=
      (Set.add_subset_add hE subset_rfl).trans (Set.Icc_add_Icc_subset _ _ _ _)
    exact ((MeasureTheory.measure_mono h1).trans_lt measure_Icc_lt_top).ne
  have hle : (K.card : ENNReal) * ENNReal.ofReal (1 / t) ^ L ≤ MeasureTheory.volume S := by
    rw [← hU]
    exact MeasureTheory.measure_mono hsub
  have hreal : ((K.card : ENNReal) * ENNReal.ofReal (1 / t) ^ L).toReal ≤
      (MeasureTheory.volume S).toReal :=
    ENNReal.toReal_mono hfin hle
  rw [ENNReal.toReal_mul, ENNReal.toReal_pow, ENNReal.toReal_natCast,
    ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (by positivity)] at hreal
  have htL : 0 < t ^ L := pow_pos ht L
  have hone : t ^ L * (1 / t) ^ L = 1 := by
    rw [← mul_pow, mul_one_div_cancel ht.ne', one_pow]
  calc (K.card : ℝ) = t ^ L * ((K.card : ℝ) * (1 / t) ^ L) := by
        rw [mul_left_comm, hone, mul_one]
    _ ≤ t ^ L * (MeasureTheory.volume S).toReal := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hreal htL.le
    _ = t ^ L * MeasureTheory.volume.real S := rfl

informal_problem.statement:
(L : ℕ) (q : Fin L → ℕ)
    (hq : ∀ i, (q i).Prime ∨ q i = 1) :
    (((∏ i, q i).totient : ℝ))⁻¹ ≤
      6 * ∏ i, (if q i < 17 then (1 : ℝ) / (q i : ℝ) else 1 / ((q i : ℝ) - 1))

signature.name: inv_totient_prod_le_six_mul_weight
signature.statement:
(L : ℕ) (q : Fin L → ℕ)
    (hq : ∀ i, (q i).Prime ∨ q i = 1) :
    (((∏ i, q i).totient : ℝ))⁻¹ ≤
      6 * ∏ i, (if q i < 17 then (1 : ℝ) / (q i : ℝ) else 1 / ((q i : ℝ) - 1))

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hsuper : ∀ (S : Finset (Fin L)),
      ∏ i ∈ S, (q i).totient ≤ (∏ i ∈ S, q i).totient := by
    intro S
    induction S using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty => simp
    | insert a S ha ih =>
      rw [Finset.prod_insert ha, Finset.prod_insert ha]
      exact le_trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ ih) (Nat.totient_super_multiplicative _ _)
  
  have hcrux : ∀ s : ℕ, (∀ p ∈ s.primeFactors, p < 17) → s ≤ 6 * s.totient := by
    intro s hs
    have hPU : s.primeFactors ⊆ ({2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13} : Finset ℕ) := by
      intro p hp
      have hpp : p.Prime := (Nat.mem_primeFactors.mp hp).1
      have hp17 := hs p hp
      interval_cases p <;> first | (simp; done) | (exfalso; norm_num at hpp)
    have hsd1 := Finset.prod_sdiff (f := fun p => p) hPU
    have hsd2 := Finset.prod_sdiff (f := fun p => p - 1) hPU
    have hU1 : ∏ p ∈ ({2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13} : Finset ℕ), p = 30030 := by decide
    have hU2 : ∏ p ∈ ({2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13} : Finset ℕ), (p - 1) = 5760 := by decide
    simp only [hU1, hU2] at hsd1 hsd2
    have hdc : ∏ p ∈ ({2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13} : Finset ℕ) \ s.primeFactors, (p - 1) ≤
        ∏ p ∈ ({2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13} : Finset ℕ) \ s.primeFactors, p :=
      Finset.prod_le_prod (fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _) (fun _ _ => Nat.sub_le _ _)
    have hd0 : 0 < ∏ p ∈ ({2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13} : Finset ℕ) \ s.primeFactors, (p - 1) := by
      apply Finset.prod_pos
      intro p hp
      have hpU := (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hp).1
      simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hpU
      omega
    have hb0 : 0 < ∏ p ∈ s.primeFactors, (p - 1) := by
      apply Finset.prod_pos
      intro p hp
      have := (Nat.mem_primeFactors.mp hp).1.two_le
      omega
    have hab : ∏ p ∈ s.primeFactors, p ≤ 6 * ∏ p ∈ s.primeFactors, (p - 1) := by
      have h1 := Nat.mul_le_mul_left (∏ p ∈ s.primeFactors, p) hdc
      have h2 : (∏ p ∈ ({2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13} : Finset ℕ) \ s.primeFactors, (p - 1)) *
          (∏ p ∈ s.primeFactors, p) ≤
          (∏ p ∈ ({2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13} : Finset ℕ) \ s.primeFactors, (p - 1)) *
          (6 * ∏ p ∈ s.primeFactors, (p - 1)) := by
        nlinarith
      exact Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_left h2 hd0
    have htot := Nat.totient_mul_prod_primeFactors s
    have h3 : s * ∏ p ∈ s.primeFactors, (p - 1) ≤
        (6 * s.totient) * ∏ p ∈ s.primeFactors, (p - 1) := by
      rw [← htot]
      nlinarith
    exact Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_right h3 hb0
  have h1 : ∀ i, 1 ≤ q i := fun i => by
    rcases hq i with h | h
    · exact h.one_lt.le
    · omega
  have hBp : ∀ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i => ¬ q i < 17), (q i).Prime ∧ 17 ≤ q i := by
    intro i hi
    have h17 : 17 ≤ q i := by
      have := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2
      omega
    rcases hq i with h | h
    · exact ⟨h, h17⟩
    · omega
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ : ∃ s, s = ∏ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i => q i < 17), q i := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ : ∃ m, m = ∏ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i => ¬ q i < 17), q i := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ : ∃ T, T = ∏ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i => ¬ q i < 17), (q i - 1) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hn : ∏ i, q i = s * m := by
    rw [hs, hm]
    exact (Finset.prod_filter_mul_prod_filter_not _ _ _).symm
  have hs0 : 0 < s := by
    rw [hs]
    exact Finset.prod_pos (fun i _ => h1 i)
  have hT0 : 0 < T := by
    rw [hT]
    exact Finset.prod_pos (fun i hi => by have := (hBp i hi).2; omega)
  have hTm : T ≤ m.totient := by
    rw [hT, hm]
    calc ∏ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i => ¬ q i < 17), (q i - 1)
        = ∏ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i => ¬ q i < 17), (q i).totient :=
          Finset.prod_congr rfl (fun i hi => (Nat.totient_prime (hBp i hi).1).symm)
      _ ≤ _ := hsuper _
  have hsφ : s ≤ 6 * s.totient := by
    apply hcrux
    intro p hp
    have hpp := (Nat.mem_primeFactors.mp hp).1
    have hpd := (Nat.mem_primeFactors.mp hp).2.1
    rw [hs] at hpd
    obtain ⟨i, hi, hpi⟩ := (Prime.dvd_finset_prod_iff hpp.prime q).mp hpd
    have hi17 : q i < 17 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2
    rcases hq i with h | h
    · rw [(Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq hpp h).mp hpi]
      exact hi17
    · rw [h] at hpi
      exact absurd (Nat.dvd_one.mp hpi) hpp.one_lt.ne'
  have hφ : s.totient * T ≤ (∏ i, q i).totient := by
    rw [hn]
    exact le_trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hTm) (Nat.totient_super_multiplicative s m)
  have hφs0 : 0 < s.totient := Nat.totient_pos.mpr hs0
  have hw : ∏ i, (if q i < 17 then (1 : ℝ) / (q i : ℝ) else 1 / ((q i : ℝ) - 1)) =
      (1 / (s : ℝ)) * (1 / (T : ℝ)) := by
    rw [Finset.prod_ite, hs, hT, Nat.cast_prod, Nat.cast_prod]
    congr 1
    · rw [Finset.prod_div_distrib, Finset.prod_const_one]
    · rw [Finset.prod_div_distrib, Finset.prod_const_one]
      congr 1
      apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
      intro i _
      rw [Nat.cast_sub (h1 i), Nat.cast_one]
  rw [hw]
  have hφR : (s.totient : ℝ) * (T : ℝ) ≤ ((∏ i, q i).totient : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hφ
  have hsR : (s : ℝ) ≤ 6 * (s.totient : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hsφ
  have ha : (0 : ℝ) < s.totient := by exact_mod_cast hφs0
  have ht : (0 : ℝ) < T := by exact_mod_cast hT0
  have hσ : (0 : ℝ) < s := by exact_mod_cast hs0
  calc ((∏ i, q i).totient : ℝ)⁻¹ ≤ ((s.totient : ℝ) * T)⁻¹ := inv_anti₀ (by positivity) hφR
    _ ≤ 6 * (1 / (s : ℝ) * (1 / (T : ℝ))) := by
      rw [show 6 * (1 / (s : ℝ) * (1 / (T : ℝ))) = 6 / ((s : ℝ) * T) by field_simp]
      rw [inv_eq_one_div, div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by positivity)]
      nlinarith

informal_problem.statement:
(r : ℕ) (Q : Finset (Fin r → ℕ))
    (hQ : ∀ q ∈ Q, Antitone q ∧ ∀ i, q i ∈ ({1, 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13} : Finset ℕ)) :
    (∑ q ∈ Q, ∏ i, (1 : ℝ) / (q i : ℝ)) ≤ 6

signature.name: window_zero_antitone_sum_le
signature.statement:
(r : ℕ) (Q : Finset (Fin r → ℕ))
    (hQ : ∀ q ∈ Q, Antitone q ∧ ∀ i, q i ∈ ({1, 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13} : Finset ℕ)) :
    (∑ q ∈ Q, ∏ i, (1 : ℝ) / (q i : ℝ)) ≤ 6

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  set T : Finset ℕ := ({1, 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13} : Finset ℕ) with hT
  let A : ℕ → ℝ := fun s => if s < 2 then 1 else if s < 3 then 2 else if s < 5 then 3 else
      if s < 7 then 15 / 4 else if s < 11 then 35 / 8 else if s < 13 then 77 / 16 else 1001 / 192
  have hA1 : ∀ s, 1 ≤ A s := by
    intro s
    simp only [A]
    split_ifs <;> norm_num
  have htel : ∀ s ∈ T,
      (∑ a ∈ T.filter (fun a => a ≤ s), (1 : ℝ) / (a : ℝ) * A a) ≤ A s := by
    intro s hs
    simp only [hT, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hs
    rcases hs with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl <;>
      simp [hT, A, Finset.filter_insert, Finset.filter_singleton] <;> norm_num
  have key : ∀ r : ℕ, ∀ s ∈ T, ∀ Q : Finset (Fin r → ℕ),
      (∀ q ∈ Q, Antitone q ∧ ∀ i, q i ∈ T ∧ q i ≤ s) →
      (∑ q ∈ Q, ∏ i, (1 : ℝ) / (q i : ℝ)) ≤ A s := by
    intro r
    induction r with
    | zero =>
      intro s hs Q hQ
      have hc : Q.card ≤ 1 := Finset.card_le_one_of_subsingleton Q
      simp only [Finset.univ_eq_empty, Finset.prod_empty, Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul,
        mul_one]
      have : (Q.card : ℝ) ≤ 1 := by exact_mod_cast hc
      linarith [hA1 s]
    | succ r ih =>
      intro s hs Q hQ
      have hmaps : ∀ q ∈ Q, q 0 ∈ T.filter (fun a => a ≤ s) := by
        intro q hq
        obtain ⟨_, h2⟩ := hQ q hq
        exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨(h2 0).1, (h2 0).2⟩
      calc (∑ q ∈ Q, ∏ i, (1 : ℝ) / (q i : ℝ))
          = ∑ a ∈ T.filter (fun a => a ≤ s), ∑ q ∈ Q.filter (fun q => q 0 = a),
              ∏ i, (1 : ℝ) / (q i : ℝ) :=
            (Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to hmaps _).symm
        _ ≤ ∑ a ∈ T.filter (fun a => a ≤ s), (1 : ℝ) / (a : ℝ) * A a := by
            apply Finset.sum_le_sum
            intro a ha
            obtain ⟨haT, _⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp ha
            have hsplit : ∀ q ∈ Q.filter (fun q => q 0 = a), ∏ i, (1 : ℝ) / (q i : ℝ) =
                (1 : ℝ) / (a : ℝ) * ∏ j, (1 : ℝ) / ((Fin.tail q j : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
              intro q hq
              rw [Fin.prod_univ_succ, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hq).2]
              rfl
            rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hsplit, ← Finset.mul_sum]
            have hinj : Set.InjOn (Fin.tail : (Fin (r + 1) → ℕ) → (Fin r → ℕ))
                (Q.filter (fun q => q 0 = a) : Set (Fin (r + 1) → ℕ)) := by
              intro q hq q' hq' h
              have e1 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp (Finset.mem_coe.mp hq)).2
              have e2 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp (Finset.mem_coe.mp hq')).2
              calc q = Fin.cons (q 0) (Fin.tail q) := (Fin.cons_self_tail q).symm
                _ = Fin.cons (q' 0) (Fin.tail q') := by rw [h, e1, e2]
                _ = q' := Fin.cons_self_tail q'
            rw [← Finset.sum_image (f := fun u : Fin r → ℕ => ∏ j, (1 : ℝ) / (u j : ℝ)) hinj]
            apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (by positivity)
            apply ih a haT
            intro u hu
            obtain ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hu
            obtain ⟨hqQ, hq0⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hq
            obtain ⟨hanti, hval⟩ := hQ q hqQ

by

    Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith))

  have hWIco : FordReciprocal.primeWindow m ⊆ Finset.Ico a (a + k) := by
    intro n hn
    rw [Finset.mem_Ico]
    have h1 : a ≤ n := Nat.ceil_le.mpr (hmemW n hn).2.1
    have h2 : n ≤ (FordReciprocal.primeWindow m).sup id := Finset.le_sup (f := id) hn
    omega
  have hT1 : (∑ n ∈ FordReciprocal.primeWindow m, f n) ≤ ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ico a (a + k), f n :=
    Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hWIco (fun i hi _ => by
      have := (Finset.mem_Ico.mp hi).1
      exact hf0 i (by omega))
  have hak : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / (((a + k : ℕ) : ℝ) - 1) := by
    have : (2 : ℝ) ≤ ((a + k : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 2 ≤ a + k)
    apply div_nonneg zero_le_one
    linarith
  have hX1 : Real.exp (m : ℝ) ≤ X - 1 := by linarith
  have hX1inv : 1 / (X - 1) ≤ e := by
    calc 1 / (X - 1) ≤ 1 / Real.exp (m : ℝ) := one_div_le_one_div_of_le hexpm_pos hX1
      _ = e := heinv
  have hainv : 1 / ((a : ℝ) - 1) ≤ 1 / (X - 1) :=
    one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hT : (∑ n ∈ FordReciprocal.primeWindow m, f n) ≤ e := by
    rw [htel k] at hT1
    linarith
  have hsplit : (∑ p ∈ FordReciprocal.primeWindow m, (1 : ℝ) / ((p : ℝ) - 1)) =
      (∑ p ∈ FordReciprocal.primeWindow m, (1 : ℝ) / p) +
        ∑ n ∈ FordReciprocal.primeWindow m, f n := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro p _
    simp only [f]
    ring
  rw [hsplit]
  simp only at hS2
  linarith

informal_problem.statement:
(c : ℕ → ℝ) (lab : ℕ → ℕ) (A : Set ℕ) (β : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hc : ∀ x, 0 ≤ c x) (hlab : Monotone lab)
    (hβ : ∀ (m r : ℕ) (Q : Finset (Fin r → ℕ)),
      (∀ q ∈ Q, Antitone q ∧ ∀ i, q i ∈ A ∧ lab (q i) = m) → (∑ q ∈ Q, ∏ i, c (q i)) ≤ β m)
    (N L : ℕ) (k : Fin L → ℕ) (Q : Finset (Fin L → ℕ)) (hk : ∀ i, k i < N)
    (hQ : ∀ q ∈ Q, Antitone q ∧ ∀ i, q i ∈ A ∧ lab (q i) = k i) :
    (∑ q ∈ Q, ∏ i, c (q i)) ≤ ∏ m ∈ Finset.range N, β m

signature.statement:
(c : ℕ → ℝ) (lab : ℕ → ℕ) (A : Set ℕ) (β : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hc : ∀ x, 0 ≤ c x) (hlab : Monotone lab)
    (hβ : ∀ (m r : ℕ) (Q : Finset (Fin r → ℕ)),
      (∀ q ∈ Q, Antitone q ∧ ∀ i, q i ∈ A ∧ lab (q i) = m) → (∑ q ∈ Q, ∏ i, c (q i)) ≤ β m)
    (N L : ℕ) (k : Fin L → ℕ) (Q : Finset (Fin L → ℕ)) (hk : ∀ i, k i < N)
    (hQ : ∀ q ∈ Q, Antitone q ∧ ∀ i, q i ∈ A ∧ lab (q i) = k i) :
    (∑ q ∈ Q, ∏ i, c (q i)) ≤ ∏ m ∈ Finset.range N, β m

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  let I : Fin N → Finset (Fin L) := fun m => Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin L => k i = (m : ℕ))
  let e : (m : Fin N) → Fin (I m).card ↪o Fin L := fun m => (I m).orderEmbOfFin rfl
  let Φ : (Fin L → ℕ) → (m : Fin N) → (Fin (I m).card → ℕ) := fun q m j => q (e m j)
  let t : (m : Fin N) → Finset (Fin (I m).card → ℕ) := fun m => Q.image (fun q => Φ q m)
  let H : ((m : Fin N) → (Fin (I m).card → ℕ)) → ℝ := fun x => ∏ m, ∏ j, c (x m j)
  have hblock : ∀ (s : Finset (Fin L)) (f : Fin L → ℝ),
      ∏ j, f (s.orderEmbOfFin rfl j) = ∏ x ∈ s, f x := by
    intro s f
    conv_rhs => rw [← Finset.map_orderEmbOfFin_univ s rfl]
    rw [Finset.prod_map]
    rfl
  have hF : ∀ q : Fin L → ℕ, ∏ i, c (q i) = H (Φ q) := by
    intro q
    have h1 := Finset.prod_fiberwise_of_maps_to (s := Finset.univ) (t := Finset.range N) (g := k)
      (fun i _ => Finset.mem_range.mpr (hk i)) (fun i => c (q i))
    refine h1.symm.trans ?_
    refine (Finset.prod_range
      (fun n => ∏ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i => k i = n), c (q i))).trans ?_
    exact Finset.prod_congr rfl (fun m _ => (hblock (I m) (fun i => c (q i))).symm)
  have hmemI : ∀ i : Fin L, ∃ j, e ⟨k i, hk i⟩ j = i := by
    intro i
    have hi : i ∈ I ⟨k i, hk i⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ i, rfl⟩
    have hr : i ∈ Set.range ((I ⟨k i, hk i⟩).orderEmbOfFin rfl) := by
      rw [Finset.range_orderEmbOfFin]
      exact hi
    exact hr
  have hinj : Set.InjOn Φ ↑Q := by
    intro q _ q' _ hqq'
    funext i
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hmemI i
    have h2 : q (e ⟨k i, hk i⟩ j) = q' (e ⟨k i, hk i⟩ j) :=
      congrFun (congrFun hqq' ⟨k i, hk i⟩) j
    rw [← hj]
    exact h2
  have hH : ∀ x, 0 ≤ H x := fun x =>
    Finset.prod_nonneg (fun m _ => Finset.prod_nonneg (fun j _ => hc _))
  have hsub : Q.image Φ ⊆ Fintype.piFinset t := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hx
    exact Fintype.mem_piFinset.mpr (fun m => Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ hq)
  have hblockβ : ∀ m : Fin N, ∑ p ∈ t m, ∏ j, c (p j) ≤ β m := by
    intro m
    apply hβ (m : ℕ) (I m).card (t m)
    intro p hp
    obtain ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hp
    refine ⟨(hQ q hq).1.comp_monotone (e m).monotone, fun j => ⟨((hQ q hq).2 (e m j)).1, ?_⟩⟩
    have h1 := ((hQ q hq).2 (e m j)).2
    have h2 : e m j ∈ I m := Finset.orderEmbOfFin_mem (I m) rfl j
    have h3 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp h2).2
    show lab (q (e m j)) = m
    rw [h1, h3]
  have hnn : ∀ m : Fin N, 0 ≤ ∑ p ∈ t m, ∏ j, c (p j) := fun m =>
    Finset.sum_nonneg (fun p _ => Finset.prod_nonneg (fun j _ => hc _))
  calc ∑ q ∈ Q, ∏ i, c (q i) = ∑ q ∈ Q, H (Φ q) := Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun q _ => hF q)
    _ = ∑ x ∈ Q.image Φ, H x := (Finset.sum_image hinj).symm
    _ ≤ ∑ x ∈ Fintype.piFinset t, H x :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hsub (fun x _ _ => hH x)
    _ = ∏ m, ∑ p ∈ t m, ∏ j, c (p j) :=
        (Finset.prod_univ_sum t (fun m p => ∏ j, c (p j))).symm
    _ ≤ ∏ m : Fin N, β m := Finset.prod_le_prod (fun m _ => hnn m) (fun m _ => hblockβ m)
    _ = ∏ m ∈ Finset.range N, β m := (Finset.prod_range β).symm

informal_problem.statement:
(hPNT : Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => (Nat.primeCounting ⌊x⌋₊ : ℝ) / (x / Real.log x)) atTop (𝓝 1))
    (hMERT : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ, 2 ≤ x →
      |(∑ p ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊x⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, (1 : ℝ) / p) - Real.log (Real.log x)| ≤ C)
    (hEULER : Asymptotics.IsEquivalent atTop
      (fun x : ℝ => ∏ p ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊x⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, (1 - (1 : ℝ) / p))
      (fun x => Real.exp (-Real.eulerMascheroniConstant) / Real.log x)) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop, ∀ (D : ℕ) (E : Set (Fin D → ℝ)) (Q : ℕ → Prop),
      E ⊆ Set.Icc (fun _ => 0) (fun _ => 1) →
      ((FordBadFacet.retainedGeometricValues x D E Q).card : ℝ) ≤
        C * x / Real.log x * (∑ n ∈ FordReciprocal.tupleIntegers D (logLog x) E, ((n.totient : ℝ))⁻¹) *
          (∑ m ∈ (totientsUpTo x).filter (fun m => ∃ n : ℕ, 0 < n ∧ n.totient = m ∧ Q n), (1 : ℝ) / m)

signature.statement:
(hPNT : Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => (Nat.primeCounting ⌊x⌋₊ : ℝ) / (x / Real.log x)) atTop (𝓝 1))
    (hMERT : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ, 2 ≤ x →
      |(∑ p ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊x⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, (1 : ℝ) / p) - Real.log (Real.log x)| ≤ C)
    (hEULER : Asymptotics.IsEquivalent atTop
      (fun x : ℝ => ∏ p ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊x⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, (1 - (1 : ℝ) / p))
      (fun x => Real.exp (-Real.eulerMascheroniConstant) / Real.log x)) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop, ∀ (D : ℕ) (E : Set (Fin D → ℝ)) (Q : ℕ → Prop),
      E ⊆ Set.Icc (fun _ => 0) (fun _ => 1) →
      ((FordBadFacet.retainedGeometricValues x D E Q).card : ℝ) ≤
        C * x / Real.log x * (∑ n ∈ FordReciprocal.tupleIntegers D (logLog x) E, ((n.totient : ℝ))⁻¹) *
          (∑ m ∈ (totientsUpTo x).filter (fun m => ∃ n : ℕ, 0 < n ∧ n.totient = m ∧ Q n), (1 : ℝ) / m)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have shifted_prime_core_value_count :
      ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ (B F : Finset ℕ) (x h : ℝ), 0 < x → 0 < h → (∀ b ∈ B, 0 < b) →
        (∀ v ∈ F, (v : ℝ) ≤ x ∧ ∃ p b : ℕ, p.Prime ∧ h ≤ Real.log p ∧ b ∈ B ∧ v = (p - 1) * b) →
        (F.card : ℝ) ≤ C * x / h * ∑ b ∈ B, (1 : ℝ) / b := by
    obtain ⟨C₀, hC₀, hpc⟩ := pc_two_factor_prime_count_bound hPNT
    refine ⟨C₀, hC₀, ?_⟩
    intro B F x h hx hh hB hF
    let G : ℕ → Finset ℕ := fun b =>
      F.filter (fun v => ∃ p : ℕ, p.Prime ∧ h ≤ Real.log p ∧ v = (p - 1) * b)
    have hsub : F ⊆ B.biUnion G := by
      intro v hv
      obtain ⟨_, p, b, hp, hlp, hb, hvpb⟩ := hF v hv
      exact Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨b, hb, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hv, p, hp, hlp, hvpb⟩⟩
    have hfib : ∀ b ∈ B, ((G b).card : ℝ) ≤ C₀ * (x / b) / h := by
      intro b hb
      have hb0 := hB b hb
      have hbR : (0 : ℝ) < b := by exact_mod_cast hb0
      have hπ : ∀ v ∈ G b, ∃ p : ℕ, p.Prime ∧ h ≤ Real.log p ∧ v = (p - 1) * b ∧
          v / b + 1 = p := by
        intro v hv
        obtain ⟨_, p, hp, hlp, hvpb⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hv
        refine ⟨p, hp, hlp, hvpb, ?_⟩
        rw [hvpb, Nat.mul_div_cancel _ hb0]
        have := hp.two_le
        omega
      have hinj : Set.InjOn (fun v => v / b + 1) (G b : Set ℕ) := by
        intro v hv w hw hvw
        obtain ⟨p, _, _, hvp, hπv⟩ := hπ v hv
        obtain ⟨q, _, _, hwq, hπw⟩ := hπ w hw
        have hpq : p = q := by
          rw [← hπv, ← hπw]
          exact hvw
        rw [hvp, hwq, hpq]
      rw [← Finset.card_image_of_injOn hinj]
      have hpc' := hpc ((G b).image (fun v => v / b + 1)) {1} {1} id (fun _ => 1) (fun _ => 1)
        (x / b) h (by positivity) hh (by
          intro n hn
          obtain ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hn
          obtain ⟨p, hp, hlp, hvp, hπv⟩ := hπ v hv
          rw [hπv]
          have hvx : (v : ℝ) ≤ x := (hF v (Finset.mem_filter.mp hv).1).1
          have hp1 : ((p : ℝ) - 1) = ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
            rw [Nat.cast_sub hp.one_le, Nat.cast_one]
          refine ⟨Finset.mem_singleton_self 1, Finset.mem_singleton_self 1, one_pos, one_pos,
            by simp, hp, hlp, ?_⟩
          simp only [id, Nat.totient_one, Nat.cast_one, mul_one]
          rw [hp1, le_div_iff₀ hbR]
          rw [hvp, Nat.cast_mul] at hvx
          exact hvx)
      simpa using hpc'
    calc (F.card : ℝ) ≤ ((B.biUnion G).card : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast Finset.card_le_card hsub
      _ ≤ ∑ b ∈ B, ((G b).card : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast Finset.card_biUnion_le
      _ ≤ ∑ b ∈ B, C₀ * (x / b) / h := Finset.sum_le_sum hfib
      _ = C₀ * x / h * ∑ b ∈ B, (1 : ℝ) / b := by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b _ => ?_)
        ring
  
  have separated_totient_two_cases : ∀ {a r : ℕ}, 0 < a → 0 < r →
      (∀ p q : ℕ, p.Prime → p ∣ a → q.Prime → q ∣ r → q ≤ p) →
      (a * r).totient = a.totient * r.totient ∨
        (a ≠ 1 ∧ (a.minFac - 1) * (a * r).totient = a.minFac * (a.totient * r.totient)) := by
    intro a r ha _ hsep
    by_cases hcop : Nat.Coprime a r
    · exact Or.inl (Nat.totient_mul hcop)
    · right
      have ha1 : a ≠ 1 := by
        rintro rfl
        exact hcop (Nat.coprime_one_left r)
      refine ⟨ha1, ?_⟩
      have hsp : (a.minFac).Prime := Nat.minFac_prime ha1
      have hg0 : Nat.gcd a r ≠ 0 := Nat.gcd_ne_zero_left ha.ne'
      have huniq : ∀ d : ℕ, d.Prime → d ∣ Nat.gcd a r → d = a.minFac := by
        intro d hd hdg
        have hda : d ∣ a := hdg.trans (Nat.gcd_dvd_left a r)
        have hdr : d ∣ r := hdg.trans (Nat.gcd_dvd_right a r)
        have h1 : a.minFac ≤ d := Nat.minFac_le_of_dvd hd.two_le hda
        have h2 : d ≤ a.minFac := hsep _ d hsp (Nat.minFac_dvd a) hd hdr
        omega
      obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ : ∃ k, Nat.gcd a r = a.minFac ^ k :=
        ⟨_, Nat.eq_prime_pow_of_unique_prime_dvd hg0 (fun hd hdg => huniq _ hd hdg)⟩
      cases k with
      | zero =>
        exact absurd (show Nat.gcd a r = 1 by rw [hk, pow_zero]) hcop
      | succ e =>
        have hkey := Nat.totient_gcd_mul_totient_mul a r
        rw [hk, Nat.totient_prime_pow_succ hsp, pow_succ] at hkey
        apply Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left (pow_pos hsp.pos e)
        calc a.minFac ^ e * ((a.minFac - 1) * (a * r).totient)
            = a.minFac ^ e * (a.minFac - 1) * (a * r).totient := by ring
          _ = a.totient * r.totient * (a.minFac ^ e * a.minFac) := hkey
          _ = a.minFac ^ e * (a.minFac * (a.totient * r.totient)) := by ring
  
  have two_case_core_reciprocal_bound : ∀ (P W B : Finset ℕ), (∀ a ∈ P, 0 < a) → (∀ m ∈ W, 0 < m) →
      (∀ c ∈ B, ∃ a ∈ P, ∃ m ∈ W, c = a.totient * m ∨
        (a ≠ 1 ∧ (a.minFac - 1) * c = a.minFac * (a.totient * m))) →
      (∑ c ∈ B, (1 : ℝ) / c) ≤ 2 * (∑ a ∈ P, ((a.totient : ℝ))⁻¹) * (∑ m ∈ W, (1 : ℝ) / m) := by
    intro P W B hP hW hB
    let g₀ : ℕ × ℕ → ℕ := fun am => am.1.totient * am.2
    let g₁ : ℕ × ℕ → ℕ := fun am => am.1.minFac * (am.1.totient * am.2) / (am.1.minFac - 1)
    have hsub : B ⊆ (P ×ˢ W).image g₀ ∪ (P ×ˢ W).image g₁ := by
      intro c hc
      obtain ⟨a, ha, m, hm, h⟩ := hB c hc
      rcases h with h | ⟨ha1, h⟩
      · exact Finset.mem_union_left _
          (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨(a, m), Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨ha, hm⟩, h.symm⟩)
      · refine Finset.mem_union_right _
          (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨(a, m), Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨ha, hm⟩, ?_⟩)
        have hs := (Nat.minFac_prime ha1).two_le
        show a.minFac * (a.totient * m) / (a.minFac - 1) = c
        rw [← h]
        exact Nat.mul_div_cancel_left c (by omega)
    have hnn : ∀ c : ℕ, (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / (c : ℝ) := fun c => by positivity
    have hpt : ∀ am ∈ P ×ˢ W, (1 : ℝ) / ((g₁ am : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (1 : ℝ) / ((g₀ am : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
      rintro ⟨a, m⟩ ham
      obtain ⟨ha, hm⟩ := Finset.mem_product.mp ham
      have hg0 : 0 < a.totient * m := Nat.mul_pos (Nat.totient_pos.mpr (hP a ha)) (hW m hm)
      show (1 : ℝ) / ((a.minFac * (a.totient * m) / (a.minFac - 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
        (1 : ℝ) / ((a.totient * m : ℕ) : ℝ)
      by_cases ha1 : a = 1
      · subst ha1
        simp only [Nat.minFac_one, Nat.sub_self, Nat.div_zero, Nat.cast_zero, div_zero]
        positivity
      · have hs := (Nat.minFac_prime ha1).two_le
        have hle : a.totient * m ≤ a.minFac * (a.totient * m) / (a.minFac - 1) := by
          rw [Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le (by omega)]
          have h1 : (a.totient * m) * (a.minFac - 1) ≤ (a.totient * m) * a.minFac :=
            Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (by omega)
          calc (a.totient * m) * (a.minFac - 1) ≤ (a.totient * m) * a.minFac := h1
            _ = a.minFac * (a.totient * m) := by ring
        exact one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by exact_mod_cast hg0) (by exact_mod_cast hle)
    have hprod : ∑ am ∈ P ×ˢ W, (1 : ℝ) / ((g₀ am : ℕ) : ℝ) =
        (∑ a ∈ P, ((a.totient : ℝ))⁻¹) * (∑ m ∈ W, (1 : ℝ) / m) := by
      rw [Finset.sum_product, Finset.sum_mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun m _ => ?_))
      show (1 : ℝ) / ((a.totient * m : ℕ) : ℝ) = ((a.totient : ℝ))⁻¹ * (1 / (m : ℝ))
      rw [Nat.cast_mul, one_div, mul_inv, one_div]
    have hunion := Finset.sum_union_inter (s₁ := (P ×ˢ W).image g₀) (s₂ := (P ×ˢ W).image g₁)
      (f := fun c : ℕ => (1 : ℝ) / c)
    have hint : 0 ≤ ∑ c ∈ (P ×ˢ W).image g₀ ∩ (P ×ˢ W).image g₁, (1 : ℝ) / c :=
      Finset.sum_nonneg (fun c _ => hnn c)
    have himg0 : ∑ c ∈ (P ×ˢ W).image g₀, (1 : ℝ) / c ≤
        ∑ am ∈ P ×ˢ W, (1 : ℝ) / ((g₀ am : ℕ) : ℝ) :=
      Finset.sum_image_le_of_nonneg (fun c _ => hnn c)
    have himg1 : ∑ c ∈ (P ×ˢ W).image g₁, (1 : ℝ) / c ≤
        ∑ am ∈ P ×ˢ W, (1 : ℝ) / ((g₁ am : ℕ) : ℝ) :=
      Finset.sum_image_le_of_nonneg (fun c _ => hnn c)
    have h01 : ∑ am ∈ P ×ˢ W, (1 : ℝ) / ((g₁ am : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
        ∑ am ∈ P ×ˢ W, (1 : ℝ) / ((g₀ am : ℕ) : ℝ) := Finset.sum_le_sum hpt
    have hB' : (∑ c ∈ B, (1 : ℝ) / c) ≤
        ∑ c ∈ (P ×ˢ W).image g₀ ∪ (P ×ˢ W).image g₁, (1 : ℝ) / c :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hsub (fun c _ _ => hnn c)
    have hunion' : ∑ c ∈ (P ×ˢ W).image g₀ ∪ (P ×ˢ W).image g₁, (1 : ℝ) / c +
        ∑ c ∈ (P ×ˢ W).image g₀ ∩ (P ×ˢ W).image g₁, (1 : ℝ) / c =
        ∑ c ∈ (P ×ˢ W).image g₀, (1 : ℝ) / c + ∑ c ∈ (P ×ˢ W).image g₁, (1 : ℝ) / c := hunion
    rw [mul_assoc, ← hprod]
    linarith
  
  have cardFactors_le_cardFactors_totient_add_one : ∀ N : ℕ, 0 < N →
      ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors N ≤ ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors N.totient + 1 := by
    intro N hN
    have key : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors n ≤
        ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors n.totient + (if 2 ∣ n then 1 else 0) := by
      intro n
      induction n using Nat.recOnPosPrimePosCoprime with
      | prime_pow p k hp hk =>
        intro _
        have hp2 := hp.two_le

      · intro i j hij

  obtain ⟨C₂, hC₂, hcount⟩ := shifted_prime_core_value_count
  refine ⟨12 * C₂, by positivity, ?_⟩
  have hLL : Tendsto logLog atTop atTop := Real.tendsto_log_atTop.comp Real.tendsto_log_atTop

  intro D E Q _hE
  have hx0 : 0 < x := by linarith

  have hxx : Real.exp (Real.exp (logLog x)) = x := by
    unfold logLog

  have hmemT : ∀ n : ℕ, n ∈ totientsUpTo x ↔ (1 ≤ n ∧ n ≤ ⌊x⌋₊) ∧ ∃ m : ℕ, m.totient = n := by

  set P := FordReciprocal.tupleIntegers D (logLog x) E with hPdef
  set W := (totientsUpTo x).filter (fun m => ∃ n : ℕ, 0 < n ∧ n.totient = m ∧ Q n) with hWdef
  set B := (Finset.range (⌊x⌋₊ + 1)).filter (fun c => 0 < c ∧ ∃ a ∈ P, ∃ m ∈ W,
    c = a.totient * m ∨ (a ≠ 1 ∧ (a.minFac - 1) * c = a.minFac * (a.totient * m))) with hBdef
  set F := FordBadFacet.retainedGeometricValues x D E Q with hFdef
  have hrep : ∀ v ∈ F, (v : ℝ) ≤ x ∧ ∃ p b : ℕ, p.Prime ∧ Real.log x / 6 ≤ Real.log p ∧

    intro v hv
    obtain ⟨hvV, hvl, hbad, hΩ, hSq, N, hN, hNv, hpoint, hQ⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hv
    obtain ⟨⟨hv1, hvfl⟩, _⟩ := (hmemT v).mp hvV
    have hvx : (v : ℝ) ≤ x := (Nat.le_floor_iff hx0.le).mp hvfl
    have hv3 : (3 : ℝ) ≤ v := hsq3.trans hvl
    have hv3' : 3 ≤ v := by exact_mod_cast hv3
    have hΩv : (ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors v : ℝ) ≤ 5 * logLog v := by

    have hLv : logLog v ≤ logLog x := by

    have hq2 := third_prime_le_of_not_badFacet hT hvV hN hNv hbad
    have hsqN : ∀ q : ℕ, q.Prime → Real.log x ^ 4 < (q : ℝ) → ¬ q ^ 2 ∣ N := by

    obtain ⟨hp, hplog, hgap⟩ := htop N hN hNv' hΩN hq2 hsqN
    obtain ⟨hφ, hsep, hr0, hrle, hpr1, hanti, hlt⟩ := ordinary_prefix_residual_split N D hN hp hgap
    have hp2 := hp.two_le
    have ha0 : 0 < ∏ i : Fin D, FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N (i.val + 1) := by

    have hb0 := Nat.totient_pos.mpr har0

    have hp1 : 1 ≤ FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N 0 - 1 := by omega
    have hbv : ((∏ i : Fin D, FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N (i.val + 1)) *
          FordBadFacet.ordinarySuffix (FordBadFacet.ordinarySuffix N 1) D).totient ≤ v := by
      rw [hvφ]; exact Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left _ hp1
    have hpv : FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N 0 - 1 ≤ v := by
      rw [hvφ]; exact Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ hb0
    have haP : (∏ i : Fin D, FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N (i.val + 1)) ∈ P := by
      have hle : ∀ i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin D)),
          FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N (i.val + 1) ≤ ⌊x⌋₊ := by
        intro i _
        have := hlt i
        omega
      refine Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨ha0, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
      · rw [hxx]
        calc (∏ i : Fin D, FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N (i.val + 1))
            ≤ ⌊x⌋₊ ^ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin D)).card := Finset.prod_le_pow_card _ _ _ hle
          _ = ⌊x⌋₊ ^ D := by rw [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
      · exact ⟨fun i => FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N (i.val + 1), rfl, hpr1, hanti, hpoint⟩
    have hrW : (FordBadFacet.ordinarySuffix (FordBadFacet.ordinarySuffix N 1) D).totient ∈ W := by
      refine Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨?_, _, hr0, rfl, hQ⟩
      exact (hmemT _).mpr ⟨⟨Nat.totient_pos.mpr hr0, (hrle.trans hNv.le).trans hvfl⟩, _, rfl⟩

      refine Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega), hb0, _, haP, _, hrW, ?_⟩

  have hB0 : ∀ b ∈ B, 0 < b := fun b hb => (Finset.mem_filter.mp hb).2.1
  have hc := hcount B F x (Real.log x / 6) hx0 (by positivity) hB0 hrep

by
  have hREN := ford_renewal_scaled_bounds hRHO

  have hERR : ∃ lam : ℝ, ∀ n : ℕ,
      |FordAnalysis.g n * FordAnalysis.rho ^ n - lam| ≤ 5 * FordAnalysis.rho ^ n :=
    ⟨_, ford_renewal_error hRHO ⟨hREN.1, hREN.2.1⟩ hNUM.2.1.2⟩
  obtain ⟨hw, hc, hz, hmean, hW⟩ := renewal_concentration_coefficients hREN hERR
  
  have key : ∀ (S X q Lr dd : ℝ), 0 < Lr → 0 < dd → q = dd / Lr → 32960 ≤ dd →
      |S - X| ≤ 400 / Lr → 1 / 20 / 2 ≤ |X / q - 1| → 1 / 80 ≤ |S / q - 1| := by
    intro S X q Lr dd hLr hdd hq hdd' hSX hX
    have hqpos : 0 < q := by rw [hq]; positivity
    have h1 : |S / q - X / q| = |S - X| / q := by
      rw [← sub_div, abs_div, abs_of_pos hqpos]
    have hLr' := hLr.ne'
    have hdd'' := hdd.ne'
    have h2 : |S - X| / q ≤ 400 / dd := by
      calc |S - X| / q ≤ (400 / Lr) / q := by gcongr
        _ = 400 / dd := by rw [hq]; field_simp
    have h3 : 400 / dd ≤ 400 / 32960 := by gcongr
    have h4 := abs_sub_le (X / q) (S / q) 1
    rw [abs_sub_comm (X / q) (S / q)] at h4
    linarith
  
  have alg : ∀ (V1 V2 H W B E F m K Ar : ℝ), V1 ≤ H * V2 → V2 ≤ E * (F * m) * W → W ≤ B →
      F * B ≤ K / Ar → H ≤ 2 → 0 ≤ E → 0 ≤ F → 0 ≤ m → 0 ≤ V2 →
      V1 ≤ (2 * E * K / Ar) * m := by
    intro V1 V2 H W B E F m K Ar h1 h2 h3 h4 hH2 hE hF hm hV2
    have hEm : 0 ≤ E * m := mul_nonneg hE hm
    have h5 : V2 ≤ E * m * (K / Ar) := by
      calc V2 ≤ E * (F * m) * W := h2
        _ ≤ E * (F * m) * B := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h3 (by positivity)
        _ = E * m * (F * B) := by ring
        _ ≤ E * m * (K / Ar) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h4 hEm
    calc V1 ≤ H * V2 := h1
      _ ≤ 2 * V2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hH2 hV2
      _ ≤ 2 * (E * m * (K / Ar)) := by linarith
      _ = (2 * E * K / Ar) * m := by ring
  refine ⟨2 * Real.exp 80 * (45000 * 160 ^ 4), by positivity, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [expanded_parameter_product_eventually_close (1 / 80) (by norm_num)] with M hM
  intro L hL A hA τ hτ hsmall
  have hξ : ∀ j, 1 ≤ FordGeometry.expandedParameter (L + M) j := by
    intro j
    unfold FordGeometry.expandedParameter
    exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (by positivity)
  have hH := hM L
  
  have h1 := parameter_concentration_diagonal_reduction L (FordGeometry.expandedParameter (L + M))
    A (1 / 20) τ hξ (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by linarith) hτ
  
  obtain ⟨Φ, hvol, hmem⟩ := thickened_slack_transfer L hL τ hτ hsmall hRHO.1 (hw L) (hc L) (hW L)
  
  have h6 := simplex_concentration_union_volume simplex_linear_statistic_fourth_tail L A hA
    (fun i j => FordOrder.invWeight L i j / (FordAnalysis.rho ^ (i.val + 1) * FordOrder.weight L j))
    (hc L) (hz L) (fun i _ => hmean L i)
  beta_reduce at h6
  have hLpos : (0 : ℝ) < L := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < L by omega)
  have hA' : (32960 : ℝ) ≤ A := by exact_mod_cast hA
  
  have hsub : Φ '' (FordGeometry.parameterConcentrationUnion L (fun _ => 1) A (1 / 20 / 2) +
      Set.Icc (fun _ : Fin L => -τ) (fun _ => τ)) ⊆
      {u : Fin L → ℝ | (∀ j, 0 ≤ u j) ∧ ∑ j, u j ≤ 1 ∧
        ∃ i ∈ FordGeometry.concentrationIndices L A,
          (1 / 80 : ℝ) ≤ |(∑ j, FordOrder.invWeight L i j /
              (FordAnalysis.rho ^ (i.val + 1) * FordOrder.weight L j) * u j) /
            ((FordGeometry.concentrationDistance i : ℝ) / (L : ℝ)) - 1|} := by
    rintro _ ⟨z, hz', rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨x, hx, e, he, rfl⟩ := Set.mem_add.mp hz'
    obtain ⟨hxP, i, hi, hdev⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨h0, hs1, hdrift⟩ := hmem x hxP e he
    refine ⟨h0, hs1, i, hi, ?_⟩
    have hdA : (A : ℝ) ≤ (FordGeometry.concentrationDistance i : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2
    have hdpos : (0 : ℝ) < (FordGeometry.concentrationDistance i : ℝ) := by linarith
    rw [← div_div] at hdev
    exact key _ _ _ _ _ hLpos hdpos rfl (by linarith) (hdrift i) hdev
  
  have hfin : MeasureTheory.volume
      {u : Fin L → ℝ | (∀ j, 0 ≤ u j) ∧ ∑ j, u j ≤ 1 ∧
        ∃ i ∈ FordGeometry.concentrationIndices L A,
          (1 / 80 : ℝ) ≤ |(∑ j, FordOrder.invWeight L i j /
              (FordAnalysis.rho ^ (i.val + 1) * FordOrder.weight L j) * u j) /
            ((FordGeometry.concentrationDistance i : ℝ) / (L : ℝ)) - 1|} ≠ ⊤ := by
    refine ne_top_of_le_ne_top

    intro u hu

    refine ⟨fun j => hu0 j, fun j => ?_⟩
    have := Finset.single_le_sum (fun k _ => hu0 k) (Finset.mem_univ j)

    linarith
