    have hlogzx : Real.log z ≤ Real.log x := Real.log_le_log (by linarith) hzx
    have hlogz0 : 0 < Real.log z := lt_of_lt_of_le hlog2 hlogz
    have hlogx0 : 0 < Real.log x := lt_of_lt_of_le hlogz0 hlogzx
    have hlogS0 : 0 < Real.log S := lt_of_lt_of_le hlog2 hlogS
    set u := Real.log x / 2 with hu
    have hu0 : 0 < u := by positivity
    set s := Real.exp u with hs
    have hs0 : 0 < s := Real.exp_pos u
    have hss : s * s = x := by
      rw [hs, ← Real.exp_add]
      have : u + u = Real.log x := by rw [hu]; ring
      rw [this, Real.exp_log hx0]
    have hs1 : 1 < s := by have := Real.add_one_le_exp u; linarith
    set L := min z s with hL
    have hL1 : 1 < L := lt_min (by linarith) hs1
    have hL0 : 0 < L := by linarith
    have hLs : L ≤ s := min_le_right _ _
    have hLz : L ≤ z := min_le_left _ _
    have hlogL0 : 0 < Real.log L := Real.log_pos hL1
    have hlogLu : Real.log L ≤ u := by
      have := Real.log_le_log hL0 hLs
      rwa [hs, Real.log_exp] at this
    have hlogLz : Real.log z / 2 ≤ Real.log L := by
      rcases le_total z s with h | h
      · rw [hL, min_eq_left h]; linarith
      · rw [hL, min_eq_right h, hs, Real.log_exp, hu]; linarith
    set b := ∏ p ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊S⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, p with hb
    have hbpos : 0 < b := Finset.prod_pos (fun p hp => (Finset.mem_filter.mp hp).2.pos)
    have hsubset : (Finset.Icc 1 ⌊x⌋₊).filter (fun n => ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → S < (p : ℝ) →
        (p : ℝ) ≤ z → ¬ p ∣ n) ⊆
        (Finset.Icc 1 ⌊x⌋₊).filter (fun n => ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → (p : ℝ) ≤ L → ¬ p ∣ b → ¬ p ∣ n) := by
      intro n hn
      rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hn ⊢
      refine ⟨hn.1, fun p hp hpL hpb => hn.2 p hp ?_ (hpL.trans hLz)⟩
      by_contra hle
      push_neg at hle
      apply hpb
      apply Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem
      rw [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Iic]
      exact ⟨Nat.le_floor hle, hp⟩
    have hcard := (Nat.cast_le (α := ℝ)).mpr (Finset.card_le_card hsubset)
    have hsv' := hSIEVE b ⌊x⌋₊ L hbpos hL1
    have hr' := hr S hS
    have hN : ((⌊x⌋₊ : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ x := Nat.floor_le hx0.le
    have hN0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ((⌊x⌋₊ : ℕ) : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
    have hratio0 : 0 ≤ (b : ℝ) / (b.totient : ℝ) := by positivity
    have hmain : 2 * ((b : ℝ) / b.totient) * ⌊x⌋₊ / Real.log L ≤
        4 * C₂ * x * Real.log S / Real.log z := by
      rw [div_le_div_iff₀ hlogL0 hlogz0]
      have h1 : 2 * ((b : ℝ) / b.totient) * ⌊x⌋₊ ≤ 2 * (C₂ * Real.log S) * x := by
        have := mul_le_mul hr' hN hN0 (by positivity)
        nlinarith
      have h2 : 0 ≤ 2 * (C₂ * Real.log S) * x := by positivity
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 hlogz0.le,
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (show Real.log z ≤ 2 * Real.log L by linarith) h2]
    have hexp4 : (1 + u) ^ 4 ≤ 256 * s := by
      have h1 : 1 + u / 4 ≤ Real.exp (u / 4) := by
        have := Real.add_one_le_exp (u / 4); linarith
      have h2 : (Real.exp (u / 4)) ^ 4 = s := by
        rw [hs, ← Real.exp_nat_mul]; congr 1; push_cast; ring
      have h3 : (1 + u) / 4 ≤ 1 + u / 4 := by linarith
      have h4 : ((1 + u) / 4) ^ 4 ≤ (Real.exp (u / 4)) ^ 4 :=
        pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) (h3.trans h1) 4
      rw [h2] at h4
      have h5 : ((1 + u) / 4) ^ 4 = (1 + u) ^ 4 / 256 := by ring
      rw [h5] at h4
      linarith
    have herr : L * (1 + Real.log L) ^ 3 ≤ 512 / Real.log 2 * x * Real.log S / Real.log z := by
      have hA : L * (1 + Real.log L) ^ 3 ≤ s * (1 + u) ^ 3 := by
        apply mul_le_mul hLs _ (by positivity) hs0.le
        exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) (by linarith) 3
      have hB : s * (1 + u) ^ 3 * Real.log x ≤ 512 * x := by
        have hlx : Real.log x = 2 * u := by rw [hu]; ring
        rw [hlx]
        have hq : (1 + u) ^ 3 * (2 * u) ≤ 2 * (1 + u) ^ 4 := by
          have he : 2 * (1 + u) ^ 4 - (1 + u) ^ 3 * (2 * u) = 2 * (1 + u) ^ 3 := by ring
          have hp : 0 ≤ 2 * (1 + u) ^ 3 := by positivity
          linarith
        calc s * (1 + u) ^ 3 * (2 * u) = s * ((1 + u) ^ 3 * (2 * u)) := by ring
          _ ≤ s * (2 * (1 + u) ^ 4) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hq hs0.le
          _ ≤ s * (2 * (256 * s)) := by
            apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ hs0.le; linarith
          _ = 512 * x := by rw [← hss]; ring
      have hC : L * (1 + Real.log L) ^ 3 * Real.log z ≤ 512 * x := by
        calc L * (1 + Real.log L) ^ 3 * Real.log z ≤ s * (1 + u) ^ 3 * Real.log x :=
              mul_le_mul hA hlogzx hlogz0.le (by positivity)
          _ ≤ 512 * x := hB
      rw [le_div_iff₀ hlogz0]
      have hq : 1 ≤ Real.log S / Real.log 2 := (one_le_div hlog2).mpr hlogS
      have : 512 * x ≤ 512 / Real.log 2 * x * Real.log S := by
        calc 512 * x = 512 * x * 1 := by ring
          _ ≤ 512 * x * (Real.log S / Real.log 2) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hq (by positivity)
          _ = 512 / Real.log 2 * x * Real.log S := by ring
      linarith
    calc _ ≤ _ := hcard
      _ ≤ _ := hsv'
      _ ≤ 4 * C₂ * x * Real.log S / Real.log z + 512 / Real.log 2 * x * Real.log S / Real.log z :=
          add_le_add hmain herr
      _ = (4 * C₂ + 512 / Real.log 2) * x * Real.log S / Real.log z := by ring
  obtain ⟨B, hB, hMe⟩ : ∃ B : ℝ, 0 ≤ B ∧ ∀ u v : ℝ, 2 ≤ u → u ≤ v →
      (∑ p ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊v⌋₊).filter (fun p : ℕ => p.Prime ∧ u < (p : ℝ)), (1 : ℝ) / p) ≤
        logLog v - logLog u + B := by
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hMERT
    refine ⟨2 * |C|, by positivity, ?_⟩
    intro u v hu huv
    have hu0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ u := by linarith
    have hsub : (Finset.Iic ⌊u⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime ⊆ (Finset.Iic ⌊v⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime := by
      intro p hp
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Iic] at hp ⊢
      exact ⟨hp.1.trans (Nat.floor_mono huv), hp.2⟩
    have hset : (Finset.Iic ⌊v⌋₊).filter (fun p : ℕ => p.Prime ∧ u < (p : ℝ)) =
        (Finset.Iic ⌊v⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime \ (Finset.Iic ⌊u⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime := by
      ext p
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Iic, Finset.mem_sdiff, not_and]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨hpv, hp, hup⟩
        refine ⟨⟨hpv, hp⟩, fun hpu _ => ?_⟩
        have := (Nat.le_floor_iff hu0).mp hpu
        linarith
      · rintro ⟨⟨hpv, hp⟩, hnot⟩
        refine ⟨hpv, hp, ?_⟩
        by_contra hle
        push_neg at hle
        exact hnot (Nat.le_floor hle) hp
    rw [hset, Finset.sum_sdiff_eq_sub hsub]
    have h1 := hC v (hu.trans huv)
    have h2 := hC u hu
    rw [abs_le] at h1 h2
    have hC0 : C ≤ |C| := le_abs_self C
    unfold logLog
    linarith
  have hCH : ∀ (M P : Finset ℕ) (a R H : ℝ), 1 ≤ a → (∀ n ∈ M, Squarefree n ∧ n.primeFactors ⊆ P ∧
      R ≤ (ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors n : ℝ)) → (∑ p ∈ P, (1 : ℝ) / p) ≤ H →
      (∑ n ∈ M, (n : ℝ)⁻¹) ≤ Real.exp (a * H - R * Real.log a) := by
    intro M P a R H ha hM hP
    have ha0 : 0 < a := by linarith
    have hterm : ∀ n ∈ M, (n : ℝ)⁻¹ * a ^ R ≤ ∏ p ∈ n.primeFactors, a / (p : ℝ) := by
      intro n hn
      obtain ⟨hsq, _, hR⟩ := hM n hn
      have hn0 : n ≠ 0 := hsq.ne_zero
      have hcard : n.primeFactors.card = ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors n := by
        rw [← (ArithmeticFunction.cardDistinctFactors_eq_cardFactors_iff_squarefree hn0).mpr hsq]
        exact (Nat.add_zero _).symm
      have hprod : ∏ p ∈ n.primeFactors, a / (p : ℝ) = a ^ (n.primeFactors.card) / (n : ℝ) := by
        rw [Finset.prod_div_distrib, Finset.prod_const]
        congr 1
        rw [← Nat.cast_prod, Nat.prod_primeFactors_of_squarefree hsq]
      rw [hprod, hcard]
      have hpow : a ^ R ≤ a ^ (ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors n) := by
        rw [← Real.rpow_natCast]
        exact Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le ha hR
      have hnpos : (0 : ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn0
      rw [inv_mul_eq_div]
      exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hpow hnpos.le
    have hinj : Set.InjOn Nat.primeFactors (M : Set ℕ) := by
      intro m hm n hn h
      have h1 := Nat.prod_primeFactors_of_squarefree (hM m hm).1
      have h2 := Nat.prod_primeFactors_of_squarefree (hM n hn).1
      rw [← h1, ← h2, h]
    have hsum : (∑ n ∈ M, (n : ℝ)⁻¹) * a ^ R ≤ ∏ p ∈ P, (1 + a / (p : ℝ)) := by
      rw [Finset.sum_mul]
      calc ∑ n ∈ M, (n : ℝ)⁻¹ * a ^ R ≤ ∑ n ∈ M, ∏ p ∈ n.primeFactors, a / (p : ℝ) :=
            Finset.sum_le_sum hterm
        _ = ∑ t ∈ M.image Nat.primeFactors, ∏ p ∈ t, a / (p : ℝ) :=
            (Finset.sum_image (f := fun t : Finset ℕ => ∏ p ∈ t, a / (p : ℝ)) hinj).symm
        _ ≤ ∑ t ∈ P.powerset, ∏ p ∈ t, a / (p : ℝ) := by
            apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg
            · intro t ht
              obtain ⟨n, hn, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp ht
              exact Finset.mem_powerset.mpr (hM n hn).2.1
            · intro t _ _
              exact Finset.prod_nonneg (fun p _ => div_nonneg ha0.le (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
        _ = ∏ p ∈ P, (1 + a / (p : ℝ)) := by
            rw [Finset.prod_one_add]
    have hexp : ∏ p ∈ P, (1 + a / (p : ℝ)) ≤ Real.exp (a * H) := by
      calc ∏ p ∈ P, (1 + a / (p : ℝ)) ≤ ∏ p ∈ P, Real.exp (a / (p : ℝ)) := by
            apply Finset.prod_le_prod
            · intro p _
              have : 0 ≤ a / (p : ℝ) := div_nonneg ha0.le (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
              linarith
            · intro p _
              have := Real.add_one_le_exp (a / (p : ℝ))
              linarith
        _ = Real.exp (a * ∑ p ∈ P, (1 : ℝ) / p) := by
            rw [← Real.exp_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
            congr 1
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro p _
            ring
        _ ≤ Real.exp (a * H) := by
            apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
            exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hP ha0.le
    have haR : a ^ R = Real.exp (R * Real.log a) := by
      rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos ha0, mul_comm]
    have hpos : 0 < a ^ R := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos ha0 R
    rw [Real.exp_sub, le_div_iff₀ (Real.exp_pos _), ← haR]
    linarith
  have hfiber : ∀ C : ℝ, 0 < C → (∀ x S z : ℝ, 2 ≤ S → S ≤ z → z ≤ x →
      (((Finset.Icc 1 ⌊x⌋₊).filter (fun n => ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → S < (p : ℝ) → (p : ℝ) ≤ z →
        ¬ p ∣ n)).card : ℝ) ≤ C * x * Real.log S / Real.log z) →
      ∀ (x S z : ℝ) (G : Finset ℕ), 1 < x → 1 ≤ logLog x → 2 ≤ S → S ≤ z →
      z ≤ x ^ (1 / (20 * logLog x)) → (∀ n ∈ G, 0 < n ∧ (n : ℝ) ≤ x) →
      (∀ n ∈ G, (ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors n : ℝ) ≤ 5 * logLog x) →
      (G.card : ℝ) ≤ C * x * Real.log S / Real.log z * ∑ m ∈ G.image (fun n : ℕ =>
        (∏ p ∈ n.primeFactors.filter (fun p : ℕ => S < (p : ℝ) ∧ (p : ℝ) ≤ z),
          p ^ n.factorization p : ℕ)), (m : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
    intro C hC hAV x S z G hx hT hS hSz hz hG hOm
    set f : ℕ → ℕ := fun n => ∏ p ∈ n.primeFactors.filter (fun p : ℕ => S < (p : ℝ) ∧ (p : ℝ) ≤ z),
      p ^ n.factorization p with hf
    set r : ℕ → ℕ := fun n => ∏ p ∈ n.primeFactors.filter
      (fun p : ℕ => ¬ (S < (p : ℝ) ∧ (p : ℝ) ≤ z)), p ^ n.factorization p with hr
    have hfr : ∀ n, n ≠ 0 → f n * r n = n := by
      intro n hn
      have h := Nat.factorization_prod_pow_eq_self hn
      rw [Finsupp.prod, Nat.support_factorization] at h
      simp only [hf, hr]
      rw [Finset.prod_filter_mul_prod_filter_not]
      exact h
    have hravoid : ∀ n, ∀ q : ℕ, q.Prime → S < (q : ℝ) → (q : ℝ) ≤ z → ¬ q ∣ r n := by
      intro n q hq hSq hqz hdvd
      simp only [hr] at hdvd
      obtain ⟨p, hp, hqp⟩ := (Prime.dvd_finset_prod_iff hq.prime _).mp hdvd
      have hp' := Finset.mem_filter.mp hp
      have hpprime : p.Prime := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp'.1
      have hqp' := (Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq hq hpprime).mp (hq.dvd_of_dvd_pow hqp)
      subst hqp'
      exact hp'.2 ⟨hSq, hqz⟩
    have hOmegaSum : ∀ n : ℕ, ∑ p ∈ n.primeFactors, n.factorization p =
        ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors n := by
      intro n
      rw [ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors_apply, ← List.sum_toFinset_count_eq_length,
        Nat.toFinset_factors]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro p _
      rw [Nat.primeFactorsList_count_eq]
    have hx0 : 0 < x := by linarith
    have hlogx : 0 < Real.log x := Real.log_pos hx
    have hT0 : 0 < logLog x := by linarith
    have hz1 : 1 ≤ z := by linarith
    have hz0 : 0 < z := by linarith
    have h20 : 0 < 20 * logLog x := by positivity
    have hlogz : Real.log z * (20 * logLog x) ≤ Real.log x := by
      have := Real.log_le_log hz0 hz
      rw [Real.log_rpow hx0, div_mul_eq_mul_div, one_mul, le_div_iff₀ h20] at this
      exact this
    have hlz0 : 0 ≤ Real.log z := Real.log_nonneg hz1
    have hfsize : ∀ n ∈ G, (f n : ℝ) * z ≤ x := by
      intro n hn
      have hsum_le : ∑ p ∈ n.primeFactors.filter (fun p : ℕ => S < (p : ℝ) ∧ (p : ℝ) ≤ z),
          n.factorization p ≤ ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors n := by
        calc _ ≤ ∑ p ∈ n.primeFactors, n.factorization p :=
              Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset (Finset.filter_subset _ _)
          _ = ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors n := hOmegaSum n
      have h1 : (f n : ℝ) ≤ z ^ (∑ p ∈ n.primeFactors.filter
          (fun p : ℕ => S < (p : ℝ) ∧ (p : ℝ) ≤ z), n.factorization p) := by
        simp only [hf]
        push_cast
        rw [← Finset.prod_pow_eq_pow_sum]
        apply Finset.prod_le_prod (fun p _ => by positivity)
        intro p hp
        exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (Finset.mem_filter.mp hp).2.2 _
      have h2 : z ^ (∑ p ∈ n.primeFactors.filter
          (fun p : ℕ => S < (p : ℝ) ∧ (p : ℝ) ≤ z), n.factorization p) ≤
          z ^ (ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors n) := pow_le_pow_right₀ hz1 hsum_le
      have h3 : z ^ (ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors n + 1) ≤ x := by
        rw [← Real.exp_log (pow_pos hz0 _), ← Real.exp_log hx0, Real.log_pow]
        apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
        push_cast
        have hOm' := hOm n hn
        nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hOm' hlz0, mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hT) hlz0]
      calc (f n : ℝ) * z ≤ z ^ (ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors n) * z :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (h1.trans h2) hz0.le
        _ = z ^ (ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors n + 1) := (pow_succ _ _).symm
        _ ≤ x := h3
    rw [Finset.card_eq_sum_card_image f G]
    push_cast
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro m hm
    obtain ⟨n₀, hn₀, hm₀⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hm
    have hn₀0 : n₀ ≠ 0 := (hG n₀ hn₀).1.ne'
    have hm0 : 0 < m := by
      rw [← hm₀]
      apply Nat.pos_of_ne_zero
      intro h
      apply hn₀0
      rw [← hfr n₀ hn₀0, h, zero_mul]
    have hmR : (0 : ℝ) < m := by exact_mod_cast hm0
    have hzxm : z ≤ x / m := by
      rw [le_div_iff₀ hmR, ← hm₀]
      have := hfsize n₀ hn₀
      linarith
    have hcard : ((G.filter (fun n => f n = m)).card : ℝ) ≤
        (((Finset.Icc 1 ⌊x / m⌋₊).filter (fun n => ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → S < (p : ℝ) →
          (p : ℝ) ≤ z → ¬ p ∣ n)).card : ℝ) := by
      apply Nat.cast_le.mpr
      apply Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn r
      · intro n hn
        obtain ⟨hnG, hfn⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hn
        obtain ⟨hnpos, hnx⟩ := hG n hnG
        have hmul := hfr n hnpos.ne'
        rw [hfn] at hmul
        have hr0 : r n ≠ 0 := by
          intro h
          rw [h, mul_zero] at hmul
          omega
        rw [Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc]
        refine ⟨⟨Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr hr0, Nat.le_floor ?_⟩,
          fun q hq h1 h2 => hravoid n q hq h1 h2⟩
        rw [le_div_iff₀ hmR]
        have hc : ((m * r n : ℕ) : ℝ) = n := by rw [hmul]
        push_cast at hc
        linarith
      · intro n₁ hn₁ n₂ hn₂ heq
        obtain ⟨hn₁G, hf₁⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp (Finset.mem_coe.mp hn₁)
        obtain ⟨hn₂G, hf₂⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp (Finset.mem_coe.mp hn₂)
        have e1 := hfr n₁ (hG n₁ hn₁G).1.ne'
        have e2 := hfr n₂ (hG n₂ hn₂G).1.ne'
        rw [← e1, ← e2, hf₁, hf₂, heq]
    have hav := hAV (x / m) S z hS hSz hzxm
    calc ((G.filter (fun n => f n = m)).card : ℝ) ≤ _ := hcard
      _ ≤ C * (x / m) * Real.log S / Real.log z := hav
      _ = C * x * Real.log S / Real.log z * (m : ℝ)⁻¹ := by ring
  refine ⟨C₁, B, hC₁, hB, ?_⟩
  intro x k w a δ G hx hT hw0 hw hcut ha hG hOmega hSq hlow
  have hwk : w 0 ≤ w k := hw 0 k (Nat.zero_le _) le_rfl
  have hfib := hfiber C₁ hC₁ hAV x (w 0) (w k) G hx hT hw0 hwk hcut hG hOmega
  have hcell : ∀ idx : Fin k, (∑ p ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊w (idx.val + 1)⌋₊).filter
      (fun p : ℕ => p.Prime ∧ w idx.val < (p : ℝ)), (1 : ℝ) / p) ≤
      logLog (w (idx.val + 1)) - logLog (w idx.val) + B := by
    intro idx
    have h1 : w 0 ≤ w idx.val := hw 0 idx.val (Nat.zero_le _) idx.isLt.le
    have h2 : w idx.val ≤ w (idx.val + 1) := hw idx.val (idx.val + 1) (Nat.le_succ _) idx.isLt
    exact hMe _ _ (hw0.trans h1) h2
  have hrec := interval_factor_reciprocal_product_of_chernoff hCH
    B k w a δ G hw0 hw ha (fun n hn => (hG n hn).1) hSq hlow hcell
  have hpos : 0 ≤ C₁ * x * Real.log (w 0) / Real.log (w k) := by
    have h1 : 0 ≤ Real.log (w 0) := Real.log_nonneg (by linarith)
    have h2 : 0 ≤ Real.log (w k) := Real.log_nonneg (by linarith)
    have h3 : 0 ≤ x := by linarith
    have h4 : 0 ≤ C₁ * x * Real.log (w 0) := by positivity
    exact div_nonneg h4 h2
  exact hfib.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hrec hpos)

subgoal_signatures.name: selberg_sieve_simple_bound
subgoal_signatures.statement:

      norm_num at h3 ⊢
      linarith
    have hprod : 1 ≤ N^2 * Real.exp ((k:ℝ)/40) :=
      one_le_mul_of_one_le_of_one_le hN2 (Real.one_le_exp (by positivity))
    have hbase : (⌊2 / h⌋₊ : ℝ) + 1 ≤ Real.exp (21 * N) := by
      calc (⌊2 / h⌋₊ : ℝ) + 1 ≤ 200001 * (N^2 * Real.exp ((k:ℝ)/40)) := by
            have hM' := hM.trans (le_of_eq h2h); linarith
        _ ≤ Real.exp 18 * (Real.exp (2*N) * Real.exp N) := by gcongr
        _ = Real.exp (18 + 3 * N) := by
            rw [← Real.exp_add, ← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; ring
        _ ≤ Real.exp (21 * N) := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
    have hpow : ((⌊2 / h⌋₊ : ℝ) + 1)^k ≤ Real.exp (21 * N)^k :=
      pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) hbase k
    rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul] at hpow
    have hkN : (k:ℝ) * (21 * N) ≤ 21 * N^2 := by rw [hNk]; linarith
    have hpow2 : ((⌊2 / h⌋₊ : ℝ) + 1)^k ≤ Real.exp (21 * N^2) :=
      hpow.trans (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hkN)
    have hNN : N ≤ N^2 := by rw [sq]; exact le_mul_of_one_le_left (by linarith) hN1
    have hNexp : N ≤ Real.exp (3 * N^2) := hexpN.trans (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith))
    have hcast : ((((k + 1) * (⌊2 / h⌋₊ + 1) ^ k : ℕ) : ℝ)) = N * ((⌊2 / h⌋₊ : ℝ) + 1)^k := by
      rw [hNk]; push_cast; ring
    rw [hcast]
    calc N * ((⌊2 / h⌋₊ : ℝ) + 1)^k ≤ Real.exp (3 * N^2) * Real.exp (21 * N^2) :=
          mul_le_mul hNexp hpow2 (by positivity) (Real.exp_pos _).le
      _ = Real.exp (24 * N^2) := by rw [← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; ring
      _ ≤ Real.exp (ω * T / 8) := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
  
  have hT2 : 1 / T^2 = Real.exp (-(2*s)) := by rw [hT2e, Real.exp_neg, one_div]
  have P12 : Real.exp (-(ω * T / 8)) ≤ 1 / T^2 := by
    rw [hT2]; exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
  have P13 : Real.exp (Benv * s^2) * (1 + T)^6 * Real.exp (-R/6) ≤ 1 / T^2 := by
    rw [hT2]
    have h1 : 1 + T ≤ Real.exp (1 + s) := by
      rw [Real.exp_add, hexps]
      have h2 : (2:ℝ) ≤ Real.exp 1 := by linarith [Real.add_one_le_exp (1:ℝ)]
      have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h2 hTpos.le
      linarith
    have h3 : (1+T)^6 ≤ Real.exp (6 + 6*s) := by
      have := pow_le_pow_left₀ (by linarith) h1 6
      rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul] at this
      calc (1+T)^6 ≤ _ := this
        _ = Real.exp (6 + 6*s) := by congr 1; push_cast; ring
    calc Real.exp (Benv * s^2) * (1 + T)^6 * Real.exp (-R/6)
        ≤ Real.exp (Benv * s^2) * Real.exp (6 + 6*s) * Real.exp (-R/6) := by gcongr
      _ = Real.exp (Benv * s^2 + (6 + 6*s) + -R/6) := by rw [← Real.exp_add, ← Real.exp_add]
      _ ≤ Real.exp (-(2*s)) := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
  have P14 : Real.log x ^ (-37 / 36 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / (Real.log x * T ^ 2) := by
    rw [hLx, Real.rpow_def_of_pos (Real.exp_pos T), Real.log_exp]
    have e : 1 / (Real.exp T * T^2) = Real.exp (-(T + 2*s)) := by
      rw [hT2e, Real.exp_neg, ← Real.exp_add, one_div]
    rw [e]
    exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
  refine ⟨hx16, by linarith, P3, P4, P5, P6, P7, P8, P9, P10, P11, P12, ?_, P14, P15⟩
  rw [hs]; exact P13

informal_problem.statement:
(hPNT : Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => (Nat.primeCounting ⌊x⌋₊ : ℝ) / (x / Real.log x)) atTop (𝓝 1))
    (hMERT : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ, 2 ≤ x →
      |(∑ p ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊x⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, (1 : ℝ) / p) - Real.log (Real.log x)| ≤ C)
    (hEULER : Asymptotics.IsEquivalent atTop
      (fun x : ℝ => ∏ p ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊x⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, (1 - (1 : ℝ) / p))
      (fun x => Real.exp (-Real.eulerMascheroniConstant) / Real.log x))
    (hRHO : 0 < FordAnalysis.rho ∧ FordAnalysis.rho < 3 / 4 ∧ FordAnalysis.F FordAnalysis.rho = 1) :
    ∀ᶠ M : ℕ in atTop, ∃ K r : ℝ, 0 < K ∧ 0 < r ∧ ∀ᶠ t : ℝ in atTop, ∀ A : ℝ, 0 ≤ A →
      MeasureTheory.volume.real
        ((FordGeometry.polytope (FordScale.coreDimension M t)
            (FordGeometry.expandedParameter (FordScale.optimalDimension t)) ∩
          {x | ∃ p : Fin (FordScale.coreDimension M t),
            p.val + 1 = FordScale.coreDimension M t ∧ A / t ≤ x p}) +
          Set.Icc (fun _ : Fin (FordScale.coreDimension M t) => -(1 / t)) (fun _ => 1 / t)) ≤
        K * Real.exp (-(r * A)) * FordGeometry.T (FordScale.coreDimension M t)

(hPNT : Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => (Nat.primeCounting ⌊x⌋₊ : ℝ) / (x / Real.log x)) atTop (𝓝 1))
    (hMERT : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ, 2 ≤ x →

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have hREN := ford_renewal_scaled_bounds hRHO
  
  have hB : ∀ (K : ℕ), 2 ≤ K → ∀ (p : Fin K), p.val + 1 = K → ∀ (β τ : ℝ), 0 ≤ β → 0 ≤ τ →
      τ ≤ 10 * FordAnalysis.rho ^ K / (K : ℝ) →
      MeasureTheory.volume.real ((FordGeometry.polytope K (fun _ => 1) ∩ {u | β ≤ u p}) +
          Set.Icc (fun _ : Fin K => -τ) (fun _ => τ)) ≤
        Real.exp 80 * Real.exp (-((K : ℝ) * β / (164 * FordAnalysis.rho ^ K))) *
          FordGeometry.modelVolume K := by
    intro K hK p hp β τ hβ hτ hsmall
    obtain ⟨hρlo, hρhi, hgb⟩ := hREN
    have hρ0 : 0 < FordAnalysis.rho := by linarith
    have hρ1 : FordAnalysis.rho < 3 / 4 := by linarith
    
    have hg0 : FordAnalysis.g 0 = 1 := by rw [FordAnalysis.g]
    have hgsucc : ∀ n : ℕ, FordAnalysis.g (n + 1) =
        ∑ idx ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), FordAnalysis.coeff (idx + 1) * FordAnalysis.g (n - idx) := by
      intro n
      rw [FordAnalysis.g]
    have hgSsucc : ∀ n : ℕ, FordAnalysis.gStar (n + 1) =
        FordAnalysis.g (n + 1) + (1 - FordAnalysis.coeff 1) * FordAnalysis.g n := by
      intro n
      rw [FordAnalysis.gStar]
    have hrDpos : 0 < FordAnalysis.renewalDenominator K :=
      mul_pos (Finset.prod_pos (fun n _ => (hgb n).1)) (hgb K).2.1
    have hmVpos : 0 < FordGeometry.modelVolume K := by
      unfold FordGeometry.modelVolume
      exact one_div_pos.mpr (mul_pos (by positivity) hrDpos)
    
    have hfw : ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → 0 ≤ fordWeight n := by
      intro n hn
      have hi1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast hn
      have hi0 : (0 : ℝ) < n := by linarith
      have hip : (0 : ℝ) < (n : ℝ) + 1 := by positivity
      have hlow := Real.one_sub_inv_le_log_of_pos (div_pos hip hi0)
      rw [Real.log_div hip.ne' hi0.ne', inv_div] at hlow
      have hl := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlow hip.le
      have hid₁ : ((n : ℝ) + 1) * (1 - (n : ℝ) / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) = 1 := by
        field_simp
        ring
      rw [hid₁] at hl
      unfold fordWeight
      nlinarith [Real.log_nonneg hi1]
    
    have htw0 : ∀ i j : Fin K, j.val ≤ i.val → FordGeometry.tailWeight i j = 0 := by
      intro i j h
      unfold FordGeometry.tailWeight
      rw [if_neg (by omega)]
    have htwnn : ∀ i j : Fin K, 0 ≤ FordGeometry.tailWeight i j := by
      intro i j
      unfold FordGeometry.tailWeight
      split_ifs with h1 h2
      · exact hfw _ (by omega)
      · norm_num
      · norm_num
    
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ : ∃ w : Fin K → ℝ, w = fun i =>
        if i.val + 1 < K then FordAnalysis.g (i.val + 1) else FordAnalysis.gStar (i.val + 1) :=
      ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hwpos : ∀ i, 0 < w i := by
      intro i
      rw [hw]
      dsimp only
      split_ifs
      · exact (hgb _).1
      · exact (hgb _).2.1
    
    have hgtail : ∀ n : ℕ, FordAnalysis.g (n + 1) = FordAnalysis.coeff (n + 1) +
        ∑ idx ∈ Finset.range n, FordAnalysis.g (idx + 1) * FordAnalysis.coeff (n - idx) := by
      intro n
      have href := Finset.sum_range_reflect
        (fun idx => FordAnalysis.coeff (idx + 1) * FordAnalysis.g (n - idx)) (n + 1)
      have hsum : (∑ idx ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), FordAnalysis.coeff (n - idx + 1) * FordAnalysis.g idx) =
          FordAnalysis.g (n + 1) := by
        rw [hgsucc, ← href]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro idx hi
        have hi' := Finset.mem_range.mp hi
        simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel, Nat.sub_sub_self (by omega : idx ≤ n)]
      rw [Finset.sum_range_succ'] at hsum
      simp only [Nat.sub_zero, hg0, mul_one] at hsum
      rw [← hsum, add_comm]
      congr 1
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro idx hi
      have hi' := Finset.mem_range.mp hi
      rw [show n - (idx + 1) + 1 = n - idx by omega, mul_comm]
    have hsumlt : ∀ n : ℕ, n ≤ K → ∀ f : ℕ → ℝ,
        (∑ idx : Fin K, if idx.val < n then f idx.val else 0) = ∑ idx ∈ Finset.range n, f idx := by
      intro n hn f
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun idx : ℕ => if idx < n then f idx else 0) K]
      calc
        (∑ idx ∈ Finset.range K, if idx < n then f idx else 0) =
            ∑ idx ∈ Finset.range n, if idx < n then f idx else 0 := by
          symm
          apply Finset.sum_subset (Finset.range_mono hn)
          intro idx _ hi
          simp only [Finset.mem_range, not_lt] at hi
          simp [not_lt_of_ge hi]
        _ = _ := Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun idx hi => if_pos (Finset.mem_range.mp hi))
    
    have hcol : ∀ j : Fin K, w j - ∑ i : Fin K, w i * FordGeometry.tailWeight i j =
        fordWeight (j.val + 1) := by
      intro j
      have hjL := j.isLt
      have hcj : FordAnalysis.coeff (j.val + 1) = fordWeight (j.val + 1) := by
        simp [FordAnalysis.coeff]
      rw [← hcj]
      by_cases hj : j.val + 1 < K
      · have hterm : ∀ i : Fin K, w i * FordGeometry.tailWeight i j =
            if i.val < j.val then FordAnalysis.g (i.val + 1) * FordAnalysis.coeff (j.val - i.val)
            else 0 := by
          intro i
          by_cases hij : i.val < j.val
          · rw [hw]
            simp [FordGeometry.tailWeight, hij, show i.val + 1 < K by omega,
              show i.val + 2 < K by omega, FordAnalysis.coeff, show j.val - i.val ≠ 0 by omega]
          · simp [FordGeometry.tailWeight, hij]
        simp_rw [hterm]
        rw [hsumlt j.val (Nat.le_of_lt hjL)
          (fun idx => FordAnalysis.g (idx + 1) * FordAnalysis.coeff (j.val - idx))]
        rw [hw]
        dsimp only
        rw [if_pos hj, hgtail j.val]
        ring
      · have hjlast : j.val + 1 = K := by omega
        obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ : ∃ k : Fin K, k.val + 1 = j.val := ⟨⟨j.val - 1, by omega⟩, by simp; omega⟩
        have hterm : ∀ i : Fin K, w i * FordGeometry.tailWeight i j =
            (if i.val < j.val then FordAnalysis.g (i.val + 1) * FordAnalysis.coeff (j.val - i.val)
              else 0) +
            (if i = k then (1 - FordAnalysis.coeff 1) * FordAnalysis.g j.val else 0) := by
          intro i
          by_cases hik : i = k
          · subst hik
            have hkj : i.val < j.val := by omega
            have hki2 : ¬ (i.val + 2 < K) := by omega
            rw [hw]
            simp only [FordGeometry.tailWeight, hjL, ↓reduceIte, hkj, hki2, mul_one, hk,
              show j.val - i.val = 1 by omega]
            ring
          · have hne : i.val ≠ k.val := fun h => hik (Fin.ext h)
            by_cases hij : i.val < j.val
            · rw [hw]
              simp [FordGeometry.tailWeight, hij, hik, show i.val + 1 < K by omega,
                show i.val + 2 < K by omega, FordAnalysis.coeff, show j.val - i.val ≠ 0 by omega]
            · simp [FordGeometry.tailWeight, hij, hik]
        simp_rw [hterm]
        rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, hsumlt j.val (Nat.le_of_lt hjL)
          (fun idx => FordAnalysis.g (idx + 1) * FordAnalysis.coeff (j.val - idx))]
        simp only [Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
        rw [hw]
        dsimp only
        rw [if_neg hj, hgSsucc, hgtail j.val]
        ring
    
    have hprod : ∏ i : Fin K, w i = FordAnalysis.renewalDenominator K := by
      obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ : ∃ n, K = n + 1 := ⟨K - 1, by omega⟩
      rw [Fin.prod_univ_castSucc]
      have hi : ∀ i : Fin n, w i.castSucc = FordAnalysis.g (i.val + 1) := by
        intro i
        rw [hw]
        simp [show i.val + 1 < n + 1 by omega]
      simp_rw [hi]
      have hl : w (Fin.last n) = FordAnalysis.gStar (n + 1) := by
        rw [hw]
        simp
      rw [hl, Fin.prod_univ_eq_prod_range (fun i => FordAnalysis.g (i + 1)) n]
      unfold FordAnalysis.renewalDenominator
      rw [Finset.prod_range_succ']
      simp only [hg0, mul_one]
    
    have hmeasΔ : ∀ (m : ℕ) (u : ℝ),
        MeasurableSet {x : Fin m → ℝ | (∀ i, 0 ≤ x i) ∧ ∑ i, x i ≤ u} := by
      intro m u
      have heq : {x : Fin m → ℝ | (∀ i, 0 ≤ x i) ∧ ∑ i, x i ≤ u} =
          (⋂ i, {x : Fin m → ℝ | 0 ≤ x i}) ∩ {x | ∑ i, x i ≤ u} := by
        ext x
        simp
      rw [heq]
      exact ((isClosed_iInter fun i => isClosed_le continuous_const (continuous_apply i)).inter
        (isClosed_le (continuous_finset_sum _ fun i _ => continuous_apply i)
          continuous_const)).measurableSet
    have hΔ : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t →
        MeasureTheory.volume {x : Fin n → ℝ | (∀ i, 0 ≤ x i) ∧ ∑ i, x i ≤ t} =
          ENNReal.ofReal (t ^ n / (n.factorial : ℝ)) := by
      intro n
      induction n with
      | zero =>
        intro t ht
        simp [ht, MeasureTheory.volume_pi]
      | succ n ih =>
        intro t ht
        let e : (ℝ × (Fin n → ℝ)) ≃ᵐ (Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) :=
          (MeasurableEquiv.piFinSuccAbove (fun _ => ℝ) 0).symm
        have he : MeasureTheory.MeasurePreserving e :=
          (MeasureTheory.volume_preserving_piFinSuccAbove (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => ℝ) 0).symm _
        have he_apply : ∀ (s : ℝ) (x : Fin n → ℝ), e (s, x) = Fin.cons s x := by
          intro s x
          simp [e, MeasurableEquiv.piFinSuccAbove_symm_apply, Fin.insertNthEquiv,
            Fin.insertNth_zero']
        have hcons : ∀ (s : ℝ) (x : Fin n → ℝ),
            (Fin.cons s x : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) ∈
                {x : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ | (∀ i, 0 ≤ x i) ∧ ∑ i, x i ≤ t} ↔
              0 ≤ s ∧ x ∈ {x : Fin n → ℝ | (∀ i, 0 ≤ x i) ∧ ∑ i, x i ≤ t - s} := by
          intro s x
          simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Fin.forall_fin_succ, Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_succ,
            Fin.sum_univ_succ]
          constructor
          · rintro ⟨⟨hs, hx⟩, hsum⟩
            exact ⟨hs, hx, by linarith⟩
          · rintro ⟨hs, hx, hsum⟩
            exact ⟨⟨hs, hx⟩, by linarith⟩
        have hm : MeasurableSet (e ⁻¹' {x : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ | (∀ i, 0 ≤ x i) ∧ ∑ i, x i ≤ t}) :=
          e.measurable (hmeasΔ _ _)
        have hslice : ∀ s : ℝ, MeasureTheory.volume
            (Prod.mk s ⁻¹' (e ⁻¹' {x : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ | (∀ i, 0 ≤ x i) ∧ ∑ i, x i ≤ t})) =
              (Set.Icc 0 t).indicator
                (fun s : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal ((t - s) ^ n / n.factorial)) s := by
          intro s
          by_cases hs : s ∈ Set.Icc 0 t
          · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hs]
            have hset : Prod.mk s ⁻¹' (e ⁻¹' {x : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ | (∀ i, 0 ≤ x i) ∧ ∑ i, x i ≤ t}) =
                {x : Fin n → ℝ | (∀ i, 0 ≤ x i) ∧ ∑ i, x i ≤ t - s} := by
              ext x
              simp only [Set.mem_preimage, he_apply, hcons, hs.1, true_and]
            rw [hset, ih (t - s) (sub_nonneg.mpr hs.2)]
          · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hs]
            have hset : Prod.mk s ⁻¹' (e ⁻¹' {x : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ | (∀ i, 0 ≤ x i) ∧ ∑ i, x i ≤ t}) =
                ∅ := by
              apply Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
              intro x hx
              have hx' := (hcons s x).mp (by simpa only [Set.mem_preimage, he_apply] using hx)
              apply hs
              refine ⟨hx'.1, ?_⟩
              have hsum := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun idx (_ : idx ∈ Finset.univ) => hx'.2.1 idx)
              have hbound := hx'.2.2
              linarith
            rw [hset, MeasureTheory.measure_empty]
        have hc : Continuous (fun s : ℝ => (t - s) ^ n / (n.factorial : ℝ)) := by fun_prop
        have hi : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun s : ℝ => (t - s) ^ n / (n.factorial : ℝ))
            (Set.Icc 0 t) := hc.integrableOn_Icc
        have hn : 0 ≤ᵐ[MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.Icc 0 t)]
            (fun s : ℝ => (t - s) ^ n / (n.factorial : ℝ)) := by
          filter_upwards [MeasureTheory.ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Icc] with s hs
          exact div_nonneg (pow_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hs.2) _) (by positivity)
        have hint : (∫ s in Set.Icc 0 t, (t - s) ^ n / (n.factorial : ℝ)) =
            t ^ (n + 1) / ((n + 1).factorial : ℝ) := by
          rw [MeasureTheory.integral_Icc_eq_integral_Ioc, ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le ht,
            intervalIntegral.integral_div,
            intervalIntegral.integral_comp_sub_left (fun x : ℝ => x ^ n) t]
          simp only [sub_self, sub_zero, integral_pow, zero_pow (by omega : n + 1 ≠ 0),
            sub_zero, Nat.factorial_succ, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
          rw [div_div]
        calc
          MeasureTheory.volume {x : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ | (∀ i, 0 ≤ x i) ∧ ∑ i, x i ≤ t} =
              MeasureTheory.volume (e ⁻¹' {x : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ | (∀ i, 0 ≤ x i) ∧ ∑ i, x i ≤ t}) :=
            (he.measure_preimage (hmeasΔ _ _).nullMeasurableSet).symm
          _ = ∫⁻ s : ℝ, MeasureTheory.volume
              (Prod.mk s ⁻¹' (e ⁻¹' {x : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ | (∀ i, 0 ≤ x i) ∧ ∑ i, x i ≤ t})) := by
            rw [MeasureTheory.Measure.volume_eq_prod, MeasureTheory.Measure.prod_apply hm]
          _ = ∫⁻ s in Set.Icc 0 t, ENNReal.ofReal ((t - s) ^ n / n.factorial) := by
            simp_rw [hslice]
            exact MeasureTheory.lintegral_indicator measurableSet_Icc _
          _ = ENNReal.ofReal (∫ s in Set.Icc 0 t, (t - s) ^ n / (n.factorial : ℝ)) :=
            (MeasureTheory.ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hi hn).symm
          _ = _ := by rw [hint]
    have hW : ∀ (n : ℕ) (b : Fin n → ℝ), (∀ i, 0 < b i) → ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t →
        MeasureTheory.volume {x : Fin n → ℝ | (∀ i, 0 ≤ x i) ∧ ∑ i, b i * x i ≤ t} =
          ENNReal.ofReal (t ^ n / ((n.factorial : ℝ) * ∏ i, b i)) := by

      (1 / 4 : ℝ) ≤ FordAnalysis.gStar n * FordAnalysis.rho ^ n

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hs1 : ∀ (z : ℝ) (n : ℕ), 0 < n → FordBadFacet.smoothResidualProperty z n →
      ∀ p ∈ (n.totient).primeFactors, (p : ℝ) ≤ z := by
    intro z n hn hs p hp
    have hpp : p.Prime := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp
    have hpd : p ∣ n.totient := Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactors hp
    have hsm : ∀ q, q.Prime → q ∣ n → q ≤ ⌊z⌋₊ := by
      intro q hq hqn
      have hmem := (Nat.mem_factoredNumbers'.mp hs) q hq hqn
      rw [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Iic] at hmem
      exact hmem.1

      have hdvd : p ∣ n * ∏ q ∈ n.primeFactors, (q - 1) := by

      · exact hsm p hpp h
      · obtain ⟨q, hq, hpq⟩ := (Prime.dvd_finset_prod_iff hpp.prime _).mp h
        have hqp : q.Prime := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hq
        have hq2 := hqp.two_le
        have h1 := Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) hpq
        have h2 := hsm q hqp (Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactors hq)

    have hz : 0 ≤ z := by

      push_neg at hneg
      rw [Nat.floor_of_nonpos hneg.le] at hle
      have := hpp.two_le
      omega
    calc (p : ℝ) ≤ (⌊z⌋₊ : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hle
      _ ≤ z := Nat.floor_le hz
  
  have hs2 : ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ z : ℝ, Real.exp 1 ≤ z → ∀ F : Finset ℕ,

    intro z hz F hF
    have he2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp 1 := by
      have := Real.add_one_le_exp (1 : ℝ); linarith
    have hz2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ z := le_trans he2 hz
    have hL1 : 1 ≤ Real.log z := by
      rw [← Real.log_exp 1]; exact Real.log_le_log (Real.exp_pos 1) hz
    have hLpos : 0 < Real.log z := by linarith
    have hu0 : 0 ≤ logLog z := Real.log_nonneg hL1
    have hδpos : 0 < 1 / (2 * Real.log z) := by positivity
    have he : Real.exp (1 / 2) ≤ 7 / 4 := by
      have hsq : Real.exp (1 / 2) * Real.exp (1 / 2) = Real.exp 1 := by
        rw [← Real.exp_add]; norm_num
      have h1 := Real.exp_one_lt_d9
      have h2 := Real.exp_pos (1 / 2)
      nlinarith
    let w : ℕ → ℝ := fun p => if (p : ℝ) ≤ z then (p : ℝ) ^ (1 / (2 * Real.log z)) else 1
    have hw_bound : ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → 0 ≤ w p ∧ w p ≤ 7 / 4 := by
      intro p hp
      simp only [w]
      split_ifs with h
      · refine ⟨Real.rpow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) _, ?_⟩
        have hp0 : (0 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast hp.pos
        rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos hp0]
        calc Real.exp (Real.log p * (1 / (2 * Real.log z)))
            ≤ Real.exp (Real.log z * (1 / (2 * Real.log z))) := by
              apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
              exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (Real.log_le_log hp0 h) hδpos.le
          _ = Real.exp (1 / 2) := by
              congr 1; field_simp
          _ ≤ 7 / 4 := he
      · norm_num
    have hE := weighted_totient_euler_bound w hw_bound z F
      (fun n hn => ⟨(hF n hn).1, (hF n hn).2.2⟩)
    have hpt : ∀ m ∈ F, (1 : ℝ) / m ≤
        Real.exp (-(logLog z ^ 2 / 2)) * ((m.primeFactorsList.map w).prod / (m.totient : ℝ)) := by
      intro m hm
      obtain ⟨hm0, hmZ, hmp⟩ := hF m hm
      have hprod : (m.primeFactorsList.map w).prod = (m : ℝ) ^ (1 / (2 * Real.log z)) := by
        have hmap : m.primeFactorsList.map w =
            (m.primeFactorsList.map (fun p : ℕ => (p : ℝ))).map
              (fun x => x ^ (1 / (2 * Real.log z))) := by
          rw [List.map_map]
          apply List.map_congr_left
          intro p hp
          have hp' : p ∈ m.primeFactors := Nat.mem_primeFactors_iff_mem_primeFactorsList.mpr hp

        · intro x hx

          obtain ⟨a, _, rfl⟩ := hx
          positivity
      rw [hprod]
      have htot : (0 : ℝ) < m.totient := by exact_mod_cast Nat.totient_pos.mpr hm0
      have htotle : (m.totient : ℝ) ≤ m := by exact_mod_cast Nat.totient_le m
      have hZpos : 0 < Real.exp (Real.log z * logLog z ^ 2) := Real.exp_pos _
      have hmd : Real.exp (logLog z ^ 2 / 2) ≤ (m : ℝ) ^ (1 / (2 * Real.log z)) := by
        calc Real.exp (logLog z ^ 2 / 2)
            = (Real.exp (Real.log z * logLog z ^ 2)) ^ (1 / (2 * Real.log z)) := by
              rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos hZpos, Real.log_exp]
              congr 1
              field_simp
          _ ≤ (m : ℝ) ^ (1 / (2 * Real.log z)) :=
              Real.rpow_le_rpow hZpos.le hmZ.le hδpos.le
      have h1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp (-(logLog z ^ 2 / 2)) * (m : ℝ) ^ (1 / (2 * Real.log z)) := by

          _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmd hpos.le
      calc (1 : ℝ) / m ≤ 1 / (m.totient : ℝ) := one_div_le_one_div_of_le htot htotle
        _ ≤ (Real.exp (-(logLog z ^ 2 / 2)) * (m : ℝ) ^ (1 / (2 * Real.log z))) / m.totient :=
            div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h1 htot.le
        _ = _ := by ring
    have hsum1 := Finset.sum_le_sum hpt
    rw [← Finset.mul_sum] at hsum1
    have hw_sum : (∑ p ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊z⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, w p / p) ≤
        7 / 4 * (logLog z + C) := by
      have hle : (∑ p ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊z⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, w p / p) ≤
          ∑ p ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊z⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, 7 / 4 * ((1 : ℝ) / p) := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro p hp
        have hpp : p.Prime := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hp).2
        rw [mul_one_div]
        exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (hw_bound p hpp).2 (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
      rw [← Finset.mul_sum] at hle
      have hM := hC z hz2
      have hM' : (∑ p ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊z⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, (1 : ℝ) / p) - logLog z ≤ C :=
        le_trans (le_abs_self _) hM
      linarith
    have hexp_le : Real.exp (-(logLog z ^ 2 / 2)) *
        Real.exp ((∑ p ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊z⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, w p / p) + 36) ≤
        Real.exp (38 + 2 * C) := by
      rw [← Real.exp_add]
      apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (logLog z - 7 / 4)]
    calc (∑ m ∈ F, (1 : ℝ) / m) ≤ _ := hsum1
      _ ≤ Real.exp (-(logLog z ^ 2 / 2)) *
          Real.exp ((∑ p ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊z⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, w p / p) + 36) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hE (Real.exp_pos _).le
      _ ≤ _ := hexp_le
  
  have hs3 : ∃ B : ℝ, 0 < B ∧ ∀ᶠ z : ℝ in atTop,
      (∑ m ∈ totientsUpTo (Real.exp (Real.log z * logLog z ^ 2)), (1 : ℝ) / m) ≤
        Real.exp (B * Real.log (logLog z) ^ 2) := by
    obtain ⟨B₀, hB₀, hP⟩ := totient_envelope_growth hPNT hMERT hEULER
    obtain ⟨K, hK, hRS⟩ := reciprocal_sum_of_density
    refine ⟨4 * B₀ + 3, by positivity, ?_⟩
    have hLL : Tendsto logLog atTop atTop :=
      Real.tendsto_log_atTop.comp Real.tendsto_log_atTop
    have hZtend : Tendsto (fun z : ℝ => Real.exp (Real.log z * logLog z ^ 2)) atTop atTop := by
      refine tendsto_atTop_mono' atTop ?_ tendsto_id
      filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop (Real.exp (Real.exp 1))] with z hz
      have hzpos : 0 < z := lt_of_lt_of_le (Real.exp_pos _) hz
      have hL : Real.exp 1 ≤ Real.log z := by
        rw [← Real.log_exp (Real.exp 1)]; exact Real.log_le_log (Real.exp_pos _) hz
      have hL1 : 1 ≤ Real.log z := le_trans (by
        have := Real.add_one_le_exp (1 : ℝ); linarith) hL
      have hu : 1 ≤ logLog z := by
        unfold logLog
        rw [← Real.log_exp 1]; exact Real.log_le_log (Real.exp_pos 1) hL
      have hu2 : 1 ≤ logLog z ^ 2 := by nlinarith
      have hmul : Real.log z ≤ Real.log z * logLog z ^ 2 := by nlinarith
      calc id z = Real.exp (Real.log z) := (Real.exp_log hzpos).symm
        _ ≤ _ := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hmul
    filter_upwards [hZtend.eventually hP, eventually_ge_atTop (Real.exp (Real.exp 1)),
      hLL.eventually_ge_atTop (max 3 (1 + 4 * K))] with z hPz hz hu
    have hL : Real.exp 1 ≤ Real.log z := by
      rw [← Real.log_exp (Real.exp 1)]; exact Real.log_le_log (Real.exp_pos _) hz
    have he1 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp 1 := by
      have := Real.add_one_le_exp (1 : ℝ); linarith
    have hLpos : 0 < Real.log z := by linarith
    have hu3 : 3 ≤ logLog z := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hu
    have huK : 1 + 4 * K ≤ logLog z := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hu
    have hupos : 0 < logLog z := by linarith
    have hlog3 : 1 < Real.log 3 := by
      rw [Real.lt_log_iff_exp_lt (by norm_num)]
      have := Real.exp_one_lt_d9; linarith
    have hℓ3 : Real.log 3 ≤ Real.log (logLog z) := Real.log_le_log (by norm_num) hu3
    have hℓ1 : 1 ≤ Real.log (logLog z) := by linarith
    have hℓu : Real.log (logLog z) ≤ logLog z - 1 := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos hupos
    set Z := Real.exp (Real.log z * logLog z ^ 2) with hZdef
    have hZ0 : 0 ≤ Z := (Real.exp_pos _).le
    have hZe : Real.exp 1 ≤ Z := by
      apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
      have hu2 : 1 ≤ logLog z ^ 2 := by nlinarith
      have : Real.log z ≤ Real.log z * logLog z ^ 2 := by nlinarith
      linarith
    have hlogZ : Real.log Z = Real.log z * logLog z ^ 2 := Real.log_exp _
    have hLLZ : logLog Z = logLog z + 2 * Real.log (logLog z) := by
      show Real.log (Real.log Z) = _
      rw [hlogZ, Real.log_mul hLpos.ne' (by positivity), Real.log_pow]
      unfold logLog
      push_cast
      ring
    have hLLZ3 : logLog Z ≤ 3 * logLog z := by rw [hLLZ]; linarith
    have hlLZ2 : Real.log (logLog Z) ≤ 2 * Real.log (logLog z) := by
      calc Real.log (logLog Z) ≤ Real.log (3 * logLog z) :=
            Real.log_le_log (by rw [hLLZ]; linarith) hLLZ3
        _ = Real.log 3 + Real.log (logLog z) := Real.log_mul (by norm_num) hupos.ne'
        _ ≤ 2 * Real.log (logLog z) := by linarith
    have hlLZ0 : 0 ≤ Real.log (logLog Z) := Real.log_nonneg (by rw [hLLZ]; linarith)
    have hsq : Real.log (logLog Z) ^ 2 ≤ 4 * Real.log (logLog z) ^ 2 := by
      nlinarith
    set D := Real.exp (B₀ * Real.log (logLog Z) ^ 2) with hDdef
    set E := Real.exp (4 * B₀ * Real.log (logLog z) ^ 2) with hEdef
    have hD0 : 0 ≤ D := (Real.exp_pos _).le
    have hDE : D ≤ E := by
      apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
      nlinarith
    have hE1 : 1 ≤ E := Real.one_le_exp (by positivity)
    set T := totientsUpTo Z with hTdef
    have hsplit := Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not T (fun q : ℕ => 2 ≤ q) (fun m => (1 : ℝ) / m)
    have hone : (∑ m ∈ T.filter (fun q : ℕ => ¬ 2 ≤ q), (1 : ℝ) / m) ≤ 1 := by
      have hsub : T.filter (fun q : ℕ => ¬ 2 ≤ q) ⊆ {1} := by
        intro m hm
        rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hm
        obtain ⟨hmT, hm2⟩ := hm
        rw [hTdef] at hmT
        unfold totientsUpTo at hmT
        rw [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc] at hmT
        rw [Finset.mem_singleton]
        omega
      calc (∑ m ∈ T.filter (fun q : ℕ => ¬ 2 ≤ q), (1 : ℝ) / m)
          ≤ ∑ m ∈ ({1} : Finset ℕ), (1 : ℝ) / m :=
            Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hsub (fun m _ _ => by positivity)
        _ = 1 := by simp
    have hQ : ∀ q ∈ T.filter (fun q : ℕ => 2 ≤ q), 2 ≤ q ∧ (q : ℝ) ≤ Z := by
      intro q hq
      rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hq
      obtain ⟨hqT, hq2⟩ := hq
      rw [hTdef] at hqT
      unfold totientsUpTo at hqT
      rw [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc] at hqT
      exact ⟨hq2, (Nat.le_floor_iff hZ0).mp hqT.1.2⟩
    have hdens : ∀ x : ℝ, 2 ≤ x → x ≤ Z →
        (((T.filter (fun q : ℕ => 2 ≤ q)).filter (fun q : ℕ => (q : ℝ) ≤ x)).card : ℝ) ≤
          D * x / Real.log x := by
      intro x hx2 hxZ
      have hsub : (T.filter (fun q : ℕ => 2 ≤ q)).filter (fun q : ℕ => (q : ℝ) ≤ x) ⊆
          totientsUpTo x := by
        intro q hq
        rw [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_filter] at hq
        obtain ⟨⟨hqT, _⟩, hqx⟩ := hq
        rw [hTdef] at hqT
        unfold totientsUpTo at hqT ⊢
        rw [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc] at hqT ⊢
        exact ⟨⟨hqT.1.1, Nat.le_floor hqx⟩, hqT.2⟩
      have hc := Finset.card_le_card hsub
      have hc' : (((T.filter (fun q : ℕ => 2 ≤ q)).filter (fun q : ℕ => (q : ℝ) ≤ x)).card : ℝ) ≤
          ((totientsUpTo x).card : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hc
      exact le_trans hc' (hPz x hx2 hxZ)
    have hmain := hRS (T.filter (fun q : ℕ => 2 ≤ q)) Z D hZe hD0 hQ hdens
    have hmain' : (∑ q ∈ T.filter (fun q : ℕ => 2 ≤ q), (1 : ℝ) / q) ≤
        K * E * (1 + 3 * logLog z) := by
      refine le_trans hmain ?_
      have hLLZeq : Real.log (Real.log Z) = logLog Z := rfl
      have h1 : 1 + Real.log (Real.log Z) ≤ 1 + 3 * logLog z := by linarith
      have h2 : 0 ≤ 1 + Real.log (Real.log Z) := by rw [hLLZeq, hLLZ]; linarith
      calc K * D * (1 + Real.log (Real.log Z)) ≤ K * E * (1 + Real.log (Real.log Z)) := by
            apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ h2
            exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hDE hK.le
        _ ≤ K * E * (1 + 3 * logLog z) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (by positivity)
    have hu_exp : Real.exp (Real.log (logLog z)) = logLog z := Real.exp_log hupos
    have husq : logLog z ^ 2 ≤ Real.exp (3 * Real.log (logLog z) ^ 2) := by
      have h2 : Real.exp (2 * Real.log (logLog z)) = logLog z ^ 2 := by

          Real.exp_add, hu_exp]
        ring
      rw [← h2]
      apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
      nlinarith
    have hpoly : 1 + K + 3 * K * logLog z ≤ logLog z ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    have hfinal : Real.exp ((4 * B₀ + 3) * Real.log (logLog z) ^ 2) =
        E * Real.exp (3 * Real.log (logLog z) ^ 2) := by
      rw [hEdef, ← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; ring
    rw [← hsplit, hfinal]
    have hE0 : 0 ≤ E := by linarith
    have hstep : 1 + K * E * (1 + 3 * logLog z) ≤ E * (1 + K + 3 * K * logLog z) := by
      nlinarith
    have hstep2 : E * (1 + K + 3 * K * logLog z) ≤ E * Real.exp (3 * Real.log (logLog z) ^ 2) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_trans hpoly husq) hE0
    linarith
  
  obtain ⟨B₁, hB₁, h3⟩ := hs3
  obtain ⟨c, hc, h2⟩ := hs2
  refine ⟨B₁ + 1, by linarith, ?_⟩
  have hLLL : Tendsto (fun z : ℝ => Real.log (logLog z)) atTop atTop :=
    Real.tendsto_log_atTop.comp (Real.tendsto_log_atTop.comp Real.tendsto_log_atTop)
  filter_upwards [h3, eventually_ge_atTop (Real.exp 1),
    hLLL.eventually_ge_atTop (max 1 c)] with z hz3 hze hℓ
  intro x
  rw [← Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not _
    (fun m : ℕ => (m : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp (Real.log z * logLog z ^ 2))]
  have hA : (∑ m ∈ ((totientsUpTo x).filter (fun m => ∃ n : ℕ, 0 < n ∧ n.totient = m ∧
      FordBadFacet.smoothResidualProperty z n)).filter
        (fun m : ℕ => (m : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp (Real.log z * logLog z ^ 2)), (1 : ℝ) / m) ≤
      Real.exp (B₁ * Real.log (logLog z) ^ 2) := by
    refine le_trans (Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg ?_ ?_) hz3
    · intro m hm
      rw [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_filter] at hm
      obtain ⟨⟨hmT, n, _, hnm, _⟩, hmZ⟩ := hm
      unfold totientsUpTo at hmT ⊢
      rw [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc] at hmT ⊢
      exact ⟨⟨hmT.1.1, Nat.le_floor hmZ⟩, n, hnm⟩
    · intro m _ _; positivity
  have hB : (∑ m ∈ ((totientsUpTo x).filter (fun m => ∃ n : ℕ, 0 < n ∧ n.totient = m ∧
      FordBadFacet.smoothResidualProperty z n)).filter
        (fun m : ℕ => ¬ (m : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp (Real.log z * logLog z ^ 2)), (1 : ℝ) / m) ≤ c := by
    apply h2 z hze
    intro m hm
    rw [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_filter] at hm
    obtain ⟨⟨hmT, n, hn, hnm, hsm⟩, hmZ⟩ := hm
    unfold totientsUpTo at hmT
    rw [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc] at hmT
    refine ⟨by omega, lt_of_not_ge hmZ, ?_⟩
    rw [← hnm]
    exact hs1 z n hn hsm
  have hℓ1 : 1 ≤ Real.log (logLog z) := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hℓ
  have hℓc : c ≤ Real.log (logLog z) := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hℓ
  have hE1 : 1 ≤ Real.exp (B₁ * Real.log (logLog z) ^ 2) := Real.one_le_exp (by positivity)
  have hexp : 1 + c ≤ Real.exp (Real.log (logLog z) ^ 2) := by
    have := Real.add_one_le_exp (Real.log (logLog z) ^ 2)
    nlinarith
  rw [show (B₁ + 1) * Real.log (logLog z) ^ 2 =
      B₁ * Real.log (logLog z) ^ 2 + Real.log (logLog z) ^ 2 by ring, Real.exp_add]
  have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hexp (by linarith :
    (0 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp (B₁ * Real.log (logLog z) ^ 2))
  nlinarith

subgoal_signatures.name: totient_envelope_growth
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(hPNT : Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => (Nat.primeCounting ⌊x⌋₊ : ℝ) / (x / Real.log x)) atTop (𝓝 1))
    (hMERT : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ, 2 ≤ x →
      |(∑ p ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊x⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, (1 : ℝ) / p) - Real.log (Real.log x)| ≤ C)
    (hEULER : Asymptotics.IsEquivalent atTop
      (fun x : ℝ => ∏ p ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊x⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, (1 - (1 : ℝ) / p))
      (fun x => Real.exp (-Real.eulerMascheroniConstant) / Real.log x)) :
    ∃ B : ℝ, 0 < B ∧ ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop, ∀ u : ℝ, 2 ≤ u → u ≤ x →
      ((totientsUpTo u).card : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp (B * Real.log (logLog x) ^ 2) * u / Real.log u

subgoal_signatures.name: weighted_totient_euler_bound
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (w : ℕ → ℝ), (∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → 0 ≤ w p ∧ w p ≤ 7 / 4) →
    ∀ (x : ℝ) (F : Finset ℕ), (∀ n ∈ F, 0 < n ∧ ∀ p ∈ n.primeFactors, (p : ℝ) ≤ x) →
    (∑ n ∈ F, (n.primeFactorsList.map w).prod / (n.totient : ℝ)) ≤
      Real.exp ((∑ p ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊x⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, w p / p) + 36)

subgoal_signatures.name: reciprocal_sum_of_density
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∃ K : ℝ, 0 < K ∧ ∀ (Q : Finset ℕ) (z D : ℝ), Real.exp 1 ≤ z → 0 ≤ D →
      (∀ q ∈ Q, 2 ≤ q ∧ (q : ℝ) ≤ z) →
      (∀ x : ℝ, 2 ≤ x → x ≤ z → ((Q.filter (fun q : ℕ => (q : ℝ) ≤ x)).card : ℝ) ≤ D * x / Real.log x) →
      (∑ q ∈ Q, (1 : ℝ) / q) ≤ K * D * (1 + Real.log (Real.log z))

signature.statement:

      FordBadFacet.smoothResidualProperty z
        (FordBadFacet.ordinarySuffix (FordBadFacet.ordinarySuffix N 1) L)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro N L z hz
  set l : List ℕ := N.primeFactorsList.reverse with hl
  set t : List ℕ := l.drop 1 with ht
  have hsub : t.reverse.Sublist N.primeFactorsList := by
    have h1 : t.Sublist l := List.drop_sublist 1 l
    have h2 := h1.reverse
    rwa [hl, List.reverse_reverse] at h2
  have hprimes : ∀ p ∈ t.reverse, p.Prime := fun p hp =>
    Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactorsList (hsub.subset hp)
  have hperm : t.reverse.Perm (t.prod).primeFactorsList :=
    Nat.primeFactorsList_unique (List.prod_reverse t) hprimes
  have hsorted : t.reverse.SortedLE :=
    ((Nat.primeFactorsList_sorted N).pairwise.sublist hsub).sortedLE
  have heq : t.reverse = (t.prod).primeFactorsList :=
    List.Perm.eq_of_sortedLE hsorted (Nat.primeFactorsList_sorted _) hperm
  have hkey : FordBadFacet.ordinarySuffix (FordBadFacet.ordinarySuffix N 1) L =
      (l.drop (L + 1)).prod := by
    show (((t.prod).primeFactorsList.reverse).drop L).prod = _
    rw [← heq, List.reverse_reverse, ht, List.drop_drop]
    congr 2
    omega
  rw [hkey]
  have hall : ∀ p ∈ l.drop (L + 1), p.Prime ∧ (p : ℝ) ≤ z := by
    intro p hp
    have hpl : p ∈ l := List.mem_of_mem_drop hp
    refine ⟨Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactorsList (List.mem_reverse.mp hpl), ?_⟩
    by_cases hL : L < l.length
    · have hz' : ((l[L] : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ z := by
        have : FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N L = l[L] := List.getD_eq_getElem l 1 hL
        rw [← this]; exact hz
      have hdesc : List.Pairwise (fun a b => b ≤ a) l :=
        List.pairwise_reverse.mpr (Nat.primeFactorsList_sorted N).pairwise
      have hd2 := hdesc.sublist (List.drop_sublist L l)
      rw [List.drop_eq_getElem_cons hL] at hd2
      have hle : p ≤ l[L] := (List.pairwise_cons.mp hd2).1 p hp
      exact le_trans (by exact_mod_cast hle) hz'
    · have : l.drop (L + 1) = [] := List.drop_eq_nil_of_le (by omega)
      rw [this] at hp
      simp at hp
  unfold FordBadFacet.smoothResidualProperty
  rw [Nat.mem_factoredNumbers']
  intro q hq hqd
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hqa⟩ := (Prime.dvd_prod_iff hq.prime).mp hqd
  obtain ⟨hapr, haz⟩ := hall a ha
  have hqa' : q = a := (Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq hq hapr).mp hqa
  subst hqa'
  exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_Iic.mpr (Nat.le_floor haz), hq⟩

signature.name: band_envelope_tail_small
signature.statement:
∀ (r B ε : ℝ), 0 < r → 0 < ε → ∃ B₀ : ℕ, ∀ F : Finset ℕ, (∀ b ∈ F, B₀ ≤ b) →
      (∑ b ∈ F, Real.exp (-(r * (b : ℝ))) * Real.exp (B * Real.log ((b : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2)) ≤ ε

proof.tactics:
by
  intro r B ε hr hε
  
  have hs1 : ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ b : ℕ, N ≤ b → B * Real.log ((b : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 ≤ r / 2 * (b : ℝ) := by
    set c : ℝ := r / (4 * (|B| + 1)) with hc
    have hB0 : 0 ≤ |B| := abs_nonneg B
    have hcpos : 0 < c := by positivity
    have ho := (Real.isLittleO_pow_log_id_atTop (n := 2)).bound hcpos
    obtain ⟨X₀, hX₀⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.mp ho
    refine ⟨⌈X₀⌉₊ + 1, fun b hb => ?_⟩
    have hb1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ b := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 1 ≤ b)
    have hbX : X₀ ≤ (b : ℝ) + 1 := by
      have h1 := Nat.le_ceil X₀
      have h2 : ((⌈X₀⌉₊ + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ b := by exact_mod_cast hb
      push_cast at h2
      linarith
    have hpos : (0 : ℝ) < (b : ℝ) + 1 := by linarith
    have hh : Real.log ((b : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 ≤ c * ((b : ℝ) + 1) := by
      have h0 := hX₀ _ hbX
      have e1 : |Real.log ((b : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2| = Real.log ((b : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 :=
        abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)
      have e2 : |(b : ℝ) + 1| = (b : ℝ) + 1 := abs_of_pos hpos
      simp only [id, Real.norm_eq_abs] at h0
      rw [e1, e2] at h0
      exact h0
    have hL0 : 0 ≤ Real.log ((b : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
    have hBL : B * Real.log ((b : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 ≤ |B| * Real.log ((b : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self B) hL0
    have hc2 : c * ((b : ℝ) + 1) ≤ c * (2 * (b : ℝ)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) hcpos.le
    have h2 : |B| * Real.log ((b : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 ≤ |B| * (c * (2 * (b : ℝ))) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hh.trans hc2) hB0
    have key : |B| * c ≤ r / 4 := by
      rw [hc, ← mul_div_assoc, div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
      nlinarith
    have hb0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ b := by linarith
    have h3 : |B| * (c * (2 * (b : ℝ))) ≤ r / 2 * (b : ℝ) := by
      have : |B| * (c * (2 * (b : ℝ))) = (|B| * c) * (2 * (b : ℝ)) := by ring
      rw [this]
      nlinarith
    linarith
  
  have hs2 : ∀ (q : ℝ) (B₀ : ℕ) (F : Finset ℕ), 0 ≤ q → q < 1 → (∀ b ∈ F, B₀ ≤ b) →
      (∑ b ∈ F, q ^ b) ≤ q ^ B₀ / (1 - q) := by
    intro q B₀ F hq0 hq1 hF
    have hsub : F ⊆ Finset.Ico B₀ (F.sup id + 1) := by
      intro b hb
      rw [Finset.mem_Ico]
      have := Finset.le_sup (f := id) hb
      simp only [id] at this
      exact ⟨hF b hb, by omega⟩
    calc ∑ b ∈ F, q ^ b ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico B₀ (F.sup id + 1), q ^ i :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hsub (fun i _ _ => pow_nonneg hq0 i)
      _ ≤ q ^ B₀ / (1 - q) := geom_sum_Ico_le_of_lt_one hq0 hq1
  
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hs1
  set q : ℝ := Real.exp (-(r / 2)) with hqdef
  have hq0 : 0 < q := Real.exp_pos _
  have hq1 : q < 1 :=
    (Real.exp_lt_exp.mpr (by linarith : -(r / 2) < 0)).trans_eq Real.exp_zero
  have h1q : 0 < 1 - q := by linarith
  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := exists_pow_lt_of_lt_one (mul_pos hε h1q) hq1
  
  have hpt : ∀ b : ℕ, N ≤ b →
      Real.exp (-(r * (b : ℝ))) * Real.exp (B * Real.log ((b : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2) ≤ q ^ b := by
    intro b hb
    rw [← Real.exp_add, hqdef, ← Real.exp_nat_mul]
    apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
    have := hN b hb
    nlinarith
  
  refine ⟨max N K, fun F hF => ?_⟩
  calc (∑ b ∈ F, Real.exp (-(r * (b : ℝ))) * Real.exp (B * Real.log ((b : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2))
        ≤ ∑ b ∈ F, q ^ b :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum (fun b hb => hpt b ((le_max_left _ _).trans (hF b hb)))
    _ ≤ q ^ (max N K) / (1 - q) := hs2 q _ F hq0.le hq1 hF
    _ ≤ q ^ K / (1 - q) :=
          div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (pow_le_pow_of_le_one hq0.le hq1.le (le_max_right _ _))
            h1q.le
    _ ≤ ε := by
          rw [div_le_iff₀ h1q]
          linarith

{x : ℝ} {A L : ℕ}
    (hx : Real.exp 1 ≤ x) (hT : 0 < logLog x) (hL : 2 ≤ L) (hLA : L ≤ A) :

signature.statement:
{x : ℝ} {A L : ℕ}
    (hx : Real.exp 1 ≤ x) (hT : 0 < logLog x) (hL : 2 ≤ L) (hLA : L ≤ A) :
    FordBadFacet.polytopeFailureValues x L (FordGeometry.expandedParameter A) ⊆

        (Finset.Ico 1 (L - 1)).biUnion (FordBadFacet.retainedFirstFailedValues x A L)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hw : ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → 0 ≤ fordWeight n := by
    intro n hn
    have ha : (1 : ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast hn
    have ha0 : (0 : ℝ) < n := by linarith
    have hdiv : 0 < ((n : ℝ) + 1) / n := by positivity
    have h1 := Real.one_sub_inv_le_log_of_pos hdiv
    rw [Real.log_div (by linarith) (by linarith), inv_div] at h1
    have hlogn : 0 ≤ Real.log n := Real.log_nonneg ha
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) + 1)
    have hid : ((n : ℝ) + 1) * (1 - (n : ℝ) / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) = 1 := by
      field_simp
      ring
    rw [hid] at hmul
    have hfw : fordWeight n = ((n : ℝ) + 1) * (Real.log ((n : ℝ) + 1) - Real.log n) +
        Real.log n - 1 := by
      unfold fordWeight
      ring
    rw [hfw]
    linarith
  
  have hplm : ∀ a b : ℝ, 1 ≤ a → a ≤ b →
      FordBadFacet.positiveLogLog a ≤ FordBadFacet.positiveLogLog b := by
    intro a b ha hab
    unfold FordBadFacet.positiveLogLog logLog
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le ha with h | h
    · rw [← h]
      simp only [Real.log_one, Real.log_zero, max_self]
      exact le_max_left _ _
    · apply max_le_max_left
      have hla : 0 < Real.log a := Real.log_pos h
      exact Real.log_le_log hla (Real.log_le_log (by linarith) hab)
  
  have hone : ∀ N idx : ℕ, 1 ≤ FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N idx := by
    intro N idx
    show 1 ≤ (N.primeFactorsList.reverse).getD idx 1
    by_cases hi : idx < (N.primeFactorsList.reverse).length
    · rw [List.getD_eq_getElem _ 1 hi]
      have hm : (N.primeFactorsList.reverse)[idx] ∈ N.primeFactorsList :=
        List.mem_reverse.mp (List.getElem_mem hi)
      exact (Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactorsList hm).one_le
    · rw [List.getD_eq_default _ _ (by omega)]
  have hantiP : ∀ N : ℕ, Antitone (FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N) := by
    intro N i j hij
    have hs : (N.primeFactorsList.reverse).SortedGE := (Nat.primeFactorsList_sorted N).reverse
    by_cases hj : j < (N.primeFactorsList.reverse).length
    · have hi : i < (N.primeFactorsList.reverse).length := lt_of_le_of_lt hij hj
      show (N.primeFactorsList.reverse).getD j 1 ≤ (N.primeFactorsList.reverse).getD i 1
      rw [List.getD_eq_getElem _ 1 hi, List.getD_eq_getElem _ 1 hj]
      exact hs.antitone_get hij
    · have h1 : FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N j = 1 := by
        show (N.primeFactorsList.reverse).getD j 1 = 1
        exact List.getD_eq_default _ _ (by omega)
      rw [h1]
      exact hone N i
  
  have hsec : ∀ N : ℕ, 0 < N → FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N 1 ≤ N.totient := by
    intro N hN
    have hprod0 : (N.primeFactorsList.reverse).prod = N := by
      rw [List.prod_reverse, Nat.prod_primeFactorsList hN.ne']
    have hmem : ∀ p ∈ N.primeFactorsList.reverse, p.Prime := fun p hp =>
      Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactorsList (List.mem_reverse.mp hp)
    have hant : (N.primeFactorsList.reverse).getD 1 1 ≤ (N.primeFactorsList.reverse).getD 0 1 :=
      hantiP N (show 0 ≤ 1 by omega)
    have htot : 1 ≤ N.totient := Nat.totient_pos.mpr hN
    show (N.primeFactorsList.reverse).getD 1 1 ≤ N.totient
    generalize N.primeFactorsList.reverse = l at hprod0 hmem hant ⊢
    rcases l with _ | ⟨p, _ | ⟨q, r⟩⟩
    · simpa using htot
    · simpa using htot
    · simp only [List.getD_cons_succ, List.getD_cons_zero] at hant ⊢
      have hp : p.Prime := hmem p (by simp)
      have hq : q.Prime := hmem q (by simp)
      have hd : p * q ∣ N := ⟨r.prod, by rw [← hprod0]; simp [List.prod_cons, mul_assoc]⟩
      have ht := Nat.le_of_dvd (Nat.totient_pos.mpr hN) (Nat.totient_dvd_of_dvd hd)
      have hpq : q ≤ (p * q).totient := by
        by_cases he : p = q
        · subst he
          rw [Nat.totient_mul_of_prime_of_dvd hp dvd_rfl, Nat.totient_prime hp]
          have h := hp.two_le
          exact Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right p (by omega)
        · have hqp' : q ≤ p - 1 := by omega
          have hq1 : 1 ≤ q - 1 := by have := hq.two_le; omega
          have hs := Nat.totient_super_multiplicative p q
          rw [Nat.totient_prime hp, Nat.totient_prime hq] at hs
          exact hqp'.trans ((Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right (p - 1) (by omega)).trans hs)
      exact hpq.trans ht
  
  have hsplit : ∀ (a n : ℕ) (g : ℕ → ℝ), (∀ k < a, g k = 0) →
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (a + n), g k = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, g (a + i) := by
    intro a n g hg
    rw [Finset.sum_range_add, Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun k hk => hg k (Finset.mem_range.mp hk)),
      zero_add]
  have hmem_of_rows : ∀ (ξ q : ℕ → ℝ), (∀ i, 0 ≤ q i) → (∀ i, 1 ≤ i → q i ≤ 1) → Antitone q →
      (∀ i, 1 ≤ ξ i) → (∀ j, j + 1 < L → FordBadFacet.RowHolds L ξ q j) →
      (fun idx : Fin L => q (idx.val + 1)) ∈ FordGeometry.polytope L ξ := by
    intro ξ q hq0 hq1 hqa hξ hrows
    refine ⟨fun idx => hq0 _, fun idx => hq1 _ (by omega), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro i j hij
      exact hqa (Nat.add_le_add_right (Fin.le_def.mp hij) 1)
    · have h0 := hrows 0 (by omega)
      simp only [FordBadFacet.RowHolds, if_pos rfl, FordBadFacet.shiftedFacet, Nat.zero_add] at h0
      show ∑ i : Fin L, fordWeight (i.val + 1) * q (i.val + 1) ≤ ξ 0
      exact h0
    · intro idx hi
      show ∑ k : Fin L, FordGeometry.tailWeight idx k * q (k.val + 1) ≤ ξ (idx.val + 1) * q (idx.val + 1)
      by_cases hrow : idx.val + 2 < L
      · have hh := hrows (idx.val + 1) hrow
        simp only [FordBadFacet.RowHolds, if_neg (Nat.succ_ne_zero _)] at hh
        have hstar : ∑ k : Fin L, FordGeometry.tailWeight idx k * q (k.val + 1) =
            FordBadFacet.shiftedFacet q (idx.val + 1) (L - (idx.val + 1)) := by
          have e1 : ∑ k : Fin L, FordGeometry.tailWeight idx k * q (k.val + 1) =
              ∑ k : Fin L, (fun k : ℕ => if idx.val < k then fordWeight (k - idx.val) * q (k + 1)
                else 0) k.val := by
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro k _
            unfold FordGeometry.tailWeight
            by_cases hk : idx.val < k.val
            · simp [hk, hrow]
            · simp [hk]
          rw [e1, Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun k : ℕ => if idx.val < k then
            fordWeight (k - idx.val) * q (k + 1) else 0) L]
          have e2 := hsplit (idx.val + 1) (L - (idx.val + 1)) (fun k : ℕ => if idx.val < k then
            fordWeight (k - idx.val) * q (k + 1) else 0) (by
              intro k hk
              simp only
              rw [if_neg (by omega)])
          rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel' (by omega)] at e2
          rw [e2]
          unfold FordBadFacet.shiftedFacet
          rw [Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun i : ℕ => fordWeight (i + 1) * q (idx.val + 1 + i + 1))
            (L - (idx.val + 1))]
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro i _
          simp only
          rw [if_pos (by omega)]
          congr 2
          omega
        rw [hstar]
        exact hh
      · have hiL : idx.val + 2 = L := by omega
        have hlast : ∑ k : Fin L, FordGeometry.tailWeight idx k * q (k.val + 1) =
            q (idx.val + 2) := by
          rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (⟨idx.val + 1, by omega⟩ : Fin L)]
          · simp [FordGeometry.tailWeight, show ¬ idx.val + 2 < L by omega]
          · intro k _ hkj
            have hne : k.val ≠ idx.val + 1 := fun h => hkj (Fin.ext h)

    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hcanti i i' hii') hκ.le
