    calc ∑ i : Fin k, a i * y i = κ * s := by
          rw [hs_def, Finset.mul_sum]
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro i _
          simp only [hy_def]
          ring
      _ = 1 + ω := div_mul_cancel₀ (1 + ω) hs.ne'
  let u : Fin k → Fin (⌊2 / h⌋₊ + 1) := fun i =>
    ⟨⌊y i / h⌋₊, Nat.lt_succ_of_le (Nat.floor_mono (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (hy2 i) hh.le))⟩
  have hu_val : ∀ i, ((u i : ℕ) : ℝ) = ((⌊y i / h⌋₊ : ℕ) : ℝ) := fun i => rfl
  have hfl : ∀ i, h * ((u i : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ y i ∧ y i - h ≤ h * ((u i : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    intro i
    rw [hu_val]
    have hf := Nat.floor_le (div_nonneg (hy0 i) hh.le)
    have hg := Nat.lt_floor_add_one (y i / h)
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hf hh.le
    have hmul' := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hg hh
    have hcc : h * (y i / h) = y i := by field_simp
    rw [hcc] at hmul hmul'
    exact ⟨hmul, by nlinarith⟩
  have hu_anti : ∀ i i' : Fin k, i ≤ i' → ((u i' : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ ((u i : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    intro i i' hii'
    rw [hu_val, hu_val]
    exact Nat.cast_le.mpr (Nat.floor_mono (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (hyanti i i' hii') hh.le))
  set θ : Fin k → ℝ := fun i => h * ((u i : ℕ) : ℝ) with hθ_def
  have hθc : ∀ i, θ i ≤ c i := fun i => (hfl i).1.trans (hyc i)
  have hθanti : ∀ i i' : Fin k, i ≤ i' → θ i' ≤ θ i := fun i i' hii' =>
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hu_anti i i' hii') hh.le
  have hsum : 1 + ω - h * A ≤ ∑ i : Fin k, a i * θ i := by
    calc 1 + ω - h * A = ∑ i : Fin k, a i * (y i - h) := by
          rw [← hysum, hA_def, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro i _
          ring
      _ ≤ ∑ i : Fin k, a i * θ i :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hfl i).2 (ha i)
  
  obtain ⟨j, hjk, hprefix⟩ : ∃ j : ℕ, j ≤ k ∧ ∀ i : Fin k, logLog S / T ≤ θ i ↔ i.val < j := by
    let P : ℕ → Prop := fun j => j = k ∨ ∃ hj : j < k, θ ⟨j, hj⟩ < logLog S / T
    have hex : ∃ j, P j := ⟨k, Or.inl rfl⟩
    refine ⟨Nat.find hex, Nat.find_min' hex (Or.inl rfl), ?_⟩
    intro i
    constructor
    · intro hi
      by_contra hij
      have hji : Nat.find hex ≤ i.val := by omega
      rcases Nat.find_spec hex with hj | ⟨hj, hlow⟩
      · have := i.isLt
        omega
      · have hiθ : θ i ≤ θ ⟨Nat.find hex, hj⟩ :=
          hθanti _ _ (Fin.le_iff_val_le_val.mpr hji)
        linarith
    · intro hij
      have hnot : ¬P i.val := Nat.find_min hex hij
      by_contra hlow
      exact hnot (Or.inr ⟨i.isLt, lt_of_not_ge hlow⟩)
  
  have hcap : ∀ z : ℝ, logLog (min F (Real.exp (Real.exp z))) = min (logLog F) z := by
    intro z
    have hez : logLog (Real.exp (Real.exp z)) = z := by
      simp only [logLog, Real.log_exp]
    have he1z : 1 < Real.exp (Real.exp z) := Real.one_lt_exp_iff.mpr (Real.exp_pos _)
    rcases le_total F (Real.exp (Real.exp z)) with hle | hle
    · rw [min_eq_left hle]
      have hmono : logLog F ≤ logLog (Real.exp (Real.exp z)) :=
        Real.log_le_log (Real.log_pos hF1) (Real.log_le_log (by linarith) hle)
      rw [hez] at hmono
      rw [min_eq_left hmono]
    · rw [min_eq_right hle]
      have hmono : logLog (Real.exp (Real.exp z)) ≤ logLog F :=
        Real.log_le_log (Real.log_pos he1z) (Real.log_le_log (by linarith) hle)
      rw [hez] at hmono ⊢
      rw [min_eq_right hmono]
  have hθX : ∀ i, θ i * T ≤ T + 1 := fun i =>
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hθc i) hT.le).trans (hcT i)
  set RHS : ℝ := ∑ i : Fin j, fordWeight (i.val + 1) * logLog (min F (Real.exp (Real.exp (h * ((u (Fin.castLE hjk i) : ℕ) : ℝ) * T)))) with hRHS_def
  have hreindex : RHS = ∑ i : Fin k,
      if i.val < j then a i * min (logLog F) (θ i * T) else 0 := by
    rw [hRHS_def]
    calc _ = ∑ i : Fin j, (fun i : Fin k => a i * min (logLog F) (θ i * T)) (Fin.castLE hjk i) := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro i _
          simp only [hθ_def, ha_def, hcap]
          rfl
      _ = ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin k => i.val < j),
            a i * min (logLog F) (θ i * T) := by
          apply Finset.sum_bij (fun i (_ : i ∈ Finset.univ) => Fin.castLE hjk i)
          · intro i _
            exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, i.isLt⟩
          · intro i _ l _ hil
            exact Fin.ext (congrArg (fun z : Fin k => z.val) hil)
          · intro i hi
            refine ⟨⟨i.val, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2⟩, Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
            exact Fin.ext rfl
          · intro i _
            rfl
      _ = _ := Finset.sum_filter _ _
  have hret : (∑ i : Fin k, a i * θ i) * T - (logLog S + (T + 1) - logLog F) * A ≤ RHS := by
    rw [hreindex, Finset.sum_mul, hA_def, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro i _
    have hai := ha i
    have hXL : 0 ≤ T + 1 - logLog F := by linarith
    split_ifs with hi
    · have hmin : θ i * T - (T + 1 - logLog F) ≤ min (logLog F) (θ i * T) :=
        le_min (by linarith [hθX i]) (by linarith)
      have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmin hai
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg hR.le hai]
    · have hlow : θ i < logLog S / T := lt_of_not_ge (fun hh' => hi ((hprefix i).mp hh'))
      have hlowT : θ i * T < logLog S := by
        have := (lt_div_iff₀ hT).mp hlow
        linarith
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlowT.le hai, mul_nonneg hXL hai]
  
  have hsumT := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsum hT.le
  have hfinal : (1 + σ) * T ≤ RHS := by
    nlinarith [hret, hsumT, hloss]
  
  have hj0 : 0 < j := by
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos j with hj | hj
    · exfalso
      subst hj
      have hR0 : RHS = 0 := by
        rw [hRHS_def]
        simp
      have : 0 < (1 + σ) * T := mul_pos (by linarith) hT
      linarith
    · exact hj
  
  refine ⟨j, hjk, u, hj0, hu_anti, fun i => ?_, hfinal⟩
  have hcut : logLog S / T ≤ θ (Fin.castLE hjk i) := (hprefix _).mpr i.isLt
  refine ⟨hRT.trans_le hcut, hθc _, ?_⟩
  have hRle : logLog S ≤ θ (Fin.castLE hjk i) * T := (div_le_iff₀ hT).mp hcut
  have hSeq : Real.exp (Real.exp (logLog S)) = S := by
    unfold logLog
    rw [Real.exp_log (by linarith), Real.exp_log (by linarith)]
  calc S = Real.exp (Real.exp (logLog S)) := hSeq.symm
    _ ≤ Real.exp (Real.exp (θ (Fin.castLE hjk i) * T)) :=
        Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hRle)

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (N j : ℕ) (S : ℝ), 0 < N → 2 ≤ S → NoLargePrimeSquare N (S / 2) → S ≤ (FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N j : ℝ) → Function.Injective (fun a : Fin (j + 1) => FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N a.val) ∧ (∀ a b : ℕ, a ≤ b → FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N b ≤ FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N a) ∧ ∀ a : ℕ, a ≤ j → (FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N a).Prime ∧ FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N a ∣ N

signature.name: ordinary_prime_prefix_distinct
signature.statement: ∀ (N j : ℕ) (S : ℝ), 0 < N → 2 ≤ S → NoLargePrimeSquare N (S / 2) → S ≤ (FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N j : ℝ) → Function.Injective (fun a : Fin (j + 1) => FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N a.val) ∧ (∀ a b : ℕ, a ≤ b → FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N b ≤ FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N a) ∧ ∀ a : ℕ, a ≤ j → (FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N a).Prime ∧ FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N a ∣ N

proof.tactics:
by
  intro N j S hN hS hNLS hSj
  have hone : ∀ idx : ℕ, 1 ≤ FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N idx := by
    intro idx
    show 1 ≤ (N.primeFactorsList.reverse).getD idx 1
    by_cases hi : idx < (N.primeFactorsList.reverse).length
    · rw [List.getD_eq_getElem _ 1 hi]
      have hm : (N.primeFactorsList.reverse)[idx] ∈ N.primeFactorsList :=
        List.mem_reverse.mp (List.getElem_mem hi)
      exact (Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactorsList hm).one_le
    · rw [List.getD_eq_default _ _ (by omega)]
  have hantiP : Antitone (FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N) := by
    intro i j' hij
    have hs : (N.primeFactorsList.reverse).SortedGE := (Nat.primeFactorsList_sorted N).reverse
    by_cases hj : j' < (N.primeFactorsList.reverse).length
    · have hi : i < (N.primeFactorsList.reverse).length := lt_of_le_of_lt hij hj
      show (N.primeFactorsList.reverse).getD j' 1 ≤ (N.primeFactorsList.reverse).getD i 1
      rw [List.getD_eq_getElem _ 1 hi, List.getD_eq_getElem _ 1 hj]
      exact hs.antitone_get hij
    · have h1 : FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N j' = 1 := by
        show (N.primeFactorsList.reverse).getD j' 1 = 1
        exact List.getD_eq_default _ _ (by omega)
      rw [h1]; exact hone i
  have hlen : j < (N.primeFactorsList.reverse).length := by
    by_contra hcon
    have h1 : FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N j = 1 := by
      show (N.primeFactorsList.reverse).getD j 1 = 1
      exact List.getD_eq_default _ _ (by omega)
    rw [h1, Nat.cast_one] at hSj
    linarith
  have hge : ∀ a, a ≤ j → S ≤ (FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N a : ℝ) := by
    intro a ha
    exact hSj.trans (by exact_mod_cast hantiP ha)
  have hmemL : ∀ a, a < (N.primeFactorsList.reverse).length →
      FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N a ∈ N.primeFactorsList := by
    intro a ha
    show (N.primeFactorsList.reverse).getD a 1 ∈ N.primeFactorsList
    rw [List.getD_eq_getElem _ 1 ha]
    exact List.mem_reverse.mp (List.getElem_mem ha)
  have hC : ∀ a, a ≤ j → (FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N a).Prime ∧
      FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N a ∣ N := by
    intro a ha
    have hm := hmemL a (by omega)
    exact ⟨Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactorsList hm, Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactorsList hm⟩
  have hsq : ∀ a b, a < b → b < (N.primeFactorsList.reverse).length →
      FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N a = FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N b →
      FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N a ^ 2 ∣ N := by
    intro a b hab hb heq
    have ha : a < (N.primeFactorsList.reverse).length := by omega
    have hqa : FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N a = (N.primeFactorsList.reverse)[a] :=
      List.getD_eq_getElem _ 1 ha
    have hqb : FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N b = (N.primeFactorsList.reverse)[b] :=
      List.getD_eq_getElem _ 1 hb
    have hm1 : FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N a ∈ (N.primeFactorsList.reverse).take (a + 1) := by
      rw [hqa]
      have hlt : a < ((N.primeFactorsList.reverse).take (a + 1)).length := by
        rw [List.length_take]; omega
      refine List.mem_iff_getElem.mpr ⟨a, hlt, ?_⟩
      rw [List.getElem_take]
    have hm2 : FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N a ∈ (N.primeFactorsList.reverse).drop (a + 1) := by
      rw [heq, hqb]
      have hlt : b - (a + 1) < ((N.primeFactorsList.reverse).drop (a + 1)).length := by
        rw [List.length_drop]; omega
      refine List.mem_iff_getElem.mpr ⟨b - (a + 1), hlt, ?_⟩
      have e : a + 1 + (b - (a + 1)) = b := by omega
      rw [List.getElem_drop]
      simp only [e]
    have hcount : 2 ≤ (N.primeFactorsList.reverse).count (FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N a) := by
      rw [← List.take_append_drop (a + 1) (N.primeFactorsList.reverse), List.count_append]
      have c1 := List.count_pos_iff.mpr hm1
      have c2 := List.count_pos_iff.mpr hm2
      omega
    rw [List.count_reverse, Nat.primeFactorsList_count_eq] at hcount
    have hpp : (FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N a).Prime :=
      Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactorsList (hmemL a ha)
    exact (Nat.Prime.pow_dvd_iff_le_factorization hpp hN.ne').mpr hcount
  refine ⟨?_, fun a b hab => hantiP hab, hC⟩
  intro a b hab
  simp only at hab
  apply Fin.ext
  by_contra hne
  have haj : a.val ≤ j := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp a.isLt
  have hbj : b.val ≤ j := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp b.isLt
  rcases Nat.lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with h | h
  · have hsq' := hsq a.val b.val h (by omega) hab
    have hpr := (hC a.val haj).1
    have hg := hge a.val haj
    exact hNLS _ hpr (by linarith) hsq'
  · have hsq' := hsq b.val a.val h (by omega) hab.symm
    have hpr := (hC b.val hbj).1
    have hg := hge b.val hbj
    exact hNLS _ hpr (by linarith) hsq'

informal_problem.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (x : ℝ), 0 < N → 2 ≤ x → 1 ≤ logLog x → (N.totient : ℝ) ≤ x → (∀ i : ℕ, 0 ≤ FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeCoordinate (logLog x) N i ∧ FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeCoordinate (logLog x) N i ≤ 2 ∧ FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeCoordinate (logLog x) N i * logLog x ≤ logLog x + 1) ∧ (∀ i i' : ℕ, i ≤ i' → FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeCoordinate (logLog x) N i' ≤ FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeCoordinate (logLog x) N i) ∧ (∀ (i : ℕ) (θ : ℝ), 0 < θ → θ ≤ FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeCoordinate (logLog x) N i → Real.exp (Real.exp (θ * logLog x)) ≤ (FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N i : ℝ))

signature.name: ordinary_coordinate_bounds
signature.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (x : ℝ), 0 < N → 2 ≤ x → 1 ≤ logLog x → (N.totient : ℝ) ≤ x → (∀ i : ℕ, 0 ≤ FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeCoordinate (logLog x) N i ∧ FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeCoordinate (logLog x) N i ≤ 2 ∧ FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeCoordinate (logLog x) N i * logLog x ≤ logLog x + 1) ∧ (∀ i i' : ℕ, i ≤ i' → FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeCoordinate (logLog x) N i' ≤ FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeCoordinate (logLog x) N i) ∧ (∀ (i : ℕ) (θ : ℝ), 0 < θ → θ ≤ FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeCoordinate (logLog x) N i → Real.exp (Real.exp (θ * logLog x)) ≤ (FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N i : ℝ))

proof.tactics:
by
  intro N x hN hx hT hphi
  classical
  have hT0 : 0 < logLog x := by linarith
  have hx0 : 0 < x := by linarith
  have hlogx : 0 < Real.log x := Real.log_pos (by linarith)
  have hT' : 1 ≤ Real.log (Real.log x) := hT
  
  have hplm : ∀ a b : ℝ, 1 ≤ a → a ≤ b →
      FordBadFacet.positiveLogLog a ≤ FordBadFacet.positiveLogLog b := by
    intro a b ha hab
    unfold FordBadFacet.positiveLogLog logLog
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le ha with h | h
    · rw [← h]
      simp only [Real.log_one, Real.log_zero, max_self]
      exact le_max_left _ _
    · apply max_le_max_left
      have hla : 0 < Real.log a := Real.log_pos h
      exact Real.log_le_log hla (Real.log_le_log (by linarith) hab)
  
  have hone : ∀ idx : ℕ, 1 ≤ FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N idx := by
    intro idx
    show 1 ≤ (N.primeFactorsList.reverse).getD idx 1
    by_cases hi : idx < (N.primeFactorsList.reverse).length
    · rw [List.getD_eq_getElem _ 1 hi]
      have hm : (N.primeFactorsList.reverse)[idx] ∈ N.primeFactorsList :=
        List.mem_reverse.mp (List.getElem_mem hi)
      exact (Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactorsList hm).one_le
    · rw [List.getD_eq_default _ _ (by omega)]
  
  have hantiP : Antitone (FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N) := by
    intro i j hij
    have hs : (N.primeFactorsList.reverse).SortedGE := (Nat.primeFactorsList_sorted N).reverse
    by_cases hj : j < (N.primeFactorsList.reverse).length
    · have hi : i < (N.primeFactorsList.reverse).length := lt_of_le_of_lt hij hj
      show (N.primeFactorsList.reverse).getD j 1 ≤ (N.primeFactorsList.reverse).getD i 1
      rw [List.getD_eq_getElem _ 1 hi, List.getD_eq_getElem _ 1 hj]
      exact hs.antitone_get hij
    · have h1 : FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N j = 1 := by
        show (N.primeFactorsList.reverse).getD j 1 = 1
        exact List.getD_eq_default _ _ (by omega)
      rw [h1]
      exact hone i
  
  have hle_tot : ∀ idx : ℕ, FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N idx ≤ N.totient + 1 := by
    intro idx
    show (N.primeFactorsList.reverse).getD idx 1 ≤ N.totient + 1
    by_cases hi : idx < (N.primeFactorsList.reverse).length
    · rw [List.getD_eq_getElem _ 1 hi]
      have hm : (N.primeFactorsList.reverse)[idx] ∈ N.primeFactorsList :=
        List.mem_reverse.mp (List.getElem_mem hi)
      have hp := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactorsList hm
      have hd := Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactorsList hm
      have ht := Nat.le_of_dvd (Nat.totient_pos.mpr hN) (Nat.totient_dvd_of_dvd hd)
      rw [Nat.totient_prime hp] at ht
      omega
    · rw [List.getD_eq_default _ _ (by omega)]
      omega
  
  have hbound : ∀ P : ℝ, 1 ≤ P → P ≤ x + 1 → FordBadFacet.positiveLogLog P ≤ logLog x + 1 := by
    intro P h1 h2
    unfold FordBadFacet.positiveLogLog
    apply max_le (by linarith)
    show Real.log (Real.log P) ≤ Real.log (Real.log x) + 1
    have hlP : 0 ≤ Real.log P := Real.log_nonneg h1
    rcases le_or_gt (Real.log P) 1 with hle | hlt
    · have := Real.log_nonpos hlP hle
      linarith
    · have hP2 : Real.log P ≤ 2 * Real.log x := by
        have a : Real.log P ≤ Real.log (2 * x) := Real.log_le_log (by linarith) (by linarith)
        have b : Real.log (2 * x) = Real.log 2 + Real.log x := Real.log_mul two_ne_zero hx0.ne'
        have c : Real.log 2 ≤ Real.log x := Real.log_le_log two_pos hx
        linarith
      have d : Real.log (Real.log P) ≤ Real.log (2 * Real.log x) :=
        Real.log_le_log (by linarith) hP2
      have e : Real.log (2 * Real.log x) = Real.log 2 + Real.log (Real.log x) :=
        Real.log_mul two_ne_zero hlogx.ne'
      have f : Real.log 2 ≤ 2 - 1 := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos two_pos
      linarith
  have hcoord : ∀ i, FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeCoordinate (logLog x) N i =
      FordBadFacet.positiveLogLog (FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N i : ℝ) / logLog x :=
    fun i => rfl
  have hPLL : ∀ i, FordBadFacet.positiveLogLog (FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N i : ℝ) ≤
      logLog x + 1 := by
    intro i
    have h1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N i : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hone i
    have h2 : (FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N i : ℝ) ≤ x + 1 := by
      have h3 : ((FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N i : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ ((N.totient + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
        exact_mod_cast hle_tot i
      push_cast at h3
      linarith
    exact hbound _ h1 h2
  refine ⟨fun i => ?_, fun i i' hii' => ?_, fun i θ hθ hle => ?_⟩
  · rw [hcoord i]
    have hnn : 0 ≤ FordBadFacet.positiveLogLog (FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N i : ℝ) := by
      unfold FordBadFacet.positiveLogLog
      exact le_max_left _ _
    have hb := hPLL i
    refine ⟨div_nonneg hnn hT0.le, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [div_le_iff₀ hT0]
      linarith
    · rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ hT0.ne']
      exact hb
  · rw [hcoord i, hcoord i']
    apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ hT0.le
    exact hplm _ _ (by exact_mod_cast hone i') (by exact_mod_cast hantiP hii')
  · rw [hcoord i, le_div_iff₀ hT0] at hle
    have h1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N i : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hone i
    generalize (FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N i : ℝ) = P at hle h1 ⊢
    have hθT : 0 < θ * logLog x := mul_pos hθ hT0
    have hpos : 0 < Real.log (Real.log P) := by
      have h0 : 0 < FordBadFacet.positiveLogLog P := by linarith
      unfold FordBadFacet.positiveLogLog logLog at h0
      rcases lt_max_iff.mp h0 with h | h
      · exact absurd h (lt_irrefl 0)
      · exact h
    have hpll : FordBadFacet.positiveLogLog P = Real.log (Real.log P) := by
      unfold FordBadFacet.positiveLogLog logLog
      exact max_eq_right hpos.le
    have hlP : 1 < Real.log P := by
      by_contra hc
      push_neg at hc

          Real.sqrt (logLog (w 0) * logLog (w (idx.val + 1))) ≤
          ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (logLog S * U) :=
        mul_le_mul h1 hδD hδ0 (mul_nonneg (by linarith) hlogK)
      have h3 : ((j + 1 - idx.val : ℕ) : ℝ) * B ≤ ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * B :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hnK hB
      nlinarith
    calc _ ≤ ∑ _idx : Fin j, ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
            (2 * Real.sqrt (logLog S * U) * Real.log ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + B) :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum (fun idx _ => hterm idx)
      _ = (j : ℝ) * (((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
            (2 * Real.sqrt (logLog S * U) * Real.log ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + B)) := by
          rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
      _ ≤ ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
            (2 * Real.sqrt (logLog S * U) * Real.log ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + B)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by exact_mod_cast (by omega : j ≤ k + 1)) hc
      _ = _ := by ring
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib] at herr
  have hL0 : logLog (w 0) = logLog S := by rw [hw0]
  linarith [hA, ht, hFac, hfacet, hpre, herr, hbudget, hL0]

informal_problem.statement: (hSEL : ∀ s : SelbergSieve, BoundingSieve.siftedSum (s := s.toBoundingSieve) ≤ s.totalMass / (∑ l ∈ s.prodPrimes.divisors, if (l : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ s.level then s.nu l * ∏ p ∈ l.primeFactors, 1 / (1 - s.nu p) else 0) + ∑ d ∈ s.prodPrimes.divisors, if (d : ℝ) ≤ s.level then (3 : ℝ) ^ ArithmeticFunction.cardDistinctFactors d * |BoundingSieve.rem (s := s.toBoundingSieve) d| else 0) (hMULT : ∀ (g : ℕ → ℝ) (P : ℕ) (y : ℝ), 1 ≤ y → Squarefree P → (∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → (p : ℝ) ≤ y → p ∣ P) → (∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → 0 ≤ g p ∧ g p < 1) → (∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 ⌊Real.sqrt y⌋₊, ∏ p ∈ m.primeFactors, g p ^ m.factorization p) ≤ ∑ l ∈ P.divisors, if (l : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ y then ∏ p ∈ l.primeFactors, g p / (1 - g p) else 0) (hCOP : ∀ (b M : ℕ), 0 < b → (b.totient : ℝ) / b * (∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 M, (k : ℝ)⁻¹) ≤ ∑ k ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 M).filter (fun k => k.Coprime b), (k : ℝ)⁻¹) (hOMEGA : ∀ (P k : ℕ) (x : ℝ), 1 ≤ x → Squarefree P → (∑ d ∈ P.divisors, if (d : ℝ) ≤ x then (k : ℝ) ^ ArithmeticFunction.cardDistinctFactors d else 0) ≤ x * (1 + Real.log x) ^ k) : ∀ (b N : ℕ) (L : ℝ), 0 < b → 1 < L → (((Finset.Icc 1 N).filter (fun n => ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → (p : ℝ) ≤ L → ¬ p ∣ b → ¬ p ∣ n)).card : ℝ) ≤ 2 * ((b : ℝ) / b.totient) * N / Real.log L + L * (1 + Real.log L) ^ 3

signature.name: coprime_sieve_count_of_ingredients
signature.statement: (hSEL : ∀ s : SelbergSieve, BoundingSieve.siftedSum (s := s.toBoundingSieve) ≤ s.totalMass / (∑ l ∈ s.prodPrimes.divisors, if (l : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ s.level then s.nu l * ∏ p ∈ l.primeFactors, 1 / (1 - s.nu p) else 0) + ∑ d ∈ s.prodPrimes.divisors, if (d : ℝ) ≤ s.level then (3 : ℝ) ^ ArithmeticFunction.cardDistinctFactors d * |BoundingSieve.rem (s := s.toBoundingSieve) d| else 0) (hMULT : ∀ (g : ℕ → ℝ) (P : ℕ) (y : ℝ), 1 ≤ y → Squarefree P → (∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → (p : ℝ) ≤ y → p ∣ P) → (∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → 0 ≤ g p ∧ g p < 1) → (∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 ⌊Real.sqrt y⌋₊, ∏ p ∈ m.primeFactors, g p ^ m.factorization p) ≤ ∑ l ∈ P.divisors, if (l : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ y then ∏ p ∈ l.primeFactors, g p / (1 - g p) else 0) (hCOP : ∀ (b M : ℕ), 0 < b → (b.totient : ℝ) / b * (∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 M, (k : ℝ)⁻¹) ≤ ∑ k ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 M).filter (fun k => k.Coprime b), (k : ℝ)⁻¹) (hOMEGA : ∀ (P k : ℕ) (x : ℝ), 1 ≤ x → Squarefree P → (∑ d ∈ P.divisors, if (d : ℝ) ≤ x then (k : ℝ) ^ ArithmeticFunction.cardDistinctFactors d else 0) ≤ x * (1 + Real.log x) ^ k) : ∀ (b N : ℕ) (L : ℝ), 0 < b → 1 < L → (((Finset.Icc 1 N).filter (fun n => ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → (p : ℝ) ≤ L → ¬ p ∣ b → ¬ p ∣ n)).card : ℝ) ≤ 2 * ((b : ℝ) / b.totient) * N / Real.log L + L * (1 + Real.log L) ^ 3

proof.tactics:
by
  intro b N L hb hL
  have hL0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ L := by linarith
  have hL1' : (1 : ℝ) ≤ L := hL.le
  
  obtain ⟨Sb, hSb⟩ : ∃ Sb : Finset ℕ,
      Sb = (Finset.range (⌊L⌋₊ + 1)).filter (fun p => p.Prime ∧ ¬ p ∣ b) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hmemSb : ∀ p, p ∈ Sb ↔ p ≤ ⌊L⌋₊ ∧ p.Prime ∧ ¬ p ∣ b := by
    intro p
    rw [hSb, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩
      exact ⟨by omega, h2, h3⟩
    · rintro ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩
      exact ⟨by omega, h2, h3⟩
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ : ∃ Q : ℕ, Q = ∏ p ∈ Sb, p := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hsqprod : ∀ T : Finset ℕ, (∀ q ∈ T, q.Prime) → Squarefree (∏ q ∈ T, q) := by
    intro T
    refine Finset.induction_on T ?_ ?_
    · intro _
      simp
    · intro a T ha ih hT
      rw [Finset.prod_insert ha, Nat.squarefree_mul_iff]
      have haP : a.Prime := hT a (Finset.mem_insert_self a T)
      refine ⟨?_, haP.prime.squarefree, ih (fun q hq => hT q (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hq))⟩
      apply Nat.Coprime.prod_right
      intro q hq
      have hqP : q.Prime := hT q (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hq)
      exact (Nat.coprime_primes haP hqP).mpr (fun h => ha (h ▸ hq))
  have hprim_dvd : ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → (p ∣ primorial ⌊L⌋₊ ↔ (p : ℝ) ≤ L) := by
    intro p hp
    rw [← Nat.le_floor_iff hL0]
    unfold primorial
    constructor
    · intro h
      obtain ⟨q, hq, hpq⟩ := (Prime.dvd_finset_prod_iff hp.prime _).mp h
      rw [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range] at hq
      have := (Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq hp hq.2).mp hpq
      omega
    · intro h
      exact Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem _
        (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega), hp⟩)
  have hQ_dvd : ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → (p ∣ Q ↔ (p : ℝ) ≤ L ∧ ¬ p ∣ b) := by
    intro p hp
    rw [← Nat.le_floor_iff hL0]
    constructor
    · intro h
      rw [hQ] at h
      obtain ⟨q, hq, hpq⟩ := (Prime.dvd_finset_prod_iff hp.prime _).mp h
      rw [hmemSb] at hq
      have := (Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq hp hq.2.1).mp hpq
      subst this
      exact ⟨hq.1, hq.2.2⟩
    · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
      rw [hQ]
      exact Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem _ ((hmemSb p).mpr ⟨h1, hp, h2⟩)
  have hQsq : Squarefree Q := by
    rw [hQ]
    exact hsqprod _ (fun q hq => ((hmemSb q).mp hq).2.1)
  have hPsq : Squarefree (primorial ⌊L⌋₊) := by
    unfold primorial
    exact hsqprod _ (fun q hq => (Finset.mem_filter.mp hq).2)
  have hPy : ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → (p : ℝ) ≤ L → p ∣ primorial ⌊L⌋₊ :=
    fun p hp hpL => (hprim_dvd p hp).mpr hpL
  
  set g₀ : ℕ → ℝ := fun p => 1 / (p : ℝ) with hg₀
  set g' : ℕ → ℝ := fun p => if p ∣ b then 0 else 1 / (p : ℝ) with hg'
  have hg₀p : ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → 0 < g₀ p ∧ g₀ p < 1 := by
    intro p hp
    have hp2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ p := by exact_mod_cast hp.two_le
    simp only [hg₀]
    refine ⟨by positivity, ?_⟩
    rw [div_lt_one (by linarith)]
    linarith
  have hg'p : ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → 0 ≤ g' p ∧ g' p < 1 := by
    intro p hp
    have hp2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ p := by exact_mod_cast hp.two_le
    simp only [hg']
    split_ifs
    · exact ⟨le_refl _, one_pos⟩
    · refine ⟨by positivity, ?_⟩
      rw [div_lt_one (by linarith)]
      linarith
  have hnup : ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → ArithmeticFunction.prodPrimeFactors g₀ p = g₀ p := by
    intro p hp
    rw [ArithmeticFunction.prodPrimeFactors_apply hp.ne_zero, hp.primeFactors,
      Finset.prod_singleton]
  
  obtain ⟨s, hsupp, hprod, hw, htot, hnu, hlev⟩ : ∃ s : SelbergSieve,
      s.support = Finset.Icc 1 N ∧
      s.prodPrimes = Q ∧ s.weights = (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) ∧
      s.totalMass = (N : ℝ) ∧ s.nu = ArithmeticFunction.prodPrimeFactors g₀ ∧ s.level = L :=
    ⟨{ support := Finset.Icc 1 N
       prodPrimes := Q
       prodPrimes_squarefree := hQsq
       weights := fun _ => 1
       weights_nonneg := fun _ => zero_le_one
       totalMass := N
       nu := ArithmeticFunction.prodPrimeFactors g₀
       nu_mult := ArithmeticFunction.IsMultiplicative.prodPrimeFactors g₀
       nu_pos_of_prime := fun p hp _ => by rw [hnup p hp]; exact (hg₀p p hp).1
       nu_lt_one_of_prime := fun p hp _ => by rw [hnup p hp]; exact (hg₀p p hp).2
       level := L
       one_le_level := hL1' }, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
  
  have hsift : BoundingSieve.siftedSum (s := s.toBoundingSieve) =
      (((Finset.Icc 1 N).filter
        (fun n => ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → (p : ℝ) ≤ L → ¬ p ∣ b → ¬ p ∣ n)).card : ℝ) := by
    rw [BoundingSieve.siftedSum, hsupp, hprod, hw, Finset.sum_boole]
    congr 2
    apply Finset.filter_congr
    intro n _
    constructor
    · intro h p hp hpL hpb hpn
      have := Nat.Coprime.coprime_dvd_left ((hQ_dvd p hp).mpr ⟨hpL, hpb⟩) h
      exact (Nat.Prime.coprime_iff_not_dvd hp).mp this hpn
    · intro h
      apply Nat.coprime_of_dvd
      intro k hk hkQ hkn
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := (hQ_dvd k hk).mp hkQ
      exact h k hk h1 h2 hkn
  
  have hrem : ∀ d ∈ Q.divisors, |BoundingSieve.rem (s := s.toBoundingSieve) d| ≤ 1 := by
    intro d hd
    have hdQ : d ∣ Q := Nat.dvd_of_mem_divisors hd
    have hdsq : Squarefree d := Squarefree.squarefree_of_dvd hdQ hQsq
    have hd0 : 0 < d := Nat.pos_of_mem_divisors hd
    have hmult : BoundingSieve.multSum (s := s.toBoundingSieve) d =
        (((Finset.Icc 1 N).filter (fun n => d ∣ n)).card : ℝ) := by
      rw [BoundingSieve.multSum, hsupp, hw, Finset.sum_boole]
    have hnud : ArithmeticFunction.prodPrimeFactors g₀ d = 1 / (d : ℝ) := by
      rw [ArithmeticFunction.prodPrimeFactors_apply hdsq.ne_zero]
      simp only [hg₀, one_div, Finset.prod_inv_distrib]
      rw [← Nat.cast_prod, Nat.prod_primeFactors_of_squarefree hdsq]
    rw [BoundingSieve.rem, hmult, hnu, htot, hnud]
    have hcard : ((Finset.Icc 1 N).filter (fun n => d ∣ n)).card = N / d := by
      have hIcc : Finset.Icc 1 N = Finset.Ioc 0 N := by
        ext x
        simp only [Finset.mem_Icc, Finset.mem_Ioc]
        omega
      rw [hIcc]
      exact Nat.Ioc_filter_dvd_card_eq_div N d
    rw [hcard]
    have hdR : (0 : ℝ) < d := by exact_mod_cast hd0
    have hdiv := Nat.div_add_mod N d
    have hmod := Nat.mod_lt N hd0
    have hNR : (N : ℝ) = d * ((N / d : ℕ) : ℝ) + ((N % d : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hdiv.symm
    have hmodR : ((N % d : ℕ) : ℝ) < d := by exact_mod_cast hmod
    have heq : ((N / d : ℕ) : ℝ) - 1 / (d : ℝ) * (N : ℝ) = -(((N % d : ℕ) : ℝ) / d) := by
      rw [hNR]
      field_simp
      ring
    rw [heq, abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg (by positivity), div_le_one hdR]
    exact hmodR.le
  
  have herr : (∑ d ∈ Q.divisors,
      if (d : ℝ) ≤ L then
        (3 : ℝ) ^ ArithmeticFunction.cardDistinctFactors d *
          |BoundingSieve.rem (s := s.toBoundingSieve) d|
      else 0) ≤ L * (1 + Real.log L) ^ 3 := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ d ∈ Q.divisors, if (d : ℝ) ≤ L then
          ((3 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ ArithmeticFunction.cardDistinctFactors d else 0 := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro d hd
        split_ifs with hdy
        · push_cast
          exact mul_le_of_le_one_right (by positivity) (hrem d hd)
        · rfl
      _ ≤ _ := hOMEGA Q 3 L hL1' hQsq
  
  have hGeq : (∑ l ∈ Q.divisors,
      if (l : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ L then ArithmeticFunction.prodPrimeFactors g₀ l *
        ∏ p ∈ l.primeFactors, 1 / (1 - ArithmeticFunction.prodPrimeFactors g₀ p) else 0) =
      ∑ l ∈ Q.divisors,
        if (l : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ L then ∏ p ∈ l.primeFactors, g₀ p / (1 - g₀ p) else 0 := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro l hl
    have hl0 : l ≠ 0 := Nat.ne_of_gt (Nat.pos_of_mem_divisors hl)
    split_ifs
    · rw [ArithmeticFunction.prodPrimeFactors_apply hl0, ← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
      apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
      intro p hp
      rw [hnup p (Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp), mul_one_div]
    · rfl
  
  have hs2 : ∀ K : ℕ, (∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 K, ∏ p ∈ m.primeFactors, g' p ^ m.factorization p) =
      ∑ k ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 K).filter (fun k => k.Coprime b), (k : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
    intro K
    rw [Finset.sum_filter]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro m hm
    have hm0 : m ≠ 0 := by rw [Finset.mem_Icc] at hm; omega
    split_ifs with hcop
    · have hfac : ∀ p ∈ m.primeFactors,
          g' p ^ m.factorization p = ((p : ℝ) ^ m.factorization p)⁻¹ := by
        intro p hp
        have hpp := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp
        have hpb : ¬ p ∣ b := by
          intro hpb
          have h1 : p ∣ m := Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactors hp
          have := Nat.Coprime.coprime_dvd_left h1 hcop
          exact (Nat.Prime.coprime_iff_not_dvd hpp).mp this hpb
        simp only [hg', if_neg hpb, one_div, inv_pow]
      rw [Finset.prod_congr rfl hfac, Finset.prod_inv_distrib]
      congr 1
      have h := Nat.factorization_prod_pow_eq_self hm0
      rw [Finsupp.prod, Nat.support_factorization] at h
      exact_mod_cast h
    · obtain ⟨p, hp, hpm, hpb⟩ := Nat.Prime.not_coprime_iff_dvd.mp hcop
      apply Finset.prod_eq_zero (i := p)
      · exact Nat.mem_primeFactors.mpr ⟨hp, hpm, hm0⟩
      · simp only [hg', if_pos hpb]
        exact zero_pow (hp.factorization_pos_of_dvd hm0 hpm).ne'
  
  have hs3 : (∑ l ∈ (primorial ⌊L⌋₊).divisors,
      if (l : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ L then ∏ p ∈ l.primeFactors, g' p / (1 - g' p) else 0) =
      ∑ l ∈ Q.divisors, if (l : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ L then ∏ p ∈ l.primeFactors, g₀ p / (1 - g₀ p) else 0 := by
    have hQP : Q ∣ primorial ⌊L⌋₊ := by
      rw [hQ]
      unfold primorial
      apply Finset.prod_dvd_prod_of_subset
      intro p hp
      rw [hmemSb] at hp
      rw [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range]
      exact ⟨by omega, hp.2.1⟩
    have hP0 : primorial ⌊L⌋₊ ≠ 0 := hPsq.ne_zero
    have hQ0 : Q ≠ 0 := hQsq.ne_zero
    refine (Finset.sum_subset (Nat.divisors_subset_of_dvd hP0 hQP) ?_).symm.trans ?_
    · intro l hlP hlQ
      have hldvd := Nat.dvd_of_mem_divisors hlP
      have hlsq : Squarefree l := Squarefree.squarefree_of_dvd hldvd hPsq
      have hex : ∃ p ∈ l.primeFactors, p ∣ b := by
        by_contra hcon
        push_neg at hcon
        apply hlQ
        rw [Nat.mem_divisors]
        refine ⟨?_, hQ0⟩
        rw [← Nat.prod_primeFactors_of_squarefree hlsq, hQ]
        apply Finset.prod_dvd_prod_of_subset
        intro p hp
        have hpp := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp
        rw [hmemSb]
        refine ⟨?_, hpp, hcon p hp⟩
        have := (hprim_dvd p hpp).mp ((Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactors hp).trans hldvd)
        exact Nat.le_floor this
      obtain ⟨p, hp, hpb⟩ := hex
      have hz : ∏ q ∈ l.primeFactors, g' q / (1 - g' q) = 0 := by
        apply Finset.prod_eq_zero hp
        simp only [hg', if_pos hpb, zero_div]
      rw [hz]
      split_ifs <;> rfl
    · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro l hl
      have hlQ := Nat.dvd_of_mem_divisors hl
      split_ifs
      · apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
        intro p hp
        have hpp := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp
        have hpb : ¬ p ∣ b := ((hQ_dvd p hpp).mp ((Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactors hp).trans hlQ)).2
        simp only [hg', hg₀, if_neg hpb]
      · rfl
  
  have hlogH : Real.log L / 2 ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 ⌊Real.sqrt L⌋₊, (k : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
    have h := log_le_harmonic_floor (Real.sqrt L) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
    rw [Real.log_sqrt hL0, harmonic_eq_sum_Icc] at h
    push_cast at h
    linarith
  have hA := hMULT g' (primorial ⌊L⌋₊) L hL1' hPsq hPy hg'p
  have hlog0 : 0 < Real.log L := Real.log_pos hL
  have hbR : (0 : ℝ) < b := by exact_mod_cast hb
  have hφR : (0 : ℝ) < b.totient := by exact_mod_cast Nat.totient_pos.mpr hb
  have hcoef : 0 ≤ (b.totient : ℝ) / b := by positivity
  have hlow : (b.totient : ℝ) / b * (Real.log L / 2) ≤
      ∑ l ∈ Q.divisors, if (l : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ L then ∏ p ∈ l.primeFactors, g₀ p / (1 - g₀ p) else 0 := by
    calc
      _ ≤ (b.totient : ℝ) / b * (∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 ⌊Real.sqrt L⌋₊, (k : ℝ)⁻¹) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlogH hcoef
      _ ≤ _ := hCOP b _ hb
      _ = _ := (hs2 _).symm
      _ ≤ _ := hA
      _ = _ := hs3
  
  have hmain := hSEL s
  rw [hsift, hprod, hnu, hlev, htot, hGeq] at hmain
  refine hmain.trans (add_le_add ?_ herr)
  have hc : 0 < (b.totient : ℝ) / b * (Real.log L / 2) := by positivity
  calc
    _ ≤ (N : ℝ) / ((b.totient : ℝ) / b * (Real.log L / 2)) :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hc hlow
    _ = _ := by field_simp

proof.tactics:
by
  intro B k w a δ G hw0 hw ha hGpos hSq hlow hcell
  
  have hfact : ∀ (n : ℕ) (u v : ℝ),
      (∏ p ∈ n.primeFactors.filter (fun p : ℕ => u < (p : ℝ) ∧ (p : ℝ) ≤ v),
        p ^ n.factorization p : ℕ) ≠ 0 ∧
      ∀ q : ℕ, (∏ p ∈ n.primeFactors.filter (fun p : ℕ => u < (p : ℝ) ∧ (p : ℝ) ≤ v),
        p ^ n.factorization p : ℕ).factorization q =
        if u < (q : ℝ) ∧ (q : ℝ) ≤ v then n.factorization q else 0 := by
    intro n u v
    have hne : ∀ p ∈ n.primeFactors.filter (fun p : ℕ => u < (p : ℝ) ∧ (p : ℝ) ≤ v),
        p ^ n.factorization p ≠ 0 := by
      intro p hp
      exact pow_ne_zero _ (Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors (Finset.mem_filter.mp hp).1).ne_zero
    refine ⟨Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr hne, ?_⟩
    intro q
    rw [Nat.factorization_prod hne, Finsupp.finset_sum_apply]
    have hterm : ∀ p ∈ n.primeFactors.filter (fun p : ℕ => u < (p : ℝ) ∧ (p : ℝ) ≤ v),
        (p ^ n.factorization p).factorization q = if p = q then n.factorization q else 0 := by
      intro p hp
      have hpp := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors (Finset.mem_filter.mp hp).1
      rw [hpp.factorization_pow, Finsupp.single_apply]
      split_ifs with h
      · subst h; rfl
      · rfl
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hterm, Finset.sum_ite_eq']
    by_cases hq : u < (q : ℝ) ∧ (q : ℝ) ≤ v
    · rw [if_pos hq]
      split_ifs with hmem
      · rfl
      · have hnot : q ∉ n.primeFactors := fun h => hmem (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨h, hq⟩)
        rw [← Nat.support_factorization] at hnot
        exact (Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.mp hnot).symm
    · rw [if_neg hq, if_neg]
      intro hmem
      exact hq (Finset.mem_filter.mp hmem).2
  
  have hsupp : ∀ (n : ℕ) (u v : ℝ),
      (∏ p ∈ n.primeFactors.filter (fun p : ℕ => u < (p : ℝ) ∧ (p : ℝ) ≤ v),
        p ^ n.factorization p : ℕ).primeFactors ⊆
        (Finset.Iic ⌊v⌋₊).filter (fun p : ℕ => p.Prime ∧ u < (p : ℝ)) := by
    intro n u v q hq
    have hqp := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hq
    have hqd := Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactors hq
    obtain ⟨p, hp, hqp'⟩ := (Prime.dvd_finset_prod_iff hqp.prime _).mp hqd
    have hp' := Finset.mem_filter.mp hp
    have hpprime := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp'.1
    have heq := (Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq hqp hpprime).mp (hqp.dvd_of_dvd_pow hqp')
    subst heq
    exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_Iic.mpr (Nat.le_floor hp'.2.2), hqp, hp'.2.1⟩
  
  have hsqf : ∀ (n : ℕ) (S u v : ℝ), NoLargePrimeSquare n S → S ≤ u →
      Squarefree (∏ p ∈ n.primeFactors.filter (fun p : ℕ => u < (p : ℝ) ∧ (p : ℝ) ≤ v),
        p ^ n.factorization p : ℕ) := by
    intro n S u v hn hSu
    obtain ⟨hne, hf⟩ := hfact n u v
    rw [Nat.squarefree_iff_factorization_le_one hne]
    intro q
    rw [hf q]
    split_ifs with hq
    · by_contra hlt
      push_neg at hlt
      have hne0 : n.factorization q ≠ 0 := by omega
      have hmem : q ∈ n.factorization.support := Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mpr hne0
      rw [Nat.support_factorization] at hmem
      have hqprime : q.Prime := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hmem
      have hn0 : n ≠ 0 := by
        rintro rfl
        simp at hne0
      have hdvd : q ^ 2 ∣ n := (hqprime.pow_dvd_iff_le_factorization hn0).mpr (by omega)
      exact hn q hqprime (by linarith [hq.1]) hdvd
    · omega
  
  have hcard : ∀ (n : ℕ) (u v : ℝ),
      ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors (∏ p ∈ n.primeFactors.filter
        (fun p : ℕ => u < (p : ℝ) ∧ (p : ℝ) ≤ v), p ^ n.factorization p : ℕ) =
        omegaInterval n u v := by
    intro n u v
    obtain ⟨hne, hf⟩ := hfact n u v
    rw [ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors_apply]
    unfold omegaInterval
    rw [List.countP_eq_length_filter]
    apply List.Perm.length_eq
    rw [List.perm_iff_count]
    intro c
    rw [Nat.primeFactorsList_count_eq, hf c]
    split_ifs with hc
    · rw [List.count_filter (by simpa using hc), Nat.primeFactorsList_count_eq]
    · rw [List.count_eq_zero_of_not_mem]
      intro hmem
      exact hc (by simpa using (List.mem_filter.mp hmem).2)
  
  have hsplit : ∀ (n : ℕ) (S u z : ℝ), S ≤ u → u ≤ z →
      (∏ p ∈ n.primeFactors.filter (fun p : ℕ => S < (p : ℝ) ∧ (p : ℝ) ≤ u),
        p ^ n.factorization p : ℕ) *
      (∏ p ∈ n.primeFactors.filter (fun p : ℕ => u < (p : ℝ) ∧ (p : ℝ) ≤ z),
        p ^ n.factorization p : ℕ) =
      (∏ p ∈ n.primeFactors.filter (fun p : ℕ => S < (p : ℝ) ∧ (p : ℝ) ≤ z),
        p ^ n.factorization p : ℕ) := by
    intro n S u z hSu huz
    obtain ⟨h1, f1⟩ := hfact n S u
    obtain ⟨h2, f2⟩ := hfact n u z
    obtain ⟨h3, f3⟩ := hfact n S z
    apply Nat.eq_of_factorization_eq (mul_ne_zero h1 h2) h3
    intro q
    rw [Nat.factorization_mul h1 h2, Finsupp.add_apply, f1, f2, f3]
    rcases le_or_gt (q : ℝ) S with hqS | hqS
    · rw [if_neg (fun h => by linarith [h.1]), if_neg (fun h => by linarith [h.1]),
        if_neg (fun h => by linarith [h.1])]
    · rcases le_or_gt (q : ℝ) u with hqu | hqu
      · rw [if_pos ⟨hqS, hqu⟩, if_neg (fun h => by linarith [h.1]),
          if_pos ⟨hqS, hqu.trans huz⟩, add_zero]
      · rcases le_or_gt (q : ℝ) z with hqz | hqz
        · rw [if_neg (fun h => by linarith [h.2]), if_pos ⟨hqu, hqz⟩,
            if_pos ⟨hqS, hqz⟩, zero_add]
        · rw [if_neg (fun h => by linarith [h.2]), if_neg (fun h => by linarith [h.2]),
            if_neg (fun h => by linarith [h.2])]
  
  have hnest : ∀ (n : ℕ) (S z u v : ℝ), S ≤ u → v ≤ z →
      (∏ p ∈ (∏ p ∈ n.primeFactors.filter (fun p : ℕ => S < (p : ℝ) ∧ (p : ℝ) ≤ z),
          p ^ n.factorization p : ℕ).primeFactors.filter
          (fun p : ℕ => u < (p : ℝ) ∧ (p : ℝ) ≤ v),
        p ^ (∏ p ∈ n.primeFactors.filter (fun p : ℕ => S < (p : ℝ) ∧ (p : ℝ) ≤ z),
          p ^ n.factorization p : ℕ).factorization p : ℕ) =
      (∏ p ∈ n.primeFactors.filter (fun p : ℕ => u < (p : ℝ) ∧ (p : ℝ) ≤ v),
        p ^ n.factorization p : ℕ) := by
    intro n S z u v hSu hvz
    obtain ⟨h1, f1⟩ := hfact n S z
    obtain ⟨h2, f2⟩ := hfact (∏ p ∈ n.primeFactors.filter
      (fun p : ℕ => S < (p : ℝ) ∧ (p : ℝ) ≤ z), p ^ n.factorization p : ℕ) u v
    obtain ⟨h3, f3⟩ := hfact n u v
    apply Nat.eq_of_factorization_eq h2 h3
    intro q
    rw [f2, f3, f1]
    by_cases hq : u < (q : ℝ) ∧ (q : ℝ) ≤ v
    · rw [if_pos hq, if_pos hq, if_pos ⟨by linarith [hq.1], by linarith [hq.2]⟩]
    · rw [if_neg hq, if_neg hq]
  
  have hchain : ∀ (n K : ℕ), (∀ idx j, idx ≤ j → j ≤ K → w idx ≤ w j) →
      (∏ j ∈ Finset.range K, (∏ p ∈ n.primeFactors.filter
        (fun p : ℕ => w j < (p : ℝ) ∧ (p : ℝ) ≤ w (j + 1)), p ^ n.factorization p : ℕ)) =
      (∏ p ∈ n.primeFactors.filter (fun p : ℕ => w 0 < (p : ℝ) ∧ (p : ℝ) ≤ w K),
        p ^ n.factorization p : ℕ) := by
    intro n K
    induction K with
    | zero =>
      intro _
      rw [Finset.prod_range_zero, Finset.filter_false_of_mem
        (fun p _ h => absurd (lt_of_lt_of_le h.1 h.2) (lt_irrefl _)), Finset.prod_empty]
    | succ K ih =>
      intro hwK
      rw [Finset.prod_range_succ, ih (fun i j hij hjk => hwK i j hij (by omega))]
      exact hsplit n (w 0) (w K) (w (K + 1)) (hwK 0 K (by omega) (by omega))
        (hwK K (K + 1) (by omega) le_rfl)
  have hchainFin : ∀ n : ℕ,
      (∏ idx : Fin k, (∏ p ∈ n.primeFactors.filter
        (fun p : ℕ => w idx.val < (p : ℝ) ∧ (p : ℝ) ≤ w (idx.val + 1)),

      (∏ p ∈ n.primeFactors.filter (fun p : ℕ => w 0 < (p : ℝ) ∧ (p : ℝ) ≤ w k),
        p ^ n.factorization p : ℕ) := by
    intro n
    exact (Fin.prod_univ_eq_prod_range (fun j => (∏ p ∈ n.primeFactors.filter
        (fun p : ℕ => w j < (p : ℝ) ∧ (p : ℝ) ≤ w (j + 1)), p ^ n.factorization p : ℕ)) k).trans
      (hchain n k hw)
  
  have hbox : ∀ (M : Finset ℕ) (f : ℕ → Fin k → ℕ), (∀ n ∈ M, (∏ idx : Fin k, f n idx) = n) →
      (∑ n ∈ M, (n : ℝ)⁻¹) ≤ ∏ idx : Fin k, ∑ c ∈ M.image (fun n => f n idx), (c : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
    intro M f hf
    have hinj : Set.InjOn f M := by
      intro n hn m hm h
      rw [← hf n hn, ← hf m hm, h]
    calc (∑ n ∈ M, (n : ℝ)⁻¹) = ∑ n ∈ M, ∏ idx : Fin k, ((f n idx : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro n hn
          rw [Finset.prod_inv_distrib, ← Nat.cast_prod, hf n hn]
      _ = ∑ b ∈ M.image f, ∏ idx : Fin k, ((b idx : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹ :=
          (Finset.sum_image (f := fun b : Fin k → ℕ => ∏ idx : Fin k, ((b idx : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹)
            hinj).symm
      _ ≤ ∑ b ∈ Fintype.piFinset (fun idx => M.image (fun n => f n idx)),
            ∏ idx : Fin k, ((b idx : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
          apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg
          · intro b hb
            obtain ⟨n, hn, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hb
            rw [Fintype.mem_piFinset]
            intro idx
            exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨n, hn, rfl⟩
          · intro b _ _
            positivity
      _ = ∏ idx : Fin k, ∑ c ∈ M.image (fun n => f n idx), (c : ℝ)⁻¹ :=
          (Finset.prod_univ_sum (fun idx => M.image (fun n => f n idx))
            (fun _ c => ((c : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹)).symm
  
  set M := G.image (fun n : ℕ => (∏ p ∈ n.primeFactors.filter
    (fun p : ℕ => w 0 < (p : ℝ) ∧ (p : ℝ) ≤ w k), p ^ n.factorization p : ℕ)) with hM
  have hprod : ∀ m ∈ M, (∏ idx : Fin k, (∏ p ∈ m.primeFactors.filter
        (fun p : ℕ => w idx.val < (p : ℝ) ∧ (p : ℝ) ≤ w (idx.val + 1)),
          p ^ m.factorization p : ℕ)) = m := by
    intro m hm
    obtain ⟨n, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hm
    rw [hchainFin]
    exact hnest n (w 0) (w k) (w 0) (w k) le_rfl le_rfl
  have hcellbound : ∀ idx : Fin k,
      (∑ c ∈ M.image (fun m => (∏ p ∈ m.primeFactors.filter
        (fun p : ℕ => w idx.val < (p : ℝ) ∧ (p : ℝ) ≤ w (idx.val + 1)),
          p ^ m.factorization p : ℕ)), (c : ℝ)⁻¹) ≤
      Real.exp ((a idx - a idx * Real.log (a idx)) * (logLog (w (idx.val + 1)) -
        logLog (w idx.val)) + 2 * a idx * δ idx * Real.log (a idx) + a idx * B) := by
    intro idx
    have h0i : w 0 ≤ w idx.val := hw 0 idx.val (Nat.zero_le _) idx.isLt.le
    have hik : w (idx.val + 1) ≤ w k := hw (idx.val + 1) k idx.isLt le_rfl
    have hdata : ∀ c ∈ M.image (fun m => (∏ p ∈ m.primeFactors.filter
        (fun p : ℕ => w idx.val < (p : ℝ) ∧ (p : ℝ) ≤ w (idx.val + 1)),
          p ^ m.factorization p : ℕ)), Squarefree c ∧
        c.primeFactors ⊆ (Finset.Iic ⌊w (idx.val + 1)⌋₊).filter
          (fun p : ℕ => p.Prime ∧ w idx.val < (p : ℝ)) ∧
        a idx * (logLog (w (idx.val + 1)) - logLog (w idx.val) - 2 * δ idx) ≤
          (ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors c : ℝ) := by
      intro c hc
      simp only [M, Finset.mem_image] at hc
      obtain ⟨m, ⟨n, hn, hnm⟩, hmc⟩ := hc
      have hfe : c = (∏ p ∈ n.primeFactors.filter
          (fun p : ℕ => w idx.val < (p : ℝ) ∧ (p : ℝ) ≤ w (idx.val + 1)),
            p ^ n.factorization p : ℕ) := by
        rw [← hmc, ← hnm]
        exact hnest n (w 0) (w k) (w idx.val) (w (idx.val + 1)) h0i hik
      rw [hfe]
      refine ⟨hsqf n (w 0) _ _ (hSq n hn) h0i, hsupp n _ _, ?_⟩
      rw [hcard n]
      exact hlow n hn idx
    have key := hCH _ _ (a idx)
      (a idx * (logLog (w (idx.val + 1)) - logLog (w idx.val) - 2 * δ idx))
      (logLog (w (idx.val + 1)) - logLog (w idx.val) + B) (ha idx) hdata (hcell idx)
    refine key.trans (le_of_eq (congrArg Real.exp ?_))
    ring
  calc (∑ m ∈ M, (m : ℝ)⁻¹)
      ≤ ∏ idx : Fin k, ∑ c ∈ M.image (fun m => (∏ p ∈ m.primeFactors.filter
        (fun p : ℕ => w idx.val < (p : ℝ) ∧ (p : ℝ) ≤ w (idx.val + 1)),
          p ^ m.factorization p : ℕ)), (c : ℝ)⁻¹ :=
        hbox M (fun m idx => (∏ p ∈ m.primeFactors.filter
          (fun p : ℕ => w idx.val < (p : ℝ) ∧ (p : ℝ) ≤ w (idx.val + 1)),
            p ^ m.factorization p : ℕ)) hprod
    _ ≤ ∏ idx : Fin k, Real.exp ((a idx - a idx * Real.log (a idx)) *
          (logLog (w (idx.val + 1)) - logLog (w idx.val)) +
          2 * a idx * δ idx * Real.log (a idx) + a idx * B) :=
        Finset.prod_le_prod
          (fun idx _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun c _ => inv_nonneg.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg _)))
          (fun idx _ => hcellbound idx)
    _ = _ := (Real.exp_sum _ _).symm

{k : ℕ} (F : Finset ℕ) (p : ℕ → Fin k → ℕ)
    (hp : ∀ n ∈ F, ∀ idx, (p n idx).Prime) (ho : ∀ n ∈ F, StrictAnti (p n))
    (hprod : ∀ n ∈ F, (∏ idx, p n idx) = n) (j : ℕ) {s : ℕ}

      (FordLower.nontrivialPreimages s).Nonempty ∧
      ∀ w ∈ FordLower.nontrivialPreimages s, largestPrimeFactor w ≠ largestPrimeFactor s

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have lpf_dvd : ∀ w : ℕ, largestPrimeFactor w ∣ w := by
    intro w
    unfold largestPrimeFactor
    rcases w.primeFactors.eq_empty_or_nonempty with h | h
    · rw [h, Finset.sup_empty]; simp
    · obtain ⟨r, hr, hsup⟩ := Finset.exists_mem_eq_sup _ h id
      simp only [hsup, id_eq]
      have h2 := (Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hr).two_le
      rw [max_eq_right (by omega)]
      exact Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactors hr
  have le_lpf : ∀ w r : ℕ, w ≠ 0 → r.Prime → r ∣ w → r ≤ largestPrimeFactor w := by
    intro w r hw hr hd
    unfold largestPrimeFactor
    have hmem : r ∈ w.primeFactors := Nat.mem_primeFactors.mpr ⟨hr, hd, hw⟩
    exact le_trans (Finset.le_sup (f := id) hmem) (le_max_right _ _)
  have lpf_le : ∀ w b : ℕ, 1 ≤ b → (∀ r, r.Prime → r ∣ w → r ≤ b) →
      largestPrimeFactor w ≤ b := by
    intro w b hb h
    unfold largestPrimeFactor
    apply max_le hb
    apply Finset.sup_le
    intro r hr
    exact h r (Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hr) (Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactors hr)
  have cop_of_lt : ∀ w r : ℕ, 0 < w → r.Prime → largestPrimeFactor w < r → Nat.Coprime r w := by
    intro w r hw hr hlt
    apply (Nat.Prime.coprime_iff_not_dvd hr).mpr
    intro hd
    have := le_lpf w r hw.ne' hr hd
    omega
  have split : ∀ q w : ℕ, q.Prime → 0 < w → largestPrimeFactor w = q → ¬ q ∣ w.totient →
      ∃ a : ℕ, 0 < a ∧ w = q * a ∧ largestPrimeFactor a < q := by
    intro q w hq hw htop hφ
    have hqw : q ∣ w := htop ▸ lpf_dvd w
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hqw
    have ha0 : 0 < a := by
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos a with h | h
      · rw [h, mul_zero] at ha; omega
      · exact h
    have hqa : ¬ q ∣ a := by
      intro hd
      apply hφ
      rw [ha, Nat.totient_mul_of_prime_of_dvd hq hd]
      exact dvd_mul_right q a.totient
    have hle : largestPrimeFactor a ≤ q := by
      apply lpf_le a q hq.one_le
      intro r hr hd
      rw [← htop]
      exact le_lpf w r hw.ne' hr (by rw [ha]; exact dvd_mul_of_dvd_right hd q)
    have hne : largestPrimeFactor a ≠ q := by
      intro heq
      exact hqa (heq ▸ lpf_dvd a)
    exact ⟨a, ha0, ha, lt_of_le_of_ne hle hne⟩
  
  unfold FordLower.suffixCollisionFamily at hs
  obtain ⟨n, hn, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hs
  simp only [FordLower.prefixCollisionClass, FordLower.externalTotientCollisions,
    Finset.mem_filter] at hn
  obtain ⟨⟨hnF, hnw⟩, hdepth⟩ := hn
  have hq := hp n hnF
  have hoq := ho n hnF
  have hprodq := hprod n hnF
  set q := p n with hqdef
  have hinj : Function.Injective q := hoq.injective
  
  have hPpos : ∀ i, 0 < FordLower.prefixProduct q i :=
    fun i => Finset.prod_pos (fun idx _ => (hq idx).pos)
  have hPS : ∀ i, FordLower.prefixProduct q i * FordLower.suffixProduct q i = n := by
    intro i
    rw [← hprodq]
    simpa only [FordLower.prefixProduct, FordLower.suffixProduct, not_lt] using
      Finset.prod_filter_mul_prod_filter_not Finset.univ (fun idx : Fin k => idx.val < i) q
  have hP0 : FordLower.prefixProduct q 0 = 1 := by simp [FordLower.prefixProduct]
  have hPk : FordLower.prefixProduct q k = n := by
    rw [← hprodq]; simp [FordLower.prefixProduct]
  have hPsucc : ∀ i (hi : i < k), FordLower.prefixProduct q (i + 1) =
      FordLower.prefixProduct q i * q ⟨i, hi⟩ := by
    intro i hi
    have hset : Finset.univ.filter (fun idx : Fin k => idx.val < i + 1) =
        insert ⟨i, hi⟩ (Finset.univ.filter (fun idx : Fin k => idx.val < i)) := by
      ext idx
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_insert, Fin.ext_iff]
      omega
    unfold FordLower.prefixProduct
    rw [hset, Finset.prod_insert (by simp)]
    exact mul_comm _ _
  
  have hD0 : 0 ∈ FordLower.prefixDepths q n := by
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hnw
    have hm' : 0 < m ∧ m.totient = n.totient ∧ ¬ n ∣ m := hm
    simp only [FordLower.prefixDepths, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range]
    refine ⟨by omega, m, hm, m, hm'.1, by rw [hP0, one_mul], fun idx hi => absurd hi (Nat.not_lt_zero _)⟩
  have hDne : (FordLower.prefixDepths q n).Nonempty := ⟨0, hD0⟩
  have hdep : FordLower.prefixDepth q n = (FordLower.prefixDepths q n).max' hDne := by
    rw [FordLower.prefixDepth, dif_pos hDne]
  have hjmem : j ∈ FordLower.prefixDepths q n := by
    rw [← hdepth, hdep]; exact Finset.max'_mem _ _
  have hjmax : ∀ i ∈ FordLower.prefixDepths q n, i ≤ j := by
    intro i hi; rw [← hdepth, hdep]; exact Finset.le_max' _ _ hi
  simp only [FordLower.prefixDepths, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range] at hjmem hjmax
  obtain ⟨hjle, m, hm, w, hw, hmw, hsep⟩ := hjmem
  have hm' : 0 < m ∧ m.totient = n.totient ∧ ¬ n ∣ m := hm
  have hj : j < k := by
    by_contra hcon
    have hjk : j = k := by omega
    rw [hjk, hPk] at hmw
    exact hm'.2.2 ⟨w, hmw⟩
  
  have hind : ∀ T : Finset (Fin k), Squarefree (∏ idx ∈ T, q idx) ∧
      (∏ idx ∈ T, q idx).totient = ∏ idx ∈ T, (q idx - 1) ∧
      ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors (∏ idx ∈ T, q idx) = T.card := by
    intro T
    refine Finset.induction_on T ?_ ?_
    · simp
    · intro a T haT ih
      obtain ⟨ih1, ih2, ih3⟩ := ih
      have hcop : Nat.Coprime (q a) (∏ idx ∈ T, q idx) := by
        apply Nat.Coprime.prod_right
        intro i hi
        apply (Nat.coprime_primes (hq a) (hq i)).mpr
        intro h
        exact haT (hinj h ▸ hi)
      have hne : (∏ idx ∈ T, q idx) ≠ 0 := (Finset.prod_pos (fun idx _ => (hq idx).pos)).ne'
      rw [Finset.prod_insert haT, Finset.prod_insert haT, Finset.card_insert_of_notMem haT]
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · exact Nat.squarefree_mul_iff.mpr ⟨hcop, (hq a).squarefree, ih1⟩
      · rw [Nat.totient_mul hcop, Nat.totient_prime (hq a), ih2]
      · rw [ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors_mul (hq a).ne_zero hne,
          ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors_apply_prime (hq a), ih3]
        ring
  set S := Finset.univ.filter (fun idx : Fin k => j ≤ idx.val) with hSdef
  have hsdef : FordLower.suffixProduct q j = ∏ idx ∈ S, q idx := rfl
  have hScard : S.card = k - j := by
    have hSI : S = Finset.Ici (⟨j, hj⟩ : Fin k) := by
      ext idx; simp [hSdef, Fin.le_def]
    rw [hSI, Fin.card_Ici]
  have hmemS : ∀ idx, idx ∈ S → (⟨j, hj⟩ : Fin k) ≤ idx := by
    intro idx hi
    simp only [hSdef, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hi
    exact Fin.le_def.mpr hi
  have hspos : 0 < FordLower.suffixProduct q j := Finset.prod_pos (fun idx _ => (hq idx).pos)
  have htops : largestPrimeFactor (FordLower.suffixProduct q j) = q ⟨j, hj⟩ := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · apply lpf_le _ _ (hq _).one_le
      intro r hr hd
      rw [hsdef] at hd
      obtain ⟨idx, hi, hri⟩ := (Nat.prime_iff.mp hr).exists_mem_finset_dvd hd
      rw [(Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq hr (hq idx)).mp hri]
      exact hoq.antitone (hmemS idx hi)
    · apply le_lpf _ _ hspos.ne' (hq _)
      rw [hsdef]
      apply Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem
      simp [hSdef]
  have hndvd : ¬ q ⟨j, hj⟩ ∣ (FordLower.suffixProduct q j).totient := by
    rw [hsdef, (hind S).2.1]
    intro hd
    obtain ⟨idx, hi, hpi⟩ := (Nat.prime_iff.mp (hq ⟨j, hj⟩)).exists_mem_finset_dvd hd
    have hle := hoq.antitone (hmemS idx hi)
    have h2 := (hq idx).two_le
    have := Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) hpi
    omega
  have hcopP : ∀ w, 0 < w → (∀ idx : Fin k, idx.val < j → largestPrimeFactor w < q idx) →
      Nat.Coprime (FordLower.prefixProduct q j) w := by
    intro w hw hsep
    unfold FordLower.prefixProduct
    apply Nat.Coprime.prod_left
    intro idx hi
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hi
    exact cop_of_lt w (q idx) hw (hq idx) (hsep idx hi)
  have hsepj : ∀ w, largestPrimeFactor w = q ⟨j, hj⟩ →
      ∀ idx : Fin k, idx.val < j → largestPrimeFactor w < q idx := by
    intro w hw idx hi
    rw [hw]
    exact hoq (show idx < (⟨j, hj⟩ : Fin k) from hi)
  have hcops := hcopP _ hspos (hsepj _ htops)
  have hφn : n.totient =
      (FordLower.prefixProduct q j).totient * (FordLower.suffixProduct q j).totient := by
    rw [← Nat.totient_mul hcops, hPS j]
  
  have hne : (FordLower.nontrivialPreimages (FordLower.suffixProduct q j)).Nonempty := by
    have hcopw := hcopP w hw hsep
    have h1 : (FordLower.prefixProduct q j).totient * w.totient =
        (FordLower.prefixProduct q j).totient * (FordLower.suffixProduct q j).totient := by
      rw [← Nat.totient_mul hcopw, ← hmw, hm'.2.1, hφn]
    have hwφ := Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left (Nat.totient_pos.mpr (hPpos j)) h1
    refine ⟨w, show 0 < w ∧ _ ∧ _ from ⟨hw, hwφ, ?_⟩⟩
    intro hd
    apply hm'.2.2
    rw [← hPS j, hmw]
    exact mul_dvd_mul_left _ hd
  
  have hraise : ∀ w' ∈ FordLower.nontrivialPreimages (FordLower.suffixProduct q j),
      largestPrimeFactor w' ≠ largestPrimeFactor (FordLower.suffixProduct q j) := by
    intro w' hw' heqtop
    have hw'' : 0 < w' ∧ w'.totient = (FordLower.suffixProduct q j).totient ∧
        ¬ FordLower.suffixProduct q j ∣ w' := hw'
    obtain ⟨hw0, hwφ, hwn⟩ := hw''
    have htop : largestPrimeFactor w' = q ⟨j, hj⟩ := heqtop.trans htops
    have hnot : ¬ q ⟨j, hj⟩ ∣ w'.totient := by rw [hwφ]; exact hndvd
    obtain ⟨a, ha0, hwa, hatop⟩ := split _ _ (hq _) hw0 htop hnot
    have hcopw := hcopP w' hw0 (hsepj w' htop)
    have hmem' : FordLower.prefixProduct q j * w' ∈ FordLower.nontrivialPreimages n := by
      show 0 < _ ∧ _ ∧ _
      refine ⟨Nat.mul_pos (hPpos j) hw0, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [Nat.totient_mul hcopw, hwφ, hφn]
      · intro hd
        apply hwn
        rw [← hPS j] at hd
        exact (mul_dvd_mul_iff_left (hPpos j).ne').mp hd
    have hagree : FordLower.PrefixAgreement q (j + 1) (FordLower.prefixProduct q j * w') := by
      refine ⟨a, ha0, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [hPsucc j hj, hwa, mul_assoc]
      · intro idx hi
        have hji : idx ≤ (⟨j, hj⟩ : Fin k) := Fin.le_def.mpr (show idx.val ≤ j by omega)
        exact hatop.trans_le (hoq.antitone hji)
    have := hjmax (j + 1) ⟨by omega, _, hmem', hagree⟩
    omega
  exact ⟨hj, hspos, by rw [hsdef]; exact (hind S).1,
    by rw [hsdef, (hind S).2.2, hScard], hne, hraise⟩

informal_problem.statement:
(hPNT : Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => (Nat.primeCounting ⌊x⌋₊ : ℝ) / (x / Real.log x)) atTop (𝓝 1))
    (hMERT : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ, 2 ≤ x →
      |(∑ p ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊x⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, (1 : ℝ) / p) - Real.log (Real.log x)| ≤ C)
    (hEULER : Asymptotics.IsEquivalent atTop
      (fun x : ℝ => ∏ p ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊x⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, (1 - (1 : ℝ) / p))
      (fun x => Real.exp (-Real.eulerMascheroniConstant) / Real.log x))
    (hRHO : 0 < FordAnalysis.rho ∧ FordAnalysis.rho < 3 / 4 ∧ FordAnalysis.F FordAnalysis.rho = 1) :
    ∀ᶠ Z : ℝ in atTop,
      ∀ (M : ℕ) (A y : ℝ) (a : Fin (FordScale.coreDimension M (logLog y))) (N : ℕ)
        (R : FordLower.PrimeProductRecord M A y a N), 1 ≤ A → 0 < logLog y →
          ∀ j : ℕ, j < FordScale.coreDimension M (logLog y) + 1 →
            ((FordLower.suffixProduct R.fullTuple j).totient : ℝ) ≤ Z →
            (ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors (FordLower.suffixProduct R.fullTuple j) : ℝ) ≤
              5 * Real.log (logLog Z)

proof.tactics:
by
  have hren := ford_renewal_scaled_bounds hRHO
  have hρ0 : 0 < FordAnalysis.rho := hRHO.1
  
  have hco : ∀ m : ℕ, 0 ≤ FordAnalysis.coeff m := by
    intro m
    unfold FordAnalysis.coeff
    split_ifs with hm
    · exact le_refl 0
    · unfold fordWeight
      have hn : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (m : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr hm
      have hn0 : (0 : ℝ) < (m : ℝ) := by linarith
      have hn1 : (0 : ℝ) < (m : ℝ) + 1 := by linarith
      have hl := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (div_pos hn0 hn1)
      rw [Real.log_div hn0.ne' hn1.ne'] at hl
      have hkey : ((m : ℝ) + 1) * ((m : ℝ) / ((m : ℝ) + 1)) = (m : ℝ) := by
        field_simp
      have h1 : 1 ≤ ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (Real.log ((m : ℝ) + 1) - Real.log (m : ℝ)) := by
        nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hl hn1.le]
      have h2 : 0 ≤ Real.log (m : ℝ) := Real.log_nonneg hn
      nlinarith
  
  have hg0 : FordAnalysis.g 0 = 1 := by rw [FordAnalysis.g]
  have hgs : ∀ n : ℕ, FordAnalysis.g (n + 1) =
      ∑ idx ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), FordAnalysis.coeff (idx + 1) * FordAnalysis.g (n - idx) := by
    intro n; rw [FordAnalysis.g]
  have hgS0 : FordAnalysis.gStar 0 = 1 := by rw [FordAnalysis.gStar]
  have hgSs : ∀ n : ℕ, FordAnalysis.gStar (n + 1) =
      FordAnalysis.g (n + 1) + (1 - FordAnalysis.coeff 1) * FordAnalysis.g n := by
    intro n; rw [FordAnalysis.gStar]
  have hgS1 : FordAnalysis.gStar 1 = 1 := by
    have h1 := hgSs 0
    have h2 := hgs 0
    simp only [zero_add, Finset.range_one, Finset.sum_singleton, Nat.sub_zero, hg0] at h1 h2
    rw [h1, h2]; ring
  have hgrec : ∀ d : ℕ, 2 ≤ d → FordAnalysis.gStar d ≤
      ∑ m ∈ Finset.range d, FordAnalysis.coeff (m + 1) * FordAnalysis.gStar (d - 1 - m) := by
    intro d hd
    obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ : ∃ n, d = n + 2 := ⟨d - 2, by omega⟩
    have hterm : ∀ m ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
        FordAnalysis.coeff (m + 1) * FordAnalysis.gStar (n + 2 - 1 - m) =
          FordAnalysis.coeff (m + 1) * FordAnalysis.g (n + 1 - m) +
            (1 - FordAnalysis.coeff 1) * (FordAnalysis.coeff (m + 1) * FordAnalysis.g (n - m)) := by
      intro m hm
      have hm' := Finset.mem_range.mp hm
      have e1 : n + 2 - 1 - m = (n - m) + 1 := by omega
      have e2 : n + 1 - m = (n - m) + 1 := by omega
      rw [e1, e2, hgSs]
      ring
    rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_congr rfl hterm, Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum,
      ← hgs n]
    have e3 : n + 2 - 1 - (n + 1) = 0 := by omega
    rw [e3, hgS0]
    have hG2 := hgs (n + 1)
    rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, Nat.sub_self, hg0] at hG2
    rw [show n + 2 = (n + 1) + 1 from rfl, hgSs (n + 1), hG2]
    linarith
  
  have hgrowth : ∀ (L : ℕ) (x : Fin L → ℝ), (∀ idx, 0 ≤ x idx) →
      (∀ idx : Fin L, idx.val + 1 < L → FordGeometry.tailForm idx x ≤ x idx) →
      ∀ (p : Fin L), p.val + 1 = L → ∀ idx : Fin L,
        FordAnalysis.gStar (p.val - idx.val) * x p ≤ x idx := by
    intro L x hx0 htail p hp
    suffices H : ∀ d : ℕ, ∀ i : Fin L, p.val - i.val = d → FordAnalysis.gStar d * x p ≤ x i by
      intro idx; exact H _ idx rfl
    intro d
    induction d using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | _ d ih =>
    intro i hi
    have hiL := i.isLt
    rcases (show d = 0 ∨ d = 1 ∨ 2 ≤ d by omega) with h0 | h1 | h2
    · subst h0
      have hip : i = p := Fin.ext (by omega)
      subst hip
      rw [hgS0, one_mul]
    · subst h1
      have hi1 : i.val + 1 < L := by omega
      have hform : FordGeometry.tailForm i x = x p := by
        show ∑ j, FordGeometry.tailWeight i j * x j = x p
        rw [Finset.sum_eq_single p]
        · have hlt : i.val < p.val := by omega
          have hnot : ¬ (i.val + 2 < L) := by omega
          simp only [FordGeometry.tailWeight, if_pos hlt, if_neg hnot, one_mul]
        · intro j _ hj
          have hnj : ¬ i.val < j.val := by
            intro h
            apply hj
            have := j.isLt
            exact Fin.ext (by omega)
          simp only [FordGeometry.tailWeight, if_neg hnj, zero_mul]
        · intro h; exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ p) h
      rw [hgS1, one_mul, ← hform]
      exact htail i hi1
    · have hi2 : i.val + 2 < L := by omega
      have hi1 : i.val + 1 < L := by omega
      let xe : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => if h : n < L then x ⟨n, h⟩ else 0
      let f : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => (if i.val < n then FordAnalysis.coeff (n - i.val) else 0) * xe n
      have hform : FordGeometry.tailForm i x =
          ∑ m ∈ Finset.range d, FordAnalysis.coeff (m + 1) * xe (i.val + 1 + m) := by
        have h1 : FordGeometry.tailForm i x = ∑ j : Fin L, f j := by
          show ∑ j, FordGeometry.tailWeight i j * x j = _
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro j _
          have hj : (if h : (j : ℕ) < L then x ⟨j, h⟩ else 0) = x j := by rw [dif_pos j.isLt]
          show FordGeometry.tailWeight i j * x j =
            (if i.val < (j : ℕ) then FordAnalysis.coeff ((j : ℕ) - i.val) else 0) *
              (if h : (j : ℕ) < L then x ⟨j, h⟩ else 0)
          rw [hj]
          unfold FordGeometry.tailWeight
          by_cases hij : i.val < j.val
          · have hne : j.val - i.val ≠ 0 := by omega
            rw [if_pos hij, if_pos hij, if_pos hi2, FordAnalysis.coeff, if_neg hne]
          · rw [if_neg hij, if_neg hij]
        have hLd : Finset.range L = Finset.range ((i.val + 1) + d) := by
          congr 1; omega
        rw [h1, Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range f L, hLd, Finset.sum_range_add]
        have hz : ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (i.val + 1), f n = 0 := by
          apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
          intro n hn
          have hn' := Finset.mem_range.mp hn
          have hnot : ¬ i.val < n := by omega
          show (if i.val < n then FordAnalysis.coeff (n - i.val) else 0) * xe n = 0
          rw [if_neg hnot, zero_mul]
        rw [hz, zero_add]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro m _
        have hlt : i.val < i.val + 1 + m := by omega
        have he : i.val + 1 + m - i.val = m + 1 := by omega
        show (if i.val < i.val + 1 + m then FordAnalysis.coeff (i.val + 1 + m - i.val) else 0) *
          xe (i.val + 1 + m) = _
        rw [if_pos hlt, he]
      have hsum : (∑ m ∈ Finset.range d,
            FordAnalysis.coeff (m + 1) * FordAnalysis.gStar (d - 1 - m)) * x p ≤
          ∑ m ∈ Finset.range d, FordAnalysis.coeff (m + 1) * xe (i.val + 1 + m) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_mul]
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro m hm
        have hm' := Finset.mem_range.mp hm
        have hlt : i.val + 1 + m < L := by omega
        have hxe : xe (i.val + 1 + m) = x ⟨i.val + 1 + m, hlt⟩ := dif_pos hlt
        rw [hxe, mul_assoc]
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (hco (m + 1))
        exact ih (d - 1 - m) (by omega) ⟨i.val + 1 + m, hlt⟩
          (by show p.val - (i.val + 1 + m) = d - 1 - m; omega)
      calc FordAnalysis.gStar d * x p
          ≤ (∑ m ∈ Finset.range d,
              FordAnalysis.coeff (m + 1) * FordAnalysis.gStar (d - 1 - m)) * x p :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hgrec d h2) (hx0 p)
        _ ≤ _ := hsum
        _ = FordGeometry.tailForm i x := hform.symm
        _ ≤ x i := htail i hi1
  
  have hcardS : ∀ (k : ℕ) (p : Fin k → ℕ), (∀ idx, (p idx).Prime) → ∀ S : Finset (Fin k),
      ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors (∏ idx ∈ S, p idx) = S.card := by
    intro k p hp S
    refine Finset.induction_on S (by simp) ?_
    intro a s ha ih
    rw [Finset.prod_insert ha, ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors_mul (hp a).ne_zero
      (Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr (fun i _ => (hp i).ne_zero)),
      ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors_apply_prime (hp a), ih, Finset.card_insert_of_notMem ha]
    ring
  
  have hLL : Tendsto logLog atTop atTop := Real.tendsto_log_atTop.comp Real.tendsto_log_atTop
  have hLLL : Tendsto (fun Z => Real.log (logLog Z)) atTop atTop :=
    Real.tendsto_log_atTop.comp hLL
  have hlog34 : Real.log (3 / 4) < -1 / 4 := by
    rw [Real.log_lt_iff_lt_exp (by norm_num)]
    have := Real.add_one_lt_exp (x := (-1 / 4 : ℝ)) (by norm_num)
    linarith
  have hlρ : Real.log FordAnalysis.rho < -1 / 4 :=
    (Real.log_lt_log hρ0 hRHO.2.1).trans hlog34
  have hlog4 : Real.log 4 ≤ 3 := by
    have := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (x := (4 : ℝ)) (by norm_num)
    linarith
  filter_upwards [hLL.eventually_ge_atTop 1, hLLL.eventually_ge_atTop 20] with Z hZ1 hZℓ
  intro M A y a N R hA ht j hj hsize
  have hℓ : (20 : ℝ) ≤ Real.log (logLog Z) := hZℓ
  have hT0 : 0 < logLog Z := by linarith
  
  have hprime : ∀ idx, (R.fullTuple idx).Prime := by
    intro idx
    refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun i => ?_) idx
    · simpa [FordLower.PrimeProductRecord.fullTuple] using R.leading_prime
    · simpa [FordLower.PrimeProductRecord.fullTuple] using R.lower_prime i
  have hanti : StrictAnti R.fullTuple := by
    intro i k hik
    induction k using Fin.cases with
    | zero => exact absurd hik (Fin.not_lt_zero _)
    | succ k' =>
      induction i using Fin.cases with
      | zero => simpa [FordLower.PrimeProductRecord.fullTuple] using R.lower_separated k'
      | succ i' =>
        simp only [FordLower.PrimeProductRecord.fullTuple, Fin.cons_succ]
        exact R.lower_order (Fin.succ_lt_succ_iff.mp hik)
  
  have hΩ : ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors (FordLower.suffixProduct R.fullTuple j) =
      FordScale.coreDimension M (logLog y) + 1 - j := by
    unfold FordLower.suffixProduct
    rw [hcardS _ _ hprime]
    have hS : (Finset.univ.filter
        (fun idx : Fin (FordScale.coreDimension M (logLog y) + 1) => j ≤ idx.val)) =
        Finset.Ici ⟨j, hj⟩ := by
      ext idx; simp [Fin.le_def]
    rw [hS, Fin.card_Ici]
  rw [hΩ]
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge j (FordScale.coreDimension M (logLog y)) with hjL | hjL
  · 
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ : ∃ n, n = a.val - j := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hnat : FordScale.coreDimension M (logLog y) + 1 - j = n + 2 := by
      have := R.terminal; omega
    
    have hPeq : R.fullTuple ⟨j + 1, by omega⟩ = R.lower ⟨j, hjL⟩ := by
      exact Fin.cons_succ (α := fun _ => ℕ) R.leading R.lower ⟨j, hjL⟩
    have hQP : R.fullTuple ⟨j + 1, by omega⟩ < R.fullTuple ⟨j, by omega⟩ :=
      hanti (Fin.mk_lt_mk.mpr (by omega))
    have hPp := hprime ⟨j + 1, by omega⟩
    have hQp := hprime ⟨j, by omega⟩
    have hdvd : R.fullTuple ⟨j, by omega⟩ * R.fullTuple ⟨j + 1, by omega⟩ ∣
        FordLower.suffixProduct R.fullTuple j := by
      have hne : (⟨j, by omega⟩ : Fin (FordScale.coreDimension M (logLog y) + 1)) ≠
          ⟨j + 1, by omega⟩ := by
        intro h; have := congrArg Fin.val h; simp at this
      have hsub : ({⟨j, by omega⟩, ⟨j + 1, by omega⟩} :
          Finset (Fin (FordScale.coreDimension M (logLog y) + 1))) ⊆
          Finset.univ.filter (fun idx => j ≤ idx.val) := by
        intro idx hidx
        simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hidx
        simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
        rcases hidx with rfl | rfl
        · exact le_refl j
        · show j ≤ j + 1; omega
      have := Finset.prod_dvd_prod_of_subset _ _ R.fullTuple hsub
      rwa [Finset.prod_pair hne] at this
    have hspos : 0 < FordLower.suffixProduct R.fullTuple j :=
      Finset.prod_pos (fun i _ => (hprime i).pos)
    have hcop : Nat.Coprime (R.fullTuple ⟨j, by omega⟩) (R.fullTuple ⟨j + 1, by omega⟩) :=
      (Nat.coprime_primes hQp hPp).mpr hQP.ne'
    have htdvd := Nat.totient_dvd_of_dvd hdvd
    rw [Nat.totient_mul hcop, Nat.totient_prime hQp, Nat.totient_prime hPp] at htdvd
    have htle := Nat.le_of_dvd (Nat.totient_pos.mpr hspos) htdvd
    have hP2 := hPp.two_le
    have hQ3 : 2 ≤ R.fullTuple ⟨j, by omega⟩ - 1 := by omega
    have hmul := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (R.fullTuple ⟨j + 1, by omega⟩ - 1) hQ3
    have hPle : R.fullTuple ⟨j + 1, by omega⟩ ≤
        (FordLower.suffixProduct R.fullTuple j).totient := by omega
    rw [hPeq] at hPle hP2
    have hqZ : (R.lower ⟨j, hjL⟩ : ℝ) ≤ Z :=
      le_trans (by exact_mod_cast hPle) hsize
    have hqR : (1 : ℝ) < (R.lower ⟨j, hjL⟩ : ℝ) := by
      have : (2 : ℝ) ≤ (R.lower ⟨j, hjL⟩ : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hP2
      linarith
    have hlq : 0 < Real.log (R.lower ⟨j, hjL⟩ : ℝ) := Real.log_pos hqR
    have hll : logLog (R.lower ⟨j, hjL⟩ : ℝ) ≤ logLog Z := by
      unfold logLog
      exact Real.log_le_log hlq (Real.log_le_log (by linarith) hqZ)
    have huT : max 0 (logLog (R.lower ⟨j, hjL⟩ : ℝ)) ≤ logLog Z := max_le hT0.le hll
    
    have hpt := R.point
    obtain ⟨⟨hpoly, -, hcap⟩, -⟩ := hpt
    obtain ⟨hx0, -, -, -, htail0⟩ := hpoly
    have hξ : ∀ k, FordInner.targetParameter (FordScale.coreDimension M (logLog y)) M k ≤ 1 := by
      intro k
      unfold FordInner.targetParameter FordInner.baseLoss
      split_ifs
      · have : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / (10 * (((M + (FordScale.coreDimension M (logLog y) - k) : ℕ) : ℝ)) ^ 3) := by
          positivity
        linarith
      · simp
    have htail : ∀ idx : Fin (FordScale.coreDimension M (logLog y)),
        idx.val + 1 < FordScale.coreDimension M (logLog y) →
        FordGeometry.tailForm idx (FordReciprocal.tuplePoint (logLog y) R.lower) ≤
          FordReciprocal.tuplePoint (logLog y) R.lower idx :=
      fun idx h => (htail0 idx h).trans (mul_le_of_le_one_left (hx0 idx) (hξ _))
    have hg : FordAnalysis.gStar n * FordReciprocal.tuplePoint (logLog y) R.lower a ≤
        FordReciprocal.tuplePoint (logLog y) R.lower ⟨j, hjL⟩ := by
      rw [hn]; exact hgrowth _ _ hx0 htail a R.terminal ⟨j, hjL⟩
    have hG : 0 < FordAnalysis.gStar n := (hren.2.2 n).2.1
    have hb : (1 / 4 : ℝ) ≤ FordAnalysis.gStar n * FordAnalysis.rho ^ n :=
      (hren.2.2 n).2.2.2.2.2
    have hxa : A / logLog y ≤ FordReciprocal.tuplePoint (logLog y) R.lower a := hcap
    have hxj : FordReciprocal.tuplePoint (logLog y) R.lower ⟨j, hjL⟩ =
        max 0 (logLog (R.lower ⟨j, hjL⟩ : ℝ)) / logLog y := rfl
    have h1 : FordAnalysis.gStar n * (A / logLog y) ≤
        max 0 (logLog (R.lower ⟨j, hjL⟩ : ℝ)) / logLog y := by
      rw [← hxj]; exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hxa hG.le).trans hg
    have hu : FordAnalysis.gStar n * A ≤ max 0 (logLog (R.lower ⟨j, hjL⟩ : ℝ)) := by
      have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 ht.le
      have e1 : FordAnalysis.gStar n * (A / logLog y) * logLog y = FordAnalysis.gStar n * A := by
        field_simp
      have e2 : max 0 (logLog (R.lower ⟨j, hjL⟩ : ℝ)) / logLog y * logLog y =
          max 0 (logLog (R.lower ⟨j, hjL⟩ : ℝ)) := by
        field_simp
      rw [e1, e2] at h2
      exact h2
    have hGT : FordAnalysis.gStar n ≤ logLog Z := by
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hA hG.le]
    have hρn : 0 < FordAnalysis.rho ^ n := pow_pos hρ0 n
    have h4 : 1 ≤ 4 * FordAnalysis.rho ^ n * logLog Z := by
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hGT hρn.le]
    have hlogineq : 0 ≤ Real.log 4 + (n : ℝ) * Real.log FordAnalysis.rho + Real.log (logLog Z) := by
      have := Real.log_le_log one_pos h4
      rw [Real.log_one, Real.log_mul (mul_pos (by norm_num) hρn).ne' hT0.ne',
        Real.log_mul (by norm_num) hρn.ne', Real.log_pow] at this
      linarith
    have hn0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ n := Nat.cast_nonneg n
    have hnb : (n : ℝ) ≤ 4 * Real.log (logLog Z) + 12 := by
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlρ.le hn0]
    rw [hnat]
    push_cast
    linarith
  · 
    have h1 : FordScale.coreDimension M (logLog y) + 1 - j ≤ 1 := by omega
    have : ((FordScale.coreDimension M (logLog y) + 1 - j : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ 1 := by exact_mod_cast h1
    linarith

informal_problem.statement:
{Z B c : ℝ} (hZ : 0 ≤ Z)
    (hsize : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → (n.totient : ℝ) ≤ Z → (n : ℝ) ≤ c * Z * logLog Z)
    (F : Finset ℕ) (k : ℕ)
    (hF : ∀ n ∈ F, 0 < n ∧ Squarefree n ∧ ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors n = k ∧
      (FordLower.nontrivialPreimages n).Nonempty ∧
      ∀ w ∈ FordLower.nontrivialPreimages n, largestPrimeFactor w ≠ largestPrimeFactor n)
    (hZF : ∀ n ∈ F, (n.totient : ℝ) ≤ Z ∧
      (ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors n : ℝ) ≤ B * Real.log (logLog Z)) :
    ∃ (G : Finset ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℕ), G ⊆ F ∧ Set.InjOn w (G : Set ℕ) ∧
      (∀ n ∈ G, 0 < n ∧ Squarefree n ∧ (n.totient : ℝ) ≤ Z ∧ 0 < w n ∧
        (w n).totient = n.totient ∧ ¬ n ∣ w n ∧ largestPrimeFactor (w n) ≠ largestPrimeFactor n ∧
        (∀ q : ℕ, q.Prime → q ∣ n → SNormal (normalityScale (logLog Z)) q) ∧
        (∀ q : ℕ, q.Prime → q ∣ w n → SNormal (normalityScale (logLog Z)) q) ∧
        NoLargePrimeSquare (w n) (Real.log Z ^ 4) ∧
        NoLargePrimeSquare (w n).totient (Real.log Z ^ 4)) ∧
      (F.card : ℝ) ≤
        (((Finset.Icc 1 ⌊c * Z * logLog Z⌋₊).filter (fun n => Squarefree n ∧
            ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors n ≤ ⌊B * Real.log (logLog Z)⌋₊ + 1 ∧
            ∃ q : ℕ, q.Prime ∧ q ∣ n ∧ ¬ SNormal (normalityScale (logLog Z)) q)).card : ℝ) +
        (((Finset.Icc 1 ⌊c * Z * logLog Z⌋₊).filter (fun n => ∃ q : ℕ, q.Prime ∧
            Real.log Z ^ 4 < (q : ℝ) ∧ (q ^ 2 ∣ n ∨ q ^ 2 ∣ n.totient))).card : ℝ) +
        (((totientsUpTo Z).filter (fun m => ∃ n : ℕ, 0 < n ∧ n.totient = m ∧
            ∃ q : ℕ, q.Prime ∧ q ∣ n ∧ ¬ SNormal (normalityScale (logLog Z)) q)).card : ℝ) +
        (G.card : ℝ)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hs1 : ∀ {n m : ℕ}, 0 < m →
      ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors n = ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors m → n ∣ m → n = m := by
    intro n m hm hc hd
    obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ := hd
    have hn0 : n ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; simp at hm
    have hd0 : d ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; simp at hm
    rw [ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors_mul hn0 hd0] at hc
    have hd1 : ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors d = 0 := by omega
    rw [ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors_eq_zero_iff_eq_zero_or_one] at hd1
    rcases hd1 with h | h
    · exact absurd h hd0
    · rw [h, mul_one]
  have hNTP : ∀ n m : ℕ, m ∈ FordLower.nontrivialPreimages n ↔
      (0 < m ∧ m.totient = n.totient ∧ ¬ n ∣ m) := fun n m => Iff.rfl
  
  let E₀ := F.filter (fun n => ∃ q : ℕ, q.Prime ∧ q ∣ n ∧ ¬ SNormal (normalityScale (logLog Z)) q)
  let F₁ := F \ E₀
  have hF₁ : ∀ n ∈ F₁, n ∈ F ∧
      ∀ q : ℕ, q.Prime → q ∣ n → SNormal (normalityScale (logLog Z)) q := by
    intro n hn
    rw [Finset.mem_sdiff] at hn
    refine ⟨hn.1, fun q hq hqn => ?_⟩
    by_contra hbad
    exact hn.2 (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hn.1, q, hq, hqn, hbad⟩)
  
  have hcyc : ∀ v : ℕ, ∃ σ : Equiv.Perm ℕ,
      σ.IsCycleOn ((F₁.filter (fun m => m.totient = v) : Finset ℕ) : Set ℕ) := by
    intro v
    refine ⟨((F₁.filter (fun m => m.totient = v)).toList).formPerm, ?_⟩
    have h := (Finset.nodup_toList (F₁.filter (fun m => m.totient = v))).isCycleOn_formPerm
    have hset : {a | a ∈ (F₁.filter (fun m => m.totient = v)).toList} =
        ((F₁.filter (fun m => m.totient = v) : Finset ℕ) : Set ℕ) := by
      ext a
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Finset.mem_toList, Finset.mem_coe]
    rw [hset] at h
    exact h
  choose σ hσ using hcyc
  let pm : ℕ → ℕ := fun n => σ n.totient n
  have hmemT : ∀ n ∈ F₁,
      n ∈ ((F₁.filter (fun m => m.totient = n.totient) : Finset ℕ) : Set ℕ) := by
    intro n hn
    rw [Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_filter]
    exact ⟨hn, rfl⟩
  have hpmmem : ∀ n ∈ F₁, pm n ∈ F₁ ∧ (pm n).totient = n.totient := by
    intro n hn
    have h := (hσ n.totient).apply_mem_iff.mpr (hmemT n hn)
    rw [Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_filter] at h
    exact h
  have hpmne : ∀ n ∈ F₁, (∃ m ∈ F₁, m.totient = n.totient ∧ m ≠ n) → pm n ≠ n := by
    rintro n hn ⟨m, hm, hmt, hmn⟩
    show σ n.totient n ≠ n
    apply (hσ n.totient).apply_ne
    · refine ⟨n, hmemT n hn, m, ?_, hmn.symm⟩
      rw [Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_filter]
      exact ⟨hm, hmt⟩
    · exact hmemT n hn
  have hpminj : ∀ n ∈ F₁, ∀ n' ∈ F₁, pm n = pm n' → n = n' := by
    intro n hn n' hn' h
    have ht : n.totient = n'.totient := by
      rw [← (hpmmem n hn).2, ← (hpmmem n' hn').2, h]
    have h' : σ n.totient n = σ n'.totient n' := h
    rw [← ht] at h'
    exact (σ n.totient).injective h'
  
  have hNex : ∀ n, ∃ N : ℕ, n ∈ F → N ∈ FordLower.nontrivialPreimages n := by
    intro n
    by_cases hn : n ∈ F
    · obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := (hF n hn).2.2.2.1
      exact ⟨N, fun _ => hN⟩
    · exact ⟨0, fun h => absurd h hn⟩
  choose N hN using hNex
  let w : ℕ → ℕ := fun n =>
    if (∃ m ∈ F₁, m.totient = n.totient ∧ m ≠ n) then pm n else N n
  have hw : ∀ n ∈ F₁, 0 < w n ∧ (w n).totient = n.totient ∧ ¬ n ∣ w n ∧
      largestPrimeFactor (w n) ≠ largestPrimeFactor n ∧
      ((∃ m ∈ F₁, m.totient = n.totient ∧ m ≠ n) → w n ∈ F₁) := by
    intro n hn
    have hnF := (hF₁ n hn).1
    by_cases hp : ∃ m ∈ F₁, m.totient = n.totient ∧ m ≠ n
    · have hwn : w n = pm n := if_pos hp
      rw [hwn]
      obtain ⟨hpmF, hpmt⟩ := hpmmem n hn
      have hpmF' := (hF₁ _ hpmF).1
      have hpos : 0 < pm n := (hF _ hpmF').1
      have hndvd : ¬ n ∣ pm n := by
        intro hd
        exact hpmne n hn hp
          (hs1 hpos (by rw [(hF n hnF).2.2.1, (hF _ hpmF').2.2.1]) hd).symm
      have hmemN : pm n ∈ FordLower.nontrivialPreimages n := (hNTP n (pm n)).mpr ⟨hpos, hpmt, hndvd⟩
      exact ⟨hpos, hpmt, hndvd, (hF n hnF).2.2.2.2 _ hmemN, fun _ => hpmF⟩
    · have hwn : w n = N n := if_neg hp
      rw [hwn]
      obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := (hNTP n (N n)).mp (hN n hnF)
      exact ⟨h1, h2, h3, (hF n hnF).2.2.2.2 _ (hN n hnF), fun h => absurd h hp⟩
  have hwinj : Set.InjOn w (F₁ : Set ℕ) := by
    intro n hn n' hn' h
    have hn : n ∈ F₁ := hn
    have hn' : n' ∈ F₁ := hn'
    have ht : n.totient = n'.totient := by
      rw [← (hw n hn).2.1, ← (hw n' hn').2.1, h]
    by_contra hne
    have hp : ∃ m ∈ F₁, m.totient = n.totient ∧ m ≠ n := ⟨n', hn', ht.symm, Ne.symm hne⟩
    have hp' : ∃ m ∈ F₁, m.totient = n'.totient ∧ m ≠ n' := ⟨n, hn, ht, hne⟩
    have e1 : w n = pm n := if_pos hp
    have e2 : w n' = pm n' := if_pos hp'
    exact hne (hpminj n hn n' hn' (by rw [← e1, ← e2]; exact h))
  
  let E₁ := F₁.filter (fun n => ∃ q : ℕ, q.Prime ∧ Real.log Z ^ 4 < (q : ℝ) ∧
    (q ^ 2 ∣ w n ∨ q ^ 2 ∣ (w n).totient))
  let E₂ := F₁.filter (fun n => ∃ q : ℕ, q.Prime ∧ q ∣ w n ∧
    ¬ SNormal (normalityScale (logLog Z)) q)
  let G := F₁ \ (E₁ ∪ E₂)
  have hGF₁ : G ⊆ F₁ := Finset.sdiff_subset
  refine ⟨G, w, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro n hn
    exact (hF₁ n (hGF₁ hn)).1
  · exact hwinj.mono (Finset.coe_subset.mpr hGF₁)
  · intro n hn
    obtain ⟨hnF₁, hnE⟩ := Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hn
    have hnE₁ : n ∉ E₁ := fun h => hnE (Finset.mem_union_left _ h)
    have hnE₂ : n ∉ E₂ := fun h => hnE (Finset.mem_union_right _ h)
    obtain ⟨hnF, hnorm⟩ := hF₁ n hnF₁
    obtain ⟨hw1, hw2, hw3, hw4, _⟩ := hw n hnF₁
    refine ⟨(hF n hnF).1, (hF n hnF).2.1, (hZF n hnF).1, hw1, hw2, hw3, hw4, hnorm, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro q hq hqw
      by_contra hbad
      exact hnE₂ (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hnF₁, q, hq, hqw, hbad⟩)
    · unfold NoLargePrimeSquare
      intro p hp hHp hdiv
      exact hnE₁ (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hnF₁, p, hp, hHp, Or.inl hdiv⟩)
    · unfold NoLargePrimeSquare
      intro p hp hHp hdiv

    have h0 : E₀ ⊆ (Finset.Icc 1 ⌊c * Z * logLog Z⌋₊).filter (fun n => Squarefree n ∧

        exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr
