    have h2 : E₂.card ≤ ((totientsUpTo Z).filter (fun m => ∃ n : ℕ, 0 < n ∧ n.totient = m ∧

      apply Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn (fun n => (w n).totient)

        have htot : ((w n).totient : ℝ) ≤ Z := by

          ⟨Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨Nat.totient_pos.mpr hw1, Nat.le_floor htot⟩, w n, rfl⟩

      intro n hn

    have hu3 := Finset.card_union_le E₀ E₁
    have h0c := Finset.card_le_card h0
    have hNat : F.card ≤
        ((Finset.Icc 1 ⌊c * Z * logLog Z⌋₊).filter (fun n => Squarefree n ∧
            ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors n ≤ ⌊B * Real.log (logLog Z)⌋₊ + 1 ∧
            ∃ q : ℕ, q.Prime ∧ q ∣ n ∧ ¬ SNormal (normalityScale (logLog Z)) q)).card +

            Real.log Z ^ 4 < (q : ℝ) ∧ (q ^ 2 ∣ n ∨ q ^ 2 ∣ n.totient))).card +

            ∃ q : ℕ, q.Prime ∧ q ∣ n ∧ ¬ SNormal (normalityScale (logLog Z)) q)).card +
        G.card := by
      omega
    exact_mod_cast hNat

    (hMERT : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ, 2 ≤ x →
      |(∑ p ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊x⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, (1 : ℝ) / p) - Real.log (Real.log x)| ≤ C)
    (hEULER : Asymptotics.IsEquivalent atTop
      (fun x : ℝ => ∏ p ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊x⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, (1 - (1 : ℝ) / p))
      (fun x => Real.exp (-Real.eulerMascheroniConstant) / Real.log x))
    (hRHO : 0 < FordAnalysis.rho ∧ FordAnalysis.rho < 3 / 4 ∧ FordAnalysis.F FordAnalysis.rho = 1) :
    ∀ᶠ Z : ℝ in atTop,
      ∀ (M : ℕ) (A y : ℝ) (a : Fin (FordScale.coreDimension M (logLog y))) (N : ℕ)
        (R : FordLower.PrimeProductRecord M A y a N), 2 ≤ M → 4 ≤ A → 1 < y → 0 < logLog y →

        ∀ j : ℕ, j < FordScale.coreDimension M (logLog y) + 1 →
          ((FordLower.suffixProduct R.fullTuple j).totient : ℝ) ≤ Z →
          (ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors (FordLower.suffixProduct R.fullTuple j) : ℝ) ≤

              CollisionFacet.extend (fun i2 => CollisionBox.primeCoordinate (logLog Z) (pr i2)) idx) ≤
                1 - (logLog Z) ^ (-1 / 8 : ℝ)

by
  have hLL : Tendsto logLog atTop atTop :=
    Real.tendsto_log_atTop.comp Real.tendsto_log_atTop
  have hbase7 : ∀ᶠ T : ℝ in atTop, 1 ≤ T ∧
      ∀ M d : ℕ, 0 < M + d → ((M + d : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ 15 * Real.log T →
        T ^ (-1 / 100 : ℝ) ≤ FordInner.baseLoss M d ∧
          2 * T ^ (-1 / 8 : ℝ) ≤ FordInner.baseLoss M d := by
    have hlo := (isLittleO_log_rpow_rpow_atTop (3 : ℝ) (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 100)).bound
      (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 67500)
    filter_upwards [hlo, eventually_ge_atTop (1 : ℝ)] with T hT hT1
    refine ⟨hT1, ?_⟩
    intro M d hMd hs
    have hT0 : 0 < T := by linarith
    have hu : 0 ≤ Real.log T := Real.log_nonneg hT1
    have hl3 : 0 ≤ Real.log T ^ (3 : ℝ) := Real.rpow_nonneg hu _
    have hy : 0 < T ^ (1 / 100 : ℝ) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hT0 _
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hl3, abs_of_pos hy] at hT
    rw [show (3 : ℝ) = ((3 : ℕ) : ℝ) by norm_num, Real.rpow_natCast] at hT
    have hs0 : (0 : ℝ) < ((M + d : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hMd
    have hs3 : ((M + d : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 3 ≤ (15 * Real.log T) ^ 3 := pow_le_pow_left₀ hs0.le hs 3
    have hexp : (15 * Real.log T) ^ 3 = 3375 * Real.log T ^ 3 := by ring
    have hA : 20 * ((M + d : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 3 ≤ T ^ (1 / 100 : ℝ) := by
      rw [hexp] at hs3
      linarith
    have h8 : T ^ (1 / 100 : ℝ) ≤ T ^ (1 / 8 : ℝ) :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hT1 (by norm_num)
    have hneg1 : T ^ (-1 / 100 : ℝ) = 1 / T ^ (1 / 100 : ℝ) := by
      rw [show (-1 / 100 : ℝ) = -(1 / 100) by norm_num, Real.rpow_neg hT0.le]
      exact (one_div _).symm
    have hneg8 : T ^ (-1 / 8 : ℝ) = 1 / T ^ (1 / 8 : ℝ) := by
      rw [show (-1 / 8 : ℝ) = -(1 / 8) by norm_num, Real.rpow_neg hT0.le]
      exact (one_div _).symm
    have hp3 : 0 < ((M + d : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 3 := pow_pos hs0 3
    unfold FordInner.baseLoss
    constructor
    · rw [hneg1]
      apply one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by positivity)
      linarith
    · rw [hneg8, mul_one_div, div_le_div_iff₀ (by linarith) (by positivity)]
      linarith
  have haux : ∀ᶠ w : ℝ in atTop, 1 < w ∧ w ^ (-1 / 20 : ℝ) ≤ coreLowerFraction w := by
    have hlo := (isLittleO_log_rpow_rpow_atTop (1 : ℝ) (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 10)).bound
      (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1)
    filter_upwards [hlo, hLL.eventually_gt_atTop 0, eventually_gt_atTop (1 : ℝ)] with w hw hll hw1
    refine ⟨hw1, ?_⟩
    have hw0 : 0 < w := by linarith
    have hlogw : 0 < Real.log w := Real.log_pos hw1
    have h20 : 0 < w ^ (1 / 20 : ℝ) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hw0 _
    rw [Real.rpow_one, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, one_mul, abs_of_pos hlogw,
      abs_of_pos (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hw0 _)] at hw
    have hll_le : logLog w ≤ Real.log w := by
      unfold logLog
      exact Real.log_le_self hlogw.le
    have hsq : (w ^ (1 / 20 : ℝ)) ^ 2 = w ^ (1 / 10 : ℝ) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hw0.le]
      norm_num
    have hsqrt : Real.sqrt (logLog w) ≤ w ^ (1 / 20 : ℝ) := by
      rw [← Real.sqrt_sq h20.le]
      apply Real.sqrt_le_sqrt
      rw [hsq]
      linarith
    have hsqrt0 : 0 < Real.sqrt (logLog w) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hll
    have hneg : w ^ (-1 / 20 : ℝ) = 1 / w ^ (1 / 20 : ℝ) := by
      rw [show (-1 / 20 : ℝ) = -(1 / 20) by norm_num, Real.rpow_neg hw0.le]
      exact (one_div _).symm
    rw [hneg]
    show 1 / w ^ (1 / 20 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / Real.sqrt (logLog w)
    exact one_div_le_one_div_of_le hsqrt0 hsqrt
  have hend8 : ∀ᶠ Z : ℝ in atTop,
      ∀ (M : ℕ) (A y : ℝ) (a : Fin (FordScale.coreDimension M (logLog y))) (N : ℕ)
        (R : FordLower.PrimeProductRecord M A y a N), 1 < y → (N.totient : ℝ) ≤ Z →
          logLog y ≤ logLog Z + 1 := by
    obtain ⟨Y₀, hY₀⟩ := eventually_atTop.mp haux

    have hy0 : 0 < y := by linarith
    have hlogy : 0 < Real.log y := Real.log_pos hy
    rcases le_or_gt y Z with hyZ | hZy
    · have h1 : Real.log y ≤ Real.log Z := Real.log_le_log hy0 hyZ
      have h2 : Real.log (Real.log y) ≤ Real.log (Real.log Z) := Real.log_le_log hlogy h1

      have h1 : (19 / 20 : ℝ) * Real.log y < Real.log Z := by
        rw [← Real.log_rpow hy0]
        exact Real.log_lt_log hpos hlt
      have hA0 : 0 < (19 / 20 : ℝ) * Real.log y := mul_pos (by norm_num) hlogy
      have h2 : Real.log ((19 / 20 : ℝ) * Real.log y) < Real.log (Real.log Z) :=
        Real.log_lt_log hA0 h1
      rw [Real.log_mul (by norm_num) hlogy.ne'] at h2
      have h3 : 1 - (19 / 20 : ℝ)⁻¹ ≤ Real.log (19 / 20) :=
        Real.one_sub_inv_le_log_of_pos (by norm_num)
      have h4 : (19 / 20 : ℝ)⁻¹ = 20 / 19 := by norm_num
      rw [h4] at h3
      unfold logLog
      linarith
  filter_upwards [hend8, hLL.eventually hbase7]
    with Z hend hbase
  obtain ⟨hT1, hb⟩ := hbase
  intro M A y a N R hM hA hy ht hMZ j hj hsize hΩ
  obtain ⟨hPprime, hPanti, hPprod⟩ : (∀ idx, (R.fullTuple idx).Prime) ∧ StrictAnti R.fullTuple ∧
      (∏ idx, R.fullTuple idx) = N := by
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro idx
      refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun i => ?_) idx
      · simpa [FordLower.PrimeProductRecord.fullTuple] using R.leading_prime
      · simpa [FordLower.PrimeProductRecord.fullTuple] using R.lower_prime i
    · intro i k hik
      induction k using Fin.cases with
      | zero => exact absurd hik (Fin.not_lt_zero _)
      | succ k' =>
        induction i using Fin.cases with
        | zero => simpa [FordLower.PrimeProductRecord.fullTuple] using R.lower_separated k'
        | succ i' =>
          simp only [FordLower.PrimeProductRecord.fullTuple, Fin.cons_succ]
          exact R.lower_order (Fin.succ_lt_succ_iff.mp hik)
    · rw [FordLower.PrimeProductRecord.fullTuple, Fin.prod_univ_succ, Fin.cons_zero]
      simp only [Fin.cons_succ]
      exact R.integer.symm
  have hlow17 : ∀ i, 17 ≤ R.lower i := by
    intro i
    have h1 := R.lower_minimum i
    have hexpA : 5 ≤ Real.exp A := by
      have := Real.add_one_le_exp A
      linarith
    have h2 : Real.exp 5 ≤ Real.exp (Real.exp A) := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hexpA
    have h4 : Real.exp 5 = Real.exp 1 ^ 5 := by
      rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul]
      norm_num
    have h5 : (2 : ℝ) ^ 5 ≤ Real.exp 1 ^ 5 :=
      pow_le_pow_left₀ (by norm_num) (by linarith [Real.exp_one_gt_d9]) 5
    have h6 : (16 : ℝ) < (R.lower i : ℝ) := by
      rw [h4] at h2
      norm_num at h5
      linarith
    have h7 : 16 < R.lower i := by exact_mod_cast h6
    omega
  have hP17 : ∀ idx, 17 ≤ R.fullTuple idx := by
    intro idx
    refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun i => ?_) idx
    · have h1 := R.lower_separated a
      have h2 := hlow17 a
      simp only [FordLower.PrimeProductRecord.fullTuple, Fin.cons_zero]
      omega
    · simpa [FordLower.PrimeProductRecord.fullTuple] using hlow17 i
  have hML : M + FordScale.coreDimension M (logLog y) = FordScale.optimalDimension (logLog y) := by
    have := a.isLt
    unfold FordScale.coreDimension at this ⊢
    omega
  have htop : FordLower.topLoss (logLog y) =
      FordInner.baseLoss M (FordScale.coreDimension M (logLog y)) := by
    unfold FordLower.topLoss FordInner.baseLoss
    rw [hML]
  have hgapfull : ∀ (idx i2 : Fin (FordScale.coreDimension M (logLog y) + 1)),
      i2.val = idx.val + 1 →
      (1 + FordInner.baseLoss M (FordScale.coreDimension M (logLog y) - idx.val)) *

  have hA0 : (0 : ℝ) < A := by linarith
  have hT0 : (0 : ℝ) < logLog Z := by linarith
  
  have hc0 : 0 ≤ (logLog Z) ^ (-1 / 8 : ℝ) := Real.rpow_nonneg hT0.le _

    Real.rpow_le_one_of_one_le_of_nonpos hT1 (by norm_num)

    have h1 : (logLog Z) ^ (-1 : ℝ) ≤ (logLog Z) ^ (-1 / 8 : ℝ) :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hT1 (by norm_num)

  have hble : ∀ d : ℕ, FordInner.baseLoss M d ≤ 1 / 10 := by
    intro d

    have h1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ((M + d : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 3 :=
      one_le_pow₀ (by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 1 ≤ M + d))
    apply one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by norm_num)
    linarith

    intro d
    unfold FordInner.baseLoss
    positivity
  have hbanti : ∀ d d' : ℕ, d' ≤ d → FordInner.baseLoss M d ≤ FordInner.baseLoss M d' := by
    intro d d' hdd
    unfold FordInner.baseLoss
    have h0 : (0 : ℝ) < ((M + d' : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 0 < M + d')
    have h1 : ((M + d' : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ ((M + d : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast (by omega : M + d' ≤ M + d)
    apply one_div_le_one_div_of_le (mul_pos (by norm_num) (pow_pos h0 3))

      · have hs6 : (∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (FordScale.coreDimension M (logLog y) - j), fordWeight m *

informal_problem.statement:
(hPNT : Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => (Nat.primeCounting ⌊x⌋₊ : ℝ) / (x / Real.log x)) atTop (𝓝 1))
    (hMERT : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ, 2 ≤ x →
      |(∑ p ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊x⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, (1 : ℝ) / p) - Real.log (Real.log x)| ≤ C)
    (hEULER : Asymptotics.IsEquivalent atTop
      (fun x : ℝ => ∏ p ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊x⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, (1 - (1 : ℝ) / p))
      (fun x => Real.exp (-Real.eulerMascheroniConstant) / Real.log x))
    (hRHO : 0 < FordAnalysis.rho ∧ FordAnalysis.rho < 3 / 4 ∧ FordAnalysis.F FordAnalysis.rho = 1)
    (A : ℝ) : ∀ᶠ Y : ℝ in atTop,
      ∀ (L n w : ℕ) (p : Fin (L + 1) → ℕ), (L : ℝ) ≤ A * Real.log (logLog Y) →
        (∏ idx, p idx) = n → (∀ idx, (p idx).Prime) → (∀ idx, 17 ≤ p idx) → StrictAnti p →
        (∀ idx j : Fin (L + 1), j.val = idx.val + 1 →
          (1 + (logLog Y) ^ (-1 / 100 : ℝ)) * logLog (p j) ≤ logLog (p idx)) →
        (∑ idx ∈ Finset.Icc 1 L, fordWeight idx * CollisionFacet.extend
          (fun j => CollisionBox.primeCoordinate (logLog Y) (p j)) idx) ≤ 1 - (logLog Y) ^ (-1 / 8 : ℝ) →
        (0 < n ∧ Squarefree n ∧ (n.totient : ℝ) ≤ Y ∧ 0 < w ∧

  have hcond : CollisionClass.Conditions C 1 (CollisionRecord.commonProduct J p C) (∏ idx, p idx)
      (normalityScale (logLog Y)) Y (CollisionSum.upper Y p J C) (CollisionSum.lower Y p J C)
      (CollisionRecord.leftPrimes J p) right (CollisionRecord.tailPrimes J p) res := by
    refine
      { normal_left := fun idx => hleft _
        normal_right := fun idx => hqn _
        normal_tail := fun idx => hleft _
        left_injective := ?_
        residual_pos := ?_
        common := rfl
        common_product := rfl
        integer := hsplitP p
        equation := hLeq.trans hR.symm
        size := ?_
        square_exclusion := ?_
        largest_left := fun idx => (hpair idx).1
        largest_right := fun idx => (hpair idx).2
        tail_support := ?_
        residual_support := ?_
        top := ?_ }
    · intro a b hab
      have h := congrArg (fun x : Fin (L + 1) => x.val) (ho.injective hab)
      exact Fin.ext h
    · exact Nat.mul_pos hspos (Finset.prod_pos fun j _ => by have := (hqn j).1.two_le; omega)
    · rw [hLeq]
      exact hsize
    · rw [hLeq]
      exact fun r hr hlt => hsqPhi r hr (lt_of_le_of_lt hv'.normality hlt)
    · intro idx z hz
      have hlt : J < CollisionRecord.tailIndex J idx := by
        rw [Fin.lt_iff_val_lt_val]
        show J.val < J.val + 1 + idx.val
        omega
      exact (hO2 (CollisionRecord.tailIndex J idx) hlt z hz).trans_eq htailEq
    · intro z hz
      exact (hO4 z hz).trans_eq htailEq
    · intro idx hi
      have h0 : CollisionMatching.prefixIndex J idx = 0 :=
        Fin.ext (by simp [CollisionMatching.prefixIndex, hi])
      show Y ^ (9 / 10 : ℝ) < (p (CollisionMatching.prefixIndex J idx) : ℝ)
      rw [h0]
      exact htop
  rw [heq] at hcond
  exact ⟨p, J, C, right, res, hzero, hv', hcond, hp17, ho.antitone, hfacet⟩

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have hLL : Tendsto logLog atTop atTop :=
    Real.tendsto_log_atTop.comp Real.tendsto_log_atTop
  have hK : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 6 * A + 7 := by linarith
  filter_upwards [retained_class_saving_with_empty_tail_eventually hPNT hMERT hEULER hA d hd (6 * A + 7),
    empty_tail_label_weight_sum_eventually hMERT hA d hd, eventually_gt_atTop (1 : ℝ),
    hLL.eventually_gt_atTop 0] with Y hclass hlabels hY hT
  intro L F hL hdS hrec
  
  have hcong : ∀ (p p' : Fin (L + 1) → ℕ) (J : Fin (L + 1)) (C : Finset (Fin (J.val + 1))),
      CollisionSum.box Y p = CollisionSum.box Y p' →
      CollisionSum.upper Y p J C = CollisionSum.upper Y p' J C ∧
        CollisionSum.lower Y p J C = CollisionSum.lower Y p' J C := by
    intro p q J C heq
    have hselected : CollisionCutoff.selectedZeta J C (1 / logLog Y)
        (fun idx => CollisionBox.shiftedCoordinate (logLog Y) (p idx)) =
        CollisionCutoff.selectedZeta J C (1 / logLog Y)
          (fun idx => CollisionBox.shiftedCoordinate (logLog Y) (q idx)) := by
      funext idx
      exact congrFun heq (CollisionCutoff.selectedIndex J C idx)
    have htail : CollisionBox.tailCoordinate (1 / logLog Y) ((logLog Y) ^ (-2 / 5 : ℝ))
        ((logLog Y) ^ (-1 / 3 : ℝ)) (fun idx => CollisionBox.shiftedCoordinate (logLog Y) (p idx)) J =
        CollisionBox.tailCoordinate (1 / logLog Y) ((logLog Y) ^ (-2 / 5 : ℝ))
          ((logLog Y) ^ (-1 / 3 : ℝ)) (fun idx => CollisionBox.shiftedCoordinate (logLog Y) (q idx)) J := by
      unfold CollisionBox.tailCoordinate
      rw [show CollisionBox.rounded (1 / logLog Y)
        (fun idx => CollisionBox.shiftedCoordinate (logLog Y) (p idx)) J =
        CollisionBox.rounded (1 / logLog Y)
          (fun idx => CollisionBox.shiftedCoordinate (logLog Y) (q idx)) J from congrFun heq J]
    constructor <;> simp only [CollisionSum.upper, CollisionSum.lower, CollisionRecord.upper,
      CollisionRecord.lower, hselected, htail]
  
  have htrans : ∀ (J₁ J₂ : Fin (L + 1)) (C₁ : Finset (Fin (J₁.val + 1)))
      (C₂ : Finset (Fin (J₂.val + 1))) (p₁ p₂ : Fin (L + 1) → ℕ)
      (r₁ : Fin (J₁.val + 1) → ℕ) (e₁ n : ℕ),
      (((J₁, CollisionSum.box Y p₁), CollisionSum.commonCode J₁ C₁,
          CollisionRecord.commonProduct J₁ p₁ C₁) : CollisionSum.Label L) =
        ((J₂, CollisionSum.box Y p₂), CollisionSum.commonCode J₂ C₂,
          CollisionRecord.commonProduct J₂ p₂ C₂) →
      CollisionClass.Conditions C₁ d (CollisionRecord.commonProduct J₁ p₁ C₁) n
        (normalityScale (logLog Y)) Y (CollisionSum.upper Y p₁ J₁ C₁) (CollisionSum.lower Y p₁ J₁ C₁)
        (CollisionRecord.leftPrimes J₁ p₁) r₁ (CollisionRecord.tailPrimes J₁ p₁) e₁ →
      ∃ (p q : Fin (J₂.val + 1) → ℕ) (t : Fin (L - J₂.val) → ℕ) (e : ℕ),
        CollisionClass.Conditions C₂ d (CollisionRecord.commonProduct J₂ p₂ C₂) n
          (normalityScale (logLog Y)) Y (CollisionSum.upper Y p₂ J₂ C₂)
          (CollisionSum.lower Y p₂ J₂ C₂) p q t e := by
    intro J₁ J₂ C₁ C₂ p₁ p₂ r₁ e₁ n heq hcond
    have hJJ : J₁ = J₂ := congrArg (fun l : CollisionSum.Label L => l.1.1) heq
    subst hJJ
    have hCC : C₁ = C₂ :=
      Finset.map_injective (CollisionSum.prefixEmbedding J₁)
        (congrArg (fun l : CollisionSum.Label L => l.2.1) heq)
    subst hCC
    have hb : CollisionSum.box Y p₁ = CollisionSum.box Y p₂ :=
      congrArg (fun l : CollisionSum.Label L => l.1.2) heq
    have hM : CollisionRecord.commonProduct J₁ p₁ C₁ = CollisionRecord.commonProduct J₁ p₂ C₁ :=
      congrArg (fun l : CollisionSum.Label L => l.2.2) heq
    have hcut := hcong p₁ p₂ J₁ C₁ hb
    refine ⟨CollisionRecord.leftPrimes J₁ p₁, r₁, CollisionRecord.tailPrimes J₁ p₁, e₁, ?_⟩
    simpa only [hM, hcut.1, hcut.2] using hcond
  
  have hex : ∀ n ∈ F, ∃ l : CollisionSum.Label L, ∃ (pr : Fin (L + 1) → ℕ) (J : Fin (L + 1))
      (common : Finset (Fin (J.val + 1))) (right : Fin (J.val + 1) → ℕ) (residual : ℕ),
      ((∀ idx : Fin (J.val + 1), idx.val = 0 → idx ∉ common) ∧
        CollisionCutoff.SieveCutoffs (CollisionClass.remaining common).card Y (normalityDelta (logLog Y))
          (CollisionSum.upper Y pr J common) (CollisionSum.lower Y pr J common) ∧
        CollisionClass.Conditions common d (CollisionRecord.commonProduct J pr common) n
          (normalityScale (logLog Y)) Y (CollisionSum.upper Y pr J common)
          (CollisionSum.lower Y pr J common)
          (CollisionRecord.leftPrimes J pr) right (CollisionRecord.tailPrimes J pr) residual ∧
        (∀ idx, 17 ≤ pr idx) ∧ Antitone pr ∧
        (∑ idx ∈ Finset.Icc 1 L, fordWeight idx *
          CollisionFacet.extend (fun i2 => CollisionBox.primeCoordinate (logLog Y) (pr i2)) idx) ≤
            1 - (logLog Y) ^ (-1 / 8 : ℝ)) ∧
      l = ((J, CollisionSum.box Y pr), CollisionSum.commonCode J common,
        CollisionRecord.commonProduct J pr common) := by
    intro n hn
    obtain ⟨pr, J, common, right, residual, h⟩ := hrec n hn
    exact ⟨_, pr, J, common, right, residual, h, rfl⟩
  choose! lab hlab using hex

    exact (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp h).2
  
  have hprodidx : ∀ f : Fin a → ℕ,
      (∏ idx : Fin (CollisionClass.remaining C).card, f (CollisionClass.index C idx)) =
        ∏ j ∈ CollisionClass.remaining C, f j := by
    intro f
    rw [← Finset.prod_coe_sort (CollisionClass.remaining C) f]
    exact Fintype.prod_equiv ((CollisionClass.remaining C).orderIsoOfFin rfl).toEquiv _ _
      (fun _ => rfl)
  
  have hfirst : ∀ idx : Fin (CollisionClass.remaining C).card, idx.val = 0 →
      (CollisionClass.index C idx).val = 0 := by
    intro idx hi
    have ha : 0 < a := by have := (CollisionClass.index C idx).isLt; omega
    let z : Fin a := ⟨0, ha⟩
    have hz : z ∈ CollisionClass.remaining C := by
      unfold CollisionClass.remaining
      exact Finset.mem_sdiff.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hzero z rfl⟩
    have hj : CollisionClass.index C
        (((CollisionClass.remaining C).orderIsoOfFin rfl).symm ⟨z, hz⟩) = z := by
      show (((CollisionClass.remaining C).orderIsoOfFin rfl)
        (((CollisionClass.remaining C).orderIsoOfFin rfl).symm ⟨z, hz⟩)).val = z
      rw [OrderIso.apply_symm_apply]
    have hij : idx ≤ ((CollisionClass.remaining C).orderIsoOfFin rfl).symm ⟨z, hz⟩ := by
      rw [Fin.le_def]; omega
    have hmono : CollisionClass.index C idx ≤ CollisionClass.index C
        (((CollisionClass.remaining C).orderIsoOfFin rfl).symm ⟨z, hz⟩) :=
      Subtype.coe_le_coe.mpr (((CollisionClass.remaining C).orderIsoOfFin rfl).monotone hij)
    rw [hj] at hmono
    have h2 : (CollisionClass.index C idx).val ≤ 0 := Fin.le_def.mp hmono
    omega
  
  have hsplit : ∀ f : Fin a → ℕ,
      (∏ j ∈ CollisionClass.remaining C, f j) * (∏ j ∈ C, f j) = ∏ j, f j := by
    intro f
    unfold CollisionClass.remaining
    exact Finset.prod_sdiff (Finset.subset_univ C)
  
  have htot : ∀ (P : Fin a → ℕ), (∀ i, (P i).Prime) → Function.Injective P →
      ∀ s : Finset (Fin a), (∏ i ∈ s, P i).totient = ∏ i ∈ s, (P i - 1) := by
    intro P hP hinj s
    induction s using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty => simp
    | insert i s his ih =>
      rw [Finset.prod_insert his, Finset.prod_insert his, Nat.totient_mul,
        Nat.totient_prime (hP i), ih]
      apply Nat.Coprime.prod_right
      intro j hj
      have hne : P i ≠ P j := by
        intro h
        apply his
        rw [hinj h]
        exact hj
      exact (Nat.coprime_primes (hP i) (hP j)).mpr hne
  
  have hcardF : ∀ {pp : ℕ} {S u : ℝ}, Real.exp 1 ≤ S → S ≤ u → SNormal S pp →
      (∀ z ∈ (pp - 1).primeFactorsList, (z : ℝ) ≤ u) →
      (ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors (pp - 1) : ℝ) ≤ 10 * logLog u := by
    intro pp S u hS hSu hp hsupp
    have hS1 : (1 : ℝ) < S := lt_of_lt_of_le (Real.one_lt_exp_iff.mpr one_pos) hS
    have hS0 : (0 : ℝ) < S := by linarith
    have hlogS : 1 ≤ Real.log S := by
      have h := Real.log_le_log (Real.exp_pos 1) hS
      rwa [Real.log_exp] at h
    have hLS : 0 ≤ Real.log (Real.log S) := Real.log_nonneg hlogS
    have hmono : ∀ x : ℝ, S ≤ x → Real.log (Real.log S) ≤ Real.log (Real.log x) := by
      intro x hx
      exact Real.log_le_log (by linarith) (Real.log_le_log hS0 hx)
    have hLSu := hmono u hSu
    have hsplitc : ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors (pp - 1) =
        omegaInterval (pp - 1) 1 S + omegaInterval (pp - 1) S u := by
      rw [ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors_apply]
      unfold omegaInterval
      rw [List.length_eq_countP_add_countP (fun z : ℕ => decide ((1 : ℝ) < z ∧ (z : ℝ) ≤ S))]
      congr 1
      apply List.countP_congr
      intro z hz
      have h1 : (1 : ℝ) < z := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactorsList hz).one_lt
      have h2 := hsupp z hz
      simp only [decide_eq_true_eq, not_and, not_le]
      constructor
      · intro h; exact ⟨h h1, h2⟩
      · intro h _; exact h.1
    have hB : (omegaInterval (pp - 1) S u : ℝ) ≤ 2 * Real.log (Real.log u) := by
      by_cases hv : S < min u ((pp - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)
      · have heqB : omegaInterval (pp - 1) S u =
            omegaInterval (pp - 1) S (min u ((pp - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) := by
          unfold omegaInterval
          apply List.countP_congr
          intro z hz
          have hzm : (z : ℝ) ≤ ((pp - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
            exact_mod_cast Nat.le_of_mem_primeFactorsList hz
          have hzu := hsupp z hz
          simp only [decide_eq_true_eq, le_min_iff]
          constructor
          · intro h; exact ⟨h.1, h.2, hzm⟩
          · intro h; exact ⟨h.1, h.2.1⟩
        have hcl := hp.2.2 S (min u ((pp - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) le_rfl hv (min_le_right _ _)
        have hlt := (abs_lt.mp hcl).2
        have hLv := hmono _ hv.le
        have hvpos : 0 < Real.log (min u ((pp - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) := by
          have := Real.log_le_log hS0 hv.le; linarith
        have hLvu : Real.log (Real.log (min u ((pp - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))) ≤ Real.log (Real.log u) :=
          Real.log_le_log hvpos (Real.log_le_log (by linarith) (min_le_left _ _))
        have hL0 : 0 ≤ Real.log (Real.log (min u ((pp - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))) := le_trans hLS hLv
        have hsq : Real.sqrt (Real.log (Real.log S) *
            Real.log (Real.log (min u ((pp - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)))) ≤
            Real.log (Real.log (min u ((pp - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))) := by
          calc Real.sqrt (Real.log (Real.log S) * Real.log (Real.log (min u ((pp - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))))
              ≤ Real.sqrt (Real.log (Real.log (min u ((pp - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))) *
                  Real.log (Real.log (min u ((pp - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)))) :=
                Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hLv hL0)
            _ = Real.log (Real.log (min u ((pp - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))) := Real.sqrt_mul_self hL0
        rw [heqB]
        linarith
      · have h0 : omegaInterval (pp - 1) S u = 0 := by
          unfold omegaInterval
          rw [List.countP_eq_zero]
          intro z hz hzd
          simp only [decide_eq_true_eq] at hzd
          have hzm : (z : ℝ) ≤ ((pp - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
            exact_mod_cast Nat.le_of_mem_primeFactorsList hz
          have hmin : (z : ℝ) ≤ min u ((pp - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := le_min hzd.2 hzm
          push_neg at hv
          linarith [hzd.1]
        rw [h0]
        push_cast
        linarith
    have hA := hp.2.1
    rw [hsplitc]
    push_cast
    unfold logLog
    linarith
  have hscale : Real.exp 1 ≤ normalityScale (logLog Y) := by
    unfold normalityScale
    exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (Real.one_le_exp_iff.mpr (by positivity))
  
  obtain ⟨st, hst⟩ : ∃ st : ℕ → (Fin ((CollisionClass.remaining C).card + l) → ℕ) ×
      (Fin ((CollisionClass.remaining C).card + 1) → ℕ),
      ∀ n, st n = (Fin.append (fun i => p n (CollisionClass.index C i) - 1) (fun j => t n j - 1),
        Fin.append (fun i => q n (CollisionClass.index C i) - 1) (fun _ : Fin 1 => e n)) :=
    ⟨_, fun n => rfl⟩
  
  have hL1 : ∀ n (x : Fin ((CollisionClass.remaining C).card + l))
      (h : x.val < (CollisionClass.remaining C).card),
      (st n).1 x = p n (CollisionClass.index C ⟨x.val, h⟩) - 1 := by
    intro n x h
    have hx : x = Fin.castAdd l ⟨x.val, h⟩ := Fin.ext rfl
    rw [hst]
    conv_lhs => rw [hx]
    simp only [Fin.append_left]
  have hR1 : ∀ n (x : Fin ((CollisionClass.remaining C).card + 1))
      (h : x.val < (CollisionClass.remaining C).card),
      (st n).2 x = q n (CollisionClass.index C ⟨x.val, h⟩) - 1 := by
    intro n x h
    have hx : x = Fin.castAdd 1 ⟨x.val, h⟩ := Fin.ext rfl
    rw [hst]
    conv_lhs => rw [hx]
    simp only [Fin.append_left]
  have hL2 : ∀ n (x : Fin ((CollisionClass.remaining C).card + l))
      (h : (CollisionClass.remaining C).card ≤ x.val),
      (st n).1 x = t n ⟨x.val - (CollisionClass.remaining C).card,
        by have := x.isLt; omega⟩ - 1 := by
    intro n x h
    have hx : x = Fin.natAdd (CollisionClass.remaining C).card
        ⟨x.val - (CollisionClass.remaining C).card, by have := x.isLt; omega⟩ := by
      ext
      simp only [Fin.val_natAdd]
      omega
    rw [hst]
    conv_lhs => rw [hx]
    simp only [Fin.append_right]
  have hR2 : ∀ n (x : Fin ((CollisionClass.remaining C).card + 1)),
      (CollisionClass.remaining C).card ≤ x.val → (st n).2 x = e n := by
    intro n x h
    have hx : x = Fin.natAdd (CollisionClass.remaining C).card (0 : Fin 1) := by
      ext
      simp only [Fin.val_natAdd]
      have := x.isLt
      simp only [Fin.val_zero]
      omega
    rw [hst]
    conv_lhs => rw [hx]
    simp only [Fin.append_right]
  
  have hP1 : ∀ n, ∏ x, (st n).1 x =
      (∏ i ∈ CollisionClass.remaining C, (p n i - 1)) * ∏ j, (t n j - 1) := by
    intro n
    rw [hst, Fin.prod_univ_add]
    simp only [Fin.append_left, Fin.append_right]
    rw [hprodidx (fun i => p n i - 1)]
  have hP2 : ∀ n, ∏ x, (st n).2 x =
      (∏ i ∈ CollisionClass.remaining C, (q n i - 1)) * e n := by
    intro n
    rw [hst, Fin.prod_univ_add]
    simp only [Fin.append_left, Fin.append_right, Fin.prod_univ_one]
    rw [hprodidx (fun i => q n i - 1)]
  have hP3 : ∀ n ∈ F, ∏ x, ((st n).1 x + 1) =
      (∏ i ∈ CollisionClass.remaining C, p n i) * ∏ j, t n j := by
    intro n hn
    have hs := hF n hn
    have e1 : ∀ i, p n i - 1 + 1 = p n i := fun i => Nat.sub_add_cancel (hs.normal_left i).1.one_le
    have e2 : ∀ j, t n j - 1 + 1 = t n j := fun j => Nat.sub_add_cancel (hs.normal_tail j).1.one_le
    rw [hst, Fin.prod_univ_add]
    simp only [Fin.append_left, Fin.append_right, e1, e2]
    rw [hprodidx (p n)]
  have hrec : ∀ n ∈ F, n = M * ∏ x, ((st n).1 x + 1) := by
    intro n hn
    have hs := hF n hn
    refine hs.integer.symm.trans ?_
    rw [hP3 n hn, ← hsplit (p n), hs.common_product]
    ring
  have hphi : ∀ n ∈ F, d * ((∏ i, (p n i - 1)) * ∏ j, (t n j - 1)) =
      M.totient * (d * ∏ x, (st n).1 x) := by
    intro n hn
    have hs := hF n hn
    rw [hP1 n, ← hs.common_product, htot (p n) (fun i => (hs.normal_left i).1) hs.left_injective C,
      ← hsplit (fun i => p n i - 1)]
    ring
  have hBal : ∀ n ∈ F, d * ∏ x, (st n).1 x = ∏ x, (st n).2 x := by
    intro n hn
    have hs := hF n hn
    have hcq : ∏ i ∈ C, (q n i - 1) = ∏ i ∈ C, (p n i - 1) := by
      apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
      intro i hi
      have hi' : i ∈ commonIndices Finset.univ (p n) (q n) := by rw [← hs.common]; exact hi
      unfold commonIndices at hi'
      rw [(Finset.mem_filter.mp hi').2]
    have hc : 0 < ∏ i ∈ C, (p n i - 1) :=
      Finset.prod_pos (fun i _ => by have := (hs.normal_left i).1.two_le; omega)
    have heq := hs.equation
    rw [← hsplit (fun i => p n i - 1), ← hsplit (fun i => q n i - 1), hcq] at heq
    rw [hP1 n, hP2 n]
    apply Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left hc
    calc (∏ i ∈ C, (p n i - 1)) *
          (d * ((∏ i ∈ CollisionClass.remaining C, (p n i - 1)) * ∏ j, (t n j - 1)))
        = d * (((∏ i ∈ CollisionClass.remaining C, (p n i - 1)) * ∏ i ∈ C, (p n i - 1)) *
            ∏ j, (t n j - 1)) := by ring
      _ = ((∏ i ∈ CollisionClass.remaining C, (q n i - 1)) * ∏ i ∈ C, (p n i - 1)) * e n := heq
      _ = (∏ i ∈ C, (p n i - 1)) * ((∏ i ∈ CollisionClass.remaining C, (q n i - 1)) * e n) := by
          ring
  have hdistinct : ∀ n ∈ F, ∀ i : Fin (CollisionClass.remaining C).card,
      p n (CollisionClass.index C i) - 1 ≠ q n (CollisionClass.index C i) - 1 := by
    intro n hn i hpq
    have hs := hF n hn
    have h2p := (hs.normal_left (CollisionClass.index C i)).1.two_le
    have h2q := (hs.normal_right (CollisionClass.index C i)).1.two_le
    have hpq' : p n (CollisionClass.index C i) = q n (CollisionClass.index C i) := by omega
    have hmemC : ∀ j : Fin a, p n j = q n j → j ∈ C := by
      intro j hj
      rw [hs.common]
      exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hj⟩
    exact hnotC i (hmemC _ hpq')
  refine ⟨F.image st, ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply Finset.card_image_of_injOn
    intro n hn m hm hnm
    have hn' := hrec n (Finset.mem_coe.mp hn)
    have hm' := hrec m (Finset.mem_coe.mp hm)
    have hnm' : st n = st m := hnm
    calc n = M * ∏ x, ((st n).1 x + 1) := hn'
      _ = M * ∏ x, ((st m).1 x + 1) := by rw [hnm']
      _ = m := hm'.symm
  · intro s hs'
    obtain ⟨n, hn, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hs'
    have hs := hF n hn
    have hP : ∀ i, (p n i).Prime := fun i => (hs.normal_left i).1
    have hQ : ∀ i, (q n i).Prime := fun i => (hs.normal_right i).1
    have hT : ∀ j, (t n j).Prime := fun j => (hs.normal_tail j).1
    refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, hBal n hn, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro x
      by_cases h : x.val < (CollisionClass.remaining C).card
      · rw [hL1 n x h]; exact Nat.sub_pos_of_lt (hP _).one_lt
      · rw [hL2 n x (by omega)]; exact Nat.sub_pos_of_lt (hT _).one_lt
    · intro x
      by_cases h : x.val < (CollisionClass.remaining C).card
      · rw [hR1 n x h]; exact Nat.sub_pos_of_lt (hQ _).one_lt
      · rw [hR2 n x (by omega)]; exact hs.residual_pos
    · have h := hs.size
      rw [hphi n hn, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_mul] at h
      simpa only [mul_assoc] using h
    · intro z hz hzv hdvd
      apply hs.square_exclusion z hz hzv
      rw [hphi n hn]
      exact Dvd.dvd.mul_left hdvd _
    · intro x h
      rw [hL1 n x h, Nat.sub_add_cancel (hP _).one_le]
      exact hs.normal_left _
    · intro x h
      rw [hR1 n x h, Nat.sub_add_cancel (hQ _).one_le]
      exact hs.normal_right _
    · intro x y hx hy
      have hy' : y.val < (CollisionClass.remaining C).card := by omega
      rw [hL1 n x hx, hR1 n y hy']
      have hxy : (⟨y.val, hy'⟩ : Fin (CollisionClass.remaining C).card) = ⟨x.val, hx⟩ := Fin.ext hy
      rw [hxy]
      exact hdistinct n hn ⟨x.val, hx⟩
    · intro x h
      rw [hL1 n x h]
      exact hs.largest_left ⟨x.val, h⟩
    · intro y h
      rw [hR1 n y h]
      exact hs.largest_right ⟨y.val, h⟩
    · intro x h r hr
      rw [hL2 n x h] at hr
      exact hs.tail_support _ r hr
    · intro y h r hr
      rw [hR2 n y h] at hr
      exact hs.residual_support r hr
    · intro x h
      rw [hL2 n x h]
      exact hcardF hscale hSv (hs.normal_tail _) (hs.tail_support _)
    · intro x h0
      have h : x.val < (CollisionClass.remaining C).card := by omega
      rw [hL1 n x h, Nat.sub_add_cancel (hP _).one_le]
      exact hs.top _ (hfirst _ h0)

informal_problem.statement:
(hPNT : Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => (Nat.primeCounting ⌊x⌋₊ : ℝ) / (x / Real.log x)) atTop (𝓝 1))
    (hMERT : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ, 2 ≤ x →
      |(∑ p ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊x⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, (1 : ℝ) / p) - Real.log (Real.log x)| ≤ C)
    (hEULER : Asymptotics.IsEquivalent atTop
      (fun x : ℝ => ∏ p ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊x⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, (1 - (1 : ℝ) / p))
      (fun x => Real.exp (-Real.eulerMascheroniConstant) / Real.log x)) :
    ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ᶠ Y : ℝ in atTop,
      ∀ (k l d : ℕ) (R : ℝ) (v W : ℕ → ℝ) (F : Finset ((Fin (k + l) → ℕ) × (Fin (k + 1) → ℕ))),
      1 ≤ k → 1 ≤ l → normalityScale (logLog Y) ≤ v k → Antitone v → v 0 = Y →
      (∀ j < k, v (j + 1) < W j ∧ W j ≤ v j) →
      (∀ idx, 2 ≤ idx → idx ≤ k → normalityDelta (logLog Y) ≤
        logLog (v (idx - 1)) / logLog Y - logLog (v idx) / logLog Y) →
      1 ≤ R → v 1 ≤ Y ^ (1 / (10 * logLog Y)) → 0 < d →
      (∀ p ∈ d.primeFactorsList, (p : ℝ) ≤ v k) →
      (∀ s ∈ F,
        ((∀ a : Fin (k + l), 0 < s.1 a) ∧ (∀ b : Fin (k + 1), 0 < s.2 b)) ∧
        d * (∏ a, s.1 a) = (∏ b, s.2 b) ∧
        R * (d : ℝ) * (((∏ a, s.1 a : ℕ)) : ℝ) ≤ Y ∧
        NoLargePrimeSquare (d * ∏ a, s.1 a) (v k) ∧
        (∀ a : Fin (k + l), a.val < k → SNormal (normalityScale (logLog Y)) (s.1 a + 1)) ∧
        (∀ b : Fin (k + 1), b.val < k → SNormal (normalityScale (logLog Y)) (s.2 b + 1)) ∧
        (∀ (a : Fin (k + l)) (b : Fin (k + 1)), a.val < k → b.val = a.val → s.1 a ≠ s.2 b) ∧
        (∀ a : Fin (k + l), a.val < k →
          W a.val ≤ (largestPrimeFactor (s.1 a) : ℝ) ∧ (largestPrimeFactor (s.1 a) : ℝ) ≤ v a.val) ∧
        (∀ b : Fin (k + 1), b.val < k →
          W b.val ≤ (largestPrimeFactor (s.2 b) : ℝ) ∧ (largestPrimeFactor (s.2 b) : ℝ) ≤ v b.val) ∧
        (∀ a : Fin (k + l), k ≤ a.val → ∀ r ∈ (s.1 a).primeFactorsList, (r : ℝ) ≤ v k) ∧
        (∀ b : Fin (k + 1), k ≤ b.val → ∀ r ∈ (s.2 b).primeFactorsList, (r : ℝ) ≤ v k) ∧
        (∀ a : Fin (k + l), k ≤ a.val →
          (ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors (s.1 a) : ℝ) ≤ 10 * logLog (v k)) ∧
        (∀ a : Fin (k + l), a.val = 0 → Y ^ (9 / 10 : ℝ) < (((s.1 a + 1 : ℕ)) : ℝ))) →
      (F.card : ℝ) ≤
        (Y / ((d : ℝ) * R)) * (c * logLog Y) ^ (6 * k) * (k + 1 : ℝ) ^ ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors d *
          (Real.log (v k)) ^ (20 * (k + l : ℕ) * Real.log (k + l : ℕ) + 1 : ℝ) *
          (Real.log Y) ^ (-2 + (∑ idx ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (k - 1), fordWeight idx * (logLog (v idx) / logLog Y)) +
            (normalityDelta (logLog Y) / 2 * (∑ idx ∈ Finset.Icc 2 k, ((idx : ℝ) * Real.log idx + idx)) +
              2 * ∑ idx ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (k - 1), (logLog (v idx) / logLog Y - logLog (W idx) / logLog Y)))

    mul_nonneg hδ (mul_nonneg (by positivity) (by linarith))
  have hmL := hm L hL
  rw [mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ hTne]
  linarith

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hlpm : ∀ (j : ℕ) {a b : ℝ}, a < b →
      (fun T : ℝ => Real.log T ^ j * T ^ a) =o[atTop] (fun T => T ^ b) := by
    intro j a b hab
    have h := (isLittleO_log_rpow_rpow_atTop (j : ℝ) (sub_pos.mpr hab)).mul_isBigO
      (Asymptotics.isBigO_refl (fun T : ℝ => T ^ a) atTop)
    refine h.congr' (Eventually.of_forall fun T => ?_) ?_
    · simp only [Real.rpow_natCast]
    · filter_upwards [eventually_gt_atTop (0 : ℝ)] with T hT
      rw [← Real.rpow_add hT]
      congr 1
      ring
  have hδnn : ∀ {T : ℝ}, 1 ≤ T → 0 ≤ normalityDelta T := fun {T} hT =>
    div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (pow_nonneg (Real.log_nonneg hT) 5))
      (Real.sqrt_nonneg T)
  have hδT : ∀ {T : ℝ}, 0 < T → normalityDelta T * T = 2 * Real.log T ^ 5 * Real.sqrt T := by
    intro T hT
    have hsqrt := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hT
    unfold normalityDelta
    apply mul_right_cancel₀ hsqrt.ne'
    rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hsqrt.ne']
    calc
      2 * Real.log T ^ 5 * T = 2 * Real.log T ^ 5 * Real.sqrt T ^ 2 := by
        rw [Real.sq_sqrt hT.le]
      _ = _ := by ring
  
  have hlogδ : (fun T : ℝ => Real.log T * normalityDelta T) =o[atTop]
      (fun T => T ^ (-2 / 5 : ℝ)) := by
    have h := (hlpm 6 (show (-1 / 2 : ℝ) < -2 / 5 by norm_num)).const_mul_left (2 : ℝ)
    refine h.congr' ?_ (Eventually.of_forall fun _ => rfl)
    filter_upwards [eventually_gt_atTop (0 : ℝ)] with T hT
    rw [show (-1 / 2 : ℝ) = -(1 / 2 : ℝ) by ring, Real.rpow_neg hT.le]
    simp only [normalityDelta, Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, div_eq_mul_inv]
    ring
  have hdsmall : ∀ (A' : ℝ) {η : ℝ}, 0 < η → ∀ᶠ T : ℝ in atTop, ∀ L : ℕ,
      (L : ℝ) ≤ A' * Real.log T → L * normalityDelta T ≤ η * T ^ (-2 / 5 : ℝ) := by
    intro A' η hη
    have h := hlogδ.const_mul_left A'
    filter_upwards [h.def hη, eventually_ge_atTop (1 : ℝ)] with T hbound hT
    intro L hL
    have hTzero : 0 ≤ T := by linarith
    simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg hTzero (-2 / 5 : ℝ))]
      at hbound
    have hproduct := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hL (hδnn hT)
    have habs := le_abs_self (A' * (Real.log T * normalityDelta T))
    nlinarith
  
  have hsaveC : ∀ C : ℝ, ∀ᶠ T : ℝ in atTop,
      -(1 / 2 : ℝ) * T ^ (7 / 8 : ℝ) + C * sieveErrorEnvelope T ≤
        -(1 / 4 : ℝ) * T ^ (7 / 8 : ℝ) := by
    intro C
    have h₁ := hlpm 2 (show (2 / 3 : ℝ) < 7 / 8 by norm_num)
    have h₂ := hlpm 8 (show (1 / 2 : ℝ) < 7 / 8 by norm_num)
    have h₃ : (fun T : ℝ => Real.log T ^ 2) =o[atTop] (fun T => T ^ (7 / 8 : ℝ)) := by
      simpa only [Real.rpow_zero, mul_one] using
        hlpm 2 (show (0 : ℝ) < 7 / 8 by norm_num)
    have henv : sieveErrorEnvelope =o[atTop] (fun T : ℝ => T ^ (7 / 8 : ℝ)) :=
      (h₁.add h₂).add h₃
    have h := henv.const_mul_left C
    filter_upwards [h.def (show (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 4 by norm_num),
      eventually_ge_atTop (0 : ℝ)] with T hbound hT
    simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg hT (7 / 8 : ℝ))] at hbound
    have hle : C * sieveErrorEnvelope T ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) * T ^ (7 / 8 : ℝ) :=
      (le_abs_self _).trans hbound
    linarith
  
  have hdim : ∀ A' : ℝ, ∀ᶠ T : ℝ in atTop, ∀ L : ℕ, (L : ℝ) ≤ A' * Real.log T →
      (L : ℝ) + 1 ≤ (A' + 1) * Real.log T ∧ Real.log ((L : ℝ) + 1) ≤ Real.log T := by
    intro A'
    have h := Real.isLittleO_log_id_atTop.const_mul_left (A' + 1)
    filter_upwards [h.def (show (0 : ℝ) < 1 by norm_num),
      eventually_ge_atTop (Real.exp 1)] with T hbound hT
    intro L hL
    have hT0 : 0 < T := (Real.exp_pos _).trans_le hT

    dsimp only [id] at hbound
    simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hT0, one_mul] at hbound
    have hbig : (A' + 1) * Real.log T ≤ T := (le_abs_self _).trans hbound
    have hL' : (L : ℝ) + 1 ≤ (A' + 1) * Real.log T := by nlinarith

  have hlossb : ∀ {T B : ℝ} {L : ℕ}, 1 ≤ T → 1 ≤ Real.log T →
      (L : ℝ) + 1 ≤ B * Real.log T → Real.log ((L : ℝ) + 1) ≤ Real.log T →

          normalityDelta T * ((L : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 * (Real.log ((L : ℝ) + 1) + 1) +
          2 * L * ((4 * L + 2 : ℝ) * normalityDelta T + 1 / T)) * T ≤
        34 * B ^ 2 * (Real.log T ^ 8 * Real.sqrt T) + 2 * B * Real.log T := by
    intro T B L hT hU hL hlogL
    have hTpos : 0 < T := by linarith
    have hδ := hδnn hT
    have hU0 : 0 ≤ Real.log T := by linarith
    have hL0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ L := Nat.cast_nonneg L
    have hlogL0 : 0 ≤ Real.log ((L : ℝ) + 1) := Real.log_nonneg (by linarith)
    have h₁ : (2 * L + 1 : ℝ) * normalityDelta T * L *
        Real.log ((L : ℝ) + 1) ≤
        3 * ((L : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 * normalityDelta T * Real.log T := by
      calc
        _ ≤ (3 * ((L : ℝ) + 1)) * normalityDelta T * ((L : ℝ) + 1) * Real.log T := by
          gcongr <;> linarith
        _ = _ := by ring
    have h₂ : normalityDelta T * ((L : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 *
        (Real.log ((L : ℝ) + 1) + 1) ≤
        2 * ((L : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 * normalityDelta T * Real.log T := by
      have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (show Real.log ((L : ℝ) + 1) + 1 ≤ 2 * Real.log T by linarith)
        (mul_nonneg hδ (sq_nonneg ((L : ℝ) + 1)))
      nlinarith
    have h₃ : 2 * L * ((4 * L + 2 : ℝ) * normalityDelta T + 1 / T) ≤

          2 * ((L : ℝ) + 1) / T := by
      calc
        _ ≤ 2 * ((L : ℝ) + 1) * (6 * ((L : ℝ) + 1) * normalityDelta T + 1 / T) := by
          gcongr <;> linarith
        _ = 12 * ((L : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 * normalityDelta T +
            2 * ((L : ℝ) + 1) / T := by ring
        _ ≤ _ := by
          nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hU
            (show 0 ≤ 12 * ((L : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 * normalityDelta T by positivity)]
    have hpre : (((2 * L + 1 : ℝ) * normalityDelta T) * L * Real.log ((L : ℝ) + 1) +
          normalityDelta T * ((L : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 * (Real.log ((L : ℝ) + 1) + 1) +
          2 * L * ((4 * L + 2 : ℝ) * normalityDelta T + 1 / T)) * T ≤
        17 * ((L : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 * normalityDelta T * Real.log T * T +
          2 * ((L : ℝ) + 1) := by
      have hsum := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (add_le_add (add_le_add h₁ h₂) h₃) hTpos.le
      have hdiv : (2 * ((L : ℝ) + 1) / T) * T = 2 * ((L : ℝ) + 1) :=
        div_mul_cancel₀ _ hTpos.ne'
      nlinarith
    calc
      _ ≤ 17 * ((L : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 * normalityDelta T * Real.log T * T +
            2 * ((L : ℝ) + 1) := hpre
      _ ≤ 17 * (B * Real.log T) ^ 2 * normalityDelta T * Real.log T * T +
            2 * (B * Real.log T) := by gcongr
      _ = 34 * B ^ 2 * (Real.log T ^ 8 * Real.sqrt T) + 2 * B * Real.log T := by
        calc
          _ = 17 * B ^ 2 * Real.log T ^ 3 * (normalityDelta T * T) +
              2 * B * Real.log T := by ring
          _ = _ := by rw [hδT hTpos]; ring
  
  have hlossE : ∀ᶠ T : ℝ in atTop, ∀ L : ℕ, (L : ℝ) ≤ A * Real.log T →
      (((2 * L + 1 : ℝ) * normalityDelta T) * L * Real.log ((L : ℝ) + 1) +
          normalityDelta T * ((L : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 * (Real.log ((L : ℝ) + 1) + 1) +
          2 * L * ((4 * L + 2 : ℝ) * normalityDelta T + 1 / T)) * T ≤
        (34 * (A + 1) ^ 2 + 2 * (A + 1)) * sieveErrorEnvelope T := by
    filter_upwards [hdim A, eventually_ge_atTop (Real.exp 1)] with T hdimT hT
    intro L hL
    have hT1 : 1 ≤ T :=
      (Real.one_le_exp (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1)).trans hT
    have hU : 1 ≤ Real.log T := by
      have h := Real.log_le_log (Real.exp_pos 1) hT
      simpa using h
    have hbounds := hdimT L hL
    have hbound := hlossb hT1 hU hbounds.1 hbounds.2
    have henv₁ : Real.log T ^ 8 * Real.sqrt T ≤ sieveErrorEnvelope T := by
      unfold sieveErrorEnvelope
      rw [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]
      have h₁ : 0 ≤ Real.log T ^ 2 * T ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ) := by positivity
      have h₂ : 0 ≤ Real.log T ^ 2 := by positivity
      linarith
    have henv₂ : Real.log T ≤ sieveErrorEnvelope T := by
      have hU₂ : Real.log T ≤ Real.log T ^ 2 := by nlinarith
      unfold sieveErrorEnvelope
      have h₁ : 0 ≤ Real.log T ^ 2 * T ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ) := by positivity
      have h₂ : 0 ≤ Real.log T ^ 8 * T ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by positivity
      linarith
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left henv₁ (by positivity : 0 ≤ 34 * (A + 1) ^ 2),
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left henv₂ (by positivity : 0 ≤ 2 * (A + 1))]
  
  have htailE : ∀ᶠ T : ℝ in atTop, ∀ L : ℕ, ∀ ζ : ℝ,
      (L : ℝ) ≤ A * Real.log T → ζ ≤ T ^ (-1 / 3 : ℝ) →
      ζ + (2 * L + 3 : ℝ) * normalityDelta T ≤ 2 * T ^ (-1 / 3 : ℝ) := by
    filter_upwards [hdsmall (A + 2) (η := 1 / 2) (by norm_num),
      eventually_ge_atTop (Real.exp 1)] with T hsmall hT
    intro L ζ hL hζ
    have hT1 : 1 ≤ T := (Real.one_le_exp (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1)).trans hT
    have hU : 1 ≤ Real.log T := by
      have h := Real.log_le_log (Real.exp_pos 1) hT
      simpa using h
    have hδ := hδnn hT1
    have hL2 : ((L + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (A + 2) * Real.log T := by
      push_cast
      nlinarith
    have h := hsmall (L + 2) hL2
    push_cast at h
    have hpowers : T ^ (-2 / 5 : ℝ) ≤ T ^ (-1 / 3 : ℝ) :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hT1 (by norm_num)
    nlinarith
  
  have hprefb : ∀ {T ν B : ℝ} {k l : ℕ}, 0 < T → 1 ≤ Real.log T → 0 ≤ B →

      ν ≤ 2 * T ^ (-1 / 3 : ℝ) →

        6 * B * (|Real.log c| + 1) * Real.log T ^ 2 + D * Real.log T +
          42 * B * (Real.log T ^ 2 * T ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ)) := by
    intro T ν B k l hT hU hB hkl1 hk hkl hlogk hlogkl hν
    have hU0 : 0 ≤ Real.log T := by linarith
    have hkl0 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (k + l : ℕ) := by exact_mod_cast hkl1
    have hlogkl0 := Real.log_nonneg hkl0
    have hlogc : Real.log (c * T) ≤ (|Real.log c| + 1) * Real.log T := by
      rw [Real.log_mul hc.ne' hT.ne']
      nlinarith [le_abs_self (Real.log c), abs_nonneg (Real.log c),
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hU (abs_nonneg (Real.log c))]
    have h₁ : 6 * k * Real.log (c * T) ≤
        6 * B * (|Real.log c| + 1) * Real.log T ^ 2 := by
      calc
        _ ≤ 6 * k * ((|Real.log c| + 1) * Real.log T) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlogc (by positivity)
        _ ≤ 6 * (B * Real.log T) * ((|Real.log c| + 1) * Real.log T) := by gcongr
        _ = _ := by ring
    have h₂ : D * Real.log ((k : ℝ) + 1) ≤ D * Real.log T :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlogk (Nat.cast_nonneg D)
    have hmon := mul_le_mul hkl hlogkl hlogkl0 (mul_nonneg hB hU0)
    have hBU : 1 ≤ B * Real.log T ^ 2 := by
      have hBU1 : 1 ≤ B * Real.log T := hkl0.trans hkl
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hU (mul_nonneg hB hU0)]
    have hcoeff : 20 * (k + l : ℕ) * Real.log (k + l : ℕ) + 1 ≤
        21 * B * Real.log T ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    have hcoeff0 : 0 ≤ 20 * (k + l : ℕ) * Real.log (k + l : ℕ) + 1 := by positivity
    have hνT : ν * T ≤ 2 * T ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ) := by
      calc
        ν * T ≤ (2 * T ^ (-1 / 3 : ℝ)) * T := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hν hT.le
        _ = 2 * (T ^ (-1 / 3 : ℝ) * T ^ (1 : ℝ)) := by rw [Real.rpow_one]; ring
        _ = 2 * T ^ ((-1 / 3 : ℝ) + 1) := by rw [Real.rpow_add hT]
        _ = _ := by congr 2; norm_num
    have h₃ : (20 * (k + l : ℕ) * Real.log (k + l : ℕ) + 1) * ν * T ≤
        42 * B * (Real.log T ^ 2 * T ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ)) := by
      calc
        _ = (20 * (k + l : ℕ) * Real.log (k + l : ℕ) + 1) * (ν * T) := by ring
        _ ≤ (20 * (k + l : ℕ) * Real.log (k + l : ℕ) + 1) *
            (2 * T ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hνT hcoeff0
        _ ≤ (21 * B * Real.log T ^ 2) * (2 * T ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ)) :=

    linarith
  
  have hprefE : ∀ᶠ T : ℝ in atTop, ∀ k l L : ℕ, ∀ ν : ℝ,
      1 ≤ k + l → k + l ≤ L + 1 → (L : ℝ) ≤ A * Real.log T →
      ν ≤ 2 * T ^ (-1 / 3 : ℝ) →
      6 * k * Real.log (c * T) + D * Real.log ((k : ℝ) + 1) +
          (20 * (k + l : ℕ) * Real.log (k + l : ℕ) + 1) * ν * T ≤
        (6 * (A + 2) * (|Real.log c| + 1) + D + 42 * (A + 2)) * sieveErrorEnvelope T := by
    filter_upwards [hdim (A + 1), eventually_ge_atTop (Real.exp 1)] with T hdimT hT
    intro k l L ν hkl1 hklL hL hν
    have hT0 : 0 < T := (Real.exp_pos 1).trans_le hT
    have hU : 1 ≤ Real.log T := by
      have h := Real.log_le_log (Real.exp_pos 1) hT
      simpa using h
    have hL1 : ((L + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (A + 1) * Real.log T := by

      nlinarith
    have hdim' := hdimT (L + 1) hL1
    push_cast at hdim'
    have hk : (k : ℝ) ≤ (A + 2) * Real.log T := by

    have hkl : ((k + l : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (A + 2) * Real.log T := by
      have hkl' : ((k + l : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (L : ℝ) + 1 := by exact_mod_cast hklL
      nlinarith [hdim'.1]
    have hlogk : Real.log ((k : ℝ) + 1) ≤ Real.log T := by
      apply (Real.log_le_log (by positivity) (show (k : ℝ) + 1 ≤ (L : ℝ) + 1 + 1 by
        exact_mod_cast (show k + 1 ≤ L + 1 + 1 by omega))).trans hdim'.2
    have hlogkl : Real.log ((k + l : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ Real.log T := by
      apply (Real.log_le_log (by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < k + l by omega))
        (show ((k + l : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (L : ℝ) + 1 + 1 by
          exact_mod_cast (show k + l ≤ L + 1 + 1 by omega))).trans hdim'.2
    have hbound := hprefb hT0 hU (by linarith : 0 ≤ A + 2) hkl1 hk hkl hlogk hlogkl hν
    have henv₁ : Real.log T ^ 2 ≤ sieveErrorEnvelope T := by
      unfold sieveErrorEnvelope
      have h₁ : 0 ≤ Real.log T ^ 2 * T ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ) := by positivity
      have h₂ : 0 ≤ Real.log T ^ 8 * T ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by positivity
      linarith
    have henv₂ : Real.log T ≤ sieveErrorEnvelope T :=
      (show Real.log T ≤ Real.log T ^ 2 by nlinarith).trans henv₁
    have henv₃ : Real.log T ^ 2 * T ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ) ≤ sieveErrorEnvelope T := by
      unfold sieveErrorEnvelope
      have h₁ : 0 ≤ Real.log T ^ 8 * T ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by positivity
      have h₂ : 0 ≤ Real.log T ^ 2 := by positivity
      linarith
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left henv₁
        (by positivity : 0 ≤ 6 * (A + 2) * (|Real.log c| + 1)),
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left henv₂ (Nat.cast_nonneg D),
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left henv₃ (by positivity : 0 ≤ 42 * (A + 2))]
  
  filter_upwards [hlossE, hprefE, htailE,
    hsaveC (34 * (A + 1) ^ 2 + 2 * (A + 1) +
      (6 * (A + 2) * (|Real.log c| + 1) + D + 42 * (A + 2)) + K),
    eventually_gt_atTop (0 : ℝ)] with T hnormal hpref htail hsave hT
  intro k l L ζ E hkl hklL hL hζ hE
  have h₁ := hnormal L hL
  have h₂ := hpref k l L _ hkl hklL hL (htail L ζ hL hζ)
  have hET := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hE hT.le
  have hpowers : T ^ (-1 / 8 : ℝ) * T = T ^ (7 / 8 : ℝ) := by
    calc
      _ = T ^ (-1 / 8 : ℝ) * T ^ (1 : ℝ) := by rw [Real.rpow_one]
      _ = T ^ ((-1 / 8 : ℝ) + 1) := (Real.rpow_add hT _ _).symm
      _ = _ := by congr 1; norm_num
  have hexpand : ∀ X : ℝ, (-1 - (1 / 2 : ℝ) * T ^ (-1 / 8 : ℝ) + X * T / T) * T =
      -T - (1 / 2 : ℝ) * T ^ (7 / 8 : ℝ) + X * T := by
    intro X
    rw [add_mul, sub_mul, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hT.ne', mul_assoc, hpowers]
    ring
  rw [hexpand] at hET
  have hlog : 6 * k * Real.log (c * T) + D * Real.log ((k : ℝ) + 1) +
      (20 * (k + l : ℕ) * Real.log (k + l : ℕ) + 1) *
        (ζ + (2 * L + 3 : ℝ) * normalityDelta T) * T + E * T ≤
      -T - (1 / 4 : ℝ) * T ^ (7 / 8 : ℝ) - K * sieveErrorEnvelope T := by
    nlinarith
  have hpos : 0 < (c * T) ^ (6 * k) * ((k : ℝ) + 1) ^ D *
      (Real.exp ((ζ + (2 * L + 3 : ℝ) * normalityDelta T) * T)) ^
        (20 * (k + l : ℕ) * Real.log (k + l : ℕ) + 1) := by
    positivity
  have hlogpref : Real.log ((c * T) ^ (6 * k) * ((k : ℝ) + 1) ^ D *
      (Real.exp ((ζ + (2 * L + 3 : ℝ) * normalityDelta T) * T)) ^
        (20 * (k + l : ℕ) * Real.log (k + l : ℕ) + 1)) =
      6 * k * Real.log (c * T) + D * Real.log ((k : ℝ) + 1) +
        (20 * (k + l : ℕ) * Real.log (k + l : ℕ) + 1) *
          (ζ + (2 * L + 3 : ℝ) * normalityDelta T) * T := by
    rw [Real.log_mul (by positivity) (by positivity),
      Real.log_mul (by positivity) (by positivity)]
    rw [Real.log_pow, Real.log_pow, Real.log_rpow (Real.exp_pos _), Real.log_exp]
    push_cast
    ring
  have hexp := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hlog
  rw [Real.exp_add, ← hlogpref, Real.exp_log hpos] at hexp
  have hpower : (Real.exp T) ^ E = Real.exp (E * T) := by
    rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos (Real.exp_pos T), Real.log_exp, mul_comm]
  rw [← hpower] at hexp
  convert hexp using 1
  rw [show -T - (1 / 4 : ℝ) * T ^ (7 / 8 : ℝ) - K * sieveErrorEnvelope T =
    -T + (-(1 / 4 : ℝ) * T ^ (7 / 8 : ℝ) - K * sieveErrorEnvelope T) by ring,
    Real.exp_add, Real.exp_neg, one_div]

{n : ℕ} {S : ℝ} (hn : 0 < n) (hS : 1 ≤ S)
    (hnormal : ∀ p ∈ n.primeFactors, SNormal S p)
    (hsquareN : NoLargePrimeSquare n S)
    (hsquarePhi : NoLargePrimeSquare n.totient S) :
    ∃ (K s : ℕ) (q : Fin K → ℕ),
      K = (n.primeFactors.filter fun r => S < (largestPrimeFactor (r - 1) : ℝ)).card ∧
      s = (∏ r ∈ n.primeFactors with (largestPrimeFactor (r - 1) : ℝ) ≤ S,
        r ^ (n.factorization r - 1) * (r - 1)) ∧
      (∀ idx, SNormal S (q idx)) ∧ Function.Injective q ∧
      StrictAnti (fun idx => largestPrimeFactor (q idx - 1)) ∧
      (∀ idx, S < (largestPrimeFactor (q idx - 1) : ℝ)) ∧
      (∀ idx, n.factorization (q idx) = 1) ∧
      n.totient = s * (∏ idx, (q idx - 1)) ∧ 0 < s ∧ (largestPrimeFactor s : ℝ) ≤ S

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hlpf_le : ∀ {m : ℕ}, 0 < m → largestPrimeFactor m ≤ m := by
    intro m hm
    exact max_le hm (Finset.sup_le fun z hz => Nat.le_of_mem_primeFactors hz)
  have hlpf_one : largestPrimeFactor 1 = 1 := by simp [largestPrimeFactor]
  have hlpf_mem : ∀ {m : ℕ}, 1 < largestPrimeFactor m →
      largestPrimeFactor m ∈ m.primeFactors := by
    intro m h
    have hs : m.primeFactors.Nonempty := by
      apply Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr
      intro hs
      simp [largestPrimeFactor, hs] at h
    obtain ⟨p, hp, hsup⟩ := Finset.exists_mem_eq_sup m.primeFactors hs id
    have hprime := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp
    simpa only [largestPrimeFactor, hsup, id_eq, max_eq_right hprime.one_le] using hp
  have hlpf_dvd : ∀ m : ℕ, largestPrimeFactor m ∣ m := by
    intro m
    by_cases h : largestPrimeFactor m = 1
    · rw [h]; exact one_dvd m
    · have hlarge : 1 < largestPrimeFactor m := by
        have : 1 ≤ largestPrimeFactor m := le_max_left _ _
        omega
      exact Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactors (hlpf_mem hlarge)
  have hlpf_mul : ∀ {a b : ℕ}, 0 < a → 0 < b →
      largestPrimeFactor (a * b) = max (largestPrimeFactor a) (largestPrimeFactor b) := by
    intro a b ha hb
    simp [largestPrimeFactor, Nat.primeFactors_mul (Nat.ne_of_gt ha) (Nat.ne_of_gt hb),
      Finset.sup_union, max_assoc, max_left_comm, max_comm]
  have hlpf_prime : ∀ {p : ℕ}, p.Prime → largestPrimeFactor p = p := by
    intro p hp
    simp [largestPrimeFactor, hp.primeFactors, hp.one_le]
  have hlpf_pow : ∀ {m : ℕ}, 0 < m → ∀ k : ℕ,
      largestPrimeFactor (m ^ k) ≤ largestPrimeFactor m := by
    intro m hm k
    induction k with
    | zero => simpa only [pow_zero, hlpf_one] using (le_max_left 1 _ : 1 ≤ largestPrimeFactor m)
    | succ k ih =>
      rw [pow_succ, hlpf_mul (Nat.pow_pos hm) hm]
      exact max_le ih le_rfl
  have hlpf_prod : ∀ (s : Finset ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℕ), (∀ i ∈ s, 0 < f i) →
      (∀ i ∈ s, (largestPrimeFactor (f i) : ℝ) ≤ S) →
      (largestPrimeFactor (∏ i ∈ s, f i) : ℝ) ≤ S := by
    intro s f
    induction s using Finset.induction with
    | empty => intro _ _; simpa [hlpf_one] using hS
    | @insert i s hi ih =>
      intro hf hbound
      have hs : ∀ j ∈ s, 0 < f j := fun j hj => hf j (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hj)
      rw [Finset.prod_insert hi,
        hlpf_mul (hf i (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _)) (Finset.prod_pos hs), Nat.cast_max]
      exact max_le (hbound i (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _))
        (ih hs (fun j hj => hbound j (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hj)))
  
  have hfac_one : ∀ {p : ℕ}, p.Prime → p ∣ n → S < (p : ℝ) → n.factorization p = 1 := by
    intro p hp hpn hSp
    have hlower := (hp.dvd_iff_one_le_factorization hn.ne').mp hpn
    have hupper : ¬2 ≤ n.factorization p := by
      intro h
      exact hsquareN p hp hSp ((hp.pow_dvd_iff_le_factorization hn.ne').mpr h)
    omega
  obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ : ∃ T : Finset ℕ,
      T = n.primeFactors.filter fun r => S < (largestPrimeFactor (r - 1) : ℝ) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hTmem : ∀ {p : ℕ}, p ∈ T ↔ p ∈ n.primeFactors ∧ S < (largestPrimeFactor (p - 1) : ℝ) := by
    intro p
    rw [hT, Finset.mem_filter]
  have hT_gt : ∀ {p : ℕ}, p ∈ T → S < (p : ℝ) := by
    intro p hp
    obtain ⟨hpn, hSp⟩ := hTmem.mp hp
    have hprime := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hpn
    have hpos : 0 < p - 1 := by have := hprime.one_lt; omega
    have hle : (largestPrimeFactor (p - 1) : ℝ) ≤ p := by
      exact_mod_cast (hlpf_le hpos).trans (Nat.sub_le p 1)
    exact hSp.trans_le hle
  have hT_fac : ∀ {p : ℕ}, p ∈ T → n.factorization p = 1 := by
    intro p hp
    have hpn := (hTmem.mp hp).1
    exact hfac_one (Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hpn) (Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactors hpn)
      (hT_gt hp)
  
  have hinj : Set.InjOn (fun p => largestPrimeFactor (p - 1)) ↑T := by
    intro p hp q hq hPQ
    change largestPrimeFactor (p - 1) = largestPrimeFactor (q - 1) at hPQ
    by_contra hpq
    obtain ⟨hpn, hSP⟩ := hTmem.mp (Finset.mem_coe.mp hp)
    obtain ⟨hqn, _⟩ := hTmem.mp (Finset.mem_coe.mp hq)
    have hprimeP := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hpn
    have hprimeQ := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hqn
    have hcop : p.Coprime q := by
      apply hprimeP.coprime_iff_not_dvd.mpr
      intro hdvd
      exact hpq ((Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq hprimeP hprimeQ).mp hdvd)
    have hpqN : p * q ∣ n :=
      hcop.mul_dvd_of_dvd_of_dvd (Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactors hpn)
        (Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactors hqn)
    have hphi := Nat.totient_dvd_of_dvd hpqN
    rw [Nat.totient_mul hcop, Nat.totient_prime hprimeP, Nat.totient_prime hprimeQ] at hphi
    have hlarge : 1 < largestPrimeFactor (p - 1) := by
      exact_mod_cast hS.trans_lt hSP
    have hQp := hlpf_dvd (p - 1)
    have hQq : largestPrimeFactor (p - 1) ∣ q - 1 := by
      rw [hPQ]
      exact hlpf_dvd (q - 1)
    apply hsquarePhi (largestPrimeFactor (p - 1))
      (Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors (hlpf_mem hlarge)) hSP
    simpa only [pow_two] using (mul_dvd_mul hQp hQq).trans hphi
  
  have hsplit : n.totient = (∏ p ∈ T, (p - 1)) *
      ∏ r ∈ n.primeFactors with (largestPrimeFactor (r - 1) : ℝ) ≤ S,
        r ^ (n.factorization r - 1) * (r - 1) := by
    have hphi := Nat.totient_eq_prod_factorization hn.ne'
    change n.totient = ∏ p ∈ n.primeFactors, p ^ (n.factorization p - 1) * (p - 1) at hphi
    rw [← Finset.prod_filter_mul_prod_filter_not n.primeFactors
      (fun p => S < (largestPrimeFactor (p - 1) : ℝ)), ← hT] at hphi
    have hlarge : (∏ p ∈ T, p ^ (n.factorization p - 1) * (p - 1)) =
        ∏ p ∈ T, (p - 1) := by
      apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
      intro p hp
      rw [hT_fac hp]
      simp
    rw [hlarge] at hphi
    simpa only [not_lt] using hphi
  
  have hpos : 0 < ∏ r ∈ n.primeFactors with (largestPrimeFactor (r - 1) : ℝ) ≤ S,
      r ^ (n.factorization r - 1) * (r - 1) := by
    apply Finset.prod_pos
    intro p hp
    have hprime := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors (Finset.mem_filter.mp hp).1
    exact Nat.mul_pos (Nat.pow_pos hprime.pos) (by have := hprime.one_lt; omega)
  have hsmooth : (largestPrimeFactor (∏ r ∈ n.primeFactors with
      (largestPrimeFactor (r - 1) : ℝ) ≤ S, r ^ (n.factorization r - 1) * (r - 1)) : ℝ) ≤ S := by
    apply hlpf_prod _ (fun r => r ^ (n.factorization r - 1) * (r - 1))
    · intro p hp
      have hprime := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors (Finset.mem_filter.mp hp).1
      exact Nat.mul_pos (Nat.pow_pos hprime.pos) (by have := hprime.one_lt; omega)
    · intro p hp
      obtain ⟨hpn, hsmall⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hp
      have hprime := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hpn
      by_cases hpS : (p : ℝ) ≤ S
      · have hpos : 0 < p - 1 := by have := hprime.one_lt; omega
        show (largestPrimeFactor (p ^ (n.factorization p - 1) * (p - 1)) : ℝ) ≤ S
        rw [hlpf_mul (Nat.pow_pos hprime.pos) hpos, Nat.cast_max]
        apply max_le _ hsmall
        have hpow : largestPrimeFactor (p ^ (n.factorization p - 1)) ≤ p := by
          simpa only [hlpf_prime hprime] using hlpf_pow hprime.pos (n.factorization p - 1)
        have hpowReal : (largestPrimeFactor (p ^ (n.factorization p - 1)) : ℝ) ≤ p := by
          exact_mod_cast hpow
        exact hpowReal.trans hpS
      · have hfac := hfac_one hprime (Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactors hpn) (lt_of_not_ge hpS)
        show (largestPrimeFactor (p ^ (n.factorization p - 1) * (p - 1)) : ℝ) ≤ S
        simpa only [hfac, Nat.sub_self, pow_zero, one_mul] using hsmall
  
  have henum : ∀ (s : Finset ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℕ), Set.InjOn f ↑s →
      ∃ e : Fin s.card ≃ s, StrictAnti (fun idx => f (e idx)) := by
    intro s f hf
    let fS : s → (s.image f) := fun a =>
      ⟨f a, Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨a, a.property, rfl⟩⟩
    have hfS : Function.Bijective fS := by
      constructor
      · intro a b hab
        apply Subtype.ext
        exact hf a.property b.property (congrArg Subtype.val hab)
      · rintro ⟨b, hb⟩
        obtain ⟨a, ha, hab⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hb
        exact ⟨⟨a, ha⟩, Subtype.ext hab⟩
    let e := Equiv.ofBijective fS hfS
    let o := (s.image f).orderIsoOfFin (Finset.card_image_of_injOn hf)
    let enumeration : Fin s.card ≃ s := (Fin.revPerm.trans o.toEquiv).trans e.symm
    have hvalue (idx : Fin s.card) : f (enumeration idx) = (o idx.rev).val := by
      change (e (e.symm (o idx.rev))).val = (o idx.rev).val
      exact congrArg Subtype.val (e.apply_symm_apply (o idx.rev))
    refine ⟨enumeration, ?_⟩
    intro idx j hij
    change f (enumeration j) < f (enumeration idx)
    rw [hvalue, hvalue]
    exact o.strictMono (Fin.rev_lt_rev.mpr hij)
  
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := henum T (fun p => largestPrimeFactor (p - 1)) hinj
  let q : Fin T.card → ℕ := fun idx => (e idx).val
  have hmem : ∀ idx, q idx ∈ T := fun idx => (e idx).property
  have hprodq : (∏ idx, (q idx - 1)) = ∏ p ∈ T, (p - 1) := by
    calc (∏ idx, (q idx - 1)) = ∏ p : T, ((p : ℕ) - 1) :=
          Fintype.prod_equiv e _ _ (fun _ => rfl)
      _ = _ := by
          rw [Finset.univ_eq_attach]
          exact Finset.prod_attach T (fun p => p - 1)
  rw [← hT]
  refine ⟨T.card, _, q, rfl, rfl, ?_, ?_, he, ?_, ?_, ?_, hpos, hsmooth⟩
  · intro idx
    exact hnormal (q idx) (hTmem.mp (hmem idx)).1
  · intro idx j hij
    exact e.injective (Subtype.ext hij)
  · intro idx
    exact (hTmem.mp (hmem idx)).2
  · intro idx
    exact hT_fac (hmem idx)
  · rw [hsplit, hprodq]
    exact mul_comm _ _

(c P κ θ : ℝ) (hκ : 1 < κ) (hθ : θ < 1) :
    ∀ᶠ T : ℝ in atTop, ∀ L : ℕ, ∀ p : Fin (L + 1) → ℕ,
      (∀ idx, SNormal (normalityScale T) (p idx)) →
      (∀ idx, 17 ≤ p idx) →
      (∀ idx, (p idx : ℝ) ≤ c * Real.exp (Real.exp T) * T) →
      Antitone p →
      (∀ idx : Fin (L + 1), 0 < idx.val → ∀ hi : idx.val + 1 < L + 1,
        κ * logLog (p ⟨idx.val + 1, hi⟩) ≤ logLog (p idx)) →
      (∀ idx, 0 < idx.val → (p idx : ℝ) ≤ CollisionBox.cutoff (Real.exp (Real.exp T)) θ) →
      (p (Fin.last L) : ℝ) ≤ P →
      (Real.exp (Real.exp T)) ^ (9 / 10 : ℝ) < (p 0 : ℝ) →
      ((p 0 - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp (Real.exp T) →
      0 < T ^ (-1 / 3 : ℝ) ∧ 0 < 1 / T ∧ 0 < T ^ (-2 / 5 : ℝ) ∧ 0 ≤ 1 - 1 / κ ∧
      Antitone (fun idx => CollisionBox.primeCoordinate T (p idx)) ∧
      (∀ idx, CollisionBox.shiftedCoordinate T (p idx) ≤ CollisionBox.primeCoordinate T (p idx)) ∧
      (∀ idx, T ^ (-1 / 3 : ℝ) ≤ CollisionBox.primeCoordinate T (p idx) →
        CollisionBox.primeCoordinate T (p idx) - Real.log (5 * T) / T ≤
          CollisionBox.shiftedCoordinate T (p idx)) ∧
      (∀ idx j : Fin (L + 1), 0 < idx.val → idx < j →
        (1 - 1 / κ) * CollisionBox.primeCoordinate T (p idx) ≤
          CollisionBox.primeCoordinate T (p idx) - CollisionBox.primeCoordinate T (p j)) ∧
      (∀ idx : Fin (L + 1), 0 < idx.val → CollisionBox.primeCoordinate T (p idx) ≤ θ) ∧
      T ^ (-1 / 3 : ℝ) < CollisionBox.shiftedCoordinate T (p 0) ∧
      CollisionBox.shiftedCoordinate T (p 0) ≤ 1 ∧
      1 - Real.log (6 * T) / T ≤ CollisionBox.shiftedCoordinate T (p 0) ∧
      CollisionBox.shiftedCoordinate T (p (Fin.last L)) ≤ T ^ (-1 / 3 : ℝ) ∧
      10 * T ^ (-2 / 5 : ℝ) + 1 / T + Real.log (5 * T) / T ≤ (1 - 1 / κ) * T ^ (-1 / 3 : ℝ) ∧
      10 * T ^ (-2 / 5 : ℝ) + 1 / T + Real.log (6 * T) / T ≤ 1 - θ ∧
      4 * T ^ (-2 / 5 : ℝ) ≤ T ^ (-1 / 3 : ℝ)
