proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hLPR : ∀ (k : ℕ) (a b : ℝ), a < b →
      (fun T : ℝ => Real.log T ^ k * T ^ a) =o[atTop] (fun T => T ^ b) := by
    intro k a b hab
    have h := (isLittleO_log_rpow_rpow_atTop (k : ℝ) (sub_pos.mpr hab)).mul_isBigO
      (Asymptotics.isBigO_refl (fun T : ℝ => T ^ a) atTop)
    refine h.congr' (Eventually.of_forall fun T => ?_) ?_
    · simp only [Real.rpow_natCast]
    · filter_upwards [eventually_gt_atTop (0 : ℝ)] with T hT
      rw [← Real.rpow_add hT]
      congr 1
      ring
  have hErr : ∀ (c' a : ℝ), 0 < c' → -1 < a →
      (fun T : ℝ => Real.log (c' * T) / T) =o[atTop] (fun T : ℝ => T ^ a) := by
    intro c' a hc ha
    have h := ((hLPR 0 (-1) a ha).const_mul_left (Real.log c')).add (hLPR 1 (-1) a ha)
    refine h.congr' ?_ (Eventually.of_forall fun _ => rfl)
    filter_upwards [eventually_gt_atTop (0 : ℝ)] with T hT
    simp only [pow_zero, one_mul, pow_one, Real.rpow_neg_one, Real.log_mul hc.ne' hT.ne']
    ring
  have hLoss : ∀ (c' a : ℝ), 0 < c' → (-2 / 5 : ℝ) < a →
      (fun T : ℝ => 10 * T ^ (-2 / 5 : ℝ) + 1 / T + Real.log (c' * T) / T) =o[atTop]
        (fun T : ℝ => T ^ a) := by
    intro c' a hc ha
    have h₁ := (hLPR 0 (-2 / 5) a ha).const_mul_left (10 : ℝ)
    have h₂ := hLPR 0 (-1) a (by linarith)
    simpa only [pow_zero, one_mul, Real.rpow_neg_one, one_div] using
      (h₁.add h₂).add (hErr c' a hc (by linarith))
  
  have hκpos : 0 < κ := by linarith
  have hg : 0 < 1 - 1 / κ := by
    have hinv : 1 / κ < (1 : ℝ) := (div_lt_iff₀ hκpos).mpr (by linarith)
    linarith
  have hlower := (hLoss 5 (-1 / 3) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)).def hg
  have hhead := (hLoss 6 0 (by norm_num) (by norm_num)).def (sub_pos.mpr hθ)
  have htail := ((hLPR 0 (-2 / 5) (-1 / 3) (by norm_num)).const_mul_left (4 : ℝ)).def
    (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1)
  have hb := (hLPR 0 (-1 / 3) 0 (by norm_num)).def (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 4)
  have he := (hErr 6 0 (by norm_num) (by norm_num)).def (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 4)
  have hp := ((hLPR 0 (-1) (-1 / 3) (by norm_num)).const_mul_left (logLog P)).def
    (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1)
  have hsmall : ∀ᶠ T : ℝ in atTop, Real.log T ^ 10 ≤ T := by
    have h := hLPR 10 0 1 (by norm_num)
    filter_upwards [h.def (show (0 : ℝ) < 1 by norm_num),
      eventually_ge_atTop (0 : ℝ)] with T hbound hT
    simpa only [Real.rpow_zero, mul_one, Real.rpow_one, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_nonneg (by positivity : 0 ≤ Real.log T ^ 10), abs_of_nonneg hT,
      one_mul] using hbound
  have henv : ∀ᶠ T : ℝ in atTop,
      c * Real.exp (Real.exp T) * T ≤ Real.exp (Real.exp (T + 1)) := by
    have h := (Real.isLittleO_pow_exp_atTop (n := 1)).const_mul_left c
    filter_upwards [h.def (show (0 : ℝ) < 1 by norm_num)] with T hbound
    simp only [pow_one, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos T), one_mul] at hbound
    have hc : c * T ≤ Real.exp T := (le_abs_self _).trans hbound
    have hTE : T ≤ Real.exp T := by linarith [Real.add_one_le_exp T]
    have hcY : c * T ≤ Real.exp (Real.exp T) := hc.trans (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hTE)
    have heone : (2 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp 1 := by linarith [Real.add_one_le_exp (1 : ℝ)]
    calc
      c * Real.exp (Real.exp T) * T = (c * T) * Real.exp (Real.exp T) := by ring
      _ ≤ Real.exp (Real.exp T) * Real.exp (Real.exp T) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcY (Real.exp_pos _).le
      _ = Real.exp (2 * Real.exp T) := by rw [← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; ring
      _ ≤ Real.exp (Real.exp (T + 1)) := by
        apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
        rw [Real.exp_add]
        nlinarith [Real.exp_pos T]
  
  have hLLmono : ∀ x y : ℝ, 1 < x → x ≤ y → logLog x ≤ logLog y := fun x y hx hxy =>
    Real.log_le_log (Real.log_pos hx) (Real.log_le_log (by linarith) hxy)
  have hLPFge : ∀ n r : ℕ, r ∈ n.primeFactorsList → r ≤ largestPrimeFactor n := by
    intro n r hr
    unfold largestPrimeFactor
    exact le_max_of_le_right
      (Finset.le_sup (f := id) (Nat.mem_primeFactors_iff_mem_primeFactorsList.mpr hr))
  have hLPFle : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → largestPrimeFactor n ≤ n := by
    intro n hn
    apply max_le hn
    apply Finset.sup_le
    intro r hr
    exact Nat.le_of_dvd hn (Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactors hr)
  have hLPFpow : ∀ n : ℕ, n ≠ 0 →
      n ≤ largestPrimeFactor n ^ ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors n := by
    intro n hn
    simpa only [Nat.prod_primeFactorsList hn, ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors_apply] using
      List.prod_le_pow_card n.primeFactorsList (largestPrimeFactor n)
        (fun _ hr => hLPFge n _ hr)
  have hLPF1 : ∀ n : ℕ, 1 < n → 1 < largestPrimeFactor n := by
    intro n hn
    have hbound := hLPFpow n (by omega)
    have hbase : 1 ≤ largestPrimeFactor n := le_max_left _ _
    by_contra h
    have heq : largestPrimeFactor n = 1 := by omega
    simp only [heq, one_pow] at hbound
    omega
  
  have hcntGen : ∀ (S v : ℝ) (q : ℕ), SNormal S q → (q : ℝ) ≤ v → Real.exp 1 ≤ S → S < v →
      0 ≤ Real.log (Real.log S) → Real.log (Real.log S) ≤ Real.log (Real.log v) →
      (ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors (q - 1) : ℝ) ≤
        Real.log (Real.log S) + 2 * Real.log (Real.log v) := by
    intro S v q hq hqv hS hSv ha0 haB
    have hq1 : 1 ≤ q := hq.1.one_lt.le
    have hmq : ((q - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ q := by exact_mod_cast Nat.sub_le q 1
    have hmv : ((q - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ v := hmq.trans hqv
    have hSpos : 0 < S := lt_of_lt_of_le (Real.exp_pos 1) hS
    have hsplit : ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors (q - 1) =
        omegaInterval (q - 1) 1 S + omegaInterval (q - 1) S v := by
      rw [ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors_apply]
      unfold omegaInterval
      rw [List.length_eq_countP_add_countP (fun r : ℕ => decide ((r : ℝ) ≤ S))]
      congr 1 <;> apply List.countP_congr <;> intro r hr
      · have hr1 : (1 : ℝ) < r := by
          exact_mod_cast (Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactorsList hr).one_lt
        simp [hr1]
      · have hrm : (r : ℝ) ≤ ((q - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
          exact_mod_cast Nat.le_of_mem_primeFactorsList hr
        have hrv : (r : ℝ) ≤ v := hrm.trans hmv
        simp [hrv, not_le]
    have hsmallpart := hq.2.1
    have hlarge : (omegaInterval (q - 1) S v : ℝ) ≤
        2 * Real.log (Real.log v) - Real.log (Real.log S) := by
      by_cases h1 : ((q - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ S
      · have hzero : omegaInterval (q - 1) S v = 0 := by
          unfold omegaInterval
          apply List.countP_eq_zero.mpr
          intro r hr
          have hrm : (r : ℝ) ≤ ((q - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
            exact_mod_cast Nat.le_of_mem_primeFactorsList hr
          simp only [decide_eq_true_eq, not_and, not_le]
          intro hSr
          exfalso
          linarith
        rw [hzero, Nat.cast_zero]
        linarith
      · push_neg at h1
        by_cases h2 : v ≤ ((q - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)
        · have hn := hq.2.2 S v le_rfl hSv h2
          have hsq : Real.sqrt (Real.log (Real.log S) * Real.log (Real.log v)) ≤
              Real.log (Real.log v) := by
            have hB0 : 0 ≤ Real.log (Real.log v) := ha0.trans haB
            calc Real.sqrt (Real.log (Real.log S) * Real.log (Real.log v))
                ≤ Real.sqrt (Real.log (Real.log v) * Real.log (Real.log v)) :=
                  Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right haB hB0)
              _ = Real.log (Real.log v) := Real.sqrt_mul_self hB0
          have := (abs_lt.mp hn).2
          linarith
        · push_neg at h2
          have htrunc : omegaInterval (q - 1) S v = omegaInterval (q - 1) S ((q - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
            unfold omegaInterval
            apply List.countP_congr
            intro r hr
            simp only [decide_eq_true_eq]
            have hrm : (r : ℝ) ≤ ((q - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
              exact_mod_cast Nat.le_of_mem_primeFactorsList hr
            exact ⟨fun h => ⟨h.1, hrm⟩, fun h => ⟨h.1, h.2.trans hmv⟩⟩
          rw [htrunc]
          have hn := hq.2.2 S ((q - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) le_rfl h1 le_rfl
          have hm1 : Real.exp 1 ≤ ((q - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := hS.trans h1.le
          have hmpos : 0 < ((q - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := lt_of_lt_of_le (Real.exp_pos 1) hm1
          have hlogm : 1 ≤ Real.log ((q - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
            have := Real.log_le_log (Real.exp_pos 1) hm1
            rwa [Real.log_exp] at this
          have hl0 : 0 ≤ Real.log (Real.log ((q - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) := Real.log_nonneg hlogm
          have hlB : Real.log (Real.log ((q - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≤ Real.log (Real.log v) :=
            Real.log_le_log (by linarith) (Real.log_le_log hmpos hmv)
          have hB0 : 0 ≤ Real.log (Real.log v) := ha0.trans haB
          have hsq : Real.sqrt (Real.log (Real.log S) * Real.log (Real.log ((q - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))) ≤
              Real.log (Real.log v) := by
            calc Real.sqrt (Real.log (Real.log S) * Real.log (Real.log ((q - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)))
                ≤ Real.sqrt (Real.log (Real.log v) * Real.log (Real.log v)) :=
                  Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (mul_le_mul haB hlB hl0 hB0)
              _ = Real.log (Real.log v) := Real.sqrt_mul_self hB0
          have := (abs_lt.mp hn).2
          linarith
    rw [hsplit, Nat.cast_add]
    linarith
  
  have hgapGen : ∀ (p' : ℕ) (T : ℝ), 17 ≤ p' →
      (ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors (p' - 1) : ℝ) ≤ 4 * T →
      logLog p' - logLog (largestPrimeFactor (p' - 1)) ≤ Real.log (5 * T) := by
    intro p' T hp17 hcount
    have hcp : (0 : ℝ) < ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors (p' - 1) := by
      exact_mod_cast ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors_pos_iff_one_lt.mpr
        (show 1 < p' - 1 by omega)
    have hT : 0 < T := by linarith
    have hPlog : 0 < Real.log (largestPrimeFactor (p' - 1)) :=
      Real.log_pos (by exact_mod_cast hLPF1 (p' - 1) (show 1 < p' - 1 by omega))
    have hpLog : 0 < Real.log p' := Real.log_pos (by exact_mod_cast (show 1 < p' by omega))
    
    have hlogm : Real.log ((p' - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
        ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors (p' - 1) * Real.log (largestPrimeFactor (p' - 1)) := by
      have hbound : ((p' - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (largestPrimeFactor (p' - 1) : ℝ) ^
          ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors (p' - 1) := by
        exact_mod_cast hLPFpow (p' - 1) (by omega)
      have hlog := Real.log_le_log (by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < p' - 1 by omega)) hbound
      simpa only [Real.log_pow] using hlog
    have hbound := hlogm.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcount hPlog.le)
    
    have hshift : Real.log p' ≤ (5 / 4 : ℝ) * Real.log ((p' - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
      have hnr : (0 : ℝ) < ((p' - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < p' - 1 by omega)
      have hsh : (p' : ℝ) ≤ 2 * ((p' - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
        exact_mod_cast (show p' ≤ 2 * (p' - 1) by omega)
      have hlog := Real.log_le_log (by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < p' by omega)) hsh
      rw [Real.log_mul (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0) hnr.ne'] at hlog
      have hbase : ((2 : ℝ) ^ 4) ≤ ((p' - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
        have : (16 : ℕ) ≤ p' - 1 := by omega
        have h16 : ((16 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ ((p' - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast this
        norm_num at h16 ⊢
        linarith
      have hlogbase := Real.log_le_log (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2 ^ 4) hbase
      rw [Real.log_pow] at hlogbase
      push_cast at hlogbase
      linarith
    have hlm0 : 0 ≤ Real.log ((p' - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) :=
      Real.log_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast (show 1 ≤ p' - 1 by omega))
    have hmain : Real.log p' ≤ 5 * T * Real.log (largestPrimeFactor (p' - 1)) := by
      nlinarith
    have hlog := Real.log_le_log hpLog hmain
    rw [Real.log_mul (by positivity : 5 * T ≠ 0) hPlog.ne'] at hlog
    change logLog p' ≤ Real.log (5 * T) + logLog (largestPrimeFactor (p' - 1)) at hlog
    linarith
  
  filter_upwards [hlower, hhead, htail, hb, he, hp, hsmall, henv, eventually_ge_atTop (3 : ℝ)]
    with T hlower hhead htail hb he hp hsmall henv hT3
  intro L p hpn hp17 hpsize horder hstep hlowerp hlast htop hsize
  have hT : 0 < T := by linarith
  have hbpos := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hT (-1 / 3 : ℝ)
  have hhpos := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hT (-2 / 5 : ℝ)
  simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hbpos] at hlower
  simp only [Real.rpow_zero, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_one, mul_one] at hhead
  simp only [pow_zero, one_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hbpos] at htail
  have hlow' := (le_abs_self _).trans hlower
  have hhead' := (le_abs_self _).trans hhead
  have htail' := (le_abs_self _).trans htail
  simp only [pow_zero, one_mul, Real.rpow_zero, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_one, mul_one] at hb he
  simp only [pow_zero, one_mul, Real.rpow_neg_one, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hbpos] at hp
  rw [← div_eq_mul_inv] at hp
  have hb' := (le_abs_self _).trans hb
  have he' := (le_abs_self _).trans he
  have hp' := (le_abs_self _).trans hp
  
  have hS1 : Real.exp 1 ≤ normalityScale T := by
    apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
    exact Real.one_le_exp_iff.mpr (by positivity)
  have hLLS : Real.log (Real.log (normalityScale T)) = Real.log T ^ 10 := by
    simp only [normalityScale, Real.log_exp]
  have hLLv : Real.log (Real.log (Real.exp (Real.exp (T + 1)))) = T + 1 := by
    simp only [Real.log_exp]
  have hSv : normalityScale T < Real.exp (Real.exp (T + 1)) :=
    Real.exp_lt_exp.mpr (Real.exp_lt_exp.mpr (by linarith))
  have hcnt : ∀ idx, (ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors (p idx - 1) : ℝ) ≤ 4 * T := by
    intro idx
    have h := hcntGen (normalityScale T) (Real.exp (Real.exp (T + 1))) (p idx) (hpn idx)
      ((hpsize idx).trans henv) hS1 hSv (by rw [hLLS]; positivity) (by rw [hLLS, hLLv]; linarith)
    rw [hLLS, hLLv] at h
    linarith
  have hgap : ∀ idx, logLog (p idx) - logLog (largestPrimeFactor (p idx - 1)) ≤
      Real.log (5 * T) := fun idx => hgapGen (p idx) T (hp17 idx) (hcnt idx)
  have hY : 1 < Real.exp (Real.exp T) := Real.one_lt_exp_iff.mpr (Real.exp_pos T)
  have hLLY : logLog (Real.exp (Real.exp T)) = T := by simp only [logLog, Real.log_exp]
  have hLP : ∀ idx, 1 < (largestPrimeFactor (p idx - 1) : ℝ) := by
    intro idx
    exact_mod_cast hLPF1 _ (show 1 < p idx - 1 by have := hp17 idx; omega)
  have hLPle : ∀ idx, (largestPrimeFactor (p idx - 1) : ℝ) ≤ (p idx - 1 : ℕ) := by
    intro idx
    exact_mod_cast hLPFle _ (show 0 < p idx - 1 by have := hp17 idx; omega)
  unfold CollisionBox.primeCoordinate CollisionBox.shiftedCoordinate
  have hxanti : Antitone (fun idx => logLog (p idx) / T) := by
    intro idx j hij
    apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ hT.le
    apply hLLmono _ _ (by have := hp17 j; norm_cast; omega)
    exact_mod_cast horder hij
  have hheadApprox : 1 - Real.log (6 * T) / T ≤ logLog (largestPrimeFactor (p 0 - 1)) / T := by
    have hpow : logLog ((Real.exp (Real.exp T)) ^ (9 / 10 : ℝ)) =
        Real.log (9 / 10 : ℝ) + T := by
      simp only [logLog, Real.log_rpow (Real.exp_pos _), Real.log_exp,
        Real.log_mul (by norm_num : (9 / 10 : ℝ) ≠ 0) (Real.exp_ne_zero T)]
    have hbig := hLLmono _ _ (Real.one_lt_rpow hY (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 9 / 10)) htop.le
    rw [hpow] at hbig
    have hlog := Real.log_le_log (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 5 * T)
      (show 5 * T ≤ (9 / 10 : ℝ) * (6 * T) by nlinarith)
    rw [Real.log_mul (by norm_num : (9 / 10 : ℝ) ≠ 0)
      (by positivity : 6 * T ≠ 0)] at hlog
    have hg0 := hgap 0
    apply (le_div_iff₀ hT).mpr
    have hid : (1 - Real.log (6 * T) / T) * T = T - Real.log (6 * T) := by
      field_simp
    rw [hid]
    linarith
  refine ⟨hbpos, one_div_pos.mpr hT, hhpos, hg.le, hxanti, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_,
    hheadApprox, ?_, hlow', hhead', htail'⟩
  · 
    intro idx
    apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ hT.le
    apply hLLmono _ _ (hLP idx)
    have hnat : ((p idx - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ p idx := by exact_mod_cast Nat.sub_le (p idx) 1
    exact (hLPle idx).trans hnat
  · 
    intro idx _
    have hi := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (hgap idx) hT.le
    rw [sub_div] at hi
    linarith
  · 
    intro idx j hi hij
    have hn : idx.val + 1 < L + 1 := by
      have : idx.val < j.val := hij
      have := j.isLt
      omega
    have hnext : (⟨idx.val + 1, hn⟩ : Fin (L + 1)) ≤ j := by
      show idx.val + 1 ≤ j.val
      exact hij
    have hx := hxanti hnext
    have hs : κ * (logLog (p ⟨idx.val + 1, hn⟩) / T) ≤ logLog (p idx) / T := by
      rw [← mul_div_assoc]
      exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (hstep idx hi hn) hT.le
    simp only at hx
    have hdiv : logLog (p j) / T ≤ (logLog (p idx) / T) / κ := by
      apply (le_div_iff₀ hκpos).mpr
      nlinarith
    calc
      (1 - 1 / κ) * (logLog (p idx) / T) = logLog (p idx) / T - (logLog (p idx) / T) / κ := by
        ring
      _ ≤ logLog (p idx) / T - logLog (p j) / T := sub_le_sub_left hdiv _
  · 
    intro idx hi
    have hpone : (1 : ℝ) < p idx := by have := hp17 idx; norm_cast; omega
    have hLL := hLLmono _ _ hpone (hlowerp idx hi)
    have hcut : logLog (CollisionBox.cutoff (Real.exp (Real.exp T)) θ) =
        θ * logLog (Real.exp (Real.exp T)) := by
      simp only [CollisionBox.cutoff, logLog, Real.log_exp, Real.log_rpow (Real.exp_pos T)]
    rw [hcut, hLLY] at hLL
    exact (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hLL hT.le).trans_eq (mul_div_cancel_right₀ θ hT.ne')
  · 
    linarith
  · 
    have hLL := hLLmono _ _ (hLP 0) ((hLPle 0).trans hsize)
    rw [hLLY] at hLL
    exact (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hLL hT.le).trans_eq (div_self hT.ne')
  · 
    have hnat : ((p (Fin.last L) - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ p (Fin.last L) := by
      exact_mod_cast Nat.sub_le (p (Fin.last L)) 1
    have hLL := hLLmono _ _ (hLP (Fin.last L))
      ((hLPle (Fin.last L)).trans (hnat.trans hlast))
    exact (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hLL hT.le).trans hp'

informal_problem.statement:
(A θ : ℝ) (hθ : θ < 1) :
    ∀ᶠ T : ℝ in atTop, ∀ L : ℕ, (L : ℝ) ≤ A * Real.log T →
      0 < T ∧ 0 ≤ normalityDelta T ∧ 0 < 1 / T ∧ 0 < T ^ (-2 / 5 : ℝ) ∧
      (4 * (L : ℝ) + 4) * normalityDelta T + 1 / T ≤ T ^ (-2 / 5 : ℝ) ∧
      θ + 2 * (1 / T) + (6 * (L : ℝ) + 3) * normalityDelta T < 1 ∧
      T ^ (-1 / 3 : ℝ) + 1 / T + (6 * (L : ℝ) + 5) * normalityDelta T < 1 ∧
      θ + 1 / T + (2 * (L : ℝ) + 1) * normalityDelta T + Real.log (10 * T) / T ≤ 1 ∧
      T ^ (-1 / 3 : ℝ) + (2 * (L : ℝ) + 3) * normalityDelta T + Real.log (10 * T) / T ≤ 1 ∧
      Real.log T ^ 10 ≤ T ^ (-1 / 3 : ℝ) * T / 2

(A θ : ℝ) (hθ : θ < 1) :

      (4 * (L : ℝ) + 4) * normalityDelta T + 1 / T ≤ T ^ (-2 / 5 : ℝ) ∧

      T ^ (-1 / 3 : ℝ) + (2 * (L : ℝ) + 3) * normalityDelta T + Real.log (10 * T) / T ≤ 1 ∧
      Real.log T ^ 10 ≤ T ^ (-1 / 3 : ℝ) * T / 2

proof.tactics:
by
  have hpow : ∀ (k : ℕ) (s c : ℝ), 0 < s → 0 < c →
      ∀ᶠ T : ℝ in atTop, Real.log T ^ k ≤ c * T ^ s := by
    intro k s c hs hc
    have h := (isLittleO_log_rpow_rpow_atTop (k : ℝ) hs).bound hc
    filter_upwards [h, eventually_ge_atTop (1 : ℝ)] with x hx hx1
    rw [Real.rpow_natCast] at hx
    have hl : 0 ≤ Real.log x ^ k := pow_nonneg (Real.log_nonneg hx1) k
    have hr : 0 ≤ x ^ s := Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) s
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hl, abs_of_nonneg hr] at hx
    exact hx
  obtain ⟨a, ha_def⟩ : ∃ a : ℝ, a = max A 0 + 1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have ha1 : 1 ≤ a := by have := le_max_right A 0; linarith
  have hAa : A ≤ a := by have := le_max_left A 0; linarith
  have ha0 : 0 < a := by linarith

informal_problem.statement:
{L N d K s : ℕ} {Y e e₀ g θ : ℝ} {x : Fin (L + 1) → ℝ}
    {p : Fin (L + 1) → ℕ} {q : Fin K → ℕ}
    (hY : Real.exp 1 < Y) (hT1 : 1 < logLog Y) (hN : 0 < N)
    (hQ : K = (N.primeFactors.filter fun r =>
          normalityScale (logLog Y) < (largestPrimeFactor (r - 1) : ℝ)).card ∧
      s = (∏ r ∈ N.primeFactors with (largestPrimeFactor (r - 1) : ℝ) ≤ normalityScale (logLog Y),
        r ^ (N.factorization r - 1) * (r - 1)) ∧
      (∀ idx, SNormal (normalityScale (logLog Y)) (q idx)) ∧ Function.Injective q ∧
      StrictAnti (fun idx => largestPrimeFactor (q idx - 1)) ∧
      (∀ idx, normalityScale (logLog Y) < (largestPrimeFactor (q idx - 1) : ℝ)) ∧
      (∀ idx, N.factorization (q idx) = 1) ∧
      N.totient = s * (∏ idx, (q idx - 1)) ∧ 0 < s ∧
      (largestPrimeFactor s : ℝ) ≤ normalityScale (logLog Y))
    (hB : 0 < (logLog Y) ^ (-1 / 3 : ℝ) ∧ 0 < 1 / logLog Y ∧ 0 < (logLog Y) ^ (-2 / 5 : ℝ) ∧
      0 ≤ g ∧ Antitone x ∧
      (∀ idx, CollisionBox.shiftedCoordinate (logLog Y) (p idx) ≤ x idx) ∧
      (∀ idx, (logLog Y) ^ (-1 / 3 : ℝ) ≤ x idx →
        x idx - e ≤ CollisionBox.shiftedCoordinate (logLog Y) (p idx)) ∧
      (∀ idx j : Fin (L + 1), 0 < idx.val → idx < j → g * x idx ≤ x idx - x j) ∧
      (∀ idx : Fin (L + 1), 0 < idx.val → x idx ≤ θ) ∧
      (logLog Y) ^ (-1 / 3 : ℝ) < CollisionBox.shiftedCoordinate (logLog Y) (p 0) ∧
      CollisionBox.shiftedCoordinate (logLog Y) (p 0) ≤ 1 ∧
      1 - e₀ ≤ CollisionBox.shiftedCoordinate (logLog Y) (p 0) ∧
      CollisionBox.shiftedCoordinate (logLog Y) (p (Fin.last L)) ≤ (logLog Y) ^ (-1 / 3 : ℝ) ∧
      10 * (logLog Y) ^ (-2 / 5 : ℝ) + 1 / logLog Y + e ≤ g * (logLog Y) ^ (-1 / 3 : ℝ) ∧
      10 * (logLog Y) ^ (-2 / 5 : ℝ) + 1 / logLog Y + e₀ ≤ 1 - θ ∧
      4 * (logLog Y) ^ (-2 / 5 : ℝ) ≤ (logLog Y) ^ (-1 / 3 : ℝ))
    (hm : 0 < logLog Y ∧ 0 ≤ normalityDelta (logLog Y) ∧ 0 < 1 / logLog Y ∧
      0 < logLog Y ^ (-2 / 5 : ℝ) ∧
      (4 * (L : ℝ) + 4) * normalityDelta (logLog Y) + 1 / logLog Y ≤ logLog Y ^ (-2 / 5 : ℝ) ∧
      θ + 2 * (1 / logLog Y) + (6 * (L : ℝ) + 3) * normalityDelta (logLog Y) < 1 ∧
      logLog Y ^ (-1 / 3 : ℝ) + 1 / logLog Y + (6 * (L : ℝ) + 5) * normalityDelta (logLog Y) < 1 ∧
      θ + 1 / logLog Y + (2 * (L : ℝ) + 1) * normalityDelta (logLog Y) +
        Real.log (10 * logLog Y) / logLog Y ≤ 1 ∧
      logLog Y ^ (-1 / 3 : ℝ) + (2 * (L : ℝ) + 3) * normalityDelta (logLog Y) +
        Real.log (10 * logLog Y) / logLog Y ≤ 1 ∧
      Real.log (logLog Y) ^ 10 ≤ logLog Y ^ (-1 / 3 : ℝ) * logLog Y / 2)
    (he₀ : e₀ ≤ normalityDelta (logLog Y))
    (hp : ∀ idx, SNormal (normalityScale (logLog Y)) (p idx)) (hp17 : ∀ idx, 17 ≤ p idx)
    (hd : 0 < d) (hdS : (largestPrimeFactor d : ℝ) ≤ normalityScale (logLog Y))
    (hphi : N.totient = d * ∏ idx, (p idx - 1)) (hsize : (N.totient : ℝ) ≤ Y) :
    ∃ J : Fin (L + 1), J.val < L ∧ ∃ ha : J.val + 1 ≤ K,
      (∀ idx : Fin (J.val + 1),
        |CollisionBox.shiftedCoordinate (logLog Y) (p (CollisionMatching.prefixIndex J idx)) -
          CollisionBox.shiftedCoordinate (logLog Y) (q (Fin.castLE ha idx))| ≤
            (2 * idx.val + 1 : ℝ) * normalityDelta (logLog Y)) ∧
      (∀ idx : Fin (L + 1), J < idx → ∀ z ∈ (p idx - 1).primeFactorsList, (z : ℝ) ≤
        CollisionBox.cutoff Y (CollisionBox.tailCoordinate (1 / logLog Y) ((logLog Y) ^ (-2 / 5 : ℝ))
          ((logLog Y) ^ (-1 / 3 : ℝ)) (fun i => CollisionBox.shiftedCoordinate (logLog Y) (p i)) J +
          (2 * (L : ℝ) + 3) * normalityDelta (logLog Y))) ∧
      (∀ j : Fin K, J.val + 1 ≤ j.val → (largestPrimeFactor (q j - 1) : ℝ) <
        CollisionBox.cutoff Y (CollisionBox.tailCoordinate (1 / logLog Y) ((logLog Y) ^ (-2 / 5 : ℝ))
          ((logLog Y) ^ (-1 / 3 : ℝ)) (fun i => CollisionBox.shiftedCoordinate (logLog Y) (p i)) J +
          (2 * (L : ℝ) + 3) * normalityDelta (logLog Y))) ∧
      (∀ z ∈ (s * ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun j : Fin K => J.val + 1 ≤ j.val),
          (q j - 1)).primeFactorsList, (z : ℝ) ≤
        CollisionBox.cutoff Y (CollisionBox.tailCoordinate (1 / logLog Y) ((logLog Y) ^ (-2 / 5 : ℝ))
          ((logLog Y) ^ (-1 / 3 : ℝ)) (fun i => CollisionBox.shiftedCoordinate (logLog Y) (p i)) J +
          (2 * (L : ℝ) + 3) * normalityDelta (logLog Y))) ∧
      (∀ C : Finset (Fin (J.val + 1)), (∀ j : Fin (J.val + 1), j.val = 0 → j ∉ C) →
        let k := (CollisionClass.remaining C).card
        let w := fun i => CollisionBox.shiftedCoordinate (logLog Y) (p i)
        let z := CollisionCutoff.selectedZeta J C (1 / logLog Y) w
        let zstar := CollisionBox.tailCoordinate (1 / logLog Y) ((logLog Y) ^ (-2 / 5 : ℝ))
          ((logLog Y) ^ (-1 / 3 : ℝ)) w J
        let v := CollisionCutoff.upper Y L (normalityDelta (logLog Y)) z zstar
        let W := CollisionCutoff.lower Y L (normalityDelta (logLog Y)) (1 / logLog Y) z zstar
        1 ≤ k ∧ CollisionCutoff.SieveCutoffs k Y (normalityDelta (logLog Y)) v W ∧
          ∀ idx : Fin k,
            (W idx.val ≤ (largestPrimeFactor (p (CollisionCutoff.selectedIndex J C idx) - 1) : ℝ) ∧
              (largestPrimeFactor (p (CollisionCutoff.selectedIndex J C idx) - 1) : ℝ) ≤ v idx.val) ∧
            (W idx.val ≤ (largestPrimeFactor (q (Fin.castLE ha (CollisionClass.index C idx)) - 1) : ℝ) ∧
              (largestPrimeFactor (q (Fin.castLE ha (CollisionClass.index C idx)) - 1) : ℝ) ≤
                v idx.val))

          ((logLog Y) ^ (-1 / 3 : ℝ)) w J
        let v := CollisionCutoff.upper Y L (normalityDelta (logLog Y)) z zstar
        let W := CollisionCutoff.lower Y L (normalityDelta (logLog Y)) (1 / logLog Y) z zstar
        1 ≤ k ∧ CollisionCutoff.SieveCutoffs k Y (normalityDelta (logLog Y)) v W ∧
          ∀ idx : Fin k,
            (W idx.val ≤ (largestPrimeFactor (p (CollisionCutoff.selectedIndex J C idx) - 1) : ℝ) ∧
              (largestPrimeFactor (p (CollisionCutoff.selectedIndex J C idx) - 1) : ℝ) ≤ v idx.val) ∧
            (W idx.val ≤ (largestPrimeFactor (q (Fin.castLE ha (CollisionClass.index C idx)) - 1) : ℝ) ∧
              (largestPrimeFactor (q (Fin.castLE ha (CollisionClass.index C idx)) - 1) : ℝ) ≤
                v idx.val)))
    (hJL : J.val < L) (hN : 0 < N)
    (hp : ∀ idx, SNormal (normalityScale (logLog Y)) (p idx)) (hinj : Function.Injective p)
    (hp17 : ∀ idx, 17 ≤ p idx) (horder : Antitone p)
    (hphi : N.totient = d * ∏ idx, (p idx - 1)) (hsize : (N.totient : ℝ) ≤ Y)
    (hsquare : NoLargePrimeSquare N.totient (normalityScale (logLog Y)))
    (htop : Y ^ (9 / 10 : ℝ) < (p 0 : ℝ)) (hsizetop : N ≤ (p 0) ^ 2)
    (hneq : largestPrimeFactor N ≠ p 0)
    (hfacet : (∑ idx ∈ Finset.Icc 1 L, fordWeight idx *
      CollisionFacet.extend (fun j => CollisionBox.primeCoordinate (logLog Y) (p j)) idx) ≤
        1 - (logLog Y) ^ (-1 / 8 : ℝ)) :
    ∃ r : CollisionSum.Record Y L d, r.integer = ∏ idx, p idx

by
  classical
  obtain ⟨_hK, _hs, hqn, _hqinj, _hqanti, _hqlarge, hqonce, hqphi, hspos, _hssmooth⟩ := hQ
  obtain ⟨_hpre, hleft, _hright, hres, hpaired⟩ := hm
  
  have hp0ndvd : ¬ p 0 ∣ N := by
    intro hpN
    have hp0 : (p 0).Prime := (hp 0).1
    have hmem : p 0 ∈ N.primeFactors := Nat.mem_primeFactors.mpr ⟨hp0, hpN, hN.ne'⟩
    obtain ⟨r, hr, hsup⟩ := Finset.exists_mem_eq_sup N.primeFactors ⟨p 0, hmem⟩ id
    have hle : p 0 ≤ r := by
      have := Finset.le_sup (f := id) hmem
      rw [hsup] at this
      exact this
    have hrp : r.Prime := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hr
    have hrN : r ∣ N := Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactors hr
    have hlpf : largestPrimeFactor N = r := by
      unfold largestPrimeFactor
      rw [hsup]
      have := hrp.two_le
      exact max_eq_right (by simp only [id]; omega)
    have hne : r ≠ p 0 := fun h => hneq (hlpf.trans h)
    have hlt : p 0 < r := lt_of_le_of_ne hle (Ne.symm hne)
    have hcop : Nat.Coprime (p 0) r := (Nat.coprime_primes hp0 hrp).mpr (ne_of_lt hlt)
    have hdvd : p 0 * r ∣ N := hcop.mul_dvd_of_dvd_of_dvd hpN hrN
    have hle2 : p 0 * r ≤ N := Nat.le_of_dvd hN hdvd
    have hpos : 0 < p 0 := hp0.pos
    have hmul : p 0 * p 0 < p 0 * r := Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hlt hpos
    have hsq : p 0 ^ 2 = p 0 * p 0 := sq (p 0)
    omega
  let right : Fin (J.val + 1) → ℕ := fun idx => q (Fin.castLE ha idx)
  let res : ℕ := s * ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun j : Fin K => J.val + 1 ≤ j.val), (q j - 1)
  let C : Finset (Fin (J.val + 1)) :=
    commonIndices Finset.univ (CollisionRecord.leftPrimes J p) right
  have hzero : ∀ idx : Fin (J.val + 1), idx.val = 0 → idx ∉ C := by
    intro idx hi hmem
    have heq : p (CollisionMatching.prefixIndex J idx) = q (Fin.castLE ha idx) :=
      (Finset.mem_filter.mp hmem).2
    have h0 : CollisionMatching.prefixIndex J idx = 0 :=
      Fin.ext (by simp [CollisionMatching.prefixIndex, hi])
    rw [h0] at heq
    have hqdvd : q (Fin.castLE ha idx) ∣ N := by
      have := hqonce (Fin.castLE ha idx)
      exact ((hqn _).1.dvd_iff_one_le_factorization hN.ne').mpr (by omega)
    exact hp0ndvd (heq ▸ hqdvd)
  obtain ⟨hk, hv, hpair⟩ := hpaired C hzero
  have htailEq : CollisionBox.cutoff Y (CollisionBox.tailCoordinate (1 / logLog Y)
      ((logLog Y) ^ (-2 / 5 : ℝ)) ((logLog Y) ^ (-1 / 3 : ℝ))
      (fun i => CollisionBox.shiftedCoordinate (logLog Y) (p i)) J +
        (2 * (L : ℝ) + 3) * normalityDelta (logLog Y)) =
      CollisionSum.upper Y p J C (CollisionClass.remaining C).card := by
    have hk' : (CollisionClass.remaining C).card ≠ 0 := by omega
    simp only [CollisionSum.upper, CollisionRecord.upper, CollisionCutoff.upper,
      CollisionCutoff.nu, hk', if_false, lt_irrefl, dite_false]
  
  have hsplitP : ∀ f : Fin (L + 1) → ℕ,
      (∏ idx : Fin (J.val + 1), f (CollisionMatching.prefixIndex J idx)) *
        (∏ idx : Fin (L - J.val), f (CollisionRecord.tailIndex J idx)) = ∏ idx, f idx := by
    intro f
    have hlen : (J.val + 1) + (L - J.val) = L + 1 := by have := J.isLt; omega
    have hprod := Fin.prod_congr' f hlen
    rw [Fin.prod_univ_add] at hprod
    exact hprod
  
  have hsplitQ : (∏ idx : Fin (J.val + 1), (q (Fin.castLE ha idx) - 1)) *
      (∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun j : Fin K => J.val + 1 ≤ j.val), (q j - 1)) =
        ∏ j, (q j - 1) := by
    have hpre : ∏ idx : Fin (J.val + 1), (q (Fin.castLE ha idx) - 1) =
        ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun j : Fin K => j.val < J.val + 1), (q j - 1) := by
      apply Finset.prod_bij (fun idx _ => Fin.castLE ha idx)
      · intro idx _
        simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Fin.coe_castLE]
        exact idx.isLt
      · intro a _ b _ h
        exact Fin.ext (by simpa using congrArg Fin.val h)
      · intro j hj
        exact ⟨⟨j.val, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hj).2⟩, Finset.mem_univ _, Fin.ext rfl⟩
      · intro idx _
        rfl
    rw [hpre]
    have h := Finset.prod_filter_mul_prod_filter_not Finset.univ
      (fun j : Fin K => j.val < J.val + 1) (fun j => q j - 1)
    simpa only [not_lt] using h
  have hL : d * ((∏ idx, (CollisionRecord.leftPrimes J p idx - 1)) *
      (∏ j, (CollisionRecord.tailPrimes J p j - 1))) = N.totient := by
    rw [hphi]
    congr 1
    exact hsplitP (fun i => p i - 1)
  have hR : (∏ idx, (right idx - 1)) * res = N.totient := by
    rw [hqphi, ← hsplitQ]
    simp only [right, res]
    ring
  have hcond : CollisionClass.Conditions C d (CollisionRecord.commonProduct J p C) (∏ idx, p idx)
      (normalityScale (logLog Y)) Y (CollisionSum.upper Y p J C) (CollisionSum.lower Y p J C)
      (CollisionRecord.leftPrimes J p) right (CollisionRecord.tailPrimes J p) res := by
    refine
      { normal_left := fun idx => hp _
        normal_right := fun idx => hqn _
        normal_tail := fun idx => hp _
        left_injective := ?_
        residual_pos := ?_
        common := rfl
        common_product := rfl
        integer := hsplitP p
        equation := hL.trans hR.symm
        size := ?_
        square_exclusion := ?_
        largest_left := fun idx => (hpair idx).1
        largest_right := fun idx => (hpair idx).2
        tail_support := ?_
        residual_support := ?_
        top := ?_ }
    · intro a b hab
      have h := congrArg (fun x : Fin (L + 1) => x.val) (hinj hab)
      exact Fin.ext h
    · exact Nat.mul_pos hspos (Finset.prod_pos fun j _ => by have := (hqn j).1.two_le; omega)
    · rw [hL]
      exact hsize
    · rw [hL]
      exact fun r hr hlt => hsquare r hr (lt_of_le_of_lt hv.normality hlt)
    · intro idx z hz
      have hlt : J < CollisionRecord.tailIndex J idx := by
        rw [Fin.lt_iff_val_lt_val]
        show J.val < J.val + 1 + idx.val
        omega
      exact (hleft (CollisionRecord.tailIndex J idx) hlt z hz).trans_eq htailEq
    · intro z hz
      exact (hres z hz).trans_eq htailEq
    · intro idx hi
      have h0 : CollisionMatching.prefixIndex J idx = 0 :=
        Fin.ext (by simp [CollisionMatching.prefixIndex, hi])
      show Y ^ (9 / 10 : ℝ) < (p (CollisionMatching.prefixIndex J idx) : ℝ)
      rw [h0]
      exact htop
  exact ⟨⟨∏ idx, p idx, p, J, C, right, res, hJL, hzero, hv, hcond, hp17, horder, hfacet⟩, rfl⟩

{m n : ℕ}
    (cut : ℝ → (Fin m → ℕ) × (Fin n → ℕ) → (Fin m → ℕ) × (Fin n → ℕ))
    (hcut : ∀ (u : ℝ) (s : (Fin m → ℕ) × (Fin n → ℕ)), cut u s =
      (fun a => ((s.1 a).primeFactorsList.filter (fun p : ℕ => decide ((p : ℝ) ≤ u))).prod,
       fun b => ((s.2 b).primeFactorsList.filter (fun p : ℕ => decide ((p : ℝ) ≤ u))).prod))
    (F : Finset ((Fin m → ℕ) × (Fin n → ℕ))) (d k : ℕ) (v : ℕ → ℝ) (A : ℝ) (B : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hanti : Antitone v) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hB : ∀ j, j < k - 1 → 0 ≤ B j)
    (hfirst : ∀ σ ∈ F.image (cut (v 1)),
      ((F.filter (fun s => cut (v 1) s = σ)).card : ℝ) ≤
        A / ((d : ℝ) * ((∏ a, σ.1 a : ℕ) : ℝ)))
    (hstep : ∀ j, j < k - 1 → ∀ σ ∈ F.image (cut (v (j + 2))),
      (∑ w ∈ (F.image (cut (v (j + 1)))).filter (fun w => cut (v (j + 2)) w = σ),
        ((∏ a, σ.1 a : ℕ) : ℝ) / ((∏ a, w.1 a : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≤ B j) :
    (F.card : ℝ) ≤ A * (∏ j ∈ Finset.range (k - 1), B j) *
      ∑ σ ∈ F.image (cut (v k)), (1 : ℝ) / ((d : ℝ) * ((∏ a, σ.1 a : ℕ) : ℝ))

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hidem : ∀ (N : ℕ) (u u' : ℝ), u' ≤ u →
      ((((N.primeFactorsList.filter (fun p : ℕ => decide ((p : ℝ) ≤ u))).prod).primeFactorsList.filter
          (fun p : ℕ => decide ((p : ℝ) ≤ u'))).prod) =
        (N.primeFactorsList.filter (fun p : ℕ => decide ((p : ℝ) ≤ u'))).prod := by
    intro N u u' hu
    have hprime : ∀ p ∈ N.primeFactorsList.filter (fun p : ℕ => decide ((p : ℝ) ≤ u)), p.Prime :=
      fun p hp => Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactorsList (List.mem_of_mem_filter hp)
    have hperm := Nat.primeFactorsList_unique rfl hprime
    rw [← (hperm.filter (fun p : ℕ => decide ((p : ℝ) ≤ u'))).prod_eq, List.filter_filter]
    congr 1
    apply List.filter_congr
    intro p _
    by_cases h : (p : ℝ) ≤ u'
    · simp [h, le_trans h hu]
    · simp [h]
  
  have hpos : ∀ (N : ℕ) (u : ℝ),
      0 < (N.primeFactorsList.filter (fun p : ℕ => decide ((p : ℝ) ≤ u))).prod := by
    intro N u
    apply List.prod_pos
    intro p hp
    exact (Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactorsList (List.mem_of_mem_filter hp)).pos
  
  have hcomp : ∀ (u u' : ℝ), u' ≤ u → ∀ s, cut u' (cut u s) = cut u' s := by
    intro u u' hu s
    rw [hcut u' (cut u s), hcut u s, hcut u' s]
    refine Prod.ext ?_ ?_
    · funext a
      exact hidem _ _ _ hu
    · funext b
      exact hidem _ _ _ hu
  
  have hPpos : ∀ (u : ℝ) s, 0 < ((∏ a, (cut u s).1 a : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    intro u s
    rw [hcut u s]
    exact Nat.cast_pos.mpr (Finset.prod_pos fun a _ => hpos _ _)
  
  have hgstep : ∀ (S T : Finset ((Fin m → ℕ) × (Fin n → ℕ)))
      (g : (Fin m → ℕ) × (Fin n → ℕ) → (Fin m → ℕ) × (Fin n → ℕ)) (Bj : ℝ),
      (∀ w ∈ S, g w ∈ T) → (∀ σ ∈ T, 0 < ((∏ a, σ.1 a : ℕ) : ℝ)) →
      (∀ σ ∈ T, (∑ w ∈ S.filter (fun w => g w = σ),
        ((∏ a, σ.1 a : ℕ) : ℝ) / ((∏ a, w.1 a : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≤ Bj) →
      (∑ w ∈ S, (1 : ℝ) / ((d : ℝ) * ((∏ a, w.1 a : ℕ) : ℝ))) ≤
        Bj * ∑ σ ∈ T, (1 : ℝ) / ((d : ℝ) * ((∏ a, σ.1 a : ℕ) : ℝ)) := by
    intro S T g Bj hmaps hP hfib
    rw [← Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to hmaps
      (fun w => (1 : ℝ) / ((d : ℝ) * ((∏ a, w.1 a : ℕ) : ℝ))), Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro σ hσ
    have hPs := hP σ hσ
    have hid : ∀ w ∈ S.filter (fun w => g w = σ),
        (1 : ℝ) / ((d : ℝ) * ((∏ a, w.1 a : ℕ) : ℝ)) =
          (1 / ((d : ℝ) * ((∏ a, σ.1 a : ℕ) : ℝ))) *
            (((∏ a, σ.1 a : ℕ) : ℝ) / ((∏ a, w.1 a : ℕ) : ℝ)) := by
      intro w _
      generalize ((∏ a, σ.1 a : ℕ) : ℝ) = x at hPs ⊢
      generalize ((∏ a, w.1 a : ℕ) : ℝ) = y
      rw [div_mul_div_comm, one_mul, show (d : ℝ) * x * y = x * ((d : ℝ) * y) by ring,
        div_mul_cancel_left₀ hPs.ne', one_div]
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hid, ← Finset.mul_sum, mul_comm Bj]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hfib σ hσ)
      (div_nonneg zero_le_one (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg d) hPs.le))
  
  have hbase : (F.card : ℝ) ≤
      A * ∑ σ ∈ F.image (cut (v 1)), (1 : ℝ) / ((d : ℝ) * ((∏ a, σ.1 a : ℕ) : ℝ)) := by
    rw [Finset.card_eq_sum_card_image (cut (v 1)) F, Nat.cast_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro σ hσ
    rw [mul_one_div]
    exact hfirst σ hσ
  
  have hind : ∀ i : ℕ, i + 1 ≤ k → (F.card : ℝ) ≤ A * (∏ j ∈ Finset.range i, B j) *
      ∑ σ ∈ F.image (cut (v (i + 1))), (1 : ℝ) / ((d : ℝ) * ((∏ a, σ.1 a : ℕ) : ℝ)) := by
    intro i
    induction i with
    | zero =>
      intro _
      rw [Finset.prod_range_zero, mul_one]
      exact hbase
    | succ i ih =>
      intro hi
      show (F.card : ℝ) ≤ A * (∏ j ∈ Finset.range (i + 1), B j) *
        ∑ σ ∈ F.image (cut (v (i + 2))), (1 : ℝ) / ((d : ℝ) * ((∏ a, σ.1 a : ℕ) : ℝ))
      have h1 := ih (by omega)
      have hvle : v (i + 2) ≤ v (i + 1) := hanti (by omega)
      have hmaps : ∀ w ∈ F.image (cut (v (i + 1))),
          cut (v (i + 2)) w ∈ F.image (cut (v (i + 2))) := by
        intro w hw
        obtain ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hw
        rw [hcomp _ _ hvle s]
        exact Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ hs
      have hPT : ∀ σ ∈ F.image (cut (v (i + 2))), 0 < ((∏ a, σ.1 a : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
        intro σ hσ
        obtain ⟨s, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hσ
        exact hPpos _ s
      have h2 := hgstep _ _ _ (B i) hmaps hPT (hstep i (by omega))
      have hnn : 0 ≤ A * ∏ j ∈ Finset.range i, B j :=
        mul_nonneg hA (Finset.prod_nonneg fun j hj => hB j (by
          rw [Finset.mem_range] at hj; omega))
      calc (F.card : ℝ) ≤ _ := h1
        _ ≤ A * (∏ j ∈ Finset.range i, B j) *
            (B i * ∑ σ ∈ F.image (cut (v (i + 2))),
              (1 : ℝ) / ((d : ℝ) * ((∏ a, σ.1 a : ℕ) : ℝ))) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 hnn
        _ = _ := by rw [Finset.prod_range_succ]; ring
  have hfin := hind (k - 1) (by omega)
  rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel hk] at hfin
  exact hfin

informal_problem.statement:
(hPNT : Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => (Nat.primeCounting ⌊x⌋₊ : ℝ) / (x / Real.log x)) atTop (𝓝 1))
    (hMERT : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ, 2 ≤ x →
      |(∑ p ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊x⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, (1 : ℝ) / p) - Real.log (Real.log x)| ≤ C)
    (hEULER : Asymptotics.IsEquivalent atTop
      (fun x : ℝ => ∏ p ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊x⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, (1 - (1 : ℝ) / p))
      (fun x => Real.exp (-Real.eulerMascheroniConstant) / Real.log x)) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ᶠ Y : ℝ in atTop,
      ∀ (k l d : ℕ) (R : ℝ) (v W : ℕ → ℝ) (F : Finset ((Fin (k + l) → ℕ) × (Fin (k + 1) → ℕ)))
        (cut : ℝ → (Fin (k + l) → ℕ) × (Fin (k + 1) → ℕ) → (Fin (k + l) → ℕ) × (Fin (k + 1) → ℕ)),
      (∀ (u : ℝ) (s : (Fin (k + l) → ℕ) × (Fin (k + 1) → ℕ)), cut u s =
        (fun a => ((s.1 a).primeFactorsList.filter (fun p : ℕ => decide ((p : ℝ) ≤ u))).prod,
         fun b => ((s.2 b).primeFactorsList.filter (fun p : ℕ => decide ((p : ℝ) ≤ u))).prod)) →
      1 ≤ k → 1 ≤ l → normalityScale (logLog Y) ≤ v k → Antitone v → v 0 = Y →
      (∀ j < k, v (j + 1) < W j ∧ W j ≤ v j) →
      (∀ idx, 2 ≤ idx → idx ≤ k → normalityDelta (logLog Y) ≤
        logLog (v (idx - 1)) / logLog Y - logLog (v idx) / logLog Y) →
      1 ≤ R → v 1 ≤ Y ^ (1 / (10 * logLog Y)) → 0 < d →
      (∀ p ∈ d.primeFactorsList, (p : ℝ) ≤ v k) →
      (∀ s ∈ F,
        ((∀ a : Fin (k + l), 0 < s.1 a) ∧ (∀ b : Fin (k + 1), 0 < s.2 b)) ∧
        d * (∏ a, s.1 a) = (∏ b, s.2 b) ∧
        R * (d : ℝ) * (((∏ a, s.1 a : ℕ)) : ℝ) ≤ Y ∧
        NoLargePrimeSquare (d * ∏ a, s.1 a) (v k) ∧
        (∀ a : Fin (k + l), a.val < k → SNormal (normalityScale (logLog Y)) (s.1 a + 1)) ∧
        (∀ b : Fin (k + 1), b.val < k → SNormal (normalityScale (logLog Y)) (s.2 b + 1)) ∧
        (∀ (a : Fin (k + l)) (b : Fin (k + 1)), a.val < k → b.val = a.val → s.1 a ≠ s.2 b) ∧
        (∀ a : Fin (k + l), a.val < k →
          W a.val ≤ (largestPrimeFactor (s.1 a) : ℝ) ∧ (largestPrimeFactor (s.1 a) : ℝ) ≤ v a.val) ∧
        (∀ b : Fin (k + 1), b.val < k →
          W b.val ≤ (largestPrimeFactor (s.2 b) : ℝ) ∧ (largestPrimeFactor (s.2 b) : ℝ) ≤ v b.val) ∧
        (∀ a : Fin (k + l), k ≤ a.val → ∀ r ∈ (s.1 a).primeFactorsList, (r : ℝ) ≤ v k) ∧
        (∀ b : Fin (k + 1), k ≤ b.val → ∀ r ∈ (s.2 b).primeFactorsList, (r : ℝ) ≤ v k) ∧
        (∀ a : Fin (k + l), k ≤ a.val →
          (ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors (s.1 a) : ℝ) ≤ 10 * logLog (v k)) ∧
        (∀ a : Fin (k + l), a.val = 0 → Y ^ (9 / 10 : ℝ) < (((s.1 a + 1 : ℕ)) : ℝ))) →
      ∀ σ ∈ F.image (cut (v 1)),

proof.tactics:
by
  have terminal_ordered_factorization_count : ∀ (r N : ℕ) (G : Finset (Fin r → ℕ)), 0 < N →
      (∀ f ∈ G, ∏ i, f i = N) → G.card ≤ r ^ ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors N := by
    intro r N G hN hG
    have main : ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ (N : ℕ) (G : Finset (Fin r → ℕ)), 0 < N → (∀ f ∈ G, ∏ i, f i = N) →
        ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors N = k → G.card ≤ r ^ k := by
      intro k
      induction k with
      | zero =>
        intro N G hN hG h
        have hN1 : N = 1 := by
          by_contra hne
          obtain ⟨p, hp, hpd⟩ := Nat.exists_prime_and_dvd hne
          have hmem : p ∈ N.primeFactorsList := (Nat.mem_primeFactorsList hN.ne').mpr ⟨hp, hpd⟩
          rw [ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors_apply, List.length_eq_zero_iff] at h
          rw [h] at hmem
          exact List.not_mem_nil hmem
        subst hN1
        rw [pow_zero]
        have hone : ∀ f : Fin r → ℕ, ∏ i, f i = 1 → ∀ i, f i = 1 := fun f hf i =>
          Nat.eq_one_of_dvd_one (hf ▸ Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem f (Finset.mem_univ i))
        apply Finset.card_le_one.mpr
        intro f hf g hg
        funext i
        rw [hone f (hG f hf) i, hone g (hG g hg) i]
      | succ k ih =>
        intro N G hN hG h
        have hN1 : N ≠ 1 := by
          intro h1
          subst h1
          simp at h
        obtain ⟨p, hp, hpd⟩ := Nat.exists_prime_and_dvd hN1
        have hNeq : N = p * (N / p) := (Nat.mul_div_cancel' hpd).symm
        have hN' : 0 < N / p := Nat.div_pos (Nat.le_of_dvd hN hpd) hp.pos
        have hΩ : ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors (N / p) = k := by
          rw [hNeq, ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors_mul hp.ne_zero hN'.ne',
            ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors_apply_prime hp] at h
          omega
        rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos r with hr | hr
        · subst hr
          have hGe : G = ∅ := by
            apply Finset.eq_empty_of_forall_notMem
            intro f hf
            have h1 := hG f hf
            simp at h1
            exact hN1 h1.symm
          simp [hGe]
        · let ι : (Fin r → ℕ) → Fin r := fun f =>
            if hx : ∃ i, p ∣ f i then Classical.choose hx else ⟨0, hr⟩
          have hι : ∀ f ∈ G, p ∣ f (ι f) := by
            intro f hf
            have hex : ∃ i, p ∣ f i := by
              have h1 : p ∣ ∏ i, f i := (hG f hf) ▸ hpd
              obtain ⟨i, _, hi⟩ := (Prime.dvd_finset_prod_iff hp.prime f).mp h1
              exact ⟨i, hi⟩
            simp only [ι, dif_pos hex]
            exact Classical.choose_spec hex
          let phi : (Fin r → ℕ) → Fin r × (Fin r → ℕ) := fun f =>
            (ι f, Function.update f (ι f) (f (ι f) / p))
          have hprod : ∀ f ∈ G, ∏ i, (phi f).2 i = N / p := by
            intro f hf
            have h1 := hG f hf
            rw [← Finset.mul_prod_erase Finset.univ f (Finset.mem_univ (ι f))] at h1
            show ∏ i, Function.update f (ι f) (f (ι f) / p) i = N / p
            rw [← Finset.mul_prod_erase Finset.univ _ (Finset.mem_univ (ι f)), Function.update_self,
              Finset.prod_congr rfl
                (fun j hj => Function.update_of_ne (Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hj) _ _)]
            apply Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left hp.pos
            rw [← mul_assoc, Nat.mul_div_cancel' (hι f hf), h1, ← hNeq]
          have hinj : Set.InjOn phi G := by
            intro f hf g hg hfg
            simp only [phi, Prod.mk.injEq] at hfg
            obtain ⟨hi, hu⟩ := hfg
            have hgi := hι g hg
            rw [← hi] at hu hgi
            funext j
            have h1 := congrFun hu j
            by_cases hj : j = ι f
            · rw [hj] at h1 ⊢
              simp only [Function.update_self] at h1
              exact (Nat.div_left_inj (hι f hf) hgi).mp h1
            · simpa [Function.update_of_ne hj] using h1
          have hsub : G.image phi ⊆ Finset.univ ×ˢ (G.image (fun f => (phi f).2)) := by
            intro x hx
            obtain ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hx
            exact Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ hf⟩
          have hIH := ih (N / p) (G.image (fun f => (phi f).2)) hN' (by
            intro g hg
            obtain ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hg
            exact hprod f hf) hΩ
          calc G.card = (G.image phi).card := (Finset.card_image_of_injOn hinj).symm
            _ ≤ (Finset.univ ×ˢ (G.image (fun f => (phi f).2))).card := Finset.card_le_card hsub
            _ = r * (G.image (fun f => (phi f).2)).card := by
                rw [Finset.card_product, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
            _ ≤ r * r ^ k := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hIH
            _ = r ^ (k + 1) := by ring
    exact main _ N G hN hG rfl
  have terminal_smooth_reciprocal_sum_le_euler : ∀ (V : ℝ) (M : Finset ℕ),
      (∀ a ∈ M, 0 < a ∧ ∀ p ∈ a.primeFactorsList, (p : ℝ) ≤ V) →
      (∑ a ∈ M, (1 : ℝ) / a) ≤ ∏ p ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊V⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, (1 - (1 : ℝ) / p)⁻¹ := by
    intro V M hM
    have claim : ∀ P : Finset ℕ, (∀ p ∈ P, p.Prime) → ∀ M : Finset ℕ,
        (∀ a ∈ M, 0 < a ∧ a.primeFactors ⊆ P) →
        (∑ a ∈ M, (1:ℝ) / a) ≤ ∏ p ∈ P, (1 - (1:ℝ) / p)⁻¹ := by
      intro P
      induction P using Finset.induction_on with
      | empty =>
        intro _ M hM
        rw [Finset.prod_empty]
        have hsub : M ⊆ {1} := by
          intro a ha
          obtain ⟨hpos, hsub⟩ := hM a ha
          have h0 : a.primeFactors = ∅ := Finset.subset_empty.mp hsub
          rw [Nat.primeFactors_eq_empty] at h0
          rw [Finset.mem_singleton]
          omega
        calc (∑ a ∈ M, (1:ℝ) / a) ≤ ∑ a ∈ ({1} : Finset ℕ), (1:ℝ) / a :=
              Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hsub (fun _ _ _ => by positivity)
          _ = 1 := by simp
      | insert q P hq ih =>
        intro hP M hM
        have hqp : q.Prime := hP q (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _)
        have hP' : ∀ p ∈ P, p.Prime := fun p hp => hP p (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hp)
        have hPipos : 0 ≤ ∏ p ∈ P, (1 - (1:ℝ) / p)⁻¹ := by
          apply Finset.prod_nonneg
          intro p hp
          have hp1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ p := by exact_mod_cast (hP' p hp).one_lt.le
          exact inv_nonneg.mpr (sub_nonneg.mpr ((div_le_one (by linarith)).mpr hp1))
        rw [← Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to (s := M) (t := M.image (fun a => a.factorization q))
          (g := fun a => a.factorization q) (fun a ha => Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ ha)]
        have hfib : ∀ j ∈ M.image (fun a => a.factorization q),
            (∑ a ∈ M.filter (fun a => a.factorization q = j), (1:ℝ) / a) ≤
              ((1:ℝ) / q) ^ j * ∏ p ∈ P, (1 - (1:ℝ) / p)⁻¹ := by
          intro j _
          have hrw : ∀ a ∈ M.filter (fun a => a.factorization q = j),
              (1:ℝ) / a = ((1:ℝ) / q) ^ j * ((1:ℝ) / ((a / q ^ a.factorization q : ℕ) : ℝ)) := by
            intro a ha
            obtain ⟨_, hej⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp ha
            have h1 : q ^ j * (a / q ^ a.factorization q) = a := by
              rw [← hej]; exact Nat.ordProj_mul_ordCompl_eq_self a q
            have h1' : (a:ℝ) = (q:ℝ) ^ j * ((a / q ^ a.factorization q : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
              exact_mod_cast h1.symm
            rw [h1', one_div_pow, one_div_mul_one_div]
          rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hrw, ← Finset.mul_sum]
          apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (by positivity)
          have hcinj : Set.InjOn (fun a => a / q ^ a.factorization q)
              (M.filter (fun a => a.factorization q = j) : Set ℕ) := by
            intro a ha b hb hab
            have ha' := (Finset.mem_filter.mp ha).2
            have hb' := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hb).2
            have hfe : a.factorization q = b.factorization q := ha'.trans hb'.symm
            have hab' : a / q ^ a.factorization q = b / q ^ b.factorization q := hab
            calc a = q ^ a.factorization q * (a / q ^ a.factorization q) :=
                  (Nat.ordProj_mul_ordCompl_eq_self a q).symm
              _ = q ^ b.factorization q * (b / q ^ b.factorization q) := by rw [hab', hfe]
              _ = b := Nat.ordProj_mul_ordCompl_eq_self b q
          rw [← Finset.sum_image (f := fun b : ℕ => (1:ℝ) / b) hcinj]
          apply ih hP'
          intro b hb
          obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hb
          obtain ⟨ha, -⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp ha
          obtain ⟨hapos, hasub⟩ := hM a ha
          refine ⟨Nat.ordCompl_pos q hapos.ne', ?_⟩
          intro r hr
          have hr1 : r ∈ a.primeFactors :=
            Nat.primeFactors_mono (Nat.ordCompl_dvd a q) hapos.ne' hr
          rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp (hasub hr1) with h | h
          · exfalso
            subst h
            exact Nat.not_dvd_ordCompl hqp hapos.ne' (Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactors hr)
          · exact h
        have hq1 : (1:ℝ) / q < 1 := by
          have : (1:ℝ) < q := by exact_mod_cast hqp.one_lt
          rw [div_lt_one (by linarith)]
          exact this
        have hq0 : 0 ≤ (1:ℝ) / q := by positivity
        calc ∑ j ∈ M.image (fun a => a.factorization q),
              ∑ a ∈ M.filter (fun a => a.factorization q = j), (1:ℝ) / a
            ≤ ∑ j ∈ M.image (fun a => a.factorization q),
                ((1:ℝ) / q) ^ j * ∏ p ∈ P, (1 - (1:ℝ) / p)⁻¹ := Finset.sum_le_sum hfib
          _ = (∑ j ∈ M.image (fun a => a.factorization q), ((1:ℝ) / q) ^ j) *
                ∏ p ∈ P, (1 - (1:ℝ) / p)⁻¹ := by rw [Finset.sum_mul]
          _ ≤ (1 - (1:ℝ) / q)⁻¹ * ∏ p ∈ P, (1 - (1:ℝ) / p)⁻¹ := by
              apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ hPipos
              rw [← tsum_geometric_of_lt_one hq0 hq1]
              exact Summable.sum_le_tsum _ (fun i _ => pow_nonneg hq0 i)
                (summable_geometric_of_lt_one hq0 hq1)
          _ = ∏ p ∈ insert q P, (1 - (1:ℝ) / p)⁻¹ := by rw [Finset.prod_insert hq]
    apply claim _ (fun p hp => (Finset.mem_filter.mp hp).2) M
    intro a ha
    obtain ⟨hapos, hV⟩ := hM a ha
    refine ⟨hapos, ?_⟩
    intro r hr
    have hrl : r ∈ a.primeFactorsList := Nat.mem_primeFactors_iff_mem_primeFactorsList.mp hr
    exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_Iic.mpr (Nat.le_floor (hV r hrl)),
      Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hr⟩
  have terminal_euler_inverse_log_bound : ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop,
      (∏ p ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊x⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, (1 - (1 : ℝ) / p)⁻¹) ≤ C * Real.log x := by
    have hw : ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop, Real.exp (-Real.eulerMascheroniConstant) / Real.log x ≠ 0 := by
      filter_upwards [eventually_gt_atTop (1:ℝ)] with x hx
      exact (div_pos (Real.exp_pos _) (Real.log_pos hx)).ne'
    have ht := (Asymptotics.isEquivalent_iff_tendsto_one hw).mp hEULER
    refine ⟨2 * Real.exp Real.eulerMascheroniConstant, by positivity, ?_⟩
    filter_upwards [ht.eventually (lt_mem_nhds (by norm_num : (1/2:ℝ) < 1)),
      eventually_gt_atTop (1:ℝ)] with x hx hx1
    simp only [Pi.div_apply] at hx
    rw [Finset.prod_inv_distrib]
    have hlog := Real.log_pos hx1
    have hw0 : 0 < Real.exp (-Real.eulerMascheroniConstant) / Real.log x :=
      div_pos (Real.exp_pos _) hlog
    have hu : Real.exp (-Real.eulerMascheroniConstant) / Real.log x / 2 <
        ∏ p ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊x⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, (1 - (1 : ℝ) / p) := by
      have := (lt_div_iff₀ hw0).mp hx
      linarith
    have hu0 : 0 < ∏ p ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊x⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, (1 - (1 : ℝ) / p) := by
      linarith [half_pos hw0]
    have hc0 : 0 < 2 * Real.exp Real.eulerMascheroniConstant * Real.log x := by positivity
    rw [inv_le_comm₀ hu0 hc0]
    have heq : (2 * Real.exp Real.eulerMascheroniConstant * Real.log x)⁻¹ =
        Real.exp (-Real.eulerMascheroniConstant) / Real.log x / 2 := by
      rw [Real.exp_neg]
      field_simp
    rw [heq]
    exact hu.le
  have terminal_smooth_part_facts : ∀ V : ℝ,
      (∀ x : ℕ, 0 < (x.primeFactorsList.filter (fun p : ℕ => decide ((p : ℝ) ≤ V))).prod) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, ∀ q ∈ ((x.primeFactorsList.filter
          (fun p : ℕ => decide ((p : ℝ) ≤ V))).prod).primeFactorsList, (q : ℝ) ≤ V) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors
          ((x.primeFactorsList.filter (fun p : ℕ => decide ((p : ℝ) ≤ V))).prod) =
        (x.primeFactorsList.filter (fun p : ℕ => decide ((p : ℝ) ≤ V))).length) ∧
      (∀ x y : ℕ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
        ((x * y).primeFactorsList.filter (fun p : ℕ => decide ((p : ℝ) ≤ V))).prod =
          (x.primeFactorsList.filter (fun p : ℕ => decide ((p : ℝ) ≤ V))).prod *
            (y.primeFactorsList.filter (fun p : ℕ => decide ((p : ℝ) ≤ V))).prod) ∧
      (∀ (r : ℕ) (f : Fin r → ℕ), (∀ i, 0 < f i) →
        ((∏ i, f i).primeFactorsList.filter (fun p : ℕ => decide ((p : ℝ) ≤ V))).prod =
          ∏ i, ((f i).primeFactorsList.filter (fun p : ℕ => decide ((p : ℝ) ≤ V))).prod) ∧
      (∀ x : ℕ, 0 < x → (∀ p ∈ x.primeFactorsList, (p : ℝ) ≤ V) →
        (x.primeFactorsList.filter (fun p : ℕ => decide ((p : ℝ) ≤ V))).prod = x) ∧
      (∀ (r : ℕ) (f : Fin r → ℕ), (∀ i, 0 < f i) →
        ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors (∏ i, f i) = ∑ i, ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors (f i)) ∧
      (∀ (r : ℕ) (f : Fin r → ℕ), (∀ i, 0 < f i) →

        unfold omegaInterval
        exact_mod_cast hsplit

  have terminal_mass_fibre_bound : ∀ (m n d : ℕ) (I : ℝ)
      (G : Finset ((Fin m → ℕ) × (Fin n → ℕ))),
      (∀ (r N : ℕ) (H : Finset (Fin r → ℕ)), 0 < N → (∀ f ∈ H, ∏ i, f i = N) →

      (∑ σ ∈ G, (1 : ℝ) / ((d : ℝ) * ((∏ a, σ.1 a : ℕ) : ℝ))) ≤

          ∑ a ∈ G.image (fun σ => ∏ a, σ.1 a), (1 : ℝ) / a := by

    have hsub : GN ⊆ (GN.image Prod.fst) ×ˢ (GN.image Prod.snd) := by
      intro σ hσ
      exact Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ hσ, Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ hσ⟩
    have h1 : (GN.image Prod.fst).card ≤ m ^ ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors N := by
      apply hcount m N _ hNpos

      exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hσ).2
    have h2 : (GN.image Prod.snd).card ≤ n ^ ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors (d * N) := by

      intro f hf

        _ = (GN.image Prod.fst).card * (GN.image Prod.snd).card := Finset.card_product _ _
        _ ≤ m ^ ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors N * n ^ ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors (d * N) :=
            Nat.mul_le_mul h1 h2

              n ^ ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors N) := by
            rw [ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors_mul hd.ne' hNpos.ne', pow_add]
        _ ≤ m ^ ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors N * (n ^ ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors d *

        Real.exp (2 * I * Real.log m) := by

            m ^ (2 * ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors N) : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hcardN

informal_problem.statement:
(C0 C1 C2 : ℝ) (hC0 : 0 < C0) (hC1 : 0 < C1) (hC2 : 0 < C2) :
    ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ (Y : ℝ) (k l d : ℕ) (R : ℝ) (v W : ℕ → ℝ),
      1 < Y → 1 ≤ logLog Y → 1 ≤ k → normalityScale (logLog Y) ≤ v k → Antitone v →
      (∀ j < k, v (j + 1) < W j ∧ W j ≤ v j) → 1 ≤ R → 0 < d →
      (C0 * Y * logLog Y ^ 6 / (R * Real.log Y ^ 2 * Real.log (v 1))) *
        (∏ j ∈ Finset.range (k - 1),
          (C1 * logLog Y ^ 6 / Real.log (W (j + 1)) ^ 2) *
            Real.exp ((1 + Real.log ((j + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ)) * ((j + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
              (logLog (v (j + 1)) - logLog (v (j + 2)) +
                Real.sqrt (logLog (normalityScale (logLog Y)) * logLog Y)))) *
        (C2 * ((k + 1 : ℝ) ^ ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors d / d) *
          (Real.log (v k)) ^ (20 * (k + l : ℕ) * Real.log (k + l : ℕ) + 1 : ℝ)) ≤
      (Y / ((d : ℝ) * R)) * (c * logLog Y) ^ (6 * k) * (k + 1 : ℝ) ^ ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors d *

    (hlast : w (Fin.last L) ≤ b)

      (∀ i, i ≤ J ↔ b < w i) ∧
      (∀ i j, i ≤ J → i < j → 10 * h + ε ≤ w i - w j) ∧
      (∀ i, i ≤ J → w i ≤ CollisionBox.rounded ε w i ∧
        (0 < i.val → CollisionBox.rounded ε w i < w i + ε)) ∧

        10 * h ≤ CollisionBox.rounded ε w i - CollisionBox.rounded ε w j) ∧
      b / 2 ≤ CollisionBox.tailCoordinate ε h b w J ∧
      CollisionBox.tailCoordinate ε h b w J ≤ b ∧
      2 * h ≤ CollisionBox.rounded ε w J - CollisionBox.tailCoordinate ε h b w J ∧
      (∀ j, J < j → w j ≤ CollisionBox.tailCoordinate ε h b w J)

    ⟨0, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hhead⟩⟩
  have hJ : b < w J := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hJmem).2
  have hlastJ : ∀ j, J < j → w j ≤ b := by
    intro j hj
    by_contra hc
    push_neg at hc
    have := hJmax j (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hc⟩)
    exact absurd hj (not_lt.mpr this)
  have hJL : J.val < L := by
    by_contra hc
    have hJeq : J = Fin.last L := Fin.ext (by rw [Fin.val_last]; have := J.isLt; omega)
    rw [hJeq] at hJ
    linarith
  have Hh : ∀ i, b < w i → (i.val = 0 ∨ b ≤ x i) :=
    fun i hbw => Or.inr (hbw.le.trans (hwx i))
  have C1 : ∀ i, i ≤ J ↔ b < w i := by
    intro i
    constructor
    · intro hiJ
      rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hiJ with hEq | hlt
      · rw [hEq]; exact hJ
      · have hxi : x J ≤ x i := hx hiJ
        have hwJ := hwx J
        have := G i J (Or.inr (by linarith)) hlt
        linarith
    · intro hbw
      by_contra hc
      have := hlastJ i (not_le.mp hc)
      linarith
  have C2 : ∀ i j, i ≤ J → i < j → 10 * h + ε ≤ w i - w j :=
    fun i j hiJ hij => G i j (Hh i ((C1 i).mp hiJ)) hij
  have C3 : ∀ i, i ≤ J → w i ≤ CollisionBox.rounded ε w i ∧
      (0 < i.val → CollisionBox.rounded ε w i < w i + ε) := by
    intro i hiJ
    have := (C1 i).mp hiJ
    exact R i (by linarith)
  have C4 : ∀ i, i ≤ J → 0 < i.val → CollisionBox.rounded ε w i ≤ θ + ε := by
    intro i hiJ hi
    have h1 := (C3 i hiJ).2 hi
    have h2 := hwx i
    have h3 := hθ i hi
    linarith
  have C5 : ∀ i j, i < j → j ≤ J →
      10 * h ≤ CollisionBox.rounded ε w i - CollisionBox.rounded ε w j := by
    intro i j hij hjJ
    have hiJ := hij.le.trans hjJ
    have h1 := (C3 i hiJ).1
    have h2 := C2 i j hiJ hij
    have hj : 0 < j.val := by
      have : i.val < j.val := hij
      omega
    have h3 := (C3 j hjJ).2 hj
    linarith
  have hrJ := (C3 J le_rfl).1
  have hz : CollisionBox.tailCoordinate ε h b w J =
      min b (CollisionBox.rounded ε w J - 2 * h) := rfl
  refine ⟨J, hJL, C1, C2, C3, C4, C5, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hz]; exact le_min (by linarith) (by linarith)
  · rw [hz]; exact min_le_left _ _
  · rw [hz]
    have := min_le_right b (CollisionBox.rounded ε w J - 2 * h)
    linarith
  · intro j hj
    rw [hz]
    refine le_min (hlastJ j hj) ?_
    have := G J j (Hh J hJ) hj
    linarith

    (hp : ∀ i, (p i).Prime) (hq : ∀ j, (q j).Prime) (hd : d ≠ 0) (he : e ≠ 0)
    (hprod : d * (∏ i, (p i - 1)) = e * (∏ j, (q j - 1)))

signature.statement:
{m n d e : ℕ} (p : Fin m → ℕ) (q : Fin n → ℕ)
    (hp : ∀ i, (p i).Prime) (hq : ∀ j, (q j).Prime) (hd : d ≠ 0) (he : e ≠ 0)
    (hprod : d * (∏ i, (p i - 1)) = e * (∏ j, (q j - 1)))
    {S : ℝ} (hdS : (largestPrimeFactor d : ℝ) ≤ S) (heS : (largestPrimeFactor e : ℝ) ≤ S)
    {u v : ℝ} (hSu : S ≤ u) :
    (∑ i, omegaInterval (p i - 1) u v) = ∑ j, omegaInterval (q j - 1) u v

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have hmul : ∀ a b : ℕ, a ≠ 0 → b ≠ 0 →
      omegaInterval (a * b) u v = omegaInterval a u v + omegaInterval b u v := by
    intro a b ha hb
    unfold omegaInterval
    rw [(Nat.perm_primeFactorsList_mul ha hb).countP_eq, List.countP_append]
  have hprodS : ∀ {ι : Type} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → ℕ), (∀ i ∈ s, f i ≠ 0) →
      omegaInterval (∏ i ∈ s, f i) u v = ∑ i ∈ s, omegaInterval (f i) u v := by
    intro ι s f hf
    induction s using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty =>
      simp [omegaInterval]
    | insert a s ha ih =>
      rw [Finset.prod_insert ha, Finset.sum_insert ha]
      have h1 : f a ≠ 0 := hf a (Finset.mem_insert_self a s)
      have hs : ∀ i ∈ s, f i ≠ 0 := fun i hi => hf i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi)
      have h2 : ∏ i ∈ s, f i ≠ 0 := Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr hs
      rw [hmul _ _ h1 h2, ih hs]
  have hzero : ∀ k : ℕ, (largestPrimeFactor k : ℝ) ≤ u → omegaInterval k u v = 0 := by
    intro k hk
    unfold omegaInterval
    rw [List.countP_eq_zero]
    intro r hr
    have hr' : r ∈ k.primeFactors := Nat.mem_primeFactors_iff_mem_primeFactorsList.mpr hr
    have h1 : r ≤ k.primeFactors.sup id := Finset.le_sup (f := id) hr'
    have h2 : r ≤ largestPrimeFactor k := by
      unfold largestPrimeFactor
      exact le_trans h1 (le_max_right _ _)
    have h3 : (r : ℝ) ≤ u := le_trans (by exact_mod_cast h2) hk
    simp only [decide_eq_true_eq, not_and, not_le]
    intro h
    exact absurd h (not_lt.mpr h3)
  have hpne : ∀ i, p i - 1 ≠ 0 := fun i => Nat.sub_ne_zero_of_lt (hp i).one_lt
  have hqne : ∀ j, q j - 1 ≠ 0 := fun j => Nat.sub_ne_zero_of_lt (hq j).one_lt
  have hP : ∏ i, (p i - 1) ≠ 0 := Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr (fun i _ => hpne i)
  have hQ : ∏ j, (q j - 1) ≠ 0 := Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr (fun j _ => hqne j)
  have hc := congrArg (fun t => omegaInterval t u v) hprod
  simp only at hc
  rw [hmul _ _ hd hP, hmul _ _ he hQ, hzero d (hdS.trans hSu), hzero e (heS.trans hSu),
    hprodS _ _ (fun i _ => hpne i), hprodS _ _ (fun j _ => hqne j)] at hc
  simpa using hc

informal_problem.statement:
{L K : ℕ} {Y b h ε : ℝ} {p : Fin (L + 1) → ℕ} {q : Fin K → ℕ}
    (hY : Real.exp 1 < Y) (hT1 : 1 < logLog Y)
    (hp : ∀ i, SNormal (normalityScale (logLog Y)) (p i)) (hp17 : ∀ i, 17 ≤ p i)
    (hpY : ∀ i, ((p i - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ Y)
    (hq : ∀ j, SNormal (normalityScale (logLog Y)) (q j))
    (hqsort : StrictAnti (fun j => largestPrimeFactor (q j - 1)))
    (hqlarge : ∀ j, normalityScale (logLog Y) < (largestPrimeFactor (q j - 1) : ℝ))
    (hqY : ∀ j, ((q j - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ Y)
    (hbal : ∀ u v : ℝ, normalityScale (logLog Y) ≤ u → u < v →
      (∑ i, omegaInterval (p i - 1) u v) = ∑ j, omegaInterval (q j - 1) u v)
    (hε : 0 < ε) (hh : 0 < h)
    (hbudget : (4 * (L : ℝ) + 4) * normalityDelta (logLog Y) + ε ≤ h)
    (htm : 4 * h ≤ b)
    (hnorm : Real.log (logLog Y) ^ 10 ≤ b * logLog Y / 2)
    (idx : Fin (L + 1))
    (hbefore : ∀ j, j ≤ idx → CollisionBox.shiftedCoordinate (logLog Y) (p idx) ≤
      CollisionBox.shiftedCoordinate (logLog Y) (p j))
    (hafter : ∀ j, idx ≤ j → CollisionBox.shiftedCoordinate (logLog Y) (p j) ≤
      CollisionBox.shiftedCoordinate (logLog Y) (p idx))
    (hhigh : b < CollisionBox.shiftedCoordinate (logLog Y) (p idx)) :
    ∃ j : Fin K, j.val = idx.val ∧
      |CollisionBox.shiftedCoordinate (logLog Y) (p idx) -
        CollisionBox.shiftedCoordinate (logLog Y) (q j)| ≤
          (2 * idx.val + 1 : ℝ) * normalityDelta (logLog Y)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have logLog_mono : ∀ {x y : ℝ}, 1 < x → x ≤ y → logLog x ≤ logLog y := fun hx hxy =>
    Real.log_le_log (Real.log_pos hx) (Real.log_le_log (by linarith) hxy)
  have logLog_strict : ∀ {x y : ℝ}, 1 < x → x < y → logLog x < logLog y := fun hx hxy =>
    Real.log_lt_log (Real.log_pos hx) (Real.log_lt_log (by linarith) hxy)
  have lpf_le : ∀ {n : ℕ}, 0 < n → largestPrimeFactor n ≤ n := by
    intro n hn
    apply max_le hn
    apply Finset.sup_le
    intro r hr
    exact Nat.le_of_dvd hn (Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactors hr)
  have lpf_one_lt : ∀ {n : ℕ}, 1 < n → 1 < largestPrimeFactor n := by
    intro n hn
    have hprime := Nat.minFac_prime (show n ≠ 1 by omega)
    have hmem : n.minFac ∈ n.primeFactors :=
      Nat.mem_primeFactors.mpr ⟨hprime, Nat.minFac_dvd n, by omega⟩
    have h2 := hprime.two_le
    have hle : n.minFac ≤ n.primeFactors.sup id := Finset.le_sup (f := id) hmem
    show 1 < max 1 (n.primeFactors.sup id)
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le (show 1 < n.minFac by omega) (le_trans hle (le_max_right 1 _))
  have mem_le_lpf : ∀ {n z : ℕ}, z ∈ n.primeFactorsList → z ≤ largestPrimeFactor n := by
    intro n z hz
    have hmem : z ∈ n.primeFactors := Nat.mem_primeFactors_iff_mem_primeFactorsList.mpr hz
    exact le_trans (Finset.le_sup (f := id) hmem) (le_max_right 1 _)
  have omega_zero : ∀ (n : ℕ) {u v : ℝ}, (largestPrimeFactor n : ℝ) ≤ u →
      omegaInterval n u v = 0 := by
    intro n u v hn
    unfold omegaInterval
    rw [List.countP_eq_zero]
    intro z hz
    have hle : (z : ℝ) ≤ largestPrimeFactor n := by exact_mod_cast mem_le_lpf hz
    simp only [decide_eq_true_eq]
    rintro ⟨h1, -⟩
    linarith
  have omega_trunc : ∀ (n : ℕ) (u : ℝ) {v : ℝ}, (n : ℝ) ≤ v →
      omegaInterval n u v = omegaInterval n u n := by
    intro n u v hn
    unfold omegaInterval
    apply List.countP_congr
    intro z hz
    simp only [decide_eq_true_eq]
    have hzn : (z : ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast Nat.le_of_mem_primeFactorsList hz
    exact ⟨fun h => ⟨h.1, hzn⟩, fun h => ⟨h.1, h.2.trans hn⟩⟩
  
  have hT0 : 0 < logLog Y := by linarith
  have hPT_all : ∀ x : ℝ, 1 < x → x ≤ Y → logLog x ≤ logLog Y := fun x hx hxY =>
    logLog_mono hx hxY
  generalize hTY : logLog Y = T at *
  have hlogT : 0 ≤ Real.log T := Real.log_nonneg hT1.le
  have hSe : Real.exp 1 ≤ normalityScale T := by
    unfold normalityScale
    exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (Real.one_le_exp (by positivity))
  have hS1 : (1 : ℝ) < normalityScale T :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le (Real.one_lt_exp_iff.mpr (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1)) hSe
  have hLS : logLog (normalityScale T) = Real.log T ^ 10 := by
    simp only [logLog, normalityScale, Real.log_exp]
  have hLS0 : 0 ≤ logLog (normalityScale T) := by rw [hLS]; positivity
  have hδ0 : 0 ≤ normalityDelta T :=
    div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (pow_nonneg hlogT 5)) (Real.sqrt_nonneg T)
  have hEδ : Real.sqrt (logLog (normalityScale T) * T) ≤ normalityDelta T * T := by
    have hsqrt : 0 < Real.sqrt T := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hT0
    have hnn : 0 ≤ Real.log T ^ 5 * Real.sqrt T := mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg hlogT 5) hsqrt.le
    have heq : normalityDelta T * T = 2 * (Real.log T ^ 5 * Real.sqrt T) := by
      unfold normalityDelta
      apply (mul_right_cancel₀ hsqrt.ne')
      rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hsqrt.ne']
      nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt hT0.le]
    have hex : Real.sqrt (logLog (normalityScale T) * T) = Real.log T ^ 5 * Real.sqrt T := by
      rw [hLS, show Real.log T ^ 10 = (Real.log T ^ 5) ^ 2 by ring, Real.sqrt_mul (sq_nonneg _),
        Real.sqrt_sq (pow_nonneg hlogT 5)]
    rw [hex, heq]
    linarith
  generalize hSdef : normalityScale T = S at *
  obtain ⟨E, hEdef⟩ : ∃ E, Real.sqrt (logLog S * T) = E := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [hEdef] at hEδ
  have hE0 : 0 ≤ E := by rw [← hEdef]; exact Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  generalize hδdef : normalityDelta T = δ at *
  
  have interval_bounds : ∀ {r : ℕ}, SNormal S r → ∀ {u v : ℝ}, S ≤ u → u < v → logLog v ≤ T →
      v ≤ ((r - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) →
      logLog v - logLog u - E ≤ (omegaInterval (r - 1) u v : ℝ) ∧
        (omegaInterval (r - 1) u v : ℝ) ≤ logLog v - logLog u + E := by
    intro r hr u v hSu huv hvT hvr
    have hnormal := hr.2.2 u v hSu huv hvr
    have herror : Real.sqrt (logLog S * logLog v) ≤ E := by
      rw [← hEdef]
      exact Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hvT hLS0)
    have habs : |(omegaInterval (r - 1) u v : ℝ) - (logLog v - logLog u)| ≤ E :=
      hnormal.le.trans herror
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := abs_le.mp habs
    constructor <;> linarith
  have interval_upper : ∀ {r : ℕ}, SNormal S r → ∀ {u v : ℝ}, S ≤ u → u < v → logLog v ≤ T →
      (omegaInterval (r - 1) u v : ℝ) ≤ logLog v - logLog u + E := by
    intro r hr u v hSu huv hvT
    have huone : 1 < u := hS1.trans_le hSu
    have hloguv : logLog u ≤ logLog v := logLog_mono huone huv.le
    by_cases hru : ((r - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ u
    · have hzero : omegaInterval (r - 1) u v = 0 := by
        unfold omegaInterval
        rw [List.countP_eq_zero]
        intro z hz
        have hzr : (z : ℝ) ≤ ((r - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
          exact_mod_cast Nat.le_of_mem_primeFactorsList hz
        simp only [decide_eq_true_eq]
        rintro ⟨h1, -⟩
        linarith
      rw [hzero, Nat.cast_zero]
      linarith
    · have hur : u < ((r - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := lt_of_not_ge hru
      by_cases hvr : v ≤ ((r - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)
      · exact (interval_bounds hr hSu huv hvT hvr).2
      · have hrv : ((r - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ v := le_of_not_ge hvr
        have hlogrv : logLog ((r - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ logLog v := logLog_mono (huone.trans hur) hrv
        rw [omega_trunc (r - 1) u hrv]
        have := (interval_bounds hr hSu hur (hlogrv.trans hvT) le_rfl).2
        linarith
  
  have sum_lower : ∀ {m : ℕ} (a : Fin m → ℕ), (∀ k, SNormal S (a k)) → ∀ i : Fin m,
      (∀ k, k ≤ i → largestPrimeFactor (a i - 1) ≤ largestPrimeFactor (a k - 1)) →
      ∀ {u v : ℝ}, v ≤ (largestPrimeFactor (a i - 1) : ℝ) → S ≤ u → u < v → logLog v ≤ T →
      ((i.val : ℝ) + 1) * (logLog v - logLog u - E) ≤
        ∑ k, (omegaInterval (a k - 1) u v : ℝ) := by
    intro m a ha i hrank u v hcut hSu huv hvT
    have hpoint : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Iic i,
        logLog v - logLog u - E ≤ (omegaInterval (a k - 1) u v : ℝ) := by
      intro k hk
      have hPk : (largestPrimeFactor (a i - 1) : ℝ) ≤ largestPrimeFactor (a k - 1) := by
        exact_mod_cast hrank k (Finset.mem_Iic.mp hk)
      have hpos : 0 < a k - 1 := by have := (ha k).1.one_lt; omega
      have hPb : (largestPrimeFactor (a k - 1) : ℝ) ≤ ((a k - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
        exact_mod_cast lpf_le hpos
      exact (interval_bounds (ha k) hSu huv hvT (hcut.trans (hPk.trans hPb))).1
    calc ((i.val : ℝ) + 1) * (logLog v - logLog u - E)
        = ∑ _k ∈ Finset.Iic i, (logLog v - logLog u - E) := by
          rw [Finset.sum_const, Fin.card_Iic, nsmul_eq_mul]; push_cast; ring
      _ ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.Iic i, (omegaInterval (a k - 1) u v : ℝ) := Finset.sum_le_sum hpoint
      _ ≤ ∑ k, (omegaInterval (a k - 1) u v : ℝ) :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.subset_univ _)
            (fun k _ _ => Nat.cast_nonneg _)
  have sum_upper_tail : ∀ {m : ℕ} (a : Fin m → ℕ), (∀ k, SNormal S (a k)) → ∀ i : Fin m,
      (∀ k, i ≤ k → largestPrimeFactor (a k - 1) ≤ largestPrimeFactor (a i - 1)) →
      ∀ {u v : ℝ}, (largestPrimeFactor (a i - 1) : ℝ) ≤ u → S ≤ u → u < v → logLog v ≤ T →
      ∑ k, (omegaInterval (a k - 1) u v : ℝ) ≤ (i.val : ℝ) * (logLog v - logLog u + E) := by
    intro m a ha i hrank u v hcut hSu huv hvT
    have hrestrict : (∑ k ∈ Finset.Iio i, (omegaInterval (a k - 1) u v : ℝ)) =
        ∑ k, (omegaInterval (a k - 1) u v : ℝ) := by
      apply Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ _)
      intro k _ hk
      have hik : i ≤ k := not_lt.mp (by simpa only [Finset.mem_Iio] using hk)
      have hle1 : (largestPrimeFactor (a k - 1) : ℝ) ≤ (largestPrimeFactor (a i - 1) : ℝ) := by
        exact_mod_cast hrank k hik
      rw [omega_zero (a k - 1) (hle1.trans hcut), Nat.cast_zero]
    rw [← hrestrict]
    calc (∑ k ∈ Finset.Iio i, (omegaInterval (a k - 1) u v : ℝ))
        ≤ ∑ _k ∈ Finset.Iio i, (logLog v - logLog u + E) :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum fun k _ => interval_upper (ha k) hSu huv hvT
      _ = (i.val : ℝ) * (logLog v - logLog u + E) := by
          rw [Finset.sum_const, Fin.card_Iio, nsmul_eq_mul]
  have sum_upper : ∀ {n : ℕ} (c : Fin n → ℕ), (∀ k, SNormal S (c k)) →
      ∀ {u v : ℝ}, S ≤ u → u < v → logLog v ≤ T →
      ∑ k, (omegaInterval (c k - 1) u v : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) * (logLog v - logLog u + E) := by
    intro n c hc u v hSu huv hvT
    calc ∑ k, (omegaInterval (c k - 1) u v : ℝ) ≤ ∑ _k : Fin n, (logLog v - logLog u + E) :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum fun k _ => interval_upper (hc k) hSu huv hvT
      _ = (n : ℝ) * (logLog v - logLog u + E) := by
          rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
  
  have one_sided : ∀ {m n : ℕ} (a : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ), (∀ k, SNormal S (a k)) →
      (∀ k, SNormal S (c k)) → ∀ (i : Fin m) (j : Fin n), i.val = j.val →
      (∀ k, i ≤ k → largestPrimeFactor (a k - 1) ≤ largestPrimeFactor (a i - 1)) →
      (∀ k, k ≤ j → largestPrimeFactor (c j - 1) ≤ largestPrimeFactor (c k - 1)) →
      S ≤ (largestPrimeFactor (a i - 1) : ℝ) → S ≤ (largestPrimeFactor (c j - 1) : ℝ) →
      logLog (largestPrimeFactor (c j - 1) : ℝ) ≤ T →
      (∀ u v : ℝ, S ≤ u → u < v →
        (∑ k, omegaInterval (a k - 1) u v) = ∑ k, omegaInterval (c k - 1) u v) →
      logLog (largestPrimeFactor (c j - 1) : ℝ) - logLog (largestPrimeFactor (a i - 1) : ℝ) ≤
        (2 * (i.val : ℝ) + 1) * E := by
    intro m n a c ha hc i j hij hrA hrC hPi hQj hQT hbalance
    by_cases hQP : (largestPrimeFactor (c j - 1) : ℝ) ≤ largestPrimeFactor (a i - 1)
    · have hlogs := logLog_mono (hS1.trans_le hQj) hQP
      have herr : 0 ≤ (2 * (i.val : ℝ) + 1) * E := mul_nonneg (by positivity) hE0
      linarith
    · have hPQ := lt_of_not_ge hQP
      have hupper := sum_upper_tail a ha i hrA le_rfl hPi hPQ hQT
      have hlower := sum_lower c hc j hrC le_rfl hPi hPQ hQT
      have hmass : (∑ k, (omegaInterval (a k - 1) (largestPrimeFactor (a i - 1) : ℝ)
            (largestPrimeFactor (c j - 1) : ℝ) : ℝ)) =
          ∑ k, (omegaInterval (c k - 1) (largestPrimeFactor (a i - 1) : ℝ)
            (largestPrimeFactor (c j - 1) : ℝ) : ℝ) := by
        exact_mod_cast hbalance _ _ hPi hPQ
      rw [hmass] at hupper
      have hij' : (j.val : ℝ) = (i.val : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hij.symm
      rw [hij'] at hlower
      nlinarith
  
  have hP1 : ∀ r, (1 : ℝ) < (largestPrimeFactor (p r - 1) : ℝ) := by
    intro r
    exact_mod_cast lpf_one_lt (show 1 < p r - 1 by have := hp17 r; omega)
  have hPY : ∀ r, (largestPrimeFactor (p r - 1) : ℝ) ≤ Y := by
    intro r
    have h1 : (largestPrimeFactor (p r - 1) : ℝ) ≤ ((p r - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast lpf_le (show 0 < p r - 1 by have := hp17 r; omega)
    exact h1.trans (hpY r)
  have hQY : ∀ k, (largestPrimeFactor (q k - 1) : ℝ) ≤ Y := by
    intro k
    have h1 : (largestPrimeFactor (q k - 1) : ℝ) ≤ ((q k - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast lpf_le (show 0 < q k - 1 by have := (hq k).1.one_lt; omega)
    exact h1.trans (hqY k)
  have hPT : logLog (largestPrimeFactor (p idx - 1) : ℝ) ≤ T := hPT_all _ (hP1 idx) (hPY idx)
  have hQT : ∀ k, logLog (largestPrimeFactor (q k - 1) : ℝ) ≤ T := fun k =>
    hPT_all _ (hS1.trans (hqlarge k)) (hQY k)
  
  have rank_of_shift : ∀ {a c : ℕ}, 17 ≤ c →
      CollisionBox.shiftedCoordinate T a ≤ CollisionBox.shiftedCoordinate T c →
      largestPrimeFactor (a - 1) ≤ largestPrimeFactor (c - 1) := by
    intro a c hc hsh
    by_contra hn
    have hlt : (largestPrimeFactor (c - 1) : ℝ) < largestPrimeFactor (a - 1) := by
      exact_mod_cast lt_of_not_ge hn
    have h1 : (1 : ℝ) < largestPrimeFactor (c - 1) := by
      exact_mod_cast lpf_one_lt (show 1 < c - 1 by omega)
    have hLL := logLog_strict h1 hlt
    unfold CollisionBox.shiftedCoordinate at hsh
    have := (div_lt_div_iff_of_pos_right hT0).mpr hLL
    linarith
  have hrankBefore : ∀ k, k ≤ idx →
      largestPrimeFactor (p idx - 1) ≤ largestPrimeFactor (p k - 1) :=
    fun k hk => rank_of_shift (hp17 k) (hbefore k hk)
  have hrankAfter : ∀ k, idx ≤ k →
      largestPrimeFactor (p k - 1) ≤ largestPrimeFactor (p idx - 1) :=
    fun k hk => rank_of_shift (hp17 idx) (hafter k hk)
  
  have hile : (idx.val : ℝ) ≤ L := by exact_mod_cast (show idx.val ≤ L by omega)
  have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hile hδ0
  have hcoef : (2 * (idx.val : ℝ) + 1) * δ ≤ h / 2 := by nlinarith
  have hbound : (2 * (idx.val : ℝ) + 1) * E ≤ h * T / 2 := by
    calc (2 * (idx.val : ℝ) + 1) * E ≤ (2 * (idx.val : ℝ) + 1) * (δ * T) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hEδ (by positivity)
      _ = ((2 * (idx.val : ℝ) + 1) * δ) * T := by ring
      _ ≤ (h / 2) * T := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcoef hT0.le
      _ = h * T / 2 := by ring
  have hnormal : logLog S ≤ b * T / 2 := by rw [hLS]; exact hnorm
  have hhighT : b * T < logLog (largestPrimeFactor (p idx - 1) : ℝ) := by
    have hh' := hhigh
    unfold CollisionBox.shiftedCoordinate at hh'
    exact (lt_div_iff₀ hT0).mp hh'
  have htailT := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right htm hT0.le
  have hhT : 0 < h * T := mul_pos hh hT0
  have hgap : (2 * (idx.val : ℝ) + 1) * E <
      logLog (largestPrimeFactor (p idx - 1) : ℝ) - logLog S := by
    nlinarith
  have hPS : S < (largestPrimeFactor (p idx - 1) : ℝ) := by
    by_contra hn
    have hLL := logLog_mono (hP1 idx) (le_of_not_gt hn)
    have hnn : 0 ≤ (2 * (idx.val : ℝ) + 1) * E := mul_nonneg (by positivity) hE0
    linarith
  
  have hexists : idx.val < K := by
    by_contra hn
    have hnle : (K : ℝ) ≤ idx.val := by exact_mod_cast Nat.le_of_not_gt hn
    have hC : 0 ≤ logLog (largestPrimeFactor (p idx - 1) : ℝ) - logLog S + E := by
      have := logLog_mono hS1 hPS.le
      linarith
    have hlower := sum_lower p hp idx hrankBefore le_rfl le_rfl hPS hPT
    have hupper := (sum_upper q hq le_rfl hPS hPT).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hnle hC)
    have hmass : (∑ k, (omegaInterval (p k - 1) S (largestPrimeFactor (p idx - 1) : ℝ) : ℝ)) =
        ∑ k, (omegaInterval (q k - 1) S (largestPrimeFactor (p idx - 1) : ℝ) : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast hbal _ _ le_rfl hPS
    rw [hmass] at hlower
    nlinarith
  
  let j : Fin K := ⟨idx.val, hexists⟩
  have hqAfter : ∀ k, j ≤ k → largestPrimeFactor (q k - 1) ≤ largestPrimeFactor (q j - 1) :=
    fun k hk => hqsort.antitone hk
  have hqBefore : ∀ k, k ≤ j → largestPrimeFactor (q j - 1) ≤ largestPrimeFactor (q k - 1) :=
    fun k hk => hqsort.antitone hk
  have hleft := one_sided p q hp hq idx j rfl hrankAfter hqBefore hPS.le (hqlarge j).le
    (hQT j) hbal
  have hright : logLog (largestPrimeFactor (p idx - 1) : ℝ) -
      logLog (largestPrimeFactor (q j - 1) : ℝ) ≤ (2 * (idx.val : ℝ) + 1) * E :=
    one_sided q p hq hp j idx rfl hqAfter hrankBefore (hqlarge j).le hPS.le hPT
      (fun u v hu huv => (hbal u v hu huv).symm)
  refine ⟨j, rfl, ?_⟩
  have habs : |logLog (largestPrimeFactor (p idx - 1) : ℝ) -
      logLog (largestPrimeFactor (q j - 1) : ℝ)| ≤ (2 * (idx.val : ℝ) + 1) * E :=
    abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, hright⟩
  have hscale := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hEδ
    (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * (idx.val : ℝ) + 1 by positivity)
  show |logLog (largestPrimeFactor (p idx - 1) : ℝ) / T -
    logLog (largestPrimeFactor (q j - 1) : ℝ) / T| ≤ (2 * (idx.val : ℝ) + 1) * δ
  rw [← sub_div, abs_div, abs_of_pos hT0, div_le_iff₀ hT0]
  nlinarith

informal_problem.statement:
{L K s : ℕ} {Y b ε zstar : ℝ} {p : Fin (L + 1) → ℕ} {q : Fin K → ℕ}
    (J : Fin (L + 1)) (hJL : J.val < L)
    (hY : Real.exp 1 < Y) (hT1 : 1 < logLog Y)
    (hp : ∀ i, SNormal (normalityScale (logLog Y)) (p i)) (hp17 : ∀ i, 17 ≤ p i)
    (hq : ∀ j, SNormal (normalityScale (logLog Y)) (q j))
    (hqsort : StrictAnti (fun j => largestPrimeFactor (q j - 1)))
    (hs : 0 < s) (hsS : (largestPrimeFactor s : ℝ) ≤ normalityScale (logLog Y))
    (hbal : ∀ u v : ℝ, normalityScale (logLog Y) ≤ u → u < v →
      (∑ i, omegaInterval (p i - 1) u v) = ∑ j, omegaInterval (q j - 1) u v)
    (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hfirst : b + ε + (6 * (L : ℝ) + 5) * normalityDelta (logLog Y) < 1)
    (hnorm : Real.log (logLog Y) ^ 10 ≤ b * logLog Y / 2)
    (hzlo : b / 2 ≤ zstar) (hzhi : zstar ≤ b)
    (htailw : ∀ r : Fin (L + 1), J < r →
      CollisionBox.shiftedCoordinate (logLog Y) (p r) ≤ zstar) :
    (∀ i : Fin (L + 1), J < i → ∀ z ∈ (p i - 1).primeFactorsList, (z : ℝ) ≤
        CollisionBox.cutoff Y (zstar + (2 * (L : ℝ) + 3) * normalityDelta (logLog Y))) ∧
    (∀ j : Fin K, J.val + 1 ≤ j.val → (largestPrimeFactor (q j - 1) : ℝ) <
        CollisionBox.cutoff Y (zstar + (2 * (L : ℝ) + 3) * normalityDelta (logLog Y))) ∧
    (∀ z ∈ (s * ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun j : Fin K => J.val + 1 ≤ j.val),
        (q j - 1)).primeFactorsList,
        (z : ℝ) ≤ CollisionBox.cutoff Y (zstar + (2 * (L : ℝ) + 3) * normalityDelta (logLog Y)))
