proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  set T := logLog Y with hTdef
  set δ := normalityDelta T with hδdef
  set S := normalityScale T with hSdef
  set u := CollisionBox.cutoff Y zstar with hudef
  set v := CollisionBox.cutoff Y (zstar + (2 * (L : ℝ) + 3) * δ) with hvdef
  
  have hT0 : 0 < T := by linarith
  have hlogT : 0 < Real.log T := Real.log_pos hT1
  have hsqrtT : 0 < Real.sqrt T := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hT0
  have hδ : 0 < δ := by
    rw [hδdef, normalityDelta]; positivity
  have hY0 : 0 < Y := lt_trans (Real.exp_pos 1) hY
  have hlogY : 1 < Real.log Y := (Real.lt_log_iff_exp_lt hY0).mpr hY
  have hTY : Real.log (Real.log Y) = T := rfl
  
  have hLLcut : ∀ a : ℝ, Real.log (Real.log (CollisionBox.cutoff Y a)) = a * T := by
    intro a
    rw [CollisionBox.cutoff, Real.log_exp, Real.log_rpow (by linarith), hTY]
  have hcutle : ∀ a x : ℝ, 1 < x → Real.log (Real.log x) ≤ a * T →
      x ≤ CollisionBox.cutoff Y a := by
    intro a x hx1 hx
    have hx0 : 0 < x := by linarith
    have hlx : 0 < Real.log x := Real.log_pos hx1
    have hpos : 0 < Real.log (CollisionBox.cutoff Y a) := by
      rw [CollisionBox.cutoff, Real.log_exp]; exact Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by linarith) _
    rw [← hLLcut a] at hx
    have h1 := (Real.log_le_log_iff hlx hpos).mp hx
    exact (Real.log_le_log_iff hx0 (Real.exp_pos _)).mp h1
  have hLLS : Real.log (Real.log S) = Real.log T ^ 10 := by
    rw [hSdef, normalityScale, Real.log_exp, Real.log_exp]
  have hLLS0 : 0 ≤ Real.log (Real.log S) := by rw [hLLS]; positivity
  have hS1 : 1 < S := by
    rw [hSdef, normalityScale]; exact Real.one_lt_exp_iff.mpr (Real.exp_pos _)
  have hSu : S ≤ u := by
    rw [hSdef, hudef, normalityScale, CollisionBox.cutoff, Real.rpow_def_of_pos (by linarith), hTY]
    apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
    apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hzlo hT0.le
    linarith
  have huv : u < v := by
    rw [hudef, hvdef]
    apply Real.exp_lt_exp.mpr
    apply Real.rpow_lt_rpow_of_exponent_lt hlogY
    have : 0 < (2 * (L : ℝ) + 3) * δ := by positivity
    linarith
  have hu1 : 1 < u := lt_of_lt_of_le hS1 hSu
  have hLLu : Real.log (Real.log u) = zstar * T := by rw [hudef]; exact hLLcut zstar
  have hLLv : Real.log (Real.log v) = (zstar + (2 * (L : ℝ) + 3) * δ) * T := by
    rw [hvdef]; exact hLLcut _
  have hLLuv : Real.log (Real.log u) < Real.log (Real.log v) := by
    rw [hLLu, hLLv]
    have : 0 < (2 * (L : ℝ) + 3) * δ * T := by positivity
    nlinarith
  have hLLvT : Real.log (Real.log v) ≤ T := by
    rw [hLLv]
    have hL0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ L := Nat.cast_nonneg L
    have h1 : (2 * (L : ℝ) + 3) * δ ≤ (6 * (L : ℝ) + 5) * δ :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) hδ.le
    have h2 : zstar + (2 * (L : ℝ) + 3) * δ ≤ 1 := by linarith
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h2 hT0.le
    linarith
  
  have hδT : δ * T / 2 = Real.log T ^ 5 * Real.sqrt T := by
    have hs : Real.sqrt T * Real.sqrt T = T := Real.mul_self_sqrt hT0.le
    have hne : Real.sqrt T ≠ 0 := hsqrtT.ne'
    calc δ * T / 2 = 2 * Real.log T ^ 5 / Real.sqrt T * (Real.sqrt T * Real.sqrt T) / 2 := by
          rw [hs, hδdef, normalityDelta]
      _ = Real.log T ^ 5 * Real.sqrt T := by field_simp
  have hEgen : ∀ x : ℝ, x ≤ T → Real.sqrt (Real.log (Real.log S) * x) ≤ δ * T / 2 := by
    intro x hx
    rw [hδT, hLLS]
    have hpos : 0 ≤ Real.log T ^ 5 * Real.sqrt T := by positivity
    rw [show Real.log T ^ 5 * Real.sqrt T = Real.sqrt ((Real.log T ^ 5 * Real.sqrt T) ^ 2) from
      (Real.sqrt_sq hpos).symm]
    apply Real.sqrt_le_sqrt
    rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hT0.le]
    have h10 : 0 ≤ Real.log T ^ 10 := by positivity
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx h10
    nlinarith
  have hE : Real.sqrt (Real.log (Real.log S) * Real.log (Real.log v)) ≤ δ * T / 2 :=
    hEgen _ hLLvT
  
  have hlpf_mem : ∀ z m : ℕ, z ∈ m.primeFactorsList → z ≤ largestPrimeFactor m := by
    intro z m hz
    have hz' : z ∈ m.primeFactors := Nat.mem_primeFactors_iff_mem_primeFactorsList.mpr hz
    exact le_trans (Finset.le_sup (f := id) hz') (le_max_right _ _)
  have hlpf_dvd : ∀ z m : ℕ, z.Prime → z ∣ m → m ≠ 0 → z ≤ largestPrimeFactor m := by
    intro z m hz hd hm
    have hz' : z ∈ m.primeFactors := Nat.mem_primeFactors.mpr ⟨hz, hd, hm⟩
    exact le_trans (Finset.le_sup (f := id) hz') (le_max_right _ _)
  have hlpf_le : ∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → largestPrimeFactor m ≤ m := by
    intro m hm
    unfold largestPrimeFactor
    apply max_le hm
    apply Finset.sup_le
    intro z hz
    exact Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) (Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactors hz)
  have hlpf_two : ∀ m : ℕ, 2 ≤ m → 2 ≤ largestPrimeFactor m := by
    intro m hm
    have hp' := Nat.minFac_prime (show m ≠ 1 by omega)
    exact le_trans hp'.two_le (hlpf_dvd _ _ hp' (Nat.minFac_dvd m) (by omega))
  
  have hupper : ∀ r : ℕ, SNormal S r → (omegaInterval (r - 1) u v : ℝ) ≤
      (Real.log (Real.log v) - Real.log (Real.log u)) +
        Real.sqrt (Real.log (Real.log S) * Real.log (Real.log v)) := by
    intro r hr
    rcases le_or_gt ((r - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) u with hA | hA
    · have h0 : omegaInterval (r - 1) u v = 0 := by
        unfold omegaInterval
        rw [List.countP_eq_zero]
        intro z hz h
        have hzle : z ≤ r - 1 := Nat.le_of_mem_primeFactorsList hz
        have hzu : (z : ℝ) ≤ u := le_trans (by exact_mod_cast hzle) hA
        simp only [decide_eq_true_eq] at h
        linarith [h.1]
      rw [h0]
      have := Real.sqrt_nonneg (Real.log (Real.log S) * Real.log (Real.log v))
      push_cast
      linarith
    · rcases le_or_gt v ((r - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) with hB | hB
      · have := hr.2.2 u v hSu huv hB
        rw [abs_sub_lt_iff] at this
        linarith [this.1]
      · have heq : omegaInterval (r - 1) u v = omegaInterval (r - 1) u ((r - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
          unfold omegaInterval
          apply List.countP_congr
          intro z hz
          have hzle : (z : ℝ) ≤ ((r - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
            exact_mod_cast Nat.le_of_mem_primeFactorsList hz
          simp only [decide_eq_true_eq]
          constructor
          · rintro ⟨h1, _⟩; exact ⟨h1, hzle⟩
          · rintro ⟨h1, _⟩; exact ⟨h1, by linarith⟩
        have := hr.2.2 u ((r - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) hSu hA le_rfl
        rw [abs_sub_lt_iff] at this
        have hn1 : 1 < ((r - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by linarith
        have hLLn : Real.log (Real.log ((r - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≤ Real.log (Real.log v) :=
          Real.log_le_log (Real.log_pos hn1) (Real.log_le_log (by linarith) hB.le)
        have hsq : Real.sqrt (Real.log (Real.log S) * Real.log (Real.log ((r - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))) ≤
            Real.sqrt (Real.log (Real.log S) * Real.log (Real.log v)) :=
          Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hLLn hLLS0)
        rw [heq]
        linarith [this.1]
  have hlower : ∀ r : ℕ, SNormal S r → v ≤ (largestPrimeFactor (r - 1) : ℝ) →
      (Real.log (Real.log v) - Real.log (Real.log u)) -
        Real.sqrt (Real.log (Real.log S) * Real.log (Real.log v)) ≤
          (omegaInterval (r - 1) u v : ℝ) := by
    intro r hr hv
    have hr2 := hr.1.two_le
    have hle : (largestPrimeFactor (r - 1) : ℝ) ≤ ((r - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast hlpf_le (r - 1) (by omega)
    have := hr.2.2 u v hSu huv (le_trans hv hle)
    rw [abs_sub_lt_iff] at this
    linarith [this.2]
  
  have htailu : ∀ r : Fin (L + 1), J < r → ∀ z ∈ (p r - 1).primeFactorsList, (z : ℝ) ≤ u := by
    intro r hr z hz
    have h17 := hp17 r
    have hP2 : 1 < largestPrimeFactor (p r - 1) := hlpf_two _ (by omega)
    have hP1 : (1 : ℝ) < (largestPrimeFactor (p r - 1) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hP2
    have hw := htailw r hr
    unfold CollisionBox.shiftedCoordinate at hw
    rw [div_le_iff₀ hT0] at hw
    have hPu : (largestPrimeFactor (p r - 1) : ℝ) ≤ u := hcutle zstar _ hP1 hw
    have hzP : (z : ℝ) ≤ (largestPrimeFactor (p r - 1) : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast hlpf_mem _ _ hz
    linarith
  have hzero : ∀ i : Fin (L + 1), J < i → omegaInterval (p i - 1) u v = 0 := by
    intro i hi
    unfold omegaInterval
    rw [List.countP_eq_zero]
    intro z hz h
    have := htailu i hi z hz
    simp only [decide_eq_true_eq] at h
    linarith [h.1]
  
  have hO3 : ∀ j : Fin K, J.val + 1 ≤ j.val → (largestPrimeFactor (q j - 1) : ℝ) < v := by
    intro j hj
    have hJK : J.val + 1 < K := lt_of_le_of_lt hj j.isLt
    have hmain : (largestPrimeFactor (q ⟨J.val + 1, hJK⟩ - 1) : ℝ) < v := by
      by_contra hcon
      push_neg at hcon
      have hsum := hbal u v hSu huv
      have hsumR : (∑ i, (omegaInterval (p i - 1) u v : ℝ)) =
          ∑ j, (omegaInterval (q j - 1) u v : ℝ) := by
        exact_mod_cast hsum
      have hAc : (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin (L + 1) => i.val ≤ J.val)).card = J.val + 1 := by
        have : Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin (L + 1) => i.val ≤ J.val) = Finset.Iic J := by
          ext i
          simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_Iic, Fin.le_def]
        rw [this, Fin.card_Iic]
      have hBc : (Finset.univ.filter (fun j : Fin K => j.val ≤ J.val + 1)).card = J.val + 2 := by
        have : Finset.univ.filter (fun j : Fin K => j.val ≤ J.val + 1) =

    have hle : (⟨J.val + 1, hJK⟩ : Fin K) ≤ j := Fin.le_def.mpr hj
    have hanti := hqsort.antitone hle
    have : (largestPrimeFactor (q j - 1) : ℝ) ≤ (largestPrimeFactor (q ⟨J.val + 1, hJK⟩ - 1) : ℝ) := by

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  set δ := normalityDelta (logLog Y) with hδdef
  
  have hsel_val : ∀ i, (CollisionCutoff.selectedIndex J C i).val = (CollisionClass.index C i).val :=
    fun i => rfl
  have hsel_le : ∀ i, CollisionCutoff.selectedIndex J C i ≤ J := by
    intro i
    rw [Fin.le_def, hsel_val]
    have := (CollisionClass.index C i).isLt
    omega
  have hsel_mono : ∀ i j, i < j →
      CollisionCutoff.selectedIndex J C i < CollisionCutoff.selectedIndex J C j := by
    intro i j hij
    rw [Fin.lt_def, hsel_val, hsel_val]
    exact Fin.lt_def.mp (hmono hij)
  have hz1 : ∀ i : Fin (CollisionClass.remaining C).card, 0 < i.val →
      CollisionCutoff.selectedZeta J C ε w i ≤ θ + ε := by
    intro i hi
    exact hint _ (hsel_le i) (by rw [hsel_val]; have := hge i; omega)
  have hz2 : ∀ i j : Fin (CollisionClass.remaining C).card, i < j →
      CollisionCutoff.selectedZeta J C ε w j + 10 * h ≤ CollisionCutoff.selectedZeta J C ε w i := by
    intro i j hij
    have := hsep _ _ (hsel_mono i j hij) (hsel_le j)
    unfold CollisionCutoff.selectedZeta
    linarith
  have hz3 : ∀ i : Fin (CollisionClass.remaining C).card,
      zstar + 2 * h ≤ CollisionCutoff.selectedZeta J C ε w i := by
    intro i
    unfold CollisionCutoff.selectedZeta
    rcases lt_or_eq_of_le (hsel_le i) with hlt | heq
    · have := hsep _ _ hlt le_rfl
      linarith
    · rw [heq]
      linarith
  
  have nuprof : ∀ (k : ℕ) (z : Fin k → ℝ), 1 ≤ k →
      (∀ i : Fin k, 0 < i.val → z i ≤ θ + ε) →
      (∀ i j : Fin k, i < j → z j + 10 * h ≤ z i) →
      (∀ i : Fin k, zstar + 2 * h ≤ z i) →
      Antitone (CollisionCutoff.nu L δ z zstar) ∧
      CollisionCutoff.nu L δ z zstar 0 = 1 ∧
      (∀ n, n < k → CollisionCutoff.nu L δ z zstar (n + 1) < CollisionCutoff.mu L δ ε z zstar n ∧
         CollisionCutoff.mu L δ ε z zstar n ≤ CollisionCutoff.nu L δ z zstar n) ∧
      (∀ n, 2 ≤ n → n ≤ k →
        δ ≤ CollisionCutoff.nu L δ z zstar (n - 1) - CollisionCutoff.nu L δ z zstar n) ∧
      CollisionCutoff.nu L δ z zstar k = zstar + (2 * (L : ℝ) + 3) * δ ∧
      CollisionCutoff.nu L δ z zstar 1 + Real.log (10 * logLog Y) / logLog Y ≤ 1 := by
    intro k z hk hz1 hz2 hz3
    have hL : (0 : ℝ) ≤ L := Nat.cast_nonneg L
    have hLδ : 0 ≤ (L : ℝ) * δ := mul_nonneg hL hδ
    have E0 : CollisionCutoff.nu L δ z zstar 0 = 1 := by
      unfold CollisionCutoff.nu
      simp
    have Ei : ∀ n (hn : 0 < n) (hnk : n < k),
        CollisionCutoff.nu L δ z zstar n = z ⟨n, hnk⟩ + (2 * (L : ℝ) + 1) * δ := by
      intro n hn hnk
      unfold CollisionCutoff.nu
      rw [if_neg (by omega), dif_pos hnk]
    have Et : ∀ n, k ≤ n → CollisionCutoff.nu L δ z zstar n = zstar + (2 * (L : ℝ) + 3) * δ := by
      intro n hn
      unfold CollisionCutoff.nu
      rw [if_neg (by omega), dif_neg (by omega)]
    have SG : ∀ n, n < k → (4 * (L : ℝ) + 2) * δ + ε <
        CollisionCutoff.nu L δ z zstar n - CollisionCutoff.nu L δ z zstar (n + 1) := by
      intro n hn
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with h0 | hpos
      · subst h0
        rw [E0]
        by_cases hk1 : 1 < k
        · rw [Ei 1 one_pos hk1]
          have := hz1 ⟨1, hk1⟩ one_pos
          linarith
        · rw [Et 1 (by omega)]
          linarith
      · by_cases hn1 : n + 1 < k
        · rw [Ei n hpos hn, Ei (n + 1) (by omega) hn1]
          have := hz2 ⟨n, hn⟩ ⟨n + 1, hn1⟩ (by rw [Fin.lt_def]; simp)
          linarith
        · rw [Ei n hpos hn, Et (n + 1) (by omega)]
          have := hz3 ⟨n, hn⟩
          linarith
    refine ⟨?_, E0, ?_, ?_, Et k le_rfl, ?_⟩
    · apply antitone_nat_of_succ_le
      intro n
      by_cases hn : n < k
      · have := SG n hn
        linarith
      · rw [Et n (by omega), Et (n + 1) (by omega)]
    · intro n hn
      have := SG n hn
      unfold CollisionCutoff.mu
      constructor <;> linarith
    · intro n h2 hnk
      have := SG (n - 1) (by omega)
      rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel (by omega : 1 ≤ n)] at this
      linarith
    · by_cases hk1 : 1 < k
      · rw [Ei 1 one_pos hk1]
        have := hz1 ⟨1, hk1⟩ one_pos
        linarith
      · rw [Et 1 (by omega)]
        linarith
  
  have hY0 : 0 < Y := lt_trans (Real.exp_pos 1) hY
  have hlogY : 1 < Real.log Y := by
    have := Real.log_lt_log (Real.exp_pos 1) hY
    rwa [Real.log_exp] at this
  have hlogY0 : 0 < Real.log Y := by linarith
  have hexpT : Real.exp (logLog Y) = Real.log Y := by
    unfold logLog
    exact Real.exp_log hlogY0
  have hcut1 : CollisionBox.cutoff Y 1 = Y := by
    unfold CollisionBox.cutoff
    rw [Real.rpow_one, Real.exp_log hY0]
  have hcutsm : StrictMono (CollisionBox.cutoff Y) := by
    intro a a' haa
    unfold CollisionBox.cutoff
    exact Real.exp_lt_exp.mpr (Real.rpow_lt_rpow_of_exponent_lt hlogY haa)
  have hcutll : ∀ a, logLog (CollisionBox.cutoff Y a) = a * logLog Y := by
    intro a
    unfold CollisionBox.cutoff logLog
    rw [Real.log_exp, Real.log_rpow hlogY0]
  have hcutee : ∀ a, CollisionBox.cutoff Y a = Real.exp (Real.exp (logLog Y * a)) := by
    intro a
    unfold CollisionBox.cutoff logLog
    rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos hlogY0]
  
  obtain ⟨hanti, hν0, hil, hgap, hνk, hν1⟩ :=
    nuprof _ (CollisionCutoff.selectedZeta J C ε w) hk hz1 hz2 hz3
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro a c hac
    exact hcutsm.monotone (hanti hac)
  · unfold CollisionCutoff.upper
    rw [hν0, hcut1]
  · intro n hn
    exact ⟨hcutsm (hil n hn).1, hcutsm.monotone (hil n hn).2⟩
  · intro n h2 hnk
    unfold CollisionCutoff.upper
    rw [hcutll, hcutll, mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ hT.ne', mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ hT.ne']
    exact hgap n h2 hnk
  · unfold CollisionCutoff.upper
    rw [hνk, hcutee]
    unfold normalityScale
    apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
    apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
    have hexp : logLog Y * (zstar + (2 * (L : ℝ) + 3) * δ) =
        zstar * logLog Y + (2 * (L : ℝ) + 3) * δ * logLog Y := by ring
    rw [hexp]
    have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hzlo hT.le
    have h2 := mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * (L : ℝ) + 3) hδ) hT.le
    linarith
  · unfold CollisionCutoff.upper
    rw [hcutee, Real.rpow_def_of_pos hY0]
    apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hν1 hT.le
    have hr : logLog Y * (Real.log (10 * logLog Y) / logLog Y) = Real.log (10 * logLog Y) := by
      field_simp
    have hle : logLog Y * CollisionCutoff.nu L δ (CollisionCutoff.selectedZeta J C ε w) zstar 1 ≤
        logLog Y - Real.log (10 * logLog Y) := by
      rw [mul_add, hr, mul_one] at hmul
      linarith
    calc Real.exp (logLog Y * CollisionCutoff.nu L δ (CollisionCutoff.selectedZeta J C ε w) zstar 1)
        ≤ Real.exp (logLog Y - Real.log (10 * logLog Y)) := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hle
      _ = Real.log Y * (1 / (10 * logLog Y)) := by
        rw [Real.exp_sub, Real.exp_log (by linarith), hexpT]
        field_simp

{L K : ℕ} {Y ε e₀ zstar : ℝ} {p : Fin (L + 1) → ℕ} {q : Fin K → ℕ}
    (J : Fin (L + 1)) (ha : J.val + 1 ≤ K) (C : Finset (Fin (J.val + 1)))
    (hY : Real.exp 1 < Y) (hT : 0 < logLog Y)
    (hge : ∀ i, i.val ≤ (CollisionClass.index C i).val)
    (hfirst : ∀ i, i.val = 0 → (CollisionClass.index C i).val = 0)
    (hp17 : ∀ i, 17 ≤ p i)
    (hqS : ∀ j, 1 < (largestPrimeFactor (q j - 1) : ℝ))
    (hqY : ∀ j, ((q j - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ Y)
    (hround : ∀ i : Fin (L + 1), i ≤ J →
      CollisionBox.shiftedCoordinate (logLog Y) (p i) ≤
        CollisionBox.rounded ε (fun r => CollisionBox.shiftedCoordinate (logLog Y) (p r)) i ∧
      (0 < i.val →
        CollisionBox.rounded ε (fun r => CollisionBox.shiftedCoordinate (logLog Y) (p r)) i <
          CollisionBox.shiftedCoordinate (logLog Y) (p i) + ε))
    (hw0 : CollisionBox.shiftedCoordinate (logLog Y) (p 0) ≤ 1)
    (hw0' : 1 - e₀ ≤ CollisionBox.shiftedCoordinate (logLog Y) (p 0))
    (he₀ : e₀ ≤ normalityDelta (logLog Y))
    (hδ : 0 ≤ normalityDelta (logLog Y)) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hmatch : ∀ i : Fin (J.val + 1),
      |CollisionBox.shiftedCoordinate (logLog Y) (p (CollisionMatching.prefixIndex J i)) -
        CollisionBox.shiftedCoordinate (logLog Y) (q (Fin.castLE ha i))| ≤
          (2 * i.val + 1 : ℝ) * normalityDelta (logLog Y)) :
    let w := fun r => CollisionBox.shiftedCoordinate (logLog Y) (p r)
    let z := CollisionCutoff.selectedZeta J C ε w
    let v := CollisionCutoff.upper Y L (normalityDelta (logLog Y)) z zstar
    let W := CollisionCutoff.lower Y L (normalityDelta (logLog Y)) ε z zstar
    ∀ idx : Fin (CollisionClass.remaining C).card,
      (W idx.val ≤ (largestPrimeFactor (p (CollisionCutoff.selectedIndex J C idx) - 1) : ℝ) ∧
        (largestPrimeFactor (p (CollisionCutoff.selectedIndex J C idx) - 1) : ℝ) ≤ v idx.val) ∧
      (W idx.val ≤ (largestPrimeFactor (q (Fin.castLE ha (CollisionClass.index C idx)) - 1) : ℝ) ∧
        (largestPrimeFactor (q (Fin.castLE ha (CollisionClass.index C idx)) - 1) : ℝ) ≤ v idx.val)

by
  intro w z v W idx
  have hY0 : 0 < Y := (Real.exp_pos 1).trans hY

  have hl0 : 0 < Real.log Y := by linarith
  have hcut : ∀ a : ℝ, CollisionBox.cutoff Y a = Real.exp (Real.exp (logLog Y * a)) := by
    intro a
    unfold CollisionBox.cutoff
    rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos hl0 a]
    rfl

    intro x y
    rw [Real.exp_le_exp, Real.exp_le_exp]
  have hcmp : ∀ (a : ℝ) (r : ℕ), 1 < (r : ℝ) →
      (CollisionBox.cutoff Y a ≤ (r : ℝ) ↔ a ≤ logLog (r : ℝ) / logLog Y) ∧
      ((r : ℝ) ≤ CollisionBox.cutoff Y a ↔ logLog (r : ℝ) / logLog Y ≤ a) := by
    intro a r hr
    have hr0 : (0 : ℝ) < r := by linarith
    have hlr : 0 < Real.log r := Real.log_pos hr
    have e1 : (r : ℝ) = Real.exp (Real.exp (logLog (r : ℝ))) := by
      unfold logLog
      rw [Real.exp_log hlr, Real.exp_log hr0]
    rw [hcut a]
    constructor
    · rw [le_div_iff₀ hT, mul_comm a (logLog Y), ← hmono (logLog Y * a) (logLog (r : ℝ)), ← e1]
    · rw [div_le_iff₀ hT, mul_comm a (logLog Y), ← hmono (logLog (r : ℝ)) (logLog Y * a), ← e1]
  have hcut1 : CollisionBox.cutoff Y 1 = Y := by
    unfold CollisionBox.cutoff
    rw [Real.rpow_one, Real.exp_log hY0]
  have hP1 : ∀ m : ℕ, 17 ≤ m → 1 < (largestPrimeFactor (m - 1) : ℝ) := by
    intro m hm

    have hn0 : m - 1 ≠ 0 := by omega

    intro n h

    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with hn | hn

      simp [largestPrimeFactor] at h'
    · have : largestPrimeFactor n ≤ n := by
        unfold largestPrimeFactor
        exact max_le hn (Finset.sup_le fun r hr => Nat.le_of_mem_primeFactors hr)

  have hqle : ∀ j, CollisionBox.shiftedCoordinate (logLog Y) (q j) ≤ 1 := by
    intro j

      (2 * ((CollisionClass.index C idx).val : ℝ) + 1) * normalityDelta (logLog Y) :=
    hmatch (CollisionClass.index C idx)

  have hwin : CollisionCutoff.mu L (normalityDelta (logLog Y)) ε z zstar idx.val ≤

        CollisionCutoff.nu L (normalityDelta (logLog Y)) z zstar idx.val ∧
      CollisionCutoff.mu L (normalityDelta (logLog Y)) ε z zstar idx.val ≤
        CollisionBox.shiftedCoordinate (logLog Y) (q (Fin.castLE ha (CollisionClass.index C idx))) ∧

      exact ⟨by linarith, hw0, by linarith, hq1⟩
    · have hc := hge idx
      have hs0 : 0 < (CollisionCutoff.selectedIndex J C idx).val := by rw [hsc]; omega
      have hsJ : CollisionCutoff.selectedIndex J C idx ≤ J := by
        rw [Fin.le_def, hsc]; omega
      obtain ⟨hlo, hhi⟩ := hround _ hsJ
      have hhi' := hhi hs0
      have hN : CollisionCutoff.nu L (normalityDelta (logLog Y)) z zstar idx.val =
          CollisionBox.rounded ε (fun r => CollisionBox.shiftedCoordinate (logLog Y) (p r))

              (2 * (L : ℝ) + 1) * normalityDelta (logLog Y) := by
        unfold CollisionCutoff.nu
        rw [if_neg (by omega), dif_pos idx.isLt]
        rfl
      rw [hN]

      obtain ⟨hA, hB⟩ := abs_le.mp (hm.trans hcoef)

  have hps := hP1 _ (hp17 (CollisionCutoff.selectedIndex J C idx))

proof.tactics:
by
  have h0mem : (0 : Fin (a + 1)) ∈ CollisionClass.remaining C := by
    unfold CollisionClass.remaining
    exact Finset.mem_sdiff.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hzero 0 rfl⟩
  have hmono : StrictMono (CollisionClass.index C) := by
    intro i j hij
    unfold CollisionClass.index
    exact ((CollisionClass.remaining C).orderIsoOfFin rfl).strictMono hij
  refine ⟨Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨0, h0mem⟩, hmono, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have key : ∀ n (hn : n < (CollisionClass.remaining C).card),
        n ≤ (CollisionClass.index C ⟨n, hn⟩).val := by
      intro n
      induction n with
      | zero => intro _; exact Nat.zero_le _
      | succ n ih =>
        intro hn
        have h1 := ih (by omega)
        have h2 : CollisionClass.index C ⟨n, by omega⟩ < CollisionClass.index C ⟨n + 1, hn⟩ :=
          hmono (Fin.mk_lt_mk.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_self n))
        rw [Fin.lt_def] at h2
        omega
    intro i
    exact key i.val i.isLt
  · intro i hi
    obtain ⟨i', hi'⟩ :=
      ((CollisionClass.remaining C).orderIsoOfFin rfl).surjective ⟨0, h0mem⟩
    have hidx : (CollisionClass.index C i').val = 0 := by
      unfold CollisionClass.index
      rw [hi']
      rfl
    by_contra hne
    have hlt : CollisionClass.index C i' < CollisionClass.index C i := by
      rw [Fin.lt_def]
      omega
    have h3 := hmono.lt_iff_lt.mp hlt
    rw [Fin.lt_def] at h3
    omega

{m n : ℕ}
    (cut : ℝ → (Fin m → ℕ) × (Fin n → ℕ) → (Fin m → ℕ) × (Fin n → ℕ))
    (hcut : ∀ (u : ℝ) (s : (Fin m → ℕ) × (Fin n → ℕ)), cut u s =
      (fun a => ((s.1 a).primeFactorsList.filter (fun p : ℕ => decide ((p : ℝ) ≤ u))).prod,
       fun b => ((s.2 b).primeFactorsList.filter (fun p : ℕ => decide ((p : ℝ) ≤ u))).prod))
    (F : Finset ((Fin m → ℕ) × (Fin n → ℕ))) (d : ℕ) (u : ℝ)
    (hd : 0 < d) (hdu : ∀ p ∈ d.primeFactorsList, (p : ℝ) ≤ u)
    (hF : ∀ s ∈ F, ((∀ a : Fin m, 0 < s.1 a) ∧ (∀ b : Fin n, 0 < s.2 b)) ∧
      d * (∏ a, s.1 a) = (∏ b, s.2 b) ∧
      (∀ a : Fin m, a.val ≠ 0 → ∀ r ∈ (s.1 a).primeFactorsList, (r : ℝ) ≤ u) ∧
      (∀ b : Fin n, b.val ≠ 0 → ∀ r ∈ (s.2 b).primeFactorsList, (r : ℝ) ≤ u))
    (σ : (Fin m → ℕ) × (Fin n → ℕ)) :
    Set.InjOn (fun s : (Fin m → ℕ) × (Fin n → ℕ) =>
        ((∏ a, s.1 a).primeFactorsList.filter (fun p : ℕ => decide (u < (p : ℝ)))).prod)
      ↑(F.filter (fun s => cut u s = σ)) ∧
    ∀ s ∈ F.filter (fun s => cut u s = σ),
      (∏ a, s.1 a) = (∏ a, σ.1 a) *
        ((∏ a, s.1 a).primeFactorsList.filter (fun p : ℕ => decide (u < (p : ℝ)))).prod ∧
      (∀ a : Fin m, a.val = 0 →
        s.1 a = σ.1 a *
          ((∏ a', s.1 a').primeFactorsList.filter (fun p : ℕ => decide (u < (p : ℝ)))).prod ∧
        ((s.1 a).primeFactorsList.filter (fun p : ℕ => decide (u < (p : ℝ)))).prod =
          ((∏ a', s.1 a').primeFactorsList.filter (fun p : ℕ => decide (u < (p : ℝ)))).prod) ∧
      (∀ b : Fin n, b.val = 0 →
        s.2 b = σ.2 b *
          ((∏ a', s.1 a').primeFactorsList.filter (fun p : ℕ => decide (u < (p : ℝ)))).prod)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hsr : ∀ x : ℕ, x ≠ 0 →
      (x.primeFactorsList.filter (fun p : ℕ => decide ((p : ℝ) ≤ u))).prod *
        (x.primeFactorsList.filter (fun p : ℕ => decide (u < (p : ℝ)))).prod = x := by
    intro x hx
    have h1 := List.filter_append_perm (fun p : ℕ => decide ((p : ℝ) ≤ u)) x.primeFactorsList
    have h2 : x.primeFactorsList.filter (fun p : ℕ => !decide ((p : ℝ) ≤ u)) =
        x.primeFactorsList.filter (fun p : ℕ => decide (u < (p : ℝ))) := by
      apply List.filter_congr
      intro p _
      by_cases h : (p : ℝ) ≤ u
      · simp [h, not_lt.mpr h]
      · simp [h, lt_of_not_ge h]
    rw [h2] at h1
    rw [← List.prod_append, h1.prod_eq, Nat.prod_primeFactorsList hx]
  
  have hrm : ∀ x y : ℕ, x ≠ 0 → y ≠ 0 →
      ((x * y).primeFactorsList.filter (fun p : ℕ => decide (u < (p : ℝ)))).prod =
        (x.primeFactorsList.filter (fun p : ℕ => decide (u < (p : ℝ)))).prod *
          (y.primeFactorsList.filter (fun p : ℕ => decide (u < (p : ℝ)))).prod := by
    intro x y hx hy
    rw [((Nat.perm_primeFactorsList_mul hx hy).filter _).prod_eq, List.filter_append,
      List.prod_append]
  
  have hrp : ∀ (k : ℕ) (f : Fin k → ℕ) (S : Finset (Fin k)), (∀ i, f i ≠ 0) →
      ((∏ i ∈ S, f i).primeFactorsList.filter (fun p : ℕ => decide (u < (p : ℝ)))).prod =
        ∏ i ∈ S, ((f i).primeFactorsList.filter (fun p : ℕ => decide (u < (p : ℝ)))).prod := by
    intro k f S hf
    refine Finset.induction_on S (by simp) ?_
    intro j S hj ih
    rw [Finset.prod_insert hj, Finset.prod_insert hj,
      hrm _ _ (hf j) (Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr (fun i _ => hf i)), ih]
  
  have hsm : ∀ x : ℕ, x ≠ 0 → (∀ r ∈ x.primeFactorsList, (r : ℝ) ≤ u) →
      (x.primeFactorsList.filter (fun p : ℕ => decide ((p : ℝ) ≤ u))).prod = x ∧
        (x.primeFactorsList.filter (fun p : ℕ => decide (u < (p : ℝ)))).prod = 1 := by
    intro x hx hxu
    constructor
    · rw [List.filter_eq_self.mpr (fun r hr => by simpa using hxu r hr),
        Nat.prod_primeFactorsList hx]
    · rw [List.filter_eq_nil_iff.mpr (fun r hr => by simpa using hxu r hr), List.prod_nil]
  
  have hcoord : ∀ s ∈ F.filter (fun s => cut u s = σ),
      (∀ a, σ.1 a = ((s.1 a).primeFactorsList.filter (fun p : ℕ => decide ((p : ℝ) ≤ u))).prod) ∧
      (∀ b, σ.2 b = ((s.2 b).primeFactorsList.filter (fun p : ℕ => decide ((p : ℝ) ≤ u))).prod) := by
    intro s hs
    rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hs
    rw [← hs.2, hcut]
    exact ⟨fun a => rfl, fun b => rfl⟩
  have hfib : ∀ s ∈ F.filter (fun s => cut u s = σ),
      (∏ a, s.1 a) = (∏ a, σ.1 a) *
        ((∏ a, s.1 a).primeFactorsList.filter (fun p : ℕ => decide (u < (p : ℝ)))).prod ∧
      (∀ a : Fin m, a.val = 0 →
        s.1 a = σ.1 a *
          ((∏ a', s.1 a').primeFactorsList.filter (fun p : ℕ => decide (u < (p : ℝ)))).prod ∧
        ((s.1 a).primeFactorsList.filter (fun p : ℕ => decide (u < (p : ℝ)))).prod =
          ((∏ a', s.1 a').primeFactorsList.filter (fun p : ℕ => decide (u < (p : ℝ)))).prod) ∧
      (∀ b : Fin n, b.val = 0 →
        s.2 b = σ.2 b *
          ((∏ a', s.1 a').primeFactorsList.filter (fun p : ℕ => decide (u < (p : ℝ)))).prod) := by
    intro s hs
    obtain ⟨hσ1, hσ2⟩ := hcoord s hs
    obtain ⟨⟨hp1, hp2⟩, hbal, hs1, hs2⟩ := hF s (Finset.mem_filter.mp hs).1
    have hA := hrp m s.1 Finset.univ (fun a => (hp1 a).ne')
    have hro1 : ∀ a : Fin m, a.val = 0 →
        ((s.1 a).primeFactorsList.filter (fun p : ℕ => decide (u < (p : ℝ)))).prod =
          ((∏ a', s.1 a').primeFactorsList.filter (fun p : ℕ => decide (u < (p : ℝ)))).prod := by
      intro a ha
      rw [hA, Finset.prod_eq_single a]
      · intro a' _ hne
        exact (hsm _ (hp1 a').ne' (hs1 a' (fun h => hne (Fin.ext (h.trans ha.symm))))).2
      · intro h; exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ a) h
    have hro2 : ∀ b : Fin n, b.val = 0 →
        ((s.2 b).primeFactorsList.filter (fun p : ℕ => decide (u < (p : ℝ)))).prod =
          ((∏ a', s.1 a').primeFactorsList.filter (fun p : ℕ => decide (u < (p : ℝ)))).prod := by
      intro b hb
      have e1 : ((s.2 b).primeFactorsList.filter (fun p : ℕ => decide (u < (p : ℝ)))).prod =
          ∏ b', ((s.2 b').primeFactorsList.filter (fun p : ℕ => decide (u < (p : ℝ)))).prod := by
        rw [Finset.prod_eq_single b]
        · intro b' _ hne
          exact (hsm _ (hp2 b').ne' (hs2 b' (fun h => hne (Fin.ext (h.trans hb.symm))))).2
        · intro h; exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ b) h
      rw [e1, ← hrp n s.2 Finset.univ (fun b => (hp2 b).ne'), ← hbal,
        hrm _ _ hd.ne' (Finset.prod_pos (fun a _ => hp1 a)).ne', (hsm d hd.ne' hdu).2, one_mul]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hA, ← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
      refine Finset.prod_congr rfl (fun a _ => ?_)
      rw [hσ1 a, hsr _ (hp1 a).ne']
    · intro a ha
      refine ⟨?_, hro1 a ha⟩
      rw [← hro1 a ha, hσ1 a, hsr _ (hp1 a).ne']
    · intro b hb
      rw [← hro2 b hb, hσ2 b, hsr _ (hp2 b).ne']
  refine ⟨?_, hfib⟩
  intro s hs t ht hst
  have hs' := Finset.mem_coe.mp hs
  have ht' := Finset.mem_coe.mp ht
  dsimp only at hst
  obtain ⟨hs1σ, hs2σ⟩ := hcoord s hs'
  obtain ⟨ht1σ, ht2σ⟩ := hcoord t ht'
  obtain ⟨⟨hsp1, hsp2⟩, -, hsm1, hsm2⟩ := hF s (Finset.mem_filter.mp hs').1
  obtain ⟨⟨htp1, htp2⟩, -, htm1, htm2⟩ := hF t (Finset.mem_filter.mp ht').1
  obtain ⟨-, hsA, hsB⟩ := hfib s hs'
  obtain ⟨-, htA, htB⟩ := hfib t ht'
  refine Prod.ext (funext fun a => ?_) (funext fun b => ?_)
  · by_cases ha : a.val = 0
    · rw [(hsA a ha).1, (htA a ha).1, hst]
    · exact ((hsm _ (hsp1 a).ne' (hsm1 a ha)).1.symm.trans (hs1σ a).symm).trans
        ((ht1σ a).trans (hsm _ (htp1 a).ne' (htm1 a ha)).1)

      exact (Nat.cast_le.mpr this).trans haY
    refine ⟨hz1, by rw [hPz]; exact hpp, by rw [hPz]; exact Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactors hp,
      ?_, hzYle⟩
    rw [hPz, hLdef, div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
    nlinarith
  have key : ∀ a b : ℕ, 0 < a → a < b →
      (∀ z ∈ Z, (a * z + 1).Prime ∧ (b * z + 1).Prime ∧ ((b * z : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ Y) →
      (Z.card : ℝ) ≤ K * logLog Y ^ 3 * X / L ^ 3 *
        ∑ c ∈ Z.image (fun z => z / largestPrimeFactor z), (1 : ℝ) / c := by
    intro a b ha hab hZab
    rw [Finset.card_eq_sum_card_image (fun z => z / largestPrimeFactor z) Z]
    push_cast
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro c hc
    obtain ⟨t₀, ht₀, hct₀⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hc
    set G := Z.filter (fun z => z / largestPrimeFactor z = c) with hGdef
    have hGmem : ∀ z ∈ G, z ∈ Z ∧ z / largestPrimeFactor z = c :=
      fun z hz => Finset.mem_filter.mp hz
    have hcz : ∀ z ∈ G, c * largestPrimeFactor z = z := by
      intro z hz
      obtain ⟨hzZ, hzc⟩ := hGmem z hz
      rw [← hzc]
      exact Nat.div_mul_cancel (hfact z hzZ).2.2.1
    have hinj : Set.InjOn largestPrimeFactor (G : Set ℕ) := by
      intro z hz w hw h
      rw [← hcz z hz, ← hcz w hw, h]
    rw [← Finset.card_image_of_injOn hinj]
    have hc0 : 0 < c := by
      rw [← hct₀]
      have := hfact t₀ ht₀
      exact Nat.div_pos (Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) this.2.2.1) this.2.1.pos
    have hcR : (0 : ℝ) < c := by exact_mod_cast hc0
    have hct : c ≤ t₀ := by rw [← hct₀]; exact Nat.div_le_self _ _
    have hbc : ((b * c : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ Y :=
      (Nat.cast_le.mpr (Nat.mul_le_mul_left b hct)).trans (hZab t₀ ht₀).2.2
    have hQ : ∀ q ∈ G.image largestPrimeFactor, q.Prime ∧ (a * c * q + 1).Prime ∧
        (b * c * q + 1).Prime ∧ (q : ℝ) ≤ X / c := by
      intro q hq
      obtain ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hq
      obtain ⟨hzZ, _⟩ := hGmem z hz
      have hczz := hcz z hz
      refine ⟨(hfact z hzZ).2.1, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [mul_assoc, hczz]; exact (hZab z hzZ).1
      · rw [mul_assoc, hczz]; exact (hZab z hzZ).2.1
      · rw [le_div_iff₀ hcR]
        have h1 : ((largestPrimeFactor z * c : ℕ) : ℝ) = z := by rw [mul_comm, hczz]
        push_cast at h1
        rw [h1]
        exact (hZ z hzZ).2.1
    have ht₀G : t₀ ∈ G := Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨ht₀, hct₀⟩
    have hq₀ := hQ _ (Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ ht₀G)
    have hq₀2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ (largestPrimeFactor t₀ : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hq₀.1.two_le
    have hx2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ X / c := hq₀2.trans hq₀.2.2.2
    have hLx : L ≤ Real.log (X / c) := (hfact t₀ ht₀).2.2.2.1.trans
      (Real.log_le_log (by exact_mod_cast hq₀.1.pos) hq₀.2.2.2)
    have h := hthree (a * c) (b * c) (X / c) _ (Nat.mul_pos ha hc0)
      (Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hab hc0) hbc hx2 hQ
    have hnum : 0 ≤ K * logLog Y ^ 3 * (X / c) :=
      mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hK (pow_nonneg hT.le 3)) (div_nonneg hX.le hcR.le)
    calc _ ≤ K * logLog Y ^ 3 * (X / c) / Real.log (X / c) ^ 3 := h
      _ ≤ K * logLog Y ^ 3 * (X / c) / L ^ 3 :=
          div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hnum (by positivity) (pow_le_pow_left₀ hL.le hLx 3)
      _ = _ := by ring
  have hmain : (Z.card : ℝ) ≤ K * logLog Y ^ 3 * X / L ^ 3 *
      ∑ c ∈ Z.image (fun z => z / largestPrimeFactor z), (1 : ℝ) / c := by
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hab with h | h
    · exact key a b ha h (fun z hz => ⟨(hZ z hz).2.2.1, (hZ z hz).2.2.2.1, (hZ z hz).2.2.2.2.2.1⟩)
    · exact key b a hb h (fun z hz => ⟨(hZ z hz).2.2.2.1, (hZ z hz).2.2.1, (hZ z hz).2.2.2.2.1⟩)
  have hsum := hrough (Z.image (fun z => z / largestPrimeFactor z)) (by
    intro c hc
    obtain ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hc
    obtain ⟨ht1, hpp, hdiv, _, htY⟩ := hfact t ht
    refine ⟨Nat.div_pos (Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) hdiv) hpp.pos, ?_⟩
    intro p hp
    have hpt : p ∈ t.primeFactorsList := (Nat.mem_primeFactorsList (by omega)).mpr
      ⟨Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactorsList hp,
        (Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactorsList hp).trans (Nat.div_dvd_of_dvd hdiv)⟩
    exact ⟨(hZ t ht).2.2.2.2.2.2.1 p hpt,
      (Nat.cast_le.mpr (Nat.le_of_mem_primeFactorsList hpt)).trans htY⟩)
  have hcoef : 0 ≤ K * logLog Y ^ 3 * X / L ^ 3 :=
    div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hK (pow_nonneg hT.le 3)) hX.le) (pow_nonneg hL.le 3)
  have hTne : logLog Y ≠ 0 := hT.ne'
  have hlYne : Real.log Y ≠ 0 := hlogY0.ne'
  have hlvne : Real.log v ≠ 0 := hlogv.ne'
  calc (Z.card : ℝ) ≤ _ := hmain
    _ ≤ K * logLog Y ^ 3 * X / L ^ 3 * (Rr * Real.log Y / Real.log v) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsum hcoef
    _ = _ := by rw [hLdef]; field_simp; ring

informal_problem.statement:
(hPNT : Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => (Nat.primeCounting ⌊x⌋₊ : ℝ) / (x / Real.log x)) atTop (𝓝 1))
    (hMERT : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ, 2 ≤ x →
      |(∑ p ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊x⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, (1 : ℝ) / p) - Real.log (Real.log x)| ≤ C)
    (hEULER : Asymptotics.IsEquivalent atTop
      (fun x : ℝ => ∏ p ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊x⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, (1 - (1 : ℝ) / p))
      (fun x => Real.exp (-Real.eulerMascheroniConstant) / Real.log x)) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ᶠ Y : ℝ in atTop, ∀ (b : ℕ) (x : ℝ) (Q : Finset ℕ),
      0 < b → (b : ℝ) ≤ Y → 2 ≤ x →
      (∀ q ∈ Q, q.Prime ∧ (b * q + 1).Prime ∧ (q : ℝ) ≤ x) →
      (Q.card : ℝ) ≤ C * logLog Y * x / Real.log x ^ 2

signature.name: retained_twoForm_prime_count
signature.statement:
(hPNT : Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => (Nat.primeCounting ⌊x⌋₊ : ℝ) / (x / Real.log x)) atTop (𝓝 1))
    (hMERT : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ, 2 ≤ x →

    (hEULER : Asymptotics.IsEquivalent atTop

      (fun x => Real.exp (-Real.eulerMascheroniConstant) / Real.log x)) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ᶠ Y : ℝ in atTop, ∀ (b : ℕ) (x : ℝ) (Q : Finset ℕ),
      0 < b → (b : ℝ) ≤ Y → 2 ≤ x →

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨D, hD, hsize⟩ := inverse_totient_size_bound hPNT hMERT hEULER
  obtain ⟨Y₀, hY₀⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.mp hsize
  have hY1 := hY₀ (max Y₀ 16) (le_max_left _ _)
  obtain ⟨K, hKdef⟩ : ∃ K : ℝ, K = D + |D * max Y₀ 16 * logLog (max Y₀ 16)| + 1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hDK : D ≤ K := by
    have := abs_nonneg (D * max Y₀ 16 * logLog (max Y₀ 16)); linarith
  have hBK : |D * max Y₀ 16 * logLog (max Y₀ 16)| ≤ K := by linarith
  have hK : 0 < K := by linarith
  have hratio : ∀ᶠ Y : ℝ in atTop, ∀ b : ℕ, 0 < b → (b : ℝ) ≤ Y →
      (b : ℝ) / b.totient ≤ K * logLog Y := by
    have hLL : Tendsto logLog atTop atTop :=
      Real.tendsto_log_atTop.comp Real.tendsto_log_atTop
    filter_upwards [hLL.eventually_ge_atTop 1] with Y hY b hb hbY
    have hφ1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ b.totient := by exact_mod_cast Nat.totient_pos.mpr hb
    have hφpos : (0:ℝ) < b.totient := by linarith
    have hφb : (b.totient : ℝ) ≤ b := by exact_mod_cast Nat.totient_le b
    have hφY : (b.totient : ℝ) ≤ Y := hφb.trans hbY
    have hLLnn : 0 ≤ logLog Y := by linarith
    by_cases hcase : max Y₀ 16 ≤ (b.totient : ℝ)
    · have h := hY₀ (b.totient : ℝ) ((le_max_left _ _).trans hcase) b hb le_rfl
      have h16 : (16:ℝ) ≤ b.totient := (le_max_right _ _).trans hcase
      have hlogφ : 0 < Real.log (b.totient : ℝ) := Real.log_pos (by linarith)
      have hll : logLog (b.totient : ℝ) ≤ logLog Y := by
        unfold logLog
        exact Real.log_le_log hlogφ (Real.log_le_log hφpos hφY)
      have h2 : (b:ℝ) ≤ K * logLog Y * b.totient := by
        calc (b:ℝ) ≤ D * b.totient * logLog b.totient := h
          _ ≤ D * b.totient * logLog Y :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hll (mul_nonneg hD.le hφpos.le)
          _ = D * logLog Y * b.totient := by ring
          _ ≤ K * logLog Y * b.totient :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hDK hLLnn) hφpos.le
      rw [div_le_iff₀ hφpos]
      exact h2
    · push_neg at hcase
      have h := hY1 b hb hcase.le
      have hbB : (b:ℝ) ≤ |D * max Y₀ 16 * logLog (max Y₀ 16)| := h.trans (le_abs_self _)
      have hb0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ b := Nat.cast_nonneg b
      have hdiv : (b:ℝ) / b.totient ≤ b := by
        rw [div_le_iff₀ hφpos]
        nlinarith
      calc (b:ℝ) / b.totient ≤ b := hdiv
        _ ≤ |D * max Y₀ 16 * logLog (max Y₀ 16)| := hbB
        _ ≤ K := hBK
        _ ≤ K * logLog Y := le_mul_of_one_le_right hK.le hY
  have h7 := twoForm_sifted_count_of_ingredients selberg_sieve_simple_bound
    selberg_sum_ge_multiplicative_sum coprime_harmonic_lower_bound
    twoForm_density_sum_lower_bound sum_pow_omega_divisors_le twoForm_count_error
  obtain ⟨C₁, hC₁, hcount⟩ := prime_pair_count_of_sifted_bound h7
  refine ⟨C₁ * K, mul_pos hC₁ hK, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hratio] with Y hY
  intro b x Q hb hbY hx hQ
  have hlogx : 0 < Real.log x := Real.log_pos (by linarith)
  have hx0 : 0 ≤ x := by linarith
  have hl2 : 0 < Real.log x ^ 2 := by positivity
  calc (Q.card : ℝ) ≤ C₁ * ((b : ℝ) / b.totient) * x / Real.log x ^ 2 := hcount b x Q hb hx hQ
    _ ≤ C₁ * (K * logLog Y) * x / Real.log x ^ 2 :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hY b hb hbY) hC₁.le) hx0) hl2.le
    _ = C₁ * K * logLog Y * x / Real.log x ^ 2 := by ring

subgoal_signatures.name: inverse_totient_size_bound
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(hPNT : Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => (Nat.primeCounting ⌊x⌋₊ : ℝ) / (x / Real.log x)) atTop (𝓝 1))
    (hMERT : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ, 2 ≤ x →
      |(∑ p ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊x⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, (1 : ℝ) / p) - Real.log (Real.log x)| ≤ C)
    (hEULER : Asymptotics.IsEquivalent atTop
      (fun x : ℝ => ∏ p ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊x⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, (1 - (1 : ℝ) / p))
      (fun x => Real.exp (-Real.eulerMascheroniConstant) / Real.log x)) :
    ∃ D : ℝ, 0 < D ∧ ∀ᶠ Y : ℝ in atTop, ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → (n.totient : ℝ) ≤ Y → (n : ℝ) ≤ D * Y * logLog Y

subgoal_signatures.name: selberg_sieve_simple_bound
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ s : SelbergSieve,
    BoundingSieve.siftedSum (s := s.toBoundingSieve) ≤
      s.totalMass / (∑ l ∈ s.prodPrimes.divisors,
          if (l : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ s.level then s.nu l * ∏ p ∈ l.primeFactors, 1 / (1 - s.nu p) else 0) +
        ∑ d ∈ s.prodPrimes.divisors,
          if (d : ℝ) ≤ s.level then
            (3 : ℝ) ^ ArithmeticFunction.cardDistinctFactors d *
              |BoundingSieve.rem (s := s.toBoundingSieve) d|
          else 0

subgoal_signatures.name: selberg_sum_ge_multiplicative_sum
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (g : ℕ → ℝ) (P : ℕ) (y : ℝ), 1 ≤ y → Squarefree P →
    (∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → (p : ℝ) ≤ y → p ∣ P) →
    (∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → 0 ≤ g p ∧ g p < 1) →
    (∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 ⌊Real.sqrt y⌋₊, ∏ p ∈ m.primeFactors, g p ^ m.factorization p) ≤
      ∑ l ∈ P.divisors, if (l : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ y then ∏ p ∈ l.primeFactors, g p / (1 - g p) else 0

subgoal_signatures.name: coprime_harmonic_lower_bound
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (b M : ℕ), 0 < b →
    (b.totient : ℝ) / b * (∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 M, (k : ℝ)⁻¹) ≤
      ∑ k ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 M).filter (fun k => k.Coprime b), (k : ℝ)⁻¹

subgoal_signatures.name: twoForm_density_sum_lower_bound
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (b M : ℕ), 0 < b →
    (b.totient : ℝ) / b * (∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 M, (k : ℝ)⁻¹) ≤
      ∑ k ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 M).filter (fun k => k.Coprime b), (k : ℝ)⁻¹ →
    (b.totient : ℝ) / b * (∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 M, (k : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ 2 ≤
      ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (M ^ 2),
        ∏ p ∈ m.primeFactors, ((if p ∣ b then 1 else 2 : ℝ) / p) ^ m.factorization p

subgoal_signatures.name: sum_pow_omega_divisors_le
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (P k : ℕ) (x : ℝ), 1 ≤ x → Squarefree P →
    (∑ d ∈ P.divisors, if (d : ℝ) ≤ x then (k : ℝ) ^ ArithmeticFunction.cardDistinctFactors d else 0) ≤
      x * (1 + Real.log x) ^ k

subgoal_signatures.name: twoForm_count_error
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (b N d : ℕ), Squarefree d →
    |(((Finset.range N).filter (fun n => d ∣ n * (b * n + 1))).card : ℝ) -
        (∏ p ∈ d.primeFactors, (if p ∣ b then 1 else 2 : ℝ) / p) * N| ≤
      (2 : ℝ) ^ ArithmeticFunction.cardDistinctFactors d

subgoal_signatures.name: twoForm_sifted_count_of_ingredients
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(∀ s : SelbergSieve,
      BoundingSieve.siftedSum (s := s.toBoundingSieve) ≤
        s.totalMass / (∑ l ∈ s.prodPrimes.divisors,
            if (l : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ s.level then s.nu l * ∏ p ∈ l.primeFactors, 1 / (1 - s.nu p) else 0) +
          ∑ d ∈ s.prodPrimes.divisors,
            if (d : ℝ) ≤ s.level then
              (3 : ℝ) ^ ArithmeticFunction.cardDistinctFactors d *
                |BoundingSieve.rem (s := s.toBoundingSieve) d|
            else 0) →
    (∀ (g : ℕ → ℝ) (P : ℕ) (y : ℝ), 1 ≤ y → Squarefree P →
      (∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → (p : ℝ) ≤ y → p ∣ P) →
      (∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → 0 ≤ g p ∧ g p < 1) →
      (∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 ⌊Real.sqrt y⌋₊, ∏ p ∈ m.primeFactors, g p ^ m.factorization p) ≤
        ∑ l ∈ P.divisors, if (l : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ y then ∏ p ∈ l.primeFactors, g p / (1 - g p) else 0) →
    (∀ (b M : ℕ), 0 < b →
      (b.totient : ℝ) / b * (∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 M, (k : ℝ)⁻¹) ≤
        ∑ k ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 M).filter (fun k => k.Coprime b), (k : ℝ)⁻¹) →
    (∀ (b M : ℕ), 0 < b →
      (b.totient : ℝ) / b * (∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 M, (k : ℝ)⁻¹) ≤
        ∑ k ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 M).filter (fun k => k.Coprime b), (k : ℝ)⁻¹ →
      (b.totient : ℝ) / b * (∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 M, (k : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ 2 ≤
        ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (M ^ 2),
          ∏ p ∈ m.primeFactors, ((if p ∣ b then 1 else 2 : ℝ) / p) ^ m.factorization p) →
    (∀ (P k : ℕ) (x : ℝ), 1 ≤ x → Squarefree P →
      (∑ d ∈ P.divisors, if (d : ℝ) ≤ x then (k : ℝ) ^ ArithmeticFunction.cardDistinctFactors d else 0) ≤
        x * (1 + Real.log x) ^ k) →

      |(((Finset.range N).filter (fun n => d ∣ n * (b * n + 1))).card : ℝ) -
          (∏ p ∈ d.primeFactors, (if p ∣ b then 1 else 2 : ℝ) / p) * N| ≤
        (2 : ℝ) ^ ArithmeticFunction.cardDistinctFactors d) →
    ∀ (b N : ℕ) (L : ℝ), 0 < b → 2 ∣ b → 1 < L →

subgoal_signatures.name: prime_pair_count_of_sifted_bound
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(∀ (b N : ℕ) (L : ℝ), 0 < b → 2 ∣ b → 1 < L →
      (((Finset.range N).filter (fun n => ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → (p : ℝ) ≤ L → ¬ p ∣ n * (b * n + 1))).card : ℝ) ≤

      (∀ q ∈ F, q.Prime ∧ (b * q + 1).Prime ∧ (q : ℝ) ≤ x) →

informal_problem.statement:
(Q : Finset ℕ) (u z D : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m)
    (hu : Real.exp 1 ≤ u) (huz : u ≤ z) (hD : 0 ≤ D)
    (hQ : ∀ q ∈ Q, u ≤ (q : ℝ) ∧ (q : ℝ) ≤ z)
    (hcount : ∀ t : ℝ, u ≤ t → t ≤ z →
      ((Q.filter (fun q : ℕ => (q : ℝ) ≤ t)).card : ℝ) ≤ D * t / Real.log t ^ (m + 1)) :
    (∑ q ∈ Q, (1 : ℝ) / q) ≤ 8 * D / Real.log u ^ m

signature.name: retained_reciprocal_tail_of_count
signature.statement:
(Q : Finset ℕ) (u z D : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m)
    (hu : Real.exp 1 ≤ u) (huz : u ≤ z) (hD : 0 ≤ D)
    (hQ : ∀ q ∈ Q, u ≤ (q : ℝ) ∧ (q : ℝ) ≤ z)
    (hcount : ∀ t : ℝ, u ≤ t → t ≤ z →
      ((Q.filter (fun q : ℕ => (q : ℝ) ≤ t)).card : ℝ) ≤ D * t / Real.log t ^ (m + 1)) :
    (∑ q ∈ Q, (1 : ℝ) / q) ≤ 8 * D / Real.log u ^ m

proof.tactics:
by
  have hu0 : 0 < u := lt_of_lt_of_le (Real.exp_pos 1) hu
  have hL : 1 ≤ Real.log u := by
    rw [Real.le_log_iff_exp_le hu0]; exact hu
  
  have s1 : ∀ K : ℕ, (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (K + 1), (1 : ℝ) / (Real.log u + k) ^ (m + 1)) ≤
      2 / Real.log u ^ m := by
    intro K
    obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ : ∃ n, m = n + 1 := ⟨m - 1, by omega⟩
    have hLpos : 0 < Real.log u := by linarith
    have hsq : ∀ K : ℕ, (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (K + 1), (1 : ℝ) / (Real.log u + k) ^ 2) ≤
        1 / Real.log u ^ 2 + 1 / Real.log u - 1 / (Real.log u + K) := by
      intro K
      induction K with
      | zero => simp
      | succ K ih =>
        rw [Finset.sum_range_succ]
        push_cast
        have hK : (0 : ℝ) ≤ K := Nat.cast_nonneg K
        have ha : 1 ≤ Real.log u + K := by linarith
        have step : 1 / (Real.log u + (K + 1)) ^ 2 ≤
            1 / (Real.log u + K) - 1 / (Real.log u + (K + 1)) := by
          rw [div_sub_div _ _ (by positivity) (by positivity),
            div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by positivity)]
          nlinarith
        linarith
    have hpt : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range (K + 1), (1 : ℝ) / (Real.log u + k) ^ (n + 1 + 1) ≤
        (1 / Real.log u ^ n) * (1 / (Real.log u + k) ^ 2) := by
      intro k _
      have hk : (0 : ℝ) ≤ k := Nat.cast_nonneg k
      have hLk : 0 < Real.log u + k := by linarith
      have hpow : Real.log u ^ n ≤ (Real.log u + k) ^ n :=
        pow_le_pow_left₀ hLpos.le (by linarith) n
      rw [one_div_mul_one_div]
      apply one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by positivity)
      calc Real.log u ^ n * (Real.log u + k) ^ 2 ≤ (Real.log u + k) ^ n * (Real.log u + k) ^ 2 :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hpow (by positivity)
        _ = (Real.log u + k) ^ (n + 1 + 1) := by ring
    have hK : (0 : ℝ) ≤ K := Nat.cast_nonneg K
    have hL2 : 1 / Real.log u ^ 2 ≤ 1 / Real.log u :=
      one_div_le_one_div_of_le hLpos (by nlinarith)
    have hLK : 0 ≤ 1 / (Real.log u + K) := by positivity
    calc (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (K + 1), (1 : ℝ) / (Real.log u + k) ^ (n + 1 + 1))
        ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (K + 1), (1 / Real.log u ^ n) * (1 / (Real.log u + k) ^ 2) :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum hpt
      _ = (1 / Real.log u ^ n) * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (K + 1), (1 / (Real.log u + k) ^ 2) := by
          rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      _ ≤ (1 / Real.log u ^ n) * (2 / Real.log u) := by
          apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (by positivity)
          have := hsq K
          have h2 : (2 : ℝ) / Real.log u = 1 / Real.log u + 1 / Real.log u := by ring
          linarith
      _ = 2 / Real.log u ^ (n + 1) := by
          rw [pow_succ]; field_simp
  
  have s2 : ∀ k : ℕ, (∑ q ∈ Q.filter (fun q : ℕ => ⌊Real.log (q : ℝ) - Real.log u⌋₊ = k),
      (1 : ℝ) / q) ≤ Real.exp 1 * D / (Real.log u + k) ^ (m + 1) := by
    intro k
    have hk0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ k := Nat.cast_nonneg k
    have hLk : 0 < Real.log u + k := by linarith
    set F := Q.filter (fun q : ℕ => ⌊Real.log (q : ℝ) - Real.log u⌋₊ = k) with hFdef
    by_cases hne : F.Nonempty
    swap
    · rw [Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hne, Finset.sum_empty]
      positivity
    
    have hfact : ∀ q ∈ F, q ∈ Q ∧ 0 < (q : ℝ) ∧ Real.log u + k ≤ Real.log q ∧
        Real.log q < Real.log u + k + 1 := by
      intro q hq
      obtain ⟨hqQ, hqk⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hq
      have huq := (hQ q hqQ).1
      have hq0 : 0 < (q : ℝ) := lt_of_lt_of_le hu0 huq
      have hx0 : 0 ≤ Real.log q - Real.log u := sub_nonneg.mpr (Real.log_le_log hu0 huq)
      have h1 : (k : ℝ) ≤ Real.log q - Real.log u := by
        rw [← hqk]; exact Nat.floor_le hx0
      have h2 : Real.log q - Real.log u < k + 1 := by
        rw [← hqk]; exact Nat.lt_floor_add_one _
      exact ⟨hqQ, hq0, by linarith, by linarith⟩
    have hexpk : Real.exp (Real.log u + k) = u * Real.exp k := by
      rw [Real.exp_add, Real.exp_log hu0]
    have hc0 : 0 < u * Real.exp k := by positivity
    have hA : ∀ q ∈ F, u * Real.exp k ≤ (q : ℝ) := by
      intro q hq
      obtain ⟨_, hq0, h1, _⟩ := hfact q hq
      rw [← hexpk]
      calc Real.exp (Real.log u + k) ≤ Real.exp (Real.log q) := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr h1
        _ = q := Real.exp_log hq0
    set M := F.max' hne with hMdef
    have hMF : M ∈ F := F.max'_mem hne
    obtain ⟨hMQ, hM0, hM1, hM2⟩ := hfact M hMF
    have hB : (M : ℝ) < u * Real.exp k * Real.exp 1 := by
      calc (M : ℝ) = Real.exp (Real.log M) := (Real.exp_log hM0).symm
        _ < Real.exp (Real.log u + k + 1) := Real.exp_lt_exp.mpr hM2
        _ = u * Real.exp k * Real.exp 1 := by rw [Real.exp_add, hexpk]
    have hsub : F ⊆ Q.filter (fun q : ℕ => (q : ℝ) ≤ (M : ℝ)) := by
      intro q hq
      rw [Finset.mem_filter]
      refine ⟨(hfact q hq).1, ?_⟩
      exact_mod_cast F.le_max' q hq
    have hcard : (F.card : ℝ) ≤ D * M / Real.log M ^ (m + 1) := by
      have h1 : (F.card : ℝ) ≤ ((Q.filter (fun q : ℕ => (q : ℝ) ≤ (M : ℝ))).card : ℝ) := by
        exact_mod_cast Finset.card_le_card hsub
      exact h1.trans (hcount M (hQ M hMQ).1 (hQ M hMQ).2)
    have hPle : (Real.log u + k) ^ (m + 1) ≤ Real.log M ^ (m + 1) :=
      pow_le_pow_left₀ hLk.le hM1 (m + 1)
    have hP : 0 < Real.log M ^ (m + 1) := lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity) hPle
    have hsum : (∑ q ∈ F, (1 : ℝ) / q) ≤ F.card • (1 / (u * Real.exp k)) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_card_nsmul
      intro q hq
      exact one_div_le_one_div_of_le hc0 (hA q hq)
    rw [nsmul_eq_mul] at hsum
    have h1 : (F.card : ℝ) * (1 / (u * Real.exp k)) ≤
        D * M / Real.log M ^ (m + 1) * (1 / (u * Real.exp k)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcard (by positivity)
    have h2 : D * M / Real.log M ^ (m + 1) * (1 / (u * Real.exp k)) ≤
        Real.exp 1 * D / Real.log M ^ (m + 1) := by
      rw [div_mul_div_comm, mul_one, div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) hP]
      have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hB.le (mul_nonneg hD hP.le)
      nlinarith [h]
    have h3 : Real.exp 1 * D / Real.log M ^ (m + 1) ≤
        Real.exp 1 * D / (Real.log u + k) ^ (m + 1) :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by positivity) (by positivity) hPle
    linarith
  
  set K := ⌊Real.log z - Real.log u⌋₊ with hKdef
  have hmaps : ∀ q ∈ Q, ⌊Real.log (q : ℝ) - Real.log u⌋₊ ∈ Finset.range (K + 1) := by
    intro q hq
    rw [Finset.mem_range, Nat.lt_succ_iff]
    apply Nat.floor_le_floor
    have hq0 : 0 < (q : ℝ) := lt_of_lt_of_le hu0 (hQ q hq).1
    have := Real.log_le_log hq0 (hQ q hq).2
    linarith
  have he : Real.exp 1 < 4 := by
    have := Real.exp_one_lt_d9
    linarith
  have hLm : 0 < Real.log u ^ m := by positivity
  calc (∑ q ∈ Q, (1 : ℝ) / q)
      = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (K + 1),
          ∑ q ∈ Q.filter (fun q : ℕ => ⌊Real.log (q : ℝ) - Real.log u⌋₊ = k), (1 : ℝ) / q :=
        (Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to hmaps _).symm
    _ ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (K + 1),
          Real.exp 1 * D * (1 / (Real.log u + k) ^ (m + 1)) := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro k _
        rw [mul_one_div]
        exact s2 k
    _ = Real.exp 1 * D * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (K + 1), (1 : ℝ) / (Real.log u + k) ^ (m + 1) := by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    _ ≤ Real.exp 1 * D * (2 / Real.log u ^ m) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (s1 K) (by positivity)
    _ = (2 * Real.exp 1) * (D / Real.log u ^ m) := by ring
    _ ≤ 8 * (D / Real.log u ^ m) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) (by positivity)
    _ = 8 * D / Real.log u ^ m := by ring

informal_problem.statement:
{m n : ℕ} (i : ℕ) (hi : 1 ≤ i)
    (G : Finset ((Fin m → ℕ) × (Fin n → ℕ))) (P : Finset ℕ) (I H : ℝ)
    (hG : ∀ τ ∈ G, (∀ a : Fin m, i ≤ a.val → τ.1 a = 1) ∧ (∀ b : Fin n, i ≤ b.val → τ.2 b = 1) ∧
      (∏ a, τ.1 a) = (∏ b, τ.2 b) ∧ Squarefree (∏ a, τ.1 a) ∧
      (∏ a, τ.1 a).primeFactors ⊆ P ∧ (ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors (∏ a, τ.1 a) : ℝ) ≤ I)
    (hH : (∑ p ∈ P, (1 : ℝ) / p) ≤ H) :
    (∑ τ ∈ G, (1 : ℝ) / ((∏ a, τ.1 a : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≤ Real.exp (I * Real.log i + (i : ℝ) * H)

signature.statement:
{m n : ℕ} (i : ℕ) (hi : 1 ≤ i)
    (G : Finset ((Fin m → ℕ) × (Fin n → ℕ))) (P : Finset ℕ) (I H : ℝ)

      (∏ a, τ.1 a).primeFactors ⊆ P ∧ (ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors (∏ a, τ.1 a) : ℝ) ≤ I)
    (hH : (∑ p ∈ P, (1 : ℝ) / p) ≤ H) :

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have s1 : ∀ (m : ℕ) (N : ℕ), Squarefree N → ∀ (T : Finset (Fin m → ℕ)),
      (∀ f ∈ T, (∀ a : Fin m, i ≤ a.val → f a = 1) ∧ (∏ a, f a) = N) →
      T.card ≤ i ^ (ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors N) := by
    intro m N hN T hT
    have hN0 : N ≠ 0 := hN.ne_zero
    have hcard : N.primeFactors.card = ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors N := by
      have h := List.toFinset_card_of_nodup
        ((Nat.squarefree_iff_nodup_primeFactorsList hN0).mp hN)
      rw [ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors_apply, ← h]
      rfl
    have hdvd : ∀ f ∈ T, ∀ a, f a ∣ N := by
      intro f hf a
      rw [← (hT f hf).2]
      exact Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem f (Finset.mem_univ a)
    have hex : ∀ f ∈ T, ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → p ∣ N → ∃ a, p ∣ f a := by
      intro f hf p hp hpN
      rw [← (hT f hf).2] at hpN
      obtain ⟨a, -, ha⟩ := ((Nat.Prime.prime hp).dvd_finset_prod_iff f).mp hpN
      exact ⟨a, ha⟩
    have hlt : ∀ f ∈ T, ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → ∀ a, p ∣ f a → a.val < i := by
      intro f hf p hp a ha
      by_contra h
      push_neg at h
      rw [(hT f hf).1 a h] at ha
      exact hp.not_dvd_one ha
    have huniq : ∀ f ∈ T, ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → ∀ a a', p ∣ f a → p ∣ f a' → a = a' := by
      intro f hf p hp a a' ha ha'
      by_contra hne
      have h1 : f a * f a' ∣ N := by
        rw [← (hT f hf).2, ← Finset.mul_prod_erase Finset.univ f (Finset.mem_univ a)]
        exact mul_dvd_mul_left _
          (Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem f (Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨Ne.symm hne, Finset.mem_univ a'⟩))
      have h2 : p * p ∣ N := (mul_dvd_mul ha ha').trans h1
      exact hp.one_lt.ne' (Nat.isUnit_iff.mp (hN p h2))
    let Φ : (Fin m → ℕ) → (N.primeFactors → ℕ) := fun f p =>
      if h : ∃ a, p.1 ∣ f a then (Classical.choose h).val else 0
    have hmaps : ∀ f ∈ T, Φ f ∈ Fintype.piFinset (fun _ : N.primeFactors => Finset.range i) := by
      intro f hf
      rw [Fintype.mem_piFinset]
      intro p
      have hp := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors p.2
      have hpN := Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactors p.2
      have h := hex f hf p.1 hp hpN
      simp only [Φ, dif_pos h, Finset.mem_range]
      exact hlt f hf p.1 hp _ (Classical.choose_spec h)
    have key : ∀ f ∈ T, ∀ g ∈ T, Φ f = Φ g → ∀ a p, p ∈ (f a).primeFactors →
        p ∈ (g a).primeFactors := by
      intro f hf g hg hfg a p hp
      have hpp := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp
      have hpa := Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactors hp
      have hpN : p ∣ N := hpa.trans (hdvd f hf a)
      have hpS : p ∈ N.primeFactors := Nat.mem_primeFactors.mpr ⟨hpp, hpN, hN0⟩
      have hf' : ∃ a, p ∣ f a := ⟨a, hpa⟩
      have hg' := hex g hg p hpp hpN
      have hcf : Classical.choose hf' = a :=
        huniq f hf p hpp _ _ (Classical.choose_spec hf') hpa
      have heq := congrFun hfg ⟨p, hpS⟩
      simp only [Φ, dif_pos hf', dif_pos hg'] at heq
      have hcg : Classical.choose hg' = a := by
        apply Fin.ext
        rw [← heq, hcf]
      have hpg : p ∣ g a := hcg ▸ Classical.choose_spec hg'
      have hga0 : g a ≠ 0 := by
        intro h0
        have := hdvd g hg a
        rw [h0, zero_dvd_iff] at this
        exact hN0 this
      exact Nat.mem_primeFactors.mpr ⟨hpp, hpg, hga0⟩
    have hinj : Set.InjOn Φ T := by
      intro f hf g hg hfg
      funext a
      have hsf : Squarefree (f a) := hN.squarefree_of_dvd (hdvd f hf a)
      have hsg : Squarefree (g a) := hN.squarefree_of_dvd (hdvd g hg a)
      have hpf : (f a).primeFactors = (g a).primeFactors := by
        ext p
        exact ⟨key f hf g hg hfg a p, key g hg f hf hfg.symm a p⟩
      rw [← Nat.prod_primeFactors_of_squarefree hsf, ← Nat.prod_primeFactors_of_squarefree hsg,
        hpf]
    calc T.card ≤ (Fintype.piFinset (fun _ : N.primeFactors => Finset.range i)).card :=
          Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn Φ (fun f hf => hmaps f hf) hinj
      _ = i ^ (ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors N) := by
          rw [Fintype.card_piFinset, Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_coe,
            Finset.card_range, hcard]
  
  have s2 : ∀ (K : Finset ℕ) (x : ℝ), 0 ≤ x → (∀ N ∈ K, Squarefree N ∧ N.primeFactors ⊆ P) →
      (∑ N ∈ K, x ^ (ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors N) / (N : ℝ)) ≤
        Real.exp (x * ∑ p ∈ P, (1 : ℝ) / p) := by
    intro K x hx hK
    have hcard : ∀ N : ℕ, Squarefree N →
        N.primeFactors.card = ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors N := by
      intro N hN
      have h := List.toFinset_card_of_nodup
        ((Nat.squarefree_iff_nodup_primeFactorsList hN.ne_zero).mp hN)
      rw [ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors_apply, ← h]
      rfl
    have hE1 : ∀ N ∈ K, x ^ (ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors N) / (N : ℝ) =
        ∏ p ∈ N.primeFactors, x / (p : ℝ) := by
      intro N hN
      have hsq := (hK N hN).1
      rw [Finset.prod_div_distrib, Finset.prod_const, hcard N hsq, ← Nat.cast_prod,
        Nat.prod_primeFactors_of_squarefree hsq]
    have hinj : ∀ a ∈ K, ∀ b ∈ K, a.primeFactors = b.primeFactors → a = b := by
      intro a ha b hb hab
      rw [← Nat.prod_primeFactors_of_squarefree (hK a ha).1,
        ← Nat.prod_primeFactors_of_squarefree (hK b hb).1, hab]
    have hnn : ∀ S : Finset ℕ, 0 ≤ ∏ p ∈ S, x / (p : ℝ) :=
      fun S => Finset.prod_nonneg (fun p _ => div_nonneg hx (Nat.cast_nonneg p))
    calc (∑ N ∈ K, x ^ (ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors N) / (N : ℝ))
        = ∑ N ∈ K, ∏ p ∈ N.primeFactors, x / (p : ℝ) := Finset.sum_congr rfl hE1
      _ = ∑ S ∈ K.image Nat.primeFactors, ∏ p ∈ S, x / (p : ℝ) := by
          rw [Finset.sum_image hinj]
      _ ≤ ∑ S ∈ P.powerset, ∏ p ∈ S, x / (p : ℝ) := by
          apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg
          · intro S hS
            obtain ⟨N, hN, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hS
            exact Finset.mem_powerset.mpr (hK N hN).2
          · intro S _ _
            exact hnn S
      _ = ∏ p ∈ P, (1 + x / (p : ℝ)) := by rw [Finset.prod_one_add]
      _ ≤ ∏ p ∈ P, Real.exp (x / (p : ℝ)) := by
          apply Finset.prod_le_prod
          · intro p _
            have := div_nonneg hx (Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) p)
            linarith
          · intro p _
            have := Real.add_one_le_exp (x / (p : ℝ))
            linarith
      _ = Real.exp (∑ p ∈ P, x / (p : ℝ)) := (Real.exp_sum _ _).symm
      _ = Real.exp (x * ∑ p ∈ P, (1 : ℝ) / p) := by
          rw [Finset.mul_sum]
          congr 1
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro p _
          ring
  
  let Nf : (Fin m → ℕ) × (Fin n → ℕ) → ℕ := fun τ => ∏ a, τ.1 a
  let K := G.image Nf
  have hlog : 0 ≤ Real.log i := Real.log_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast hi)
  have hi0 : (0:ℝ) < i := by exact_mod_cast hi
  have hKprop : ∀ N ∈ K, ∃ τ ∈ G, Nf τ = N := fun N hN => Finset.mem_image.mp hN
  have hpow : ∀ N ∈ K, (i:ℝ) ^ (ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors N) ≤
      Real.exp (I * Real.log i) := by
    intro N hN
    obtain ⟨τ, hτ, rfl⟩ := hKprop N hN
    have hΩ := (hG τ hτ).2.2.2.2.2
    calc (i:ℝ) ^ (ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors (Nf τ))
        = Real.exp (Real.log i) ^ (ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors (Nf τ)) := by
          rw [Real.exp_log hi0]
      _ = Real.exp ((ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors (Nf τ) : ℝ) * Real.log i) :=
          (Real.exp_nat_mul _ _).symm
      _ ≤ _ := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hΩ hlog)
  have hfib : ∀ N ∈ K, ((G.filter (fun τ => Nf τ = N)).card : ℝ) ≤
      (i:ℝ) ^ (ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors N) * (i:ℝ) ^ (ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors N) := by
    intro N hN
    obtain ⟨τ₀, hτ₀, hτ₀N⟩ := hKprop N hN
    have hsq : Squarefree N := hτ₀N ▸ (hG τ₀ hτ₀).2.2.2.1
    have h1 := s1 m N hsq ((G.filter (fun τ => Nf τ = N)).image Prod.fst) (by
      intro f hf
      obtain ⟨τ, hτ, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hf
      obtain ⟨hτG, hτN⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hτ
      exact ⟨(hG τ hτG).1, hτN⟩)
    have h2 := s1 n N hsq ((G.filter (fun τ => Nf τ = N)).image Prod.snd) (by
      intro f hf
      obtain ⟨τ, hτ, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hf
      obtain ⟨hτG, hτN⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hτ
      exact ⟨(hG τ hτG).2.1, ((hG τ hτG).2.2.1).symm.trans hτN⟩)
    have hc : (G.filter (fun τ => Nf τ = N)).card ≤
        ((G.filter (fun τ => Nf τ = N)).image Prod.fst).card *
          ((G.filter (fun τ => Nf τ = N)).image Prod.snd).card := by
      rw [← Finset.card_product]
      exact Finset.card_le_card Finset.subset_product
    have : (G.filter (fun τ => Nf τ = N)).card ≤
        i ^ (ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors N) * i ^ (ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors N) :=
      hc.trans (Nat.mul_le_mul h1 h2)
    exact_mod_cast this
  have hs2 := s2 K (i:ℝ) hi0.le (by
    intro N hN
    obtain ⟨τ, hτ, rfl⟩ := hKprop N hN
    exact ⟨(hG τ hτ).2.2.2.1, (hG τ hτ).2.2.2.2.1⟩)
  calc (∑ τ ∈ G, (1 : ℝ) / ((∏ a, τ.1 a : ℕ) : ℝ))
      = ∑ N ∈ K, ∑ τ ∈ G.filter (fun τ => Nf τ = N), (1:ℝ) / (Nf τ : ℝ) :=
        (Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to (fun τ hτ => Finset.mem_image_of_mem Nf hτ) _).symm
    _ = ∑ N ∈ K, ((G.filter (fun τ => Nf τ = N)).card : ℝ) * (1 / (N : ℝ)) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro N _
        rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun τ hτ => by rw [(Finset.mem_filter.mp hτ).2]),
          Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
    _ ≤ ∑ N ∈ K, Real.exp (I * Real.log i) *
          ((i:ℝ) ^ (ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors N) / (N : ℝ)) := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro N hN
        have hNn : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 / (N:ℝ) := by positivity

proof.tactics:
by
  have hT : Tendsto logLog atTop atTop :=
    Real.tendsto_log_atTop.comp Real.tendsto_log_atTop
  filter_upwards [hT.eventually_ge_atTop (max 4 (B ^ 2))] with Y hY
  have h4 : (4 : ℝ) ≤ logLog Y := (le_max_left _ _).trans hY
  have hB2 : B ^ 2 ≤ logLog Y := (le_max_right _ _).trans hY
  have hTpos : 0 < logLog Y := by linarith
  have hlogT : 1 ≤ Real.log (logLog Y) := by
    rw [Real.le_log_iff_exp_le hTpos]
    have := Real.exp_one_lt_d9
    linarith
  have hL10 : 1 ≤ Real.log (logLog Y) ^ 10 := one_le_pow₀ hlogT
  have hL5 : 1 ≤ Real.log (logLog Y) ^ 5 := one_le_pow₀ hlogT
  refine ⟨by linarith, ?_, ?_⟩

      unfold normalityScale
      rw [logLog, Real.log_exp, Real.log_exp]
    rw [hS]
    have hle : B ^ 2 ≤ Real.log (logLog Y) ^ 10 * logLog Y := by
      have : logLog Y ≤ Real.log (logLog Y) ^ 10 * logLog Y := by
        have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hL10 hTpos.le
        linarith
      linarith
    calc B ≤ |B| := le_abs_self B
      _ = Real.sqrt (B ^ 2) := (Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs B).symm

    set δ := normalityDelta (logLog Y) with hδ
    have htel : ∀ n : ℕ, n + 1 ≤ k → (n : ℝ) * δ ≤ ν 1 - ν (n + 1) := by
      intro n
      induction n with
      | zero => intro _; simp
      | succ m ih =>
        intro hm
        have h1 := ih (by omega)
        have h2 := hgap (m + 2) (by omega) (by omega)
        have e : m + 2 - 1 = m + 1 := by omega
        rw [e] at h2
        push_cast
        have : ((m : ℝ) + 1) * δ = (m : ℝ) * δ + δ := by ring

      rw [Nat.cast_sub hk]; simp

    have hs2 : 2 ≤ s := by

      linarith
    have hδs : δ * s = 2 * Real.log (logLog Y) ^ 5 := by
      rw [hδ, normalityDelta, ← hs, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hs0.ne']
    have hδs2 : 2 ≤ δ * s := by linarith
    have hkm : 0 ≤ (k : ℝ) - 1 := by
      have : (1 : ℝ) ≤ k := by exact_mod_cast hk
      linarith
    have ha : ((k : ℝ) - 1) * δ * s ≤ s := by
      have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hkd hs0.le
      linarith
    have hb : ((k : ℝ) - 1) * 2 ≤ ((k : ℝ) - 1) * (δ * s) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hδs2 hkm
    have hc : ((k : ℝ) - 1) * δ * s = ((k : ℝ) - 1) * (δ * s) := by ring

    have hfin : 1 + s / 2 ≤ s ^ 2 := by
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg hs0.le (sub_nonneg.mpr hs2)]
    linarith

informal_problem.statement:
(hMERT : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ, 2 ≤ x →
      |(∑ p ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊x⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, (1 : ℝ) / p) - Real.log (Real.log x)| ≤ C) :

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hMERT
  refine ⟨max C 0, le_max_right _ _, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro u v hu huv
    have hv : 2 ≤ v := le_trans hu huv
    have h1 := hC u hu
    have h2 := hC v hv
    rw [abs_le] at h1 h2
    have hsub : (Finset.Iic ⌊v⌋₊).filter (fun p : ℕ => p.Prime ∧ u < (p : ℝ)) ∪
        (Finset.Iic ⌊u⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime ⊆ (Finset.Iic ⌊v⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime := by
      intro p hp
      rw [Finset.mem_union] at hp
      rw [Finset.mem_filter]
      rcases hp with hp | hp
      · rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hp
        exact ⟨hp.1, hp.2.1⟩
      · rw [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Iic] at hp
        exact ⟨Finset.mem_Iic.mpr (le_trans hp.1 (Nat.floor_le_floor huv)), hp.2⟩
    have hdisj : Disjoint ((Finset.Iic ⌊v⌋₊).filter (fun p : ℕ => p.Prime ∧ u < (p : ℝ)))
        ((Finset.Iic ⌊u⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime) := by
      rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
      intro p hp hp'
      rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hp
      rw [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Iic] at hp'
      have hpu : (p : ℝ) ≤ u := by
        have h0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ u := by linarith
        calc (p:ℝ) ≤ (⌊u⌋₊ : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hp'.1
          _ ≤ u := Nat.floor_le h0
      linarith [hp.2.2]
    have hle := Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (f := fun p : ℕ => (1 : ℝ) / p) hsub
      (fun _ _ _ => by positivity)
    rw [Finset.sum_union hdisj] at hle
    unfold logLog
    have := le_max_left C 0
    linarith
  · intro x hx Q hQ
    have h2 := hC x hx
    rw [abs_le] at h2
    have hsub : Q ⊆ (Finset.Iic ⌊x⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime := by
      intro q hq
      rw [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Iic]
      exact ⟨Nat.le_floor (hQ q hq).2, (hQ q hq).1⟩
    have hle := Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (f := fun p : ℕ => (1 : ℝ) / p) hsub
      (fun _ _ _ => by positivity)
    unfold logLog
    have := le_max_left C 0
    linarith

            Real.sqrt (logLog (normalityScale (logLog Y)) * logLog Y)) := by
          rw [Finset.sum_ite, Finset.sum_const_zero, add_zero, Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
      _ ≤ ((j + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (logLog (v (j + 1)) - logLog (v (j + 2)) +
            Real.sqrt (logLog (normalityScale (logLog Y)) * logLog Y)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by exact_mod_cast hcard) hX0
  · intro a b ha hb
    have hak : a.val < k := by omega
    have hbk : b.val < k := by omega
    have hA1 := (hlpf1 a hak).1
    have hA2 := (hlpf1 a hak).2
    have hB1 := (hlpf2 b hbk).1
    have hB2 := (hlpf2 b hbk).2
    rw [ha] at hA1 hA2
    rw [hb] at hB1 hB2
    have hfull1 : σ.1 a * (h w).1 a = s.1 a := by
      rw [← hwr1 a, hwa a, List.filter_eq_self.mpr ?_, Nat.prod_primeFactorsList (hp1 a).ne']
      intro p hp
      have h1 := (c6 (s.1 a) Q).1 p hp
      have h4 : (p : ℝ) ≤ largestPrimeFactor (s.1 a) := by exact_mod_cast h1
      simp only [decide_eq_true_eq]
      linarith
    have hfull2 : σ.2 b * (h w).2 b = s.2 b := by
      rw [← hwr2 b, hwb b, List.filter_eq_self.mpr ?_, Nat.prod_primeFactorsList (hp2 b).ne']
      intro p hp
      have h1 := (c6 (s.2 b) Q).1 p hp
      have h4 : (p : ℝ) ≤ largestPrimeFactor (s.2 b) := by exact_mod_cast h1
      simp only [decide_eq_true_eq]
      linarith
    have hlp1 : largestPrimeFactor ((h w).1 a) = largestPrimeFactor (s.1 a) := by
      rw [hτ1 a]
      apply (c6 (s.1 a) Q).2
      · have : (1 : ℝ) < largestPrimeFactor (s.1 a) := by linarith
        exact_mod_cast this
      · exact (hQ _).mpr ⟨by linarith, hA2⟩
    have hlp2 : largestPrimeFactor ((h w).2 b) = largestPrimeFactor (s.2 b) := by
      rw [hτ2 b]
      apply (c6 (s.2 b) Q).2
      · have : (1 : ℝ) < largestPrimeFactor (s.2 b) := by linarith
        exact_mod_cast this
      · exact (hQ _).mpr ⟨by linarith, hB2⟩
    rw [hfull1, hfull2, hlp1, hlp2]
    have hd1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ d := by exact_mod_cast hd
    have hP0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ((∏ a', s.1 a' : ℕ) : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
    have hRd : 1 ≤ R * d := by nlinarith
    refine ⟨(hsn1 a hak).1, (hsn2 b hbk).1, hdist a b hak (by omega), ?_, ?_, hA1, hA2, hB1, hB2⟩
    · have h1 : s.1 a ≤ ∏ a', s.1 a' :=
        Finset.single_le_prod' (fun i _ => Nat.succ_le_of_lt (hp1 i)) (Finset.mem_univ a)
      have h1' : ((s.1 a : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ ((∏ a', s.1 a' : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast h1
      have h2 : ((∏ a', s.1 a' : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ R * d * ((∏ a', s.1 a' : ℕ) : ℝ) := by nlinarith
      linarith
    · have h1 : s.2 b ≤ ∏ b', s.2 b' :=
        Finset.single_le_prod' (fun i _ => Nat.succ_le_of_lt (hp2 i)) (Finset.mem_univ b)
      rw [← hbal] at h1
      have h1' : ((s.2 b : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (d : ℝ) * ((∏ a', s.1 a' : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast h1
      have h2 : (d : ℝ) * ((∏ a', s.1 a' : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ R * d * ((∏ a', s.1 a' : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
        have : (d : ℝ) * ((∏ a', s.1 a' : ℕ) : ℝ) ≥ 0 := by positivity
        nlinarith
      linarith

{m n : ℕ} (i : ℕ) (c : Fin m) (c' : Fin n) (A0 B0 : ℕ)
    (Y W v K E I : ℝ) (P : Finset ℕ) (G : Finset ((Fin m → ℕ) × (Fin n → ℕ)))
    (hc : c.val < i) (hc' : c'.val < i) (hA0 : 0 < A0) (hB0 : 0 < B0) (hW : 1 < W)
    (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hE : 0 ≤ E)
    (hG : ∀ τ ∈ G,
      (∀ a : Fin m, 0 < τ.1 a) ∧ (∀ b : Fin n, 0 < τ.2 b) ∧
      (∀ a : Fin m, i ≤ a.val → τ.1 a = 1) ∧ (∀ b : Fin n, i ≤ b.val → τ.2 b = 1) ∧
      (∏ a, τ.1 a) = (∏ b, τ.2 b) ∧ Squarefree (∏ a, τ.1 a) ∧
      (∏ a, τ.1 a).primeFactors ⊆ P ∧ (ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors (∏ a, τ.1 a) : ℝ) ≤ I ∧
      (A0 * τ.1 c + 1).Prime ∧ (B0 * τ.2 c' + 1).Prime ∧ A0 * τ.1 c ≠ B0 * τ.2 c' ∧
      ((A0 * τ.1 c : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ Y ∧ ((B0 * τ.2 c' : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ Y ∧
      W ≤ (largestPrimeFactor (τ.1 c) : ℝ) ∧ (largestPrimeFactor (τ.1 c) : ℝ) ≤ v ∧
      largestPrimeFactor (τ.1 c) = largestPrimeFactor (τ.2 c'))
    (htail : ∀ (A B : ℕ) (Q : Finset ℕ), 0 < A → 0 < B → A ≠ B → (A : ℝ) ≤ Y → (B : ℝ) ≤ Y →
      (∀ q ∈ Q, q.Prime ∧ (A * q + 1).Prime ∧ (B * q + 1).Prime ∧ W ≤ (q : ℝ) ∧ (q : ℝ) ≤ v) →
      (∑ q ∈ Q, (1 : ℝ) / q) ≤ K)
    (halloc : ∀ G' : Finset ((Fin m → ℕ) × (Fin n → ℕ)),
      (∀ τ ∈ G', (∀ a : Fin m, i ≤ a.val → τ.1 a = 1) ∧ (∀ b : Fin n, i ≤ b.val → τ.2 b = 1) ∧
        (∏ a, τ.1 a) = (∏ b, τ.2 b) ∧ Squarefree (∏ a, τ.1 a) ∧
        (∏ a, τ.1 a).primeFactors ⊆ P ∧ (ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors (∏ a, τ.1 a) : ℝ) ≤ I) →
      (∑ τ ∈ G', (1 : ℝ) / ((∏ a, τ.1 a : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≤ E) :
    (∑ τ ∈ G, (1 : ℝ) / ((∏ a, τ.1 a : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≤ K * E

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have lpf : ∀ N : ℕ, 1 < largestPrimeFactor N →
      (largestPrimeFactor N).Prime ∧ largestPrimeFactor N ∣ N := by
    intro N h
    unfold largestPrimeFactor at h ⊢
    have hs : 1 < N.primeFactors.sup id := by
      rcases lt_max_iff.mp h with h1 | h1
      · exact absurd h1 (lt_irrefl 1)
      · exact h1
    rw [max_eq_right hs.le]
    have hne : N.primeFactors.Nonempty := by
      rw [Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty]
      intro he
      rw [he, Finset.sup_empty] at hs
      simp at hs
    obtain ⟨p, hp, hpeq⟩ := Finset.exists_mem_eq_sup N.primeFactors hne id
    rw [hpeq]
    have hmem := Nat.mem_primeFactors.mp hp
    exact ⟨hmem.1, hmem.2.1⟩
  obtain ⟨qf, hqf⟩ : ∃ qf : (Fin m → ℕ) × (Fin n → ℕ) → ℕ,
      ∀ τ, qf τ = largestPrimeFactor (τ.1 c) := ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ : ∃ f : (Fin m → ℕ) × (Fin n → ℕ) → (Fin m → ℕ) × (Fin n → ℕ),
      ∀ τ, f τ = (Function.update τ.1 c (τ.1 c / qf τ), Function.update τ.2 c' (τ.2 c' / qf τ)) :=
    ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
  
  have hq : ∀ τ ∈ G, (qf τ).Prime ∧ qf τ ∣ τ.1 c ∧ qf τ ∣ τ.2 c' := by
    intro τ hτ
    obtain ⟨p1, p2, p3, p4, p5, p6, p7, p8, p9, p10, p11, p12, p13, p14, p15, p16⟩ := hG τ hτ
    have h1 : 1 < largestPrimeFactor (τ.1 c) := by
      have : (1 : ℝ) < (largestPrimeFactor (τ.1 c) : ℝ) := lt_of_lt_of_le hW p14
      exact_mod_cast this
    obtain ⟨hp, hd⟩ := lpf _ h1
    have h2 : 1 < largestPrimeFactor (τ.2 c') := by rw [← p16]; exact h1
    obtain ⟨_, hd2⟩ := lpf _ h2
    rw [hqf]
    refine ⟨hp, hd, ?_⟩
    rw [p16]; exact hd2
  
  have hU : ∀ τ ∈ G, (∏ a, τ.1 a) = (∏ a, (f τ).1 a) * qf τ ∧
      (∏ b, τ.2 b) = (∏ b, (f τ).2 b) * qf τ ∧
      (f τ).1 c * qf τ = τ.1 c ∧ (f τ).2 c' * qf τ = τ.2 c' ∧
      (∀ a : Fin m, a ≠ c → (f τ).1 a = τ.1 a) ∧ (∀ b : Fin n, b ≠ c' → (f τ).2 b = τ.2 b) ∧
      (∀ a : Fin m, 0 < (f τ).1 a) ∧ (∀ b : Fin n, 0 < (f τ).2 b) := by
    intro τ hτ
    obtain ⟨hp, hd1, hd2⟩ := hq τ hτ
    obtain ⟨p1, p2, -⟩ := hG τ hτ
    have hq0 : 0 < qf τ := hp.pos
    rw [hf τ]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · show (∏ a, τ.1 a) = (∏ a, Function.update τ.1 c (τ.1 c / qf τ) a) * qf τ
      rw [Finset.prod_update_of_mem (Finset.mem_univ c),
        Finset.prod_eq_mul_prod_diff_singleton (Finset.mem_univ c) τ.1]
      calc τ.1 c * ∏ x ∈ Finset.univ \ {c}, τ.1 x
          = (τ.1 c / qf τ * qf τ) * ∏ x ∈ Finset.univ \ {c}, τ.1 x := by
            rw [Nat.div_mul_cancel hd1]
        _ = _ := by ring
    · show (∏ b, τ.2 b) = (∏ b, Function.update τ.2 c' (τ.2 c' / qf τ) b) * qf τ
      rw [Finset.prod_update_of_mem (Finset.mem_univ c'),
        Finset.prod_eq_mul_prod_diff_singleton (Finset.mem_univ c') τ.2]
      calc τ.2 c' * ∏ x ∈ Finset.univ \ {c'}, τ.2 x
          = (τ.2 c' / qf τ * qf τ) * ∏ x ∈ Finset.univ \ {c'}, τ.2 x := by
            rw [Nat.div_mul_cancel hd2]
        _ = _ := by ring
    · show Function.update τ.1 c (τ.1 c / qf τ) c * qf τ = τ.1 c
      rw [Function.update_self]; exact Nat.div_mul_cancel hd1
    · show Function.update τ.2 c' (τ.2 c' / qf τ) c' * qf τ = τ.2 c'
      rw [Function.update_self]; exact Nat.div_mul_cancel hd2
    · intro a ha
      show Function.update τ.1 c (τ.1 c / qf τ) a = τ.1 a
      rw [Function.update_of_ne ha]
    · intro b hb
      show Function.update τ.2 c' (τ.2 c' / qf τ) b = τ.2 b
      rw [Function.update_of_ne hb]
    · intro a
      show 0 < Function.update τ.1 c (τ.1 c / qf τ) a
      by_cases ha : a = c
      · rw [ha, Function.update_self]
        exact Nat.div_pos (Nat.le_of_dvd (p1 c) hd1) hq0
      · rw [Function.update_of_ne ha]; exact p1 a
    · intro b
      show 0 < Function.update τ.2 c' (τ.2 c' / qf τ) b
      by_cases hb : b = c'
      · rw [hb, Function.update_self]
        exact Nat.div_pos (Nat.le_of_dvd (p2 c') hd2) hq0
      · rw [Function.update_of_ne hb]; exact p2 b
  
  have hinj : ∀ τ ∈ G, ∀ τ₂ ∈ G, f τ = f τ₂ → qf τ = qf τ₂ → τ = τ₂ := by
    intro τ hτ τ₂ hτ₂ hff hqq
    obtain ⟨-, -, u3, u4, u5, u6, -, -⟩ := hU τ hτ
    obtain ⟨-, -, v3, v4, v5, v6, -, -⟩ := hU τ₂ hτ₂
    refine Prod.ext (funext fun a => ?_) (funext fun b => ?_)
    · by_cases ha : a = c
      · rw [ha, ← u3, ← v3, hff, hqq]
      · rw [← u5 a ha, ← v5 a ha, hff]
    · by_cases hb : b = c'
      · rw [hb, ← u4, ← v4, hff, hqq]
      · rw [← u6 b hb, ← v6 b hb, hff]
  
  have hfib : ∀ b ∈ G.image f,
      (∑ τ ∈ G.filter (fun τ => f τ = b), (1 : ℝ) / ((∏ a, τ.1 a : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≤
        (1 / ((∏ a, b.1 a : ℕ) : ℝ)) * K := by
    intro b hb
    obtain ⟨τ0, hτ0, hfb⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hb
    have step1 : (∑ τ ∈ G.filter (fun τ => f τ = b), (1 : ℝ) / ((∏ a, τ.1 a : ℕ) : ℝ)) =
        (1 / ((∏ a, b.1 a : ℕ) : ℝ)) * ∑ τ ∈ G.filter (fun τ => f τ = b), (1 : ℝ) / (qf τ : ℝ) := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro τ hτ
      obtain ⟨hτG, hfτ⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hτ
      rw [(hU τ hτG).1, hfτ, Nat.cast_mul, one_div_mul_one_div]
    have step2 : (∑ τ ∈ G.filter (fun τ => f τ = b), (1 : ℝ) / (qf τ : ℝ)) =
        ∑ p ∈ (G.filter (fun τ => f τ = b)).image qf, (1 : ℝ) / (p : ℝ) := by
      rw [Finset.sum_image]
      intro x hx y hy hxy
      obtain ⟨hxG, hfx⟩ : x ∈ G ∧ f x = b := by simpa using hx
      obtain ⟨hyG, hfy⟩ : y ∈ G ∧ f y = b := by simpa using hy
      exact hinj x hxG y hyG (hfx.trans hfy.symm) hxy
    have coefA : ∀ τ ∈ G, f τ = b → A0 * b.1 c * qf τ = A0 * τ.1 c := by
      intro τ hτ hfτ
      rw [← hfτ, mul_assoc, (hU τ hτ).2.2.1]
    have coefB : ∀ τ ∈ G, f τ = b → B0 * b.2 c' * qf τ = B0 * τ.2 c' := by
      intro τ hτ hfτ
      rw [← hfτ, mul_assoc, (hU τ hτ).2.2.2.1]
    obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, r11, r12, r13, -, -, -⟩ := hG τ0 hτ0
    have hq0pos : 1 ≤ qf τ0 := (hq τ0 hτ0).1.one_lt.le
    have hK' : (∑ p ∈ (G.filter (fun τ => f τ = b)).image qf, (1 : ℝ) / (p : ℝ)) ≤ K := by
      apply htail (A0 * b.1 c) (B0 * b.2 c')
      · refine Nat.mul_pos hA0 ?_
        rw [← hfb]; exact (hU τ0 hτ0).2.2.2.2.2.2.1 c
      · refine Nat.mul_pos hB0 ?_
        rw [← hfb]; exact (hU τ0 hτ0).2.2.2.2.2.2.2 c'
      · intro hAB
        apply r11
        rw [← coefA τ0 hτ0 hfb, ← coefB τ0 hτ0 hfb, hAB]
      · have hle : A0 * b.1 c ≤ A0 * τ0.1 c := by
          rw [← coefA τ0 hτ0 hfb]
          exact le_mul_of_one_le_right (Nat.zero_le _) hq0pos
        exact le_trans (by exact_mod_cast hle) r12
      · have hle : B0 * b.2 c' ≤ B0 * τ0.2 c' := by
          rw [← coefB τ0 hτ0 hfb]
          exact le_mul_of_one_le_right (Nat.zero_le _) hq0pos
        exact le_trans (by exact_mod_cast hle) r13
      · intro p hp
        obtain ⟨τ, hτ, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hp
        obtain ⟨hτG, hfτ⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hτ
        obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, s9, s10, -, -, -, s14, s15, -⟩ := hG τ hτG
        refine ⟨(hq τ hτG).1, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [coefA τ hτG hfτ]; exact s9
        · rw [coefB τ hτG hfτ]; exact s10
        · rw [hqf]; exact s14
        · rw [hqf]; exact s15
    rw [step1, step2]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hK' (by positivity)
  
  have hall : (∑ b ∈ G.image f, (1 : ℝ) / ((∏ a, b.1 a : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≤ E := by
    apply halloc
    intro τ' hτ'
    obtain ⟨τ, hτ, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hτ'
    obtain ⟨p1, p2, p3, p4, p5, p6, p7, p8, -⟩ := hG τ hτ
    obtain ⟨u1, u2, u3, u4, u5, u6, u7, u8⟩ := hU τ hτ
    have hq0 : 0 < qf τ := (hq τ hτ).1.pos
    have hN0 : (∏ a, τ.1 a) ≠ 0 := (Finset.prod_pos (fun a _ => p1 a)).ne'
    have hdvd : (∏ a, (f τ).1 a) ∣ ∏ a, τ.1 a := ⟨qf τ, u1⟩
    have hM0 : (∏ a, (f τ).1 a) ≠ 0 := (Finset.prod_pos (fun a _ => u7 a)).ne'
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro a ha
      have hac : a ≠ c := by
        intro h; rw [h] at ha; omega
      rw [u5 a hac]; exact p3 a ha
    · intro b hb
      have hbc : b ≠ c' := by
        intro h; rw [h] at hb; omega
      rw [u6 b hbc]; exact p4 b hb
    · apply Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_right hq0
      rw [← u1, ← u2]; exact p5
    · exact Squarefree.squarefree_of_dvd hdvd p6
    · exact (Nat.primeFactors_mono hdvd hN0).trans p7
    · have hqne : qf τ ≠ 0 := hq0.ne'
      have hΩ : ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors (∏ a, (f τ).1 a) ≤
          ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors (∏ a, τ.1 a) := by
        rw [u1, ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors_mul hM0 hqne]
        exact Nat.le_add_right _ _
      exact le_trans (by exact_mod_cast hΩ) p8
  
  calc (∑ τ ∈ G, (1 : ℝ) / ((∏ a, τ.1 a : ℕ) : ℝ))
      = ∑ b ∈ G.image f, ∑ τ ∈ G.filter (fun τ => f τ = b),
          (1 : ℝ) / ((∏ a, τ.1 a : ℕ) : ℝ) :=
        (Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to (fun τ hτ => Finset.mem_image_of_mem f hτ) _).symm
    _ ≤ ∑ b ∈ G.image f, (1 / ((∏ a, b.1 a : ℕ) : ℝ)) * K := Finset.sum_le_sum hfib
    _ = K * ∑ b ∈ G.image f, (1 : ℝ) / ((∏ a, b.1 a : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro b _
        ring
    _ ≤ K * E := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hall hK

informal_problem.statement:
{m n : ℕ} (i : ℕ) (c : Fin m) (c' : Fin n) (A0 B0 : ℕ)
    (Y W v K1 K2 K3 E I : ℝ) (P : Finset ℕ) (G : Finset ((Fin m → ℕ) × (Fin n → ℕ)))
    (hc : c.val < i) (hc' : c'.val < i) (hA0 : 0 < A0) (hB0 : 0 < B0) (hW : 1 < W)
    (hK1 : 0 ≤ K1) (hK2 : 0 ≤ K2) (hK3 : 0 ≤ K3) (hE : 0 ≤ E)
    (hG : ∀ τ ∈ G,
