proof.tactics:
by
  have hKn : 0 ≤ K2 * K2 + K1 * K3 := add_nonneg (mul_nonneg hK2 hK2) (mul_nonneg hK1 hK3)
  
  have lpf : ∀ N : ℕ, 1 < largestPrimeFactor N →
      (largestPrimeFactor N).Prime ∧ largestPrimeFactor N ∣ N := by
    intro N h
    unfold largestPrimeFactor at h ⊢
    have hs : 1 < N.primeFactors.sup id := by
      rcases lt_max_iff.mp h with h1 | h1
      · exact absurd h1 (lt_irrefl 1)
      · exact h1
    rw [max_eq_right hs.le]
    have hne : N.primeFactors.Nonempty := by
      rw [Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty]
      intro he
      rw [he, Finset.sup_empty] at hs
      simp at hs
    obtain ⟨p, hp, hpeq⟩ := Finset.exists_mem_eq_sup N.primeFactors hne id
    rw [hpeq]
    have hmem := Nat.mem_primeFactors.mp hp
    exact ⟨hmem.1, hmem.2.1⟩
  
  have bil : ∀ (S : Finset (ℕ × ℕ)) (α β : ℝ), 0 ≤ β →
      (∑ p ∈ S.image Prod.fst, (1 : ℝ) / (p : ℝ)) ≤ α →
      (∀ p ∈ S.image Prod.fst,
        (∑ q ∈ (S.filter (fun z => z.1 = p)).image Prod.snd, (1 : ℝ) / (q : ℝ)) ≤ β) →
      (∑ z ∈ S, (1 : ℝ) / ((z.1 : ℝ) * (z.2 : ℝ))) ≤ α * β := by
    intro S α β hβ hα hin
    have h1 : (∑ z ∈ S, (1 : ℝ) / ((z.1 : ℝ) * (z.2 : ℝ))) =
        ∑ p ∈ S.image Prod.fst, ∑ z ∈ S.filter (fun z => z.1 = p),
          (1 : ℝ) / ((z.1 : ℝ) * (z.2 : ℝ)) :=
      (Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to (fun z hz => Finset.mem_image_of_mem Prod.fst hz) _).symm
    have h2 : ∀ p ∈ S.image Prod.fst, (∑ z ∈ S.filter (fun z => z.1 = p),
          (1 : ℝ) / ((z.1 : ℝ) * (z.2 : ℝ))) ≤ (1 / (p : ℝ)) * β := by
      intro p hp
      have e1 : (∑ z ∈ S.filter (fun z => z.1 = p), (1 : ℝ) / ((z.1 : ℝ) * (z.2 : ℝ))) =
          (1 / (p : ℝ)) * ∑ z ∈ S.filter (fun z => z.1 = p), (1 : ℝ) / (z.2 : ℝ) := by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro z hz
        rw [(Finset.mem_filter.mp hz).2, one_div_mul_one_div]
      have e2 : (∑ z ∈ S.filter (fun z => z.1 = p), (1 : ℝ) / (z.2 : ℝ)) =
          ∑ q ∈ (S.filter (fun z => z.1 = p)).image Prod.snd, (1 : ℝ) / (q : ℝ) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_image]
        intro x hx y hy hxy
        have hx1 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx).2
        have hy1 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hy).2
        exact Prod.ext (hx1.trans hy1.symm) hxy
      rw [e1, e2]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hin p hp) (by positivity)
    rw [h1]
    calc _ ≤ ∑ p ∈ S.image Prod.fst, (1 / (p : ℝ)) * β := Finset.sum_le_sum h2
      _ = (∑ p ∈ S.image Prod.fst, (1 : ℝ) / (p : ℝ)) * β := by rw [Finset.sum_mul]
      _ ≤ α * β := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hα hβ
  
  have pm : ∀ (u w : ℕ) (ea eb : Prop) [Decidable ea] [Decidable eb] (S : Finset (ℕ × ℕ)),
      0 < u → 0 < w →
      (∀ z ∈ S, z.1.Prime ∧ z.2.Prime ∧
        W ≤ (z.1 : ℝ) ∧ (z.1 : ℝ) ≤ v ∧ W ≤ (z.2 : ℝ) ∧ (z.2 : ℝ) ≤ v ∧
        (A0 * (u * (z.1 * (if ea then z.2 else 1))) + 1).Prime ∧
        (B0 * (w * (z.2 * (if eb then z.1 else 1))) + 1).Prime ∧
        A0 * (u * (z.1 * (if ea then z.2 else 1))) ≠ B0 * (w * (z.2 * (if eb then z.1 else 1))) ∧
        ((A0 * (u * (z.1 * (if ea then z.2 else 1))) : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ Y ∧
        ((B0 * (w * (z.2 * (if eb then z.1 else 1))) : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ Y) →
      (∑ z ∈ S, (1 : ℝ) / ((z.1 : ℝ) * (z.2 : ℝ))) ≤ K2 * K2 + K1 * K3 := by
    intro u w ea eb _ _ S hu hw hS
    have hK22 : 0 ≤ K2 * K2 := mul_nonneg hK2 hK2
    have hK13 : 0 ≤ K1 * K3 := mul_nonneg hK1 hK3
    rcases S.eq_empty_or_nonempty with hSe | ⟨z0, hz0⟩
    · rw [hSe, Finset.sum_empty]; linarith
    have hS' : ∀ p q : ℕ, (p, q) ∈ S → p.Prime ∧ q.Prime ∧
        W ≤ (p : ℝ) ∧ (p : ℝ) ≤ v ∧ W ≤ (q : ℝ) ∧ (q : ℝ) ≤ v ∧
        (A0 * (u * (p * (if ea then q else 1))) + 1).Prime ∧
        (B0 * (w * (q * (if eb then p else 1))) + 1).Prime ∧
        A0 * (u * (p * (if ea then q else 1))) ≠ B0 * (w * (q * (if eb then p else 1))) ∧
        ((A0 * (u * (p * (if ea then q else 1))) : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ Y ∧
        ((B0 * (w * (q * (if eb then p else 1))) : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ Y := fun p q h => hS (p, q) h
    have memfst : ∀ p, p ∈ S.image Prod.fst → ∃ q, (p, q) ∈ S := by
      intro p hp
      obtain ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hp
      exact ⟨z.2, hz⟩
    have memsl : ∀ p q, q ∈ (S.filter (fun z => z.1 = p)).image Prod.snd → (p, q) ∈ S := by
      intro p q hq
      obtain ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hq
      obtain ⟨hzS, hz1⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hz
      rw [← hz1]; exact hzS
    have hz0' : (z0.1, z0.2) ∈ S := hz0
    by_cases hea : ea
    · by_cases heb : eb
      · 
        simp only [if_pos hea, if_pos heb] at hS'
        have hb := bil S K1 K3 hK3 ?_ ?_
        · linarith
        · apply hprimes
          intro p hp
          obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := memfst p hp
          obtain ⟨g0, -, -, g3, -⟩ := hS' p q hq
          exact ⟨g0, g3⟩
        · intro p hp
          obtain ⟨q0, hq0⟩ := memfst p hp
          obtain ⟨g0, g1, g2, g3, g4, g5, g6, g7, g8, g9, g10⟩ := hS' p q0 hq0
          have eA : ∀ q, A0 * (u * (p * q)) = (A0 * (u * p)) * q := fun q => by ring
          have eB : ∀ q, B0 * (w * (q * p)) = (B0 * (w * p)) * q := fun q => by ring
          apply hthree (A0 * (u * p)) (B0 * (w * p))
          · exact Nat.mul_pos hA0 (Nat.mul_pos hu g0.pos)
          · exact Nat.mul_pos hB0 (Nat.mul_pos hw g0.pos)
          · intro hAB
            apply g8
            rw [eA, eB, hAB]
          · have h1 : A0 * (u * p) ≤ A0 * (u * (p * q0)) := by
              rw [eA]; exact le_mul_of_one_le_right (Nat.zero_le _) g1.one_lt.le
            exact le_trans (by exact_mod_cast h1) g9
          · have h1 : B0 * (w * p) ≤ B0 * (w * (q0 * p)) := by
              rw [eB]; exact le_mul_of_one_le_right (Nat.zero_le _) g1.one_lt.le
            exact le_trans (by exact_mod_cast h1) g10
          · intro q hq
            obtain ⟨-, h1, -, -, h4, h5, h6, h7, -⟩ := hS' p q (memsl p q hq)
            refine ⟨h1, ?_, ?_, h4, h5⟩
            · rw [← eA]; exact h6
            · rw [← eB]; exact h7
      · 
        simp only [if_pos hea, if_neg heb, mul_one] at hS'
        have hsw : (∑ z ∈ S, (1 : ℝ) / ((z.1 : ℝ) * (z.2 : ℝ))) =
            ∑ z ∈ S.image Prod.swap, (1 : ℝ) / ((z.1 : ℝ) * (z.2 : ℝ)) := by
          rw [Finset.sum_image (fun x _ y _ h => Prod.swap_injective h)]
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro z _
          simp only [Prod.fst_swap, Prod.snd_swap, mul_comm]
        have hT : ∀ q p, (q, p) ∈ S.image Prod.swap → (p, q) ∈ S := by
          intro q p h
          obtain ⟨z, hz, hzq⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp h
          have hz' : z = (p, q) := by simpa using congrArg Prod.swap hzq
          rw [← hz']; exact hz
        have memfst' : ∀ q, q ∈ (S.image Prod.swap).image Prod.fst → ∃ p, (p, q) ∈ S := by
          intro q hq
          obtain ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hq
          exact ⟨z.2, hT z.1 z.2 hz⟩
        have memsl' : ∀ q p,
            p ∈ ((S.image Prod.swap).filter (fun z => z.1 = q)).image Prod.snd → (p, q) ∈ S := by
          intro q p hp
          obtain ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hp
          obtain ⟨hzS, hz1⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hz
          have h := hT z.1 z.2 hzS
          rw [hz1] at h; exact h
        rw [hsw]
        have hb := bil (S.image Prod.swap) K2 K2 hK2 ?_ ?_
        · linarith
        · apply htwo (B0 * w)
          · exact Nat.mul_pos hB0 hw
          · obtain ⟨-, g1, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, g10⟩ := hS' z0.1 z0.2 hz0'
            have h1 : B0 * w ≤ B0 * (w * z0.2) := by
              rw [← mul_assoc]; exact le_mul_of_one_le_right (Nat.zero_le _) g1.one_lt.le

          · intro q hq
            obtain ⟨p, hpq⟩ := memfst' q hq
            obtain ⟨-, g1, -, -, g4, g5, -, g7, -⟩ := hS' p q hpq
            refine ⟨g1, ?_, g4, g5⟩
            rw [mul_assoc]; exact g7
        · intro q hq
          obtain ⟨p0, hp0⟩ := memfst' q hq
          obtain ⟨g0, g1, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, g9, -⟩ := hS' p0 q hp0
          have eA : ∀ p, A0 * (u * (p * q)) = (A0 * (u * q)) * p := fun p => by ring
          apply htwo (A0 * (u * q))
          · exact Nat.mul_pos hA0 (Nat.mul_pos hu g1.pos)
          · have h1 : A0 * (u * q) ≤ A0 * (u * (p0 * q)) := by
              rw [eA]; exact le_mul_of_one_le_right (Nat.zero_le _) g0.one_lt.le
            exact le_trans (by exact_mod_cast h1) g9
          · intro p hp
            obtain ⟨h0, -, h2, h3, -, -, h6, -⟩ := hS' p q (memsl' q p hp)
            refine ⟨h0, ?_, h2, h3⟩
            rw [← eA]; exact h6
    · 
      simp only [if_neg hea, mul_one] at hS'
      have hb := bil S K2 K2 hK2 ?_ ?_
      · linarith
      · apply htwo (A0 * u)
        · exact Nat.mul_pos hA0 hu
        · obtain ⟨g0, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, g9, -⟩ := hS' z0.1 z0.2 hz0'
          have h1 : A0 * u ≤ A0 * (u * z0.1) := by
            rw [← mul_assoc]; exact le_mul_of_one_le_right (Nat.zero_le _) g0.one_lt.le
          exact le_trans (by exact_mod_cast h1) g9
        · intro p hp
          obtain ⟨q, hpq⟩ := memfst p hp
          obtain ⟨g0, -, g2, g3, -, -, g6, -⟩ := hS' p q hpq
          refine ⟨g0, ?_, g2, g3⟩
          rw [mul_assoc]; exact g6
      · intro p hp
        obtain ⟨q0, hq0⟩ := memfst p hp
        obtain ⟨g0, g1, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, g10⟩ := hS' p q0 hq0
        have eB : ∀ q, B0 * (w * (q * (if eb then p else 1))) =
            (B0 * (w * (if eb then p else 1))) * q := fun q => by ring
        have hite : 0 < (if eb then p else 1) := by
          split_ifs
          · exact g0.pos
          · exact Nat.one_pos
        apply htwo (B0 * (w * (if eb then p else 1)))
        · exact Nat.mul_pos hB0 (Nat.mul_pos hw hite)
        · have h1 : B0 * (w * (if eb then p else 1)) ≤ B0 * (w * (q0 * (if eb then p else 1))) := by
            rw [eB]; exact le_mul_of_one_le_right (Nat.zero_le _) g1.one_lt.le
          exact le_trans (by exact_mod_cast h1) g10
        · intro q hq
          obtain ⟨-, h1, -, -, h4, h5, -, h7, -⟩ := hS' p q (memsl p q hq)
          refine ⟨h1, ?_, h4, h5⟩
          rw [← eB]; exact h7
  
  obtain ⟨pf, hpf⟩ : ∃ pf : (Fin m → ℕ) × (Fin n → ℕ) → ℕ,
      ∀ τ, pf τ = largestPrimeFactor (τ.1 c) := ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨qf, hqf⟩ : ∃ qf : (Fin m → ℕ) × (Fin n → ℕ) → ℕ,
      ∀ τ, qf τ = largestPrimeFactor (τ.2 c') := ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
  have hpq : ∀ τ ∈ G, (pf τ).Prime ∧ pf τ ∣ τ.1 c ∧ (qf τ).Prime ∧ qf τ ∣ τ.2 c' ∧
      pf τ ≠ qf τ := by
    intro τ hτ
    obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, p14, -, p16, -, p18⟩ := hG τ hτ
    have h1 : 1 < largestPrimeFactor (τ.1 c) := by
      have : (1 : ℝ) < (largestPrimeFactor (τ.1 c) : ℝ) := lt_of_lt_of_le hW p14
      exact_mod_cast this
    have h2 : 1 < largestPrimeFactor (τ.2 c') := by
      have : (1 : ℝ) < (largestPrimeFactor (τ.2 c') : ℝ) := lt_of_lt_of_le hW p16
      exact_mod_cast this
    obtain ⟨a1, a2⟩ := lpf _ h1
    obtain ⟨b1, b2⟩ := lpf _ h2
    rw [hpf, hqf]
    exact ⟨a1, a2, b1, b2, p18⟩
  
  have hk : ∀ τ, ∃ k : Fin m, τ ∈ G → k.val < i ∧ qf τ ∣ τ.1 k := by
    intro τ
    by_cases hτ : τ ∈ G
    · obtain ⟨-, -, p3, -, p5, -⟩ := hG τ hτ
      obtain ⟨-, -, hq, hqd, -⟩ := hpq τ hτ
      have hdvd : qf τ ∣ ∏ a, τ.1 a := by
        rw [p5]; exact hqd.trans (Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem _ (Finset.mem_univ c'))
      obtain ⟨a, -, ha⟩ := (Nat.Prime.prime hq).exists_mem_finset_dvd hdvd
      refine ⟨a, fun _ => ⟨?_, ha⟩⟩
      by_contra hlt
      have h1 := p3 a (not_lt.mp hlt)
      rw [h1] at ha
      exact hq.not_dvd_one ha
    · exact ⟨c, fun h => absurd h hτ⟩
  choose kf hkf using hk
  have hl : ∀ τ, ∃ l : Fin n, τ ∈ G → l.val < i ∧ pf τ ∣ τ.2 l := by
    intro τ
    by_cases hτ : τ ∈ G
    · obtain ⟨-, -, -, p4, p5, -⟩ := hG τ hτ
      obtain ⟨hp, hpd, -⟩ := hpq τ hτ
      have hdvd : pf τ ∣ ∏ b, τ.2 b := by
        rw [← p5]; exact hpd.trans (Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem _ (Finset.mem_univ c))
      obtain ⟨a, -, ha⟩ := (Nat.Prime.prime hp).exists_mem_finset_dvd hdvd
      refine ⟨a, fun _ => ⟨?_, ha⟩⟩
      by_contra hlt
      have h1 := p4 a (not_lt.mp hlt)
      rw [h1] at ha
      exact hp.not_dvd_one ha
    · exact ⟨c', fun h => absurd h hτ⟩
  choose lf hlf using hl
  
  obtain ⟨dl, hdl⟩ : ∃ dl : (Fin m → ℕ) × (Fin n → ℕ) → Fin m → ℕ, ∀ τ t,
      dl τ t = (if t = c then pf τ else 1) * (if t = kf τ then qf τ else 1) :=
    ⟨_, fun _ _ => rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨dr, hdr⟩ : ∃ dr : (Fin m → ℕ) × (Fin n → ℕ) → Fin n → ℕ, ∀ τ t,
      dr τ t = (if t = c' then qf τ else 1) * (if t = lf τ then pf τ else 1) :=
    ⟨_, fun _ _ => rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ : ∃ f : (Fin m → ℕ) × (Fin n → ℕ) → (Fin m → ℕ) × (Fin n → ℕ), ∀ τ,
      f τ = (fun t => τ.1 t / dl τ t, fun t => τ.2 t / dr τ t) := ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
  have hdvdl : ∀ τ ∈ G, ∀ t, dl τ t ∣ τ.1 t := by
    intro τ hτ t
    obtain ⟨hp, hpd, hq, -, hne⟩ := hpq τ hτ
    have hkd := ((hkf τ) hτ).2
    rw [hdl]
    by_cases h1 : t = c <;> by_cases h2 : t = kf τ
    · rw [if_pos h1, if_pos h2]
      rw [← h2, h1] at hkd
      rw [h1]
      exact Nat.Coprime.mul_dvd_of_dvd_of_dvd ((Nat.coprime_primes hp hq).mpr hne) hpd hkd
    · rw [if_pos h1, if_neg h2, mul_one, h1]; exact hpd
    · rw [if_neg h1, if_pos h2, one_mul, h2]; exact hkd
    · rw [if_neg h1, if_neg h2, mul_one]; exact one_dvd _
  have hdvdr : ∀ τ ∈ G, ∀ t, dr τ t ∣ τ.2 t := by
    intro τ hτ t
    obtain ⟨hp, -, hq, hqd, hne⟩ := hpq τ hτ
    have hld := ((hlf τ) hτ).2
    rw [hdr]
    by_cases h1 : t = c' <;> by_cases h2 : t = lf τ
    · rw [if_pos h1, if_pos h2]
      rw [← h2, h1] at hld
      rw [h1]
      exact Nat.Coprime.mul_dvd_of_dvd_of_dvd ((Nat.coprime_primes hq hp).mpr (Ne.symm hne)) hqd hld
    · rw [if_pos h1, if_neg h2, mul_one, h1]; exact hqd
    · rw [if_neg h1, if_pos h2, one_mul, h2]; exact hld
    · rw [if_neg h1, if_neg h2, mul_one]; exact one_dvd _
  have hdlpos : ∀ τ ∈ G, ∀ t, 0 < dl τ t := by
    intro τ hτ t
    obtain ⟨hp, -, hq, -, -⟩ := hpq τ hτ
    rw [hdl]
    apply Nat.mul_pos
    · split_ifs
      · exact hp.pos
      · exact Nat.one_pos
    · split_ifs
      · exact hq.pos
      · exact Nat.one_pos
  have hdrpos : ∀ τ ∈ G, ∀ t, 0 < dr τ t := by
    intro τ hτ t
    obtain ⟨hp, -, hq, -, -⟩ := hpq τ hτ
    rw [hdr]
    apply Nat.mul_pos
    · split_ifs
      · exact hq.pos
      · exact Nat.one_pos
    · split_ifs
      · exact hp.pos
      · exact Nat.one_pos
  have hR1 : ∀ τ ∈ G, ∀ t, (f τ).1 t * dl τ t = τ.1 t := by
    intro τ hτ t; rw [hf]; exact Nat.div_mul_cancel (hdvdl τ hτ t)
  have hR2 : ∀ τ ∈ G, ∀ t, (f τ).2 t * dr τ t = τ.2 t := by
    intro τ hτ t; rw [hf]; exact Nat.div_mul_cancel (hdvdr τ hτ t)
  have hpos1 : ∀ τ ∈ G, ∀ t, 0 < (f τ).1 t := by
    intro τ hτ t
    rw [hf]
    exact Nat.div_pos (Nat.le_of_dvd ((hG τ hτ).1 t) (hdvdl τ hτ t)) (hdlpos τ hτ t)
  have hpos2 : ∀ τ ∈ G, ∀ t, 0 < (f τ).2 t := by
    intro τ hτ t
    rw [hf]
    exact Nat.div_pos (Nat.le_of_dvd ((hG τ hτ).2.1 t) (hdvdr τ hτ t)) (hdrpos τ hτ t)
  have hprod1 : ∀ τ ∈ G, (∏ a, τ.1 a) = (∏ a, (f τ).1 a) * (pf τ * qf τ) := by
    intro τ hτ
    have e1 : (∏ a, τ.1 a) = ∏ a, ((f τ).1 a * dl τ a) :=
      Finset.prod_congr rfl (fun a _ => (hR1 τ hτ a).symm)
    rw [e1, Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
    congr 1
    simp only [hdl, Finset.prod_mul_distrib, Finset.prod_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
  have hprod2 : ∀ τ ∈ G, (∏ b, τ.2 b) = (∏ b, (f τ).2 b) * (pf τ * qf τ) := by
    intro τ hτ
    have e1 : (∏ b, τ.2 b) = ∏ b, ((f τ).2 b * dr τ b) :=
      Finset.prod_congr rfl (fun b _ => (hR2 τ hτ b).symm)
    rw [e1, Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
    congr 1
    simp only [hdr, Finset.prod_mul_distrib, Finset.prod_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
    ring
  have hdl1 : ∀ τ ∈ G, ∀ t : Fin m, i ≤ t.val → dl τ t = 1 := by
    intro τ hτ t ht
    have h1 : t ≠ c := fun h => by rw [h] at ht; omega
    have h2 : t ≠ kf τ := fun h => by have := ((hkf τ) hτ).1; rw [h] at ht; omega
    rw [hdl, if_neg h1, if_neg h2]
  have hdr1 : ∀ τ ∈ G, ∀ t : Fin n, i ≤ t.val → dr τ t = 1 := by
    intro τ hτ t ht
    have h1 : t ≠ c' := fun h => by rw [h] at ht; omega
    have h2 : t ≠ lf τ := fun h => by have := ((hlf τ) hτ).1; rw [h] at ht; omega
    rw [hdr, if_neg h1, if_neg h2]
  have hsh1 : ∀ τ ∈ G, (f τ).1 c * (pf τ * (if c = kf τ then qf τ else 1)) = τ.1 c := by
    intro τ hτ
    have h := hR1 τ hτ c
    rw [hdl, if_pos rfl] at h
    exact h
  have hsh2 : ∀ τ ∈ G, (f τ).2 c' * (qf τ * (if c' = lf τ then pf τ else 1)) = τ.2 c' := by
    intro τ hτ
    have h := hR2 τ hτ c'
    rw [hdr, if_pos rfl] at h
    exact h
  
  have hclass : ∀ kl : ℕ × ℕ, (∑ τ ∈ G.filter (fun τ => ((kf τ).val, (lf τ).val) = kl),
      (1 : ℝ) / ((∏ a, τ.1 a : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≤ (K2 * K2 + K1 * K3) * E := by
    intro kl
    set Gc := G.filter (fun τ => ((kf τ).val, (lf τ).val) = kl) with hGc
    have hGcG : ∀ τ ∈ Gc, τ ∈ G := fun τ hτ => (Finset.mem_filter.mp hτ).1
    have hkk : ∀ τ ∈ Gc, ∀ τ₂ ∈ Gc, kf τ = kf τ₂ ∧ lf τ = lf τ₂ := by
      intro τ hτ τ₂ hτ₂
      have e1 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hτ).2
      have e2 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hτ₂).2
      rw [← e2] at e1
      obtain ⟨e3, e4⟩ := Prod.mk.inj e1
      exact ⟨Fin.ext e3, Fin.ext e4⟩
    have hinj : ∀ τ ∈ Gc, ∀ τ₂ ∈ Gc, f τ = f τ₂ → pf τ = pf τ₂ → qf τ = qf τ₂ → τ = τ₂ := by
      intro τ hτ τ₂ hτ₂ hff hpp hqq
      obtain ⟨hk, hl⟩ := hkk τ hτ τ₂ hτ₂
      have hd1 : ∀ t, dl τ t = dl τ₂ t := fun t => by rw [hdl, hdl, hpp, hqq, hk]
      have hd2 : ∀ t, dr τ t = dr τ₂ t := fun t => by rw [hdr, hdr, hpp, hqq, hl]
      refine Prod.ext (funext fun t => ?_) (funext fun t => ?_)
      · rw [← hR1 τ (hGcG τ hτ) t, ← hR1 τ₂ (hGcG τ₂ hτ₂) t, hff, hd1]
      · rw [← hR2 τ (hGcG τ hτ) t, ← hR2 τ₂ (hGcG τ₂ hτ₂) t, hff, hd2]
    have hfib : ∀ b ∈ Gc.image f,
        (∑ τ ∈ Gc.filter (fun τ => f τ = b), (1 : ℝ) / ((∏ a, τ.1 a : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≤
          (1 / ((∏ a, b.1 a : ℕ) : ℝ)) * (K2 * K2 + K1 * K3) := by
      intro b hb
      obtain ⟨τ0, hτ0, hfb⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hb
      have hτ0G := hGcG τ0 hτ0
      have step1 : (∑ τ ∈ Gc.filter (fun τ => f τ = b), (1 : ℝ) / ((∏ a, τ.1 a : ℕ) : ℝ)) =
          (1 / ((∏ a, b.1 a : ℕ) : ℝ)) * ∑ τ ∈ Gc.filter (fun τ => f τ = b),
            (1 : ℝ) / ((pf τ : ℝ) * (qf τ : ℝ)) := by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro τ hτ
        obtain ⟨hτGc, hfτ⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hτ
        rw [hprod1 τ (hGcG τ hτGc), hfτ, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_mul, one_div_mul_one_div]
      have step2 : (∑ τ ∈ Gc.filter (fun τ => f τ = b), (1 : ℝ) / ((pf τ : ℝ) * (qf τ : ℝ))) =
          ∑ z ∈ (Gc.filter (fun τ => f τ = b)).image (fun τ => (pf τ, qf τ)),
            (1 : ℝ) / ((z.1 : ℝ) * (z.2 : ℝ)) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_image]
        intro x hx y hy hxy
        obtain ⟨hxG, hfx⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hx
        obtain ⟨hyG, hfy⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hy
        obtain ⟨e1, e2⟩ := Prod.mk.inj hxy
        exact hinj x hxG y hyG (hfx.trans hfy.symm) e1 e2
      have hpm := pm (b.1 c) (b.2 c') (c = kf τ0) (c' = lf τ0)
        ((Gc.filter (fun τ => f τ = b)).image (fun τ => (pf τ, qf τ)))
        (by rw [← hfb]; exact hpos1 τ0 hτ0G c) (by rw [← hfb]; exact hpos2 τ0 hτ0G c') ?_
      · rw [step1, step2]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpm (by positivity)
      · intro z hz
        obtain ⟨τ, hτ, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hz
        obtain ⟨hτGc, hfτ⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hτ
        have hτG := hGcG τ hτGc
        obtain ⟨hk, hl⟩ := hkk τ hτGc τ0 hτ0
        obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, p9, p10, p11, p12, p13, p14, p15, p16, p17, -⟩ := hG τ hτG
        obtain ⟨hp, -, hq, -, -⟩ := hpq τ hτG
        have s1 := hsh1 τ hτG
        have s2 := hsh2 τ hτG
        rw [hfτ, hk] at s1
        rw [hfτ, hl] at s2
        rw [← hpf τ] at p14
        rw [← hpf τ] at p15
        rw [← hqf τ] at p16
        rw [← hqf τ] at p17
        rw [← s1] at p9
        rw [← s1] at p11
        rw [← s1] at p12
        rw [← s2] at p10
        rw [← s2] at p11
        rw [← s2] at p13
        exact ⟨hp, hq, p14, p15, p16, p17, p9, p10, p11, p12, p13⟩
    have hall : (∑ b ∈ Gc.image f, (1 : ℝ) / ((∏ a, b.1 a : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≤ E := by
      apply halloc
      intro σ hσ
      obtain ⟨τ, hτ, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hσ
      have hτG := hGcG τ hτ
      obtain ⟨p1, p2, p3, p4, p5, p6, p7, p8, -⟩ := hG τ hτG
      obtain ⟨hp, -, hq, -, -⟩ := hpq τ hτG
      have hpq0 : 0 < pf τ * qf τ := Nat.mul_pos hp.pos hq.pos
      have u1 := hprod1 τ hτG
      have u2 := hprod2 τ hτG
      have hN0 : (∏ a, τ.1 a) ≠ 0 := (Finset.prod_pos (fun a _ => p1 a)).ne'
      have hdvd : (∏ a, (f τ).1 a) ∣ ∏ a, τ.1 a := ⟨pf τ * qf τ, u1⟩
      have hM0 : (∏ a, (f τ).1 a) ≠ 0 := (Finset.prod_pos (fun a _ => hpos1 τ hτG a)).ne'
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro t ht
        have h := hR1 τ hτG t
        rw [hdl1 τ hτG t ht, mul_one, p3 t ht] at h
        exact h
      · intro t ht
        have h := hR2 τ hτG t
        rw [hdr1 τ hτG t ht, mul_one, p4 t ht] at h
        exact h
      · apply Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_right hpq0
        rw [← u1, ← u2]; exact p5
      · exact Squarefree.squarefree_of_dvd hdvd p6
      · exact (Nat.primeFactors_mono hdvd hN0).trans p7
      · have hΩ : ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors (∏ a, (f τ).1 a) ≤
            ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors (∏ a, τ.1 a) := by
          rw [u1, ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors_mul hM0 hpq0.ne']
          exact Nat.le_add_right _ _
        exact le_trans (by exact_mod_cast hΩ) p8
    calc (∑ τ ∈ Gc, (1 : ℝ) / ((∏ a, τ.1 a : ℕ) : ℝ))
        = ∑ b ∈ Gc.image f, ∑ τ ∈ Gc.filter (fun τ => f τ = b),
            (1 : ℝ) / ((∏ a, τ.1 a : ℕ) : ℝ) :=
          (Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to (fun τ hτ => Finset.mem_image_of_mem f hτ) _).symm
      _ ≤ ∑ b ∈ Gc.image f, (1 / ((∏ a, b.1 a : ℕ) : ℝ)) * (K2 * K2 + K1 * K3) :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum hfib
      _ = (K2 * K2 + K1 * K3) * ∑ b ∈ Gc.image f, (1 : ℝ) / ((∏ a, b.1 a : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
          rw [Finset.mul_sum]
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro b _
          ring
      _ ≤ (K2 * K2 + K1 * K3) * E := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hall hKn
  
  have hmaps : ∀ τ ∈ G, ((kf τ).val, (lf τ).val) ∈ Finset.range i ×ˢ Finset.range i := by
    intro τ hτ
    exact Finset.mem_product.mpr
      ⟨Finset.mem_range.mpr ((hkf τ) hτ).1, Finset.mem_range.mpr ((hlf τ) hτ).1⟩
  calc (∑ τ ∈ G, (1 : ℝ) / ((∏ a, τ.1 a : ℕ) : ℝ))
      = ∑ kl ∈ Finset.range i ×ˢ Finset.range i,
          ∑ τ ∈ G.filter (fun τ => ((kf τ).val, (lf τ).val) = kl),
            (1 : ℝ) / ((∏ a, τ.1 a : ℕ) : ℝ) :=
        (Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to hmaps _).symm
    _ ≤ ∑ kl ∈ Finset.range i ×ˢ Finset.range i, (K2 * K2 + K1 * K3) * E :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum (fun kl _ => hclass kl)
    _ = (i : ℝ) ^ 2 * (K2 * K2 + K1 * K3) * E := by
        rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_product, Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul]
        push_cast
        ring

informal_problem.statement:
∀ (a b N d : ℕ), a < b → Squarefree d →
    Nat.Coprime d (6 * a * b * (b - a)) →
    |(((Finset.range N).filter (fun n => d ∣ n * (a * n + 1) * (b * n + 1))).card : ℝ) -
        (∏ p ∈ d.primeFactors, (3 : ℝ) / p) * N| ≤
      (3 : ℝ) ^ ArithmeticFunction.cardDistinctFactors d

signature.name: threeForm_count_error
signature.statement:
∀ (a b N d : ℕ), a < b → Squarefree d →
    Nat.Coprime d (6 * a * b * (b - a)) →
    |(((Finset.range N).filter (fun n => d ∣ n * (a * n + 1) * (b * n + 1))).card : ℝ) -
        (∏ p ∈ d.primeFactors, (3 : ℝ) / p) * N| ≤
      (3 : ℝ) ^ ArithmeticFunction.cardDistinctFactors d

proof.tactics:
by
  intro a b N d hab hd hcop
  have hd0 : 0 < d := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hd.ne_zero
  
  have hdiv : ∀ (k x : ℕ), k ∣ x * (a * x + 1) * (b * x + 1) ↔
      (x : ZMod k) * ((a : ZMod k) * (x : ZMod k) + 1) * ((b : ZMod k) * (x : ZMod k) + 1) = 0 := by
    intro k x
    rw [← ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff]
    simp only [Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
  
  have hzmod : ∀ (k : ℕ) [NeZero k],
      ((Finset.range k).filter (fun x => k ∣ x * (a * x + 1) * (b * x + 1))).card =
        ((Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod k)).filter
          (fun t => t * ((a : ZMod k) * t + 1) * ((b : ZMod k) * t + 1) = 0)).card := by
    intro k _
    have heq : ((Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod k)).filter
        (fun t => t * ((a : ZMod k) * t + 1) * ((b : ZMod k) * t + 1) = 0)).image ZMod.val =
        (Finset.range k).filter (fun x => k ∣ x * (a * x + 1) * (b * x + 1)) := by
      ext n
      constructor
      · intro hn
        obtain ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hn
        apply Finset.mem_filter.mpr
        refine ⟨Finset.mem_range.mpr (ZMod.val_lt t), ?_⟩
        apply (hdiv k t.val).mpr
        simpa only [ZMod.natCast_zmod_val] using (Finset.mem_filter.mp ht).2
      · intro hn
        obtain ⟨hnlt, hn⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hn
        refine Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨(n : ZMod k), ?_, ?_⟩
        · exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, (hdiv k n).mp hn⟩
        · exact ZMod.val_natCast_of_lt (Finset.mem_range.mp hnlt)
    rw [← heq, Finset.card_image_of_injective _ (ZMod.val_injective k)]
  
  have hprime : ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → ¬ p ∣ a → ¬ p ∣ b → ¬ p ∣ (b - a) →
      ((Finset.range p).filter (fun x => p ∣ x * (a * x + 1) * (b * x + 1))).card = 3 := by
    intro p hp hpa hpb hpba
    haveI : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
    rw [hzmod p]
    have hA : (a : ZMod p) ≠ 0 := fun h => hpa ((ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff a p).mp h)
    have hB : (b : ZMod p) ≠ 0 := fun h => hpb ((ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff b p).mp h)
    have hAB : (a : ZMod p) ≠ (b : ZMod p) := by
      intro h
      apply hpba
      rw [← ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff, Nat.cast_sub hab.le, h, sub_self]
    have key : ∀ (X t : ZMod p), X ≠ 0 → (X * t + 1 = 0 ↔ t = -X⁻¹) := by
      intro X t hX
      constructor
      · intro h
        apply mul_left_cancel₀ hX
        calc X * t = -1 := eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left h
          _ = X * -X⁻¹ := by simp [hX]
      · rintro rfl
        simp [hX]
    have hset : (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod p)).filter
        (fun t => t * ((a : ZMod p) * t + 1) * ((b : ZMod p) * t + 1) = 0) =
          {0, -(a : ZMod p)⁻¹, -(b : ZMod p)⁻¹} := by
      ext t
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_insert,
        Finset.mem_singleton, mul_eq_zero]
      rw [key _ t hA, key _ t hB, or_assoc]
    have h0A : (0 : ZMod p) ≠ -(a : ZMod p)⁻¹ :=
      fun h => inv_ne_zero hA (neg_eq_zero.mp h.symm)
    have h0B : (0 : ZMod p) ≠ -(b : ZMod p)⁻¹ :=
      fun h => inv_ne_zero hB (neg_eq_zero.mp h.symm)
    have hAB' : -(a : ZMod p)⁻¹ ≠ -(b : ZMod p)⁻¹ := by
      intro h
      exact hAB (inv_inj.mp (neg_inj.mp h))
    have hnot : (0 : ZMod p) ∉ ({-(a : ZMod p)⁻¹, -(b : ZMod p)⁻¹} : Finset (ZMod p)) := by
      simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton, not_or]
      exact ⟨h0A, h0B⟩
    rw [hset, Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hnot, Finset.card_pair hAB']
  
  have hcardk : ∀ (k : ℕ) [NeZero k],
      Nat.card {t : ZMod k // t * ((a : ZMod k) * t + 1) * ((b : ZMod k) * t + 1) = 0} =
        ((Finset.range k).filter (fun x => k ∣ x * (a * x + 1) * (b * x + 1))).card := by
    intro k _
    rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_subtype, hzmod]
  have hmul : ∀ m n : ℕ, 0 < m → 0 < n → m.Coprime n →
      ((Finset.range (m * n)).filter (fun x => m * n ∣ x * (a * x + 1) * (b * x + 1))).card =
        ((Finset.range m).filter (fun x => m ∣ x * (a * x + 1) * (b * x + 1))).card *
          ((Finset.range n).filter (fun x => n ∣ x * (a * x + 1) * (b * x + 1))).card := by
    intro m n hm hn hcop
    haveI : NeZero m := ⟨hm.ne'⟩
    haveI : NeZero n := ⟨hn.ne'⟩
    haveI : NeZero (m * n) := ⟨(Nat.mul_pos hm hn).ne'⟩
    let e := ZMod.chineseRemainder hcop
    have hmap : ∀ t : ZMod (m * n),
        t * ((a : ZMod (m * n)) * t + 1) * ((b : ZMod (m * n)) * t + 1) = 0 ↔
        (e t).1 * ((a : ZMod m) * (e t).1 + 1) * ((b : ZMod m) * (e t).1 + 1) = 0 ∧
        (e t).2 * ((a : ZMod n) * (e t).2 + 1) * ((b : ZMod n) * (e t).2 + 1) = 0 := by
      intro t
      constructor
      · intro ht
        have h := congrArg e ht
        simp only [map_mul, map_add, map_natCast, map_one, map_zero] at h
        exact ⟨congrArg (fun x : ZMod m × ZMod n => x.1) h,
          congrArg (fun x : ZMod m × ZMod n => x.2) h⟩
      · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
        apply e.injective
        simp only [map_mul, map_add, map_natCast, map_one, map_zero]
        exact Prod.ext h1 h2
    let E : {t : ZMod (m * n) // t * ((a : ZMod (m * n)) * t + 1) * ((b : ZMod (m * n)) * t + 1) = 0} ≃
        {t : ZMod m // t * ((a : ZMod m) * t + 1) * ((b : ZMod m) * t + 1) = 0} ×
        {t : ZMod n // t * ((a : ZMod n) * t + 1) * ((b : ZMod n) * t + 1) = 0} :=
      (e.toEquiv.subtypeEquiv hmap).trans
        (Equiv.subtypeProdEquivProd
          (p := fun t : ZMod m => t * ((a : ZMod m) * t + 1) * ((b : ZMod m) * t + 1) = 0)
          (q := fun t : ZMod n => t * ((a : ZMod n) * t + 1) * ((b : ZMod n) * t + 1) = 0))
    rw [← hcardk (m * n), ← hcardk m, ← hcardk n, ← Nat.card_prod]
    exact Nat.card_congr E
  
  let ρ : ArithmeticFunction ℕ :=
    ⟨fun k => ((Finset.range k).filter (fun x => k ∣ x * (a * x + 1) * (b * x + 1))).card, by simp⟩
  have hρ : ∀ k, ρ k = ((Finset.range k).filter (fun x => k ∣ x * (a * x + 1) * (b * x + 1))).card :=
    fun k => rfl
  have hρmult : ρ.IsMultiplicative := by
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hρ]
      simp
    · intro m n hcop
      rw [hρ, hρ, hρ]
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos m with rfl | hm
      · simp
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with rfl | hn
      · simp
      exact hmul m n hm hn hcop
  have hρd : ((Finset.range d).filter (fun x => d ∣ x * (a * x + 1) * (b * x + 1))).card =
      ∏ p ∈ d.primeFactors, (3 : ℕ) := by
    rw [← hρ d, ← hρmult.prod_primeFactors hd]
    refine Finset.prod_congr rfl (fun p hp => ?_)
    have hpp := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp
    have hpd := Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactors hp
    have hnd : ¬ p ∣ 6 * a * b * (b - a) :=
      (Nat.Prime.coprime_iff_not_dvd hpp).mp (Nat.Coprime.coprime_dvd_left hpd hcop)
    refine hprime p hpp ?_ ?_ ?_
    · intro h
      exact hnd (((h.mul_left 6).mul_right b).mul_right (b - a))
    · intro h
      exact hnd ((h.mul_left (6 * a)).mul_right (b - a))
    · intro h
      exact hnd (h.mul_left (6 * a * b))
  have hdc : (d : ℝ) = ∏ p ∈ d.primeFactors, (p : ℝ) := by
    rw [← Nat.cast_prod, Nat.prod_primeFactors_of_squarefree hd]
  have hcoef : (((Finset.range d).filter (fun x => d ∣ x * (a * x + 1) * (b * x + 1))).card : ℝ) / d =
      ∏ p ∈ d.primeFactors, (3 : ℝ) / p := by
    rw [Finset.prod_div_distrib, hρd, hdc]
    push_cast
    rfl
  have hle : (((Finset.range d).filter (fun x => d ∣ x * (a * x + 1) * (b * x + 1))).card : ℝ) ≤
      (3 : ℝ) ^ ArithmeticFunction.cardDistinctFactors d := by
    have h1 : ((Finset.range d).filter (fun x => d ∣ x * (a * x + 1) * (b * x + 1))).card ≤
        3 ^ ArithmeticFunction.cardDistinctFactors d := by
      rw [hρd]
      have hcard : d.primeFactors.card = ArithmeticFunction.cardDistinctFactors d := by
        rw [ArithmeticFunction.cardDistinctFactors_apply, ← Nat.toFinset_factors,
          List.card_toFinset]
      rw [← hcard, Finset.prod_const]
    exact_mod_cast h1
  
  have hcount_err : ∀ (P : ℕ → Prop) [DecidablePred P], Function.Periodic P d → ∀ M : ℕ,
      |(Nat.count P M : ℝ) - (Nat.count P d : ℝ) / d * M| ≤ Nat.count P d := by
    intro P _ hP M
    have hmulc : ∀ k : ℕ, Nat.count P (k * d) = k * Nat.count P d := by
      intro k
      induction k with
      | zero => simp
      | succ k ih =>
        have hshift : (fun n => P (n + k * d)) = P := funext (hP.nat_mul k)
        simp only [Nat.succ_mul, Nat.add_comm (k * d) d, Nat.count_add', hshift, ih]
        omega
    have hdm : Nat.count P M = (M / d) * Nat.count P d + Nat.count P (M % d) := by
      have hshift : (fun n => P (n + (M / d) * d)) = P := funext (hP.nat_mul (M / d))
      calc
        _ = Nat.count P (M % d + (M / d) * d) := by rw [Nat.mod_add_div']
        _ = _ := by simp only [Nat.count_add', hshift, hmulc]; omega
    have hdR : (0 : ℝ) < d := by exact_mod_cast hd0
    have hrem : (M % d : ℕ) ≤ d := (Nat.mod_lt M hd0).le
    have hremR : ((M % d : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ d := by exact_mod_cast hrem
    have hcount : (Nat.count P (M % d) : ℝ) ≤ Nat.count P d := by
      exact_mod_cast Nat.count_monotone P hrem
    have hterm : 0 ≤ (Nat.count P d : ℝ) / d * (M % d : ℕ) := by positivity
    have htermle : (Nat.count P d : ℝ) / d * (M % d : ℕ) ≤ Nat.count P d := by
      calc
        _ ≤ (Nat.count P d : ℝ) / d * d :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hremR (by positivity)
        _ = _ := div_mul_cancel₀ _ hdR.ne'
    have hN : (M : ℝ) = (M / d : ℕ) * (d : ℝ) + (M % d : ℕ) := by
      exact_mod_cast (by simpa only [Nat.mul_comm] using (Nat.div_add_mod M d).symm)
    have hdec : (Nat.count P M : ℝ) =
        (M / d : ℕ) * (Nat.count P d : ℝ) + (Nat.count P (M % d) : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast hdm
    have heq : (Nat.count P M : ℝ) - (Nat.count P d : ℝ) / d * M =
        (Nat.count P (M % d) : ℝ) - (Nat.count P d : ℝ) / d * (M % d : ℕ) := by
      rw [hdec, hN]
      field_simp
      ring
    rw [heq, abs_le]
    constructor <;> linarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (Nat.count P (M % d)) (α := ℝ)]
  have hper : Function.Periodic (fun n => d ∣ n * (a * n + 1) * (b * n + 1)) d := by
    intro n
    apply propext
    show d ∣ (n + d) * (a * (n + d) + 1) * (b * (n + d) + 1) ↔ d ∣ n * (a * n + 1) * (b * n + 1)
    have h : (n + d) * (a * (n + d) + 1) * (b * (n + d) + 1) =
        d * (a * b * (3 * n ^ 2 + 3 * n * d + d ^ 2) + (a + b) * (2 * n + d) + 1) +
          n * (a * n + 1) * (b * n + 1) := by
      ring
    rw [h]
    exact Nat.dvd_add_right (dvd_mul_right d _)
  have herr := hcount_err (fun n => d ∣ n * (a * n + 1) * (b * n + 1)) hper N
  simp only [Nat.count_eq_card_filter_range] at herr
  rw [hcoef] at herr
  exact herr.trans hle

signature.name: threeFold_factorization_count_le
signature.statement:
∀ m : ℕ, 0 < m →
    ((m.divisors ×ˢ m.divisors ×ˢ m.divisors).filter
      (fun t : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ => t.1 * t.2.1 * t.2.2 = m)).card ≤ 3 ^ ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors m

proof.tactics:
by
  have step : ∀ p n : ℕ, p.Prime → 0 < n →
      (((p * n).divisors ×ˢ (p * n).divisors ×ˢ (p * n).divisors).filter
        (fun t : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ => t.1 * t.2.1 * t.2.2 = p * n)).card ≤
      3 * ((n.divisors ×ˢ n.divisors ×ˢ n.divisors).filter
        (fun t : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ => t.1 * t.2.1 * t.2.2 = n)).card := by
    intro p n hp hn
    set T := ((n.divisors ×ˢ n.divisors ×ˢ n.divisors).filter
        (fun t : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ => t.1 * t.2.1 * t.2.2 = n)) with hT
    have hp0 : 0 < p := hp.pos
    have hn0 : n ≠ 0 := hn.ne'
    have hmemT : ∀ a b c : ℕ, a * b * c = n → (a, b, c) ∈ T := by
      intro a b c h
      rw [hT, Finset.mem_filter]
      refine ⟨?_, h⟩
      simp only [Finset.mem_product, Nat.mem_divisors]
      exact ⟨⟨⟨b * c, by rw [← h]; ring⟩, hn0⟩, ⟨⟨a * c, by rw [← h]; ring⟩, hn0⟩,
        ⟨⟨a * b, by rw [← h]; ring⟩, hn0⟩⟩
    have hsub : ((p * n).divisors ×ˢ (p * n).divisors ×ˢ (p * n).divisors).filter
        (fun t : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ => t.1 * t.2.1 * t.2.2 = p * n) ⊆
        T.image (fun t : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ => (p * t.1, t.2.1, t.2.2)) ∪
          T.image (fun t : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ => (t.1, p * t.2.1, t.2.2)) ∪
          T.image (fun t : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ => (t.1, t.2.1, p * t.2.2)) := by
      rintro ⟨a, b, c⟩ h
      rw [Finset.mem_filter] at h
      have habc : a * b * c = p * n := h.2
      have hdvd : p ∣ a * b * c := ⟨n, habc⟩
      simp only [Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_image]
      rcases (hp.dvd_mul.mp hdvd) with h1 | h3
      · rcases (hp.dvd_mul.mp h1) with ⟨a', rfl⟩ | ⟨b', rfl⟩
        · have : a' * b * c = n := by
            apply Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left hp0
            rw [← habc]; ring
          left; left
          exact ⟨(a', b, c), hmemT _ _ _ this, rfl⟩
        · have : a * b' * c = n := by
            apply Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left hp0
            rw [← habc]; ring
          left; right
          exact ⟨(a, b', c), hmemT _ _ _ this, rfl⟩
      · obtain ⟨c', rfl⟩ := h3
        have : a * b * c' = n := by
          apply Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left hp0
          rw [← habc]; ring
        right
        exact ⟨(a, b, c'), hmemT _ _ _ this, rfl⟩
    have i1 := Finset.card_image_le (s := T) (f := fun t : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ => (p * t.1, t.2.1, t.2.2))
    have i2 := Finset.card_image_le (s := T) (f := fun t : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ => (t.1, p * t.2.1, t.2.2))
    have i3 := Finset.card_image_le (s := T) (f := fun t : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ => (t.1, t.2.1, p * t.2.2))
    have u1 := Finset.card_union_le (T.image (fun t : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ => (p * t.1, t.2.1, t.2.2)))
      (T.image (fun t : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ => (t.1, p * t.2.1, t.2.2)))
    have u2 := Finset.card_union_le (T.image (fun t : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ => (p * t.1, t.2.1, t.2.2)) ∪
      T.image (fun t : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ => (t.1, p * t.2.1, t.2.2)))
      (T.image (fun t : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ => (t.1, t.2.1, p * t.2.2)))
    have hc := Finset.card_le_card hsub
    omega
  intro m
  induction m using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ m ih =>
    intro hm
    by_cases h1 : m = 1
    · subst h1
      rw [Nat.divisors_one, ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors_one, pow_zero]
      exact (Finset.card_filter_le _ _).trans (by simp)
    · have hp := Nat.minFac_prime h1
      obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := Nat.minFac_dvd m
      generalize m.minFac = p at hp hn
      have hnpos : 0 < n := by
        rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with h | h
        · subst h; simp at hn; omega
        · exact h
      have hnlt : n < m := by
        rw [hn]
        have := hp.two_le
        nlinarith
      have ihn := ih n hnlt hnpos
      subst hn
      have hΩ : ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors (p * n) = ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors n + 1 := by
        rw [ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors_mul hp.ne_zero hnpos.ne',
          ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors_apply_prime hp]
        ring
      rw [hΩ, pow_succ]
      calc _ ≤ 3 * _ := step p n hp hnpos
        _ ≤ 3 * 3 ^ ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors n := Nat.mul_le_mul_left 3 ihn
        _ = _ := by ring

informal_problem.statement:
(hT3 : ∀ m : ℕ, 0 < m →
      ((m.divisors ×ˢ m.divisors ×ˢ m.divisors).filter
        (fun t : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ => t.1 * t.2.1 * t.2.2 = m)).card ≤ 3 ^ ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors m) :
    ∀ (D M : ℕ),
      (∑ k ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 M).filter (fun k => k.Coprime D), (k : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ 3 ≤
        ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (M ^ 3),
          ∏ p ∈ m.primeFactors, ((if p ∣ D then 0 else 3 : ℝ) / p) ^ m.factorization p

signature.name: threeForm_density_sum_lower_bound
signature.statement:
(hT3 : ∀ m : ℕ, 0 < m →
      ((m.divisors ×ˢ m.divisors ×ˢ m.divisors).filter
        (fun t : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ => t.1 * t.2.1 * t.2.2 = m)).card ≤ 3 ^ ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors m) :
    ∀ (D M : ℕ),
      (∑ k ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 M).filter (fun k => k.Coprime D), (k : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ 3 ≤
        ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (M ^ 3),
          ∏ p ∈ m.primeFactors, ((if p ∣ D then 0 else 3 : ℝ) / p) ^ m.factorization p

proof.tactics:
by
  intro D M
  
  have s1 : ∀ m : ℕ, 0 < m → m.Coprime D →
      ∏ p ∈ m.primeFactors, ((if p ∣ D then 0 else 3 : ℝ) / p) ^ m.factorization p =
        (3 : ℝ) ^ ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors m / m := by
    intro m hm hcop
    have hden : (∏ p ∈ m.primeFactors, (p : ℝ) ^ m.factorization p) = m := by
      have h := Nat.factorization_prod_pow_eq_self hm.ne'
      rw [Finsupp.prod, Nat.support_factorization] at h
      exact_mod_cast h
    have hnum : (∏ p ∈ m.primeFactors, (3 : ℝ) ^ m.factorization p) =
        (3 : ℝ) ^ ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors m := by
      rw [Finset.prod_pow_eq_pow_sum, ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors_eq_sum_factorization,
        Finsupp.sum, Nat.support_factorization]
    calc _ = ∏ p ∈ m.primeFactors,
          ((3 : ℝ) ^ m.factorization p / (p : ℝ) ^ m.factorization p) := by
          apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
          intro p hp
          have hpp := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp
          have hpm := Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactors hp
          have hpD : ¬ p ∣ D := fun hpD => hpp.not_dvd_one (hcop ▸ Nat.dvd_gcd hpm hpD)
          rw [if_neg hpD, div_pow]
      _ = _ := by rw [Finset.prod_div_distrib, hden, hnum]
  
  let B := (Finset.Icc 1 M).filter (fun k => k.Coprime D)
  let C := (Finset.Icc 1 (M ^ 3)).filter (fun m => m.Coprime D)
  let S : ℕ → Finset (ℕ × ℕ × ℕ) := fun m =>
    (m.divisors ×ˢ m.divisors ×ˢ m.divisors).filter (fun t : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ => t.1 * t.2.1 * t.2.2 = m)
  let P := B ×ˢ B ×ˢ B
  let Q : Finset (Σ _ : ℕ, ℕ × ℕ × ℕ) := C.sigma S
  let f : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ → (Σ _ : ℕ, ℕ × ℕ × ℕ) := fun v => ⟨v.1 * v.2.1 * v.2.2, v⟩
  have hB : ∀ k ∈ B, 0 < k ∧ k ≤ M ∧ k.Coprime D := by
    intro k hk
    obtain ⟨hk1, hc⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hk
    exact ⟨(Finset.mem_Icc.mp hk1).1, (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hk1).2, hc⟩
  have hsub : P.image f ⊆ Q := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hx
    obtain ⟨ha, hbc⟩ := Finset.mem_product.mp hv
    obtain ⟨hb, hc⟩ := Finset.mem_product.mp hbc
    obtain ⟨ha1, ha2, ha3⟩ := hB _ ha
    obtain ⟨hb1, hb2, hb3⟩ := hB _ hb
    obtain ⟨hc1, hc2, hc3⟩ := hB _ hc
    have hpos : 0 < v.1 * v.2.1 * v.2.2 := Nat.mul_pos (Nat.mul_pos ha1 hb1) hc1
    apply Finset.mem_sigma.mpr
    refine ⟨Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨hpos, ?_⟩,
      Nat.Coprime.mul (Nat.Coprime.mul ha3 hb3) hc3⟩, ?_⟩
    · calc v.1 * v.2.1 * v.2.2 ≤ M * M * M := Nat.mul_le_mul (Nat.mul_le_mul ha2 hb2) hc2
        _ = M ^ 3 := by ring
    · refine Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨?_, rfl⟩
      exact Finset.mem_product.mpr
        ⟨Nat.mem_divisors.mpr ⟨dvd_mul_of_dvd_left (dvd_mul_right _ _) _, hpos.ne'⟩,
          Finset.mem_product.mpr
            ⟨Nat.mem_divisors.mpr ⟨dvd_mul_of_dvd_left (dvd_mul_left _ _) _, hpos.ne'⟩,
              Nat.mem_divisors.mpr ⟨dvd_mul_left _ _, hpos.ne'⟩⟩⟩
  have hinj : Set.InjOn f (P : Set (ℕ × ℕ × ℕ)) := by
    intro v _ w _ heq
    exact congrArg (fun x : Σ _ : ℕ, ℕ × ℕ × ℕ => x.2) heq
  have hexp : (∑ k ∈ B, (k : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ 3 = ∑ v ∈ P, ((v.1 * v.2.1 * v.2.2 : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
    rw [pow_three, Finset.sum_mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul_sum]
    simp only [P, Finset.sum_product]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro a _
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro b _
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro c _
    push_cast
    rw [mul_inv, mul_inv]
    ring
  have hmid : (∑ k ∈ B, (k : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ 3 ≤ ∑ m ∈ C, ((S m).card : ℝ) / m := by
    calc _ = ∑ v ∈ P, ((v.1 * v.2.1 * v.2.2 : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹ := hexp
      _ = ∑ x ∈ P.image f, (x.1 : ℝ)⁻¹ :=
        (Finset.sum_image (f := fun x : Σ _ : ℕ, ℕ × ℕ × ℕ => (x.1 : ℝ)⁻¹) hinj).symm
      _ ≤ ∑ x ∈ Q, (x.1 : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hsub
        intro x _ _
        positivity
      _ = ∑ m ∈ C, ∑ t ∈ S m, (m : ℝ)⁻¹ :=
        Finset.sum_sigma _ _ (fun x : Σ _ : ℕ, ℕ × ℕ × ℕ => (x.1 : ℝ)⁻¹)
      _ = _ := by simp only [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, div_eq_mul_inv]
  
  calc _ ≤ ∑ m ∈ C, ((S m).card : ℝ) / m := hmid
    _ ≤ ∑ m ∈ C, (3 : ℝ) ^ ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors m / m := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro m hm
      have hm0 : 0 < m := (Finset.mem_Icc.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp hm).1).1
      have h := hT3 m hm0
      have h' : ((S m).card : ℝ) ≤ (3 : ℝ) ^ ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors m := by
        exact_mod_cast h
      exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h' (Nat.cast_nonneg m)
    _ = ∑ m ∈ C, ∏ p ∈ m.primeFactors,
          ((if p ∣ D then 0 else 3 : ℝ) / p) ^ m.factorization p := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro m hm
      obtain ⟨hm1, hc⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hm
      exact (s1 m (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hm1).1 hc).symm
    _ ≤ _ := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.filter_subset _ _)
      intro m _ _
      apply Finset.prod_nonneg
      intro p _
      apply pow_nonneg
      apply div_nonneg _ (Nat.cast_nonneg p)
      split_ifs <;> norm_num

informal_problem.statement:
(∀ s : SelbergSieve,
      BoundingSieve.siftedSum (s := s.toBoundingSieve) ≤
        s.totalMass / (∑ l ∈ s.prodPrimes.divisors,
            if (l : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ s.level then s.nu l * ∏ p ∈ l.primeFactors, 1 / (1 - s.nu p) else 0) +
          ∑ d ∈ s.prodPrimes.divisors,
            if (d : ℝ) ≤ s.level then
              (3 : ℝ) ^ ArithmeticFunction.cardDistinctFactors d *
                |BoundingSieve.rem (s := s.toBoundingSieve) d|
            else 0) →
    (∀ (g : ℕ → ℝ) (P : ℕ) (y : ℝ), 1 ≤ y → Squarefree P →
      (∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → (p : ℝ) ≤ y → p ∣ P) →
      (∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → 0 ≤ g p ∧ g p < 1) →

        (∀ a : Fin (k + l), a.val = 0 → Y ^ (9 / 10 : ℝ) < (((s.1 a + 1 : ℕ)) : ℝ))) →

        (Y / ((d : ℝ) * R)) * (c * logLog Y) ^ (6 * k) * (k + 1 : ℝ) ^ ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors d *
          (Real.log (v k)) ^ (20 * (k + l : ℕ) * Real.log (k + l : ℕ) + 1 : ℝ) *
          (Real.log Y) ^ (-2 + (∑ idx ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (k - 1), fordWeight idx * (logLog (v idx) / logLog Y)) +
            (normalityDelta (logLog Y) / 2 * (∑ idx ∈ Finset.Icc 2 k, ((idx : ℝ) * Real.log idx + idx)) +
              2 * ∑ idx ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (k - 1), (logLog (v idx) / logLog Y - logLog (W idx) / logLog Y)))

subgoal_signatures.name: retained_cutoff_exponent_eventually
subgoal_signatures.statement:
{A : ℝ} (hA : 0 ≤ A) :
    ∀ᶠ Y : ℝ in atTop, ∀ (L : ℕ) (p : Fin (L + 1) → ℕ)
      (J : Fin (L + 1)) (C : Finset (Fin (J.val + 1))) (h b : ℝ),
      (L : ℝ) ≤ A * Real.log (logLog Y) → 1 ≤ (CollisionClass.remaining C).card →
      (∀ idx, 17 ≤ p idx) → Antitone p →
      (∑ idx ∈ Finset.Icc 1 L, fordWeight idx *
        CollisionFacet.extend (fun j => CollisionBox.primeCoordinate (logLog Y) (p j)) idx) ≤
          1 - (logLog Y) ^ (-1 / 8 : ℝ) →
      -2 + (∑ idx ∈ Finset.Icc 1 ((CollisionClass.remaining C).card - 1), fordWeight idx *
          (logLog (CollisionRecord.upper Y p (1 / logLog Y) h b J C idx) / logLog Y)) +
        (normalityDelta (logLog Y) / 2 *
            (∑ idx ∈ Finset.Icc 2 (CollisionClass.remaining C).card, ((idx : ℝ) * Real.log idx + idx)) +
          2 * ∑ idx ∈ Finset.Icc 1 ((CollisionClass.remaining C).card - 1),
            (logLog (CollisionRecord.upper Y p (1 / logLog Y) h b J C idx) / logLog Y -
              logLog (CollisionRecord.lower Y p (1 / logLog Y) h b J C idx) / logLog Y)) ≤
        -1 - (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (logLog Y) ^ (-1 / 8 : ℝ) +
          ((((2 * L + 1 : ℝ) * normalityDelta (logLog Y)) * L * Real.log ((L : ℝ) + 1) +
            normalityDelta (logLog Y) * ((L : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 * (Real.log ((L : ℝ) + 1) + 1) +
            2 * L * ((4 * L + 2 : ℝ) * normalityDelta (logLog Y) + 1 / logLog Y)) * logLog Y) /
            logLog Y

subgoal_signatures.name: retained_prefactor_saving_eventually
subgoal_signatures.statement:
{A c : ℝ} (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hc : 0 < c) (D : ℕ) (K : ℝ) :
    ∀ᶠ T : ℝ in atTop, ∀ (k l L : ℕ) (ζ E : ℝ),
      1 ≤ k + l → k + l ≤ L + 1 → (L : ℝ) ≤ A * Real.log T → ζ ≤ T ^ (-1 / 3 : ℝ) →
      E ≤ -1 - (1 / 2 : ℝ) * T ^ (-1 / 8 : ℝ) +
          ((((2 * L + 1 : ℝ) * normalityDelta T) * L * Real.log ((L : ℝ) + 1) +
            normalityDelta T * ((L : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 * (Real.log ((L : ℝ) + 1) + 1) +
            2 * L * ((4 * L + 2 : ℝ) * normalityDelta T + 1 / T)) * T) / T →
      (c * T) ^ (6 * k) * ((k : ℝ) + 1) ^ D *
          (Real.exp ((ζ + (2 * L + 3 : ℝ) * normalityDelta T) * T)) ^
            (20 * (k + l : ℕ) * Real.log (k + l : ℕ) + 1) * (Real.exp T) ^ E ≤
        (1 / Real.exp T) * Real.exp (-(1 / 4 : ℝ) * T ^ (7 / 8 : ℝ) - K * sieveErrorEnvelope T)

informal_problem.statement:
(hMERT : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ, 2 ≤ x →
      |(∑ p ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊x⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, (1 : ℝ) / p) - Real.log (Real.log x)| ≤ C)
    {A : ℝ} (hA : 0 ≤ A) (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) :
    ∀ᶠ Y : ℝ in atTop, ∀ (L : ℕ) (Λ : Finset (CollisionSum.Label L)),
      (L : ℝ) ≤ A * Real.log (logLog Y) →
      (∀ l ∈ Λ, ∃ (n : ℕ) (pr : Fin (L + 1) → ℕ) (J : Fin (L + 1)) (common : Finset (Fin (J.val + 1)))
          (right : Fin (J.val + 1) → ℕ) (residual : ℕ),
          (∀ idx : Fin (J.val + 1), idx.val = 0 → idx ∉ common) ∧
          CollisionClass.Conditions common d (CollisionRecord.commonProduct J pr common) n
            (normalityScale (logLog Y)) Y (CollisionSum.upper Y pr J common) (CollisionSum.lower Y pr J common)
            (CollisionRecord.leftPrimes J pr) right (CollisionRecord.tailPrimes J pr) residual ∧
          (∀ idx, 17 ≤ pr idx) ∧
          l = ((J, CollisionSum.box Y pr), CollisionSum.commonCode J common,
            CollisionRecord.commonProduct J pr common)) →
      (∑ l ∈ Λ, invTotient l.2.2) ≤ Real.exp ((6 * A + 7) * Real.log (logLog Y) ^ 2)

signature.statement:
(hMERT : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ, 2 ≤ x →
      |(∑ p ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊x⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, (1 : ℝ) / p) - Real.log (Real.log x)| ≤ C)

      (∀ l ∈ Λ, ∃ (n : ℕ) (pr : Fin (L + 1) → ℕ) (J : Fin (L + 1)) (common : Finset (Fin (J.val + 1)))

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have s1 : ∀ (x : ℕ → ℝ) (P : Finset ℕ), (∀ q ∈ P, 0 ≤ x q) → ∀ L : ℕ,
      (∑ s ∈ P.powerset.filter (fun s => s.card ≤ L), ∏ q ∈ s, x q) ≤ (1 + ∑ q ∈ P, x q) ^ L := by
    intro x P
    induction P using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty => intro _ L; rw [Finset.sum_filter]; simp
    | insert a P ha ih =>
      intro hx L
      have hxa : 0 ≤ x a := hx a (Finset.mem_insert_self a P)
      have hx' : ∀ q ∈ P, 0 ≤ x q := fun q hq => hx q (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hq)
      have ih' : ∀ L : ℕ, (∑ t ∈ P.powerset, if t.card ≤ L then ∏ q ∈ t, x q else 0) ≤
          (1 + ∑ q ∈ P, x q) ^ L := by
        intro L
        have := ih hx' L
        rwa [Finset.sum_filter] at this
      have hS0 : 0 ≤ ∑ q ∈ P, x q := Finset.sum_nonneg hx'
      rw [Finset.sum_filter, Finset.sum_powerset_insert ha, Finset.sum_insert ha]
      have key : (∑ t ∈ P.powerset,
          if (insert a t).card ≤ L then ∏ q ∈ insert a t, x q else 0) =
          x a * ∑ t ∈ P.powerset, (if t.card + 1 ≤ L then ∏ q ∈ t, x q else 0) := by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro t ht
        have hat : a ∉ t := fun h => ha (Finset.mem_powerset.mp ht h)
        rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hat, Finset.prod_insert hat]
        split_ifs <;> simp
      rw [key]
      rcases L with _ | k
      · have hz : (∑ t ∈ P.powerset, (if t.card + 1 ≤ 0 then ∏ q ∈ t, x q else 0)) = 0 :=
          Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun t _ => if_neg (by omega))
        rw [hz, mul_zero, add_zero, pow_zero]
        simpa using ih' 0
      · have h1 := ih' (k + 1)
        have h2 := ih' k
        simp only [Nat.add_le_add_iff_right]
        have hp : (1 + ∑ q ∈ P, x q) ^ k ≤ (1 + ∑ q ∈ P, x q + x a) ^ k :=
          pow_le_pow_left₀ (by linarith) (by linarith) k
        calc _ ≤ (1 + ∑ q ∈ P, x q) ^ (k + 1) + x a * (1 + ∑ q ∈ P, x q) ^ k :=
              add_le_add h1 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 hxa)
          _ = (1 + ∑ q ∈ P, x q) ^ k * (1 + ∑ q ∈ P, x q + x a) := by ring
          _ ≤ (1 + ∑ q ∈ P, x q + x a) ^ k * (1 + ∑ q ∈ P, x q + x a) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hp (by linarith)
          _ = _ := by ring
  
  have s2 : ∀ s : Finset ℕ, (∀ q ∈ s, q.Prime) → (∏ q ∈ s, q).totient = ∏ q ∈ s, (q - 1) := by
    intro s hs
    have hpos : 0 < ∏ q ∈ s, q := Finset.prod_pos (fun q hq => (hs q hq).pos)
    have h := Nat.totient_mul_prod_primeFactors (∏ q ∈ s, q)
    rw [Nat.primeFactors_prod hs, mul_comm (Nat.totient _)] at h
    exact Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left hpos h
  
  have s6 : ∀ᶠ Y : ℝ in atTop,
      1 + ∑ q ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊Y + 1⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, (((q - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))⁻¹ ≤ logLog Y ^ 2 := by
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hMERT
    have hLL : Tendsto logLog atTop atTop := Real.tendsto_log_atTop.comp Real.tendsto_log_atTop
    filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop (2:ℝ), hLL.eventually_ge_atTop (3 + 2 * |C|)] with Y hY hT
    have hstep : ∀ q ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊Y + 1⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime,
        (((q - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))⁻¹ ≤ 2 * ((1:ℝ) / q) := by
      intro q hq
      have hp := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hq).2
      have h2 := hp.two_le
      have hq1 : ((q - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) = (q:ℝ) - 1 := by
        rw [Nat.cast_sub (by omega)]; simp
      rw [hq1]
      have hq2 : (2:ℝ) ≤ q := by exact_mod_cast h2
      have : (1:ℝ) / ((q:ℝ) - 1) ≤ 2 / q := by
        rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (by linarith) (by linarith)]; linarith
      calc ((q:ℝ) - 1)⁻¹ = 1 / ((q:ℝ) - 1) := (one_div _).symm
        _ ≤ 2 / q := this
        _ = 2 * (1 / q) := by ring
    have hsum : ∑ q ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊Y + 1⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, (((q - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))⁻¹ ≤
        2 * ∑ q ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊Y + 1⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, (1:ℝ) / q := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]; exact Finset.sum_le_sum hstep
    have hM := hC (Y + 1) (by linarith)
    have hM' : ∑ q ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊Y + 1⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, (1:ℝ) / q ≤
        Real.log (Real.log (Y + 1)) + C := by
      have := (abs_le.mp hM).2; linarith
    have hll : Real.log (Real.log (Y + 1)) ≤ logLog Y + 1 := by
      have hY1 : Y + 1 ≤ Y ^ 2 := by nlinarith
      have hlogY : 0 < Real.log Y := Real.log_pos (by linarith)
      have hl1 : 0 < Real.log (Y + 1) := Real.log_pos (by linarith)
      have hl2 : Real.log (Y + 1) ≤ 2 * Real.log Y := by
        calc Real.log (Y + 1) ≤ Real.log (Y ^ 2) := Real.log_le_log (by linarith) hY1
          _ = 2 * Real.log Y := by rw [Real.log_pow]; push_cast; ring
      have hlog2 : Real.log 2 ≤ 1 := by
        have := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 2); linarith
      calc Real.log (Real.log (Y + 1)) ≤ Real.log (2 * Real.log Y) := Real.log_le_log hl1 hl2
        _ = Real.log 2 + Real.log (Real.log Y) := Real.log_mul (by norm_num) hlogY.ne'
        _ ≤ logLog Y + 1 := by unfold logLog; linarith
    have hT3 : 3 ≤ logLog Y := by linarith [abs_nonneg C]
    have hA1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hT (by linarith : 0 ≤ logLog Y)
    have hA2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hT3 (abs_nonneg C)
    nlinarith [le_abs_self C, abs_nonneg C]
  
  have s7 : ∀ T : ℝ, 4 ≤ T → 1 ≤ Real.log T → ∀ L : ℕ, (L : ℝ) ≤ A * Real.log T →
      ((L : ℝ) + 1) * (((⌈T⌉₊ : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1) ^ (L + 1) * (2 : ℝ) ^ (L + 1) * (T ^ 2) ^ L ≤
        Real.exp ((6 * A + 7) * Real.log T ^ 2) := by
    intro T hT hu L hL
    have hT0 : 0 < T := by linarith
    have h1 : (L:ℝ) + 1 ≤ T ^ L := by
      have h := Nat.lt_two_pow_self (n := L)
      have h' : L + 1 ≤ 2 ^ L := h
      calc (L:ℝ) + 1 ≤ (2:ℝ) ^ L := by exact_mod_cast h'
        _ ≤ T ^ L := pow_le_pow_left₀ (by norm_num) (by linarith) L
    have h2 : (((⌈T⌉₊ : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1) ^ (L + 1) ≤ (T ^ 2) ^ (L + 1) := by
      apply pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity)
      have := Nat.ceil_lt_add_one hT0.le
      nlinarith
    have h3 : (2:ℝ) ^ (L + 1) ≤ T ^ (L + 1) := pow_le_pow_left₀ (by norm_num) (by linarith) _
    have hprod : ((L : ℝ) + 1) * (((⌈T⌉₊ : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1) ^ (L + 1) * (2 : ℝ) ^ (L + 1) * (T ^ 2) ^ L ≤
        T ^ L * (T ^ 2) ^ (L + 1) * T ^ (L + 1) * (T ^ 2) ^ L := by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (by positivity)
      apply mul_le_mul _ h3 (by positivity) (by positivity)
      exact mul_le_mul h1 h2 (by positivity) (by positivity)
    have hpow : T ^ L * (T ^ 2) ^ (L + 1) * T ^ (L + 1) * (T ^ 2) ^ L = T ^ (6 * L + 3) := by ring
    have hexp : T ^ (6 * L + 3) = Real.exp (((6 * L + 3 : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log T) := by
      rw [Real.exp_nat_mul, Real.exp_log hT0]
    have hineq : ((6 * L + 3 : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log T ≤ (6 * A + 7) * Real.log T ^ 2 := by
      push_cast
      have hu0 : 0 ≤ Real.log T := by linarith
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hL hu0]
    calc _ ≤ _ := hprod
      _ = _ := hpow
      _ = _ := hexp
      _ ≤ _ := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hineq
  have hLL : Tendsto logLog atTop atTop := Real.tendsto_log_atTop.comp Real.tendsto_log_atTop
  filter_upwards [s6, hLL.eventually_ge_atTop 4, hLL.eventually_ge_atTop (Real.exp 1)]
    with Y h6 hT4 hTe
  intro L Λ hL hΛ
  have hT0 : 0 < logLog Y := by linarith
  have hu : 1 ≤ Real.log (logLog Y) := by
    simpa only [Real.log_exp] using Real.log_le_log (Real.exp_pos 1) hTe
  
  have s3 : ∀ (n : ℕ) (pr : Fin (L + 1) → ℕ) (J : Fin (L + 1)) (common : Finset (Fin (J.val + 1)))
      (right : Fin (J.val + 1) → ℕ) (residual : ℕ),
      CollisionClass.Conditions common d (CollisionRecord.commonProduct J pr common) n
        (normalityScale (logLog Y)) Y (CollisionSum.upper Y pr J common) (CollisionSum.lower Y pr J common)
        (CollisionRecord.leftPrimes J pr) right (CollisionRecord.tailPrimes J pr) residual →
      (∀ idx, 17 ≤ pr idx) → ∀ idx : Fin (L + 1), ((pr idx - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ Y := by
    intro n pr J common right residual hcond h17 idx
    have hsize : ((d * ((∏ i, (CollisionRecord.leftPrimes J pr i - 1)) *
        (∏ j, (CollisionRecord.tailPrimes J pr j - 1))) : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ Y :=
      hcond.size
    have hXpos : 0 < d * ((∏ i, (CollisionRecord.leftPrimes J pr i - 1)) *
        (∏ j, (CollisionRecord.tailPrimes J pr j - 1))) := by
      apply mul_pos hd
      apply mul_pos
      · apply Finset.prod_pos
        intro i _
        have := h17 (CollisionMatching.prefixIndex J i)
        simp only [CollisionRecord.leftPrimes]
        omega
      · apply Finset.prod_pos
        intro j _
        have := h17 (CollisionRecord.tailIndex J j)
        simp only [CollisionRecord.tailPrimes]
        omega
    have hdvd : pr idx - 1 ∣ d * ((∏ i, (CollisionRecord.leftPrimes J pr i - 1)) *
        (∏ j, (CollisionRecord.tailPrimes J pr j - 1))) := by
      by_cases h : idx.val ≤ J.val
      · have hi : CollisionRecord.leftPrimes J pr ⟨idx.val, by omega⟩ = pr idx :=
          congrArg pr (Fin.ext rfl)
        have h1 : CollisionRecord.leftPrimes J pr ⟨idx.val, by omega⟩ - 1 ∣
            ∏ i, (CollisionRecord.leftPrimes J pr i - 1) :=
          Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem (fun i => CollisionRecord.leftPrimes J pr i - 1)
            (Finset.mem_univ _)
        rw [hi] at h1
        exact dvd_mul_of_dvd_right (Dvd.dvd.mul_right h1 _) d
      · have hlt := idx.isLt
        have hi : CollisionRecord.tailPrimes J pr ⟨idx.val - J.val - 1, by omega⟩ =
            pr idx :=
          congrArg pr (Fin.ext (by simp only [CollisionRecord.tailIndex]; omega))
        have h1 : CollisionRecord.tailPrimes J pr ⟨idx.val - J.val - 1, by omega⟩ - 1 ∣
            ∏ j, (CollisionRecord.tailPrimes J pr j - 1) :=
          Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem (fun j => CollisionRecord.tailPrimes J pr j - 1)
            (Finset.mem_univ _)
        rw [hi] at h1
        exact dvd_mul_of_dvd_right (Dvd.dvd.mul_left h1 _) d
    exact (Nat.cast_le.mpr (Nat.le_of_dvd hXpos hdvd)).trans hsize
  
  have s4 : ∀ p : Fin (L + 1) → ℕ, (∀ idx, 17 ≤ p idx) → (∀ idx, ((p idx - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ Y) →
      CollisionSum.box Y p ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (L + 1) → Fin (⌈logLog Y⌉₊ + 1))).image
        (fun k : Fin (L + 1) → Fin (⌈logLog Y⌉₊ + 1) => fun idx : Fin (L + 1) =>
          if idx.val = 0 then (1 : ℝ) else (1 / logLog Y) * ((k idx : ℕ) : ℝ)) := by
    intro p h17 hle
    have hbound : ∀ idx, ⌈CollisionBox.shiftedCoordinate (logLog Y) (p idx) / (1 / logLog Y)⌉₊ <
        ⌈logLog Y⌉₊ + 1 := by
      intro idx
      apply Nat.lt_succ_of_le
      apply Nat.ceil_mono
      have heq : CollisionBox.shiftedCoordinate (logLog Y) (p idx) / (1 / logLog Y) =
          logLog (largestPrimeFactor (p idx - 1)) := by
        unfold CollisionBox.shiftedCoordinate
        field_simp
      rw [heq]
      have hn : 16 ≤ p idx - 1 := by have := h17 idx; omega
      have hP1 : 1 ≤ largestPrimeFactor (p idx - 1) := le_max_left _ _
      have hPn : largestPrimeFactor (p idx - 1) ≤ p idx - 1 :=
        max_le (by omega) (Finset.sup_le fun q hq => Nat.le_of_mem_primeFactors hq)
      have hPY : (largestPrimeFactor (p idx - 1) : ℝ) ≤ Y := (Nat.cast_le.mpr hPn).trans (hle idx)
      have hP1' : (1:ℝ) ≤ largestPrimeFactor (p idx - 1) := by exact_mod_cast hP1
      have hT' : 0 < Real.log (Real.log Y) := hT0
      unfold logLog
      have hl0 : 0 ≤ Real.log (largestPrimeFactor (p idx - 1)) := Real.log_nonneg hP1'
      have hlY : Real.log (largestPrimeFactor (p idx - 1)) ≤ Real.log Y :=
        Real.log_le_log (by linarith) hPY
      rcases hl0.eq_or_lt with h0 | hpos
      · rw [← h0, Real.log_zero]; exact hT'.le
      · exact Real.log_le_log hpos hlY
    refine Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨fun idx => ⟨_, hbound idx⟩, Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
    funext idx
    rfl
  
  have s5 : ∀ (n : ℕ) (pr : Fin (L + 1) → ℕ) (J : Fin (L + 1)) (common : Finset (Fin (J.val + 1)))
      (right : Fin (J.val + 1) → ℕ) (residual : ℕ),
      (∀ idx : Fin (J.val + 1), idx.val = 0 → idx ∉ common) →
      CollisionClass.Conditions common d (CollisionRecord.commonProduct J pr common) n
        (normalityScale (logLog Y)) Y (CollisionSum.upper Y pr J common) (CollisionSum.lower Y pr J common)
        (CollisionRecord.leftPrimes J pr) right (CollisionRecord.tailPrimes J pr) residual →
      (∀ idx, 17 ≤ pr idx) →
      CollisionRecord.commonProduct J pr common ∈
        ((((Finset.Iic ⌊Y + 1⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime).powerset.filter (fun s => s.card ≤ L)).image
          (fun s : Finset ℕ => ∏ q ∈ s, q)) := by
    intro n pr J common right residual hz hcond h17
    refine Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨common.image (CollisionRecord.leftPrimes J pr), ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_powerset]
      constructor
      · intro q hq
        obtain ⟨i, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hq
        rw [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Iic]
        refine ⟨?_, (hcond.normal_left i).1⟩
        apply Nat.le_floor
        have h1 := s3 n pr J common right residual hcond h17 (CollisionMatching.prefixIndex J i)
        have h17' := h17 (CollisionMatching.prefixIndex J i)
        rw [Nat.cast_sub (by omega), Nat.cast_one] at h1
        show ((pr (CollisionMatching.prefixIndex J i) : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ Y + 1
        linarith
      · calc (common.image (CollisionRecord.leftPrimes J pr)).card
            ≤ common.card := Finset.card_image_le
          _ ≤ (Finset.univ.erase (⟨0, Nat.succ_pos _⟩ : Fin (J.val + 1))).card :=
              Finset.card_le_card (fun i hi => Finset.mem_erase.mpr

    intro idx hi
    have hi1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ idx := by exact_mod_cast hi
    have hi0 : (0 : ℝ) < idx := by linarith
    have hip : (0 : ℝ) < (idx : ℝ) + 1 := by positivity
    have hlow := Real.one_sub_inv_le_log_of_pos (div_pos hip hi0)
    rw [Real.log_div hip.ne' hi0.ne', inv_div] at hlow
    have hl := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlow hip.le
    have hid₁ : ((idx : ℝ) + 1) * (1 - (idx : ℝ) / ((idx : ℝ) + 1)) = 1 := by
      field_simp
      ring
    rw [hid₁] at hl
    unfold fordWeight
    nlinarith [Real.log_nonneg hi1]
  
  have hsorted : (FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeList N).SortedGE :=
    (Nat.primeFactorsList_sorted N).reverse
  have hspec : ∀ i : ℕ, FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N i = 1 ∨
      (FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N i).Prime := by
    intro i
    by_cases hi : i < (FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeList N).length
    · right
      change ((FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeList N).getD i 1).Prime
      rw [List.getD_eq_getElem _ 1 hi]
      have hm : (FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeList N)[i] ∈ N.primeFactorsList :=
        List.mem_reverse.mp (List.getElem_mem hi)
      exact Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactorsList hm
    · left
      exact List.getD_eq_default _ _ (by omega)
  have hone : ∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N i := by
    intro i
    rcases hspec i with h | h
    · rw [h]
    · exact h.one_le
  have hanti : ∀ i i' : ℕ, i ≤ i' →
      FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N i' ≤ FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N i := by
    intro i i' hii
    by_cases hj : i' < (FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeList N).length
    · have hi : i < (FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeList N).length := lt_of_le_of_lt hii hj
      change (FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeList N).getD i' 1 ≤ (FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeList N).getD i 1
      rw [List.getD_eq_getElem _ 1 hi, List.getD_eq_getElem _ 1 hj]
      exact hsorted.antitone_get (show (⟨i, hi⟩ : Fin _) ≤ ⟨i', hj⟩ from hii)
    · have h1 : FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N i' = 1 := List.getD_eq_default _ _ (by omega)
      rw [h1]
      exact hone i
  have hle1 : FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N 1 ≤ N.totient := by
    have htpos : 0 < N.totient := Nat.totient_pos.mpr hN
    have hprod : (FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeList N).prod = N := by
      rw [List.prod_reverse, Nat.prod_primeFactorsList hN.ne']
    have hmem : ∀ a, a ∈ FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeList N → a.Prime := fun a ha =>
      Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactorsList (List.mem_reverse.mp ha)
    have h01 := hanti 0 1 (by omega)
    change (FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeList N).getD 1 1 ≤ N.totient
    change (FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeList N).getD 1 1 ≤ (FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeList N).getD 0 1 at h01
    revert hprod hmem h01
    generalize FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeList N = l
    intro hprod hmem h01
    match l, hprod, hmem, h01 with
    | [], _, _, _ => exact htpos
    | [_], _, _, _ => exact htpos
    | p :: q :: l, hprod, hmem, h01 =>
      have hp : p.Prime := hmem p (by simp)
      have hq : q.Prime := hmem q (by simp)
      have hqp : q ≤ p := by simpa using h01
      have hd : p * q ∣ N := ⟨l.prod, by rw [← hprod]; simp [mul_assoc]⟩
      have ht := Nat.le_of_dvd htpos (Nat.totient_dvd_of_dvd hd)
      have hkey : q ≤ (p * q).totient := by
        by_cases he : p = q
        · subst he
          rw [Nat.totient_mul_of_prime_of_dvd hp dvd_rfl, Nat.totient_prime hp]
          have h := hp.two_le
          exact Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right p (by omega)
        · have hqp' : q ≤ p - 1 := by omega
          have hq1 : 1 ≤ q - 1 := by have := hq.two_le; omega
          have hs := Nat.totient_super_multiplicative p q
          rw [Nat.totient_prime hp, Nat.totient_prime hq] at hs
          exact hqp'.trans ((Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right (p - 1) (by omega)).trans hs)
      simpa using hkey.trans ht
  
  have hx1 : (1 : ℝ) < x := by
    have := Real.add_one_le_exp (1 : ℝ)
    linarith
  have hx0 : (0 : ℝ) < x := by linarith
  have hlogx : 0 < Real.log x := Real.log_pos hx1
  have hLLmono : ∀ a b : ℝ, 1 ≤ a → a ≤ b →
      FordBadFacet.positiveLogLog a ≤ FordBadFacet.positiveLogLog b := by
    intro a b ha hab
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le ha with heq | hlt
    · rw [← heq]
      have h0 : FordBadFacet.positiveLogLog 1 = 0 := by
        simp [FordBadFacet.positiveLogLog, logLog]
      rw [h0]
      exact le_max_left _ _
    · apply max_le_max_left 0
      unfold logLog
      exact Real.log_le_log (Real.log_pos hlt) (Real.log_le_log (by linarith) hab)
  have hPx : ∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → (FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N i : ℝ) ≤ x := by
    intro i hi
    have h := (hanti 1 i hi).trans hle1
    exact (Nat.cast_le.mpr h).trans hphi
  
  set q : ℕ → ℝ := FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeCoordinate (logLog x) N with hqdef
  have hq0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ q i := fun i => div_nonneg (le_max_left _ _) hT.le
  have hq1 : ∀ i, 1 ≤ i → q i ≤ 1 := by
    intro i hi
    have h := hLLmono _ _ (by exact_mod_cast hone i) (hPx i hi)
    have hxx : FordBadFacet.positiveLogLog x = logLog x := max_eq_right hT.le
    rw [hxx] at h
    exact (div_le_one hT).mpr h
  have hqanti : ∀ i i' : ℕ, i ≤ i' → q i' ≤ q i := by
    intro i i' hii
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
      (hLLmono _ _ (by exact_mod_cast hone i') (by exact_mod_cast hanti i i' hii)) hT.le
  
  have hmono : ∀ a k k' : ℕ, k ≤ k' →
      FordBadFacet.shiftedFacet q a k ≤ FordBadFacet.shiftedFacet q a k' := by
    intro a k k' hk
    unfold FordBadFacet.shiftedFacet
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun i => fordWeight (i + 1) * q (a + i + 1)) k,
      Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun i => fordWeight (i + 1) * q (a + i + 1)) k']
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.range_subset_range.mpr hk)
      (fun i _ _ => mul_nonneg (hw _ (by omega)) (hq0 _))
  have htail : ∀ (K : ℕ) (i : Fin K), i.val + 2 < K →
      FordGeometry.tailForm i (fun k : Fin K => q (k.val + 1)) =
        FordBadFacet.shiftedFacet q (i.val + 1) (K - (i.val + 1)) := by
    intro K i hi
    have e1 : FordGeometry.tailForm i (fun k : Fin K => q (k.val + 1)) =
        ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K, (if i.val < k then fordWeight (k - i.val) else 0) * q (k + 1) := by
      rw [← Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range
        (fun k => (if i.val < k then fordWeight (k - i.val) else 0) * q (k + 1)) K]
      show ∑ k : Fin K, FordGeometry.tailWeight i k * q (k.val + 1) = _
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro k _
      simp [FordGeometry.tailWeight, hi]
    have e2 : ∀ n : ℕ, ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (i.val + 1 + n),
        (if i.val < k then fordWeight (k - i.val) else 0) * q (k + 1) =
          ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, fordWeight (k + 1) * q (i.val + 1 + k + 1) := by
      intro n
      rw [Finset.sum_range_add, Finset.sum_eq_zero, zero_add]
      · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro k _
        rw [if_pos (by omega), show i.val + 1 + k - i.val = k + 1 by omega]
      · intro k hk
        have := Finset.mem_range.mp hk
        rw [if_neg (by omega), zero_mul]
    have e3 := e2 (K - (i.val + 1))
    rw [show i.val + 1 + (K - (i.val + 1)) = K by omega] at e3
    rw [e1, e3, FordBadFacet.shiftedFacet,
      Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun k => fordWeight (k + 1) * q (i.val + 1 + k + 1))]
  
  have hjL : j + 1 < L := hfirst.1
  have hrows : ∀ i < j, FordBadFacet.RowHolds L ξ q i := hfirst.2.2
  have hrow0 : FordBadFacet.shiftedFacet q 0 L ≤ ξ 0 := by
    have h := hrows 0 hj
    unfold FordBadFacet.RowHolds at h
    rw [if_pos rfl] at h
    exact h
  
  have hpoly : (fun idx : Fin (j - 1) => q (idx.val + 1)) ∈ FordGeometry.polytope (j - 1) ξ := by
    refine ⟨fun idx => hq0 _, fun idx => hq1 _ (by omega), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro a b hab
      exact hqanti _ _ (Nat.add_le_add_right (Fin.le_def.mp hab) 1)
    · have e : FordGeometry.outerForm (j - 1) (fun idx : Fin (j - 1) => q (idx.val + 1)) =
          FordBadFacet.shiftedFacet q 0 (j - 1) := by
        show ∑ idx : Fin (j - 1), fordWeight (idx.val + 1) * q (idx.val + 1) =
          ∑ idx : Fin (j - 1), fordWeight (idx.val + 1) * q (0 + idx.val + 1)
        simp only [Nat.zero_add]
      refine e.trans_le ?_
      exact (hmono 0 (j - 1) L (by omega)).trans hrow0
    · intro idx hidx
      by_cases hrow : idx.val + 2 < j - 1
      · refine (htail (j - 1) idx hrow).trans_le ?_
        have h := hrows (idx.val + 1) (by omega)
        unfold FordBadFacet.RowHolds at h
        rw [if_neg (by omega)] at h
        exact (hmono _ _ _ (by omega)).trans h
      · have hlast : FordGeometry.tailForm idx (fun k : Fin (j - 1) => q (k.val + 1)) =
            q (idx.val + 1 + 1) := by
          show ∑ k : Fin (j - 1), FordGeometry.tailWeight idx k * q (k.val + 1) = _
          rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (⟨idx.val + 1, by omega⟩ : Fin (j - 1))]
          · simp [FordGeometry.tailWeight, hrow]
          · intro k _ hk
            have hk' : k.val ≠ idx.val + 1 := fun h => hk (Fin.ext h)
            have hnot : ¬ idx.val < k.val := by have := k.isLt; omega
            simp [FordGeometry.tailWeight, hnot]
          · intro h
            exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ _) h
        refine hlast.trans_le ?_
        exact (hqanti (idx.val + 1) (idx.val + 1 + 1) (by omega)).trans
          (le_mul_of_one_le_left (hq0 _) (hξ _))
  
  have hee : Real.exp (Real.exp (logLog x)) = x := by
    unfold logLog
    rw [Real.exp_log hlogx, Real.exp_log hx0]
  have hQle : ∀ idx : Fin (j - 1), FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N (idx.val + 1) ≤ ⌊x⌋₊ :=
    fun idx => Nat.le_floor (hPx _ (by omega))
  have hprodle : (∏ idx : Fin (j - 1), FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N (idx.val + 1)) ≤
      ⌊x⌋₊ ^ (j - 1) := by
    have h := Finset.prod_le_pow_card (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (j - 1)))
      (fun idx => FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N (idx.val + 1)) ⌊x⌋₊ (fun idx _ => hQle idx)
    simpa only [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] using h
  have hprodpos : 0 < ∏ idx : Fin (j - 1), FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N (idx.val + 1) :=
    Finset.prod_pos (fun idx _ => hone _)
  unfold FordReciprocal.tupleIntegers
  rw [hee]
  refine Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨hprodpos, hprodle⟩,
    fun idx => FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N (idx.val + 1), rfl, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro idx
    rcases hspec (idx.val + 1) with h | h
    · exact Or.inr h
    · exact Or.inl h
  · intro a b hab
    exact hanti _ _ (Nat.add_le_add_right (Fin.le_def.mp hab) 1)
  · exact hpoly

informal_problem.statement:
{N L j : ℕ} {T H : ℝ} {ξ : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hN : 0 < N) (hT : 0 < T) (hξ : ∀ i, 1 ≤ ξ i) (hξmono : Monotone ξ)
    (hfirst : FordBadFacet.FirstFailedRow L ξ (FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeCoordinate T N) j)
    (hj : 0 < j) (hH : 1 ≤ H) (hSq : NoLargePrimeSquare N H)
    (hlarge : H < (FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N 0 : ℝ)) :
    N.totient = (FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N 0 - 1) *
      (∏ idx : Fin (j - 1), FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N (idx.val + 1)).totient *
      (FordBadFacet.ordinarySuffix N j).totient
