proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hw1 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ fordWeight 1 := by
    unfold fordWeight
    have h2 := Real.log_two_gt_d9
    norm_num
    linarith
  have hw : ∀ n : ℕ, fordWeight n ≤ fordWeight (n + 1) := by
    intro n
    unfold fordWeight
    push_cast
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with rfl | hn
    · have h2 := Real.log_two_gt_d9
      norm_num
      linarith
    · have hn' : (1 : ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast hn
      have hn0 : (0 : ℝ) < n := by linarith
      have ha : Real.log ((n : ℝ) + 1) - Real.log ((n : ℝ) + 1 + 1) ≤
          ((n : ℝ) + 1) / ((n : ℝ) + 1 + 1) - 1 := by
        rw [← Real.log_div (by positivity) (by positivity)]
        exact Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by positivity)
      have hb : Real.log ((n : ℝ) + 1) - Real.log n ≤ ((n : ℝ) + 1) / n - 1 := by
        rw [← Real.log_div (by positivity) (by positivity)]
        exact Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by positivity)
      have ha' : ((n : ℝ) + 1 + 1) * (Real.log ((n : ℝ) + 1) - Real.log ((n : ℝ) + 1 + 1)) ≤ -1 := by
        have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ha (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) + 1 + 1)
        have e : ((n : ℝ) + 1 + 1) * (((n : ℝ) + 1) / ((n : ℝ) + 1 + 1) - 1) = -1 := by
          field_simp
          ring
        linarith
      have hb' : (n : ℝ) * (Real.log ((n : ℝ) + 1) - Real.log n) ≤ 1 := by
        have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb hn0.le
        have e : (n : ℝ) * (((n : ℝ) + 1) / n - 1) = 1 := by
          field_simp
          ring
        linarith
      nlinarith [ha', hb']
  
  have key : ∀ q : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ i, 0 ≤ q i) → FordBadFacet.FirstFailedRow L ξ q j →
      ∀ j0 : ℕ, j = j0 + 1 → 1 ≤ j0 → q (j0 + 1) < q j0 := by
    intro q hq hff j0 hj0 hj01
    subst hj0
    obtain ⟨hjL, hfail, hprev⟩ := hff
    have hF : ξ (j0 + 1) * q (j0 + 1) < FordBadFacet.shiftedFacet q (j0 + 1) (L - (j0 + 1)) := by
      unfold FordBadFacet.RowHolds at hfail
      rw [if_neg (by omega)] at hfail
      exact lt_of_not_ge hfail
    have hG : FordBadFacet.shiftedFacet q j0 (L - j0) ≤ ξ j0 * q j0 := by
      have := hprev j0 (by omega)
      unfold FordBadFacet.RowHolds at this
      rwa [if_neg (by omega)] at this
    have hLe : L - j0 = (L - (j0 + 1)) + 1 := by omega
    have hsplit : FordBadFacet.shiftedFacet q j0 (L - j0) = fordWeight 1 * q (j0 + 1) +
        ∑ t : Fin (L - (j0 + 1)), fordWeight (t.val + 1 + 1) * q (j0 + 1 + t.val + 1) := by
      unfold FordBadFacet.shiftedFacet
      rw [hLe, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
      have e0 : ∀ t : Fin (L - (j0 + 1)),
          fordWeight ((Fin.succ t : Fin _).val + 1) * q (j0 + (Fin.succ t : Fin _).val + 1) =
            fordWeight (t.val + 1 + 1) * q (j0 + 1 + t.val + 1) := by
        intro t
        rw [Fin.val_succ, show j0 + (t.val + 1) + 1 = j0 + 1 + t.val + 1 by omega]
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun t _ => e0 t)]
      simp
    have hterm : FordBadFacet.shiftedFacet q (j0 + 1) (L - (j0 + 1)) ≤
        ∑ t : Fin (L - (j0 + 1)), fordWeight (t.val + 1 + 1) * q (j0 + 1 + t.val + 1) := by
      unfold FordBadFacet.shiftedFacet
      exact Finset.sum_le_sum (fun t _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hw _) (hq _))
    have hw1q : 0 ≤ fordWeight 1 * q (j0 + 1) := mul_nonneg hw1 (hq _)
    have hmono : ξ j0 * q (j0 + 1) ≤ ξ (j0 + 1) * q (j0 + 1) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hξmono (by omega)) (hq _)
    have hlt : ξ j0 * q (j0 + 1) < ξ j0 * q j0 := by linarith
    exact lt_of_mul_lt_mul_left hlt (le_trans zero_le_one (hξ j0))
  
  have s3 : ∀ (l : List ℕ) (k : ℕ), (∏ idx : Fin k, l.getD idx.val 1) = (l.take k).prod := by
    intro l
    induction l with
    | nil => intro k; simp
    | cons a l ih =>
      intro k
      cases k with
      | zero => simp
      | succ k =>
        rw [Fin.prod_univ_succ, List.take_succ_cons, List.prod_cons, ← ih k]
        rfl
  
  have s4 : ∀ (rest : List ℕ) (k : ℕ), List.Pairwise (fun a b => b ≤ a) rest → 1 ≤ k →
      rest.getD k 1 ≠ rest.getD (k - 1) 1 → ∀ a ∈ rest.take k, ∀ b ∈ rest.drop k, b ≠ a := by
    intro rest k hs hk hgap a ha b hb
    obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := List.getElem_of_mem ha
    obtain ⟨i', hi', rfl⟩ := List.getElem_of_mem hb
    have hi2 : i < min k rest.length := by simpa using hi
    have hi2' : i' < rest.length - k := by simpa using hi'
    simp only [List.getElem_take, List.getElem_drop]
    have hmono : ∀ s t (hs' : s < rest.length) (ht : t < rest.length), s ≤ t → rest[t] ≤ rest[s] := by
      intro s t hs' ht hst
      rcases Nat.lt_or_eq_of_le hst with h | h
      · exact List.pairwise_iff_getElem.mp hs s t hs' ht h
      · subst h; exact le_refl _
    have hkl : k < rest.length := by omega
    have hk1 : k - 1 < rest.length := by omega
    rw [List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ hkl, List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ hk1] at hgap
    have h1 := hmono (k - 1) k hk1 hkl (by omega)
    have h2 := hmono i (k - 1) (by omega) hk1 (by omega)
    have h3 := hmono k (k + i') hkl (by omega) (by omega)
    have h4 : rest[k] < rest[k - 1] := lt_of_le_of_ne h1 hgap
    exact ne_of_lt (lt_of_le_of_lt h3 (lt_of_lt_of_le h4 h2))
  
  have s5 : ∀ (p : ℕ) (rest : List ℕ) (k : ℕ), (∀ r ∈ p :: rest, r.Prime) → p ∉ rest →
      (∀ a ∈ rest.take k, ∀ b ∈ rest.drop k, b ≠ a) →
      ((p :: rest).prod).totient =
        (p - 1) * ((rest.take k).prod).totient * ((rest.drop k).prod).totient := by
    intro p rest k hprime htop hdisj
    have hpp : p.Prime := hprime p (List.mem_cons_self ..)
    have hr : ∀ r ∈ rest, r.Prime := fun r hr => hprime r (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hr)
    have hAB : Nat.Coprime (rest.take k).prod (rest.drop k).prod := by
      rw [Nat.coprime_list_prod_left_iff]
      intro a ha
      rw [Nat.coprime_list_prod_right_iff]
      intro b hb
      exact (Nat.coprime_primes (hr a (List.mem_of_mem_take ha))
        (hr b (List.mem_of_mem_drop hb))).mpr (hdisj a ha b hb).symm
    have hpR : Nat.Coprime p rest.prod := by
      rw [Nat.coprime_list_prod_right_iff]
      intro r hrr
      exact (Nat.coprime_primes hpp (hr r hrr)).mpr (fun h => htop (h ▸ hrr))
    rw [List.prod_cons, Nat.totient_mul hpR, Nat.totient_prime hpp,
      ← List.prod_take_mul_prod_drop rest k, Nat.totient_mul hAB, mul_assoc]
  
  obtain ⟨j', rfl⟩ : ∃ j', j = j' + 1 := ⟨j - 1, by omega⟩
  have hlne : N.primeFactorsList.reverse ≠ [] := by
    intro h
    have h1 : FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N 0 = 1 := by
      simp [FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt, FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeList, h]
    rw [h1] at hlarge
    push_cast at hlarge
    linarith
  obtain ⟨p, rest, hl⟩ := List.exists_cons_of_ne_nil hlne
  have hP0 : FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N 0 = p := by
    simp [FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt, FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeList, hl]
  have hPs : ∀ i, FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N (i + 1) = rest.getD i 1 := by
    intro i
    simp [FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt, FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeList, hl]
  have hprime : ∀ r ∈ p :: rest, r.Prime := by
    intro r hr
    rw [← hl, List.mem_reverse] at hr
    exact Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactorsList hr
  have hprod : (p :: rest).prod = N := by
    rw [← hl, List.prod_reverse, Nat.prod_primeFactorsList hN.ne']
  have htop : p ∉ rest := by
    intro hmem
    have hd : p ^ 2 ∣ N := by
      rw [← hprod, List.prod_cons, pow_two]
      exact mul_dvd_mul_left p (List.dvd_prod hmem)
    exact hSq p (hprime p (List.mem_cons_self ..)) (by rw [hP0] at hlarge; exact hlarge) hd
  have hsorted : List.Pairwise (fun a b => b ≤ a) rest := by
    have h1 : List.Pairwise (· ≤ ·) N.primeFactorsList := (Nat.primeFactorsList_sorted N).pairwise
    have h2 : List.Pairwise (fun a b => b ≤ a) N.primeFactorsList.reverse :=
      List.pairwise_reverse.mpr h1
    rw [hl] at h2
    exact (List.pairwise_cons.mp h2).2
  have hdisj : ∀ a ∈ rest.take j', ∀ b ∈ rest.drop j', b ≠ a := by
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos j' with h0 | hj'
    · subst h0
      simp
    · have hq : ∀ i, 0 ≤ FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeCoordinate T N i := by
        intro i
        show 0 ≤ FordBadFacet.positiveLogLog _ / T
        exact div_nonneg (le_max_left _ _) hT.le
      have hdrop := key _ hq hfirst j' rfl hj'
      have hne : rest.getD j' 1 ≠ rest.getD (j' - 1) 1 := by
        intro heq
        have e1 : FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N (j' + 1) = FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N j' := by
          rw [show j' = (j' - 1) + 1 by omega, hPs, hPs, Nat.sub_add_cancel hj', heq]
        have e2 : FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeCoordinate T N (j' + 1) =
            FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeCoordinate T N j' :=
          congrArg (FordBadFacet.fordPrimeCoordinate T) e1
        linarith
      exact s4 rest j' hsorted hj' hne
  have hmain := s5 p rest j' hprime htop hdisj
  have hfin : (∏ idx : Fin (j' + 1 - 1), FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N (idx.val + 1)) =
      (rest.take j').prod := by
    show (∏ idx : Fin j', FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N (idx.val + 1)) = _
    rw [← s3 rest j']
    exact Finset.prod_congr rfl (fun idx _ => hPs idx.val)
  have hsuf : FordBadFacet.ordinarySuffix N (j' + 1) = (rest.drop j').prod := by
    show (N.primeFactorsList.reverse.drop (j' + 1)).prod = _
    rw [hl]
    rfl
  rw [hP0, hfin, hsuf, ← hmain, hprod]

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have hL4 : 0 < Real.log 4 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  
  have s1 : ∀ (Q : Finset ℕ) (y a : ℝ), 0 ≤ y → 0 < a →
      (∀ p ∈ Q, p.Prime ∧ a ≤ Real.log p ∧ (p : ℝ) ≤ y + 1) →
      (Q.card : ℝ) ≤ 2 * Real.log 4 * y / a := by
    intro Q y a hy ha hQ
    rcases Q.eq_empty_or_nonempty with h | ⟨p₀, hp₀⟩
    · subst h
      simp only [Finset.card_empty, Nat.cast_zero]
      positivity
    · have h1y : 1 ≤ y := by
        obtain ⟨hp, -, hle⟩ := hQ p₀ hp₀
        have : (2 : ℝ) ≤ p₀ := by exact_mod_cast hp.two_le
        linarith
      set n := ⌊y + 1⌋₊ with hn
      have hsub : Q ⊆ (Finset.range (n + 1)).filter Nat.Prime := by
        intro p hp
        obtain ⟨hpp, -, hle⟩ := hQ p hp
        rw [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range]
        exact ⟨Nat.lt_succ_of_le (Nat.le_floor hle), hpp⟩
      have i1 : (Q.card : ℝ) * a ≤ ∑ p ∈ Q, Real.log (p : ℝ) := by
        have := Finset.card_nsmul_le_sum Q (fun p => Real.log (p : ℝ)) a
          (fun p hp => (hQ p hp).2.1)
        rwa [nsmul_eq_mul] at this
      have i2 : ∑ p ∈ Q, Real.log (p : ℝ) ≤
          ∑ p ∈ (Finset.range (n + 1)).filter Nat.Prime, Real.log (p : ℝ) :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hsub (fun p _ _ => Real.log_natCast_nonneg p)
      have i3 : ∑ p ∈ (Finset.range (n + 1)).filter Nat.Prime, Real.log (p : ℝ) =
          Real.log ((primorial n : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
        rw [← Real.log_prod]
        · congr 1
          unfold primorial
          push_cast
          rfl
        · intro p hp
          have := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hp).2.pos
          positivity
      have i4 : Real.log ((primorial n : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ n * Real.log 4 := by
        rw [← Real.log_pow]
        apply Real.log_le_log
        · exact_mod_cast primorial_pos n
        · exact_mod_cast primorial_le_4_pow n
      have i5 : (n : ℝ) ≤ 2 * y := by
        have := Nat.floor_le (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ y + 1 by linarith)
        linarith
      have i6 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right i5 hL4.le
      rw [le_div_iff₀ ha]
      linarith
  refine ⟨2 * Real.log 4, by positivity, ?_⟩
  intro P W F x a hx ha hP hW hF
  let S : ℕ → ℕ → Finset ℕ := fun b m => (Finset.range (⌊x⌋₊ + 2)).filter
    (fun p => p.Prime ∧ a ≤ Real.log p ∧ ((p : ℝ) - 1) * (b.totient : ℝ) * (m : ℝ) ≤ x)
  let G : Finset ℕ := (P ×ˢ W).biUnion
    (fun q => (S q.1 q.2).image (fun p => (p - 1) * q.1.totient * q.2))
  have hFG : F ⊆ G := by
    intro v hv
    obtain ⟨hvx, p, b, m, hp, hlog, hb, hm, rfl⟩ := hF v hv
    rw [Finset.mem_biUnion]
    refine ⟨(b, m), Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨hb, hm⟩, Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨p, ?_, rfl⟩⟩
    rw [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range]
    have hbt : 0 < b.totient := Nat.totient_pos.mpr (hP b hb)
    have hm0 : 0 < m := hW m hm
    have hle1 : (p - 1) * 1 * 1 ≤ (p - 1) * b.totient * m :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul (Nat.mul_le_mul (le_refl (p - 1)) hbt) hm0
    have hfl : (p - 1) * b.totient * m ≤ ⌊x⌋₊ := Nat.le_floor hvx
    have hcast : (((p - 1) * b.totient * m : ℕ) : ℝ) = ((p : ℝ) - 1) * b.totient * m := by
      push_cast [Nat.cast_sub hp.one_lt.le]
      ring
    refine ⟨by omega, hp, hlog, ?_⟩
    rw [← hcast]
    exact hvx
  have hcardF : (F.card : ℝ) ≤ ∑ q ∈ P ×ˢ W, ((S q.1 q.2).card : ℝ) := by
    have h1 : F.card ≤ ∑ q ∈ P ×ˢ W, (S q.1 q.2).card := by
      calc F.card ≤ G.card := Finset.card_le_card hFG
        _ ≤ ∑ q ∈ P ×ˢ W, ((S q.1 q.2).image (fun p => (p - 1) * q.1.totient * q.2)).card :=
          Finset.card_biUnion_le
        _ ≤ _ := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun q _ => Finset.card_image_le)
    exact_mod_cast h1
  have hfib : ∀ q ∈ P ×ˢ W, ((S q.1 q.2).card : ℝ) ≤
      2 * Real.log 4 * x / a * ((q.1.totient : ℝ))⁻¹ * (1 / (q.2 : ℝ)) := by
    rintro ⟨b, m⟩ hq
    obtain ⟨hb, hm⟩ := Finset.mem_product.mp hq
    have hφ : (0 : ℝ) < b.totient := by exact_mod_cast Nat.totient_pos.mpr (hP b hb)
    have hμ : (0 : ℝ) < m := by exact_mod_cast hW m hm
    have hy : 0 ≤ x / ((b.totient : ℝ) * m) := by positivity
    have key := s1 (S b m) (x / ((b.totient : ℝ) * m)) a hy ha (by
      intro p hp
      obtain ⟨-, hpp, hlog, hle⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hp
      refine ⟨hpp, hlog, ?_⟩
      have : (p : ℝ) - 1 ≤ x / ((b.totient : ℝ) * m) := by
        rw [le_div_iff₀ (mul_pos hφ hμ), ← mul_assoc]
        exact hle
      linarith)
    calc ((S b m).card : ℝ) ≤ 2 * Real.log 4 * (x / ((b.totient : ℝ) * m)) / a := key
      _ = 2 * Real.log 4 * x / a * ((b.totient : ℝ))⁻¹ * (1 / (m : ℝ)) := by
        field_simp
  calc (F.card : ℝ) ≤ ∑ q ∈ P ×ˢ W, ((S q.1 q.2).card : ℝ) := hcardF
    _ ≤ ∑ q ∈ P ×ˢ W, 2 * Real.log 4 * x / a * ((q.1.totient : ℝ))⁻¹ * (1 / (q.2 : ℝ)) :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum hfib
    _ = 2 * Real.log 4 * x / a * (∑ b ∈ P, ((b.totient : ℝ))⁻¹) * (∑ m ∈ W, (1 : ℝ) / m) := by
      rw [Finset.sum_product, mul_assoc (2 * Real.log 4 * x / a), Finset.sum_mul_sum,
        Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b _ => ?_)
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun m _ => ?_)
      ring

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hw : ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → 0 ≤ fordWeight n := by
    intro n hn
    unfold fordWeight
    have hm : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hn
    have hm0 : (0 : ℝ) < (n : ℝ) := by linarith
    have hm1 : (0 : ℝ) < (n : ℝ) + 1 := by linarith
    have hlog2 : Real.log 2 ≤ Real.log ((n : ℝ) + 1) :=
      Real.log_le_log (by norm_num) (by linarith)
    have h2 := Real.log_two_gt_d9
    have hdiv := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (show 0 < (n : ℝ) / ((n : ℝ) + 1) by positivity)
    rw [Real.log_div hm0.ne' hm1.ne'] at hdiv
    have hfrac : (n : ℝ) / ((n : ℝ) + 1) - 1 = -(1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) := by
      rw [div_sub_one hm1.ne']
      ring
    have h3 : 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) ≤ Real.log ((n : ℝ) + 1) - Real.log (n : ℝ) := by linarith
    have h4 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h3 hm0.le
    have h5 : 1 / 2 ≤ (n : ℝ) * (1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) := by
      rw [mul_one_div, div_le_div_iff₀ (by norm_num) hm1]
      linarith
    nlinarith
  
  have hprod : ∀ n : ℕ, (∏ j ∈ Finset.range n, ∏ i ∈ Finset.range (j + 1), ξ i) =
      ∏ i ∈ Finset.range n, ξ i ^ (n - i) := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => simp
    | succ n ih =>
      rw [Finset.prod_range_succ (fun j => ∏ i ∈ Finset.range (j + 1), ξ i) n, ih,
        Finset.prod_range_succ (fun i => ξ i ^ (n + 1 - i)) n,
        Finset.prod_range_succ (fun i => ξ i) n]
      have hsplit : ∏ i ∈ Finset.range n, ξ i ^ (n + 1 - i) =
          (∏ i ∈ Finset.range n, ξ i ^ (n - i)) * ∏ i ∈ Finset.range n, ξ i := by
        rw [← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
        apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
        intro i hi
        rw [Finset.mem_range] at hi
        rw [show n + 1 - i = (n - i) + 1 by omega, pow_succ]
      rw [hsplit, show n + 1 - n = 1 by omega, pow_one]
      ring
  
  obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ : ∃ S : ℕ → ℝ, S = fun m => ∏ i ∈ Finset.range m, ξ i := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hSzero : S 0 = 1 := by rw [hS]; simp
  have hSsucc : ∀ m, S (m + 1) = S m * ξ m := by
    intro m; rw [hS]; exact Finset.prod_range_succ _ _
  have hS1 : ∀ m, 1 ≤ S m := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero => exact le_of_eq hSzero.symm
    | succ m ih => rw [hSsucc]; nlinarith [hξ m]
  have hSpos : ∀ m, 0 < S m := fun m => by linarith [hS1 m]
  have hSmono : Monotone S :=
    monotone_nat_of_le_succ (fun m => by rw [hSsucc]; nlinarith [hS1 m, hξ m])
  have hSone : S 1 = ξ 0 := by rw [hSsucc, hSzero, one_mul]
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ : ∃ s : Fin K → ℝ, s = fun j => S (j.val + 1) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hs1 : ∀ j, 1 ≤ s j := fun j => by simp only [hs]; exact hS1 _
  have hspos : ∀ j, 0 < s j := fun j => by linarith [hs1 j]
  
  have hnorm : ∀ x ∈ FordGeometry.polytope K ξ,
      (fun j => x j / s j) ∈ FordGeometry.polytope K (fun _ => 1) := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨h0, h1, hanti, houter, htail⟩ := hx
    refine ⟨fun j => div_nonneg (h0 j) (hspos j).le,
      fun j => (div_le_self (h0 j) (hs1 j)).trans (h1 j), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro a b hab
      have hab' : a.val ≤ b.val := hab
      have hsab : s a ≤ s b := by
        simp only [hs]; exact hSmono (show a.val + 1 ≤ b.val + 1 by omega)
      have hxb := h0 b
      have hsa := hspos a
      have hx' := hanti hab
      show x b / s b ≤ x a / s a
      calc x b / s b ≤ x b / s a := div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hxb hsa hsab
        _ ≤ x a / s a := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hx' hsa.le
    · show ∑ j, fordWeight (j.val + 1) * (x j / s j) ≤ 1
      have ho : ∑ j, fordWeight (j.val + 1) * x j ≤ ξ 0 := houter
      have hξ0 : 0 < ξ 0 := by linarith [hξ 0]
      calc ∑ j, fordWeight (j.val + 1) * (x j / s j)
          ≤ ∑ j, fordWeight (j.val + 1) * x j / ξ 0 := by
            apply Finset.sum_le_sum
            intro j _
            rw [mul_div_assoc]
            apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (hw _ (by omega))
            apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (h0 j) hξ0
            simp only [hs]
            rw [← hSone]
            exact hSmono (show 1 ≤ j.val + 1 by omega)
        _ = (∑ j, fordWeight (j.val + 1) * x j) / ξ 0 := by rw [Finset.sum_div]
        _ ≤ ξ 0 / ξ 0 := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right ho hξ0.le
        _ = 1 := div_self hξ0.ne'
    · intro idx hidx
      show ∑ j, FordGeometry.tailWeight idx j * (x j / s j) ≤ 1 * (x idx / s idx)
      have ht : ∑ j, FordGeometry.tailWeight idx j * x j ≤ ξ (idx.val + 1) * x idx :=
        htail idx hidx
      have hS'pos : 0 < S (idx.val + 2) := hSpos _
      have hS'eq : S (idx.val + 2) = s idx * ξ (idx.val + 1) := by
        simp only [hs]; exact hSsucc _
      have hξi : 0 < ξ (idx.val + 1) := by linarith [hξ (idx.val + 1)]
      calc ∑ j, FordGeometry.tailWeight idx j * (x j / s j)
          ≤ ∑ j, FordGeometry.tailWeight idx j * x j / S (idx.val + 2) := by
            apply Finset.sum_le_sum
            intro j _
            by_cases hij : idx.val < j.val
            · have htw : 0 ≤ FordGeometry.tailWeight idx j := by
                unfold FordGeometry.tailWeight
                rw [if_pos hij]
                split_ifs
                · exact hw _ (by omega)
                · norm_num
              rw [mul_div_assoc]
              apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ htw
              apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (h0 j) hS'pos
              simp only [hs]
              exact hSmono (show idx.val + 2 ≤ j.val + 1 by omega)
            · have htw : FordGeometry.tailWeight idx j = 0 := by
                unfold FordGeometry.tailWeight
                rw [if_neg hij]
              rw [htw]; simp
        _ = (∑ j, FordGeometry.tailWeight idx j * x j) / S (idx.val + 2) := by
            rw [Finset.sum_div]
        _ ≤ (ξ (idx.val + 1) * x idx) / S (idx.val + 2) :=
            div_le_div_of_nonneg_right ht hS'pos.le
        _ = 1 * (x idx / s idx) := by
            rw [hS'eq, one_mul, mul_comm (s idx), mul_div_mul_left _ _ hξi.ne']
  
  set C : Set (Fin K → ℝ) := Set.Icc (fun _ : Fin K => -τ) (fun _ => τ) with hC
  set P1 : Set (Fin K → ℝ) := FordGeometry.polytope K (fun _ => 1) with hP1
  let f : (Fin K → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] (Fin K → ℝ) := Matrix.toLin' (Matrix.diagonal s)
  have hf : ∀ y : Fin K → ℝ, f y = fun j => s j * y j := by
    intro y; funext j; simp [f, Matrix.toLin'_apply, Matrix.mulVec_diagonal]
  have hdet : LinearMap.det f = ∏ j, s j := by
    simp only [f, LinearMap.det_toLin', Matrix.det_diagonal]
  have hincl : FordGeometry.polytope K ξ + C ⊆ f '' (P1 + C) := by
    intro z hz
    obtain ⟨x, hx, e, he, rfl⟩ := Set.mem_add.mp hz
    refine ⟨(fun j => x j / s j) + (fun j => e j / s j), Set.add_mem_add (hnorm x hx) ?_, ?_⟩
    · obtain ⟨he1, he2⟩ := he
      have hab : ∀ j, |e j / s j| ≤ τ := by
        intro j
        have h1 : -τ ≤ e j := he1 j
        have h2 : e j ≤ τ := he2 j
        rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos (hspos j)]
        exact (div_le_self (abs_nonneg _) (hs1 j)).trans (abs_le.mpr ⟨h1, h2⟩)
      constructor
      · intro j
        show -τ ≤ e j / s j
        exact (abs_le.mp (hab j)).1
      · intro j
        show e j / s j ≤ τ
        exact (abs_le.mp (hab j)).2
    · rw [hf]
      funext j
      have hsj := (hspos j).ne'
      simp only [Pi.add_apply]
      field_simp
  
  have hP1sub : P1 ⊆ Set.Icc (fun _ : Fin K => (0 : ℝ)) (fun _ => 1) :=
    fun x hx => ⟨fun i => hx.1 i, fun i => hx.2.1 i⟩
  have hbdd : Bornology.IsBounded (P1 + C) :=
    ((Metric.isBounded_Icc _ _).subset hP1sub).add (Metric.isBounded_Icc _ _)
  have hfin : MeasureTheory.volume (P1 + C) ≠ ⊤ := hbdd.measure_lt_top.ne
  have himg : MeasureTheory.volume (f '' (P1 + C)) =
      ENNReal.ofReal |LinearMap.det f| * MeasureTheory.volume (P1 + C) :=
    MeasureTheory.Measure.addHaar_image_linearMap _ f _
  have hc0 : 0 ≤ ∏ j, s j := Finset.prod_nonneg (fun j _ => (hspos j).le)
  have hne : MeasureTheory.volume (f '' (P1 + C)) ≠ ⊤ := by
    rw [himg]; exact ENNReal.mul_ne_top ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top hfin
  have hvol : MeasureTheory.volume.real (FordGeometry.polytope K ξ + C) ≤
      (∏ j, s j) * MeasureTheory.volume.real (P1 + C) := by
    calc _ ≤ MeasureTheory.volume.real (f '' (P1 + C)) :=
          MeasureTheory.measureReal_mono hincl hne
      _ = _ := by
        rw [MeasureTheory.measureReal_def, himg, ENNReal.toReal_mul, hdet, abs_of_nonneg hc0,
          ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hc0, MeasureTheory.measureReal_def]
  have hprodeq : (∏ j, s j) = ∏ i ∈ Finset.range K, ξ i ^ (K - i) := by
    rw [← hprod K]
    simp only [hs, hS]
    exact Fin.prod_univ_eq_prod_range (fun j => ∏ i ∈ Finset.range (j + 1), ξ i) K
  rw [hprodeq] at hvol
  exact hvol

  obtain ⟨E, hE⟩ : ∃ E : ℕ → ℝ, ∀ i : ℕ, E i = Real.exp (-(((A : ℝ) - (i : ℝ)) / 40)) :=
    ⟨fun i => Real.exp (-(((A : ℝ) - (i : ℝ)) / 40)), fun _ => rfl⟩
  have hEpos : ∀ i, 0 < E i := fun i => by rw [hE]; exact Real.exp_pos _
  have hr0 : 0 < Real.exp (-1 / 40) := Real.exp_pos _
  have hr1 : Real.exp (-1 / 40) ≤ 40 / 41 := by
    have h1 : (1 / 40 : ℝ) + 1 ≤ Real.exp (1 / 40) := Real.add_one_le_exp _
    have h2 : Real.exp (-1 / 40) * Real.exp (1 / 40) = 1 := by
      rw [← Real.exp_add]; norm_num
    nlinarith [Real.exp_pos (1 / 40 : ℝ)]
  have hrec : ∀ n : ℕ, E n = Real.exp (-1 / 40) * E (n + 1) := by
    intro n
    rw [hE, hE, ← Real.exp_add]
    congr 1
    push_cast
    ring
  have hH : ∀ n : ℕ, (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, E i) ≤ 40 * E n := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      rw [Finset.sum_range_zero]
      linarith [hEpos 0]
    | succ n ih =>
      rw [Finset.sum_range_succ]
      have h3 := hrec n
      have hp := hEpos (n + 1)
      nlinarith
  have hG : ∀ k : ℕ, (∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, ((k - i : ℕ) : ℝ) * E i) ≤ 1640 * E k := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero =>
      rw [Finset.sum_range_zero]
      linarith [hEpos 0]
    | succ k ih =>
      have h1 : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1),
          ((k + 1 - i : ℕ) : ℝ) * E i = ((k - i : ℕ) : ℝ) * E i + E i := by
        intro i hi
        have : i ≤ k := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
        rw [show k + 1 - i = (k - i) + 1 by omega, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
        ring
      have hsplit : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), ((k + 1 - i : ℕ) : ℝ) * E i) =
          (∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, ((k - i : ℕ) : ℝ) * E i) +
            ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), E i := by
        rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl h1, Finset.sum_add_distrib,
          Finset.sum_range_succ (fun i => ((k - i : ℕ) : ℝ) * E i)]
        simp
      rw [hsplit]
      have h2 := hH (k + 1)
      have h3 := hrec k
      have hp := hEpos (k + 1)
      nlinarith
  have hEK : E K ≤ 1 := by
    rw [hE]
    apply Real.exp_le_one_iff.mpr
    have : (K : ℝ) ≤ A := by exact_mod_cast hKA
    have h40 : 0 ≤ ((A : ℝ) - (K : ℝ)) / 40 := by
      apply div_nonneg <;> linarith
    linarith
  have hS : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range K, ((K - i : ℕ) : ℝ) * E i) ≤ 1640 := by
    have := hG K
    linarith
  have hprod : (∏ i ∈ Finset.range K, FordGeometry.expandedParameter A i ^ (K - i)) ≤
      ∏ i ∈ Finset.range K, Real.exp (((K - i : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((1 / 10000) * E i)) := by
    apply Finset.prod_le_prod
    · intro i _
      apply pow_nonneg
      unfold FordGeometry.expandedParameter
      positivity
    · intro i _
      rw [Real.exp_nat_mul]
      apply pow_le_pow_left₀
      · unfold FordGeometry.expandedParameter
        positivity
      · unfold FordGeometry.expandedParameter
        have := Real.add_one_le_exp ((1 / 10000) * E i)
        rw [hE] at this ⊢
        linarith
  rw [← Real.exp_sum] at hprod
  have hsum : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range K, ((K - i : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((1 / 10000) * E i)) =
      (1 / 10000) * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range K, ((K - i : ℕ) : ℝ) * E i := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    ring
  rw [hsum] at hprod
  have hlog2 := Real.log_two_gt_d9
  have h3 : Real.exp ((1 / 10000) * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range K, ((K - i : ℕ) : ℝ) * E i) ≤
      Real.exp (Real.log 2) := by
    apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
    linarith
  rw [Real.exp_log (by norm_num)] at h3
  linarith

      |(∑ p ∈ (Finset.Iic ⌊x⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, (1 : ℝ) / p) - Real.log (Real.log x)| ≤ C)

    (hadd : FordScale.coreDimension M t + M = FordScale.optimalDimension t) {K : ℕ}
    (hK : K ≤ FordScale.coreDimension M t) :
    t ^ K * FordGeometry.modelVolume K ≤
      (4 * FordAnalysis.rho ^ M) ^ (FordScale.coreDimension M t - K) *
        FordAnalysis.rho ^ ((FordScale.coreDimension M t - K).choose 2) *
        (t ^ (FordScale.coreDimension M t) * FordGeometry.modelVolume (FordScale.coreDimension M t))

proof.tactics:
by
  have hρ0 : 0 ≤ FordAnalysis.rho := hRHO.1.le
  have hc0 : 0 ≤ 4 * FordAnalysis.rho ^ M := by positivity
  have hLM : FordScale.coreDimension M t + M = FordScale.optimalDimension t := hadd
  
  have hstep : ∀ d : ℕ, d + 1 ≤ FordScale.coreDimension M t →
      t ^ (FordScale.coreDimension M t - (d + 1)) *
          FordGeometry.modelVolume (FordScale.coreDimension M t - (d + 1)) ≤
        4 * FordAnalysis.rho ^ M * FordAnalysis.rho ^ d *
          (t ^ (FordScale.coreDimension M t - d) *
            FordGeometry.modelVolume (FordScale.coreDimension M t - d)) := by
    intro d hd
    have hcd : FordScale.coreDimension
        (FordScale.optimalDimension t - (FordScale.coreDimension M t - d)) t =
        FordScale.coreDimension M t - d := by
      show FordScale.optimalDimension t -
          (FordScale.optimalDimension t - (FordScale.coreDimension M t - d)) =
        FordScale.coreDimension M t - d
      omega
    have hadd' : FordScale.coreDimension
        (FordScale.optimalDimension t - (FordScale.coreDimension M t - d)) t +
        (FordScale.optimalDimension t - (FordScale.coreDimension M t - d)) =
        FordScale.optimalDimension t := by
      rw [hcd]; omega
    have hK' : FordScale.coreDimension M t - (d + 1) ≤ FordScale.coreDimension
        (FordScale.optimalDimension t - (FordScale.coreDimension M t - d)) t := by
      rw [hcd]; omega
    have h := core_scaled_prefix_bound hPNT hMERT hEULER hRHO
      (FordScale.optimalDimension t - (FordScale.coreDimension M t - d)) ht hadd' hK'
    rw [hcd] at h
    have e1 : FordScale.coreDimension M t - d - (FordScale.coreDimension M t - (d + 1)) = 1 := by
      omega
    have e2 : FordScale.optimalDimension t - (FordScale.coreDimension M t - d) = M + d := by
      omega
    rw [e1, e2] at h
    calc _ ≤ _ := h
      _ = _ := by ring
  
  have iter : ∀ d : ℕ, d ≤ FordScale.coreDimension M t →
      t ^ (FordScale.coreDimension M t - d) *
          FordGeometry.modelVolume (FordScale.coreDimension M t - d) ≤
        (4 * FordAnalysis.rho ^ M) ^ d * FordAnalysis.rho ^ (d.choose 2) *
          (t ^ (FordScale.coreDimension M t) *
            FordGeometry.modelVolume (FordScale.coreDimension M t)) := by
    intro d
    induction d with
    | zero => intro _; simp
    | succ d ih =>
      intro hd
      have h1 := hstep d hd
      have h2 := ih (by omega)
      have hnn : 0 ≤ 4 * FordAnalysis.rho ^ M * FordAnalysis.rho ^ d :=
        mul_nonneg hc0 (pow_nonneg hρ0 d)
      calc _ ≤ _ := h1
        _ ≤ 4 * FordAnalysis.rho ^ M * FordAnalysis.rho ^ d *
            ((4 * FordAnalysis.rho ^ M) ^ d * FordAnalysis.rho ^ (d.choose 2) *
              (t ^ (FordScale.coreDimension M t) *
                FordGeometry.modelVolume (FordScale.coreDimension M t))) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 hnn
        _ = _ := by
          rw [Nat.choose_succ_succ', Nat.choose_one_right]
          ring
  have hfin := iter (FordScale.coreDimension M t - K) (Nat.sub_le _ _)
  rw [Nat.sub_sub_self hK] at hfin
  exact hfin

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have s1 : ∀ N j i : ℕ, FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt (FordBadFacet.ordinarySuffix N j) i =
      FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N (j + i) := by
    intro N j i
    have key : (FordBadFacet.ordinarySuffix N j).primeFactorsList =
        ((N.primeFactorsList.reverse).drop j).reverse := by
      have hsub : ((N.primeFactorsList.reverse).drop j).reverse.Sublist N.primeFactorsList := by
        have := (List.drop_sublist j N.primeFactorsList.reverse).reverse
        rwa [List.reverse_reverse] at this
      have hprimes : ∀ p ∈ ((N.primeFactorsList.reverse).drop j).reverse, p.Prime :=
        fun p hp => Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactorsList (hsub.subset hp)
      have hprod : ((N.primeFactorsList.reverse).drop j).reverse.prod =
          FordBadFacet.ordinarySuffix N j := by
        rw [List.prod_reverse]
      have hperm := Nat.primeFactorsList_unique hprod hprimes
      have hs1 := ((Nat.primeFactorsList_sorted N).pairwise.sublist hsub).sortedLE
      exact (hperm.eq_of_sortedLE hs1 (Nat.primeFactorsList_sorted _)).symm
    show (FordBadFacet.ordinarySuffix N j).primeFactorsList.reverse.getD i 1 =
      N.primeFactorsList.reverse.getD (j + i) 1
    rw [key, List.reverse_reverse, List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD,
      List.getElem?_drop]
  
  have s2 : ∀ M r : ℕ, r ∈ M.primeFactors → r ≤ FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt M 0 := by
    intro M r hr
    have hmem : r ∈ M.primeFactorsList.reverse :=
      List.mem_reverse.mpr (Nat.mem_primeFactors_iff_mem_primeFactorsList.mp hr)
    have hsorted : M.primeFactorsList.reverse.Pairwise (fun a b => b ≤ a) :=
      List.pairwise_reverse.mpr (Nat.primeFactorsList_sorted M).pairwise
    unfold FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeList
    generalize M.primeFactorsList.reverse = l at hmem hsorted ⊢
    cases l with
    | nil => simp at hmem
    | cons a t =>
      simp only [List.getD_cons_zero]
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp hmem with h | h
      · omega
      · exact (List.pairwise_cons.mp hsorted).1 r h
  
  have s3 : ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → 0 ≤ fordWeight n := by
    intro n hn
    unfold fordWeight
    have ha : (1:ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast hn
    set a : ℝ := (n : ℝ) with hadef
    have ha0 : 0 < a := by linarith
    have h1 : Real.log (a / (a+1)) ≤ a / (a+1) - 1 := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by positivity)
    rw [Real.log_div ha0.ne' (by linarith)] at h1
    have h2 : a / (a+1) - 1 = -(1/(a+1)) := by field_simp; ring
    rw [h2] at h1
    have h3 : Real.log 2 ≤ Real.log (a+1) := Real.log_le_log (by norm_num) (by linarith)
    have h4 := Real.log_two_gt_d9
    have h5 : 1/(a+1) ≤ 1/2 := by rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (by linarith) (by norm_num)]; linarith
    have h6 : a * (1/(a+1)) ≤ a * (Real.log (a+1) - Real.log a) := by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ ha0.le; linarith [h1]
    have h7 : a * (1/(a+1)) = 1 - 1/(a+1) := by field_simp; ring
    nlinarith
  
  have s4 : ∀ (y : ℝ) (p : ℕ), 1 < y → 0 < logLog y → y ^ (1 / (20 * logLog y)) < (p : ℝ) →
      1 - Real.log (20 * logLog y) / logLog y ≤ FordBadFacet.positiveLogLog (p : ℝ) / logLog y := by
    intro y p hy hU hp
    set U := logLog y with hUdef
    have hy0 : 0 < y := by linarith
    have hlogy : 0 < Real.log y := Real.log_pos hy
    have hz : 0 < y ^ (1 / (20 * U)) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hy0 _
    have hlogz : Real.log (y ^ (1 / (20 * U))) = (1 / (20 * U)) * Real.log y := Real.log_rpow hy0 _
    have hlz_pos : 0 < Real.log (y ^ (1 / (20 * U))) := by rw [hlogz]; positivity
    have h1 : Real.log (y ^ (1 / (20 * U))) ≤ Real.log p := Real.log_le_log hz hp.le
    have h2 : Real.log (Real.log (y ^ (1 / (20 * U)))) ≤ Real.log (Real.log p) :=
      Real.log_le_log hlz_pos h1
    have h20 : (1 / (20 * U)) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have h3 : Real.log (Real.log (y ^ (1 / (20 * U)))) = U - Real.log (20 * U) := by
      rw [hlogz, Real.log_mul h20 hlogy.ne', one_div, Real.log_inv]
      rw [hUdef]; unfold logLog; ring
    have h4 : logLog (p:ℝ) ≤ FordBadFacet.positiveLogLog p := le_max_right _ _
    unfold logLog at h4
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hU]
    have : (1 - Real.log (20 * U) / U) * U = U - Real.log (20 * U) := by field_simp
    rw [this]; linarith
  
  have s5 : ∀ (N S A L j : ℕ) (T y δ : ℝ), (∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → 0 ≤ fordWeight n) → 0 < S →
      (∀ i : ℕ, FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt S i = FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N (j + i)) →
      0 < logLog y → 0 < T → L ≤ A → 0 < j →
      FordBadFacet.FirstFailedRow L (FordGeometry.expandedParameter A)
        (FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeCoordinate T N) j →
      (S.totient : ℝ) ≤ y →
      1 - δ ≤ FordBadFacet.positiveLogLog (FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N j : ℝ) / logLog y →
      (1 + FordRestricted.suffixMargin (A - j)) * δ ≤ FordRestricted.suffixMargin (A - j) / 2 →
      S.totient ∈ FordBadFacet.badFacetValues y (A - j + 40)
        (FordRestricted.suffixMargin (A - j + 40)) := by
    intro N S A L j T y δ hw hS hscale hU hT hLA hj hfirst hvalue hlow hbudget
    obtain ⟨hjL, hfail, -⟩ := hfirst
    have hjA : j ≤ A := by omega
    have hLj : L - j ≤ A - j + 40 := by omega
    unfold FordBadFacet.badFacetValues
    rw [Finset.mem_filter]
    refine ⟨?_, S, hS, rfl, ?_⟩
    · simp only [totientsUpTo, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc]
      exact ⟨⟨Nat.totient_pos.mpr hS, Nat.le_floor hvalue⟩, S, rfl⟩
    set U := logLog y with hUdef
    set ω := FordRestricted.suffixMargin (A - j) with hωdef
    set P : ℕ → ℝ := fun i => FordBadFacet.positiveLogLog (FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N i : ℝ)
      with hPdef
    have hT' : T ≠ 0 := hT.ne'
    have hU' : U ≠ 0 := hU.ne'
    have hc : ∀ i, FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeCoordinate U S i = P (j + i) / U := by
      intro i
      show FordBadFacet.positiveLogLog _ / U = _
      rw [hscale i]
    have hP0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ P i := fun i => le_max_left _ _
    have hpar : FordGeometry.expandedParameter A j = 1 + ω := by
      simp only [FordGeometry.expandedParameter, hωdef, FordRestricted.suffixMargin]
      rw [Nat.cast_sub hjA, neg_div]
    have hfail' : (1 + ω) * (P j / T) <
        ∑ idx : Fin (L - j), fordWeight (idx.val + 1) * (P (j + idx.val + 1) / T) := by
      unfold FordBadFacet.RowHolds at hfail
      rw [if_neg (by omega)] at hfail
      push_neg at hfail
      unfold FordBadFacet.shiftedFacet at hfail
      rw [hpar] at hfail
      exact hfail
    have hTU : 0 < T / U := div_pos hT hU
    have hmul : (1 + ω) * (P j / U) <
        ∑ idx : Fin (L - j), fordWeight (idx.val + 1) * (P (j + idx.val + 1) / U) := by
      have h := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hfail' hTU
      rw [Finset.mul_sum] at h
      have e1 : T / U * ((1 + ω) * (P j / T)) = (1 + ω) * (P j / U) := by field_simp
      have e2 : ∀ idx : Fin (L - j),
          T / U * (fordWeight (idx.val + 1) * (P (j + idx.val + 1) / T)) =
          fordWeight (idx.val + 1) * (P (j + idx.val + 1) / U) := by
        intro idx; field_simp
      rw [e1, Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun idx _ => e2 idx)] at h
      exact h
    have hlow' : 1 - δ ≤ P j / U := hlow
    have hω0 : 0 < ω := by simp only [hωdef, FordRestricted.suffixMargin]; positivity
    have hf : 1 + ω / 2 ≤ (1 + ω) * (P j / U) := by
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlow' (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 + ω)]
    have hω40 : FordRestricted.suffixMargin (A - j + 40) = ω * Real.exp (-1) := by
      simp only [hωdef, FordRestricted.suffixMargin]
      rw [mul_assoc, ← Real.exp_add]; congr 2; push_cast; ring
    have he1 : Real.exp (-1) ≤ 1 / 2 := by
      have h1 := Real.add_one_le_exp (1:ℝ)

  have hsqpos : 0 < Real.sqrt x := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hx0

    rw [mul_div_assoc', le_div_iff₀ hlog0]

  have hT2 : 1 ≤ logLog x ^ 2 := one_le_pow₀ hT

  have e2 : (1 / 4 : ℝ) * A * x / Real.log x = (1 / 4 : ℝ) * A * q := by rw [hq]; ring
  have e5 : K₅ * x / Real.log x * logLog x ^ 2 * A' = K₅ * q * (logLog x ^ 2 * A') := by

  have e6 : (K₅ + 5) * x / Real.log x * logLog x ^ 2 * A' = (K₅ + 5) * q * (logLog x ^ 2 * A') := by

  have hE2b := h2 A hA henvx

by

    have h1 : u * Real.log u ≤ u * max 1 (Real.log x) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hlog.trans (le_max_right _ _)) hu0.le
    have h2 : ((totientsUpTo u).card : ℝ) * Real.log u ≤ u * Real.log u :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hT hlogu.le
    linarith
  
  let g : ℝ → ℝ := fun u => ((totientsUpTo u).card : ℝ) * Real.log u / u
  let F : ℝ → ℝ := fun T => max 1 (sSup (g '' Set.Icc 2 (Real.exp (Real.exp T))))
  have hF1 : ∀ T, 1 ≤ F T := fun T => le_max_left _ _
  have hbdd : ∀ T, BddAbove (g '' Set.Icc 2 (Real.exp (Real.exp T))) := by
    intro T
    refine ⟨Real.exp T, ?_⟩
    rintro y ⟨u, ⟨hu2, hux⟩, rfl⟩

      have := Real.log_le_log hu0 hux

    rw [div_le_iff₀ hu0]
    have h1 := mul_le_mul (hTu u hu0.le) hl hlogu.le hu0.le
    linarith
  have henv : ∀ T : ℝ, 1 ≤ T → ∀ u : ℝ, 2 ≤ u → u ≤ Real.exp (Real.exp T) →
      ((totientsUpTo u).card : ℝ) ≤ F T * u / Real.log u := by
    intro T _ u hu hux
    have hu0 : 0 < u := by linarith
    have hlogu : 0 < Real.log u := Real.log_pos (by linarith)

    have h1 : g u ≤ F T := (le_csSup (hbdd T) hmem).trans (le_max_right _ _)
    have h2 : ((totientsUpTo u).card : ℝ) * Real.log u ≤ F T * u := by
      have h3 : ((totientsUpTo u).card : ℝ) * Real.log u / u ≤ F T := h1
      rwa [div_le_iff₀ hu0] at h3
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hlogu]

  have hmin : ∀ T M : ℝ, 1 ≤ M →

    intro T M hM hMenv
    apply max_le hM
    apply Real.sSup_le _ (by linarith)
    rintro y ⟨u, ⟨hu2, hux⟩, rfl⟩
    have hu0 : 0 < u := by linarith
    have hlogu : 0 < Real.log u := Real.log_pos (by linarith)
    have h := hMenv u hu2 hux
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hlogu] at h
    show ((totientsUpTo u).card : ℝ) * Real.log u / u ≤ M

    linarith
  have hmono : ∀ a b : ℝ, 1 ≤ a → a ≤ b → F a ≤ F b := by
    intro a b ha hab
    apply hmin a (F b) (hF1 b)
    intro u hu hux

  set X₀ := max X₁ (Real.exp (Real.exp 1)) with hX₀def
  have hstep' : ∀ x : ℝ, X₀ ≤ x → ∀ A A' : ℝ, 1 ≤ A → 1 ≤ A' →

      ((totientsUpTo x).card : ℝ) ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) * A * x / Real.log x +
        K * x / Real.log x * logLog x ^ 2 * A' :=
    fun x hx => hX₁ x ((le_max_left _ _).trans hx)
  have hC₀ : 1 ≤ max 1 (Real.log X₀) := le_max_left _ _
  set C₀ := max 1 (Real.log X₀) with hC₀def
  refine ⟨F, C₀ + 4 / 3 * K, by linarith, hF1, hmono, ?_, henv⟩
  filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop (10 / 9 : ℝ)] with T hT
  have hT1 : 1 ≤ T := by linarith

    hC₀.trans (le_max_left _ _)
  have claim : ∀ u : ℝ, 2 ≤ u → u ≤ Real.exp (Real.exp T) →
      ((totientsUpTo u).card : ℝ) ≤

        have := Real.log_le_log (Real.exp_pos _) (hX₀e.trans h)
        rwa [Real.log_exp] at this
      have hu0 : 0 < u := by linarith
      have hlogux : Real.log u ≤ Real.exp T := by
        have := Real.log_le_log hu0 hux
        rwa [Real.log_exp] at this
      have hllu0 : 0 ≤ logLog u := Real.log_nonneg (by linarith)
      have hlluT : logLog u ≤ T := by
        have := Real.log_le_log (by linarith) hlogux
        rw [Real.log_exp] at this
        exact this
      have hEnd : envelopeTailEndpoint (logLog u) ≤ Real.exp (Real.exp ((9 / 10 : ℝ) * T)) := by
        unfold envelopeTailEndpoint
        gcongr
      have hst := hstep' u h (F T) (F ((9 / 10 : ℝ) * T)) hA hA'

        (fun v hv hvY => henv _ h09 v hv (hvY.trans hEnd))

      have e1 : (1 / 4 : ℝ) * F T * u / Real.log u +
          K * u / Real.log u * logLog u ^ 2 * F ((9 / 10 : ℝ) * T) =
          (F T / 4 + K * logLog u ^ 2 * F ((9 / 10 : ℝ) * T)) * u / Real.log u := by ring
      rw [e1] at hst

      refine le_trans ?_ (le_max_right _ _)
      have : K * logLog u ^ 2 * F ((9 / 10 : ℝ) * T) ≤ K * T ^ 2 * F ((9 / 10 : ℝ) * T) := by
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (by linarith)
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsq hK.le
      linarith
  have hFT := hmin T _ hM1 claim
  have eC : (C₀ + 4 / 3 * K) * T ^ 2 * F ((9 / 10 : ℝ) * T) =

  have hP0 : 0 ≤ T ^ 2 * F ((9 / 10 : ℝ) * T) := by linarith
  have e2 : 0 ≤ 4 / 3 * K * (T ^ 2 * F ((9 / 10 : ℝ) * T)) :=
    mul_nonneg (by linarith) hP0
  have e3 : 0 ≤ C₀ * (T ^ 2 * F ((9 / 10 : ℝ) * T)) := mul_nonneg (by linarith) hP0
  rcases le_max_iff.mp hFT with h | h
  · have e1 : C₀ ≤ C₀ * (T ^ 2 * F ((9 / 10 : ℝ) * T)) :=
      le_mul_of_one_le_right (by linarith) hTA
    rw [eC]
    linarith
  · have e4 : K * T ^ 2 * F ((9 / 10 : ℝ) * T) = K * (T ^ 2 * F ((9 / 10 : ℝ) * T)) := by ring
    rw [eC]
    linarith

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨T₁, hT₁⟩ := eventually_atTop.mp hstep
  let T₀ := max 1 T₁
  let q : ℝ := 10/9
  let A := |Real.log C|+2*|Real.log T₀|
  let D := |Real.log (F T₀)|
  have hT₀1 : 1 ≤ T₀ := le_max_left _ _
  have hT₀ : 0 < T₀ := by linarith
  have hq1 : 1 ≤ q := by norm_num [q]
  have hq0 : 0 < q := by norm_num [q]
  have hlogq : 0 < Real.log q := Real.log_pos (by norm_num [q])
  have hlogq_lower : (1/10 : ℝ) ≤ Real.log q := by
    have h := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 9/10)
    rw [Real.log_div (by norm_num) (by norm_num)] at h
    dsimp [q]
    rw [Real.log_div (by norm_num) (by norm_num)]
    norm_num at h
    linarith
  have hA0 : 0 ≤ A := by dsimp [A]; positivity
  have hD0 : 0 ≤ D := abs_nonneg _
  have hAcost : Real.log C+2*Real.log T₀ ≤ A := by
    dsimp [A]
    linarith [le_abs_self (Real.log C), le_abs_self (Real.log T₀)]
  have hDcost : Real.log (F T₀) ≤ D := le_abs_self _
  have hgrid_ge (n : ℕ) : T₀ ≤ T₀*q^n :=
    le_mul_of_one_le_right hT₀.le (one_le_pow₀ hq1)
  have hgridlog (n : ℕ) : Real.log (T₀*q^n) = Real.log T₀+(n : ℝ)*Real.log q := by
    rw [Real.log_mul hT₀.ne' (pow_ne_zero _ hq0.ne'), Real.log_pow]
  have hgrid : ∀ n : ℕ, F (T₀*q^n) ≤
      Real.exp (D+A*(n : ℝ)+Real.log q*(n : ℝ)*((n : ℝ)+1)) := by
    intro n

    | zero =>
      have hFpos : 0 < F T₀ := by linarith [hF T₀]
      simpa only [pow_zero, mul_one, Nat.cast_zero, mul_zero, zero_mul, add_zero] using
        (Real.log_le_iff_le_exp hFpos).mp hDcost
    | succ n ih =>
      have hstepn := hT₁ (T₀*q^(n+1)) ((le_max_right _ _).trans (hgrid_ge _))
      have hshrink : (9/10 : ℝ)*(T₀*q^(n+1)) = T₀*q^n := by
        rw [pow_succ]
        dsimp [q]
        ring
      rw [hshrink] at hstepn
      have hRpos : 0 < T₀*q^(n+1) := mul_pos hT₀ (pow_pos hq0 _)
      calc
        _ ≤ C*(T₀*q^(n+1))^2*F (T₀*q^n) := hstepn
        _ ≤ C*(T₀*q^(n+1))^2*
            Real.exp (D+A*(n : ℝ)+Real.log q*(n : ℝ)*((n : ℝ)+1)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ih (by positivity)
        _ ≤ _ := by
          apply (Real.log_le_log_iff (by positivity) (Real.exp_pos _)).mp
          rw [Real.log_mul (by positivity) (Real.exp_ne_zero _),
            Real.log_mul hC.ne' (by positivity), Real.log_pow, hgridlog,
            Real.log_exp, Real.log_exp]
          push_cast
          nlinarith
  let H := 10*A+20*Real.log q+1
  let J := A+2*Real.log q+D
  filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop (Real.exp 1),
    Real.tendsto_log_atTop.eventually_ge_atTop H,
    Real.tendsto_log_atTop.eventually_ge_atTop J] with T hTe hH hJ
  have hTpos : 0 < T := (Real.exp_pos 1).trans_le hTe
  have hT1 : 1 ≤ T := by linarith [Real.add_one_le_exp (1 : ℝ)]
  have hlogT : 1 ≤ Real.log T := by
    simpa only [Real.log_exp] using Real.log_le_log (Real.exp_pos 1) hTe
  have hu0 : 0 ≤ Real.log T := by linarith
  let n : ℕ := ⌈Real.log T/Real.log q⌉₊
  have hTq : T ≤ q^n := by
    apply (Real.log_le_log_iff hTpos (pow_pos hq0 _)).mp
    rw [Real.log_pow]
    exact (div_le_iff₀ hlogq).mp (Nat.le_ceil (Real.log T/Real.log q))
  have hTgrid : T ≤ T₀*q^n := hTq.trans
    (le_mul_of_one_le_left (pow_nonneg hq0.le _) hT₀1)
  have hn : (n : ℝ) ≤ Real.log T/Real.log q+1 :=
    (Nat.ceil_lt_add_one (div_nonneg hu0 hlogq.le)).le
  have hn0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ n := Nat.cast_nonneg n
  have hqinv : 1/Real.log q ≤ (10 : ℝ) := (div_le_iff₀ hlogq).mpr (by linarith)
  have hnupper : (n : ℝ) ≤ 10*Real.log T+1 := by
    calc
      _ ≤ Real.log T/Real.log q+1 := hn
      _ = Real.log T*(1/Real.log q)+1 := by ring
      _ ≤ Real.log T*10+1 := add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hqinv hu0) le_rfl
      _ = _ := by ring
  have hnlog : (n : ℝ)*Real.log q ≤ Real.log T+Real.log q := by
    calc
      _ ≤ (Real.log T/Real.log q+1)*Real.log q := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hn hlogq.le
      _ = _ := by field_simp [hlogq.ne']
  have hpoly : D+A*(n : ℝ)+Real.log q*(n : ℝ)*((n : ℝ)+1) ≤
      D+(10*Real.log T+1)*(Real.log T+A+2*Real.log q) := by
    calc
      _ = D+(n : ℝ)*(A+(n : ℝ)*Real.log q+Real.log q) := by ring
      _ ≤ D+(n : ℝ)*(Real.log T+A+2*Real.log q) :=
        add_le_add le_rfl (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
          (show A+(n : ℝ)*Real.log q+Real.log q ≤ Real.log T+A+2*Real.log q by linarith) hn0)
      _ ≤ _ := add_le_add le_rfl (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hnupper
        (by positivity : 0 ≤ Real.log T+A+2*Real.log q))
  have hfinal : D+(10*Real.log T+1)*(Real.log T+A+2*Real.log q) ≤ 12*Real.log T^2 := by
    have hHmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hH hu0
    have humul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hlogT hu0
    dsimp [H, J] at hHmul hJ
    nlinarith
  exact (hmono T _ hT1 hTgrid).trans
    ((hgrid n).trans (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (hpoly.trans hfinal)))

informal_problem.statement:
(δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    ∀ᶠ M : ℕ in Filter.atTop, ∀ L : ℕ,

signature.name: expanded_parameter_product_eventually_close
signature.statement:
(δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    ∀ᶠ M : ℕ in Filter.atTop, ∀ L : ℕ,
      (∏ i ∈ Finset.range L, FordGeometry.expandedParameter (L + M) i ^ (L - i)) ≤ 1 + δ

proof.tactics:
by
  have hδ1 : (1 : ℝ) < 1 + δ := by linarith
  have hℓ : 0 < Real.log (1 + δ) := Real.log_pos hδ1
  obtain ⟨N₀, hN₀⟩ := exists_nat_gt (7 / Real.log (1 + δ))
  filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_ge_atTop N₀] with M hM
  intro L
  have hMR : (N₀ : ℝ) ≤ (M : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hM
  have hMl : 7 < (M : ℝ) * Real.log (1 + δ) := by
    have h := lt_of_lt_of_le hN₀ hMR
    rw [div_lt_iff₀ hℓ] at h
    linarith
  have hM0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (M : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg M
  obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ : ∃ A : ℕ, A = L + M := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hA]
  have hAR : (A : ℝ) = (L : ℝ) + (M : ℝ) := by rw [hA]; push_cast; ring
  obtain ⟨E, hE⟩ : ∃ E : ℕ → ℝ, ∀ i : ℕ, E i = Real.exp (-(((A : ℝ) - (i : ℝ)) / 40)) :=
    ⟨fun i => Real.exp (-(((A : ℝ) - (i : ℝ)) / 40)), fun _ => rfl⟩
  have hEpos : ∀ i, 0 < E i := fun i => by rw [hE]; exact Real.exp_pos _
  have hr0 : 0 < Real.exp (-1 / 40) := Real.exp_pos _
  have hr1 : Real.exp (-1 / 40) ≤ 40 / 41 := by
    have h1 : (1 / 40 : ℝ) + 1 ≤ Real.exp (1 / 40) := Real.add_one_le_exp _
    have h2 : Real.exp (-1 / 40) * Real.exp (1 / 40) = 1 := by
      rw [← Real.exp_add]; norm_num
    nlinarith [Real.exp_pos (1 / 40 : ℝ)]
  have hrec : ∀ n : ℕ, E n = Real.exp (-1 / 40) * E (n + 1) := by
    intro n
    rw [hE, hE, ← Real.exp_add]
    congr 1
    push_cast
    ring
  have hH : ∀ n : ℕ, (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, E i) ≤ 40 * E n := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      rw [Finset.sum_range_zero]
      linarith [hEpos 0]
    | succ n ih =>
      rw [Finset.sum_range_succ]
      have h3 := hrec n
      have hp := hEpos (n + 1)
      nlinarith
  have hG : ∀ k : ℕ, (∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, ((k - i : ℕ) : ℝ) * E i) ≤ 1640 * E k := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero =>
      rw [Finset.sum_range_zero]
      linarith [hEpos 0]
    | succ k ih =>
      have h1 : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1),
          ((k + 1 - i : ℕ) : ℝ) * E i = ((k - i : ℕ) : ℝ) * E i + E i := by
        intro i hi
        have : i ≤ k := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
        rw [show k + 1 - i = (k - i) + 1 by omega, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
        ring
      have hsplit : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), ((k + 1 - i : ℕ) : ℝ) * E i) =
          (∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, ((k - i : ℕ) : ℝ) * E i) +
            ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), E i := by
        rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl h1, Finset.sum_add_distrib,
          Finset.sum_range_succ (fun i => ((k - i : ℕ) : ℝ) * E i)]
        simp
      rw [hsplit]
      have h2 := hH (k + 1)
      have h3 := hrec k
      have hp := hEpos (k + 1)
      nlinarith
  have hEL : E L = Real.exp (-((M : ℝ) / 40)) := by
    rw [hE, hAR]
    congr 1
    ring
  have ht : E L * ((40 : ℝ) + M) ≤ 40 := by
    rw [hEL]
    have h1 : (M : ℝ) / 40 + 1 ≤ Real.exp ((M : ℝ) / 40) := Real.add_one_le_exp _
    have h2 : Real.exp (-((M : ℝ) / 40)) * Real.exp ((M : ℝ) / 40) = 1 := by
      rw [← Real.exp_add]; simp
    have h3 := Real.exp_pos (-((M : ℝ) / 40))
    nlinarith
  set S := (∑ i ∈ Finset.range L, ((L - i : ℕ) : ℝ) * E i) with hSdef
  have hS : S ≤ 1640 * E L := hG L
  have hSl : (1 / 10000) * S ≤ Real.log (1 + δ) := by
    have hpos : (0 : ℝ) < 40 + M := by linarith
    have h1 : (1 / 10000) * S * (40 + M) ≤ (164 / 25 : ℝ) := by
      have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hS hpos.le
      nlinarith
    have h2 : (164 / 25 : ℝ) ≤ Real.log (1 + δ) * (40 + M) := by nlinarith
    exact le_of_mul_le_mul_right (h1.trans h2) hpos
  have hprod : (∏ i ∈ Finset.range L, FordGeometry.expandedParameter A i ^ (L - i)) ≤
      ∏ i ∈ Finset.range L, Real.exp (((L - i : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((1 / 10000) * E i)) := by
    apply Finset.prod_le_prod
    · intro i _
      apply pow_nonneg
      unfold FordGeometry.expandedParameter
      positivity
    · intro i _
      rw [Real.exp_nat_mul]
      apply pow_le_pow_left₀
      · unfold FordGeometry.expandedParameter
        positivity
      · unfold FordGeometry.expandedParameter
        have := Real.add_one_le_exp ((1 / 10000) * E i)
        rw [hE] at this ⊢
        linarith
  rw [← Real.exp_sum] at hprod
  have hsum : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range L, ((L - i : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((1 / 10000) * E i)) =
      (1 / 10000) * S := by
    rw [hSdef, Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    ring
  rw [hsum] at hprod
  have h3 : Real.exp ((1 / 10000) * S) ≤ Real.exp (Real.log (1 + δ)) :=
    Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hSl
  rw [Real.exp_log (by linarith)] at h3
  linarith

informal_problem.statement:
(L : ℕ) (ξ : ℕ → ℝ) (A : ℕ) (η τ : ℝ)
    (hξ : ∀ j, 1 ≤ ξ j) (hη : 0 < η) (hη1 : η ≤ 1)
    (hH : (∏ i ∈ Finset.range L, ξ i ^ (L - i)) ≤ 1 + η / 4) (hτ : 0 ≤ τ) :
    MeasureTheory.volume.real (FordGeometry.parameterConcentrationUnion L ξ A η +
        Set.Icc (fun _ : Fin L => -τ) (fun _ => τ)) ≤
      (∏ i ∈ Finset.range L, ξ i ^ (L - i)) *
        MeasureTheory.volume.real (FordGeometry.parameterConcentrationUnion L (fun _ => 1) A (η / 2) +
          Set.Icc (fun _ : Fin L => -τ) (fun _ => τ))

signature.name: parameter_concentration_diagonal_reduction
signature.statement:
(L : ℕ) (ξ : ℕ → ℝ) (A : ℕ) (η τ : ℝ)
    (hξ : ∀ j, 1 ≤ ξ j) (hη : 0 < η) (hη1 : η ≤ 1)
    (hH : (∏ i ∈ Finset.range L, ξ i ^ (L - i)) ≤ 1 + η / 4) (hτ : 0 ≤ τ) :
    MeasureTheory.volume.real (FordGeometry.parameterConcentrationUnion L ξ A η +
        Set.Icc (fun _ : Fin L => -τ) (fun _ => τ)) ≤
      (∏ i ∈ Finset.range L, ξ i ^ (L - i)) *
        MeasureTheory.volume.real (FordGeometry.parameterConcentrationUnion L (fun _ => 1) A (η / 2) +
          Set.Icc (fun _ : Fin L => -τ) (fun _ => τ))

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hw : ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → 0 ≤ fordWeight n := by
    intro n hn
    unfold fordWeight
    have hm : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hn
    have hm0 : (0 : ℝ) < (n : ℝ) := by linarith
    have hm1 : (0 : ℝ) < (n : ℝ) + 1 := by linarith
    have hlog2 : Real.log 2 ≤ Real.log ((n : ℝ) + 1) :=
      Real.log_le_log (by norm_num) (by linarith)
    have h2 := Real.log_two_gt_d9
    have hdiv := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (show 0 < (n : ℝ) / ((n : ℝ) + 1) by positivity)
    rw [Real.log_div hm0.ne' hm1.ne'] at hdiv
    have hfrac : (n : ℝ) / ((n : ℝ) + 1) - 1 = -(1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) := by
      rw [div_sub_one hm1.ne']
      ring
    have h3 : 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) ≤ Real.log ((n : ℝ) + 1) - Real.log (n : ℝ) := by linarith
    have h4 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h3 hm0.le
    have h5 : 1 / 2 ≤ (n : ℝ) * (1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) := by
      rw [mul_one_div, div_le_div_iff₀ (by norm_num) hm1]
      linarith
    nlinarith
  
  have hprod : ∀ n : ℕ, (∏ j ∈ Finset.range n, ∏ i ∈ Finset.range (j + 1), ξ i) =
      ∏ i ∈ Finset.range n, ξ i ^ (n - i) := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => simp
    | succ n ih =>
      rw [Finset.prod_range_succ (fun j => ∏ i ∈ Finset.range (j + 1), ξ i) n, ih,
        Finset.prod_range_succ (fun i => ξ i ^ (n + 1 - i)) n,
        Finset.prod_range_succ (fun i => ξ i) n]
      have hsplit : ∏ i ∈ Finset.range n, ξ i ^ (n + 1 - i) =
          (∏ i ∈ Finset.range n, ξ i ^ (n - i)) * ∏ i ∈ Finset.range n, ξ i := by
        rw [← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
        apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
        intro i hi
        rw [Finset.mem_range] at hi
        rw [show n + 1 - i = (n - i) + 1 by omega, pow_succ]
      rw [hsplit, show n + 1 - n = 1 by omega, pow_one]
      ring
  
  obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ : ∃ S : ℕ → ℝ, S = fun m => ∏ i ∈ Finset.range m, ξ i := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hSzero : S 0 = 1 := by rw [hS]; simp
  have hSsucc : ∀ m, S (m + 1) = S m * ξ m := by
    intro m; rw [hS]; exact Finset.prod_range_succ _ _
  have hS1 : ∀ m, 1 ≤ S m := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero => exact le_of_eq hSzero.symm
    | succ m ih => rw [hSsucc]; nlinarith [hξ m]
  have hSpos : ∀ m, 0 < S m := fun m => by linarith [hS1 m]
  have hSmono : Monotone S :=
    monotone_nat_of_le_succ (fun m => by rw [hSsucc]; nlinarith [hS1 m, hξ m])
  have hSone : S 1 = ξ 0 := by rw [hSsucc, hSzero, one_mul]
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ : ∃ s : Fin L → ℝ, s = fun j => S (j.val + 1) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hs1 : ∀ j, 1 ≤ s j := fun j => by simp only [hs]; exact hS1 _
  have hspos : ∀ j, 0 < s j := fun j => by linarith [hs1 j]
  have hprodeq : (∏ j, s j) = ∏ i ∈ Finset.range L, ξ i ^ (L - i) := by
    rw [← hprod L]
    simp only [hs, hS]
    exact Fin.prod_univ_eq_prod_range (fun j => ∏ i ∈ Finset.range (j + 1), ξ i) L
  
  have hsle : ∀ j, s j ≤ 1 + η / 4 := by
    intro j
    have hme := Finset.mul_prod_erase Finset.univ s (Finset.mem_univ j)
    have hone : 1 ≤ ∏ k ∈ Finset.univ.erase j, s k := by
      have : (∏ k ∈ Finset.univ.erase j, (1 : ℝ)) ≤ ∏ k ∈ Finset.univ.erase j, s k :=
        Finset.prod_le_prod (fun _ _ => zero_le_one) (fun k _ => hs1 k)
      simpa using this
    have hsj : s j ≤ ∏ k, s k := by
      rw [← hme]
      exact le_mul_of_one_le_right (hspos j).le hone
    rw [hprodeq] at hsj
    linarith
  
  have hscal : ∀ r σ : ℝ, 1 ≤ σ → σ ≤ 1 + η / 4 → η ≤ |r - 1| → η / 2 ≤ |r / σ - 1| := by
    intro r σ hσ1 hσ2 hr
    have hσ : 0 < σ := by linarith
    rw [div_sub_one hσ.ne', abs_div, abs_of_pos hσ, le_div_iff₀ hσ]
    have htri : |r - 1| ≤ |r - σ| + |σ - 1| := abs_sub_le r σ 1
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ σ - 1)] at htri
    nlinarith
  
  have hnorm : ∀ x ∈ FordGeometry.polytope L ξ,
      (fun j => x j / s j) ∈ FordGeometry.polytope L (fun _ => 1) := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨h0, h1, hanti, houter, htail⟩ := hx
    refine ⟨fun j => div_nonneg (h0 j) (hspos j).le,
      fun j => (div_le_self (h0 j) (hs1 j)).trans (h1 j), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro a b hab
      have hab' : a.val ≤ b.val := hab
      have hsab : s a ≤ s b := by
        simp only [hs]; exact hSmono (show a.val + 1 ≤ b.val + 1 by omega)
      have hxb := h0 b
      have hsa := hspos a
      have hx' := hanti hab
      show x b / s b ≤ x a / s a
      calc x b / s b ≤ x b / s a := div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hxb hsa hsab
        _ ≤ x a / s a := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hx' hsa.le
    · show ∑ j, fordWeight (j.val + 1) * (x j / s j) ≤ 1
      have ho : ∑ j, fordWeight (j.val + 1) * x j ≤ ξ 0 := houter
      have hξ0 : 0 < ξ 0 := by linarith [hξ 0]
      calc ∑ j, fordWeight (j.val + 1) * (x j / s j)
          ≤ ∑ j, fordWeight (j.val + 1) * x j / ξ 0 := by
            apply Finset.sum_le_sum
            intro j _
            rw [mul_div_assoc]
            apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (hw _ (by omega))
            apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (h0 j) hξ0
            simp only [hs]
            rw [← hSone]
            exact hSmono (show 1 ≤ j.val + 1 by omega)
        _ = (∑ j, fordWeight (j.val + 1) * x j) / ξ 0 := by rw [Finset.sum_div]
        _ ≤ ξ 0 / ξ 0 := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right ho hξ0.le
        _ = 1 := div_self hξ0.ne'
    · intro idx hidx
      show ∑ j, FordGeometry.tailWeight idx j * (x j / s j) ≤ 1 * (x idx / s idx)
      have ht : ∑ j, FordGeometry.tailWeight idx j * x j ≤ ξ (idx.val + 1) * x idx :=
        htail idx hidx
      have hS'pos : 0 < S (idx.val + 2) := hSpos _
      have hS'eq : S (idx.val + 2) = s idx * ξ (idx.val + 1) := by
        simp only [hs]; exact hSsucc _
      have hξi : 0 < ξ (idx.val + 1) := by linarith [hξ (idx.val + 1)]
      calc ∑ j, FordGeometry.tailWeight idx j * (x j / s j)
          ≤ ∑ j, FordGeometry.tailWeight idx j * x j / S (idx.val + 2) := by
            apply Finset.sum_le_sum
            intro j _
            by_cases hij : idx.val < j.val
            · have htw : 0 ≤ FordGeometry.tailWeight idx j := by
                unfold FordGeometry.tailWeight
                rw [if_pos hij]
                split_ifs
                · exact hw _ (by omega)
                · norm_num
              rw [mul_div_assoc]
              apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ htw
              apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (h0 j) hS'pos
              simp only [hs]
              exact hSmono (show idx.val + 2 ≤ j.val + 1 by omega)
            · have htw : FordGeometry.tailWeight idx j = 0 := by
                unfold FordGeometry.tailWeight
                rw [if_neg hij]
              rw [htw]; simp
        _ = (∑ j, FordGeometry.tailWeight idx j * x j) / S (idx.val + 2) := by
            rw [Finset.sum_div]
        _ ≤ (ξ (idx.val + 1) * x idx) / S (idx.val + 2) :=
            div_le_div_of_nonneg_right ht hS'pos.le
        _ = 1 * (x idx / s idx) := by
            rw [hS'eq, one_mul, mul_comm (s idx), mul_div_mul_left _ _ hξi.ne']
  
  have hpcu : ∀ x ∈ FordGeometry.parameterConcentrationUnion L ξ A η,
      (fun j => x j / s j) ∈ FordGeometry.parameterConcentrationUnion L (fun _ => 1) A (η / 2) := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨hxP, i, hi, hdev⟩ := hx
    refine ⟨hnorm x hxP, i, hi, ?_⟩
    show η / 2 ≤ |x i / s i / (FordAnalysis.rho ^ (i.val + 1) *
      ((FordGeometry.concentrationDistance i : ℝ) / (L : ℝ))) - 1|
    rw [div_right_comm]
    exact hscal _ _ (hs1 i) (hsle i) hdev
  
  set C : Set (Fin L → ℝ) := Set.Icc (fun _ : Fin L => -τ) (fun _ => τ) with hC
  set P1 : Set (Fin L → ℝ) := FordGeometry.parameterConcentrationUnion L (fun _ => 1) A (η / 2)
    with hP1
  let f : (Fin L → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] (Fin L → ℝ) := Matrix.toLin' (Matrix.diagonal s)
  have hf : ∀ y : Fin L → ℝ, f y = fun j => s j * y j := by
    intro y; funext j; simp [f, Matrix.toLin'_apply, Matrix.mulVec_diagonal]
  have hdet : LinearMap.det f = ∏ j, s j := by
    simp only [f, LinearMap.det_toLin', Matrix.det_diagonal]
  have hincl : FordGeometry.parameterConcentrationUnion L ξ A η + C ⊆ f '' (P1 + C) := by
    intro z hz
    obtain ⟨x, hx, e, he, rfl⟩ := Set.mem_add.mp hz
    refine ⟨(fun j => x j / s j) + (fun j => e j / s j), Set.add_mem_add (hpcu x hx) ?_, ?_⟩
    · obtain ⟨he1, he2⟩ := he
      have hab : ∀ j, |e j / s j| ≤ τ := by
        intro j
        have h1 : -τ ≤ e j := he1 j
        have h2 : e j ≤ τ := he2 j
        rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos (hspos j)]
        exact (div_le_self (abs_nonneg _) (hs1 j)).trans (abs_le.mpr ⟨h1, h2⟩)
      constructor
      · intro j
        show -τ ≤ e j / s j
        exact (abs_le.mp (hab j)).1
      · intro j
        show e j / s j ≤ τ
        exact (abs_le.mp (hab j)).2
    · rw [hf]
      funext j
      have hsj := (hspos j).ne'
      simp only [Pi.add_apply]
      field_simp
  
  have hP1sub : P1 ⊆ Set.Icc (fun _ : Fin L => (0 : ℝ)) (fun _ => 1) :=
    fun x hx => ⟨fun i => hx.1.1 i, fun i => hx.1.2.1 i⟩
  have hbdd : Bornology.IsBounded (P1 + C) :=
    ((Metric.isBounded_Icc _ _).subset hP1sub).add (Metric.isBounded_Icc _ _)
  have hfin : MeasureTheory.volume (P1 + C) ≠ ⊤ := hbdd.measure_lt_top.ne
  have himg : MeasureTheory.volume (f '' (P1 + C)) =
      ENNReal.ofReal |LinearMap.det f| * MeasureTheory.volume (P1 + C) :=
    MeasureTheory.Measure.addHaar_image_linearMap _ f _
  have hc0 : 0 ≤ ∏ j, s j := Finset.prod_nonneg (fun j _ => (hspos j).le)
  have hne : MeasureTheory.volume (f '' (P1 + C)) ≠ ⊤ := by
    rw [himg]; exact ENNReal.mul_ne_top ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top hfin
  have hvol : MeasureTheory.volume.real (FordGeometry.parameterConcentrationUnion L ξ A η + C) ≤
      (∏ j, s j) * MeasureTheory.volume.real (P1 + C) := by
    calc _ ≤ MeasureTheory.volume.real (f '' (P1 + C)) :=
          MeasureTheory.measureReal_mono hincl hne
      _ = _ := by
        rw [MeasureTheory.measureReal_def, himg, ENNReal.toReal_mul, hdet, abs_of_nonneg hc0,
          ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hc0, MeasureTheory.measureReal_def]
  rw [hprodeq] at hvol
  exact hvol

by
  
  have hclosed : ∀ (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ),

    intro n t s x

    · rintro ⟨hs, hx, hsum⟩

      rw [show t - t * s = t * (1 - s) by ring, mul_pow, mul_pow, pow_add]

    have he_apply (s : ℝ) (x : Fin n → ℝ) : e (s, x) = Fin.cons s x := by

    let g := ({x : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ | (∀ j, 0 ≤ x j) ∧ ∑ j, x j ≤ t}).indicator f

        simp only [g, Set.indicator, hx]

            {x : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ | (∀ j, 0 ≤ x j) ∧ ∑ j, x j ≤ t} := by
          intro hx

    calc
      _ = ∫ x, g x := (integral_indicator (hmeas (n + 1) t)).symm
      _ = ∫ z : ℝ × (Fin n → ℝ), g (e z) := (he.integral_comp' g).symm
      _ = ∫ s : ℝ, ∫ x : Fin n → ℝ, g (Fin.cons s x) := by
        rw [Measure.volume_eq_prod]
        simpa only [he_apply] using integral_prod (fun z : ℝ × (Fin n → ℝ) => g (e z))
          (by simpa only [Measure.volume_eq_prod, Function.comp_def] using hge)
      _ = _ := by
        simp_rw [hsl]
        exact integral_indicator measurableSet_Icc
  
  have hmono : ∀ (n r : ℕ) (k : Fin n → ℕ) (t : ℝ), 0 ≤ t →
      (∫ x in {x : Fin n → ℝ | (∀ j, 0 ≤ x j) ∧ ∑ j, x j ≤ t}, (t - ∑ j, x j) ^ r * ∏ j, x j ^ k j) =
        ((r.factorial : ℝ) * (∏ j, ((k j).factorial : ℝ)) / ((n + r + ∑ j, k j).factorial : ℝ)) *
          t ^ (n + r + ∑ j, k j) := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro r k t ht
      have huniv : {x : Fin 0 → ℝ | (∀ j, 0 ≤ x j) ∧ ∑ j, x j ≤ t} = Set.univ := by
        ext x
        simp [ht]
      have hvol : volume.real (Set.univ : Set (Fin 0 → ℝ)) = 1 := by
        simp [measureReal_def, volume_pi]
      rw [huniv]
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_zero, Fin.prod_univ_zero, sub_zero, mul_one,
        zero_add, add_zero, setIntegral_const, smul_eq_mul, hvol, one_mul]
      rw [div_self (by positivity : (r.factorial : ℝ) ≠ 0), one_mul]
    | succ n ih =>
      intro r k t ht
      let k' : Fin n → ℕ := fun j => k j.succ
      let R : ℕ := n + r + ∑ j, k' j
      let C : ℝ := (r.factorial : ℝ) * (∏ j, ((k' j).factorial : ℝ)) / R.factorial
      have hf : Continuous (fun x : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ =>
          (t - ∑ j, x j) ^ r * ∏ j, (x j) ^ (k j)) := by fun_prop
      rw [hslice n t _ hf]
      have hsl (s : ℝ) (hs : s ∈ Set.Icc 0 t) :
          (∫ x in {x : Fin n → ℝ | (∀ j, 0 ≤ x j) ∧ ∑ j, x j ≤ t - s},
            (t - ∑ j, (Fin.cons s x : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) j) ^ r *
              ∏ j, ((Fin.cons s x : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) j) ^ (k j)) =
            s ^ (k 0) * (C * (t - s) ^ R) := by
        have hpoly (x : Fin n → ℝ) :
            (t - ∑ j, (Fin.cons s x : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) j) ^ r *
              ∏ j, ((Fin.cons s x : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) j) ^ (k j) =
            s ^ (k 0) * ((t - s - ∑ j, x j) ^ r * ∏ j, (x j) ^ (k' j)) := by
          simp only [Fin.sum_univ_succ, Fin.prod_univ_succ, Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_succ]
          rw [show t - (s + ∑ j, x j) = t - s - ∑ j, x j by ring]
          dsimp only [k']
          ring
        simp_rw [hpoly]
        rw [integral_const_mul, ih r k' (t - s) (sub_nonneg.mpr hs.2)]

        _ = ∫ s : ℝ in Set.Icc 0 t, s ^ (k 0) * (C * (t - s) ^ R) := by
          apply setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Icc
          exact hsl
        _ = C * (∫ s : ℝ in Set.Icc 0 t, s ^ (k 0) * (t - s) ^ R) := by
          rw [← integral_const_mul]
          apply integral_congr_ae
          filter_upwards [] with s

          have hdegree : n + 1 + r + ∑ j, k j = k 0 + R + 1 := by

  have hsum4 : ∀ (m : ℕ) (i j k l : Fin m),

    ring
  have hpfs : ∀ (m : ℕ) (a : Fin m → ℕ) (i : Fin m),

      · simp [hv]
    simp_rw [hp]
    rw [Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
    simp only [Finset.prod_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, ↓reduceIte]
  have hweight : ∀ (m : ℕ) (i j k l : Fin m),
      (∏ v, ((Nat.factorial ((if v = i then 1 else 0) + ((if v = j then 1 else 0) +
          ((if v = k then 1 else 0) + (if v = l then 1 else 0)))) : ℕ) : ℝ)) =

          (if i = l then 1 else 0) + (if j = k then 1 else 0) +
          (if j = l then 1 else 0) + (if k = l then 1 else 0) +

          (if i = j ∧ k = l then 1 else 0) + (if i = k ∧ j = l then 1 else 0) +
          (if i = l ∧ j = k then 1 else 0) +
          (if i = j ∧ i = k ∧ i = l then (6 : ℝ) else 0) := by
    intro m i j k l

      intro v _
      split_ifs <;> norm_num
    rw [hlast]
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst j
      by_cases hik : i = k
      · subst k
        by_cases hil : i = l <;> norm_num [hil]
      · by_cases hil : i = l
        · subst l
          norm_num [hik, Ne.symm hik]
        · by_cases hkl : k = l <;> norm_num [hik, hil, hkl]
    · by_cases hik : i = k
      · subst k
        by_cases hil : i = l
        · subst l
          norm_num [hij, Ne.symm hij]
        · by_cases hjl : j = l <;>
            norm_num [hij, Ne.symm hij, hil, Ne.symm hil, hjl]
      · by_cases hjk : j = k
        · subst k
          by_cases hil : i = l
          · subst l
            norm_num [hij, Ne.symm hij]
          · by_cases hjl : j = l <;> norm_num [hij, hil, hjl]
        · by_cases hil : i = l
          · subst l

          · by_cases hjl : j = l
            · subst l

            · by_cases hkl : k = l <;>

  have hmixed : ∀ (m : ℕ) (b : Fin m → ℝ),

          (if i = k ∧ i = l then 2 else 0) + (if j = k ∧ j = l then 2 else 0) +
          (if i = j ∧ k = l then 1 else 0) + (if i = k ∧ j = l then 1 else 0) +
          (if i = l ∧ j = k then 1 else 0) +
          (if i = j ∧ i = k ∧ i = l then (6 : ℝ) else 0))) =
        (∑ i, b i) ^ 4 + 6 * (∑ i, b i) ^ 2 * (∑ i, b i ^ 2) + 8 * (∑ i, b i) * (∑ i, b i ^ 3) +

    intro m b
    simp only [mul_add, mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero, Finset.sum_add_distrib, ite_and]
    simp only [Finset.sum_ite_irrel, Finset.sum_ite_eq, Finset.mem_univ, ↓reduceIte,
      Finset.sum_const_zero]
    ring_nf
    simp only [← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_mul]
    ring_nf
  have hW : ∀ (m : ℕ) (b : Fin m → ℝ),
      (∑ i, ∑ j, ∑ k, ∑ l, b i * b j * b k * b l *
          ∏ v, ((Nat.factorial ((if v = i then 1 else 0) + ((if v = j then 1 else 0) +
            ((if v = k then 1 else 0) + (if v = l then 1 else 0)))) : ℕ) : ℝ)) =
        (∑ i, b i) ^ 4 + 6 * (∑ i, b i) ^ 2 * (∑ i, b i ^ 2) + 8 * (∑ i, b i) * (∑ i, b i ^ 3) +
          3 * (∑ i, b i ^ 2) ^ 2 + 6 * (∑ i, b i ^ 4) := by
    intro m b

  have hexp4 : ∀ (m : ℕ) (b Y : Fin m → ℝ), (∑ i, b i * Y i) ^ 4 =
      ∑ i, ∑ j, ∑ k, ∑ l, (b i * b j * b k * b l) * (Y i * Y j * Y k * Y l) := by
    intro m b Y
    have h4p : ∀ z : Fin m → ℝ, (∑ i, ∑ j, ∑ k, ∑ l, z i * z j * z k * z l) = (∑ i, z i) ^ 4 := by
      intro z
      simp only [← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_mul]
      ring
    rw [← h4p]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ =>
      Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ => by ring
  
  have hfourth : ∀ (n : ℕ) (b : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ),
      (∫ x in {x : Fin n → ℝ | (∀ j, 0 ≤ x j) ∧ ∑ j, x j ≤ 1},
        (∑ i, b i * (Fin.cons (1 - ∑ j, x j) x : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) i) ^ 4) =
      ((∑ i, b i) ^ 4 + 6 * (∑ i, b i) ^ 2 * (∑ i, b i ^ 2) + 8 * (∑ i, b i) * (∑ i, b i ^ 3) +
        3 * (∑ i, b i ^ 2) ^ 2 + 6 * (∑ i, b i ^ 4)) / ((n + 4).factorial : ℝ) := by
    intro n b
    have hsumI : ∀ (f : Fin (n + 1) → (Fin n → ℝ) → ℝ), (∀ i, Continuous (f i)) →
        (∫ x in {x : Fin n → ℝ | (∀ j, 0 ≤ x j) ∧ ∑ j, x j ≤ 1}, ∑ i, f i x) =
          ∑ i, ∫ x in {x : Fin n → ℝ | (∀ j, 0 ≤ x j) ∧ ∑ j, x j ≤ 1}, f i x :=
      fun f hf => integral_finset_sum Finset.univ (fun i _ =>
        (hf i).continuousOn.integrableOn_compact (hcompact n 1))
    have h4 : ∀ i j k l : Fin (n + 1),
        (∫ x in {x : Fin n → ℝ | (∀ j, 0 ≤ x j) ∧ ∑ j, x j ≤ 1},
          (Fin.cons (1 - ∑ j, x j) x : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) i *
            (Fin.cons (1 - ∑ j, x j) x : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) j *
            (Fin.cons (1 - ∑ j, x j) x : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) k *
            (Fin.cons (1 - ∑ j, x j) x : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) l) =
          (∏ v, ((Nat.factorial ((if v = i then 1 else 0) + ((if v = j then 1 else 0) +
            ((if v = k then 1 else 0) + (if v = l then 1 else 0)))) : ℕ) : ℝ)) /
            ((n + 4).factorial : ℝ) := by
      intro i j k l
      have h := hbarymono n (fun v => (if v = i then 1 else 0) + ((if v = j then 1 else 0) +
        ((if v = k then 1 else 0) + (if v = l then 1 else 0))))
      rw [hsum4] at h
      simp_rw [hprodpow] at h
      exact h
    have hcont : ∀ i j k l : Fin (n + 1), Continuous (fun x : Fin n → ℝ =>
        (b i * b j * b k * b l) *
          ((Fin.cons (1 - ∑ j, x j) x : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) i *
            (Fin.cons (1 - ∑ j, x j) x : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) j *
            (Fin.cons (1 - ∑ j, x j) x : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) k *
            (Fin.cons (1 - ∑ j, x j) x : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) l)) := fun i j k l =>
      continuous_const.mul ((((hy n i).mul (hy n j)).mul (hy n k)).mul (hy n l))
    simp_rw [hexp4 (n + 1) b]
    rw [hsumI _ (fun i => continuous_finset_sum _ fun j _ => continuous_finset_sum _ fun k _ =>
      continuous_finset_sum _ fun l _ => hcont i j k l)]
    simp_rw [hsumI _ (fun j => continuous_finset_sum _ fun k _ =>
      continuous_finset_sum _ fun l _ => hcont _ j k l)]
    simp_rw [hsumI _ (fun k => continuous_finset_sum _ fun l _ => hcont _ _ k l)]
    simp_rw [hsumI _ (fun l => hcont _ _ _ l)]
    simp_rw [integral_const_mul, h4]
    simp only [← mul_div_assoc, ← Finset.sum_div]
    rw [hW]
  
  have hmarkov : ∀ (n : ℕ) (f : (Fin n → ℝ) → ℝ), Continuous f → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε →
      ε ^ 4 * MeasureTheory.volume.real
          ({x : Fin n → ℝ | (∀ j, 0 ≤ x j) ∧ ∑ j, x j ≤ 1} ∩ {x | ε ≤ |f x|}) ≤
        ∫ x in {x : Fin n → ℝ | (∀ j, 0 ≤ x j) ∧ ∑ j, x j ≤ 1}, f x ^ 4 := by
    intro n f hf ε hε
    have hfi : Integrable (fun x => (f x) ^ 4)
        (volume.restrict {x : Fin n → ℝ | (∀ j, 0 ≤ x j) ∧ ∑ j, x j ≤ 1}) :=
      (hf.pow 4).continuousOn.integrableOn_compact (hcompact n 1)
    have hnonneg : 0 ≤ᵐ[volume.restrict {x : Fin n → ℝ | (∀ j, 0 ≤ x j) ∧ ∑ j, x j ≤ 1}]
        (fun x => (f x) ^ 4) :=
      Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => by positivity)
    have h := mul_meas_ge_le_integral_of_nonneg hnonneg hfi (ε ^ 4)
    have hset : {x : Fin n → ℝ | ε ^ 4 ≤ (f x) ^ 4} = {x | ε ≤ |f x|} := by
      ext x
      change ε ^ 4 ≤ (f x) ^ 4 ↔ ε ≤ |f x|
      rw [← (show Even (4 : ℕ) by decide).pow_abs (f x)]
      exact pow_le_pow_iff_left₀ hε.le (abs_nonneg _) (by norm_num)
    rw [hset, measureReal_restrict_apply' (hmeas n 1), Set.inter_comm] at h
    exact h
  
  intro n c ε hε
  obtain ⟨b, hb0, hb2, hstat⟩ : ∃ b : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ, ∑ i, b i = 0 ∧
      ∑ i, b i ^ 2 ≤ ∑ j, c j ^ 2 ∧
      ∀ x : Fin n → ℝ, ∑ i, b i * (Fin.cons (1 - ∑ j, x j) x : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) i =
        ∑ j, c j * x j - (∑ j, c j) / ((n : ℝ) + 1) := by
    set m : ℝ := (∑ j, c j) / ((n : ℝ) + 1) with hm
    have hN : (0 : ℝ) < (n : ℝ) + 1 := by positivity
    have hS : ∑ j, c j = ((n : ℝ) + 1) * m := by
      rw [hm]
      field_simp
    refine ⟨Fin.cons (-m) (fun j => c j - m), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp only [Fin.sum_univ_succ, Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_succ, Finset.sum_sub_distrib,
        Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul, hS]
      ring
    · simp only [Fin.sum_univ_succ, Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_succ]
      have hexp : ∑ j, (c j - m) ^ 2 = ∑ j, c j ^ 2 - 2 * m * ∑ j, c j + (n : ℝ) * m ^ 2 := by
        have : ∀ j, (c j - m) ^ 2 = c j ^ 2 - 2 * m * c j + m ^ 2 := fun j => by ring
        simp only [this, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum,
          Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
      rw [hexp, hS]
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg m]
    · intro x
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_succ, Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_succ, sub_mul,
        Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum]
      ring
  have hset : {u : Fin n → ℝ | (∀ j, 0 ≤ u j) ∧ ∑ j, u j ≤ 1 ∧
      ε ≤ |∑ j, c j * u j - (∑ j, c j) / ((n : ℝ) + 1)|} =
      {x : Fin n → ℝ | (∀ j, 0 ≤ x j) ∧ ∑ j, x j ≤ 1} ∩
        {x | ε ≤ |∑ i, b i * (Fin.cons (1 - ∑ j, x j) x : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) i|} := by
    ext x
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_inter_iff, hstat, and_assoc]
  rw [hset]
  have hM := hmarkov n (fun x => ∑ i, b i * (Fin.cons (1 - ∑ j, x j) x : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) i)
    (continuous_finset_sum _ fun i _ => continuous_const.mul (hy n i)) ε hε
  have hF := hfourth n b
  rw [hb0] at hF
  have hfac : ((n + 4).factorial : ℝ) =
      (((n : ℝ) + 1) * ((n : ℝ) + 2) * ((n : ℝ) + 3) * ((n : ℝ) + 4)) * n.factorial := by
    simp only [show n + 4 = ((n + 1) + 1) + 1 + 1 by omega, Nat.factorial_succ,
      Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
    ring
  set V := MeasureTheory.volume.real ({x : Fin n → ℝ | (∀ j, 0 ≤ x j) ∧ ∑ j, x j ≤ 1} ∩
        {x | ε ≤ |∑ i, b i * (Fin.cons (1 - ∑ j, x j) x : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) i|}) with hV
  set I := ∫ x in {x : Fin n → ℝ | (∀ j, 0 ≤ x j) ∧ ∑ j, x j ≤ 1},
        (∑ i, b i * (Fin.cons (1 - ∑ j, x j) x : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) i) ^ 4 with hI
  set B := ∑ i, b i ^ 2 with hB
  set Q := ∑ i, b i ^ 4 with hQ
  set C := ∑ j, c j ^ 2 with hC
  set D := ((n : ℝ) + 1) * ((n : ℝ) + 2) * ((n : ℝ) + 3) * ((n : ℝ) + 4) with hD
  have hfpos : (0 : ℝ) < (n.factorial : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hDpos : 0 < D := by positivity
  have hN4 : (0 : ℝ) < ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ 4 := by positivity
  have hDge : ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ 4 ≤ D := by
    rw [hD]
    have h0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ n := Nat.cast_nonneg n
    calc ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ 4 = ((n : ℝ) + 1) * ((n : ℝ) + 1) * ((n : ℝ) + 1) * ((n : ℝ) + 1) := by
          ring
      _ ≤ _ := by gcongr <;> linarith
  have hB0 : 0 ≤ B := Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => sq_nonneg (b i)
  have hQB : Q ≤ B ^ 2 := by
    have h := Finset.sum_sq_le_sq_sum_of_nonneg (s := Finset.univ) (f := fun i => b i ^ 2)
      (fun i _ => sq_nonneg (b i))
    have hq : Q = ∑ i, (b i ^ 2) ^ 2 := by
      rw [hQ]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by ring
    rw [hq]
    exact h
  have hBC : B ^ 2 ≤ C ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ hB0 hb2 2
  have hnum : 3 * B ^ 2 + 6 * Q ≤ 9 * C ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hFI : (n.factorial : ℝ) * I = (3 * B ^ 2 + 6 * Q) / D := by
    rw [hF, hfac]
    simp only [zero_pow (by norm_num : 4 ≠ 0), zero_pow (by norm_num : 2 ≠ 0),
      mul_zero, zero_mul, zero_add]
    field_simp
  have hX : (n.factorial : ℝ) * V * ε ^ 4 ≤ (3 * B ^ 2 + 6 * Q) / D := by
    rw [← hFI]
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hM hfpos.le
    linarith [this]
  have hY : (3 * B ^ 2 + 6 * Q) / D ≤ 9 * C ^ 2 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ 4 := by
    rw [div_le_div_iff₀ hDpos hN4]
    exact mul_le_mul hnum hDge hN4.le (by positivity)
  have hε4 : 0 < ε ^ 4 := pow_pos hε 4
  rw [le_div_iff₀ (mul_pos hN4 hε4)]
  have hZ : (n.factorial : ℝ) * V * ε ^ 4 ≤ 9 * C ^ 2 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ 4 := hX.trans hY
  rw [le_div_iff₀ hN4] at hZ
  linarith [hZ]

informal_problem.statement:
(hREN : (217 / 400 : ℝ) < FordAnalysis.rho ∧ FordAnalysis.rho < 2713 / 5000 ∧
      ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < FordAnalysis.g n ∧ 0 < FordAnalysis.gStar n ∧
        (1 ≤ n → FordAnalysis.g n * FordAnalysis.rho ^ n < 17 / 50) ∧
        (2 ≤ n → (31 / 100 : ℝ) < FordAnalysis.g n * FordAnalysis.rho ^ n) ∧
        (2 ≤ n → FordAnalysis.gStar n * FordAnalysis.rho ^ n < 1 / 2) ∧
        (1 / 4 : ℝ) ≤ FordAnalysis.gStar n * FordAnalysis.rho ^ n)
    (hERR : ∃ lam : ℝ, ∀ n : ℕ,
      |FordAnalysis.g n * FordAnalysis.rho ^ n - lam| ≤ 5 * FordAnalysis.rho ^ n) :
    (∀ (L : ℕ) (j : Fin L), 0 < FordOrder.weight L j) ∧
    (∀ (L : ℕ) (i j : Fin L),
      0 ≤ FordOrder.invWeight L i j / (FordAnalysis.rho ^ (i.val + 1) * FordOrder.weight L j) ∧
      FordOrder.invWeight L i j / (FordAnalysis.rho ^ (i.val + 1) * FordOrder.weight L j) ≤ 5) ∧
    (∀ (L : ℕ) (i j : Fin L), j.val < i.val →
      FordOrder.invWeight L i j / (FordAnalysis.rho ^ (i.val + 1) * FordOrder.weight L j) = 0) ∧
    (∀ (L : ℕ) (i : Fin L),
      |(∑ j : Fin L, FordOrder.invWeight L i j / (FordAnalysis.rho ^ (i.val + 1) * FordOrder.weight L j)) -
        ((L - i.val : ℕ) : ℝ)| ≤ 205) ∧
    (∀ L : ℕ, FordAnalysis.rho ^ L * ∑ j : Fin L, FordOrder.weight L j ≤ 4)
