proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨hρlo, hρhi, hn⟩ := hREN
  obtain ⟨lam, hlam⟩ := hERR
  have hρ0 : 0 < FordAnalysis.rho := by linarith
  have hρ1 : FordAnalysis.rho ≤ 1 := by linarith
  have hρlt1 : FordAnalysis.rho < 1 := by linarith
  
  have hg0 : FordAnalysis.g 0 = 1 := by rw [FordAnalysis.g]
  have hgs0 : FordAnalysis.gStar 0 = 1 := by rw [FordAnalysis.gStar]
  have hc1 : FordAnalysis.coeff 1 = 2 * Real.log 2 - 1 := by
    simp only [FordAnalysis.coeff, fordWeight]; norm_num
  have hg1 : FordAnalysis.g 1 = FordAnalysis.coeff 1 := by
    rw [FordAnalysis.g]; simp [hg0]
  have hgs1 : FordAnalysis.gStar 1 = 1 := by
    show FordAnalysis.g 1 + (1 - FordAnalysis.coeff 1) * FordAnalysis.g 0 = 1
    rw [hg1, hg0]; ring
  
  have hGup : ∀ n : ℕ, FordAnalysis.g n * FordAnalysis.rho ^ n ≤ 1 := by
    intro n
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with h | h
    · subst h; simp [hg0]
    · have := (hn n).2.2.1 h; linarith
  have hlog2 : (6931471803 / 10000000000 : ℝ) < Real.log 2 := by
    have := Real.log_two_gt_d9; norm_num at this ⊢; linarith
  have hGlo : ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → (1 / 5 : ℝ) ≤ FordAnalysis.g n * FordAnalysis.rho ^ n := by
    intro n hn1
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge n 2 with h | h
    · have h1 : n = 1 := by omega
      subst h1
      rw [hg1, hc1, pow_one]
      nlinarith [mul_pos (sub_pos.2 hlog2) (sub_pos.2 hρlo)]
    · have := (hn n).2.2.2.1 h; linarith
  have hSup : ∀ n : ℕ, FordAnalysis.gStar n * FordAnalysis.rho ^ n ≤ 1 := by
    intro n
    rcases n with _ | _ | n
    · simp [hgs0]
    · show FordAnalysis.gStar 1 * FordAnalysis.rho ^ 1 ≤ 1
      rw [hgs1, pow_one, one_mul]; exact hρ1
    · have := (hn (n + 2)).2.2.2.2.1 (by omega); linarith
  
  have hwpos : ∀ (L : ℕ) (j : Fin L), 0 < FordOrder.weight L j := by
    intro L j; unfold FordOrder.weight; split_ifs
    · exact (hn _).1
    · exact (hn _).2.1
  have hzero : ∀ (L : ℕ) (i j : Fin L), j.val < i.val →
      FordOrder.invWeight L i j / (FordAnalysis.rho ^ (i.val + 1) * FordOrder.weight L j) = 0 := by
    intro L i j hji
    have h : ¬ i.val ≤ j.val := by omega
    simp only [FordOrder.invWeight, if_neg h, zero_div]
  have hscale : ∀ (i j : ℕ) (a w : ℝ), i ≤ j → w ≠ 0 →
      a / (FordAnalysis.rho ^ (i + 1) * w) =
        (a * FordAnalysis.rho ^ (j - i)) / (w * FordAnalysis.rho ^ (j + 1)) := by
    intro i j a w hij hw
    have hp : FordAnalysis.rho ^ (j + 1) =
        FordAnalysis.rho ^ (i + 1) * FordAnalysis.rho ^ (j - i) := by
      rw [← pow_add]; congr 1; omega
    have h1 : FordAnalysis.rho ^ (i + 1) ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ hρ0.ne'
    have h2 : FordAnalysis.rho ^ (j - i) ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ hρ0.ne'
    rw [hp, div_eq_div_iff (mul_ne_zero h1 hw) (mul_ne_zero hw (mul_ne_zero h1 h2))]
    ring
  have hratio : ∀ X Y : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ 1 → 1 / 5 ≤ Y →
      0 ≤ X / Y ∧ X / Y ≤ 5 ∧ |X / Y - 1| ≤ 5 * |X - Y| := by
    intro X Y hX0 hX1 hY
    have hYp : 0 < Y := by linarith
    refine ⟨div_nonneg hX0 hYp.le, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [div_le_iff₀ hYp]; linarith
    · rw [div_sub_one hYp.ne', abs_div, abs_of_pos hYp, div_le_iff₀ hYp]
      nlinarith [abs_nonneg (X - Y)]
  have hratio' : ∀ X Y : ℝ, 0 ≤ X → X ≤ 1 → 1 / 4 ≤ Y → 0 ≤ X / Y ∧ X / Y ≤ 4 := by
    intro X Y hX0 hX1 hY
    have hYp : 0 < Y := by linarith
    refine ⟨div_nonneg hX0 hYp.le, ?_⟩
    rw [div_le_iff₀ hYp]; linarith
  have hentry : ∀ (L : ℕ) (i j : Fin L), i.val ≤ j.val →
      0 ≤ FordOrder.invWeight L i j / (FordAnalysis.rho ^ (i.val + 1) * FordOrder.weight L j) ∧
      FordOrder.invWeight L i j / (FordAnalysis.rho ^ (i.val + 1) * FordOrder.weight L j) ≤ 5 ∧
      (j.val + 1 < L →
        |FordOrder.invWeight L i j / (FordAnalysis.rho ^ (i.val + 1) * FordOrder.weight L j) - 1| ≤
          50 * FordAnalysis.rho ^ (j.val - i.val)) ∧
      (¬ j.val + 1 < L →
        |FordOrder.invWeight L i j / (FordAnalysis.rho ^ (i.val + 1) * FordOrder.weight L j) - 1| ≤
          4) := by
    intro L i j hij
    by_cases hA : j.val + 1 < L
    · have hw : FordOrder.weight L j = FordAnalysis.g (j.val + 1) := by
        simp only [FordOrder.weight, if_pos hA]
      have hv : FordOrder.invWeight L i j = FordAnalysis.g (j.val - i.val) := by
        simp only [FordOrder.invWeight, if_pos hij, if_pos hA]
      rw [hw, hv, hscale i.val j.val _ _ hij (hn _).1.ne']
      have hX0 : 0 ≤ FordAnalysis.g (j.val - i.val) * FordAnalysis.rho ^ (j.val - i.val) :=
        (mul_pos (hn _).1 (pow_pos hρ0 _)).le
      obtain ⟨r1, r2, r3⟩ := hratio _ _ hX0 (hGup _) (hGlo (j.val + 1) (by omega))
      refine ⟨r1, r2, fun _ => ?_, fun h => absurd hA h⟩
      have e1 := hlam (j.val - i.val)
      have e2 := hlam (j.val + 1)
      have hpow : FordAnalysis.rho ^ (j.val + 1) ≤ FordAnalysis.rho ^ (j.val - i.val) :=
        pow_le_pow_of_le_one hρ0.le hρ1 (by omega)
      have htri := abs_sub_le
        (FordAnalysis.g (j.val - i.val) * FordAnalysis.rho ^ (j.val - i.val)) lam
        (FordAnalysis.g (j.val + 1) * FordAnalysis.rho ^ (j.val + 1))
      rw [abs_sub_comm lam] at htri
      linarith
    · have hw : FordOrder.weight L j = FordAnalysis.gStar (j.val + 1) := by
        simp only [FordOrder.weight, if_neg hA]
      have hv : FordOrder.invWeight L i j = FordAnalysis.gStar (j.val - i.val) := by
        simp only [FordOrder.invWeight, if_pos hij, if_neg hA]
      rw [hw, hv, hscale i.val j.val _ _ hij (hn _).2.1.ne']
      have hX0 : 0 ≤ FordAnalysis.gStar (j.val - i.val) * FordAnalysis.rho ^ (j.val - i.val) :=
        (mul_pos (hn _).2.1 (pow_pos hρ0 _)).le
      obtain ⟨r1, r2⟩ := hratio' _ _ hX0 (hSup _) ((hn _).2.2.2.2.2)
      refine ⟨r1, by linarith, fun h => absurd h hA, fun _ => ?_⟩
      rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith
  
  have hP : ∀ (r : ℝ) (i L : ℕ), ∑ m ∈ Finset.range L, (if i ≤ m then r ^ (m - i) else 0) =
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (L - i), r ^ k := by
    intro r i L
    induction L with
    | zero => simp
    | succ L ih =>
      rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, ih]
      by_cases h : i ≤ L
      · rw [if_pos h, show L + 1 - i = (L - i) + 1 by omega, Finset.sum_range_succ]
      · rw [if_neg h, show L + 1 - i = L - i by omega, add_zero]
  have hgeom : ∀ N : ℕ, ∑ k ∈ Finset.range N, FordAnalysis.rho ^ k ≤ 4 := by
    intro N
    have h := geom_sum_Ico_le_of_lt_one (m := 0) (n := N) hρ0.le hρlt1
    rw [← Finset.range_eq_Ico, pow_zero] at h
    refine h.trans ?_
    rw [div_le_iff₀ (by linarith)]; linarith
  have hT : ∀ L : ℕ, ∑ m ∈ Finset.range L, (if L ≤ m + 1 then (4 : ℝ) else 0) ≤ 4 := by
    intro L
    cases L with
    | zero => simp
    | succ L =>
      rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, if_pos le_rfl]
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun m hm => if_neg (by have := Finset.mem_range.mp hm; omega))]
      norm_num
  have hrow : ∀ (L : ℕ) (i : Fin L),
      |(∑ j : Fin L, FordOrder.invWeight L i j /
          (FordAnalysis.rho ^ (i.val + 1) * FordOrder.weight L j)) -
        ((L - i.val : ℕ) : ℝ)| ≤ 205 := by
    intro L i
    have hcount : ((L - i.val : ℕ) : ℝ) =
        ∑ j : Fin L, (if i.val ≤ j.val then (1 : ℝ) else 0) := by
      have h := Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun m => if i.val ≤ m then (1 : ℝ) else 0) L
      rw [h]
      have h2 := hP 1 i.val L
      simp only [one_pow] at h2
      rw [h2]; simp
    have hterm : ∀ j : Fin L,
        |FordOrder.invWeight L i j / (FordAnalysis.rho ^ (i.val + 1) * FordOrder.weight L j) -
          (if i.val ≤ j.val then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤
        50 * (if i.val ≤ j.val then FordAnalysis.rho ^ (j.val - i.val) else 0) +
          (if L ≤ j.val + 1 then (4 : ℝ) else 0) := by
      intro j
      by_cases hij : i.val ≤ j.val
      · simp only [if_pos hij]
        obtain ⟨_, _, h3, h4⟩ := hentry L i j hij
        have hp : 0 ≤ FordAnalysis.rho ^ (j.val - i.val) := pow_nonneg hρ0.le _
        by_cases hA : j.val + 1 < L
        · rw [if_neg (by omega)]; linarith [h3 hA]
        · rw [if_pos (by omega)]; linarith [h4 hA]
      · simp only [if_neg hij]
        rw [hzero L i j (by omega)]
        have h0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ if L ≤ j.val + 1 then (4 : ℝ) else 0 := by
          split_ifs <;> norm_num
        simp only [sub_zero, abs_zero, mul_zero, zero_add]
        exact h0
    rw [hcount, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    refine (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _).trans ?_
    refine (Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => hterm j).trans ?_
    rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum]
    have hS : ∑ j : Fin L,
        (if i.val ≤ j.val then FordAnalysis.rho ^ (j.val - i.val) else 0) ≤ 4 := by
      have h := Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range
        (fun m => if i.val ≤ m then FordAnalysis.rho ^ (m - i.val) else 0) L
      rw [h, hP]; exact hgeom _
    have hT' : ∑ j : Fin L, (if L ≤ j.val + 1 then (4 : ℝ) else 0) ≤ 4 := by
      have h := Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun m => if L ≤ m + 1 then (4 : ℝ) else 0) L
      rw [h]; exact hT L
    linarith
  
  have hwsum : ∀ L : ℕ, FordAnalysis.rho ^ L * ∑ j : Fin L, FordOrder.weight L j ≤ 4 := by
    intro L
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    have hb : ∀ j : Fin L, FordAnalysis.rho ^ L * FordOrder.weight L j ≤
        FordAnalysis.rho ^ (L - 1 - j.val) := by
      intro j
      have hj := j.isLt
      have h1 : FordAnalysis.rho ^ (j.val + 1) * FordOrder.weight L j ≤ 1 := by
        unfold FordOrder.weight
        split_ifs
        · rw [mul_comm]; exact hGup _
        · rw [mul_comm]; exact hSup _
      have hpow : FordAnalysis.rho ^ L =
          FordAnalysis.rho ^ (L - 1 - j.val) * FordAnalysis.rho ^ (j.val + 1) := by
        rw [← pow_add]; congr 1; omega
      rw [hpow, mul_assoc]
      calc _ ≤ FordAnalysis.rho ^ (L - 1 - j.val) * 1 :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (pow_nonneg hρ0.le _)
        _ = _ := mul_one _
    refine (Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => hb j).trans ?_
    have h := Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun m => FordAnalysis.rho ^ (L - 1 - m)) L
    have h2 := Finset.sum_range_reflect (fun m => FordAnalysis.rho ^ m) L
    rw [h, h2]
    exact hgeom L
  refine ⟨hwpos, ?_, hzero, hrow, hwsum⟩
  intro L i j
  by_cases hij : i.val ≤ j.val
  · exact ⟨(hentry L i j hij).1, (hentry L i j hij).2.1⟩
  · rw [hzero L i j (by omega)]; norm_num

informal_problem.statement:
(L : ℕ) (hL : 2 ≤ L) (τ : ℝ) (hτ : 0 ≤ τ)
    (hsmall : τ ≤ 10 * FordAnalysis.rho ^ L / (L : ℝ)) (hρ : 0 < FordAnalysis.rho)
    (hw : ∀ j : Fin L, 0 < FordOrder.weight L j)
    (hc : ∀ i j : Fin L,
      0 ≤ FordOrder.invWeight L i j / (FordAnalysis.rho ^ (i.val + 1) * FordOrder.weight L j) ∧
      FordOrder.invWeight L i j / (FordAnalysis.rho ^ (i.val + 1) * FordOrder.weight L j) ≤ 5)
    (hW : FordAnalysis.rho ^ L * ∑ j : Fin L, FordOrder.weight L j ≤ 4) :
    ∃ Φ : (Fin L → ℝ) → (Fin L → ℝ),
      (∀ E : Set (Fin L → ℝ), MeasureTheory.volume.real E ≤
        Real.exp 80 * ((L.factorial : ℝ) * FordGeometry.modelVolume L) * MeasureTheory.volume.real (Φ '' E)) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ FordGeometry.polytope L (fun _ => 1), ∀ e ∈ Set.Icc (fun _ : Fin L => -τ) (fun _ => τ),
        (∀ j, 0 ≤ Φ (x + e) j) ∧ (∑ j, Φ (x + e) j ≤ 1) ∧
        ∀ i : Fin L, |(∑ j, FordOrder.invWeight L i j /
            (FordAnalysis.rho ^ (i.val + 1) * FordOrder.weight L j) * Φ (x + e) j) -
          x i / FordAnalysis.rho ^ (i.val + 1)| ≤ 400 / (L : ℝ))

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have hLpos : (0 : ℝ) < L := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < L by omega)
  have hg0 : FordAnalysis.g 0 = 1 := by rw [FordAnalysis.g]
  
  have hfw : ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → 0 ≤ fordWeight n := by
    intro n hn
    have hi1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast hn
    have hi0 : (0 : ℝ) < n := by linarith
    have hip : (0 : ℝ) < (n : ℝ) + 1 := by positivity
    have hlow := Real.one_sub_inv_le_log_of_pos (div_pos hip hi0)
    rw [Real.log_div hip.ne' hi0.ne', inv_div] at hlow
    have hl := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlow hip.le
    have hid₁ : ((n : ℝ) + 1) * (1 - (n : ℝ) / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) = 1 := by
      field_simp
      ring
    rw [hid₁] at hl
    unfold fordWeight
    nlinarith [Real.log_nonneg hi1]
  
  have htw0 : ∀ i j : Fin L, j.val ≤ i.val → FordGeometry.tailWeight i j = 0 := by
    intro i j h
    unfold FordGeometry.tailWeight
    rw [if_neg (by omega)]
  have htwnn : ∀ i j : Fin L, 0 ≤ FordGeometry.tailWeight i j := by
    intro i j
    unfold FordGeometry.tailWeight
    split_ifs with h1 h2
    · exact hfw _ (by omega)
    · norm_num
    · norm_num
  
  have hprod : ∏ j : Fin L, FordOrder.weight L j = FordAnalysis.renewalDenominator L := by
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ : ∃ n, L = n + 1 := ⟨L - 1, by omega⟩
    subst hn
    rw [Fin.prod_univ_castSucc]
    have hi : ∀ i : Fin n, FordOrder.weight (n + 1) i.castSucc = FordAnalysis.g (i.val + 1) := by
      intro i
      simp [FordOrder.weight, show i.val + 1 < n + 1 by omega]
    simp_rw [hi]
    have hl : FordOrder.weight (n + 1) (Fin.last n) = FordAnalysis.gStar (n + 1) := by
      simp [FordOrder.weight]
    rw [hl, Fin.prod_univ_eq_prod_range (fun i => FordAnalysis.g (i + 1)) n]
    unfold FordAnalysis.renewalDenominator
    rw [Finset.prod_range_succ']
    simp only [hg0, mul_one]
  have hrD : 0 < FordAnalysis.renewalDenominator L := by
    rw [← hprod]
    exact Finset.prod_pos (fun j _ => hw j)
  have hmV : (L.factorial : ℝ) * FordGeometry.modelVolume L =
      1 / FordAnalysis.renewalDenominator L := by
    unfold FordGeometry.modelVolume
    have : (0 : ℝ) < L.factorial := by exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_pos L
    field_simp
  
  obtain ⟨W, hWdef⟩ : ∃ W : ℝ, W = ∑ j : Fin L, FordOrder.weight L j := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hWdef] at hW
  have hW0 : 0 ≤ W := by
    rw [hWdef]
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => (hw j).le)
  have hσ0 : 0 ≤ 2 * τ * W := mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hτ) hW0
  obtain ⟨s, hsdef⟩ : ∃ s : ℝ, s = 1 + 2 * τ * W := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hs1 : 1 ≤ s := by rw [hsdef]; linarith
  have hs0 : 0 < s := by linarith
  have hτL : τ * (L : ℝ) ≤ 10 * FordAnalysis.rho ^ L := (le_div_iff₀ hLpos).mp hsmall
  have hτLW : τ * (L : ℝ) * W ≤ 10 * FordAnalysis.rho ^ L * W := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hτL hW0
  have hpow : s ^ L ≤ Real.exp 80 := by
    have hexp : (L : ℝ) * (2 * τ * W) ≤ 80 := by nlinarith
    rw [hsdef]
    calc (1 + 2 * τ * W) ^ L ≤ (Real.exp (2 * τ * W)) ^ L :=
          pow_le_pow_left₀ (by linarith) (by linarith [Real.add_one_le_exp (2 * τ * W)]) L
      _ = Real.exp ((L : ℝ) * (2 * τ * W)) := by rw [Real.exp_nat_mul]
      _ ≤ Real.exp 80 := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hexp
  obtain ⟨R, hRdef⟩ : ∃ R : Fin L → ℝ, R = fun j => 1 + ∑ k, FordGeometry.tailWeight j k :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hRj : ∀ j, R j = 1 + ∑ k, FordGeometry.tailWeight j k := fun j => by rw [hRdef]
  obtain ⟨d, hddef⟩ : ∃ d : Fin L → ℝ, d = fun j => FordOrder.weight L j / s := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hdj : ∀ j, d j = FordOrder.weight L j / s := fun j => by rw [hddef]
  obtain ⟨b, hbdef⟩ : ∃ b : Fin L → ℝ, b = fun j => FordOrder.weight L j * τ * R j / s := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hbj : ∀ j, b j = FordOrder.weight L j * τ * R j / s := fun j => by rw [hbdef]
  obtain ⟨Φ, hΦ⟩ : ∃ Φ : (Fin L → ℝ) → (Fin L → ℝ),
      Φ = fun z j => d j * FordOrder.slack z j + b j := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hΦapp : ∀ z j, Φ z j = d j * FordOrder.slack z j + b j := fun z j => by rw [hΦ]
  have hslack_eq : ∀ (z : Fin L → ℝ) (j : Fin L),
      FordOrder.slack z j = z j - ∑ k, FordGeometry.tailWeight j k * z k := fun z j => rfl
  refine ⟨Φ, ?_, ?_⟩
  
  · intro E
    obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ : ∃ A : Matrix (Fin L) (Fin L) ℝ,
        A = fun i j => (if i = j then 1 else 0) - FordGeometry.tailWeight i j := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hAapply : ∀ (z : Fin L → ℝ) (i : Fin L),
        Matrix.toLin' A z i = z i - ∑ j, FordGeometry.tailWeight i j * z j := by
      intro z i
      rw [Matrix.toLin'_apply, hA]
      simp [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, sub_mul, ite_mul, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    have hdetA : LinearMap.det (Matrix.toLin' A) = 1 := by
      rw [LinearMap.det_toLin', Matrix.det_of_upperTriangular]
      · apply Finset.prod_eq_one
        intro i _
        rw [hA]
        simp [htw0 i i le_rfl]
      · intro i j hij
        simp only [id] at hij
        rw [hA]
        have hji : j.val ≤ i.val := le_of_lt hij
        simp [htw0 i j hji, ne_of_gt hij]
    have hDapp : ∀ (v : Fin L → ℝ) (j : Fin L),
        Matrix.toLin' (Matrix.diagonal d) v j = d j * v j := by
      intro v j
      simp [Matrix.toLin'_apply, Matrix.mulVec_diagonal]
    have hdetD : LinearMap.det (Matrix.toLin' (Matrix.diagonal d)) = ∏ j, d j := by
      rw [LinearMap.det_toLin', Matrix.det_diagonal]
    have hdpos : 0 < ∏ j, d j :=
      Finset.prod_pos (fun j _ => by rw [hdj]; exact div_pos (hw j) hs0)
    have hmapeq : Φ = (fun y => y + b) ∘ (Matrix.toLin' (Matrix.diagonal d)) ∘ (Matrix.toLin' A) := by
      funext z j
      rw [hΦapp]
      simp only [Function.comp_apply, Pi.add_apply, hDapp, hAapply]
      rfl
    have hvolE : MeasureTheory.volume (Φ '' E) =
        ENNReal.ofReal (∏ j, d j) * MeasureTheory.volume E := by
      rw [hmapeq, Set.image_comp, Set.image_comp, Set.image_add_right,
        MeasureTheory.measure_preimage_add_right,
        MeasureTheory.Measure.addHaar_image_linearMap,
        MeasureTheory.Measure.addHaar_image_linearMap, hdetA, hdetD, abs_one, ENNReal.ofReal_one,
        one_mul, abs_of_pos hdpos]
    have hreal : MeasureTheory.volume.real (Φ '' E) =
        (∏ j, d j) * MeasureTheory.volume.real E := by
      rw [MeasureTheory.measureReal_def, MeasureTheory.measureReal_def, hvolE, ENNReal.toReal_mul,
        ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hdpos.le]
    have hprodd : ∏ j, d j = FordAnalysis.renewalDenominator L / s ^ L := by
      rw [Finset.prod_congr rfl (fun j _ => hdj j), Finset.prod_div_distrib, Finset.prod_const,
        Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, hprod]
    rw [hreal, hprodd, hmV]
    have hsL : 0 < s ^ L := pow_pos hs0 L
    have heq : Real.exp 80 * (1 / FordAnalysis.renewalDenominator L) *
        (FordAnalysis.renewalDenominator L / s ^ L * MeasureTheory.volume.real E) =
        (Real.exp 80 / s ^ L) * MeasureTheory.volume.real E := by
      field_simp
    rw [heq]
    exact le_mul_of_one_le_left MeasureTheory.measureReal_nonneg ((one_le_div hsL).mpr hpow)
  
  · intro x hx e he
    have hk := (ford_slack_coordinates L).1 hL
    have hinv := (ford_slack_coordinates L).2.1
    have hei : ∀ i, -τ ≤ e i ∧ e i ≤ τ := fun i => ⟨he.1 i, he.2 i⟩
    have hslack_add : ∀ j, FordOrder.slack (x + e) j =
        FordOrder.slack x j + FordOrder.slack e j := by
      intro j
      rw [hslack_eq, hslack_eq, hslack_eq]
      simp only [Pi.add_apply, mul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      ring
    have hbnd : ∀ a : Fin L → ℝ, (∀ j, 0 ≤ a j) →
        ∑ j, a j * e j ≤ (∑ j, a j) * τ ∧ -((∑ j, a j) * τ) ≤ ∑ j, a j * e j := by
      intro a ha
      rw [Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
      exact ⟨Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hei j).2 (ha j),
        Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => by nlinarith [(hei j).1, ha j]⟩
    have htfx : ∀ i : Fin L, ∑ j, FordGeometry.tailWeight i j * x j ≤ x i := by
      intro i
      by_cases hi : i.val + 1 < L
      · have h := hx.2.2.2.2 i hi
        have h' : FordGeometry.tailForm i x = ∑ j, FordGeometry.tailWeight i j * x j := rfl
        rw [h'] at h
        linarith
      · rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun j _ => by
          rw [htw0 i j (by have := j.isLt; omega), zero_mul])]
        exact hx.1 i
    have hsx : ∀ j, 0 ≤ FordOrder.slack x j := fun j => by rw [hslack_eq]; linarith [htfx j]
    have hge : ∀ j, 0 ≤ FordOrder.slack e j + τ * R j := by
      intro j
      rw [hslack_eq, hRj]
      have h2 := (hbnd _ (htwnn j)).1
      have h3 := (hei j).1
      nlinarith
    have hu : ∀ j, 0 ≤ FordOrder.weight L j * FordOrder.slack x j :=
      fun j => mul_nonneg (hw j).le (hsx j)
    have hg : ∀ j, 0 ≤ FordOrder.weight L j * (FordOrder.slack e j + τ * R j) :=
      fun j => mul_nonneg (hw j).le (hge j)
    have hones : ∑ j, FordOrder.weight L j * (1 - ∑ k, FordGeometry.tailWeight j k) =
        ∑ j : Fin L, fordWeight (j.val + 1) := by
      have h := hk (fun _ => 1)
      have ho1 : FordGeometry.outerForm L (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) =
          ∑ j : Fin L, fordWeight (j.val + 1) * 1 := rfl
      rw [ho1] at h
      simp only [hslack_eq, mul_one] at h
      exact h
    have hWR : ∑ j, FordOrder.weight L j * R j = 2 * W - ∑ j : Fin L, fordWeight (j.val + 1) := by
      have h2 : ∑ j, FordOrder.weight L j * R j +
          ∑ j, FordOrder.weight L j * (1 - ∑ k, FordGeometry.tailWeight j k) = 2 * W := by
        rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib, hWdef, Finset.mul_sum]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro j _
        rw [hRj]
        ring
      linarith
    have hox : FordGeometry.outerForm L x ≤ 1 := hx.2.2.2.1
    have hoe : FordGeometry.outerForm L e ≤ τ * ∑ j : Fin L, fordWeight (j.val + 1) := by
      have ho : FordGeometry.outerForm L e = ∑ j, fordWeight (j.val + 1) * e j := rfl
      rw [ho]
      have := (hbnd (fun j => fordWeight (j.val + 1)) (fun j => hfw _ (by omega))).1
      simp only at this
      linarith
    have hsumu : ∑ j, FordOrder.weight L j * FordOrder.slack x j ≤ 1 := by
      rw [hk x]
      exact hox
    have hsumg : ∑ j, FordOrder.weight L j * (FordOrder.slack e j + τ * R j) ≤ 2 * τ * W := by
      have h1 : ∑ j, FordOrder.weight L j * (FordOrder.slack e j + τ * R j) =
          FordGeometry.outerForm L e + τ * ∑ j, FordOrder.weight L j * R j := by
        rw [← hk e, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro j _
        ring
      rw [h1, hWR]
      linarith
    have hΦxe : ∀ j, Φ (x + e) j =
        (FordOrder.weight L j * FordOrder.slack x j +
          FordOrder.weight L j * (FordOrder.slack e j + τ * R j)) / s := by
      intro j
      rw [hΦapp, hslack_add, hdj, hbj, div_mul_eq_mul_div, ← add_div]
      congr 1
      ring
    refine ⟨fun j => ?_, ?_, fun i => ?_⟩
    · rw [hΦxe]
      exact div_nonneg (add_nonneg (hu j) (hg j)) hs0.le
    · rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => hΦxe j), ← Finset.sum_div, Finset.sum_add_distrib,
        div_le_one hs0]
      linarith
    · have hρi : 0 < FordAnalysis.rho ^ (i.val + 1) := pow_pos hρ _
      have hcu : ∀ j, FordOrder.invWeight L i j /
          (FordAnalysis.rho ^ (i.val + 1) * FordOrder.weight L j) *
            (FordOrder.weight L j * FordOrder.slack x j) =
          FordOrder.invWeight L i j * FordOrder.slack x j / FordAnalysis.rho ^ (i.val + 1) := by
        intro j
        rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_eq_div_iff (mul_pos hρi (hw j)).ne' hρi.ne']
        ring
      have hV : ∑ j, FordOrder.invWeight L i j /
          (FordAnalysis.rho ^ (i.val + 1) * FordOrder.weight L j) *
            (FordOrder.weight L j * FordOrder.slack x j) = x i / FordAnalysis.rho ^ (i.val + 1) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => hcu j), ← Finset.sum_div, hinv x i]
      have hsplit : ∀ j, FordOrder.invWeight L i j /
          (FordAnalysis.rho ^ (i.val + 1) * FordOrder.weight L j) * Φ (x + e) j =
          (FordOrder.invWeight L i j /
            (FordAnalysis.rho ^ (i.val + 1) * FordOrder.weight L j) *
              (FordOrder.weight L j * FordOrder.slack x j) +
            FordOrder.invWeight L i j /
            (FordAnalysis.rho ^ (i.val + 1) * FordOrder.weight L j) *
              (FordOrder.weight L j * (FordOrder.slack e j + τ * R j))) / s := by
        intro j
        rw [hΦxe]
        ring
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => hsplit j), ← Finset.sum_div, Finset.sum_add_distrib, hV]
      rw [← hV]
      set V := ∑ j, FordOrder.invWeight L i j /
          (FordAnalysis.rho ^ (i.val + 1) * FordOrder.weight L j) *
            (FordOrder.weight L j * FordOrder.slack x j) with hVdef
      set Γ := ∑ j, FordOrder.invWeight L i j /
          (FordAnalysis.rho ^ (i.val + 1) * FordOrder.weight L j) *
            (FordOrder.weight L j * (FordOrder.slack e j + τ * R j)) with hΓdef
      have hV0 : 0 ≤ V := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => mul_nonneg (hc i j).1 (hu j))
      have hV5 : V ≤ 5 := by
        have h1 : V ≤ ∑ j, 5 * (FordOrder.weight L j * FordOrder.slack x j) :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hc i j).2 (hu j))
        rw [← Finset.mul_sum] at h1
        linarith
      have hΓ0 : 0 ≤ Γ := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => mul_nonneg (hc i j).1 (hg j))
      have hΓ5 : Γ ≤ 5 * (2 * τ * W) := by
        have h1 : Γ ≤ ∑ j, 5 * (FordOrder.weight L j * (FordOrder.slack e j + τ * R j)) :=

        rw [le_div_iff₀ hLpos]
        nlinarith
      refine le_trans ?_ h5
      rw [abs_le]
      constructor
      · rw [le_sub_iff_add_le, le_div_iff₀ hs0, hsdef]
        nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hV5) hσ0, mul_nonneg hσ0 hσ0]

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have hmemCI : ∀ i ∈ FordGeometry.concentrationIndices L A,
      A ≤ FordGeometry.concentrationDistance i := fun i hi => (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2
  
  have hs2 : (∑ i ∈ FordGeometry.concentrationIndices L A,
      ((FordGeometry.concentrationDistance i : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹) ≤ 2 / (A : ℝ) := by
    have hinj : Set.InjOn (fun i : Fin L => FordGeometry.concentrationDistance i)
        (FordGeometry.concentrationIndices L A : Set (Fin L)) := by
      intro i hi j hj hij
      have h1 := hmemCI i hi
      have h2 := hmemCI j hj
      have hi' := i.isLt
      have hj' := j.isLt
      simp only [FordGeometry.concentrationDistance] at hij h1 h2
      apply Fin.ext
      omega
    have hsub : (FordGeometry.concentrationIndices L A).image
        (fun i : Fin L => FordGeometry.concentrationDistance i) ⊆ Finset.Ioo (A - 1) L := by
      intro r hr
      obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hr
      have h1 := hmemCI i hi
      have hi' := i.isLt
      simp only [FordGeometry.concentrationDistance] at h1 ⊢
      rw [Finset.mem_Ioo]
      omega
    calc (∑ i ∈ FordGeometry.concentrationIndices L A,
          ((FordGeometry.concentrationDistance i : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹)
        = ∑ r ∈ (FordGeometry.concentrationIndices L A).image
            (fun i : Fin L => FordGeometry.concentrationDistance i), ((r : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
          rw [Finset.sum_image hinj]
      _ ≤ ∑ r ∈ Finset.Ioo (A - 1) L, ((r : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹ :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hsub (fun _ _ _ => by positivity)
      _ ≤ 2 / (((A - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1) := sum_Ioo_inv_sq_le _ _
      _ = 2 / (A : ℝ) := by
          rw [Nat.cast_sub (by omega)]
          push_cast
          ring_nf
  
  have hs3 : ∀ (d : ℕ) (σ S : ℝ), 32960 ≤ d → d + 1 ≤ L → |σ - ((d : ℝ) + 1)| ≤ 205 →
      (1 / 80 : ℝ) ≤ |S / ((d : ℝ) / (L : ℝ)) - 1| →
      (d : ℝ) / (160 * (L : ℝ)) ≤ |S - σ / ((L : ℝ) + 1)| := by
    intro d σ S hd hdL hσ hS
    have hdR : (32960 : ℝ) ≤ d := by exact_mod_cast hd
    have hLR : (d : ℝ) + 1 ≤ L := by exact_mod_cast hdL
    have hLpos : (0 : ℝ) < L := by linarith
    have hdpos : (0 : ℝ) < d := by linarith
    have hqpos : (0 : ℝ) < (d : ℝ) / (L : ℝ) := div_pos hdpos hLpos
    have hmean' : |σ / ((L : ℝ) + 1) / ((d : ℝ) / (L : ℝ)) - 1| ≤ 1 / 160 := by
      have heq : σ / ((L : ℝ) + 1) / ((d : ℝ) / (L : ℝ)) - 1 =
          ((L : ℝ) * (σ - ((d : ℝ) + 1)) + ((L : ℝ) - d)) / (((L : ℝ) + 1) * d) := by
        field_simp
        ring
      rw [heq, abs_div, abs_of_pos (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < ((L : ℝ) + 1) * d),
        div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
      have h1 : |(L : ℝ) * (σ - ((d : ℝ) + 1)) + ((L : ℝ) - d)| ≤ 206 * L := by
        have h := abs_add_le ((L : ℝ) * (σ - ((d : ℝ) + 1))) ((L : ℝ) - d)
        rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos hLpos, abs_of_pos (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) < L - d)] at h
        have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hσ hLpos.le
        linarith
      have h3 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ((d : ℝ) - 32960) * L := mul_nonneg (by linarith) hLpos.le
      nlinarith
    have htri := abs_sub_le (S / ((d : ℝ) / (L : ℝ))) (σ / ((L : ℝ) + 1) / ((d : ℝ) / (L : ℝ))) 1
    have h2 : 1 / 160 ≤ |S / ((d : ℝ) / (L : ℝ)) - σ / ((L : ℝ) + 1) / ((d : ℝ) / (L : ℝ))| := by
      linarith
    rw [← sub_div, abs_div, abs_of_pos hqpos, le_div_iff₀ hqpos] at h2
    have h4 : (d : ℝ) / (160 * L) = 1 / 160 * ((d : ℝ) / L) := by
      field_simp
    linarith
  
  have hs4 : ∀ (d : ℕ) (r : Fin L → ℝ), 32960 ≤ d → d + 1 ≤ L → (∀ j, 0 ≤ r j ∧ r j ≤ 5) →
      |(∑ j, r j) - ((d : ℝ) + 1)| ≤ 205 →
      (L.factorial : ℝ) * MeasureTheory.volume.real {u : Fin L → ℝ | (∀ j, 0 ≤ u j) ∧ ∑ j, u j ≤ 1 ∧
          (d : ℝ) / (160 * (L : ℝ)) ≤ |∑ j, r j * u j - (∑ j, r j) / ((L : ℝ) + 1)|} ≤
        22500 * 160 ^ 4 / ((d : ℝ) ^ 2) := by
    intro d r hd hdL hr hσ
    have hdR : (32960 : ℝ) ≤ d := by exact_mod_cast hd
    have hLR : (d : ℝ) + 1 ≤ L := by exact_mod_cast hdL
    have hLpos : (0 : ℝ) < L := by linarith
    have hdpos : (0 : ℝ) < d := by linarith
    have hε : (0 : ℝ) < (d : ℝ) / (160 * (L : ℝ)) := by positivity
    refine (hFOURTH L r _ hε).trans ?_
    have hsq : ∑ j, r j ^ 2 ≤ 50 * d := by
      have h1 : ∑ j, r j ^ 2 ≤ ∑ j, 5 * r j :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _ => by nlinarith [hr j])
      rw [← Finset.mul_sum] at h1
      have h2 := (abs_le.mp hσ).2
      linarith
    have hsq0 : 0 ≤ ∑ j, r j ^ 2 := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => sq_nonneg _)
    have hsq2 : (∑ j, r j ^ 2) ^ 2 ≤ (50 * (d : ℝ)) ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ hsq0 hsq 2
    have hkey : (22500 * 160 ^ 4 : ℝ) * (((L : ℝ) + 1) ^ 4 * ((d : ℝ) / (160 * (L : ℝ))) ^ 4) =
        22500 * (d : ℝ) ^ 4 * (((L : ℝ) + 1) ^ 4 / (L : ℝ) ^ 4) := by
      field_simp
    have hratio : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ((L : ℝ) + 1) ^ 4 / (L : ℝ) ^ 4 := by
      rw [le_div_iff₀ (by positivity), one_mul]
      exact pow_le_pow_left₀ hLpos.le (by linarith) 4
    rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by positivity), hkey]
    have hd4 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 22500 * (d : ℝ) ^ 4 := by positivity
    calc 9 * (∑ j, r j ^ 2) ^ 2 * (d : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ 9 * (50 * (d : ℝ)) ^ 2 * (d : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
          gcongr
      _ = 22500 * (d : ℝ) ^ 4 * 1 := by ring
      _ ≤ 22500 * (d : ℝ) ^ 4 * (((L : ℝ) + 1) ^ 4 / (L : ℝ) ^ 4) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hratio hd4
  
  have hidx : ∀ i ∈ FordGeometry.concentrationIndices L A,
      32960 ≤ FordGeometry.concentrationDistance i ∧ FordGeometry.concentrationDistance i + 1 ≤ L ∧
      |(∑ j, c i j) - ((FordGeometry.concentrationDistance i : ℝ) + 1)| ≤ 205 := by
    intro i hi
    have h1 := hmemCI i hi
    have hlt := i.isLt
    have hd1 : 32960 ≤ FordGeometry.concentrationDistance i := by omega
    simp only [FordGeometry.concentrationDistance] at h1 hd1 ⊢
    have hi1 : i.val + 1 < L := by omega
    have heq : L - i.val = L - (i.val + 1) + 1 := by omega
    refine ⟨hd1, by omega, ?_⟩
    have h := hmean i hi1
    rw [heq] at h
    push_cast at h
    exact h
  
  let B : Fin L → Set (Fin L → ℝ) := fun i => {u : Fin L → ℝ | (∀ j, 0 ≤ u j) ∧ ∑ j, u j ≤ 1 ∧
      (FordGeometry.concentrationDistance i : ℝ) / (160 * (L : ℝ)) ≤
        |∑ j, c i j * u j - (∑ j, c i j) / ((L : ℝ) + 1)|}
  have hsub : {u : Fin L → ℝ | (∀ j, 0 ≤ u j) ∧ ∑ j, u j ≤ 1 ∧
        ∃ i ∈ FordGeometry.concentrationIndices L A,
          (1 / 80 : ℝ) ≤ |(∑ j, c i j * u j) /
            ((FordGeometry.concentrationDistance i : ℝ) / (L : ℝ)) - 1|} ⊆
      ⋃ i ∈ FordGeometry.concentrationIndices L A, B i := by
    intro u hu
    obtain ⟨hu0, hus, i, hi, hbad⟩ := hu
    obtain ⟨hd1, hd2, hσ⟩ := hidx i hi
    exact Set.mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨i, hi, hu0, hus, hs3 _ _ _ hd1 hd2 hσ hbad⟩
  have hfin : MeasureTheory.volume (⋃ i ∈ FordGeometry.concentrationIndices L A, B i) ≠ ⊤ := by
    refine ne_top_of_le_ne_top
      (isCompact_Icc (a := (fun _ : Fin L => (0 : ℝ))) (b := fun _ => 1)).measure_lt_top.ne
      (MeasureTheory.measure_mono ?_)
    intro u hu
    obtain ⟨i, hi, hu'⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp hu
    obtain ⟨hu0, hus, -⟩ := hu'
    refine ⟨fun j => hu0 j, fun j => ?_⟩
    have := Finset.single_le_sum (fun k _ => hu0 k) (Finset.mem_univ j)
    show u j ≤ 1
    linarith
  have hmono := MeasureTheory.measureReal_mono hsub hfin
  have hunion := MeasureTheory.measureReal_biUnion_finset_le
    (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) (FordGeometry.concentrationIndices L A) B
  have hper : ∀ i ∈ FordGeometry.concentrationIndices L A,
      (L.factorial : ℝ) * MeasureTheory.volume.real (B i) ≤
        (22500 * 160 ^ 4 : ℝ) * ((FordGeometry.concentrationDistance i : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
    intro i hi
    obtain ⟨hd1, hd2, hσ⟩ := hidx i hi
    have h := hs4 _ (c i) hd1 hd2 (fun j => hc i j) hσ
    rw [div_eq_mul_inv] at h
    exact h
  have hF0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (L.factorial : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
  calc _ ≤ (L.factorial : ℝ) * ∑ i ∈ FordGeometry.concentrationIndices L A,
          MeasureTheory.volume.real (B i) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hmono.trans hunion) hF0
    _ = ∑ i ∈ FordGeometry.concentrationIndices L A,
          (L.factorial : ℝ) * MeasureTheory.volume.real (B i) := Finset.mul_sum _ _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ FordGeometry.concentrationIndices L A,
          (22500 * 160 ^ 4 : ℝ) * ((FordGeometry.concentrationDistance i : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹ :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum hper
    _ = (22500 * 160 ^ 4 : ℝ) * ∑ i ∈ FordGeometry.concentrationIndices L A,
          ((FordGeometry.concentrationDistance i : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹ := (Finset.mul_sum _ _ _).symm
    _ ≤ (22500 * 160 ^ 4 : ℝ) * (2 / (A : ℝ)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs2 (by positivity)
    _ = 45000 * 160 ^ 4 / (A : ℝ) := by ring

proof.tactics:
by
  have hLL : Tendsto logLog atTop atTop := Real.tendsto_log_atTop.comp Real.tendsto_log_atTop
  filter_upwards [retained_top_prime_log_lower, hLL.eventually_ge_atTop (1501 : ℝ),

  intro m N hm hsqrt hN hNm hbad hfive hlsq
  subst hNm
  obtain ⟨hp, hplog⟩ := htop N hN hm hsqrt hbad hfive hlsq
  refine ⟨hp, ?_⟩
  set T := logLog x with hTdef
  have hlog : 0 < Real.log x := Real.log_pos hx1
  have hlx : Real.exp T = Real.log x := Real.exp_log hlog
  have hT0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ T := by linarith
  have hE2 : 4 * T < Real.log x / 6 := by
    have hq := Real.quadratic_le_exp_of_nonneg hT0
    rw [← hlx]
    nlinarith
  have hp0pos : (0 : ℝ) < (FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N 0 : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hp.pos
  have hlx4 : Real.log x ^ 4 < (FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N 0 : ℝ) := by
    have hl4pos : 0 < Real.log x ^ 4 := by positivity
    rw [← Real.log_lt_log_iff hl4pos hp0pos, Real.log_pow]
    have hTT : Real.log (Real.log x) = T := rfl
    rw [hTT]
    push_cast
    linarith
  have hsq : ¬ (FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N 0) ^ 2 ∣ N := by
    intro hdvd
    exact hlsq (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hm, N, hN, rfl, FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N 0, hp,
      hlx4, Or.inl hdvd⟩)
  have hprod : N.primeFactorsList.reverse.prod = N := by
    rw [List.prod_reverse]
    exact Nat.prod_primeFactorsList hN.ne'
  have hpr : ∀ q ∈ N.primeFactorsList.reverse, q.Prime := fun q hq =>
    Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactorsList (List.mem_reverse.mp hq)
  have hpw : (N.primeFactorsList.reverse).Pairwise (fun a b => b ≤ a) :=
    List.pairwise_reverse.mpr (Nat.primeFactorsList_sorted N).pairwise
  change (N.primeFactorsList.reverse.getD 0 1).Prime at hp
  change ¬ (N.primeFactorsList.reverse.getD 0 1) ^ 2 ∣ N at hsq
  show N.primeFactorsList.reverse.getD 1 1 < N.primeFactorsList.reverse.getD 0 1
  generalize N.primeFactorsList.reverse = L at hprod hpr hpw hp hsq ⊢
  match L, hprod, hpr, hpw, hp, hsq with
  | [], _, _, _, hp, _ =>
    exact absurd hp (by simp [Nat.not_prime_one])
  | [a], _, hpr, _, _, _ =>
    have ha : a.Prime := hpr a (by simp)
    show 1 < a
    exact ha.one_lt
  | a :: b :: t, hprod, _, hpw, _, hsq =>
    have hpw1 := List.pairwise_cons.mp hpw
    have hba : b ≤ a := hpw1.1 b (by simp)
    have hNeq : N = a * b * t.prod := by
      rw [← hprod, List.prod_cons, List.prod_cons, mul_assoc]
    show b < a
    rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hba with h | h
    · exact h
    · exfalso
      have hdvd : a ^ 2 ∣ N := ⟨t.prod, by rw [hNeq, h]; ring⟩
      exact hsq hdvd

    rw [Real.log_div hn1.ne' hnpos.ne', inv_div] at h1
    have e1 : 1 - n / (n + 1) = 1 / (n + 1) := by field_simp <;> ring
    have e2 : 1 - (n + 1)⁻¹ = n / (n + 1) := by field_simp <;> ring
    rw [e1, div_le_iff₀ hn1] at h1
    rw [e2, div_le_iff₀ hn1] at h2
    have h3 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 hnpos.le
    have h4 : 0 ≤ (n + 1) * ((n + 1) * Real.log (n + 1) - n * Real.log n - 1) := by
      nlinarith
    exact (mul_nonneg_iff_of_pos_left hn1).mp h4
  have hsub : ∀ f : Fin D → ℝ, (∀ j, 0 ≤ f j) →
      ∑ i : Fin K, f (Fin.castLE hKD i) ≤ ∑ j : Fin D, f j := by
    intro f hf
    have e : ∑ i : Fin K, f (Fin.castLE hKD i) =
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.map (Fin.castLEEmb hKD), f j := by
      rw [Finset.sum_map]; rfl
    rw [e]
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.subset_univ _) (fun j _ _ => hf j)
  have houter : FordGeometry.outerForm K (fun idx : Fin K => x (Fin.castLE hKD idx)) ≤
      FordGeometry.outerForm D x := by
    show ∑ i : Fin K, fordWeight (i.val + 1) * x (Fin.castLE hKD i) ≤
      ∑ j : Fin D, fordWeight (j.val + 1) * x j
    exact hsub (fun j => fordWeight (j.val + 1) * x j)
      (fun j => mul_nonneg (hw _ (by omega)) (hx0 j))
  refine ⟨⟨fun i => hx0 _, fun i => hx1 _, ?_, houter.trans hxouter, ?_⟩, houter⟩
  · intro i j hij
    apply hxanti
    rw [Fin.le_iff_val_le_val] at hij ⊢
    simpa using hij
  · intro idx hidx
    show ∑ j : Fin K, FordGeometry.tailWeight idx j * x (Fin.castLE hKD j) ≤
      ξ (idx.val + 1) * x (Fin.castLE hKD idx)
    by_cases hA : idx.val + 2 < K
    · have hA' : idx.val + 2 < D := by omega
      have hD := hxtail (Fin.castLE hKD idx) (by simp; omega)
      change ∑ j : Fin D, FordGeometry.tailWeight (Fin.castLE hKD idx) j * x j ≤
        ξ ((Fin.castLE hKD idx).val + 1) * x (Fin.castLE hKD idx) at hD
      have hnn : ∀ j : Fin D, 0 ≤ FordGeometry.tailWeight (Fin.castLE hKD idx) j * x j := by
        intro j
        unfold FordGeometry.tailWeight
        split_ifs with h1 h2
        · exact mul_nonneg (hw _ (by omega)) (hx0 j)
        · simp [hx0 j]
        · simp
      have hS := hsub (fun j => FordGeometry.tailWeight (Fin.castLE hKD idx) j * x j) hnn
      have heq : ∑ j : Fin K, FordGeometry.tailWeight idx j * x (Fin.castLE hKD j) =
          ∑ i : Fin K, (fun j => FordGeometry.tailWeight (Fin.castLE hKD idx) j * x j)
            (Fin.castLE hKD i) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro j _
        simp [FordGeometry.tailWeight, hA, hA']
      rw [heq]
      exact hS.trans hD
    · obtain ⟨last, hlv⟩ : ∃ l : Fin K, l.val = idx.val + 1 := ⟨⟨idx.val + 1, hidx⟩, rfl⟩
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_single last]
      · have hw1 : FordGeometry.tailWeight idx last = 1 := by
          unfold FordGeometry.tailWeight
          rw [if_pos (by omega), if_neg hA]
        rw [hw1, one_mul]
        have h1 : x (Fin.castLE hKD last) ≤ x (Fin.castLE hKD idx) := by
          apply hxanti
          rw [Fin.le_iff_val_le_val]
          simp only [Fin.coe_castLE]
          omega
        exact h1.trans (le_mul_of_one_le_left (hx0 _) (hξ _))
      · intro j _ hj
        have hz : FordGeometry.tailWeight idx j = 0 := by
          unfold FordGeometry.tailWeight
          rw [if_neg]
          intro hlt
          apply hj
          have := j.isLt
          exact Fin.ext (by omega)
        rw [hz, zero_mul]
      · intro h
        exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ _) h

proof.tactics:
by
  have claimA : ∀ (k : ℕ) (r : List ℕ), List.Pairwise (fun a b => b ≤ a) r →
      (∀ x ∈ r, x.Prime) → (∀ i < k, r.getD (i + 1) 1 < r.getD i 1) →
      (r.prod).totient = ((r.drop k).prod).totient * ∏ i : Fin k, (r.getD i.val 1 - 1) := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => intro r _ _ _; simp
    | succ k ih =>
      intro r hs hp hlt
      cases r with
      | nil =>
        have h := hlt 0 (Nat.succ_pos k)
        simp at h
      | cons a t =>
        have h0 := hlt 0 (Nat.succ_pos k)
        have hst := (List.pairwise_cons.mp hs).2
        have ha : a.Prime := hp a (List.mem_cons_self ..)
        have htp : ∀ x ∈ t, x.Prime := fun x hx => hp x (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hx)
        have hnot : a ∉ t := by
          intro hmem
          cases t with
          | nil => simp at hmem
          | cons b t' =>
            have hba : b < a := by simpa using h0
            have hle := (List.pairwise_cons.mp hst).1
            rcases List.mem_cons.mp hmem with h | h
            · omega
            · have := hle a h
              omega
        have hcop : Nat.Coprime a t.prod := by
          rw [Nat.coprime_list_prod_right_iff]
          intro c hc
          exact (Nat.coprime_primes ha (htp c hc)).mpr (fun h => hnot (h ▸ hc))
        have hih := ih t hst htp (fun i hi => by
          have h' := hlt (i + 1) (by omega)
          simpa using h')
        rw [List.prod_cons, Nat.totient_mul hcop, Nat.totient_prime ha, hih, List.drop_succ_cons,
          Fin.prod_univ_succ]
        simp only [Fin.val_zero, Fin.val_succ, List.getD_cons_zero, List.getD_cons_succ]
        ring
  have hprimeAll : ∀ x ∈ N.primeFactorsList.reverse, x.Prime := by
    intro x hx
    rw [List.mem_reverse] at hx
    exact Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactorsList hx
  have hsorted : List.Pairwise (fun a b => b ≤ a) N.primeFactorsList.reverse := by
    have h1 : List.Pairwise (· ≤ ·) N.primeFactorsList := (Nat.primeFactorsList_sorted N).pairwise
    exact List.pairwise_reverse.mpr h1
  have hprod : N.primeFactorsList.reverse.prod = N := by
    rw [List.prod_reverse, Nat.prod_primeFactorsList hN.ne']
  have hstrict : ∀ i < L + 1,
      N.primeFactorsList.reverse.getD (i + 1) 1 < N.primeFactorsList.reverse.getD i 1 := by
    intro i hi
    rcases i with _ | j
    · exact htop
    · exact horder (j + 1) (by omega) (by omega)
  have hq0 : (FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N 0).Prime := by
    have hne : N.primeFactorsList.reverse ≠ [] := by
      intro h
      have h1 : FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N 0 = 1 := by
        simp [FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt, FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeList, h]
      have h2 : FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N 1 = 1 := by
        simp [FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt, FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeList, h]
      omega
    obtain ⟨p, rest, hl⟩ := List.exists_cons_of_ne_nil hne
    have hP0 : FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N 0 = p := by
      simp [FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt, FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeList, hl]
    rw [hP0]
    exact hprimeAll p (by rw [hl]; exact List.mem_cons_self ..)
  refine ⟨hq0, ?_⟩
  have hA := claimA (L + 1) _ hsorted hprimeAll hstrict
  rw [hprod, Fin.prod_univ_succ] at hA
  show N.totient = (N.primeFactorsList.reverse.getD 0 1 - 1) *
      (((N.primeFactorsList.reverse.drop (L + 1)).prod).totient *
        ∏ idx : Fin L, (N.primeFactorsList.reverse.getD (idx.val + 1) 1 - 1))
  rw [hA]
  simp only [Fin.val_zero, Fin.val_succ]
  ring

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have key : ∀ N j : ℕ, (FordBadFacet.ordinarySuffix N j).primeFactorsList =
      ((N.primeFactorsList.reverse).drop j).reverse := by
    intro N j
    have hsub : ((N.primeFactorsList.reverse).drop j).reverse.Sublist N.primeFactorsList := by
      have := (List.drop_sublist j N.primeFactorsList.reverse).reverse
      rwa [List.reverse_reverse] at this
    have hprimes : ∀ p ∈ ((N.primeFactorsList.reverse).drop j).reverse, p.Prime :=
      fun p hp => Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactorsList (hsub.subset hp)
    have hprod : ((N.primeFactorsList.reverse).drop j).reverse.prod =
        FordBadFacet.ordinarySuffix N j := by
      rw [List.prod_reverse]
    have hperm := Nat.primeFactorsList_unique hprod hprimes
    have hs1 := ((Nat.primeFactorsList_sorted N).pairwise.sublist hsub).sortedLE
    exact (hperm.eq_of_sortedLE hs1 (Nat.primeFactorsList_sorted _)).symm
  
  have s1 : ∀ N j i : ℕ, FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt (FordBadFacet.ordinarySuffix N j) i =
      FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N (j + i) := by
    intro N j i
    show (FordBadFacet.ordinarySuffix N j).primeFactorsList.reverse.getD i 1 =
      N.primeFactorsList.reverse.getD (j + i) 1
    rw [key, List.reverse_reverse, List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD,
      List.getElem?_drop]
  
  have s2 : ∀ M r : ℕ, r ∈ M.primeFactors → r ≤ FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt M 0 := by
    intro M r hr
    have hmem : r ∈ M.primeFactorsList.reverse :=
      List.mem_reverse.mpr (Nat.mem_primeFactors_iff_mem_primeFactorsList.mp hr)
    have hsorted : M.primeFactorsList.reverse.Pairwise (fun a b => b ≤ a) :=
      List.pairwise_reverse.mpr (Nat.primeFactorsList_sorted M).pairwise
    unfold FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeList
    generalize M.primeFactorsList.reverse = l at hmem hsorted ⊢
    cases l with
    | nil => simp at hmem
    | cons a t =>
      simp only [List.getD_cons_zero]
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp hmem with h | h
      · omega
      · exact (List.pairwise_cons.mp hsorted).1 r h
  
  have s0c : ∀ N i : ℕ, 1 ≤ FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N i := by
    intro N i
    show 1 ≤ N.primeFactorsList.reverse.getD i 1
    rcases lt_or_ge i N.primeFactorsList.reverse.length with h | h
    · rw [List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ h]
      exact (Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactorsList
        (List.mem_reverse.mp (List.getElem_mem h))).one_lt.le
    · rw [List.getD_eq_default _ _ h]
  
  have s4 : ∀ M i : ℕ, FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt M i ≤ FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt M 0 := by
    intro M i
    rcases lt_or_ge i M.primeFactorsList.reverse.length with h | h
    · have he : FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt M i = M.primeFactorsList.reverse[i] :=
        List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ h
      rw [he]
      apply s2
      exact Nat.mem_primeFactors_iff_mem_primeFactorsList.mpr
        (List.mem_reverse.mp (List.getElem_mem h))
    · have he : FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt M i = 1 := List.getD_eq_default _ _ h
      rw [he]
      exact s0c M 0
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro N i j hij
    obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hij
    have h1 := s1 N i d
    have h2 := s1 N i 0
    rw [Nat.add_zero] at h2
    rw [← h1, ← h2]
    exact s4 _ _
  · intro N j
    show 0 < ((N.primeFactorsList.reverse).drop j).prod
    apply List.prod_pos
    intro a ha
    exact (Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactorsList
      (List.mem_reverse.mp (List.mem_of_mem_drop ha))).pos
  · intro N j
    unfold largestPrimeFactor
    apply max_le (s0c N j)
    apply Finset.sup_le
    intro r hr
    have := s2 _ r hr
    rw [s1, Nat.add_zero] at this
    exact this
  · intro N j k
    show ((FordBadFacet.ordinarySuffix N j).primeFactorsList.reverse.drop k).prod =
      ((N.primeFactorsList.reverse).drop (j + k)).prod
    rw [key, List.reverse_reverse, List.drop_drop]

dynamic_headers.content:
noncomputable def totientsUpTo (x : ℝ) : Finset ℕ :=
  (Finset.Icc 1 ⌊x⌋₊).filter (fun n => ∃ m : ℕ, m.totient = n)


noncomputable def collisionPoints {α β : Type*} (s : Finset α) (f : α → β) : Finset α :=
  s.filter fun a => ∃ b ∈ s, b ≠ a ∧ f b = f a


def largestPrimeFactor (n : ℕ) : ℕ := max 1 (n.primeFactors.sup id)

noncomputable def logLog (x : ℝ) : ℝ := Real.log (Real.log x)


def corePairValue (bp : ℕ × ℕ) : ℕ := (bp.2 - 1) * bp.1


noncomputable def corePairs (cores : Finset ℕ) (lo hi : ℝ) : Finset (ℕ × ℕ) :=
  (cores.product (Finset.range (⌊hi⌋₊ + 2))).filter fun bp =>
    bp.2.Prime ∧ lo < (corePairValue bp : ℝ) ∧ (corePairValue bp : ℝ) ≤ hi

noncomputable def fordWeight (idx : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ((idx : ℝ) + 1) * Real.log ((idx : ℝ) + 1) - idx * Real.log idx - 1

def weightedForm {L : ℕ} (a : Fin L → ℝ) : (Fin L → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ where
  toFun x := ∑ idx, a idx * x idx
  map_add' x y := by simp [mul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  map_smul' t x := by simp [Finset.mul_sum, mul_left_comm]

noncomputable def FordGeometry.outerForm (L : ℕ) : (Fin L → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ :=
  weightedForm (fun idx => fordWeight (idx.val + 1))

noncomputable def CollisionBox.cutoff (Y ν : ℝ) : ℝ := Real.exp ((Real.log Y) ^ ν)

noncomputable def CollisionBox.primeCoordinate (T : ℝ) (p : ℕ) : ℝ := logLog p / T


structure CoreRecords.LowerCoreRecord (Y : ℝ) (L R : ℕ) (P : ℝ) where
  length_pos : 0 < L
  tail : ℕ
  tail_pos : 0 < tail
  tail_le : tail ≤ R
  lower : Fin L → ℕ
  prime : ∀ idx, (lower idx).Prime
  order : StrictAnti lower
  last_lower : max 17 (largestPrimeFactor tail) < lower ⟨L - 1, by omega⟩
  last_upper : (lower ⟨L - 1, by omega⟩ : ℝ) ≤ P
  gaps : ∀ idx j : Fin L, j.val = idx.val + 1 →
    (6 / 5 : ℝ) * logLog (lower j) ≤ logLog (lower idx)
  upper : ∀ idx, (lower idx : ℝ) ≤ CollisionBox.cutoff Y (4 / 5)
  facet : FordGeometry.outerForm L
      (fun idx => CollisionBox.primeCoordinate (logLog Y) (lower idx)) ≤
    1 - (logLog Y) ^ (-1 / 8 : ℝ)

noncomputable def CoreRecords.LowerCoreRecord.integer {Y P : ℝ} {L R : ℕ}
    (Q : CoreRecords.LowerCoreRecord Y L R P) : ℕ :=
  Q.tail * ∏ idx, Q.lower idx

noncomputable def CoreRecords.LowerCoreRecord.numericalCore {Y P : ℝ} {L R : ℕ}
    (Q : CoreRecords.LowerCoreRecord Y L R P) : ℕ :=
  Q.tail.totient * ∏ idx, (Q.lower idx - 1)

noncomputable def CoreRecords.LowerCoreRecord.boundedEncoding {Y P : ℝ} {L R : ℕ}
    (Q : CoreRecords.LowerCoreRecord Y L R P) :
    Fin (R + 1) × (Fin L → Fin (⌊CollisionBox.cutoff Y (4 / 5)⌋₊ + 1)) :=
  (⟨Q.tail, by have := Q.tail_le; omega⟩, fun idx => ⟨Q.lower idx, by
    have hcut : 0 ≤ CollisionBox.cutoff Y (4 / 5) := (Real.exp_pos _).le
    have hle := (Nat.le_floor_iff hcut).mpr (Q.upper idx)
    omega⟩)

noncomputable instance CoreRecords.LowerCoreRecord.instFintype {Y P : ℝ} {L R : ℕ} :
    Fintype (CoreRecords.LowerCoreRecord Y L R P) :=
  Fintype.ofInjective CoreRecords.LowerCoreRecord.boundedEncoding (by
    intro Q₁ Q₂ h
    have h1 : Q₁.tail = Q₂.tail := congrArg (fun z => z.1.val) h
    have h2 : Q₁.lower = Q₂.lower := funext fun idx => congrArg (fun z => (z.2 idx).val) h
    cases Q₁
    cases Q₂
    cases h1
    cases h2
    rfl)


structure CoreRecords.CoreSelection (Y : ℝ) (L R : ℕ) (P : ℝ) where
  cores : Finset ℕ
  record : ∀ _b : cores, CoreRecords.LowerCoreRecord Y L R P
  core_eq : ∀ b : cores, (record b).numericalCore = b.val

noncomputable def CoreRecords.CoreSelection.ofRecords {Y P : ℝ} {L R : ℕ}
    (F : Finset (CoreRecords.LowerCoreRecord Y L R P)) : CoreRecords.CoreSelection Y L R P where
  cores := F.image CoreRecords.LowerCoreRecord.numericalCore
  record := fun b => Classical.choose (Finset.mem_image.mp b.property)
  core_eq := fun b => (Classical.choose_spec (Finset.mem_image.mp b.property)).2

noncomputable def CoreRecords.CoreSelection.fullSelection (Y : ℝ) (L R : ℕ) (P : ℝ) :
    CoreRecords.CoreSelection Y L R P :=
  CoreRecords.CoreSelection.ofRecords Finset.univ

noncomputable def CoreRecords.powerRawPairs {Y P : ℝ} {L R : ℕ}
    (S : CoreRecords.CoreSelection Y L R P) : Finset (ℕ × ℕ) :=
  corePairs S.cores (Y ^ (99 / 100 : ℝ)) Y

noncomputable def omegaInterval (n : ℕ) (u v : ℝ) : ℕ :=
  n.primeFactorsList.countP (fun p : ℕ => decide (u < (p : ℝ) ∧ (p : ℝ) ≤ v))


def SNormal (S : ℝ) (p : ℕ) : Prop :=
  p.Prime ∧
  (omegaInterval (p - 1) 1 S : ℝ) ≤ 2 * Real.log (Real.log S) ∧
  ∀ u v : ℝ, S ≤ u → u < v → v ≤ (p - 1 : ℕ) →
    |(omegaInterval (p - 1) u v : ℝ) -
      (Real.log (Real.log v) - Real.log (Real.log u))| <
      Real.sqrt (Real.log (Real.log S) * Real.log (Real.log v))


noncomputable def normalityScale (T : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.exp (Real.exp (Real.log T ^ 10))


def NoLargePrimeSquare (n : ℕ) (S : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → S < (p : ℝ) → ¬p ^ 2 ∣ n


noncomputable def CollisionFacet.extend {L : ℕ} (x : Fin (L + 1) → ℝ) (idx : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  if hi : idx < L + 1 then x ⟨idx, hi⟩ else 0


structure Rigidity.Tuple {L : ℕ} (Y P κ θ : ℝ) (r n : ℕ) (p : Fin (L + 1) → ℕ) : Prop where
  integer : (∏ idx, p idx) = n
  prime : ∀ idx, (p idx).Prime
  order : StrictAnti p
  last_lower : max 17 (largestPrimeFactor r) < p (Fin.last L)
  last_upper : (p (Fin.last L) : ℝ) ≤ P
  gaps : ∀ idx : Fin (L + 1), 0 < idx.val → ∀ hi : idx.val + 1 < L + 1,
    κ * logLog (p ⟨idx.val + 1, hi⟩) ≤ logLog (p idx)
  lower_upper : ∀ idx, 0 < idx.val → (p idx : ℝ) ≤ CollisionBox.cutoff Y θ
  top : Y ^ (9 / 10 : ℝ) < (p 0 : ℝ)
  size : ((r.totient * n.totient : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ Y
  facet : (∑ idx ∈ Finset.Icc 1 L, fordWeight idx *
    CollisionFacet.extend (fun j => CollisionBox.primeCoordinate (logLog Y) (p j)) idx) ≤
      1 - (logLog Y) ^ (-1 / 8 : ℝ)


structure CollisionSum.RetainedPair {L : ℕ} (Y P κ θ : ℝ) (d n : ℕ) (p : Fin (L + 1) → ℕ)
    (N : ℕ) : Prop where
  integer : (∏ idx, p idx) = n
  normal_left : ∀ idx, SNormal (normalityScale (logLog Y)) (p idx)
  prime_min : ∀ idx, 17 ≤ p idx
  order : StrictAnti p
  gaps : ∀ idx : Fin (L + 1), 0 < idx.val → ∀ hi : idx.val + 1 < L + 1,
    κ * logLog (p ⟨idx.val + 1, hi⟩) ≤ logLog (p idx)
  lower_upper : ∀ idx, 0 < idx.val → (p idx : ℝ) ≤ CollisionBox.cutoff Y θ
  last_upper : (p (Fin.last L) : ℝ) ≤ P
  top : Y ^ (9 / 10 : ℝ) < (p 0 : ℝ)
  witness_pos : 0 < N
  equation : N.totient = d * ∏ idx, (p idx - 1)
  size : (N.totient : ℝ) ≤ Y
  largest_ne : largestPrimeFactor N ≠ p 0
  normal_right : ∀ q ∈ N.primeFactors, SNormal (normalityScale (logLog Y)) q
  square_witness : NoLargePrimeSquare N (Real.log Y ^ 4)
  square_totient : NoLargePrimeSquare N.totient (Real.log Y ^ 4)
  facet : (∑ idx ∈ Finset.Icc 1 L, fordWeight idx *
    CollisionFacet.extend (fun j => CollisionBox.primeCoordinate (logLog Y) (p j)) idx) ≤
      1 - (logLog Y) ^ (-1 / 8 : ℝ)

noncomputable def fiveLogOmegaTotients (x : ℝ) : Finset ℕ :=
  (totientsUpTo x).filter (fun n : ℕ => 3 ≤ n ∧
    5 * logLog (n : ℝ) < (ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors n : ℝ))


noncomputable def largeSquareTotients (x : ℝ) : Finset ℕ :=
  (totientsUpTo x).filter (fun m : ℕ => ∃ n : ℕ, 0 < n ∧ n.totient = m ∧
    ∃ q : ℕ, q.Prime ∧ Real.log x ^ 4 < (q : ℝ) ∧ (q ^ 2 ∣ n ∨ q ^ 2 ∣ n.totient))


noncomputable def FordGeometry.tailWeight {L : ℕ} (idx j : Fin L) : ℝ :=
  if idx.val < j.val then
    if idx.val + 2 < L then fordWeight (j.val - idx.val) else 1
  else 0


noncomputable def FordGeometry.tailForm {L : ℕ} (idx : Fin L) : (Fin L → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ :=
  weightedForm (FordGeometry.tailWeight idx)


noncomputable def FordGeometry.polytope (L : ℕ) (ξ : ℕ → ℝ) : Set (Fin L → ℝ) :=
  {x | (∀ idx, 0 ≤ x idx) ∧ (∀ idx, x idx ≤ 1) ∧ Antitone x ∧
    FordGeometry.outerForm L x ≤ ξ 0 ∧
    ∀ idx : Fin L, idx.val + 1 < L → FordGeometry.tailForm idx x ≤ ξ (idx.val + 1) * x idx}


noncomputable def FordGeometry.T (L : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  MeasureTheory.volume.real (FordGeometry.polytope L (fun _ => 1))


noncomputable def FordGeometry.expandedParameter (N j : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  1 + (1 / 10000 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(((N : ℝ) - j) / 40))


noncomputable def FordAnalysis.coeff (n : ℕ) : ℝ := if n = 0 then 0 else fordWeight n


noncomputable def FordAnalysis.F (z : ℝ) : ℝ := ∑' n : ℕ, FordAnalysis.coeff n * z ^ n


noncomputable def FordAnalysis.rho : ℝ :=
  Classical.epsilon (fun r : ℝ => 0 < r ∧ r < 3 / 4 ∧ FordAnalysis.F r = 1)


noncomputable def FordAnalysis.C : ℝ := (2 * |Real.log FordAnalysis.rho|)⁻¹


noncomputable def FordScale.optimalDimension (t : ℝ) : ℕ :=
  ⌊2 * FordAnalysis.C * (Real.log t - Real.log (Real.log t))⌋₊


noncomputable def FordScale.coreDimension (M : ℕ) (t : ℝ) : ℕ := FordScale.optimalDimension t - M


noncomputable def FordReciprocal.coreOuterShell (M : ℕ) (t : ℝ) :
    Set (Fin (FordScale.coreDimension M t) → ℝ) :=
  FordGeometry.polytope (FordScale.coreDimension M t)
      (FordGeometry.expandedParameter (FordScale.optimalDimension t)) ∩
    {x | 1 - t ^ (-1 / 8 : ℝ) < FordGeometry.outerForm (FordScale.coreDimension M t) x}


noncomputable def FordRestricted.suffixMargin (k : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  (1 / 10000 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(k : ℝ) / 40)


noncomputable def FordBadFacet.positiveLogLog (x : ℝ) : ℝ := max 0 (logLog x)


noncomputable def FordBadFacet.fordPrimeCoordinate (T : ℝ) (p : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  FordBadFacet.positiveLogLog p / T


abbrev FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeList (N : ℕ) : List ℕ := N.primeFactorsList.reverse


abbrev FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt (N idx : ℕ) : ℕ := (FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeList N).getD idx 1


noncomputable abbrev FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeCoordinate (T : ℝ) (N idx : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  FordBadFacet.fordPrimeCoordinate T (FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N idx)


noncomputable abbrev FordBadFacet.ordinarySuffix (N j : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  ((FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeList N).drop j).prod


noncomputable def FordBadFacet.badFacetValues (x : ℝ) (k : ℕ) (ω : ℝ) : Finset ℕ :=
  (totientsUpTo x).filter (fun m => ∃ N : ℕ, 0 < N ∧ N.totient = m ∧
    1 + ω ≤ ∑ idx : Fin k, fordWeight (idx.val + 1) *
      FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeCoordinate (logLog x) N (idx.val + 1))


noncomputable def FordBadFacet.polytopeFailureValues (x : ℝ) (L : ℕ) (ξ : ℕ → ℝ) : Finset ℕ :=
  (totientsUpTo x).filter (fun m => ∃ N : ℕ, 0 < N ∧ N.totient = m ∧
    (fun idx : Fin L => FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeCoordinate (logLog x) N (idx.val + 1)) ∉
      FordGeometry.polytope L ξ)


noncomputable def FordBadFacet.firstFailedExceptionalValues (x : ℝ) (A : ℕ) : Finset ℕ :=
  totientsUpTo (Real.sqrt x) ∪ FordBadFacet.badFacetValues x 2 (1 / 1000) ∪ fiveLogOmegaTotients x ∪
    largeSquareTotients x ∪ FordBadFacet.badFacetValues x A (FordRestricted.suffixMargin A)


noncomputable def FordBadFacet.retainedGeometricValues (x : ℝ) (D : ℕ)
    (E : Set (Fin D → ℝ)) (Q : ℕ → Prop) : Finset ℕ :=
  (totientsUpTo x).filter (fun m => Real.sqrt x ≤ (m : ℝ) ∧
    m ∉ FordBadFacet.badFacetValues x 2 (1 / 1000) ∧ m ∉ fiveLogOmegaTotients x ∧
    m ∉ largeSquareTotients x ∧
    ∃ N : ℕ, 0 < N ∧ N.totient = m ∧
      (fun idx : Fin D => FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeCoordinate (logLog x) N (idx.val + 1)) ∈ E ∧
      Q (FordBadFacet.ordinarySuffix (FordBadFacet.ordinarySuffix N 1) D))


noncomputable def FordBadFacet.largeTerminalValues (x : ℝ) (M : ℕ) (P : ℝ) : Finset ℕ :=
  (totientsUpTo x).filter (fun m => ∃ N : ℕ, 0 < N ∧ N.totient = m ∧
    (fun idx : Fin (FordScale.coreDimension M (logLog x)) =>
        FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeCoordinate (logLog x) N (idx.val + 1)) ∈
      FordGeometry.polytope (FordScale.coreDimension M (logLog x))
        (FordGeometry.expandedParameter (FordScale.optimalDimension (logLog x))) ∧
    P ≤ (FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeAt N (FordScale.coreDimension M (logLog x)) : ℝ))


def FordBadFacet.largeSmoothResidualProperty (P R : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : Prop :=
  R ≤ (n : ℝ) ∧ n ∈ Nat.factoredNumbers ((Finset.Iic ⌊P⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime)


noncomputable def FordBadFacet.largeSmoothResidualValues (x : ℝ) (M : ℕ) (P R : ℝ) : Finset ℕ :=
  (totientsUpTo x).filter (fun m => ∃ N : ℕ, 0 < N ∧ N.totient = m ∧
    (fun idx : Fin (FordScale.coreDimension M (logLog x)) =>
        FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeCoordinate (logLog x) N (idx.val + 1)) ∈
      FordGeometry.polytope (FordScale.coreDimension M (logLog x))
        (FordGeometry.expandedParameter (FordScale.optimalDimension (logLog x))) ∧
    FordBadFacet.largeSmoothResidualProperty P R
      (FordBadFacet.ordinarySuffix (FordBadFacet.ordinarySuffix N 1) (FordScale.coreDimension M (logLog x))))


def FordBadFacet.smoothResidualProperty (z : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : Prop :=
  n ∈ Nat.factoredNumbers ((Finset.Iic ⌊z⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime)


def FordGeometry.concentrationDistance {L : ℕ} (idx : Fin L) : ℕ := L - (idx.val + 1)


def FordGeometry.concentrationIndices (L A : ℕ) : Finset (Fin L) :=
  Finset.univ.filter (fun idx => A ≤ FordGeometry.concentrationDistance idx)


noncomputable def FordGeometry.parameterConcentrationUnion (L : ℕ) (ξ : ℕ → ℝ) (A : ℕ) (η : ℝ) :
    Set (Fin L → ℝ) :=
  FordGeometry.polytope L ξ ∩ {x | ∃ idx ∈ FordGeometry.concentrationIndices L A,
    η ≤ |x idx / (FordAnalysis.rho ^ (idx.val + 1) *
      ((FordGeometry.concentrationDistance idx : ℝ) / (L : ℝ))) - 1|}


noncomputable def FordBadFacet.smoothConcentrationValues (x : ℝ) (H A : ℕ) (z : ℝ) : Finset ℕ :=
  FordBadFacet.retainedGeometricValues x (FordScale.coreDimension H (logLog x))
    (FordGeometry.parameterConcentrationUnion (FordScale.coreDimension H (logLog x))
      (FordGeometry.expandedParameter (FordScale.optimalDimension (logLog x))) A (1 / 20))
    (FordBadFacet.smoothResidualProperty z)


noncomputable def FordBadFacet.smoothOuterShellValues (x : ℝ) (H : ℕ) (z : ℝ) : Finset ℕ :=
  FordBadFacet.retainedGeometricValues x (FordScale.coreDimension H (logLog x))
    (FordReciprocal.coreOuterShell H (logLog x)) (FordBadFacet.smoothResidualProperty z)


noncomputable def FordBadFacet.coreCoverageExceptions (x : ℝ) (H M : ℕ) (P_D P_L : ℝ) (R : ℕ) :
    Finset ℕ :=
  FordBadFacet.firstFailedExceptionalValues x (FordScale.optimalDimension (logLog x)) ∪
    FordBadFacet.polytopeFailureValues x (FordScale.coreDimension H (logLog x))
      (FordGeometry.expandedParameter (FordScale.optimalDimension (logLog x))) ∪
    FordBadFacet.largeTerminalValues x H P_D ∪
    FordBadFacet.smoothConcentrationValues x H (M - H - 1) P_D ∪
    FordBadFacet.smoothOuterShellValues x H P_D ∪
    FordBadFacet.largeSmoothResidualValues x M P_L (R : ℝ)

noncomputable def invTotient (n : ℕ) : ℝ := (n.totient : ℝ)⁻¹

noncomputable def normalityDelta (T : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  2 * Real.log T ^ 5 / Real.sqrt T

noncomputable def sieveErrorEnvelope (T : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.log T ^ 2 * T ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ) +
    Real.log T ^ 8 * T ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) + Real.log T ^ 2

noncomputable def commonIndices {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (p q : ι → ℕ) : Finset ι :=
  s.filter (fun idx => p idx = q idx)

noncomputable def CollisionClass.remaining {a : ℕ} (C : Finset (Fin a)) : Finset (Fin a) :=
  Finset.univ \ C

noncomputable def CollisionClass.index {a : ℕ} (C : Finset (Fin a))
    (idx : Fin (CollisionClass.remaining C).card) : Fin a :=
  ((CollisionClass.remaining C).orderIsoOfFin rfl idx).val

structure CollisionClass.Conditions {a l : ℕ} (C : Finset (Fin a)) (d M n : ℕ) (S Y : ℝ) (v W : ℕ → ℝ)
    (p q : Fin a → ℕ) (t : Fin l → ℕ) (e : ℕ) : Prop where
  normal_left : ∀ idx, SNormal S (p idx)
  normal_right : ∀ idx, SNormal S (q idx)
  normal_tail : ∀ idx, SNormal S (t idx)
  left_injective : Function.Injective p
  residual_pos : 0 < e
  common : C = commonIndices Finset.univ p q
  common_product : (∏ idx ∈ C, p idx) = M
  integer : (∏ idx, p idx)*(∏ j, t j) = n
  equation : d*((∏ idx, (p idx-1))*(∏ j, (t j-1))) = (∏ idx, (q idx-1))*e
  size : ((d*((∏ idx, (p idx-1))*(∏ j, (t j-1))) : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ Y
  square_exclusion : NoLargePrimeSquare (d*((∏ idx, (p idx-1))*(∏ j, (t j-1))))
    (v (CollisionClass.remaining C).card)
  largest_left : ∀ idx : Fin (CollisionClass.remaining C).card,
    W idx.val ≤ (largestPrimeFactor (p (CollisionClass.index C idx)-1) : ℝ) ∧
      (largestPrimeFactor (p (CollisionClass.index C idx)-1) : ℝ) ≤ v idx.val
  largest_right : ∀ idx : Fin (CollisionClass.remaining C).card,
    W idx.val ≤ (largestPrimeFactor (q (CollisionClass.index C idx)-1) : ℝ) ∧
      (largestPrimeFactor (q (CollisionClass.index C idx)-1) : ℝ) ≤ v idx.val
  tail_support : ∀ idx : Fin l, ∀ z ∈ (t idx-1).primeFactorsList,
    (z : ℝ) ≤ v (CollisionClass.remaining C).card
  residual_support : ∀ z ∈ e.primeFactorsList, (z : ℝ) ≤ v (CollisionClass.remaining C).card
  top : ∀ idx : Fin a, idx.val = 0 → Y^(9/10 : ℝ) < (p idx : ℝ)

noncomputable def CollisionBox.roundUp (ε w : ℝ) : ℝ := ε * (⌈w / ε⌉₊ : ℝ)

noncomputable def CollisionBox.rounded {L : ℕ} (ε : ℝ) (w : Fin (L + 1) → ℝ)
    (idx : Fin (L + 1)) : ℝ := if idx.val = 0 then 1 else CollisionBox.roundUp ε (w idx)

noncomputable def CollisionBox.tailCoordinate {L : ℕ} (ε h b : ℝ)
    (w : Fin (L + 1) → ℝ) (J : Fin (L + 1)) : ℝ :=
  min b (CollisionBox.rounded ε w J - 2 * h)

noncomputable def CollisionBox.shiftedCoordinate (T : ℝ) (p : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  logLog (largestPrimeFactor (p - 1)) / T

noncomputable def CollisionCutoff.nu {k : ℕ} (L : ℕ) (δ : ℝ) (z : Fin k → ℝ) (zstar : ℝ) (idx : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  if idx = 0 then 1 else if hi : idx < k then z ⟨idx, hi⟩ + (2 * L + 1) * δ
  else zstar + (2 * L + 3) * δ

noncomputable def CollisionCutoff.mu {k : ℕ} (L : ℕ) (δ ε : ℝ) (z : Fin k → ℝ) (zstar : ℝ) (idx : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  CollisionCutoff.nu L δ z zstar idx - (4 * L + 2) * δ - ε

noncomputable def CollisionCutoff.upper {k : ℕ} (Y : ℝ) (L : ℕ) (δ : ℝ) (z : Fin k → ℝ)
    (zstar : ℝ) (idx : ℕ) : ℝ := CollisionBox.cutoff Y (CollisionCutoff.nu L δ z zstar idx)

noncomputable def CollisionCutoff.lower {k : ℕ} (Y : ℝ) (L : ℕ) (δ ε : ℝ) (z : Fin k → ℝ)
    (zstar : ℝ) (idx : ℕ) : ℝ := CollisionBox.cutoff Y (CollisionCutoff.mu L δ ε z zstar idx)

noncomputable def CollisionCutoff.selectedIndex {L : ℕ} (J : Fin (L + 1))
    (C : Finset (Fin (J.val + 1))) (idx : Fin (CollisionClass.remaining C).card) : Fin (L + 1) :=
  Fin.castLE (by have := J.isLt; omega) (CollisionClass.index C idx)

noncomputable def CollisionCutoff.selectedZeta {L : ℕ} (J : Fin (L + 1)) (C : Finset (Fin (J.val + 1)))
    (ε : ℝ) (w : Fin (L + 1) → ℝ) (idx : Fin (CollisionClass.remaining C).card) : ℝ :=
  CollisionBox.rounded ε w (CollisionCutoff.selectedIndex J C idx)

structure CollisionCutoff.SieveCutoffs (k : ℕ) (Y δ : ℝ) (v W : ℕ → ℝ) : Prop where
  antitone : Antitone v
  zero : v 0 = Y
  interleaving : ∀ idx, idx < k → v (idx + 1) < W idx ∧ W idx ≤ v idx
  gaps : ∀ idx, 2 ≤ idx → idx ≤ k → δ ≤ logLog (v (idx - 1)) / logLog Y - logLog (v idx) / logLog Y
  normality : normalityScale (logLog Y) ≤ v k
  initial : v 1 ≤ Y ^ (1 / (10 * logLog Y))

def CollisionMatching.prefixIndex {L : ℕ} (J : Fin (L + 1)) (idx : Fin (J.val + 1)) : Fin (L + 1) :=
  Fin.castLE (by have := J.isLt; omega) idx

def CollisionRecord.tailIndex {L : ℕ} (J : Fin (L + 1)) (idx : Fin (L - J.val)) : Fin (L + 1) :=
  ⟨J.val + 1 + idx.val, by have := idx.isLt; have := J.isLt; omega⟩

abbrev CollisionRecord.leftPrimes {L : ℕ} (J : Fin (L + 1)) (p : Fin (L + 1) → ℕ) : Fin (J.val + 1) → ℕ :=
  fun idx => p (CollisionMatching.prefixIndex J idx)

abbrev CollisionRecord.tailPrimes {L : ℕ} (J : Fin (L + 1)) (p : Fin (L + 1) → ℕ) : Fin (L - J.val) → ℕ :=
  fun idx => p (CollisionRecord.tailIndex J idx)

noncomputable def CollisionRecord.commonProduct {L : ℕ} (J : Fin (L + 1)) (p : Fin (L + 1) → ℕ)
    (C : Finset (Fin (J.val + 1))) : ℕ := ∏ idx ∈ C, CollisionRecord.leftPrimes J p idx

noncomputable def CollisionRecord.upper {L : ℕ} (Y : ℝ) (p : Fin (L + 1) → ℕ) (ε h b : ℝ)
    (J : Fin (L + 1)) (C : Finset (Fin (J.val + 1))) : ℕ → ℝ :=
  let w := fun idx => CollisionBox.shiftedCoordinate (logLog Y) (p idx)
  CollisionCutoff.upper Y L (normalityDelta (logLog Y))
    (CollisionCutoff.selectedZeta J C ε w) (CollisionBox.tailCoordinate ε h b w J)

noncomputable def CollisionRecord.lower {L : ℕ} (Y : ℝ) (p : Fin (L + 1) → ℕ) (ε h b : ℝ)
    (J : Fin (L + 1)) (C : Finset (Fin (J.val + 1))) : ℕ → ℝ :=
  let w := fun idx => CollisionBox.shiftedCoordinate (logLog Y) (p idx)
  CollisionCutoff.lower Y L (normalityDelta (logLog Y)) ε
    (CollisionCutoff.selectedZeta J C ε w) (CollisionBox.tailCoordinate ε h b w J)

noncomputable abbrev CollisionSum.upper {L : ℕ} (Y : ℝ) (p : Fin (L + 1) → ℕ) (J : Fin (L + 1))
    (C : Finset (Fin (J.val + 1))) : ℕ → ℝ :=
  CollisionRecord.upper Y p (1 / logLog Y) ((logLog Y) ^ (-2 / 5 : ℝ)) ((logLog Y) ^ (-1 / 3 : ℝ)) J C

noncomputable abbrev CollisionSum.lower {L : ℕ} (Y : ℝ) (p : Fin (L + 1) → ℕ) (J : Fin (L + 1))
    (C : Finset (Fin (J.val + 1))) : ℕ → ℝ :=
  CollisionRecord.lower Y p (1 / logLog Y) ((logLog Y) ^ (-2 / 5 : ℝ)) ((logLog Y) ^ (-1 / 3 : ℝ)) J C

noncomputable def CollisionSum.box {L : ℕ} (Y : ℝ) (p : Fin (L + 1) → ℕ) : Fin (L + 1) → ℝ :=
  CollisionBox.rounded (1 / logLog Y) (fun idx => CollisionBox.shiftedCoordinate (logLog Y) (p idx))

def CollisionSum.prefixEmbedding {L : ℕ} (J : Fin (L + 1)) : Fin (J.val + 1) ↪ Fin (L + 1) where
  toFun := CollisionMatching.prefixIndex J
  inj' := by
    intro idx j hij
    exact Fin.ext (congrArg (fun k : Fin (L + 1) => k.val) hij)

noncomputable def CollisionSum.commonCode {L : ℕ} (J : Fin (L + 1)) (C : Finset (Fin (J.val + 1))) :
    Finset (Fin (L + 1)) :=
  C.map (CollisionSum.prefixEmbedding J)

structure CollisionSum.Record (Y : ℝ) (L d : ℕ) where
  integer : ℕ
  primes : Fin (L + 1) → ℕ
  J : Fin (L + 1)
  common : Finset (Fin (J.val + 1))
  right : Fin (J.val + 1) → ℕ
  residual : ℕ
  prefix_lt : J.val < L
  zero_survives : ∀ idx : Fin (J.val + 1), idx.val = 0 → idx ∉ common
  cutoffs : CollisionCutoff.SieveCutoffs (CollisionClass.remaining common).card Y (normalityDelta (logLog Y))
    (CollisionSum.upper Y primes J common) (CollisionSum.lower Y primes J common)
  conditions : CollisionClass.Conditions common d (CollisionRecord.commonProduct J primes common) integer
    (normalityScale (logLog Y)) Y (CollisionSum.upper Y primes J common) (CollisionSum.lower Y primes J common)
    (CollisionRecord.leftPrimes J primes) right (CollisionRecord.tailPrimes J primes) residual
  prime_min : ∀ idx, 17 ≤ primes idx
  order : Antitone primes
  facet : (∑ idx ∈ Finset.Icc 1 L, fordWeight idx *
    CollisionFacet.extend (fun j => CollisionBox.primeCoordinate (logLog Y) (primes j)) idx) ≤
      1 - (logLog Y) ^ (-1 / 8 : ℝ)

abbrev CollisionSum.Label (L : ℕ) :=
  (Fin (L + 1) × (Fin (L + 1) → ℝ)) × Finset (Fin (L + 1)) × ℕ

noncomputable def CollisionSum.Record.label {Y : ℝ} {L d : ℕ} (r : CollisionSum.Record Y L d) :
    CollisionSum.Label L :=
  ((r.J, CollisionSum.box Y r.primes), CollisionSum.commonCode r.J r.common,
    CollisionRecord.commonProduct r.J r.primes r.common)

noncomputable def envelopeNormalityScale (T : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.exp (Real.exp (100 * Real.log T))

noncomputable def envelopeLargePrimeCutoff (T : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.exp (Real.exp ((4 / 5 : ℝ) * T))

noncomputable def envelopeTailEndpoint (T : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.exp (Real.exp ((9 / 10 : ℝ) * T))

noncomputable def envelopeThreeLargeNormalTotients (x : ℝ) : Finset ℕ :=
  (totientsUpTo x).filter (fun m : ℕ => Real.sqrt x ≤ (m : ℝ) ∧
    (ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors m : ℝ) ≤ 5 * logLog x ∧
    ∃ n : ℕ, 0 < n ∧ n.totient = m ∧ ∃ P : Finset ℕ, P.card = 3 ∧
      ∀ p ∈ P, SNormal (envelopeNormalityScale (logLog x)) p ∧ p ∣ n ∧
        envelopeLargePrimeCutoff (logLog x) < (p : ℝ))

noncomputable def envelopeRetainedTotients (x : ℝ) : Finset ℕ :=
  (totientsUpTo x).filter (fun m : ℕ => Real.sqrt x ≤ (m : ℝ) ∧
    (ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors m : ℝ) ≤ 5 * logLog x ∧
    ∃ n : ℕ, 0 < n ∧ n.totient = m ∧
      NoLargePrimeSquare n (envelopeLargePrimeCutoff (logLog x)) ∧
      (n.primeFactors.filter (fun p : ℕ => envelopeLargePrimeCutoff (logLog x) < (p : ℝ))).card ≤ 2)

noncomputable def coreLowerFraction (y : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  1 / Real.sqrt (Real.log (Real.log y))

noncomputable def FordReciprocal.tuplePoint {L : ℕ} (t : ℝ) (q : Fin L → ℕ) : Fin L → ℝ :=
  fun idx => max 0 (logLog (q idx)) / t

noncomputable def FordReciprocal.tupleIntegers (L : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (E : Set (Fin L → ℝ)) : Finset ℕ :=
  (Finset.Icc 1 (⌊Real.exp (Real.exp t)⌋₊ ^ L)).filter (fun n =>
    ∃ q : Fin L → ℕ, (∏ idx, q idx) = n ∧
      (∀ idx, (q idx).Prime ∨ q idx = 1) ∧ Antitone q ∧ FordReciprocal.tuplePoint t q ∈ E)

def FordGeometry.separatedCap {L : ℕ} (ξ : ℕ → ℝ) (p : Fin L) (α : ℝ) : Set (Fin L → ℝ) :=
  {x | x ∈ FordGeometry.polytope L ξ ∧
    (∀ idx j : Fin L, j.val = idx.val + 1 → x j ≤ ξ (idx.val + 1) * x idx) ∧ α ≤ x p}

noncomputable def FordInner.baseLoss (M d : ℕ) : ℝ := 1 / (10 * ((M + d : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 3)

noncomputable def FordInner.targetParameter (L M j : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  1 - (if j < L then FordInner.baseLoss M (L - j) else 0)

def FordInner.innerSeed {L : ℕ} (ξ : ℕ → ℝ) (p : Fin L) (α : ℝ) : Set (Fin L → ℝ) :=
  FordGeometry.separatedCap ξ p α ∩ {x | ∀ idx : Fin L, idx.val = 0 → x idx ≤ ξ 0}

noncomputable def FordLower.topLoss (t : ℝ) : ℝ := 1 / (10 * (FordScale.optimalDimension t : ℝ) ^ 3)

noncomputable def FordLower.lowerPrimeChoices (y : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : Finset ℕ :=
  (corePairs {n.totient} (coreLowerFraction y * y) y).image Prod.snd

noncomputable def FordLower.primeProducts (F : Finset ℕ) (y : ℝ) : Finset ℕ :=
  (F.sigma (FordLower.lowerPrimeChoices y)).image (fun np => np.2 * np.1)

structure FordLower.PrimeProductRecord (M : ℕ) (A y : ℝ)
    (p : Fin (FordScale.coreDimension M (logLog y))) (N : ℕ) where
  leading : ℕ
  lower : Fin (FordScale.coreDimension M (logLog y)) → ℕ
  terminal : p.val + 1 = FordScale.coreDimension M (logLog y)
  leading_prime : leading.Prime
  lower_prime : ∀ idx, (lower idx).Prime
  lower_order : StrictAnti lower
  point : FordReciprocal.tuplePoint (logLog y) lower ∈
    FordInner.innerSeed (FordInner.targetParameter (FordScale.coreDimension M (logLog y)) M) p
      (A / logLog y)
  integer : N = leading * (∏ idx, lower idx)
  leading_size : y ^ (19 / 20 : ℝ) < (leading : ℝ)
  lower_separated : ∀ idx, lower idx < leading
  lower_minimum : ∀ idx, Real.exp (Real.exp A) ≤ (lower idx : ℝ)
  lower_gaps : ∀ idx j, j.val = idx.val + 1 →
    (1 + FordInner.baseLoss M (FordScale.coreDimension M (logLog y) - (idx.val + 1))) *
      logLog (lower j) ≤ logLog (lower idx)
  leading_gap : ∀ idx, idx.val = 0 →
    (1 + FordLower.topLoss (logLog y)) * logLog (lower idx) ≤ logLog leading
  totient_range : coreLowerFraction y * y < (N.totient : ℝ) ∧ (N.totient : ℝ) ≤ y

noncomputable def FordLower.PrimeProductRecord.fullTuple {M : ℕ} {A y : ℝ}
    {p : Fin (FordScale.coreDimension M (logLog y))} {N : ℕ}
    (R : FordLower.PrimeProductRecord M A y p N) :
    Fin (FordScale.coreDimension M (logLog y) + 1) → ℕ :=
  Fin.cons R.leading R.lower

def FordLower.prefixProduct {k : ℕ} (p : Fin k → ℕ) (j : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  ∏ idx ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun idx : Fin k => idx.val < j), p idx

def FordLower.suffixProduct {k : ℕ} (p : Fin k → ℕ) (j : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  ∏ idx ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun idx : Fin k => j ≤ idx.val), p idx

def FordLower.PrefixAgreement {k : ℕ} (p : Fin k → ℕ) (j m : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∃ w : ℕ, 0 < w ∧ m = FordLower.prefixProduct p j * w ∧
    ∀ idx : Fin k, idx.val < j → largestPrimeFactor w < p idx

def FordLower.nontrivialPreimages (n : ℕ) : Set ℕ :=
  {m | 0 < m ∧ m.totient = n.totient ∧ ¬ n ∣ m}

noncomputable def FordLower.externalTotientCollisions (F : Finset ℕ) : Finset ℕ :=
  F.filter (fun n => (FordLower.nontrivialPreimages n).Nonempty)

noncomputable def FordLower.prefixDepths {k : ℕ} (p : Fin k → ℕ) (n : ℕ) : Finset ℕ :=
  (Finset.range (k + 1)).filter (fun j =>
    ∃ m ∈ FordLower.nontrivialPreimages n, FordLower.PrefixAgreement p j m)

noncomputable def FordLower.prefixDepth {k : ℕ} (p : Fin k → ℕ) (n : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  if h : (FordLower.prefixDepths p n).Nonempty then (FordLower.prefixDepths p n).max' h else 0

noncomputable def FordLower.prefixCollisionClass {k : ℕ} (F : Finset ℕ) (p : ℕ → Fin k → ℕ)
    (j : ℕ) : Finset ℕ :=
  (FordLower.externalTotientCollisions F).filter (fun n => FordLower.prefixDepth (p n) n = j)

noncomputable def FordLower.suffixCollisionFamily {k : ℕ} (F : Finset ℕ) (p : ℕ → Fin k → ℕ)
    (j : ℕ) : Finset ℕ :=
  (FordLower.prefixCollisionClass F p j).image (fun n => FordLower.suffixProduct (p n) j)

noncomputable def FordLower.suffixesUpTo {k : ℕ} (F : Finset ℕ) (q : ℕ → Fin k → ℕ)
    (j : ℕ) (Z : ℝ) : Finset ℕ :=
  (FordLower.suffixCollisionFamily F q j).filter (fun s => (s.totient : ℝ) ≤ Z)

noncomputable def FordAnalysis.g : ℕ → ℝ
  | 0 => 1
  | n + 1 => ∑ idx ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), FordAnalysis.coeff (idx + 1) * FordAnalysis.g (n - idx)
termination_by n => n
decreasing_by omega

noncomputable def FordAnalysis.gStar : ℕ → ℝ
  | 0 => 1
  | n + 1 => FordAnalysis.g (n + 1) + (1 - FordAnalysis.coeff 1) * FordAnalysis.g n

noncomputable def FordAnalysis.renewalDenominator (L : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  (∏ n ∈ Finset.range L, FordAnalysis.g n) * FordAnalysis.gStar L

noncomputable def FordGeometry.modelVolume (K : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  1 / ((K.factorial : ℝ) * FordAnalysis.renewalDenominator K)

noncomputable def FordGeometry.prefixDecay (M : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  4 * FordAnalysis.rho ^ M * Real.exp ((M : ℝ) / 9)

noncomputable def FordReciprocal.cubeErosion {L : ℕ} (E : Set (Fin L → ℝ)) (τ : ℝ) : Set (Fin L → ℝ) :=
  {x | ∀ e ∈ Set.Icc (fun _ : Fin L => -τ) (fun _ => τ), x + e ∈ E}

noncomputable def FordInner.innerRadius (d : ℕ) : ℝ := 4 + ((d : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2

noncomputable def FordInner.radiusMass : ℝ :=
  ∑' d : ℕ, (d : ℝ) * FordInner.innerRadius d * FordAnalysis.rho ^ d

noncomputable def FordInner.innerEpsilon : ℝ := 1 / (8 * (FordInner.radiusMass + 1))

noncomputable def FordInner.extraLoss (d : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  FordInner.innerEpsilon * FordInner.innerRadius d * FordAnalysis.rho ^ d

noncomputable def FordInner.lossSeq (L M j : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  if j < L then FordInner.baseLoss M (L - j) + FordInner.extraLoss (L - j) else 0

noncomputable def FordInner.tightParameter (L M j : ℕ) : ℝ := 1 - FordInner.lossSeq L M j

noncomputable def FordReciprocal.primeWindow (m : ℕ) : Finset ℕ :=
  (Finset.range (⌊Real.exp (Real.exp ((m : ℝ) + 1))⌋₊ + 1)).filter
    (fun p : ℕ => p.Prime ∧ Real.exp (Real.exp (m : ℝ)) ≤ (p : ℝ) ∧
      (p : ℝ) < Real.exp (Real.exp ((m : ℝ) + 1)))

noncomputable def FordOrder.unordered (L : ℕ) : Set (Fin L → ℝ) :=
  {x | FordGeometry.outerForm L x ≤ 1 ∧ ∀ idx, FordGeometry.tailForm idx x ≤ x idx}

noncomputable def FordOrder.slack {L : ℕ} (x : Fin L → ℝ) : Fin L → ℝ :=
  fun j => x j - FordGeometry.tailForm j x

noncomputable def FordOrder.weight (L : ℕ) (j : Fin L) : ℝ :=
  if j.val + 1 < L then FordAnalysis.g (j.val + 1) else FordAnalysis.gStar (j.val + 1)

noncomputable def FordOrder.invWeight (L : ℕ) (i j : Fin L) : ℝ :=
  if i.val ≤ j.val then
    (if j.val + 1 < L then FordAnalysis.g (j.val - i.val) else FordAnalysis.gStar (j.val - i.val))
  else 0

noncomputable def FordOrder.topCoeff (L : ℕ) (j : Fin L) : ℝ :=
  if j.val = 0 then 0
  else if j.val + 1 < L then FordAnalysis.g (j.val + 1) - FordAnalysis.g j.val
  else FordAnalysis.gStar (j.val + 1) - FordAnalysis.gStar j.val

noncomputable def FordOrder.adjCoeff (L : ℕ) (p j : Fin L) : ℝ :=
  if j.val + 1 = p.val then 1
  else if p.val < j.val then
    (if j.val + 1 < L then FordAnalysis.g (j.val - p.val + 1) - FordAnalysis.g (j.val - p.val)
     else FordAnalysis.gStar (j.val - p.val + 1) - FordAnalysis.gStar (j.val - p.val))
  else 0

noncomputable def FordOrder.cutWeight {n : ℕ} (b c : Fin n → ℝ) (d : ℝ) (p j : Fin n) : ℝ :=
  if j = p then b p / d else b j + (b p / d) * c j

noncomputable def FordBadFacet.shiftedFacet (q : ℕ → ℝ) (j k : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ idx : Fin k, fordWeight (idx.val + 1) * q (j + idx.val + 1)


def FordBadFacet.RowHolds (L : ℕ) (ξ q : ℕ → ℝ) (j : ℕ) : Prop :=
  if j = 0 then FordBadFacet.shiftedFacet q 0 L ≤ ξ 0
  else FordBadFacet.shiftedFacet q j (L - j) ≤ ξ j * q j


def FordBadFacet.FirstFailedRow (L : ℕ) (ξ q : ℕ → ℝ) (j : ℕ) : Prop :=
  j + 1 < L ∧ ¬ FordBadFacet.RowHolds L ξ q j ∧ ∀ idx < j, FordBadFacet.RowHolds L ξ q idx


noncomputable def FordBadFacet.firstFailedFacetValues (x : ℝ) (L : ℕ) (ξ : ℕ → ℝ) (j : ℕ) :
    Finset ℕ :=
  (totientsUpTo x).filter (fun m => ∃ N : ℕ, 0 < N ∧ N.totient = m ∧
    FordBadFacet.FirstFailedRow L ξ (FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeCoordinate (logLog x) N) j)


noncomputable def FordBadFacet.retainedFirstFailedValues (x : ℝ) (A L j : ℕ) : Finset ℕ :=
  (FordBadFacet.firstFailedFacetValues x L (FordGeometry.expandedParameter A) j).filter (fun m =>
    Real.sqrt x ≤ (m : ℝ) ∧ m ∉ FordBadFacet.badFacetValues x 2 (1 / 1000) ∧
      m ∉ fiveLogOmegaTotients x ∧ m ∉ largeSquareTotients x)


noncomputable def FordBadFacet.retainedFirstFailedSuffixes (x : ℝ) (A L j : ℕ) : Finset ℕ :=
  (totientsUpTo x).filter (fun m => ∃ N : ℕ, 0 < N ∧
    N.totient ∈ FordBadFacet.retainedFirstFailedValues x A L j ∧
    FordBadFacet.FirstFailedRow L (FordGeometry.expandedParameter A)
      (FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeCoordinate (logLog x) N) j ∧
    (FordBadFacet.ordinarySuffix N j).totient = m)


def FordBadFacet.IsFirstFailedSuffixValue (T : ℝ) (A L j m : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∃ N : ℕ, 0 < N ∧ (FordBadFacet.ordinarySuffix N j).totient = m ∧
    FordBadFacet.FirstFailedRow L (FordGeometry.expandedParameter A)
      (FordBadFacet.ordinaryPrimeCoordinate T N) j
